title: Ask a Language Model for Lottery Numbers: Concentration in Repeated Six-of-49 Outputs
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Data, code, and collector at github.com/Rankfor/rankfor-open (research/lotto-models)
summary: We evaluate six language-model configurations on requests for six distinct random integers from 1-49. Across 1,200 attempted calls using four English prompt variants, 1,184 responses yielded valid tickets. Effective diversity of number frequencies ranged from 9.9 to 18.0, compared with simulated fifth-percentile thresholds of 46.6-46.7 under independent uniform six-of-49 sampling at the corresponding sample sizes. Systems produced 8-93 distinct unordered tickets, and their modal tickets accounted for 22.5-68.0% of valid responses. Two archived Polish Lotto samples provided a physical-lottery comparison, with effective diversities of 41.1 and 41.4 at smaller sample sizes. These results demonstrate substantial concentration under the tested deployment settings. They do not identify its mechanism or establish performance under other prompts, temperatures, or tool configurations.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估六种语言模型配置在随机选号任务（1-49选6）上的多样性，发现其输出高度集中，远低于独立均匀抽样基准。但研究未揭示机制或验证其他设置下的表现。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型在生成随机数（如彩票选号）时是否能产生足够的多样性，以检验其在随机性任务上的部署表现。
AI.method: 对六种语言模型配置进行测试，使用四种英文提示变体，共1,200次调用，请求六个1-49之间不同随机整数。统计有效彩票数、数字频率的有效多样性、不同无序彩票数量及众数占比，并与独立均匀六选四十九抽样的模拟第五百分位阈值比较。另用两份波兰Lotto样本作实物彩票对照。
AI.result: 1,184次响应生成有效彩票；数字频率有效多样性为9.9-18.0，远低于模拟阈值46.6-46.7；不同无序彩票数为8-93，众数占比22.5%-68.0%；波兰Lotto样本的有效多样性为41.1和41.4（样本更小）。
AI.conclusion: 在测试的部署设置下，模型输出存在显著集中现象；但该结果未阐明其机制，也未确定在其他提示、温度或工具配置下的表现。

title: On-Device Commercial Intent Retrieval Under Size, Latency, and Privacy Constraints: A 3 MiB Retrieval System with Typed Egress Boundaries
comment: 36 pages, 40 tables, 1 figure. Evidence bundle (measurement ledgers and verification gates, no datasets): https://github.com/hyojunguy/ondevice-intent-evidence
summary:
We study commercial intent inference that runs entirely on the user's device, under three constraints frozen before the work began: the downloaded payload under 3 MiB, Tier-0 inference under 20 ms at p95, and no raw text, content embedding, or stable identifier leaving the device. Under them we build a retrieval path over a 6,020-leaf commercial taxonomy: a static embedding table distilled from a Korean sentence transformer, quantized to 4 bits, no inference runtime.
  Our main result is where that constraint costs accuracy. On real Korean commerce text labelled by others (22,900 AI-Hub shopping reviews), mid-category top-5 on real product names is 75.0% against an 18.4% permutation baseline, but splits on one observable: a query containing some leaf name as a substring scores 83.5%, one containing none 45.2%. A generic 196.6x larger teacher seemed to localize the gap (+20.1 pp without an anchor, +0.1 with). That null was two effects cancelling: the same teacher fine-tuned on the student's own contrastive pairs reaches 0.8586 and beats the pure-encoder student by +10.6 pp with an anchor and +20.9 pp without. The cost is not uniform, but it is not free anywhere; where the anchor is absent, task adaptation buys the teacher nothing, so what the constrained encoder lacks there is capacity. The expensive regime is detectable on-device from the ranker's own score margin: declining the least confident fifth lifts the rest to 0.8296.
  A second axis we first reported, a manufacturer model code, does not survive source-category fixed effects (-4.0 pp, p=0.51); the anchor does (+13.0 pp).
  Payload is 2,942,652 bytes, all three library links measured. Tier-0 p95 is 4.431 and 3.670 ms on two iPhones (A14, A16) and 5.080 ms on a budget Android tablet (Snapdragon 695), all slower than three server CPUs on the same code. Taxonomy supervision is mostly synthetic Korean utterances.

AI.tldr: 在设备端商用意图推断的三项冻结约束（载荷<3 MiB、Tier-0 延迟 p95<20 ms、无原始文本/嵌入/稳定标识符离端）下，构建基于 6,020 叶节点商用分类体系的检索路径：蒸馏自韩语句子编码器的静态嵌入表，4 比特量化，无推理运行时；核心发现是精度损失集中出现在查询不含任何叶名称子串的场景。
AI.motivation: 商用意图推断通常依赖服务端大模型，但隐私法规与延迟要求迫使其下沉到设备端。作者在事前固定的三项硬约束下，探究这类受限编码器究竟在何处损失精度、以及损失源于容量不足还是任务适配不足，从而判断约束的真实代价是否均匀分布。
AI.method: 构建 6,020 叶节点的商用分类体系检索路径：从韩语句子 transformer 蒸馏出静态嵌入表并 4 比特量化，取消推理运行时。在他人标注的真实韩语商务文本（22,900 条 AI-Hub 购物评论）上评估；以"查询是否包含某叶名称子串"作为可观测变量做分组对照；并与体积大 196.6 倍的通用教师模型、以及在同一对比学习对上微调后的教师做比较；另用秩排序器的分数裕度检测高成本区间。
AI.result: 真实商品名上中层类目 top-5 为 75.0%（置换基线 18.4%）；含叶名称子串时 83.5%，不含时 45.2%。通用大教师看似定位了差距（无锚 +20.1 pp、有锚 +0.1 pp），但该零效应是两个相反效应抵消：同一教师在学生对比对上微调后达 0.8586，较纯编码器学生有锚 +10.6 pp、无锚 +20.9 pp。无锚场景下任务适配无法弥补，说明是容量缺失。第二个轴（制造商型号代码）在控制来源类目固定效应后不显著（-4.0 pp，p=0.51），锚则显著（+13.0 pp）。载荷 2,942,652 字节，三条库链路均实测；Tier-0 p95 在两台 iPhone（A14/A16）为 4.431 与 3.670 ms，入门级 Android 平板（骁龙 695）为 5.080 ms。
AI.conclusion: 在设备端冻结约束下，精度代价并非均匀分布，而是集中在缺少叶名称锚点的查询上，其根因是编码器容量不足而非任务不适配；该高成本区间可仅凭排序器分数裕度在端侧检测，拒绝最不置信的五分之一可将其余样本提升至 0.8296。载荷与延迟均满足全部约束。

title: System Attribution in LLM Brand Recommendations: Single Responses Identify the System, Aggregated Brand Profiles Do Not Transfer
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Appendix D documents corrections to an earlier manuscript
summary: Audits of AI visibility summarise the brand recommendations of deployed language models into per-system profiles. We test whether such a profile describes the system on one corpus of 6,475 stored responses (6,324 analysable) collected between December 2025 and February 2026 from five deployed endpoints across gift-recommendation, corporate-reputation and category-ownership queries. The collection harness cut many answers short: 83.1% of Gemini 3 Flash answers in category ownership end mid-sentence under a 1,024-token output cap. With every answer cut to its first 800 characters, a character n-gram classifier cross-validated by prompt attributes one response to GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Flash, Gemini 3 Flash with search, Grok or Perplexity sonar-pro with 97.84% accuracy (5,028 responses, 383 prompts, majority class 31.5%, 30 split seeds). Length alone falls to the majority rate, 24 formatting statistics reach 95.79%, and masking brand names and capitalised tokens leaves 97.72%. Held-out query conditions keep 97.43% weighted by size and 88.0% unweighted; in a retrieval-grounded arm that changes the harness, no Grok answer is attributed to Grok (0/120). Aggregated into 50 model-by-domain-by-condition units, twelve behavioural features separate four systems at 66.53% under grouped cross-validation, against a label-permutation null with mean 33.71% and 95th percentile 46.0%. Across domains the aggregate profile fails: a forest trained on category-ownership units assigns all 22 gift units to the wrong system, consistent with a reversal in brand volume (8.41 against 0.94 brands per response in gifts, 3.01 against 3.91 in category ownership), while single responses transfer at 89.92% balanced accuracy. The surface form of an answer carries the system across the query domains tested; aggregated brand behaviour does not, and the uncrossed design cannot separate the system from the domain or the harness.

AI.tldr: 本文检验"AI可见性审计"中按系统汇总的品牌画像是否真正刻画该系统：单条回答的表面形式可高精度识别系统，但按模型-领域-条件聚合后的品牌行为特征在跨领域迁移时失效。
AI.motivation: AI可见性审计常将部署语言模型的品牌推荐汇总为"每系统画像"，本文质疑这种画像是否真的描述该系统本身，还是混杂了领域与采集工具（harness）的影响。
AI.method: 使用2025年12月至2026年2月从五个部署端点采集的6,475条存储回答（6,324条可分析），覆盖礼品推荐、企业声誉、品类归属三类查询。将每条回答截断至前800字符，用按提示属性交叉验证的字符n-gram分类器做系统归属；并对比长度基线、24项格式统计、品牌名与大写token掩蔽、留出查询条件、检索接地臂，以及聚合到50个"模型×领域×条件"单元后用12项行为特征做分组交叉验证与标签置换零假设检验。
AI.result: 字符n-gram分类器以97.84%准确率将回答归属到GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Flash、Gemini 3 Flash with search、Grok或Perplexity sonar-pro（5,028条回答、383个提示、多数类31.5%、30个划分种子）。仅用长度退化到多数类水平，24项格式统计达95.79%，掩蔽品牌名与大写token后仍有97.72%。留出查询条件下，按规模加权保持97.43%、不加权88.0%；在改变采集工具的检索接地臂中，Grok的回答无一被归为Grok（0/120）。聚合到50个模型×领域×条件单元后，12项行为特征在分组交叉验证下以66.53%区分四个系统（标签置换零假设均值33.71%、95分位46.0%）。跨领域时聚合画像失效：在品类归属单元上训练的森林把全部22个礼品单元都判给错误系统，与品牌数量的反转一致（礼品每回答8.41对0.94个品牌，品类归属3.01对3.91）；而单条回答迁移的平衡准确率为89.92%。
AI.conclusion: 回答的表面形式在该测试的查询领域间能稳定携带系统标识，但聚合的品牌行为不能；且未交叉的设计无法将系统与领域或采集工具分离。

title: A Shared Taste for Model-Written Text: The Generator-by-Selector Matrices of "AI-AI Bias" Show No Detectable Own-Model Premium
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Reanalysis of publicly available generator-by-selector matrices
summary: Laurito et al. (PNAS 2025) showed that large language models choosing between two descriptions of the same product, paper or film prefer the description written by a language model over the one written by a person, by a wide margin over what human judges do. Their design crosses five generators with the same five models as selectors, which permits a second question the paper does not headline: does a selector prefer text from its own model beyond what the generator and selector main effects predict? We rebuild the three 5x5 matrices from the per-item counts in the authors' public repository (21,828 valid trials; every cell matches the published value) and fit a two-way fixed-effects model with an own-model term gamma, tested by the exact permutation test over the 120 relabellings of the selectors. The premium is +0.013 on products (exact one-sided p = 0.24), -0.010 on paper abstracts (p = 0.74), +0.054 on films (p = 0.07) and +0.019 pooled (p = 0.14; 95% interval -0.008 to 0.046). The same-vendor term for the GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 pair is negative in all three datasets. Position bias moves single cells by up to 0.42 share points in either direction, and the own-model contrast is unchanged once order-driven items are removed. The design would have detected a premium of 0.05 with 82% (products), 88% (papers), 42% (films) and 97% (pooled) power; the minimum detectable effect at 80% power is 0.034 pooled. The absence is informative down to about 0.04 share points and silent below that. The 4x4 matrix of Tan et al. (ACL 2024) gives gamma = +0.148 at the smallest p its 24 relabellings allow, with a same-family term of the same size. The main result of Laurito et al. stands: models share a taste for model-written text, with GPT-4's descriptions chosen 77% to 95% of the time by every selector on products. What these data do not show is a model recognising and favouring its own prose.

AI.tldr: 重新分析Laurito等(PNAS 2025)的5x5选择矩阵，发现模型对自身生成文本并无显著偏好（gamma≈0.019, p=0.14），而Tan等(ACL 2024)的4x4矩阵显示较大自偏好效应；主结论"模型偏好模型文本"成立，但"自我识别偏好"缺乏证据。
AI.motivation: 原论文的设计交叉了5个生成器与同样的5个模型作为选择器，这隐含了一个原论文未重点讨论的问题：选择器是否在生成器和选择器主效应之外，额外偏好来自自身模型的文本（即自我模型偏好/self-preference）。作者希望检验这一"自我识别偏好"假设。
AI.method: 从作者公开仓库重建三个5x5矩阵（21,828个有效试次，每格与已发表值一致），拟合含own-model项gamma的两向固定效应模型，并用对选择器120种重标记的精确置换检验。同时评估位置偏置、剔除次序驱动项，并计算统计检验力与最小可检测效应；另对Tan等(ACL 2024)的4x4矩阵做同类分析。
AI.result: own-model溢价：产品+0.013(p=0.24)、论文摘要-0.010(p=0.74)、电影+0.054(p=0.07)、合并+0.019(p=0.14, 95%CI -0.008~0.046)。GPT-3.5/GPT-4同厂商项在三个数据集均为负。位置偏置可使单格移动至多0.42个百分点，剔除次序驱动项后对比不变。对0.05溢价的检验力分别为82%、88%、42%、97%，80%检验力下最小可检测效应为0.034(合并)。Tan等的4x4矩阵得gamma=+0.148(其24种重标记下最小p值)，同族项大小相当。
AI.conclusion: Laurito等的主结论成立：模型普遍偏好模型撰写的文本（GPT-4描述在所有选择器中被选率77%-95%）。但数据不支持模型能识别并偏爱自身文本；该"无效应"结果在约0.04个百分点以上具有信息量，以下则不敏感。

title: Comparison of Common Crawl News & GDELT
summary: The corpus of worldwide news is important for natural language processing, knowledge graphs, large language models, and other technical efforts. Additionally, this corpus is important for understanding the people, places, organizations, and events that interact in real-time every day. This paper compares two news datasets used for these tasks today, namely the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone (GDELT) and Common Crawl News. Our research highlights the strengths and limitations of each dataset, analyzing their content and coverage. Notably, while GDELT relies on broadcasts, prints, and web news from across the globe, Common Crawl focuses on news sites from around the world gathered through web crawling. Our analysis revealed considerable differences in where the two datasets gather their news sources.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了两个主流新闻语料库——GDELT与Common Crawl News，分析其内容与覆盖范围，揭示二者在新闻来源地理分布上的显著差异及各自的优势与局限。
AI.motivation: 全球新闻语料对自然语言处理、知识图谱和大语言模型等技术研究至关重要，也有助于理解每日实时互动的人物、地点、组织和事件。然而，不同新闻数据集在来源与覆盖上存在差异，亟需对其进行比较以明确各自适用场景。
AI.method: 选取GDELT（全球事件、语言与语调数据库）与Common Crawl News两个数据集，对其内容（content）与覆盖范围（coverage）进行对比分析。GDELT依赖全球的广播、印刷及网络新闻，而Common Crawl则聚焦于通过网络爬取获取的全球新闻站点。
AI.result: 分析发现，两个数据集在新闻来源的采集地点（即新闻来源的地理分布）上存在相当大的差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究凸显了GDELT与Common Crawl News各自的优势与局限，表明二者在新闻来源和覆盖范围上差异显著，使用者应根据具体任务需求选择合适的数据集。

title: CANOPY: Adaptive-Granularity Evidence Compression for Multimodal RAG
summary: Multimodal RAG retrieves text, tables, images, and videos, but choosing a retrieval granularity does not determine how much context to retain within each item. Coarse units include irrelevant content, while uniformly fine selection can remove context needed to interpret the evidence. Existing compressors address this trade-off with modality-specific mechanisms, leaving open a shared procedure for adapting the retained extent region by region across heterogeneous items. We introduce CANOPY (Canonical Projection over Hierarchy), a framework for adaptive-granularity post-retrieval evidence compression. CANOPY represents retrieved items as hierarchies and uses a node encoder fine-tuned on gold evidence to score regions against the query. Parent-relative refinement compares these scores to select multiple regions at different granularities without LLM calls for node-level pruning. Because compression cannot recover evidence that was never retrieved, a critic requests targeted follow-up retrieval when it judges the accumulated evidence insufficient; newly retrieved items are compressed before being added. Across five QA benchmarks over a 33M-item heterogeneous corpus, CANOPY achieves higher average answer accuracy than the evaluated retrieval baselines. Ablations indicate that additional retrieval drives the main accuracy gains on multi-hop QA. In the unrouted Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct setting, compression reduces reader-input evidence tokens by 14.2-27.7% relative to the same iterative pipeline without compression, with comparable answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: CANOPY：面向多模态RAG的自适应粒度检索后证据压缩框架，通过层次化表示与父子相对精细化实现按区域选择不同粒度，并配合critic触发定向补充检索。在5个QA基准、33M异构语料上取得更高平均准确率，压缩使reader输入证据token减少14.2–27.7%且准确率相当。
AI.motivation: 多模态RAG需检索文本、表格、图像与视频，但检索粒度无法决定每个条目内部应保留多少上下文：粗粒度单元会包含无关内容，统一细粒度选择又会删除理解证据所需的上下文。现有压缩器以模态专用机制处理该权衡，缺少一个可跨异构条目、逐区域自适应保留范围的共享流程。
AI.method: CANOPY（Canonical Projection over Hierarchy）将检索项表示为层次结构，使用在gold evidence上微调的node encoder对区域相对查询打分；通过parent-relative refinement比较分数，在不同粒度上选择多个区域，且节点级剪枝无需LLM调用。由于压缩无法恢复未被检索到的证据，critic在判断累积证据不足时发起定向后续检索，新检索项先压缩再加入。
AI.result: 在33M条目异构语料上的5个QA基准中，CANOPY平均答案准确率高于所评估的检索基线；消融表明额外检索是多跳QA准确率提升的主要来源。在未路由的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct设置下，相比无压缩的同款迭代流程，压缩将reader输入证据token减少14.2–27.7%，答案准确率相当。
AI.conclusion: CANOPY以统一的层次化框架实现跨模态、按区域自适应粒度的检索后证据压缩，在不牺牲答案准确率的前提下显著降低reader输入token，并通过critic驱动的补充检索缓解压缩不可恢复证据的局限；其收益在多跳QA中主要来自迭代检索。

title: RPTune: Learned Context Curation for LLM Catalog Search
summary:
For small merchant businesses (SMBs) whose catalogs fit within a long-context LLM, full-catalog prompting offers a compelling alternative to multi-stage retrieval designed primarily for large marketplaces with millions of items. However, fitting the full catalog into the context window does not ensure that the model can use it effectively, since LLMs do not exploit long contexts uniformly. We therefore study in-context catalog search through two complementary questions: (1) how to curate and present catalogs to the LLM, and (2) how to adapt the LLM for product selection on curated contexts.
  We propose RPTune, an end-to-end framework that couples learned catalog curation with LLM post-training using automatically generated, catalog-grounded supervision. An encoder-reorganizer curator orders and prunes products guided by downstream LLM feedback, while the resulting curated catalogs in turn improve the effectiveness of LLM post-training with a context-relative reward. We evaluate RPTune on 7 real merchants spanning distinct retail verticals, using 100 complex conversational queries per merchant. RPTune consistently improves search accuracy across both proprietary and open-weight LLMs, with context curation yielding gains of up to 31.4 percentage points and post-training adding a further 10.3 points on average.

AI.tldr: 提出RPTune框架，将可学习的商品目录筛选与LLM后训练耦合，通过自动生成、基于目录的监督提升小商户全目录上下文搜索的准确性。
AI.motivation: 面向商品目录可放入长上下文窗口的中小商户，全目录提示相比为大型市场设计的多阶段检索更具吸引力；但将整个目录塞入上下文窗口并不意味着模型能有效利用它，因为LLM对长上下文的利用并不均衡。因此需研究两个问题：如何为LLM策划与呈现目录，以及如何让LLM适应策划后上下文中的商品选择。
AI.method: 提出端到端框架RPTune，将可学习的目录策划与LLM后训练相结合，并使用自动生成、以目录为依据的监督信号。其中编码器-重组器式策划器（encoder-reorganizer curator）在下游LLM反馈指导下对商品进行排序与剪枝；由此得到的策划目录反过来借助上下文相对奖励（context-relative reward）提升LLM后训练的效果。
AI.result: 在7个真实商户（覆盖不同零售垂直领域）上评估，每个商户使用100条复杂对话式查询。RPTune在专有与开源权重LLM上均持续提升搜索准确率，上下文策划带来最高31.4个百分点的增益，后训练平均再增加10.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RPTune表明，面向SMB的全目录上下文搜索需同时解决目录策划与模型后训练两个环节；二者相互增强，可显著提升商品搜索准确率，为全目录提示范式提供了可行且有效的方案。

title: Do Multilingual Encoders Produce Language-Consistent Semantic IDs?
comment: 7 pages, 8 tables. Accepted as a short paper at WiNLP 2026, co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Semantic IDs (SIDs) compress item embeddings into discrete code sequences used in generative retrieval. We ask whether a multilingual encoder is sufficient for different-language renderings of the same product to receive language-consistent SIDs. Using Amazon ESCI listings rendered in English, Spanish, and Japanese, we test whether translations remain close to their English source, whether residual quantization is unusually sensitive to translation-induced movement, and whether multilingual or language-balanced quantizer fitting improves SID agreement. Multilingual E5 places translations measurably apart: under an English-heavy fit, a Japanese translation preserves the first SID code of its English counterpart in only 7.7% of cases, compared with 89.0% for an English rewording. Distance-matched product-directed controls produce nearly the same full-SID mismatch as translation, providing no evidence that the quantizer selectively amplifies language directions. Balancing the fitting mixture makes codebook use more uniform but further reduces cross-lingual prefix agreement: Spanish first-code consistency falls from 28.3% to 6.6%, while an English-only fit preserves it for 67.6% of Spanish translations. These results show that multilingual exposure and balanced codebook use alone do not guarantee language-consistent SIDs.

AI.tldr: 基于亚马逊ESCI英/西/日三语商品数据检验发现：多语言编码器不足以让同一商品的不同语言版本获得语言一致的语义ID（SID），且语言均衡拟合反而降低跨语言一致性。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索中SID由商品嵌入离散化得到，若同一商品不同语言渲染得到差异极大的SID，会破坏跨语言检索的一致性。作者追问：仅靠多语言编码器是否就能保证语言一致的SID，并进一步检验残差量化是否对翻译引起的嵌入位移异常敏感。
AI.method: 使用亚马逊ESCI商品列表的英语、西班牙语、日语三种语言版本。分三组实验：(1)检验翻译嵌入与英语源嵌入的距离邻近性；(2)比较翻译引起的位移与距离匹配的“面向同商品”对照位移对量化器的影响，以判断残差量化是否选择性放大语言方向；(3)对比多语言拟合、语言均衡拟合与纯英语拟合下的码本使用均匀度与跨语言SID一致率（首码一致、前缀一致）。
AI.result: 多语言E5将翻译嵌入显著分开：在以英语为主的拟合下，日语翻译与英语原文保持首个SID码一致的比例仅7.7%，而英语改写可达89.0%。距离匹配的对照产生的全SID失配与翻译几乎相同，说明量化器并未选择性放大语言方向。语言均衡拟合使码本使用更均匀，却进一步降低跨语言前缀一致率：西班牙语首码一致率从28.3%降至6.6%，而纯英语拟合在67.6%的西班牙语翻译上仍能保持首码一致。
AI.conclusion: 多语言暴露与码本均衡使用本身并不足以保证语言一致的SID。跨语言SID一致性并非源于编码器的多语言能力或量化器的语言方向偏好，而更多取决于拟合数据分布与量化对任意嵌入位移的普遍敏感性，提示需在量化目标或训练机制上专门引入跨语言对齐约束。

title: Learning to structure data from user-generated thematic corpora
summary: Thematic corpora, such as social media communities, contain unstructured text describing data that could be made structured. These include, for example, personal attributes, behaviors, and experiences mentioned in social media data. Extracting structured data is challenging as relevant attributes are often implicit, domain-dependent, and unknown in advance. We propose a fully automated, iterative framework for discovering and extracting domain-specific attribute schemas without a predefined ontology. Using large language models (LLMs), the framework induces candidate attributes, sequentially consolidates semantically overlapping attributes, and assigns a structural type. These enable creating an ontology and populating it with values from the corpus. The framework also enables the use of smaller LLMs for value extraction with estimable accuracy loss compared to large LLMs. We evaluate the framework on 5 health-related Reddit communities. Discovered attributes achieved 61% agreement with human-identified attributes, close to the 62% agreement between independent annotators. In most cases, the algorithm converges to a stable attribute set in fewer than 10 iterations. Structural type assignment achieves 82% accuracy, and value extraction reaches an F1 score of 0.8 compared to human annotations. Across four LLM families, smaller instruction-tuned models show statistically significant improvements in extraction performance with model scale when evaluated against a high-capacity reference LLM, supporting informed accuracy-cost trade-offs. These results show that attributes comparable to those identified by humans can be discovered automatically, enabling the creation of high-quality structured datasets economically and at scale. By removing the need for predefined ontologies, iterative model-driven schema induction offers a practical and scalable foundation for mining thematic corpora.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全自动、迭代的框架，无需预定义本体即可从主题语料中发现并抽取领域特定属性模式，并构建可填充的本体。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体等主题语料包含大量非结构化文本，其中隐含个人属性、行为与经历等信息。抽取结构化数据困难在于相关属性往往隐含、依赖领域且事先未知，且缺乏预定义本体。
AI.method: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的迭代框架：诱导候选属性，顺序合并语义重叠的属性，并赋予结构类型；据此创建本体并从语料中填充取值。同时支持使用较小LLM进行值抽取，并可与大LLM对比估计精度损失。
AI.result: 在5个健康相关Reddit社区上评估：发现的属性与人工识别属性一致率61%，接近独立标注者间62%的一致性；多数情况下算法在少于10次迭代内收敛到稳定属性集；结构类型分配准确率82%；值抽取相对人工标注F1为0.8。跨四个LLM家族，较小指令微调模型随规模增大抽取性能相对高容量参考LLM有统计显著提升，支持精度-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: 可自动发现与人工识别相当的属性，从而经济、大规模地创建高质量结构化数据集；无需预定义本体的迭代式模型驱动模式归纳为主题语料挖掘提供了实用且可扩展的基础。

title: From Rules to Neural Graphs: Scalable Structured Prediction for Patent Prior Art Search
comment: Accepted for publication at the ECML PKDD 2026 conference (Applied Data Science track)
summary: Patent search requires processing documents routinely exceeding tens of thousands of tokens. Most neural retrieval approaches operate on truncated inputs, limiting their effectiveness. Graph-based retrieval addresses this by representing each patent as a structured invention graph, but constructing these graphs relies on brittle rule-based parsers. We present the neural parser, which adapts biaffine attention from dependency parsing to predict invention graphs directly from patent text. Our local biaffine attention restricts pairwise scoring to a sliding window, reducing complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n \cdot w)$. Since local and global scoring share the same weights, the model trains on short sequences and deploys on documents exceeding 40,000 tokens without retraining. Distilled from 1 million rule-parsed documents, it surpasses its teacher at 3$\times$ lower inference cost: neural graphs improve citation recall by 0.5% on short queries and 1.1% on full documents in a downstream Graph Transformer retrieval system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经解析器,将依存句法分析中的双仿射注意力适配为直接从专利文本预测发明图,通过局部滑窗注意力将复杂度从O(n²)降至O(n·w),可在短序列训练、长文档(>40k tokens)部署,从百万级规则解析文档蒸馏后性能超过教师模型且推理成本降低3倍,在下游图Transformer检索中提升引用召回。
AI.motivation: 专利检索需处理常超万级token的文档,而多数神经检索方法受限于截断输入;基于图的检索用结构化发明图缓解此问题,但构图依赖脆弱的规则解析器。
AI.method: 提出神经解析器:将依存句法分析中的双仿射注意力适配,直接预测发明图;采用局部双仿射注意力,将成对打分限制在滑动窗口内;局部与全局打分共享权重,使短序列训练可泛化到长文档;从100万条规则解析文档中蒸馏。
AI.result: 复杂度由O(n²)降至O(n·w);短序列训练即可在超过40,000 token文档上部署而无需重训;性能超过教师模型,推理成本降低3倍;在下游图Transformer检索系统中,神经图使短查询引用召回提升0.5%,完整文档提升1.1%。
AI.conclusion: 该神经解析器以更低计算成本超越规则解析教师模型,生成的发明图可有效提升长文档专利检索的召回表现。

title: AgentWebRec: Compact Evidence Fusion over the Agent Web for Personalized Recommendation
summary: LLM-based personal agents are emerging as persistent carriers of user semantics and intermediaries between users and recommendation platforms, maintaining richer user knowledge locally. As agents interact with one another, the conventional \textit{User--Platform} relation evolves into a \textit{User--Agent Web--Platform} information pathway, enabling distributed user-side information to complement item-side information. This new pathway, however, defies conventional recommendation: evidence is scattered across mutually opaque agents and reachable only through bounded queries, only a small portion of it is relevant to the current recommendation decision, and the responses returned by different agents are semantically heterogeneous. We therefore recast recommendation over the agent web as a \emph{task-time evidence acquisition and fusion} problem under a finite evidence budget by deciding what to ask and what to keep, rather than learning from aggregated data. We propose AgentWebRec, a user-agent-oriented framework that progressively acquires and fuses distributed evidence for each user-item decision while keeping underlying agent memories local. It grounds each decision in platform-provided item semantics and task-relevant evidence from the target user agent's private memory, and conditionally queries neighboring user agents for complementary preference patterns when local evidence is insufficient. Experiments on four InstructRec datasets show that AgentWebRec consistently outperforms baseline recommenders, and ablations verify that the evidence layers contribute complementary gains.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 AgentWebRec，将 LLM 智能体网络上的推荐重构为有限证据预算下的任务时证据获取与融合问题，通过本地记忆检索与条件性邻居查询实现用户侧分布式证据的渐进式获取与融合。
AI.motivation: LLM 个人智能体正成为用户语义的持久载体及用户与推荐平台的中介，随着智能体间交互，传统“用户—平台”关系演变为“用户—智能体网络—平台”信息通路，可使用户侧分布式信息补充物品侧信息。但该通路对传统推荐构成挑战：证据分散在互相不透明的智能体之间，只能通过有限查询访问；仅有小部分证据与当前推荐决策相关；不同智能体返回的响应语义异构。
AI.method: 将智能体网络上的推荐重新表述为在有限证据预算下决定“问什么”与“保留什么”的任务时证据获取与融合问题，而非从聚合数据中学习。据此提出 AgentWebRec：面向用户—智能体，在保持底层智能体记忆本地化的前提下，为每个用户—物品决策渐进地获取并融合分布式证据。每个决策以平台提供的物品语义和目标用户智能体私有记忆中与任务相关的证据为依据，当本地证据不足时，有条件地向邻近用户智能体查询互补偏好模式。
AI.result: 在四个 InstructRec 数据集上的实验表明，AgentWebRec 一致优于基线推荐器；消融实验验证各证据层贡献互补增益。
AI.conclusion: AgentWebRec 以任务时证据获取与融合的视角，在保障智能体记忆本地化的同时有效利用用户侧分布式证据，验证了“用户—智能体网络—平台”新信息通路在推荐任务中的可行性与有效性。

title: Optimizing Effective Training Time for Large-Scale Recommendation Systems
summary: Lifecycle overhead silently consumes accelerator capacity across large-scale recommendation training fleets. Our largest recommendation workloads process tens of billions train- ing examples per day on thousands of GPUs. Before this work, only 50-60% of their end-to-end wall time advanced training on new data. We present a fleet-scale study of this lifecycle overhead and a set of optimizations spanning the full training stack. We use Effective Training Time (ETT%) as an operational framework to instrument lost time, localize it to independently owned infrastructure components, and expose work repeated across job restarts. This analysis guides optimizations like communication elimination and pipeline overlap during trainer initialization; dynamic-shape handling, autotuning pruning, and reusable Py- Torch 2 compilation caches; asynchronous checkpointing; stan- dalone model publishing; and reductions in recovery cost. We evaluate the optimizations on representative models and measure their impacts in our training fleet. ETT% improves on every benchmark, by 15.5% on average, and reaches 85% on our largest workload. Fleet-wide ETT% rose from about 80% to above 90% after deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大规模推荐模型训练集群中的"生命周期开销"问题，提出以有效训练时间占比（ETT%）为运营框架来定位时间损耗，并给出覆盖全训练栈的优化方案，使集群整体ETT%从约80%提升至90%以上。
AI.motivation: 最大的推荐训练工作负载每天在数千块GPU上处理数百亿训练样本，但端到端墙钟时间中仅50-60%真正用于在新数据上推进训练，其余被生命周期开销（初始化、重启重复工作、检查点、恢复等）静默消耗，造成大规模加速器算力浪费，因此需要系统性度量并消除这些开销。
AI.method: 提出以Effective Training Time（ETT%）作为运营框架，对各环节丢失时间进行埋点度量，将其归因到独立拥有的基础设施组件，并暴露作业重启期间重复执行的工作；基于该分析实施全栈优化：训练器初始化阶段的通信消除与流水线重叠、动态shape处理、自动调优剪枝、可复用的PyTorch 2编译缓存、异步检查点、独立模型发布以及降低恢复成本。
AI.result: 在代表性模型上评估：所有基准测试的ETT%均有提升，平均提升15.5%，最大工作负载达到85%；部署后集群整体ETT%从约80%上升到90%以上。
AI.conclusion: 生命周期开销是阻碍大规模推荐训练算力有效利用的重要隐性来源，通过ETT%框架对其进行可观测、可归因的度量，并配合跨训练全栈的针对性优化，可显著提升端到端有效训练时间比例，该框架与优化组合已在生产级训练集群中验证有效并可规模化落地。

title: Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS): Reducing Representational Complexity for Enterprise AI
summary:
Enterprise information is represented through artifacts shaped by applications, projects, technologies, organizational boundaries, and local requirements. These structures accumulate over time, creating representational complexity that must be maintained by the enterprise and interpreted by information consumers and AI systems. This paper introduces Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS) as reducing unnecessary representational complexity while preserving required information within a defined scope, and Enterprise Representation Complexity (ERC), a representation-neutral model for comparing complexity across representation states.
  ERC characterizes representational extent through four dimensions: Representation Objects, Interactions, Behaviors, and Supporting Sources. Objects, Interactions, and Behaviors form dependent categories, while Supporting Sources characterize representation exposure. ERC is defined at representation and task levels, enabling comparison and distinguishing architectural simplification from retrieval optimization.
  The paper develops two consequences of ERS. First, representational structures create lifecycle obligations for maintenance, governance, dependencies, change, enhancement, and operation. An economic model distinguishes recurring global representation cost, recurring task-level cost, and one-time transformation cost, enabling evaluation over a defined time horizon. Second, reductions in task-level ERC reduce the representational extent an AI system must identify, relate, and interpret. Text-to-SQL research provides evidence that reduced schema and reasoning complexity can improve reasoning accuracy.
  ERC is not a universal complexity, performance, or cost metric. It provides measurable architectural variables for comparing representational alternatives, transformation effects, economic outcomes, and AI reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出企业表示简化（ERS）与企业表示复杂度（ERC）模型，用四个维度（表示对象、交互、行为、支撑来源）刻画表示的复杂度范围，并给出生命周期义务与经济成本模型，以及任务级复杂度降低对AI推理（如Text-to-SQL）的潜在收益。
AI.motivation: 企业信息通过应用、项目、技术、组织边界与局部需求塑造的工件来表示，这些结构随时间累积，形成表示复杂度，需要企业持续维护，并由信息消费者与AI系统解释。为此需要明确的概念框架，用以界定并度量这种复杂度，从而支持简化的评估与比较。
AI.method: 提出ERS（在既定范围内减少不必要的表示复杂度、同时保留必需信息）与ERC（面向表示中立的复杂度比较模型）。ERC从四个维度刻画表示范围：表示对象、交互、行为、支撑来源；对象、交互、行为构成依赖类别，支撑来源刻画表示暴露。ERC在表示级与任务级定义，用于比较并区分架构简化与检索优化。进一步构建经济模型，区分经常性全局表示成本、经常性任务级成本与一次性转换成本，并给出时间范围内的评估。
AI.result: ERC提供了可度量的架构变量，用于比较不同表示方案、转换效果、经济结果与AI推理表现。分析给出两个后果：一是表示结构带来维护、治理、依赖、变更、增强与运行等生命周期义务；二是任务级ERC的降低减少AI系统需要识别、关联与解释的表示范围，Text-to-SQL研究表明模式与推理复杂度的降低可提升推理准确率。
AI.conclusion: ERC并非通用的复杂度、性能或成本指标，而是用于比较表示替代方案、转换效应、经济结果与AI推理绩效的可度量架构变量；ERS则是在限定范围内减少不必要表示复杂度的目标导向。

title: JoinGR: Learning to Traverse Join Graphs for Table Retrieval
summary: Retrieving the right tables is a prerequisite for Text-to-SQL over realistic databases. Dense table retrievers rank schema elements independently, but this ignores a key source of evidence: some required tables are not mentioned in the question and become identifiable only through their join relationships to already relevant tables. We introduce JOINGR, a join-aware table retrieval method that treats the database join graph as the retrieval space. Columns are represented as graph nodes, while intra-table and foreign-key relationships are represented as typed edges. Given a question, JOINGR selects semantically similar anchor tables, traverses join edges with a query-conditioned scorer, and aggregates the resulting edge deposits into table scores. The scorer is a lightweight MLP on top of frozen query, node, and edge embeddings, trained with a pairwise margin loss over gold tables. On BIRD and Spider datasets, JOINGR is competitive with the strongest retrieval baselines. On BEAVER, a challenging enterprise benchmark with multi-hop table requirements, JOINGR substantially improves recall over dense retrieval and re-ranking baselines. Cross-domain experiments show that the learned scorer transfers across benchmarks, indicating that the method captures reusable joingraph traversal behavior.

AI.tldr: JOINGR是一种连接感知的表检索方法，将数据库连接图作为检索空间，通过锚点表选择与边遍历聚合表分数，在BIRD、Spider上具竞争力，在BEAVER多跳场景显著优于稠密检索与重排序基线，且跨域可迁移。
AI.motivation: 真实数据库的Text-to-SQL需先检索正确表。稠密检索器独立地对模式元素打分，忽略了关键证据：部分必需表未在问题中出现，只能通过与已相关表的连接关系被识别出来。
AI.method: 把数据库连接图作为检索空间：列为图节点，表内关系与外键关系为带类型边。给定问题，先选语义相似的锚点表，用查询条件化的打分器遍历连接边，并将边上的累积量聚合为表分数。打分器是冻结的查询、节点、边嵌入之上的轻量MLP，用针对金标准表的成对边距损失训练。
AI.result: 在BIRD与Spider上，JOINGR与最强检索基线相当；在含多跳表需求的企业级基准BEAVER上，召回率大幅优于稠密检索与重排序基线；跨域实验显示学习到的打分器可跨基准迁移。
AI.conclusion: 将表检索置于连接图上、以查询条件化的边遍历补充未提及表，是提升多跳表检索的有效途径，且所学遍历行为具有可复用的泛化性。

title: Madeleine: Learning Involuntary Recall for Conversational Memory from Simulated Lives
summary: A long-term conversational assistant must recall the right memory at the right moment, yet the memory that matters most is often not similar to what the user says now. Current systems recover such associations by letting an LLM reason at write or read time, at a cost of hundreds to over a thousand LLM calls per memory bank and up to several thousand context tokens per query. We argue that association is a learnable relevance: the pointwise mutual information of memories under how human lives unfold. We introduce Madeleine, which learns amortized association: offline, an LLM life simulator writes simulated lives, whose cue-trigger pairs teach a query encoder a residual association on top of frozen similarity; online, it calls no LLM and plugs into any vector memory by replacing only the query encoder. On LoCoMo-Plus under the official protocol, Madeleine (I) reaches 66.6 when plugged into HyperMem, the highest among all systems evaluated under this protocol; (II) used alone, reaches the score of HyperMem as released (52.4 vs. 52.9) with zero LLM calls and about 1/21 of its answer context; and (III) lifts T-Mem by 26.2 points, significantly outperforms the same untrained backbone inside both systems, and leaves ordinary QA intact on the 4B backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Madeleine，将长期对话助手中的记忆关联建模为可学习的点互信息式相关性，通过离线"人生模拟器"生成模拟生活并构造线索-触发配对来训练查询编码器，使模型在冻结相似度基础上学习残差关联；在线推理阶段无需调用 LLM，可直接替换任意向量记忆系统的查询编码器，在 LoCoMo-Plus 上取得优异表现并大幅降低开销。
AI.motivation: 长期对话助手需要在恰当时刻召回恰当记忆，但最相关的记忆往往与用户当前话语并不相似。现有系统依赖 LLM 在写入或读取阶段进行推理来恢复这类关联，代价是每个记忆库需数百到上千次 LLM 调用，且每次查询消耗数千上下文 token，开销高昂。作者因此主张：关联性是一种可学习的相关性，即记忆在人类生活展开方式下的点互信息。
AI.method: Madeleine 学习摊销式关联（amortized association）。离线阶段，由 LLM 生活模拟器生成模拟人生，从中提取线索-触发配对（cue-trigger pairs），用于训练查询编码器，使其在冻结的相似度之上学习残差关联。在线阶段不调用任何 LLM，仅通过替换查询编码器即可接入任意向量记忆系统。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo-Plus 官方协议下：(I) 接入 HyperMem 时 Madeleine 达到 66.6，为该协议下所有评估系统中的最高分；(II) 单独使用时达到 HyperMem 发布版本的分数水平（52.4 对 52.9），且零 LLM 调用、答案上下文约为其 1/21；(III) 将 T-Mem 提升 26.2 分，在两个系统中均显著优于相同的未训练骨干，并在 4B 骨干上保持普通 QA 性能不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 关联性可以作为可学习的相关性被摊销学习，从而在无需在线 LLM 调用的前提下有效恢复长期记忆中的非相似关联；Madeleine 以即插即用方式显著提升多种向量记忆系统的表现，同时大幅降低计算与上下文开销，且不损害通用问答能力。

title: Not All Is Lost: Repairing Lossy User Preference States of Personalization Encoders
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Author-prepared archival version with expanded discussion and interpretation. 59 pages, including references and appendices
summary: Personalization encoders compress evolving interaction histories into preference states used to rank items or condition text generation. A task head operating only on this state can miss useful evidence that remains in the frozen encoder's cached representations for individual timesteps. We study this recoverability gap and propose REPAIR, which compares cached representations with the current preference state in a compact learned coordinate space. It resolves corrective evidence over extended history, recent interactions, and localized bursts. It then selects which patterns at which timesteps contribute and adds their aggregate correction to the state before the task head. Encoder-host repair reuses representations from the existing forward computation without re-encoding the history. Across MovieLens, PENS, MIND, and Amazon Reviews 2023, training only REPAIR improves MRR and nDCG@10 for all twelve representative recommendation hosts while both encoder and task head remain frozen. Head-only finetuning of the same hosts yields smaller gains. For example, Mamba4Rec on MovieLens gains 3.96 MRR points, compared with 0.19 from head-only finetuning. Rank and temporal diagnostics support a compact, host-dependent corrective structure. In personalized generation, IMPerSumm improves the two reported weighted PerSEval variants, which assess responsiveness to user preference, by up to 25.23%. These results support post-compression state correction and distinguish the availability of preference evidence from its downstream use.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 REPAIR：在冻结的个性化编码器与任务头之间，用紧凑学习坐标空间比较缓存表示与当前偏好状态，选择性聚合纠正证据并加回状态，实现无需重编码历史的"编码器宿主修复"。
AI.motivation: 个性化编码器将演化交互历史压缩为偏好状态，仅基于该状态的任务头可能遗漏仍存在于冻结编码器各时间步缓存表示中的有用证据，存在"可恢复性缺口"。
AI.method: REPAIR 在紧凑学习坐标空间中比较缓存表示与当前偏好状态，覆盖长历史、近期交互与局部突发的纠正证据，并选择哪些时间步的哪些模式参与，将其聚合修正量在任务头之前加回状态；编码器与任务头均保持冻结，复用现有前向计算的表示，无需重新编码历史。
AI.result: 在 MovieLens、PENS、MIND、Amazon Reviews 2023 上，仅训练 REPAIR 即在全部 12 个代表性推荐宿主上提升 MRR 与 nDCG@10；例如 MovieLens 上 Mamba4Rec 提升 3.96 MRR 点，而仅微调任务头仅 0.19。排序与时间诊断支持紧凑、宿主相关的纠正结构。个性化生成中 IMPerSumm 在两个加权 PerSEval 变体上最高提升 25.23%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"压缩后状态纠正"范式，并区分偏好证据的可用性与下游使用之间的差距。

title: Neither Black nor White: Balancing Semantic and Collaborative Signals with Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS)
summary: Existing work on Semantic IDs (SIDs) for generative recommendation treats SID construction as a representation learning problem: encode items into a quantised latent space and read off codes. We argue this view is incidental. SID construction is, at heart, a recursive clustering problem, and once stated this way the natural object to cluster is a graph whose nodes carry semantic content and whose edges carry collaborative signal; SID assignment becomes a hierarchical graph partition. This reframing yields a unified framework, Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS), that subsumes prior approaches rather than displacing them. RQ-VAE and RQ-KMeans are recovered as the special case where the graph is empty, exposing content-only quantisation as one corner of a larger design space along two so-far-collapsed axes: graph construction and recursive partition algorithm. We explore two contrasting instantiations: RecDMoN, which performs hierarchical assignment via differentiable graph pooling, and RQ-GAE, which extends RQ-VAE with graph-aware item representations and a graph reconstruction objective. On multiple real-world datasets, GrIS consistently improves over CF-aware SOTA, with gains of up to +52\% Hit@10. Because graph construction and partition are explicit, separately configurable components, improvements on either axis can be combined and evaluated systematically.

AI.tldr: 本文将语义ID(SID)构建重新定义为递归聚类问题，提出图信息语义ID(GrIS)统一框架，把SID分配视为分层图划分，并实例化为RecDMoN与RQ-GAE两种方法，在真实数据集上显著优于现有CF感知方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐的SID工作将SID构建视为表征学习问题（把物品编码到量化隐空间再读取码），作者认为这一视角是附带的、非本质的；SID构建本质上是递归聚类问题。
AI.method: 提出GrIS框架：将SID构建建模为在同时承载语义内容（节点）与协同信号（边）的图上进行分层图划分，从而把SID分配分解为两个可配置轴——图构建与递归划分算法；并给出两种实例化：RecDMoN（通过可微图池化做分层分配）和RQ-GAE（在RQ-VAE上加入图感知物品表征与图重构目标）。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上，GrIS持续优于CF感知的SOTA方法，Hit@10提升最高达+52%。
AI.conclusion: RQ-VAE与RQ-KMeans被证明是图中无边的特例，内容-only量化只是更大设计空间的一个角落；由于图构建与划分是显式、可分别配置的组件，两条轴上的改进可被组合并系统评估，从而形成统一且可扩展的SID构建框架。

title: A Matryoshka Hierarchical RAG for Efficient Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for multi-hop Question Answering (QA) must balance retrieval quality with computational cost. This cost is incurred during indexing time, through the use of expensive Knowledge Graphs (KGs) or Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate summaries, or during querying, through iterative LLM-driven retrieval. To reduce it while maintaining retrieval quality, we present MatRAG, a hierarchical framework that combines RAG systems with Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL). MatRAG addresses both kinds of cost by aligning the semantic hierarchy of a clustering structure with the nested structure of MRL. Specifically, it organizes the corpus of documents into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of clusters with progressively coarser granularity. Each level is indexed by a lower Matryoshka dimension. MatRAG pairs an iterative, top-down traversal of the DAG with an entity-driven mechanism that controls the hop budget and re-ranks candidates. We evaluated MatRAG on three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks against seven representative baselines. MatRAG outperforms its strongest competitors in terms of retrieval quality; furthermore, it reduces indexing costs by avoiding KG construction and LLM-based summarization, and lowers query-time costs through dimension-aware similarity.

AI.tldr: MatRAG将RAG与Matryoshka表示学习（MRL）结合，构建由粗到细的层次化聚类DAG，各层用不同Matryoshka维度索引，并配合自顶向下遍历与实体驱动的跳数控制与重排序，在降低索引与查询成本的同时提升多跳QA检索质量。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答的RAG系统需在检索质量与计算成本间权衡：索引阶段依赖昂贵的知识图谱构建或LLM摘要生成，查询阶段依赖迭代式LLM驱动检索。作者希望在保持检索质量的前提下同时降低这两类成本。
AI.method: 提出MatRAG层次化框架，将RAG与Matryoshka表示学习（MRL）结合。核心是对齐聚类结构的语义层次与MRL的嵌套结构：将文档语料组织为粒度由细到粗的多层聚类有向无环图（DAG），每一层用更低的Matryoshka维度索引。检索时采用迭代式自顶向下DAG遍历，并引入实体驱动机制来控制跳数预算（hop budget）并对候选进行重排序。
AI.result: 在三个标准多跳QA基准上与七个代表性基线对比，MatRAG在检索质量上优于最强竞争者；同时通过避免知识图谱构建与LLM摘要降低了索引成本，并借助维度感知相似度计算降低查询时成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过将层次化聚类结构与Matryoshka嵌套表示对齐，MatRAG实现了检索质量与计算效率的联合优化，为多跳QA提供了一种低成本、高质量的RAG方案。

title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research
summary: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ScholarCatalyst 数据集与"作者标注"检索任务：让 207 篇近期计算机科学论文的 184 位第一作者标注哪些早期论文真正（或可能）推动了该项目，并给出理由；在该任务上，智能体检索（0.42 R@20）不如嵌入检索（0.48），即使基于 Claude Fable 5.1 的智能体也仅达 0.51，说明模型尚缺乏专家式的文献检索直觉。
AI.motivation: 科学家在"感知某个新问题需要哪篇被埋没的早期工作"这一能力上仍远超 AI。作者希望将这种隐性科研直觉显性化、可评测化，从而为科学智能体提供训练与评测基础。
AI.method: 构建可扩展的自动化作者标注流程；邀请 184 位第一作者（对应 207 篇近期 CS 论文）标注哪些候选论文推动或可能推动其项目，并附详细理由；据此设计检索任务：给定初始研究问题，只能从项目开始时已存在的文献中检索这些论文；对比嵌入检索、智能体检索及基于 Claude Fable 5.1 的智能体。
AI.result: 智能体检索并不优于嵌入检索（Recall@20 0.42 vs. 0.48），尽管其将同一检索器作为工具调用；即便使用可能已在训练中见过完整论文的 Claude Fable 5.1 智能体，也仅达 0.51 R@20。
AI.conclusion: 现有方法在专家式文献检索上仍有明显不足，需要新的训练范式来赋予模型面向大规模语料的专家直觉。ScholarCatalyst 被视为迈向"能接收半成型想法并指向所需先行研究"的科学智能体的一步。

title: Supporting Perspective Acquisition and Opinion Formation on Societal Issues Through AI-Generated Japanese Rap Battle Debates
summary: Acquiring diverse perspectives and forming informed opinions on societal issues are essential for critical thinking and informed decision-making. Although observing debates between opposing viewpoints can promote perspective acquisition, conventional debates require substantial time and human resources, limiting their accessibility. This study investigates whether brief AI-generated rap battle-style debates can support perspective acquisition and opinion formation on societal issues. Rap battles are debate-style performances in which opposing viewpoints are expressed through rhymed verses, making them engaging while preserving the structure of argumentative dialogue. To conduct this investigation, we automatically generated rap battle-style debates using GPT-5.4-mini and presented them to participants with synthesized audio through a web-based viewing interface. We evaluated the educational effectiveness of this approach through a user study involving six participants who viewed 40 debates generated from topics on societal issues used in the All Japan Junior and Senior High School Debate Championships. The results showed that watching approximately 1.5 minute rap battle-style debates nearly doubled the number of opinions and discussion points identified by participants. Furthermore, participants reconsidered or changed their stances in 52.5% of the evaluated cases. These findings demonstrate that even brief AI-generated rap battle-style debates can effectively support perspective acquisition and opinion formation on societal issues.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨短视频形式的AI生成说唱对战（rap battle）辩论能否促进受众获取多元视角并形成观点。利用GPT-5.4-mini自动生成说唱对战式辩论，配以合成音频并通过网页界面呈现，进行6人、40个社会议题的用户研究。结果显示，观看约1.5分钟的说唱对战辩论使参与者识别的观点与讨论点数量几乎翻倍，且在52.5%的评估案例中参与者重新考虑或改变了立场，表明简短的AI生成说唱对战辩论可有效支持视角获取与观点形成。
AI.motivation: 获取多元视角并就社会议题形成有依据的观点，对批判性思维与知情决策至关重要。观察对立观点之间的辩论虽有助于视角获取，但传统辩论耗费大量时间与人力资源，可及性受限。因此作者希望探索一种低成本、短时长且具吸引力的辩论呈现形式，以提升公众接触多元观点的机会。
AI.method: 采用说唱对战（rap battle）这一以押韵歌词表达对立立场、同时保留论证对话结构的辩论式表演形式。使用GPT-5.4-mini自动生成说唱对战式辩论文本，并通过合成音频与基于网页的观看界面呈现给参与者。以全日本初高中辩论锦标赛使用的社会议题为素材，生成40个辩论，开展6名参与者参加的用户研究，评估其教育效果。
AI.result: 观看约1.5分钟的说唱对战式辩论后，参与者识别出的观点与讨论点数量几乎翻倍；在52.5%的评估案例中，参与者重新考虑或改变了自己的立场。
AI.conclusion: 即使是简短的AI生成说唱对战式辩论，也能有效支持社会议题上的视角获取与观点形成，说明该类自动生成、短时长的辩论形式具有作为批判性思维教育手段的潜力。

title: Frozen Scenes, Shifting Winners: Configuration Fragility in Text-to-3D Evaluation
summary: Can a text-to-3D leaderboard change when every generated scene stays fixed? We audit this question for rendered-image evaluation, where camera settings and caption wording become part of the measurement protocol. Across 300 frozen scenes from six generators, we vary eight render and caption factors for 19 alignment evaluators plus one perceptual-quality control, then test four targeted scene degradations. Peak configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 17/19 alignment evaluators, with prompt-bootstrap lower bounds above 1 for 11/19. Rankings are more stable than scores, yet 18/19 evaluators change their point-estimate winner under some configuration. Pairwise protocol margin envelopes show which comparisons keep their direction across the tested settings. Selected pairs have opposite pointwise intervals, but no reversal survives simultaneous inference over the full search. Thus the observed winner changes are descriptive, not confirmed changes in generator superiority. Sensitivity remains separate: no evaluator, even the prompt-free control, exceeds 67% tie-adjusted directional discrimination on layout scrambling, which is diagnostic rather than human-validated ground truth. The audit separates score stability, decision uncertainty, and targeted sensitivity, and recommends reporting (generator, score, card ID) with protocol-dependent comparisons and selection-aware uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了文本到3D渲染图像评测的协议依赖性：在300个固定场景、六个生成器、八种渲染与字幕配置下，19个对齐评测器中有17个的配置间方差超过生成器间方差，排名虽较分数稳定但18/19的赢家仍会改变；同步推断后无方向翻转可被确认，且所有评测器在布局打乱上的方向判别均不超过67%。
AI.motivation: 文本到3D排行榜通常以渲染图像为评测对象，但相机设置与字幕措辞本身构成测量协议的一部分。若场景固定而协议可变，排行榜的稳定性与结论可靠性存疑，作者因此系统审计这一问题的严重程度。
AI.method: 使用六个生成器的300个冻结场景，变化八种渲染与字幕因素，评测19个对齐评测器加一个感知质量对照，并施加四种针对性场景退化；通过配置方差与生成器方差的比较、prompt-bootstrap下界、排名与分数稳定性分析、成对协议边际包络以及全搜索同步推断来量化协议依赖性；另以布局打乱任务评估Tie-adjusted方向判别率作为独立敏感性诊断。
AI.result: 17/19对齐评测器的峰值配置方差超过生成器间方差，11/19的prompt-bootstrap下界大于1；排名比分数更稳定，但18/19的评测器仍会在某些配置下改变点估计赢家。成对协议边际包络显示部分比较方向可保持，选中配对存在相反的点状区间，但在全搜索同步推断下没有翻转能存活，因此赢家变化只是描述性而非确证性的优越性变化。敏感性方面，包括无prompt对照在内，没有评测器在布局打乱上超过67%的Tie-adjusted方向判别率。
AI.conclusion: 该审计将分数稳定性、决策不确定性与针对性敏感性区分开来，建议在报告排行榜时给出（生成器、分数、卡片ID）三元组，并采用协议依赖的比较方式与考虑选择效应的不确定性；同时指出布局打乱的判别结果仅为诊断性，而非经人类验证的真值。

title: PLACE: Positional Latent Adaptation via Conditioned Embeddings for Binaural Audio Generation
summary: We present PLACE, a method that extends the pretrained any-to-audio model AudioX for binaural generation from arbitrary combinations of text, video, and optional audio prompts. PLACE augments video conditioning with Perception Encoder Core features, aligns text and video representations to derive spatial cues, and applies a conditioning-dependent low-rank transformation to the generated latent. The adapter is supervised via decoded-audio interaural level and time difference objectives. Trained on MRSAudio, PLACE improves most metrics over ViSAGe on FAIR-Play and achieves an improved SpatialCLAP score over SpatialSonic on the BEWO-1M Single Static test split. Listener evaluations favor PLACE for video-to-audio and out-of-distribution text-to-audio generation, demonstrating flexible multimodal control and improved spatial consistency.

AI.tldr: PLACE 将预训练的任意到音频模型 AudioX 扩展至双耳音频生成，通过感知编码器特征增强视频条件、对齐文本与视频表示以推断空间线索，并用条件相关的低秩变换调制潜在表示，在多项空间音频指标和听感评测上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 现有任意到音频模型多面向单声道生成，缺乏对双耳空间信息的建模能力，难以从文本、视频及可选音频的任意组合中生成具有正确空间感的音频。
AI.method: 在 AudioX 基础上引入适配器：以 Perception Encoder Core 特征增强视频条件；对齐文本与视频表示以导出空间线索；对生成潜在表示施加条件依赖的低秩变换；并以解码音频的双耳级间电平差与时间差目标进行监督，在 MRSAudio 上训练。
AI.result: 在 FAIR-Play 上多数指标优于 ViSAGe，在 BEWO-1M Single Static 测试划分上的 SpatialCLAP 分数优于 SpatialSonic；听感评测在视频到音频及分布外文本到音频生成任务中更偏好 PLACE。
AI.conclusion: PLACE 以轻量适配方式赋予预训练任意到音频模型双耳生成能力，实现灵活的多模态控制与更好的空间一致性。

title: Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio
summary: Recent joint audio-video generative models can synthesize realistic videos with synchronized sound, but typically generate audio as a single mixed track. This limits source-level control and differs from practical audiovisual workflows, where speech, music, sound effects, and ambient sounds are represented as separate editable tracks. We introduce Soundwich, a training-free framework that transforms a frozen joint audio-video flow-matching model into a generator of multiple synchronized, independently editable audio stems coupled to a shared video. Soundwich generates separate audio stems with explicit control over their temporal activity. To keep separately generated sounds coherent, we introduce a shared scene representation that communicates global audiovisual context across stems while preserving their source-level separation. We further route cross-modal interactions between each audio stem and its corresponding visual source, improving audiovisual consistency. The resulting stems remain synchronized with the video and can be independently retimed, muted, replaced, or remixed. Experiments and human evaluations show improved temporal control, source separation, and naturalness, while enabling flexible source-level editing within coherent audiovisual generation. Code is available at https://github.com/CodyNing/Soundwich.

AI.tldr: 提出 Soundwich，一种免训练框架，可将冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型改造为生成多个与共享视频同步、可独立编辑音频音轨（stems）的生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型通常只生成单一混合音轨，限制了声源级控制，且与实际工作流中将语音、音乐、音效、环境声分离为可编辑轨道的需求不符。
AI.method: 免训练地将冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型转化为多音轨生成器：生成独立音轨并显式控制其时间活动；引入共享场景表示传递全局音视频上下文以保持音轨间一致性，同时保留声源级分离；进一步路由每个音轨与其对应视觉源之间的跨模态交互以提升音视频一致性。
AI.result: 实验与人类评估表明，在时间控制、声源分离和自然度方面均有提升，并支持在连贯的音视频生成中实现灵活的音源级编辑；音轨与视频保持同步，可独立重定时、静音、替换或重混。
AI.conclusion: Soundwich 以免训练方式实现了多音轨、可控、可编辑的同步音视频生成，弥补了单一混合音轨在声源级控制上的不足，代码已开源。

title: Supervising Sound Localization by In-the-wild Egomotion
comment: CVPR 2025 Highlight (IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition)
summary: We present a method for learning binaural sound localization using egomotion as a supervisory signal. Over the course of a video, the cameras direction to a sound source will change as the camera moves. We train an audio model to predict sound directions that are consistent with visual estimates of camera motion, which we obtain using traditional methods from multi-view geometry. This provides a weak but plentiful form of supervision that we combine with traditional binaural cues. To evaluate this method, we propose a dataset of real-world audio-visual videos with egomotion. We show that our model can successfully learn from real-world data and that it performs well on sound localization tasks

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用相机自运动（egomotion）作为监督信号来学习双耳声源定位的方法，结合传统双耳线索，并构建了真实音视频数据集进行验证。
AI.motivation: 声源定位通常需要昂贵的标注数据（如声源方位真值）。本文希望利用视频中相机移动导致的声源方向变化这一自然现象，获得廉价且大量的弱监督信号，从而减少对人工标注的依赖。
AI.method: 将相机自运动作为监督信号：在视频中，相机移动会使声源相对相机的方向发生变化。采用多视图几何的传统方法从视频中估计相机运动，得到视觉方向估计，并训练音频模型预测与之一致的声源方向，同时融合传统双耳线索作为补充监督。此外构建了一个包含自运动的真实音视频数据集用于评估。
AI.result: 模型能够从真实世界数据中成功学习，并在声源定位任务上取得良好表现；所提出的数据集也为该任务提供了真实场景下的评测基准。
AI.conclusion: 利用自运动作为弱监督信号进行双耳声源定位是可行且有效的，能够在真实数据上取得良好性能，为减少声源定位标注成本提供了新思路。

title: Exploring Weaknesses of Generative Image Watermarks against Latent Frequency Masking
comment: This work has been accepted for publication at IEEE ICDM 2026 conference. The final published version will be available via IEEE Xplore
summary: Invisible watermarking has become a central tool for tracing AI-generated images, but its robustness against adaptive removal attacks remains an open security question. We introduce Latent Frequency Masking, an attack that erases watermark evidence by replacing selected Fourier coefficients in the latent representation of a watermarked image. The replacement can be sampled from Gaussian noise for efficiency or derived from diffusion regeneration for improved image preservation. We provide a theoretical distortion bound relating the change between the reconstructed adversarial image and the masked latent-frequency perturbation. We evaluate the proposed attack against six diffusion watermarking methods on images generated from DiffusionDB and MS-COCO prompts. Latent Frequency Masking removes or substantially weakens several watermarks while preserving perceptual quality and achieving favorable runtime compared with existing attacks. These results identify latent-frequency manipulation as a practical attack surface and highlight the need to include such attacks in robustness evaluations of generative image watermarking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出潜频掩蔽（Latent Frequency Masking）攻击，通过在潜表示中替换选定傅里叶系数来擦除水印，并在六个扩散水印方法上验证其有效性与效率。
AI.motivation: 隐形水印已成为追踪AI生成图像的核心手段，但其面对自适应移除攻击的鲁棒性仍是未解的安全问题，需要揭示潜频操作这一攻击面并促使其纳入鲁棒性评估。
AI.method: 替换带水印图像潜表示中的选定傅里叶系数：替换值可采样自高斯噪声以提升效率，或由扩散再生得到以改善图像保真；同时给出将重建对抗图像与潜频扰动关联的理论失真界。
AI.result: 在DiffusionDB与MS-COCO提示生成的图像上对六种扩散水印方法评估，该攻击可移除或显著削弱多种水印，同时保持感知质量并在运行时间上优于现有攻击。
AI.conclusion: 潜频操纵是一种实用的攻击面，生成式图像水印的鲁棒性评估应纳入此类攻击。

title: Bounded-Fidelity Sim-as-Demo-Stage: Mocap Handoff for Governance Benchmarks
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Reference implementation and data: https://github.com/s20sc/bounded-fidelity-mocap-handoff
summary: Sim-to-real research pursues physics fidelity as a primary objective: simulators are judged by how closely they reproduce real-world contact dynamics. For governance benchmarking of LLM-driven robots, where the simulator demonstrates that an admission/policy/contract/audit pipeline behaves correctly, contact fidelity at object handoffs (grasp, carry, place) becomes a liability: contact-force integration noise injects audit-chain divergence that is structurally unrelated to the governance property under test. We propose bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage, a design pattern that suppresses contact physics within explicitly bracketed handoff envelopes while preserving full dynamics elsewhere. The construction uses MuJoCo's mocap-body primitive driven by a 220-line Python adapter that the governance bridge invokes via structured intents. We formalise audit-chain stability as byte-equality of the hashed event log across replays and identify two structural envelope properties that imply it. Across N=1000 replays per posture, the mocap variant produces one distinct audit-chain hash (1000/1000 byte-identical; Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]); the contact-force baseline produces 584 distinct hashes (993/1000 diverged; CI [0.987, 0.998]). A timestep sweep (1, 2, 5, 10 ms) shows the divergence is structural, not a tuning artefact: it stays at 0.985 at every timestep. Envelope-edge timing jitter (+/-10 simulation steps, 1,400 replays) produces 0 divergence, and audit chains remain byte-equal across K in {1, 2, 3} sequentially handed-off objects (1,500 replays) with sub-linear per-pick-and-place overhead. The pattern gives benchmark designers audit-chain reproducibility at near-zero engineering cost; we also map where it is harmful (sim-to-real validation, policy training, contact-rich tasks) so it is not mis-deployed.

AI.tldr: 提出"有界保真度仿真即演示阶段"设计模式：在显式括起的交接包络内抑制接触物理，其余部分保留完整动力学，以消除审计链分歧并保证回放字节一致。
AI.motivation: 仿真到现实研究以物理保真度为首要目标，但在LLM驱动机器人的治理基准测试中，交接处（抓取、搬运、放置）的接触力积分噪声会注入与所测治理属性无关的审计链分歧，接触保真度反而成为负担。
AI.method: 基于MuJoCo的mocap-body原语，配合220行Python适配器，由治理桥接层通过结构化意图调用；将审计链稳定性形式化为哈希事件日志跨回放的字节相等性，并识别两个隐含该性质的包络结构属性。
AI.result: 每种姿态N=1000次回放：mocap变体产生1个唯一审计链哈希（1000/1000字节一致，Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]）；接触力基线产生584个不同哈希（993/1000分歧，CI [0.987, 0.998]）。时间步扫描（1、2、5、10 ms）显示分歧率为0.985，属结构性而非调参问题。包络边缘时序抖动（±10仿真步，1400次回放）产生0分歧；K∈{1,2,3}顺序交接对象时审计链保持字节相等（1500次回放），每次抓取放置开销呈次线性。
AI.conclusion: 该模式以近乎零工程成本为基准设计者提供审计链可复现性；同时界定其不适用场景（仿真到现实验证、策略训练、接触密集任务），避免误用。

title: Multi-Reference Path Tracking Control for an Agricultural Tractor with Nonlinear Model Predictive Control
summary: Guiding a tractor along a predefined reference path is a key component of precision agriculture. This study develops a path tracking controller based on Nonlinear Model Predictive Control, which incorporates multiple segments of a piecewise-linear reference path directly into the objective function. In addition, methods for selecting viable reference segments from the full path are presented. The control system is evaluated during a field test with a tractor controlled via the Tractor Implement Management steering interface. The NMPC solver converged on average after 3.45 ms and tracked the curved reference path with a mean absolute cross-track error of 6.1 cm.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）的拖拉机路径跟踪控制器，将分段线性参考路径的多段直接纳入目标函数，并给出可行的参考段选取方法。田间试验经Tractor Implement Management转向接口控制拖拉机，求解器平均3.45 ms收敛，曲线路径跟踪的平均绝对横向误差为6.1 cm。
AI.motivation: 引导拖拉机沿预定参考路径行驶是精准农业的关键环节，需要高精度且可实时求解的路径跟踪控制方法。
AI.method: 构建非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）路径跟踪控制器，将分段线性参考路径的多个路段直接嵌入目标函数，并提出从完整路径中选取可用参考路段的方法；通过Tractor Implement Management转向接口在田间试验中控制拖拉机进行验证。
AI.result: NMPC求解器平均在3.45 ms内收敛；拖拉机跟踪曲线参考路径的平均绝对横向误差为6.1 cm。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的NMPC路径跟踪控制器在田间试验中表现出良好的实时性与跟踪精度，适用于精准农业中拖拉机的路径跟踪任务。

title: Probabilistic Plan Legibility with Off-the-shelf Planners
comment: Accepted at the 9th ICAPS Workshop on Planning and Robotics. ICAPS 2021
summary: Legible planning is the creation of plans that best disambiguate their goals from a set of other candidates from an observer's perspective. In this paper we propose a method for legible planning for arbitrary PDDL domains, by extending previous research on legibility to classical planning without requiring to construct ad-hoc planners. We also discuss how the observer perspective may be estimated through a second order theory of mind that connects the planner's and the observer's task spaces. Our solution can for example be deployed in human-robot teaming scenarios, where an autonomous robot in a team can implicitly communicate its goal by producing legible plans. We present benchmark results on several PDDL planning domains. Our results generally show that plan legibility is a trade-off with plan efficiency, however, not all planning domains allows to increase legibility in the same way and a regularizing factor to balance legibility and efficiency was proved necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向任意PDDL领域的可读性规划方法，通过将可读性研究扩展到经典规划并借助二阶心智理论估计观察者视角，无需构建专用规划器，在多个基准领域验证了可读性与效率之间的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 可读性规划旨在从观察者视角使规划目标更容易与其他候选目标区分开，从而实现隐式沟通。已有可读性研究多局限于特定场景或需构建专用规划器，难以推广到一般经典规划问题；同时观察者视角的建模也缺乏通用手段。
AI.method: 将既往可读性研究扩展到经典规划，提出适用于任意PDDL领域的可读性规划方法，无需构建ad-hoc规划器；并通过连接规划者与观察者任务空间的二阶心智理论来估计观察者视角。
AI.result: 在若干PDDL规划领域上进行了基准测试。结果普遍显示可读性与规划效率之间存在权衡关系；并非所有规划领域都能以相同方式提升可读性，且实验证明需要引入正则化因子来平衡可读性与效率。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可推广到任意PDDL领域，并可用于人-机器人协作等场景中机器人通过产生可读规划来隐式传达目标；但实际应用中需通过正则化因子在可读性与效率之间进行权衡。

title: HumanoidTTT: Test-Time Capability Reuse for Efficient Humanoid Control
summary: Recent advances in motion generation and whole-body tracking have enabled humanoid robots to execute increasingly diverse motions, yet the same motion capabilities may be requested repeatedly during continual deployment. Reliable reuse is challenging because intervening motions can change the robot's entry state, making previously successful motions unsafe to replay blindly. Meanwhile, validated capabilities accumulate during deployment, while bounded storage requires deciding which ones are worth retaining. To address these challenges, we present HumanoidTTT, a framework for test-time capability reuse in continual humanoid control. Specifically, we introduce Selective Full-Motion Reuse, which authorizes direct reuse of validated complete motions only from certified applicable entry states, allowing accepted reuse to bypass fresh generation. We further introduce Test-Time Capability Consolidation, which adapts which qualified capabilities persist in a bounded Full-Motion Store using subsequent deployment reuse as feedback. Experiments demonstrate zero unsafe accepts and a 16.4$\times$ end-to-end speedup over fresh generation, while online consolidation improves avoided generator calls by 13.2 per 200 requests over its frozen counterpart. Overall, HumanoidTTT enables reliable and efficient reuse of validated motion capabilities while adaptively retaining useful capabilities throughout continual deployment. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/HumanoidTTT. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/HumanoidTTT.

AI.tldr: 提出 HumanoidTTT 框架，通过选择性完整动作复用与测试时能力巩固，实现人形机器人持续部署中已验证运动能力的安全复用与高效保留。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人运动生成与全身跟踪的进步使其能执行多样动作，但持续部署中同一动作能力会被反复请求。可靠复用的难点在于：中间执行的动作会改变机器人的进入状态，导致此前成功的动作无法盲目重放；同时已验证能力不断累积，而存储有限，需决定哪些能力值得保留。
AI.method: 提出 HumanoidTTT 框架，包含两个组件：（1）选择性完整动作复用（Selective Full-Motion Reuse），仅从经认证的适用进入状态授权直接复用已验证的完整动作，使被接受的复用绕过重新生成；（2）测试时能力巩固（Test-Time Capability Consolidation），以后续部署中的复用情况为反馈，在有界完整动作存储（Full-Motion Store）中自适应决定哪些合格能力得以保留。
AI.result: 实验实现零次不安全接受，端到端相比重新生成加速 16.4 倍；在线巩固相比冻结版本每 200 次请求额外减少 13.2 次生成器调用。
AI.conclusion: HumanoidTTT 在持续部署中实现了已验证运动能力的可靠、高效复用，并能自适应保留有用能力。

title: Real-Time Whole-Body Safe Motion Generation for Multi-Segment Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
summary: Real-time motion generation for tendon-driven continuum robots requires accurate modeling of nonuniform bending and whole-body collision avoidance. This paper presents a unified actuation-space framework for planar multi-segment tendon-driven continuum robots. An energy-based variable-curvature model captures spatially varying tendon spacing and bending stiffness and provides analytical Jacobians for differential inverse kinematics and safety monitoring. A multipoint CBF-QP enforces backbone clearance under obstacle motion and actuation-velocity bounds, while its decision dimension depends only on the number of independently actuated segments. The model closely agrees with GVS references, with a maximum curvature error of $5.223 \times 10^{-2}\,\mathrm{m}^{-1}$. Over 100 MuJoCo trials, the proposed method achieves collision-free success rates of 96% and 100% in static and dynamic scenarios, respectively, compared with approximately 60% and 80% without CBF constraints. Hole-traversal tests further demonstrate safe motion in constrained environments. With 600 backbone monitoring points, the mean control-step time is 6.66 ms, demonstrating real-time whole-body safe motion generation.

AI.tldr: 提出面向平面多段腱驱动连续体机器人的统一驱动空间框架，结合变曲率能量模型与多点CBF-QP，实现实时全身避障运动生成。
AI.motivation: 腱驱动连续体机器人的实时运动生成需要同时处理非均匀弯曲建模与全身避障，现有方法难以兼顾建模精度与实时安全性。
AI.method: 采用能量型变曲率模型，刻画随空间变化的腱间距与弯曲刚度，并给出解析雅可比以支持微分逆运动学与安全监测；引入多点CBF-QP，在障碍运动与驱动速度约束下保证骨架间隙，其决策维度仅取决于独立驱动段数。
AI.result: 模型与GVS参考吻合，最大曲率误差5.223×10⁻² m⁻¹；100次MuJoCo试验中，静态与动态场景碰撞自由成功率分别为96%与100%，无CBF约束时约为60%与80%；穿洞测试验证受限环境安全性；600个骨架监测点下平均控制步时间6.66 ms。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保证建模精度的同时实现实时全身安全运动生成，验证了多点CBF-QP在连续体机器人避障中的有效性与实时性。

title: DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models increasingly rely on action experts that generate short action chunks under receding-horizon control. While chunk-level training is convenient across robot embodiments, it optimizes local action likelihood without explicitly accounting for long-horizon task success. Sequence-level reinforcement learning can address this limitation, but typically requires policy rollouts and closed-loop interaction, which are costly for real-robot manipulation. We introduce DriftOPD, a teacher-free, rollout-free framework for sequence-level on-policy distillation of continuous VLA action experts. We show that the sequence-level reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence decomposes into a chunk-level reverse-KL term and a future-potential term that captures the long-horizon effect of the current action. DriftOPD optimizes these two terms using a one-step drifting objective and a Q-function critic learned from offline demonstrations, respectively, enabling sequence-level optimization with only offline data and one-step action generation. Across multiple VLA architectures in simulation and real-world manipulation, DriftOPD generally outperforms existing one-step distillation baselines while achieving task success performance comparable to multi-step teacher policies. These results demonstrate that long-horizon behavior can be effectively distilled into one-step VLA action experts without online interaction or a separate teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出 DriftOPD，一种无教师、无 rollout 的序列级在线策略蒸馏框架，将序列级反向 KL 分解为 chunk 级反向 KL 项与未来势能项，仅用离线数据和单步生成实现长时程优化。
AI.motivation: VLA 动作专家在滚动时域控制下生成短动作块，chunk 级训练只优化局部动作似然，未显式考虑长时程任务成功；而序列级强化学习需策略 rollout 与闭环交互，真实机器人操作代价高昂。
AI.method: 证明序列级反向 KL 散度可分解为 chunk 级反向 KL 项与刻画当前动作长时程影响的未来势能项；分别用一步 drifting 目标优化前者、用离线演示学习的 Q 函数 critic 优化后者，实现仅依赖离线数据的序列级优化与单步动作生成。
AI.result: 在多种 VLA 架构的仿真与真实操作任务中，DriftOPD 总体优于现有单步蒸馏基线，任务成功率与多步教师策略相当。
AI.conclusion: 长时程行为可有效蒸馏进单步 VLA 动作专家，无需在线交互或独立教师策略。

title: Retrospective Open-Vocabulary Memory for Long-Term Object Search
summary: Long-term object search requires learning where objects usually appear from repeated but uneven observations of a changing environment. We formulate retrospective open-vocabulary memory as probabilistic inference from censored observations, where the key idea is to reason with evidence per opportunity: a detection or non-detection should influence belief only in proportion to the robot's opportunity to observe the corresponding location. We introduce ECROM, which uses this principle to estimate long-term prevalence for concepts specified only at query time and converts the resulting belief directly into an active-search prior. To evaluate this problem, we introduce a controlled long-term benchmark in ten HM3D homes that independently varies object placement and observation opportunity across repeated traversals. ECROM improves support-level AP on held-out queries by 4.5 points and search SPL by 4.2 points over the strongest competing memory in each metric. The benchmark, dataset, and code will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出回顾式开放词汇记忆的概率推断框架，通过"按观察机会加权"的证据推理来估计长期物体出现概率，并用于主动搜索先验。
AI.motivation: 长期物体搜索需要从对变化环境的重复但不均匀观测中学习物体的常见位置。现有记忆方法未能正确处理观察机会不均导致的删失观测问题。
AI.method: 提出ECROM，将回顾式开放词汇记忆建模为删失观测下的概率推断，核心是"按机会加权证据"：检测或未检测只应按机器人观察该位置的机会比例影响信念；据此估计仅在查询时指定的概念的长期出现率，并将信念直接转化为主动搜索先验。同时构建了在10个HM3D家庭中独立变化物体摆放与观察机会的受控长期基准。
AI.result: ECROM在留出查询上将support-level AP提升4.5个点，搜索SPL提升4.2个点，均超过各指标下最强的竞争记忆方法。
AI.conclusion: 按观察机会加权证据的概率推断能有效处理不均匀观测，提升长期开放词汇物体搜索性能；基准、数据集与代码将开源。

title: IndoorBEV: A Lightweight Real-Time LiDAR BEV Perception System for Indoor Mobile Robots
summary: Efficient indoor LiDAR perception is challenging because mobile robots must understand cluttered three-dimensional environments under strict latency and memory constraints. Existing point-based and voxel-based methods often incur substantial computational overhead, whereas conventional bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations improve efficiency at the cost of discarding vertical geometric information. We present IndoorBEV, a lightweight LiDAR perception framework that mitigates this tradeoff through a height-aware BEV representation and geometry-conditioned feature fusion. IndoorBEV summarizes the vertical point distribution in each BEV cell using statistical height features and multi-frequency height encoding, allowing informative three-dimensional cues to be processed efficiently by two-dimensional convolutions. A lightweight encoder then integrates complementary geometric features with multi-scale local representations and compact global scene context. Decoupled dense prediction heads jointly produce semantic BEV maps and oriented object bounding boxes. IndoorBEV contains only 0.6M parameters and requires 2.3 MB of model storage. On an NVIDIA AGX Orin, it uses 21.52 MB of GPU memory per inference and achieves a mean latency of 169.6 ms under a 200 ms perception deadline, with a deadline miss ratio of 1.8\%. Evaluations on simulated scenes, real-world robot scans, and an open-source indoor point-cloud dataset demonstrate a favorable tradeoff among perception accuracy, latency, and memory consumption. These results indicate that explicitly encoding vertical geometry within a compact BEV representation provides an effective approach to resource-efficient indoor LiDAR perception.

AI.tldr: IndoorBEV：一种轻量级激光雷达感知框架，通过高度感知BEV表示与几何条件化特征融合，在垂直几何信息与计算效率之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 室内LiDAR感知需在严格延迟与内存约束下理解杂乱三维环境。现有点云/体素方法计算开销大，传统BEV表示虽高效但丢弃垂直几何信息，二者存在效率与信息保真度的权衡。
AI.method: 提出高度感知BEV表示，用统计高度特征与多频高度编码汇总每个BEV单元的垂直点分布，使三维线索可由二维卷积高效处理；轻量编码器融合互补几何特征、多尺度局部表示与紧凑全局场景上下文；解耦式密集预测头联合输出语义BEV图与有向目标边界框。
AI.result: 模型仅0.6M参数、2.3 MB存储；NVIDIA AGX Orin上单次推理GPU内存21.52 MB，200 ms截止期内平均延迟169.6 ms，超时率1.8%；在模拟场景、真实机器人扫描及开源室内点云数据集上均表现出精度、延迟与内存的有利权衡。
AI.conclusion: 在紧凑BEV表示中显式编码垂直几何，是实现资源高效室内LiDAR感知的有效途径。

title: DexPolicy: Scheduled Exploration for Trajectory-Guided Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for dexterous manipulation must discover finger-object contacts and then control the object precisely; the action noise that serves the first goal can interfere with the second. In trajectory-guided settings such as ViViDex, where RL refine hand-object trajectories from human video, our baseline PPO runs end near their initial action noise after 5M steps, motivating explicit control of exploration scale. DexPolicy makes that scale an explicit function of training steps, annealing from broad to narrow exploration while holding loss, architecture, reward, and optimizer settings fixed. We study three policy-optimization settings: PPO, critic-free GRPO continuation, and a flow-parameterized PPO variant (FPO). Across five YCB objects and three training seeds, mean deterministic Target success rises from 49.4% to 68.1% (FPO), 14.1% to 45.4% (GRPO), and 32.0% to 35.7% (PPO). On a RealMan RM75 arm with an Inspire/RH56 hand, 360 trials over three objects raise mean Target success from 25.0% to 85.0% (FPO), 10.0% to 63.3% (GRPO), and 8.3% to 43.3% (PPO), with one trained model per object-method condition. PPO component screening favors noise control over the tested optimizer contraction; the selected PPO schedule yields higher mean Target success than linear decay with the same endpoints on three tested objects. Training return, deterministic Target success, and tolerance to execution noise dissociate; schedules should therefore be judged by terminal task success under the intended execution conditions, per task and policy-optimization setting. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DexPolicy. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DexPolicy.

AI.tldr: DexPolicy将探索尺度显式设为训练步数的退火函数（从宽到窄），在保持损失、架构、奖励与优化器设置不变的前提下，比较PPO、无critic的GRPO续训与流参数化PPO（FPO）三种策略优化设置，证明按终端任务成功率评价退火调度可显著提升灵巧手操作性能。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作强化学习需要先发现手指-物体接触，再进行精确控制；服务于前者的动作噪声会干扰后者。在ViViDex等轨迹引导设置中，基线PPO训练500万步后动作噪声几乎仍停留在初始水平，说明缺乏对探索尺度的显式控制。
AI.method: DexPolicy把探索噪声尺度建模为训练步数的显式函数，随训练由宽到窄退火，其余损失、网络架构、奖励与优化器配置均保持不变。在三种策略优化设置下验证：PPO、无critic的GRPO续训、流参数化PPO变体（FPO）。同时开展PPO组件筛选（比较噪声控制与优化器收缩）以及退火调度与线性衰减的对照实验。
AI.result: 在5个YCB物体、3个训练种子下，确定性Target平均成功率：FPO由49.4%升至68.1%，GRPO由14.1%升至45.4%，PPO由32.0%升至35.7%。在RealMan RM75机械臂配Inspire/RH56手上，3个物体共360次试验，平均Target成功率：FPO由25.0%升至85.0%，GRPO由10.0%升至63.3%，PPO由8.3%升至43.3%。PPO组件筛选表明噪声控制优于所测试的优化器收缩；所选PPO调度在三个物体上平均Target成功率高于相同端点的线性衰减。
AI.conclusion: 训练回报、确定性Target成功率与对执行噪声的容忍度三者相互解耦；因此调度应按预期执行条件下的终端任务成功率、分任务与分策略优化设置来评价。代码与项目网站已公开。

title: DeepJEPA: Scaling World Models from Within
summary: World-model planners typically scale outward by rolling farther, sampling more trajectories, or optimizing longer, while assigning the same computation to every imagined transition. We show that making every transition uniformly deeper wastes computation and can degrade planning because useful refinement is concentrated at a small set of decision-critical events. We introduce DeepJEPA, a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model that treats transition depth as an inner test-time scaling axis and learns when another recurrent update is worth computing for each candidate and rollout step. Across five visual-control settings, DeepJEPA improves or matches the strongest fixed-depth planner while averaging only 1.00-1.26 updates per transition. Its additional computation concentrates at contact onset and sustained object interaction, where latent corrections can change which candidates enter the planner's elite set and which action is selected. Representation probes further show that improved planning does not require uniformly better object-state decodability. DeepJEPA therefore reframes world-model scaling as a problem of allocating internal computation where it can change the planner's decision: think deeper at decision-critical transitions instead of making every rollout uniformly deeper or longer.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepJEPA，一种权重共享的联合嵌入预测世界模型，将转移深度作为测试时的内部扩展轴，学习为每个候选和推演步判断是否需要更多递归更新。在五个视觉控制任务上，匹配或超越最强固定深度规划器，平均每步仅需1.00–1.26次更新。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型规划器通常通过延长推演、增加采样轨迹或延长优化来向外扩展，但对每个想象转移分配相同计算量。均匀加深每个转移会浪费计算，甚至损害规划效果，因为有用的细化集中在少量决策关键事件上。
AI.method: DeepJEPA采用权重共享（weight-tied）的联合嵌入预测架构，把转移深度视为内层测试时扩展轴，通过学习自适应决定每个候选轨迹及每个推演步是否需要额外一次递归更新，从而将内部计算动态分配到决策关键转移处。
AI.result: 在五个视觉控制设定中，DeepJEPA优于或匹敌最强固定深度规划器，平均每转移仅1.00–1.26次更新；额外计算集中在接触起始与持续物体交互阶段，此时潜空间修正会改变进入精英集的候选及最终动作选择；表征探针表明规划改善并不需要统一更优的物体状态可解码性。
AI.conclusion: DeepJEPA将世界模型扩展重新定义为内部计算分配问题：在能改变规划器决策的决策关键转移上思考更深，而非让所有推演统一变深或变长。

title: Whole-Body Aerial Grasping and Lifting via Partial Visual Observations
summary: Aerial grasp-and-lift tasks require whole-body coordination across approach, acquisition, and lifting under partial target observations. Early approach failures can limit exposure to later task stages during training, while changing visibility complicates alignment and closure timing during execution. We present a recurrent teacher-student framework that learns a single policy in simulation to jointly command flight, arm motion, and gripper closure without an explicit task-phase input. A privileged teacher learns through reinforcement learning with a critical-state curriculum that exposes acquisition and lifting states before connecting them to normal approach trajectories. Its behavior is distilled into a recurrent visual student that replaces privileged target states with dual-view point clouds and proprioception, integrating observation history for closed-loop control. A dedicated closure objective supervises closure timing from sustained model-defined readiness sequences. Training and primary evaluation use a simulated acquisition-and-payload model with condition-triggered latching, virtual attachment, and wrench-based payload loading for short-distance lifting. Across 8,996 completed simulation episodes under this model, the frozen student achieves full-task success rates of 99.97%, 97.14%, and 95.84% under nominal, physics/control-randomized, and additional camera-randomized conditions, respectively. The nominal latch-count-weighted mean of per-seed 90th-percentile alignment errors at acquisition is 8.12 mm.

AI.tldr: 提出循环师生框架，用特权教师（强化学习+关键状态课程）蒸馏为循环视觉学生（双视角点云+本体感受+观测历史），无需显式任务阶段输入即可联合控制飞行、手臂与夹爪闭合；冻结学生在仿真中三种条件下全任务成功率99.97%/97.14%/95.84%，对准误差P90加权均值8.12 mm。
AI.motivation: 空中抓取-提举任务需在目标部分可观测下完成接近、抓取、提举的全身协调。训练中早期接近失败会减少后期阶段的样本暴露；执行中可见性变化使对准与闭合时机难以把控，二者共同构成本文要解决的核心矛盾。
AI.method: 采用循环教师-学生框架：特权教师用强化学习训练，配合关键状态课程（先暴露抓取与提举状态，再与常规接近轨迹衔接）；行为蒸馏为循环视觉学生，以双视角点云与本体感受替代特权目标状态，并用观测历史实现闭环控制；另设专门闭合目标，由持续的模型定义就绪序列监督闭合时机。仿真环境采用条件触发锁存、虚拟附着与基于力旋量的载荷加载。
AI.result: 在8,996个完成的仿真回合中，冻结学生的全任务成功率在标称、物理/控制随机化、再加相机随机化条件下分别为99.97%、97.14%、95.84%；标称条件下按锁存数加权的各随机种子抓取对准误差第90百分位均值为8.12 mm。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，单一策略无需显式任务阶段输入即可完成空中抓取-提举的全身协调，关键状态课程与循环视觉蒸馏有效保留原子技能并提升鲁棒性；但结论主要基于该仿真模型，真实世界迁移与长距离提举仍待验证。

title: Towards a General Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Model via Egocentric Whole-Body Human Data Pretraining
summary: Humanoid whole-body manipulation has advanced rapidly, enabling policies to coordinate locomotion, posture, bimanual interaction, and dexterous hand movements. Meanwhile, egocentric human videos provide diverse examples of everyday interactions across objects and scenes, offering scalable supervision without robot operation. However, existing supervision from these videos provides limited coverage of whole-body movement and coordination with hand-object interaction, while obtaining such supervision through humanoid teleoperation is also costly and difficult to scale. We therefore explore how human experience can support scalable learning of humanoid loco-manipulation. To support this study, we introduce HumanVerse-500, a 500-hour dataset of diverse human loco-manipulation behaviors in open-world environments, collected with a lightweight wearable system that synchronizes egocentric video with body and hand motion. Building on this dataset, we develop $λ_0$, a whole-body humanoid vision-language-action policy, through three-stage training that first learns interaction from diverse egocentric datasets, then coordinates body and hand motion using HumanVerse-500, and finally adapts the policy to downstream tasks and robot embodiments. Across these stages, $λ_0$ learns a shared representation space for human experience transfer, while domain-specific interfaces handle differences between human and robot states and actions. We evaluate $λ_0$ on SIMPLE and 4 real-world loco-manipulation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance, and further analyze its scaling behavior, generalization, and training-stage contributions to understand how human data support downstream whole-body humanoid control. We will release our code, models, and data to support further research.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出HumanVerse-500数据集与λ0全身人形视觉-语言-动作策略，通过三阶段训练将人类自我中心视频经验迁移到人形机器人移动操作任务，在SIMPLE及4个真实任务上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 人形全身操作发展迅速，但仍缺乏可扩展的监督。自我中心人类视频提供多样日常交互示例，可免机器人操作获取监督，然而现有视频对全身运动及手-物交互协调覆盖有限，而人形遥操作采集此类监督成本高、难扩展。因此本文探索如何利用人类经验支持人形移动操作的可扩展学习。
AI.method: 1) 构建HumanVerse-500：500小时开放世界人类移动操作行为数据集，采用轻量可穿戴系统同步采集自我中心视频与身体、手部运动。2) 提出λ0：全身人形视觉-语言-动作策略，采用三阶段训练——先通过多样自我中心数据集学习交互，再用HumanVerse-500协调身体与手部运动，最后将策略适配到下游任务与机器人实体。3) 三个阶段学习共享表征空间以迁移人类经验，同时用领域特定接口处理人与机器人状态与动作差异。
AI.result: 在SIMPLE基准及4个真实世界移动操作任务上评估λ0，取得SOTA性能；并进一步分析其扩展行为、泛化能力及各训练阶段的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明人类经验可有效支持下游全身人形控制。作者将开源代码、模型与数据以支持后续研究。

title: ScaffoldM3C: A Multimodal Sequential Monte Carlo Framework for Generative Stable Construction Planning
comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics and Learning (T-RL) and is currently under review. Project Page: https://stanfordmsl.github.io/ScaffoldM3C/
summary: Autonomously constructing physically realizable 3D structures remains a significant challenge due to combinatorial action spaces, interchangeable components, equifinal assembly sequences, and strict stability requirements during construction. State-of-the-art methods fine-tune large language models for text-based generative construction.
