However, these approaches do not allow for Multimodal (text, image, sketch) conditioning, overlook the practical role of scaffolding for stabilizing intermediate structures, and suffer from slow inference speeds. Therefore, we formulate construction as a probabilistic next-block generation task with multiple potential assembly actions and multiple potential task conditioning modalities. Concurrently, we explicitly consider the utility of scaffolding by introducing an auxiliary scaffold block token. We present Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo (ScaffoldM3C), a multimodal, lightweight, auto-regressive model for stable block-based construction, that proposes a set of next-step candidate blocks. Leveraging these candidates, we utilize Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to maintain a population of possible assembly sequences, allowing us to consider multiple, potentially different, assembly directions simultaneously. We train our multimodal architecture by extending the StableText2Brick dataset to contain image conditioning prompts and scaffold-stabilized build sequences. ScaffoldM3C is 4x smaller than competing baselines, yielding a 5x to 20x speedup during inference, while achieving comparable construction quality to state-of-the-art methods and higher overall stability. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through simulations and real-world robot assembly demonstrations.

AI.tldr: ScaffoldM3C是一种多模态轻量级自回归模型，用于稳定的积木式结构建造，通过引入脚手架token和序列蒙特卡洛维护多种装配序列候选，实现更小、更快且稳定性更高的建造。
AI.motivation: 自主构建物理可实现的3D结构面临组合动作空间大、组件可互换、装配序列等效终点多以及建造过程稳定性要求严格等挑战。现有方法微调大语言模型进行文本生成式建造，但存在三大不足：不支持多模态条件（文本、图像、草图）；忽视脚手架对稳定中间结构的实际作用；推理速度慢。
AI.method: 将建造问题形式化为带多种潜在装配动作和多种任务条件模态的概率性下一块生成任务，并引入辅助脚手架块token以显式建模脚手架的效用。提出Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo (ScaffoldM3C)——一种多模态、轻量级、自回归的稳定积木建造模型，可提出一组下一步候选块；基于这些候选，采用序列蒙特卡洛(Sequential Monte Carlo, SMC)维护可能的装配序列种群，从而同时考虑多个（可能不同的）装配方向。训练上，将StableText2Brick数据集扩展为包含图像条件提示和脚手架稳定建造序列。
AI.result: ScaffoldM3C相比同类基线模型小4倍，推理速度提升5至20倍，同时建造质量与最先进方法相当，整体稳定性更高。并通过仿真和真实机器人装配演示验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过多模态轻量级自回归建模、显式引入脚手架token以及结合SMC的多序列搜索，可以在显著提升效率（模型更小、推理更快）的同时保持建造质量并提高稳定性，且可迁移至真实机器人装配场景。

title: Same Scene, Different Task: Skill Alignment for Compositional Generalization in VLAs
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often struggle to generalize to skill combinations absent from their fine-tuning demonstrations, even when every constituent skill has been demonstrated. We focus on a vision shortcut as one failure mode: during fine-tuning, visual observations can serve as a proxy for the instruction, so a policy may execute a demonstrated combination associated with similar observations rather than the instructed combination. This motivates training with counterfactual pairs formed by holding a demonstration observation fixed while changing the instruction to specify an undemonstrated combination. These pairs, however, lack corresponding demonstrated action targets. Crucially, the currently required skill has already been demonstrated, but actions from those executions cannot serve as direct targets because the same skill can require different actions across observations. We propose CRAFT, which transfers supervision from demonstrated executions of the required skill to counterfactual pairs using skill representations that can be reused across executions of the same skill. Across three VLA models and two simulation benchmarks, CRAFT improves success on undemonstrated combinations while maintaining high success on demonstrated ones; it also improves compositional generalization on a real robot. Project website: https://taegeunyang.github.io/craft/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CRAFT，通过反事实指令配对和技能表征迁移监督，缓解 VLA 模型的视觉捷径问题，从而提升未演示技能组合的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型在微调后难以泛化到未演示过的技能组合，即使每个组成技能都已被演示。作者识别出一种失效模式——视觉捷径：微调时视觉观测可能成为指令的代理，导致策略依据相似观测执行已演示组合，而非按指令执行新的组合。
AI.method: 构造反事实配对：固定一条演示观测不变，改变指令使其指定一个未被演示的技能组合，以此进行训练。由于这些配对缺乏对应的已演示动作目标，且同一技能在不同观测下所需动作不同，无法直接复用动作作为目标；因此提出 CRAFT，利用可在同一技能不同执行间复用的技能表征，将已演示执行中的监督迁移到反事实配对。
AI.result: 在三种 VLA 模型和两个仿真基准上，CRAFT 提升了未演示组合的成功率，同时保持已演示组合的高成功率；在真实机器人上也改善了组合泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对视觉捷径的反事实训练与技能表征级监督迁移，CRAFT 有效增强了 VLA 模型对未演示技能组合的组合泛化能力，并在仿真与真实环境中均得到验证。

title: Does Continual Imitation Learning Remain Grounded? A Language-Perturbed Benchmark for Robotic Task Retention
summary: Continual imitation learning evaluates whether a robot can learn new knowledge without forgetting previously learned skills. However, retaining task performance does not ensure the behavior remains grounded in language because policies may rely on scene cues, object associations, or memorized task structure. We introduce a benchmark protocol to study how language-guided behavior changes as robotic policies learn successive tasks. We construct meaning-preserving and meaning-changing instruction variants for the Goal, Spatial, Object, and Long suites of LIBERO. Policy experiments focus on LIBERO-Goal, evaluating Original and Paraphrase instructions after each continual-learning stage. We compare representative continual imitation learning methods under their original assumptions while separating task competence from language sensitivity. The proposed diagnostics complement standard learning and forgetting metrics by measuring semantic robustness, goal adaptation, and language sensitivity. Results show that strong continual-learning performance does not always translate to reliable language grounding, and our diagnostics help determine whether retained skills remain correctly guided by their instructions. Additional materials are available at https://sites.google.com/view/stillgrounded

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套诊断性基准协议，用于评估持续模仿学习策略在连续学习任务过程中语言引导行为的保持情况，通过意义保持与意义改变指令变体衡量语义鲁棒性、目标适应与语言敏感性。
AI.motivation: 持续模仿学习通常只关注任务性能是否遗忘，但策略可能依赖场景线索、物体关联或记忆化的任务结构，而非真正理解语言，因此任务性能保持并不能保证行为仍以语言为依据。需要一套能区分"任务能力"与"语言敏感性"的评测手段。
AI.method: 为LIBERO的Goal、Spatial、Object、Long四个套件构造意义保持与意义改变两种指令变体；策略实验聚焦LIBERO-Goal，在每次持续学习阶段后评估原始指令与同义改写指令；在各自原始假设下对比代表性持续模仿学习方法，并将任务能力与语言敏感性分开度量，提出针对语义鲁棒性、目标适应与语言敏感性的诊断指标。
AI.result: 实验显示，较强的持续学习性能并不总能转化为可靠的语言落地能力；所提诊断指标能够补充标准的学习与遗忘指标，用于判断保留下来的技能是否仍被指令正确引导。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠任务性能指标不足以评估持续模仿学习中的语言落地能力，需引入语义层面的诊断协议；该协议可揭示性能与语言敏感性之间的错位，为更可靠的持续语言引导策略研究提供评测基础。

title: Token-World: World Modeling in Vision-Language Model Token Space for Robot Manipulation
comment: Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
summary: A common approach to world-model simulation for vision-language-action (VLA) systems is to predict future RGB observations and then re-encode them into policy inputs, introducing an indirect interface between simulation and downstream policy execution. We instead investigate whether world dynamics can be modeled in a compact, policy-oriented state derived from VLM visual tokens. A key challenge is that raw VLM visual tokens are high-dimensional, making efficient and accurate autoregressive dynamics modeling challenging. To address this, we introduce Token-World, an action-conditioned world model that compresses VLM features into a compact token state, learns future dynamics in this reduced space, and maps predicted states back to the original policy-facing representation for downstream use. Across manipulation benchmarks, Token-World improves open-loop feature fidelity and policy-action consistency over recent world-model simulators, with slower degradation over long rollout horizons. In closed-loop evaluation, its simulated policy performance correlates more strongly with reference policy performance than Ctrl-World ($r=0.794$ vs.\ $0.583$), while requiring lower simulation latency. Ablations further show that compact-representation design and dimensionality substantially affect future-state prediction. Code will be available at https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/.

AI.tldr: Token-World通过将VLM视觉token压缩为紧凑状态，在该低维空间中进行动作条件化的自回归动力学建模，并映射回策略表示，从而提升仿真保真度与策略动作一致性。
AI.motivation: 常见VLA世界模型仿真先预测未来RGB观测，再重新编码为策略输入，导致仿真与下游策略执行之间存在间接接口。作者希望探究能否在由VLM视觉token导出的、面向策略的紧凑状态中直接建模世界动力学。主要挑战在于原始VLM视觉token维度极高，难以高效且准确地进行自回归动力学建模。
AI.method: 提出Token-World，一种动作条件化世界模型：将VLM特征压缩为紧凑token状态，在压缩后的空间中学习未来动力学，再将预测状态映射回原始面向策略的表示以供下游使用。
AI.result: 在多种操作基准上，Token-World相比近期世界模型仿真器提升了开环特征保真度与策略动作一致性，并在长时程rollout中退化更慢。闭环评估中其仿真策略性能与参考策略性能的相关性高于Ctrl-World（r=0.794 vs 0.583），同时仿真延迟更低。消融实验表明紧凑表示设计及其维度对未来状态预测有显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 在面向策略的紧凑VLM token状态中建模世界动力学是可行且有效的，可提升仿真保真度、长时程稳定性与闭环策略性能预测相关性，并降低仿真延迟。

title: When Reasoning Helps Action: Monitoring and Steering Chain-of-Thought in Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Reasoning-enabled VLA policies expose chain-of-thought (CoT) traces that appear to explain and guide their actions, creating a potential interface for runtime safety through reasoning monitoring and correction. In this work, we define and operationalize two evaluation axes for assessing when this interface can improve embodied behavior: correctability, which measures whether unreliable reasoning can be detected and improved during generation, and actionability, which measures whether reasoning corrections produce behaviorally meaningful changes in the intended direction. To enable correctability, we introduce Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought (TRUST), an offline-trained value model that predicts eventual reasoning correctness from partial prefixes and uses these estimates to monitor and selectively steer reasoning generation in frozen VLA policies. On the Alpamayo 1.5 driving VLA, TRUST monitors correctness with 88.9% accuracy and improves reasoning correctness from 75.9% to 90.0%. On a baseline-defined challenging subset in AlpaSim, TRUST reduces collision rate by 30.4% and maximum trajectory error by 11.5% relative to the unsteered policy, outperforming a compute-matched Best-of-4 baseline. On the DeepThinkVLA manipulation VLA, TRUST improves the correctness of grasp-state claims from 69.3% to 90.2% and action-choice claims from 68.8% to 85.9%, yet closed-loop task performance on LIBERO-Plus remains largely unchanged. Empirical analysis reveals intent-consistent behavioral effects in Alpamayo 1.5 but limited effects in DeepThinkVLA, helping interpret these different task-level outcomes. Together, our results show that gains in reasoning correctness do not automatically imply gains in embodied performance, motivating evaluation of correctability and actionability when using CoT as a runtime safety interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出评估推理型VLA策略中CoT作为运行时安全接口的两个维度——可纠正性(correctability)与可操作性(actionability)，并据此提出TRUST方法：离线训练价值模型从部分前缀预测推理正确性，从而监控并选择性引导冻结VLA策略的推理生成。
AI.motivation: 推理驱动的VLA策略会输出看似能解释并引导动作的CoT轨迹，形成潜在的运行时安全接口；但推理正确性的提升是否必然带来具身行为改善尚不明确，需要明确定义并量化"何时该接口能改善具身行为"的评估坐标。
AI.method: 定义两个评估轴：可纠正性（能否在生成过程中检测并改进不可靠推理）与可操作性（推理纠正是否产生预期方向上有行为意义的变化）。为实现可纠正性，提出TRUST（Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought）：离线训练的价值模型从部分推理前缀预测最终推理正确性，并据此在线监控与选择性引导冻结VLA策略的推理生成。
AI.result: 在Alpamayo 1.5驾驶VLA上，TRUST以88.9%准确率监控正确性，将推理正确率从75.9%提升至90.0%；在AlpaSim困难子集上碰撞率降低30.4%、最大轨迹误差降低11.5%，优于算力匹配的Best-of-4基线。在DeepThinkVLA操作VLA上，抓取状态判断与动作选择判断正确率分别从69.3%→90.2%、68.8%→85.9%，但LIBERO-Plus闭环任务性能基本不变。分析显示Alpamayo 1.5存在意图一致的行为效应，而DeepThinkVLA效应有限，解释了两者任务级结果的差异。
AI.conclusion: 推理正确性的提升并不自动带来具身性能提升；将CoT用作运行时安全接口时，应同时评估可纠正性与可操作性，二者共同决定该接口能否真正改善具身行为。

title: TacDyn-WAM: Learning Implicit Tactile Dynamics in a Heterogeneous Visuo-Tactile World Action Model
summary: World action models improve robotic manipulation by conditioning actions on predicted futures, yet existing tactile variants largely inherit video-generation pipelines that reconstruct future tactile observations through iterative denoising. Such prediction can become unreliable under deployment drift: small changes in contact position or force may substantially alter tactile pixels even when the underlying contact evolution remains predictable. We introduce TacDyn-WAM, a heterogeneous visuo-tactile world action model that predicts implicit tactile dynamics rather than reconstructing future tactile observations. It learns TacRep, a dynamics-aware tactile target space trained through masked spatio-temporal prediction on tactile clips and regularized by relational structure distillation. A visual expert and an Implicit Tactile Dynamics Expert predict future visual and tactile representations in separate target spaces while interacting through joint attention; the tactile expert predicts future representations and their changes at multiple horizons in a single forward pass, and a read-only tactile memory supplies the current tactile state. On UniVTAC, TacDyn-WAM achieves an average success rate of 81.5% using only the provided demonstrations, reaching state-of-the-art-level performance and remaining competitive with models pretrained on large-scale visuo-tactile trajectories. Ablations confirm the benefits of both tactile pathways and TacRep over pixel-reconstruction and static alternatives. On five real-robot tasks, TacDyn-WAM reaches 71.0% average success, and modest-scale pretraining raises it to 85.0%, further validating our method.

AI.tldr: TacDyn-WAM：一种异构视触觉世界动作模型，预测隐式触觉动力学而非重建未来触觉观测，在UniVTAC和真实机器人任务上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有触觉世界动作模型多沿用视频生成流程，通过迭代去噪重建未来触觉观测。这种像素级预测在部署漂移下不可靠：接触位置或力的微小变化会显著改变触觉像素，而底层接触演化实际仍可预测。
AI.method: 提出TacDyn-WAM，包含：TacRep动力学感知触觉目标空间，通过触觉片段上的掩码时空预测训练，并用关系结构蒸馏正则化；视觉专家与隐式触觉动力学专家在各自目标空间预测未来表征，通过联合注意力交互；触觉专家单次前向预测多时间跨度的未来表征及其变化；只读触觉记忆提供当前触觉状态。
AI.result: UniVTAC上仅用给定演示平均成功率81.5%，达到SOTA水平，与大规模视触觉轨迹预训练模型竞争力相当；消融验证两条触觉路径与TacRep优于像素重建和静态方案。五项真机任务平均成功率71.0%，适度规模预训练提升至85.0%。
AI.conclusion: 预测隐式触觉动力学是比像素重建更鲁棒的触觉世界建模方式，配合TacRep与双路径异构交互，可在数据有限条件下实现领先的机器人操作性能。

title: Toward Humanoid Robots in Construction: A Teleoperation Feasibility Study
comment: Accepted at IROS 2026 Workshop on Future of Construction
summary: We present a teleoperation system that enables a single operator to perform construction tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, combining extended reality (XR) based upper body control with pedal-based locomotion to enable simultaneous manipulation and locomotion. Motivated by persistent labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and challenges in humanoid autonomy, we investigate teleoperation as a practical near-term approach for reducing physical strain on workers while generating high quality demonstration data. We evaluate the system on two representative construction tasks drawn from O*NET occupational database, and report task success and completion time relative to a manual baseline. The system achieved 100% success on tool transport and 80% success on surface painting, with teleoperation requiring substantially more time compared to manual execution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向 Unitree G1 人形机器人的遥操作系统，将 XR 上身控制与脚踏式移动结合，实现单操作员同时操作与行走，并在两项建筑任务上对比人工基线进行评估。
AI.motivation: 动机来自持续的劳动力短缺、危险作业环境以及人形机器人自主性的不足；研究遥操作作为近期可行方案，既降低工人身体负担，又能采集高质量示范数据。
AI.method: 系统由 XR 驱动的上身/手臂控制与脚踏式移动控制组成，支持单人同时进行操纵与移动；任务选取自 O*NET 职业数据库中的两项代表性建筑任务，并与人工直接执行基线进行对比。
AI.result: 工具搬运任务成功率为 100%，表面涂装任务成功率为 80%；相比人工执行，遥操作所需时间显著更长。
AI.conclusion: 该遥操作系统可在代表性建筑任务上实现较高成功率，验证了单人同时操纵与移动的可行性，但作业效率仍是主要瓶颈，适合作为近期缓解人力压力与数据采集的实用手段。

title: CF-JEPA: Improving Robustness of JEPA World Models via Controllability Factorization
summary: Controlling an agent with vision requires being able to separate useful information from irrelevant background information. JEPA-style latent world models seem like a natural approach for this, as they do not perform pixel-level reconstruction; however, they are still sensitive to these distractor signals and experience latent collapse. In this work, we introduce Controllability Factorized JEPA (CF-JEPA), a JEPA-style world model which splits the latent space into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces. This factorization allows us to capture all the distractor information into the uncontrollable region, while we use the control-relevant latent information for our task. With this, we show comparable performance across 2D and 3D control tasks under nominal conditions and improved performance under distracted conditions, where CF-JEPA is the only model that does not experience latent collapse. We also validate our model under distracted conditions for a simulated robot task, highlighting the practical application of such a scheme.

AI.tldr: 提出CF-JEPA，将JEPA世界模型的潜空间分解为可控与不可控子空间，把干扰信息隔离到不可控区域，从而在2D/3D控制任务中于存在干扰条件下取得更优表现且避免潜空间崩溃。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体控制需要从无关背景中分离有用信息。JEPA式潜空间世界模型虽不做像素级重建，理论上更适合这一目标，但实际仍对干扰信号敏感，并会出现潜空间崩溃（latent collapse）问题。
AI.method: 提出Controllability Factorized JEPA（CF-JEPA）：在JEPA风格的世界模型中将潜空间显式划分为可控子空间与不可控子空间。不可控子空间用于容纳全部干扰信息，可控子空间保留与控制相关的潜变量并用于下游任务。
AI.result: 在2D与3D控制任务中，常态条件下性能与基线相当；在存在干扰的条件下性能提升，且CF-JEPA是唯一未发生潜空间崩溃的模型。此外在仿真机器人任务中验证了干扰条件下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过可控性分解潜空间，可有效隔离干扰信息、缓解潜空间崩溃，并提升干扰环境下的控制性能，展示了该方案在仿真机器人等实际场景中的应用潜力。

title: Measuring Asset and Scene Reconstruction Effects in Real-to-Sim Robot Evaluation
summary: Simulated evaluation is increasingly used alongside real-world evaluation of robot policies because it is cheaper and easier to repeat; however, its value depends on how closely its outcomes track the real robot's. We test whether our reconstruction pipeline, combining metrically scaled object geometry, authored physical parameters and scene reconstruction, reduces disagreement between simulated and real robot scores relative to a default open-source recipe. We constructed two simulated versions of one bimanual robot cell: an authored reconstruction, using object geometry at estimated metric scale, projected textures, authored physics and our own scene splat; and a baseline, referred to as the default reconstruction, using the open-source recipe of a generative single-image mesh, engine-default physics and a Gaussian-splat scene. Both reconstructions use the same object photographs and scene video. Two policies ran five tasks each, giving ten task-policy pairs, which we call cells; each cell was run twenty times in each reconstruction with all other settings held fixed. Both reconstructions were scored against the same real trials, graded by a third-party evaluator. Pearson correlation between the ten simulated and real cell means is r = 0.90 for the authored reconstruction and 0.51 for the default. Mean score error is 6.97 percentage points for the authored reconstruction and 17.54 for the default, a reduction of 10.56 percentage points. These results show that improving the quality of the environment reconstruction through higher visual fidelity, authored physics and metric scale makes the simulation more faithful to the real world and narrows the sim-to-real gap. We release the harness, the per-trial scores, every reported run's configuration, and the assets and scenes of both reconstructions.

AI.tldr: 论文比较了两种仿真重建方案（自建重建 vs 开源默认重建）与真机评测的一致性：自建方案（度量尺度几何、人工标注物理参数、自定义场景）在10个任务-策略单元上Pearson相关系数达0.90，平均分数误差6.97个百分点；默认方案分别为0.51与17.54个百分点，误差降低10.56个百分点，表明提升重建质量可缩小sim-to-real差距。
AI.motivation: 仿真评测因成本低、易重复而被广泛用于机器人策略评估，但其价值取决于仿真结果能否准确反映真机表现。因此需要验证：通过提升环境重建质量（视觉保真度、物理参数、度量尺度）能否降低仿真与真机评分之间的不一致。
AI.method: 构建同一双臂机器人工作单元的两个仿真版本：（1）自建重建——使用按估计度量尺度重建的物体几何、投影纹理、人工设定的物理参数及自研场景splat；（2）默认重建——采用开源流程（单图生成式网格、引擎默认物理、高斯splat场景）。两者使用相同的物体照片与场景视频。两个策略各跑5个任务，共10个任务-策略单元（cell），每单元在每种重建中固定其他设置运行20次，并与同一批真机试验（由第三方评测者打分）对比。
AI.result: 10个单元仿真均值与真机均值的Pearson相关系数：自建重建 r=0.90，默认重建 r=0.51；平均分数误差：自建重建6.97个百分点，默认重建17.54个百分点，误差减少10.56个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过提升环境重建的视觉保真度、物理参数质量与度量尺度，可显著提高仿真对真实世界的还原度，缩小sim-to-real差距。作者公开了评测框架、逐次试验分数、所有运行配置，以及两种重建的资产与场景。

title: DITTO-X: Forward and Reverse Teleoperation for Dexterous Manipulation and Human Intervention
summary: Teleoperated demonstrations are a primary source of data for robot manipulation, and teleoperated interventions are a primary mechanism for correcting policies at deployment. Yet most teleoperation systems close the loop through vision alone and are built around parallel-jaw grippers, limiting both what the robot can execute and what the operator can express through it. This is most damaging in shared autonomy, where the operator sees the scene only through occluded cameras and must take over a dexterous hand mid-task, often with an object already grasped. We present DITTO-X, a hand-agnostic dexterous teleoperation interface that renders joint-level force and fingertip contact events from sensing already on the robot hand, and drives three commercial dexterous hands (Sharpa, Wuji, and Inspire) without per-hand redesign. Because the exoskeleton is actuated, DITTO-X also supports reverse teleoperation, in which the robot back-drives the operator's fingers into its own configuration before control is transferred, so the human enters the loop already matched to the state they inherit. Our results show that DITTO-X improves demonstration quality and throughput over a commercial hand-tracking glove, both in regular data collection and in human intervention during policy deployment for contact-rich manipulation tasks. More information can be found from our website: https://tml.stanford.edu/ditto-x/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DITTO-X，一种与特定手型无关的灵巧遥操作接口，可渲染关节力矩与指尖接触事件，驱动三款商用灵巧手无需逐手重新设计，并支持反向遥操作使操作者进入环路时已与机械手状态对齐，从而提升示教质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有遥操作系统多仅依靠视觉闭环、且围绕平行夹爪构建，限制了机器人可执行的动作与操作者可表达的意图；在共享自主场景中尤为不利——操作者只能通过被遮挡的相机观察场景，还需在中途接管正在抓持物体的灵巧手。
AI.method: DITTO-X 利用机械手上已有的传感，渲染关节级力矩与指尖接触事件；采用手型无关（hand-agnostic）设计，可直接驱动 Sharpa、Wuji 与 Inspire 三款商用灵巧手而无需逐手重设计。由于外骨骼为主动驱动，还支持反向遥操作：在控制权转移前，机器人反向驱动操作者手指至自身构型，使人类进入环路时已匹配其所继承的状态。
AI.result: 实验表明，在常规数据采集以及策略部署中针对接触丰富操作任务进行人类干预时，DITTO-X 相较商用运动追踪手套均提升了示教质量与吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: DITTO-X 通过手型无关的力/接触反馈与反向遥操作机制，改善了灵巧遥操作在示教采集与部署干预中的表现，有助于提升共享自主下的接管与纠正效率。

title: ECoMEM: Explicit Concept Memory for Memory-Dependent Robot Control
summary: A robot may lose sight of an object it must later retrieve, need to recall what a person demonstrated earlier, or track which steps of a task it has already completed. Current vision-language-action (VLA) policies often fail once the information needed for action disappears from the current observation, making memory critical for long-horizon robot behavior. Existing approaches typically provide longer histories or learn implicit memory from observation-action trajectories. But action supervision tells a policy how to act, not what to remember: it does not specify which past facts should persist or how they should change as new evidence arrives. We therefore separate maintaining an evidence-grounded account of the past from learning how to act on it. This insight motivates Explicit Concept Memory (ECoMEM), which represents task-relevant history with a reusable library of grounded concepts. An evidence-based Writer selects and updates these records, while a learned Reader turns them into memory tokens that directly condition the VLA. Across 16 RoboMME tasks, ECoMEM leads the evaluated robot policies on 15 tasks. On two new real-robot tasks, the same memory library either transfers directly or requires only one new concept, achieving 86.1% success versus 8.6% for a no-memory VLA. These results show that explicit concepts provide a reusable and extensible memory interface for robot control. Project website: https://ecomem.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出显式概念记忆（ECoMEM），将"维护过去证据"与"学习如何行动"解耦，通过可复用的落地概念库表示任务相关历史，在16个RoboMME任务中15个领先，并在真实机器人任务上显著优于无记忆VLA。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人任务中，目标物体离开视野、需回忆人类演示或追踪任务进度时，当前观测已不包含行动所需信息，记忆因此成为关键。现有VLA策略依赖更长历史或从观测-动作轨迹中隐式学习记忆，但动作监督只告诉策略如何行动，并不指明哪些过去事实应被保留、以及新证据到来时它们应如何变化，因此记忆内容缺乏明确约束。
AI.method: 将"维护基于证据的过去记录"与"学习基于记忆行动"分离。ECoMEM用可复用的落地概念库（grounded concepts）表示任务相关历史：基于证据的Writer负责选择并更新这些概念记录，学习得到的Reader将记录转化为记忆token，直接对VLA策略进行条件化。
AI.result: 在16个RoboMME任务中，ECoMEM在15个任务上优于所评估的机器人策略。在两个新的真实机器人任务中，同一记忆库或可直接迁移、或仅需新增一个概念，成功率达86.1%，而无记忆VLA仅为8.6%。
AI.conclusion: 显式概念可作为机器人控制中可复用、可扩展的记忆接口，为长时程VLA策略提供有效的记忆机制。

title: Getting Out and Getting Back: World and Behavior Grounding in Real2Sim2Real Co-Training
summary: Simulation can expand scarce real demonstrations for co-training, yet how world fidelity and similarity to human behavior affect policy performance remains unclear. We distinguish world grounding, which aligns simulation with the real system, and behavior grounding, which aligns simulated trajectories with human motion. We build a real2sim2real pipeline that varies these axes independently to generate data for co-training. On a dynamic dexterous pick-and-sort task, fully grounded co-training raises success from 52% to 86%; averaged across configurations, world grounding improves success by 18 percentage points and behavior grounding by 10. Deployed policies behave like a mixture of real-derived and simulation-derived policies, imitating real demonstrations in covered states and relying on simulated behavior elsewhere, which we examine through latent-space analysis. Together, these results suggest complementary roles: world grounding lets policies use simulated experience beyond real-data coverage, while behavior grounding matters mainly when world grounding is imperfect. Grounded simulation remains beneficial when co-training foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出real2sim2real流水线，独立变化"世界接地"（仿真对齐真实系统）与"行为接地"（仿真轨迹对齐人类运动）两个维度，用于生成co-training数据；在动态灵巧抓取分拣任务上，完全接地的co-training将成功率从52%提升至86%，并揭示两者互补作用。
AI.motivation: 仿真可扩展稀缺的真实示范以支持co-training，但世界的保真度以及与人类行为的相似性如何影响策略性能尚不清楚。
AI.method: 区分world grounding（使仿真对齐真实系统）与behavior grounding（使仿真轨迹对齐人类运动），构建real2sim2real流水线，独立改变这两个维度以生成co-training数据，并通过隐空间分析考察策略行为。
AI.result: 在动态灵巧pick-and-sort任务上，完全接地的co-training将成功率从52%提升到86%；跨配置平均而言，world grounding提升18个百分点，behavior grounding提升10个百分点。部署策略表现为真实衍生与仿真衍生策略的混合：在覆盖状态下模仿真实示范，其他情况依赖仿真行为。
AI.conclusion: 两者角色互补：world grounding使策略能利用超出真实数据覆盖范围的仿真经验，而behavior grounding主要在世界接地不完美时发挥作用；在co-training基础模型时，接地仿真仍然有益。

title: TRACE: Privacy-Preserving Next-Best-View Selection over Distributed 3D Gaussian-Splat Maps
summary: Share the light, not the map. We study next-best-view selection for a team of robots, each of which builds its own 3D Gaussian Splatting map and keeps it private. A robot picks the view with the largest expected information gain (EIG) about the splats along its own path. This gain depends on the other maps. Their splats occlude its own and shine behind them, so the gain has to be evaluated against the pooled map. No robot has this map. We show that the coupling passes through only two ray quantities, the transmittance in front of a splat and the radiance behind it, and that both are sums over the hits of the ray. Hence, they decompose across the robots, and each robot sums them over depth bins in its own map, along the rays of a candidate view, and sends the sums with their pose derivatives. The robot planning the view turns them into its EIG and gradient on SO(3). Transmittance and Radiance Aggregates, communicated for the EIG, give the protocol its name: TRACE. No robot shares its splats, and the message size does not grow with a map. We prove that the reconstruction is exact unless a depth bin behind a splat mixes hits of two robots, and we bound the error otherwise. Over 100 next-best-view decisions in Habitat-Sim, TRACE picks a heading within 15 degrees of the centralized one in 83.3% of the cases, and its views reach 97.9% of the centralized EIG.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE协议，使多机器人团队在各自私有的3D高斯泼溅地图上，通过仅交换两类光线聚合量实现隐私保护的下一最佳视角选择。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协作建图时，各机器人维护私有3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）地图。下一最佳视角（NBV）选择需评估期望信息增益（EIG），但增益依赖于其他地图的泼溅体（遮挡与背景辐射），而没有任何机器人拥有全局地图，因此需要在不共享地图的前提下完成协作式视角规划。
AI.method: 证明耦合仅通过两个光线量传递：泼溅体前方的透射率（transmittance）与其后方的辐射度（radiance），二者均为光线上命中项的求和，因而可按机器人分解。各机器人沿候选视角光线在自己的地图中按深度分箱求和，并连同位姿导数一起发送。规划机器人聚合这些量以计算EIG及其在SO(3)上的梯度。该协议命名为TRACE（Transmittance and Radiance Aggregates for EIG）。不共享泼溅体，消息大小不随地图规模增长；并证明除某深度箱混合了两机器人命中项的情况外重建是精确的，否则给出误差上界。
AI.result: 在Habitat-Sim中超过100次NBV决策中，TRACE选出的朝向与集中式方案相差15度以内的比例为83.3%，其视角达到集中式EIG的97.9%。
AI.conclusion: TRACE在无需共享私有地图、通信量恒定的条件下，实现了接近集中式方案的NBV性能，为隐私保护的多机器人主动建图提供了可行方案。

title: Reactive Humanoid Multi-Contact Using Learned Stability Models
summary: We present a planning and control approach to reactively use hand contacts to stabilize a humanoid in low stability scenarios, where only using feet contacts may result in a fall. Candidate contacts are sampled within the robot's reachable workspace, and a preview is computed by rolling out the centroidal dynamics through pre-impact, impact and post-impact phases. Sampled points are scored based on the Center of Pressure (CoP) control authority at the post-impact phase. Central to our approach is a learned model of the robot's CoP region during post-impact, which enables rapid evaluation of candidate contact points compared to traditional optimization-based methods. The presented planner has two stages: the first selects an optimal bracing region and the second computes an optimal bracing point within the region. Our simulation results demonstrate an average increase in impulse resilience of 89% over recovery without hand contacts and 17% over a naive planning strategy (closest reachable region). We validate our framework on hardware, performing push tests while standing and walking. The standing trials show an average 43% reduction in stabilization time compared to naive hand placement and the walking trials demonstrate a 18% reduction compared to baseline recovery (without hand contacts).

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用手部接触的仿人机器人反应式规划与控制方法，通过学习的CoP区域模型快速评估候选接触点，实现低稳定性场景下的稳定，仿真与硬件实验均验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 在低稳定性场景中，仅依靠足部接触可能导致仿人机器人跌倒，需要引入手部接触（支撑/撑扶）来增强稳定性；而传统基于优化的接触点选择方法计算代价高，难以满足反应式快速规划需求。
AI.method: 在机器人可达工作空间内采样候选接触点，通过滚动展开质心动力学（涵盖碰撞前、碰撞、碰撞后三个阶段）进行预览；基于碰撞后阶段质心压力（CoP）控制权限对采样点打分。核心是学习得到的碰撞后机器人CoP区域模型，相比传统优化方法可实现候选接触点快速评估。规划器分两阶段：先选择最优撑扶区域，再在该区域内计算最优撑扶点。
AI.result: 仿真结果显示，相比无手部接触的恢复方式，冲量鲁棒性平均提升89%，相比朴素规划策略（最近可达区域）提升17%。硬件验证包括站立与行走时的推力测试：站立试验中相比朴素手部放置，稳定时间平均缩短43%；行走试验中相比无手部接触的基线恢复，缩短18%。
AI.conclusion: 利用手部接触的反应式规划可显著提升仿人机器人在低稳定性场景下的抗扰动能力，学习的CoP区域模型兼顾评估速度与规划质量，仿真与硬件实验共同验证了框架的实用性。

title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
summary: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) combine scene estimation, interaction grounding, and executable actions. Understanding how these abilities support complete robotic tasks is central to evaluating their readiness as robot generalists. We introduce Embodied Agent Arena to examine where local competence supports, or falls short of, complete task success across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation. The arena contains 1,000 cases drawn from 32 established sources and GeoProbe, our new benchmark for geometric estimation on Blender renders and real-scene images. A minimal harness preserves source observations and operations while separating metric precision, functional grounding, and native goal completion. We evaluate seven VLMs, analyze Astra's task-specific advantages, and compare richer-observation execution protocols and multi-round review. Across the arena, Astra's advantage is strongest in precise estimation and usable-contact localization; completing coordinated, goal-directed actions remains the key gap to robot generalism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Embodied Agent Arena，通过 1000 个跨五类能力的案例评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在完整机器人任务中的表现，发现局部能力（精确估计、可操作接触定位）较强，但协调的目标导向动作执行仍是实现机器人通用化的关键短板。
AI.motivation: 前沿 VLM 已整合场景估计、交互接地与可执行动作，但其各项能力如何支撑完整的机器人任务尚不清楚。为评估其作为机器人通用模型的准备程度，需要系统性地考察局部能力在何处支撑或不足以支撑完整任务成功。
AI.method: 构建 Embodied Agent Arena，覆盖 Geometry、Spatial Reasoning、Affordance、Task Planning、Manipulation 五类能力，包含 1000 个案例，来自 32 个既有来源及新基准 GeoProbe（基于 Blender 渲染与真实场景图像的几何估计）。采用最小化测试框架，保留原始观测与操作，同时分离度量精度、功能接地与原生目标完成度。评估七个 VLM，分析 Astra 的任务特定优势，并比较更丰富观测的执行协议与多轮复核。
AI.result: 在整体评估中，Astra 的优势在精确估计和可用接触定位方面最为突出；但在完成协调的、目标导向的动作方面仍存在明显不足。
AI.conclusion: 局部感知与接地能力已较为成熟，但完成协调的目标导向动作仍是通往机器人通用化的核心瓶颈；Embodied Agent Arena 为系统评估 VLM 的机器人任务能力提供了统一框架。

title: Kinematic MeanFlow: One-Step Action Generation Policy for Robotic Foundation Models
summary: In this paper, we study how to achieve one-step action generation in Robotic Foundation Models (RFMs), aiming to overcome the high inference latency of multi-step flow matching. MeanFlow provides a promising framework for this goal, yet its direct application leads to performance collapse. We discover that this stems from two distinctive dynamics exhibited in the RFM velocity field: (1) the ``local acceleration" exhibits stability early on, but surges sharply towards the end of the denoising process, and (2) the spread of its magnitudes across samples widens as denoising progresses. To address these issues, we introduce Kinematic MeanFlow (K-MF), a novel one-step action policy tailored for RFMs. Specifically, grounded in a kinematic identity, K-MF decouples the time derivative term in the MeanFlow formulation into two sub-interval terms separated by an intermediate point. This decoupled formulation enables the two terms to capture early-stage and late-stage denoising dynamics, respectively, while mitigating the error amplification across the process. As a result, our K-MF empowers RFMs to achieve one-step action generation in both training from scratch and fine-tuning paradigms across diverse tasks, while outperforming multi-step flow matching in most settings. In terms of inference efficiency, K-MF reduces action-head latency of GR00T-N1.6 by 67.5%~74.4% across L40 and Jetson Orin in eager and compiled modes, yielding end-to-end latency reductions of 30.3%~54.9%. Code will be available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/K-MF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Kinematic MeanFlow (K-MF)，一种面向机器人基础模型（RFM）的一步动作生成策略，通过运动学恒等式解耦MeanFlow中的时间导数项，解决直接应用MeanFlow导致的性能崩溃问题，并显著降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 多步流匹配（flow matching）在机器人基础模型中存在高推理延迟问题。MeanFlow框架虽有望实现一步生成，但直接应用会导致性能崩溃，需要分析其根本原因并加以解决。
AI.method: 首先揭示RFM速度场中的两种动态特性：(1)"局部加速度"在早期稳定，但在去噪过程末期急剧上升；(2)其幅值的样本间分布随去噪推进而变宽。基于此，提出K-MF：以运动学恒等式为基础，将MeanFlow公式中的时间导数项解耦为以中间点为界的两个子区间项，分别捕捉早期和晚期去噪动态，同时缓解误差放大。
AI.result: K-MF使RFM在从零训练和微调两种范式下、跨越多种任务均能实现一步动作生成，并在多数场景下优于多步流匹配。推理效率方面，K-MF将GR00T-N1.6的动作头延迟在L40和Jetson Orin上（eager与compiled模式）降低67.5%~74.4%，端到端延迟降低30.3%~54.9%。
AI.conclusion: K-MF是一种有效且高效的一步动作生成方法，解决了MeanFlow在RFM中的性能崩溃问题，在保持或超越多步流匹配性能的同时大幅降低推理延迟。

title: UniTrackPLA: Unified Panorama-Language-Action Model for Instruction-Guided Navigation and Dynamic Person Tracking
comment: The project page is at https://tw5775.github.io/UniTrackPLA
summary: General-purpose embodied robots should support both navigation toward language-specified destinations and dynamic person tracking under arbitrary initial target azimuths. However, existing methods typically rely on forward-facing observations and address these tasks with separate policies, limiting omnidirectional perception and unified closed-loop control. We present UniTrackPLA, a unified panorama-language-action model for instruction-guided navigation and dynamic person tracking. Its Panoramic-Aware Encoding (PAE) preserves the temporal and azimuthal structure of perspective views projected from each panorama, enabling perspective-pretrained visual encoders to process omnidirectional observations. A shared vision-language backbone grounds instructions in the panoramic context and predicts continuous robot-centric waypoint chunks for both tasks. World-Action Consistency (WAC) further predicts action-conditioned future visual states and verifies waypoint prefixes online, allowing reliable actions to be reused while triggering replanning upon inconsistency. We also introduce OmniTrackNav-Bench, comprising 5,000 simulated tracking trajectories, 10,000 simulated VLN routes, and 96 verified real-world routes, providing 919,978 waypoint-supervision instances. UniTrackPLA improves overall tracking SR from 23.50% to 35.00% and Omni-VLN SR/SPL from 13.00%/12.77% to 19.75%/19.29%. Incorporating 76 real-world routes further improves held-out EP@0.2m from 42.92% to 92.08%. Closed-loop experiments on a Go2-W robot demonstrate unified panoramic tracking and navigation across indoor and outdoor environments. The project page is at https://tw5775.github.io/UniTrackPLA.

AI.tldr: UniTrackPLA是一个统一的全景-语言-动作模型，将指令导航与动态人员跟踪整合于同一策略，通过全景感知编码与动作一致性校验提升全向闭环控制性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖前向观测且将导航与人员跟踪分为独立策略，限制了全向感知能力与统一闭环控制，而通用具身机器人需同时支持语言指定目的地的导航与任意初始方位下的动态人员跟踪。
AI.method: 提出UniTrackPLA模型：1) 全景感知编码（PAE）保留全景投影视图的时间与方位结构，使透视预训练编码器可处理全向观测；2) 共享视觉-语言骨干将指令锚定于全景上下文，预测连续机器人中心航点块；3) 世界-动作一致性（WAC）预测动作条件下的未来视觉状态并在线校验航点前缀，一致时复用动作，不一致时触发重规划；并构建OmniTrackNav-Bench基准。
AI.result: 跟踪整体SR由23.50%提升至35.00%；Omni-VLN的SR/SPL由13.00%/12.77%提升至19.75%/19.29%；加入76条真实路线后，留出集EP@0.2m由42.92%提升至92.08%；在Go2-W机器人上完成室内外统一全景跟踪与导航闭环实验。
AI.conclusion: UniTrackPLA验证了统一全景-语言-动作框架在指令导航与动态人员跟踪任务上的有效性，配合新基准OmniTrackNav-Bench实现了全向感知与统一闭环控制，并在真实机器人上完成室内外验证。

title: Real-Time Human-Adaptive Task Allocation for Multi-Human Multi-Robot Supervision
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: We propose a human-factor-aware method of allocating robot supervision tasks to multiple human operators. In scenarios where multiple operators occasionally teleoperate multiple robots to help the robots overcome difficulties, the allocation of the supervisory control tasks to humans needs to consider the real-time cognitive states of individual operators. However, most existing methods assume fixed supervisory capacity per operator and overlook fluctuations in the human factors such as workload and fatigue. As a result, workload distribution can be unbalanced where some operators become overloaded while the others remain underused. Our method dynamically regulates supervisory capacity and allocates tasks in a way that maintains balanced mental workload, prevents overload, and improves overall team performance. The allocation method uses a greedy strategy that minimizes estimated operator workloads with task prioritization. Robots are assigned to operators by reflecting their current supervisory capacity where the required effort depends on the types of tasks. In the user study, the analysis across predefined time intervals shows that the proposed method consistently achieves higher performance and lower behavioral signs of fatigue compared to a baseline method that does not consider human factors. These results highlight adaptive capacity adjustment as an effective preventive mechanism for sustaining operator performance in long-duration, high-demand settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种考虑人类因素的多操作员机器人监督任务分配方法，动态调节监督容量，使用贪心策略平衡心理负荷，用户研究中比基线方法性能更高、疲劳迹象更低。
AI.motivation: 多操作员偶尔遥操作多个机器人的场景中，任务分配需考虑个体操作员实时认知状态；但现有方法假设每名操作员的监督容量固定，忽略工作负荷与疲劳等人类因素波动，导致负荷分配不均（部分过载、部分未充分利用）。
AI.method: 一种人类因素感知的任务分配方法：动态调节监督容量并按任务优先级进行分配；采用贪心策略最小化估计的操作员工作负荷；根据操作员当前监督容量进行机器人指派，所需投入取决于任务类型。
AI.result: 用户研究中，按预定时间区间分析表明，与不考虑人类因素的基线方法相比，所提方法 consistently 获得更高性能，并表现出更低的行为疲劳迹象。
AI.conclusion: 自适应容量调节是一种有效的预防机制，可在长时间、高需求环境中维持操作员绩效。

title: TOAST: Stochastic Robot Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action models often represent continuous robot actions as discrete token sequences, enabling action prediction with standard next-token objectives. FAST has substantially improved this representation by compactly encoding action containing diverse temporal frequencies into relatively few tokens. However, while such compression reduces the number of action tokens required for autoregressive prediction, it does not necessarily improve the efficiency of policy learning from limited demonstrations. In particular, FAST typically assigns a single deterministic tokenization to each quantized action sequence, although multiple token sequences can represent and decode to the same robot motion. We investigate whether exploiting this representational redundancy can improve policy learning. In this paper, we propose TOkenization of Action sequences with STochastic sampling (TOAST), a stochastic action tokenization method that samples alternative tokenizations of the same quantized action sequence during policy training. This diversifies the discrete supervision while preserving the underlying robot action and requires no additional demonstrations. Experiments on LIBERO show that TOAST consistently improves over its deterministic counterpart, with the improvement increasing as training data decreases, achieving a 6.8 point gain in success rate when only 1/16 of training data is available. Across four real-robot manipulation tasks, TOAST further improves mean success rate by 15.8 points over the deterministic counterpart. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of stochastic action tokenization for autoregressive robot policy learning, particularly when training data are limited.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TOAST，一种随机动作分词方法，在策略训练时对同一量化动作序列采样多种替代分词，在不增加示教数据的前提下提升自回归VLA策略学习效果。
AI.motivation: FAST等方法通过紧凑编码将连续机器人动作表示为少量离散token，但压缩仅减少动作token数量，未必提升有限示教下的策略学习效率。FAST对每个量化动作序列仅给出单一确定性分词，而同一机器人运动其实可由多个token序列表示并解码得到，这种表示冗余性尚未被利用。
AI.method: 提出TOAST（TOkenization of Action sequences with STochastic sampling）：一种随机动作分词方法，在策略训练过程中对同一量化动作序列采样不同的替代分词，从而在保持底层机器人动作不变的前提下多样化离散监督信号，且无需额外示教数据。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上，TOAST持续优于确定性分词基线，且训练数据越少提升越明显：仅使用1/16训练数据时成功率提升6.8个百分点。在四项真实机器人操作任务上，TOAST相较确定性方法平均成功率提升15.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明随机动作分词对自回归机器人策略学习有效，尤其在训练数据有限时优势显著，说明利用分词表示的冗余性可作为一种无需额外数据的有效训练增强手段。

title: Screw Attention: Rigid-Body Algebra Inside a Transformer
summary: Learned manipulation policies rediscover from data the spatial relations that rigid-body mechanics supplies in closed form. This costs data, and it leaves the policies fragile to geometric changes in the scene. We present Screw Attention, a transformer layer in which the relation between two bodies is a spatial transform rather than a graph edge. Every token is a body with a pose. Each pair of tokens carries the relative pose and, for robot joints, the joint screw. Messages are transported along this relation into the receiver's frame, while the attention scores see only frame-invariant quantities. By construction, the messages are equivariant to an independent change of frame at every token, and a single layer can express the velocity recursion of rigid-body mechanics. On simulated manipulation tasks, Screw Attention matches or outperforms controls of the same size, including graph, transformer and flat networks on LIBERO-Spatial. With 16,162 parameters it reaches 97.3% on LIBERO-Spatial from object poses (without images or language), above a flat network with 27x more parameters. Under a change of per-link frame convention its success is unchanged, while every other learned network falls below 3%. Placed on an analytic controller as a gated residual, it raises insertion success by 17.3 points. It is unaffected by pose noise up to 10,mm and by joint offsets within the factory calibration of a Franka arm. These results suggest a criterion: geometry is decisive when the task requires relations between frames that no other part of the system supplies. Code and trained policies will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出Screw Attention层：以刚体位姿相对变换传递消息，注意力分数仅用坐标系不变量，天然等变且可表达刚体速度递推，在LIBERO-Spatial等任务上以极少参数超越大规模基线并对坐标系约定与噪声鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 学习到的操作策略需要从数据中重新发现刚体力学本可闭式给出的空间关系，这既耗费数据，又使策略对场景几何变化（如坐标系约定改变）脆弱。作者希望把几何结构直接嵌入网络，而非让网络从数据中学。
AI.method: Screw Attention：一个transformer层，将两刚体间关系建模为空间变换而非图边。每个token是一个带位姿的刚体；每对token携带相对位姿，机器人关节则携带关节螺旋。消息沿该关系被变换到接收者坐标系，而注意力分数只依赖坐标系不变量。由此消息对每个token独立的坐标系变化等变，单层即可表达刚体的速度递推。
AI.result: 在仿真操作任务上，Screw Attention匹配或超越同规模基线（图网络、transformer、扁平网络），在LIBERO-Spatial上以16,162参数、仅用物体位姿（无图像、无语言）达到97.3%，优于参数多27倍的扁平网络。改变每连杆坐标系约定时其成功率不变，而其他学习网络均降至3%以下。作为门控残差置于解析控制器上，插入成功率提升17.3个百分点。对最高10 mm的位姿噪声以及Franka机械臂出厂标定范围内的关节偏移均不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 几何是决定性的：当任务需要其他系统部件无法提供的坐标系间关系时，应显式建模几何结构。作者据此提出判据，并将公开代码与训练策略。

title: eRLT: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Action-Relevant Token Routing
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide strong behavioral priors for robotic manipulation, yet efficiently adapting them to downstream tasks remains challenging. Recent work addresses this challenge by adapting frozen VLAs through online reinforcement learning (RL), whose sample efficiency depends on the quality of the state representation used by the actor and critic. Existing methods construct such representations either with VLA-independent visual encoders or through fixed compression of internal VLA representations. Neither design explicitly extracts the task-specific action-relevant VLA features most useful for downstream action refinement and action-value estimation, therefore limiting sample efficiency. To address this limitation, we introduce eRLT, which constructs an effective state representation by routing task-specific action-relevant information across both tokens and layers of the frozen VLA. Specifically, learned routing tokens dynamically aggregate visual-language features at multiple depths, while a lightweight layer router combines these summaries into a fixed-dimensional RL token. The routing module is initialized using expert demonstrations to capture features predictive of expert actions and then refined using critic feedback from online interactions for action-value estimation. Across seven LIBERO and RoboTwin tasks, eRLT improves mean normalized learning-curve AUC by up to 23.7% over representative baselines. Real-robot experiments on USB connector insertion and motherboard ribbon-cable insertion further show AUC improvements of 108.9% and 46.7%, respectively, over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 eRLT，一种为冻结 VLA 模型构建高效状态表示的在线强化学习方法：通过可学习的 routing token 在冻结 VLA 的多个层与 token 间动态聚合任务相关的动作-视觉-语言特征，并用轻量 layer router 融合为固定维度 RL token。该模块先用专家示范初始化，再用在线交互的 critic 反馈微调。在 7 个 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 任务上平均归一化学习曲线 AUC 最多提升 23.7%；真机 USB 连接器插入与主板排线插入任务上 AUC 分别提升 108.9% 与 46.7%。
AI.motivation: 将 VLA 模型适配到下游操作任务时，在线 RL 微调冻结 VLA 具有潜力，但其样本效率高度依赖 actor 与 critic 所用状态表示的质量。现有方法要么使用与 VLA 无关的视觉编码器，要么对 VLA 内部表示做固定压缩，均未显式提取对下游动作精修与动作价值估计最有用的、任务特定的动作相关 VLA 特征，因而限制了样本效率。
AI.method: 提出 eRLT，通过在冻结 VLA 的 token 与 layer 两个维度上进行路由，构建有效的状态表示。具体地：可学习的 routing token 动态聚合多个深度的视觉-语言特征，轻量 layer router 将这些多层总结组合成固定维度的 RL token；路由模块先由专家示范初始化，以捕获对专家动作具有预测性的特征，再借助在线交互中的 critic 反馈进行精修，以服务于动作价值估计。
AI.result: 在 7 个 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 任务上，eRLT 相比代表性基线将平均归一化学习曲线 AUC 最多提升 23.7%。在 USB 连接器插入与主板排线插入的真机实验中，相比最强基线 AUC 分别提升 108.9% 与 46.7%。
AI.conclusion: 跨多个仿真与真机任务的结果表明，显式路由并聚合任务特定的动作相关 VLA 特征，可显著提升冻结 VLA 在线 RL 适配的样本效率，验证了 token-层双维度路由与示范初始化加 critic 反馈精修设计的有效性。

title: A Survey on End-to-End Autonomous Driving Training from the Perspectives of Data, Strategy, and Platform
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, accepted by IEEE transactions on intelligent transportation systems
summary: Autonomous driving is a cornerstone technology for the future of intelligent transportation, where end-to-end learning has emerged as a transformative paradigm that directly maps multimodal sensory inputs to driving actions through unified differentiable models. While offering advantages, the effectiveness of end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) is ultimately determined by the quality of its training ecosystem. This paper provides a comprehensive review of training methods and ecosystem for E2E-AD. We introduce a Data-Strategy-Platform taxonomy that conceptualizes training as an interdependent system. The data layer defines what can be learned, the strategy layer governs how learning aligns with driving objectives, and the platform layer supports scalability and continuous evolution. Within this framework, we survey recent advances across data-centric pipelines, learning paradigms, and training infrastructures, and analyze their interplay in shaping model performance, robustness, and deployability. Finally, we reflect on current limitations and articulate a forward-looking vision that emphasizes a shift from data quantity to data value, from isolated optimization to foundation-driven generalization, and from static training to integrated training-testing loops, aiming toward robust, scalable, and trustworthy autonomous driving systems. We maintain a continuously updated repository tracking cutting-edge literature and works at \href{https://github.com/Jiaaqiliu/Awesome-Training-Ecosystem-for-E2E-AD}{Our Project Page}.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了端到端自动驾驶（E2E-AD）的训练方法与生态系统，提出"数据-策略-平台"分类体系，分析三层协同对模型性能、鲁棒性和可部署性的影响，并展望未来发展方向。
AI.motivation: 端到端学习已成为自动驾驶的变革性范式，其效果最终取决于训练生态系统的质量，但目前缺乏对E2E-AD训练方法与生态的系统性梳理。
AI.method: 提出Data-Strategy-Platform（数据-策略-平台）分类体系，将训练概念化为相互依赖的系统：数据层定义可学习内容，策略层决定学习如何对齐驾驶目标，平台层支撑可扩展性与持续演进；并在此框架下综述数据中心流程、学习范式与训练基础设施的进展及其相互作用。
AI.result: 系统归纳了各层的近期进展，剖析了三层间的耦合关系如何共同决定模型的性能、鲁棒性与可部署性，并指出了当前局限。
AI.conclusion: 提出前瞻性愿景：从数据数量转向数据价值，从孤立优化转向基础驱动的泛化，从静态训练转向训练-测试一体化闭环，以实现鲁棒、可扩展、可信的自动驾驶系统，并维护持续更新的文献仓库。

title: ShowerFlex: Achieving Pseudo-Static Balancing in a Continuum Shower Hose
comment: 10 pages, 9 figures. Accepted to ASME IDETC/CIE 2026, Mechanisms and Robotics Conference
summary: With the global population rapidly aging, maintaining independence in Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), particularly bathing or showering, has become a critical challenge. Older adults who sit while showering currently have limited options, often relying on rigid overhead showerheads or flexible hand-held hoses that require continuous gripping and precarious user maneuvers, increasing the risk of falls. To address this need, this paper introduces a highly articulated, pseudo-static balanced continuum mechanism designed specifically for accessible bathing assistance. The proposed mechanism features a modular continuum architecture composed of friction-locked ball-and-socket joints (loc-line), seamlessly integrated with a retractable spring-loaded reel for effective gravity compensation. This hybrid design achieves an intuitive "Push-and-Stay" interaction logic, maintaining an approximate static equilibrium with ergonomically low actuation force, without any external electronic power, while significantly minimizing the force needed for repositioning. Theoretically, we established a recursive forward kinematics framework to construct the geometric model of the structure, coupled with a comprehensive static equilibrium analysis to evaluate the system's holding capacity across its 51-DOF structure. Numerical simulations utilizing Monte Carlo methods validate the system's morphological adaptability and stability at various extreme positions within a standard bath space. Physical experiments further validate the prototype's real-world performance, confirming its intrinsic static stability against gravity and ensuring that the actuation force remains well within the ergonomic capabilities of older adults. Ultimately, this research provides a low-cost, intrinsically safe showerhead design that reduces physical strain, restoring dignity and autonomy in personal hygiene.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向老年人淋浴辅助的高铰接、伪静力平衡连续体机构，采用摩擦锁定球窝关节（loc-line）与弹簧回卷轮结合的混合设计，实现免电力的"推入即停"交互，并通过递归正运动学、静力学分析与仿真、实验验证其稳定性与低驱动力。
AI.motivation: 全球人口快速老龄化背景下，维持日常生活活动（ADL，尤其洗澡/淋浴）的独立性成为关键挑战。现有坐姿淋浴老年人只能使用刚性顶置喷头或需持续握持、操作不便的软管，易增加跌倒风险；因此需要一种低成本、本质安全、可轻松调节的淋浴喷头机构。
AI.method: 提出模块化连续体架构，由摩擦锁定球窝关节（loc-line）与可伸缩弹簧回卷轮集成，实现重力补偿与近似静力平衡，形成"推入即停"交互逻辑；建立递归正运动学框架构建几何模型，并进行覆盖51自由度结构的静力平衡分析评估保持能力；采用蒙特卡洛数值仿真验证标准浴室空间内极端位置的形态适应性与稳定性；最后通过物理实验验证原型性能。
AI.result: 数值仿真验证了系统在标准浴室空间内多种极端位置的形态适应性与稳定性；物理实验验证了原型对重力的内在静稳定性，并确认驱动力保持在老年人人体工效能力范围内。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种低成本、本质安全的淋浴喷头设计，可减少身体负担，恢复老年人在个人卫生中的尊严与自主性。

title: NarrativeFlow: Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Model Using Robot Velocity Fields
summary: We focus on language-conditioned flow-based manipulation, where robot flows (robot velocity fields) serve as embodiment-agnostic, motion-centric representations for leveraging data collected from multiple robot platforms. This task is crucial because language-conditioned manipulation is essential for practical robotic systems, yet scaling robot foundation models remains limited by the labor-intensive collection of embodiment-specific data. Existing methods either coarsely approximate robot flows with sparse keypoint displacements, or cannot handle language-conditioned manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose NarrativeFlow, which models robot flows as continuous velocity fields using a flow-matching formulation conditioned on language. Accordingly, NarrativeFlow generates robot flows that are physically consistent with real-world manipulation. To validate NarrativeFlow, we have conducted experiments on standard datasets for language-conditioned manipulation. The experimental results show that NarrativeFlow outperforms representative baseline methods on standard evaluation metrics. Furthermore, through real-world experiments, we show that NarrativeFlow achieves higher success rates than baseline methods across multiple manipulation tasks. The project page is available at https://shota0520.github.io/NarrativeFlow-project-page/

AI.tldr: 提出 NarrativeFlow，将机器人流建模为语言条件下的连续速度场，实现具身无关的流式操作表征。
AI.motivation: 语言条件操作对实用机器人系统至关重要，但机器人基础模型的扩展受限于具身特定数据的高昂采集成本；现有方法仅用稀疏关键点位移粗略近似机器人流，或无法处理语言条件操作。
AI.method: 以流匹配（flow-matching）形式，将机器人流建模为以语言为条件的连续速度场，从而生成与现实操作物理一致的机器人流。
AI.result: 在语言条件操作标准数据集上，NarrativeFlow 在标准评测指标上优于代表性基线方法；真实世界实验中，在多个操作任务上取得比基线更高的成功率。
AI.conclusion: NarrativeFlow 通过语言条件的连续速度场建模机器人流，为跨具身数据利用提供了有效且具身无关的解决方案，并在仿真与真实任务中均验证了其优越性。

title: Divide-and-Remember: Recursive Action-Relevant Memory for Long-Horizon VLA Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle on history-dependent manipulation tasks, where the current observation alone does not determine the action, and the policy needs a memory of the history. Existing memory methods decide what to remember by design, for example, keeping frames with large pixel changes, and show inconsistent gains across tasks. We view what to remember as an optimisation problem. From the POMDP formulation of imitation learning, we show that the optimal memory maximises the conditional mutual information $I(a_t; m_t \mid o_t)$ between the action and the memory given the current observation. Intuitively, this means preserving the action-relevant information in the history that is not already contained in the current observation. Based on our analysis, we propose Divide-and-Remember (D&R), a recursive memory method that learns a memory function $m_t = M(h_t)$ and scales to long contexts while staying compute-light. It involves two strategies: (1) the selection over the full history is divided recursively into subproblems of top-$K$ selection over $2K$ tokens, so that fixed-size, lightweight selectors learned end-to-end support an unbounded history; (2) all recursion blocks share one selector, which captures the selection rule common to every block and keeps the method efficient. On RoboMME, a benchmark of 16 long-horizon manipulation tasks that require remembering when, where, what, and how to act, D&R achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate with consistent gains across all four suites under a budget of only 64 tokens; real-robot experiments show the same gain. Code, checkpoints and more results are at https://dnr-memory.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出Divide-and-Remember (D&R)——一种递归式记忆方法，将"记什么"视为优化问题，通过最大化动作与记忆在当前观测条件下的互信息来学习记忆函数，在长程操作任务上仅用64个token预算即取得SOTA成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在依赖历史信息的操作任务中表现不佳：仅凭当前观测无法确定动作，策略需要历史记忆。现有记忆方法多以人工设计规则决定"记什么"（如保留像素变化大的帧），在不同任务上增益不稳定。
AI.method: 作者将"记什么"建模为优化问题。基于模仿学习的POMDP形式化，证明最优记忆应最大化条件互信息 I(a_t; m_t | o_t)，即保留当前观测中尚未包含且与动作相关的历史信息。据此提出D&R递归记忆方法，学习记忆函数 m_t = M(h_t)，包含两项策略：(1) 将全历史的top-K选择递归分解为在2K个token上的子问题，使固定规模、端到端训练的轻量选择器能支持无界历史；(2) 所有递归块共享同一个选择器，以捕获各块共有的选择规则并保持高效。
AI.result: 在RoboMME（16个长程操作任务，要求记住何时、何地、做什么、怎么做）上，D&R在仅64个token的预算下取得SOTA平均成功率，且在全部四个任务套件上均有稳定增益；真实机器人实验也展现同样增益。代码、检查点及更多结果见 https://dnr-memory.github.io/。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆选择形式化为条件互信息最大化问题，并以此指导的递归、共享选择器架构，能在极低token预算下为VLA提供长期记忆，在仿真基准与真实机器人上均获得一致提升。

title: Online Planning for Sparse Ground Target Search from a High-Altitude UAV under Partial Observability
summary:
Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) searching for ground targets from a high altitude face a unique challenge, particularly when the target is already within the field of view but effectively unobservable because of its small apparent scale. Standard object detectors often underperform in such scenarios because of resolution downscaling and limited context. In contrast, active object search frameworks address this challenge by directing the agent to a suitable pose to gather richer visual information. However, flight regulations in urban airspace often restrict such physical movements for UAVs. As an alternative active sensing approach, the UAV can leverage the pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) mechanism of the onboard camera to dynamically adjust its field of view and sequentially gather enhanced visual information from specific regions of interest. Once the candidate locations of the target are identified, it can deploy more expensive object detection schemes, such as an ensemble of multiple models, to get better reasoning at a fixed scale. In this work, we formulate the sequential exploration with PTZ operation as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), in which the agent maintains a belief state over the target's true location. To solve the POMDP, we deploy partially observable Monte Carlo planning (POMCP), where we condition the sensing reliability on target object scale and deploy selective ensemble detection as an additional reasoning step.
  We validate our methodology with experiments in a photorealistic simulator under different environmental conditions and vehicle states, showing detection of ground targets at variable scales with significantly fewer steps and minimal dependence on sensor resolution compared to baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文将无人机利用机载云台变焦（PTZ）相机进行地面目标搜索建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），并用POMCP求解，结合基于目标尺度的感知可靠性与选择性集成检测，在仿真中实现变尺度目标的高效检测。
AI.motivation: 高空无人机搜索地面目标时，目标虽在视场内但表观尺度极小，近乎不可观测；分辨率下采样与上下文受限导致常规检测器性能不足。主动目标搜索虽可通过改变位姿获取更丰富信息，但城市空域飞行管制限制了无人机的物理移动，因此需要一种替代性的主动感知手段。
AI.method: 以PTZ相机视场调节替代物理移动，将带PTZ操作的序贯探索形式化为POMDP，智能体维护关于目标真实位置的信念状态；采用POMCP进行规划求解，将感知可靠性以目标物体尺度为条件进行建模，并在候选位置确定后引入选择性集成检测（多模型集成）作为额外推理步骤。
AI.result: 在照片级真实感仿真器中，针对不同环境条件与载具状态进行实验，相比基线方法，在可变尺度地面目标检测上以显著更少的步数完成检测，且对传感器分辨率的依赖极小。
AI.conclusion: 基于PTZ的主动感知与POMCP规划相结合，可在不依赖无人机物理机动的前提下有效应对小表观尺度目标搜索问题，降低对传感器分辨率的依赖并提升搜索效率，为受限空域下的无人机目标搜索提供了可行方案。

title: quARtet Marker: A 3D-Printable Multi-Tag Fiducial for Robust Near-Frontal Pose Estimation
summary: Robotic manipulation of labware is difficult when transparent or reflective objects must be identified and localized. Coded planar fiducials are a practical retrofit: easy to print, they leave the marked face flat and graspable. Yet a single planar tag is least reliable in near-frontal views, where perspective cues fade. Non-planar geometries restore those cues but intrude on the flat face that a parallel-jaw gripper must contact. Our idea is to tilt multiple tags within one compact footprint, so that each tag is seen at a non-frontal angle even when the marker faces the camera. We propose the quARtet marker, a 3D-printable fiducial embodying this idea: all detected corners of its four tilted AprilTags enter one Perspective-n-Point solve, and a shared configuration defines the fabricated geometry and the detector model. Because tilting consumes flat area, its three layouts trade pose-estimation consistency against graspability. In robot-referenced, same-setup fixed-camera experiments, all three layouts reduced the mean frontal orientation error from 2.18 degree for a single planar tag to 0.24-0.47 degree and the root-mean-square position error from 1.50 to 0.17-0.20 mm. A robot-mounted-camera pose-hold test confirmed this separation under closed-loop visual feedback. In swing-down trials under identical conditions, the two layouts with flat contact strips retained the object with about 2 mm of in-grasp slip, whereas the layout without flat strips slipped by roughly 100 mm. For the tested conditions, the results support a rule: the layout without flat strips when pose-estimation consistency dominates, a layout with flat strips when the marked face must remain graspable.

AI.tldr: 提出 quARtet 3D 打印基准标记：在紧凑底面内倾斜布置四个 AprilTag，使各标签即使正对相机也处于非正面视角，从而提升位姿估计精度，并通过三种布局在精度与可抓取性之间权衡。
AI.motivation: 透明或反射实验器皿的识别与定位困难，平面码标记虽便于改造与抓取，但单一平面标签在近正面视角下透视线索缺失、位姿估计最不可靠；而非平面几何虽能恢复透视线索，却会破坏平行夹爪所需的平整接触面。
AI.method: 设计并 3D 打印 quARtet 标记，在单一紧凑 footprint 内倾斜多个标签；将四个倾斜 AprilTag 的所有检测角点统一输入一个 Perspective-n-Point 求解，并用共享配置同时定义制造几何与检测器模型；提出三种布局以权衡位姿估计一致性与可抓取性。
AI.result: 在机器人坐标系、同装置固定相机实验中，三种布局将正面朝向平均误差从单平面标签的 2.18° 降至 0.24–0.47°，位置 RMSE 从 1.50 mm 降至 0.17–0.20 mm；机器人搭载相机的闭环视觉反馈位姿保持测试验证了该差异；相同条件下的下摆抓取试验中，带平整接触条带的两种布局抓取滑移约 2 mm，而无平整条带布局滑移约 100 mm。
AI.conclusion: 在测试条件下结果支持如下选取规则：当位姿估计一致性优先时选用无平整条带的布局；当标记面必须保持可抓取时选用带平整条带的布局。

title: WBAG: A Whole-Body and Attached-Geometry Safety Framework for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generalizable robotic manipulation, but their deployment in the real world remains challenging due to potential collisions involving different parts of the robot, manipulated objects, and the surrounding environment. Existing inference-time VLA safety frameworks typically rely on simplified end-effector-centered representations that do not explicitly model the full articulated robot and attached-object geometry. In this paper, we present WBAG, a safety framework that models the robot's whole-body and grasp-dependent attached geometry. WBAG constructs a grasp-conditioned safe set that adapts the protected geometry as objects are grasped, then converts this evolving geometry into differentiable CBF constraints that minimally modify the VLA's native six-dimensional operational-space action for collision avoidance across robot, scene, and attached geometry. On the SafeLIBERO benchmark, a variant of LIBERO augmented with obstacles for safety evaluation, WBAG achieves the best overall safety and safe task success among the evaluated methods under a scene-level safety evaluator that monitors all eligible non-task objects, reaching 97.38\% aggregate Scene Safety and 59.38\% Safe Success.

AI.tldr: 提出WBAG安全框架，建模机器人全身与抓取相关的附着几何，通过抓取条件下的可微CBF约束微调VLA动作以实现避碰，在SafeLIBERO上取得最优安全性与安全任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略在真实世界部署时存在机器人与被操纵物体、环境间的碰撞风险；而现有推理时安全框架多依赖简化的以末端执行器为中心的表示，未显式建模完整的关节机器人与附着物体几何。
AI.method: WBAG构建抓取条件的安全集，随物体被抓取自适应调整受保护的几何，并将这一演化几何转化为可微的控制障碍函数（CBF）约束，以最小方式修改VLA原生的六维操作空间动作，从而在机器人、场景与附着几何之间实现避碰。
AI.result: 在SafeLIBERO（在LIBERO基础上增加障碍物用于安全评估的变体）上，使用监控所有非任务物体的场景级安全评估器，WBAG在所评估方法中取得最佳的整体安全性与安全任务成功率，达到97.38%的聚合场景安全性（Scene Safety）与59.38%的安全成功率（Safe Success）。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模机器人全身与抓取依赖的附着几何，并将其转化为可微CBF约束，可有效提升VLA策略的推理时安全性，同时保持较高的安全任务成功率。

title: OrbitTAMP: Grounding Language Models for Task and Motion Planning in Spacecraft Rendezvous
summary: Spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) are currently planned through an expertise-intensive process in which engineers translate high-level operational intent into safe, dynamically feasible trajectories, creating a bottleneck to scalable operations. Large language model (LLM)-based agents could offer an intuitive interface for this process, although their outputs are not inherently grounded in orbital dynamics, operational constraints, or the structure of admissible spacecraft maneuvers. To exploit their semantic reasoning while ensuring the generated plan's physical validity, this paper presents a hierarchical framework for spacecraft task-and-motion planning (TAMP) that grounds LLM reasoning in a graph of reusable behaviors and domain-specific planning modules. Within this framework, a pretrained LLM maps a natural-language command to a partial mission specification. The associated planners then resolve unspecified decisions within the admissible operational space. Finally, trajectory optimization converts the completed mission specification into a dynamically feasible trajectory. Numerical experiments demonstrate that this architecture substantially improves intent recovery over direct LLM generation, achieving 98% exact recovery of partial mission specifications across all evaluated splits when backed by frontier LLMs. Additional test-time-compute experiments show that, for a compact 9B model, verifier-guided revision increases exact recovery from 75% to 88%, while broader behavior-plan search independently improves selection among admissible trajectory realizations. Overall, these results establish a scalable and auditable foundation for language-driven agentic planning of spacecraft RPO.

AI.tldr: 提出分层TAMP框架，用图结构行为与领域规划模块约束LLM推理，实现航天器RPO的语言驱动规划，显著提升意图恢复率与物理可行性。
AI.motivation: 航天器交会与近距操作（RPO）规划高度依赖专家经验，难以规模化。LLM代理可提供直观的自然语言接口，但其输出缺乏轨道动力学、操作约束与可行机动结构的物理依据，因此需要兼顾语义推理与物理有效性。
AI.method: 分层TAMP框架：预训练LLM将自然语言指令映射为部分任务规格；可复用行为图与领域专用规划模块在其上解析未定决策于可行操作空间内；最后通过轨迹优化将完整任务规格转化为动力学可行轨迹。并引入验证器引导的修正与行为-规划搜索（测试时计算）。
AI.result: 相较直接LLM生成，意图恢复大幅提升：在使用前沿LLM时所有评测划分上部分任务规格精确恢复率达98%。对紧凑9B模型，验证器引导修正使精确恢复率从75%提升至88%，更广的行为-规划搜索可独立改善可行轨迹实现的选择。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为语言驱动的航天器RPO代理式规划建立了可扩展、可审计的基础，在保持语义推理优势的同时确保规划的物理有效性。

title: MASkillBlender: Decentralized Whole-Body Coordination for Multi-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Skill Blending
summary: Coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation is promising yet challenging due to high-dimensional whole-body control, decentralized decision making, and scalability. While recent reinforcement learning methods have improved single-humanoid whole-body control, extending them to the multi-humanoid setting remains nontrivial and often requires substantial reward engineering or task-specific design. We propose MASkillBlender, a general multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to achieve decentralized multi-humanoid whole-body coordination. By learning a shared decentralized high-level policy over reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills, MASkillBlender enables coordinated behaviors using only task-level rewards, without requiring task-specific motion references. To improve learning efficiency, we further introduce a permutation-based data augmentation strategy for homogeneous multi-humanoid systems, and theoretically show that the permuted samples preserve the policy-gradient direction of the original samples under the homogeneous Markov game formulation. We evaluate MASkillBlender on multiple multi-humanoid coordination tasks across two humanoid embodiments. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently achieves strong task performance and enables coordinated behaviors across different tasks and humanoid embodiments.

AI.tldr: 提出MASkillBlender，一种通用多智能体强化学习框架，通过在可复用预训练单机器人技能上学习共享分散高层策略，实现去中心化多机器人全身协调，仅需任务级奖励，并引入基于置换的数据增强提升样本效率。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协同运动-操作具有潜力但面临高维全身控制、去中心化决策与可扩展性挑战。现有强化学习方法虽提升了单机器人全身控制，但扩展到多机器人场景需要大量奖励工程或任务特定设计，非平凡。
AI.method: MASkillBlender在预训练的可复用单机器人技能之上学习共享的去中心化高层策略，实现多机器人全身协调；仅使用任务级奖励，无需任务特定运动参考。针对同构多机器人系统提出基于置换的数据增强，并在同构马尔可夫博弈框架下理论证明置换样本保持原样本的策略梯度方向。
AI.result: 在两种机器人实体的多个多机器人协调任务上评估，仿真结果表明框架在不同任务和机器人实体上均能持续取得强任务性能并实现协调行为。
AI.conclusion: MASkillBlender为去中心化多机器人全身协调提供通用框架，降低奖励工程与任务特定设计依赖，并借助置换数据增强提升学习效率，具备跨任务与跨实体泛化能力。

title: Extreme Length Generalization in a Compact Recurrent Architecture for One-Shot Exploration
summary: Autonomous robots on one-shot missions run over horizons far longer than the trajectories seen during training, under a fixed onboard compute budget. We present FRANK, a 507K-parameter recurrent architecture that combines tau-gated recurrent modules, content-addressable memory, and a feedforward reflex pathway. We evaluate it against recurrent, state-space, and reduced modular baselines at matched parameter count on four algorithmic sequence tasks, trained at length 5-20 and evaluated out to two million tokens. At 100,000x the maximum training length, 6 of 10 FRANK seeds retain exactly 100.0% accuracy, while none of the 50 baseline configurations does, five architectures at ten seeds each with none left incomplete (Fisher exact, two-sided p = 4.2E-6. Targeted lesions across the four tasks yield four distinct component-reliance profiles, consistent with task-dependent allocation across the recurrent, memory, and reflex pathways. Separately, a FRANK policy trained in simulation drives a physical ground vehicle to commanded waypoints through obstacles without teleoperation.

AI.tldr: 提出507K参数循环架构FRANK（tau门控循环+内容可寻址记忆+前馈反射通路），在四个算法序列任务上训练长度5-20、外推至200万token，10个种子中6个在10万倍训练长度下保持100.0%准确率，基线无一做到；损伤实验显示任务依赖的三通路分工，并在实车导航中验证。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人执行一次性任务时，运行时间跨度远超训练所见轨迹长度，且机载算力预算固定。现有循环、状态空间及模块化架构在长程外推下难以维持可靠性，作者希望以匹配参数量的小模型实现超长程稳定泛化并落地到实体平台。
AI.method: FRANK为507K参数的循环架构，由三部分构成：tau门控循环模块、内容可寻址记忆、前馈反射通路。评测设置为四个算法序列任务，训练长度5-20，评估外推至两百万token；对照基线包括循环、状态空间与缩减模块化架构，均在参数量匹配条件下比较。此外进行跨四任务的定向损伤（lesion）实验，并在仿真中训练策略后部署到实体地面车辆执行避障航点导航。
AI.result: 在10万倍最大训练长度处，FRANK的10个种子中有6个保持精确100.0%准确率，而50个基线配置（5种架构×10个种子，全部完成实验）无一达到该水平（Fisher精确检验，双侧p=4.2E-6）。定向损伤实验在四个任务上得到四种不同的组件依赖谱，说明循环、记忆与反射通路存在任务依赖的分配。仿真训练的FRANK策略可驱动实体地面车辆在无障碍远程操作下通过障碍到达指令航点。
AI.conclusion: FRANK表明，在固定小参数量预算下，融合门控循环、内容可寻址记忆与前馈反射的混合架构可将稳定序列能力外推到训练长度十万倍以上，其鲁棒性依赖任务相关的通路分工，并具备迁移到实体机器人导航的可行性。

title: Experience-Based Feasibility-Aware Generative Adversarial Imitation from Observation under Embodiment Mismatch
summary: With the increasing use of robot-free demonstration interfaces that provide state trajectories without action labels, imitation from observation has become a promising approach for learning robot behaviors from human demonstrations. However, due to differences in embodiment and dynamics between humans and robots, demonstrated human motions may not be feasible for the robot, potentially degrading policy performance. In this study, we propose Experience-Based Feasibility-Aware Generative Adversarial Imitation from Observation (EF-GAIfO), which estimates the feasibility of state-only demonstrations from the robot's own experience rather than relying on explicit dynamics models or large prior exploration datasets. A key feature of EF-GAIfO is that the notion of feasibility evolves with policy learning: as the policy improves and the robot experiences a broader range of state transitions, the feasible region is progressively expanded, allowing additional demonstrations to be incorporated into learning. This enables feasibility-aware imitation that adapts to the current stage of policy learning, rather than relying on a pre-designed feasibility criterion. We validate the effectiveness of EF-GAIfO on a locomotion task in simulation and on a real quadruped robot performing a object-reaching-and-grasping task.

AI.tldr: 提出EF-GAIfO，通过机器人自身经验估计无动作标注演示的状态可行性，并随策略学习动态扩展可行域，实现从观察模仿。
AI.motivation: 无动作标注的演示接口日益普及，但从观察模仿面临人机具身与动力学差异，人类动作对机器人可能不可行，导致策略性能下降；现有方法依赖显式动力学模型或大规模先验探索数据，成本高且难以泛化。
AI.method: EF-GAIfO基于机器人自身经验评估仅状态演示的可行性，无需显式动力学模型或大规模先验探索数据集；核心在于可行性概念随策略学习演化——策略改进并经历更广泛状态转移时，可行域逐步扩展，使更多演示被纳入学习，从而形成随学习阶段自适应调整的可行性感知模仿机制，而非预设固定可行性准则。
AI.result: 在仿真中的locomotion任务以及真实四足机器人执行物体接近与抓取任务上验证了EF-GAIfO的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EF-GAIfO通过经验驱动、动态演化的可行性估计，为跨具身从观察模仿提供了一种无需显式动力学建模或大规模先验数据的可行方案，并具备仿真与真实机器人任务的实证支持。

title: Recova: Agent-Guided Failure Recovery for Autonomous Robotic Manipulation
summary: Manipulation failures can leave scenes in states from which a task policy cannot recover. Learning corrective behaviors requires scalable failure exploration and physical grounding. We present Recova, an agent-guided framework that jointly develops task execution and recovery in a reconstructed digital twin, then verifies and refines both through real-world experience. In the twin, the agent diagnoses failures, tests corrective programs, and collects successful task and recovery rollouts for separate policies. During deployment, it monitors progress, invokes a learned or programmatic recovery, verifies scene restoration, and resumes execution. When no suitable recovery is available, a human demonstration resolves the failure and enters the learning loop, allowing the system to expand its recovery capabilities. Physical rollouts and human demonstrations are routed to the corresponding policy for DAgger training. Across six LIBERO-Pro settings and four MolmoSpaces categories, Recova achieves 78.8% and 64.9% mean success, compared with 71.7% and 38.0% for the strongest baselines. With parallel collection across four real-robot workstations, DAgger fine-tuning raises mean success from 23.8% to 77.5%, and recovery skills further raise it to 87.5%. Over four collection rounds on one task, observed human intervention falls from 87.5% to 0%. Together, these results show how agent-guided recovery turns failures into reusable capabilities, improving robustness while progressively reducing human intervention. Project page: https://www.liuisabella.com/Recova

AI.tldr: Recova 是一个智能体引导的任务执行与恢复联合学习框架：在数字孪生中诊断失败、测试纠正程序并采集成功 rollout，在真机上验证恢复效果并借助 DAgger 持续迭代，将失败转化为可复用能力。
AI.motivation: 机械臂操作失败会让场景进入任务策略无法恢复的状态，而学习纠正行为需要可扩展的失败探索与物理落地验证，二者在现实中都难以获得。
AI.method: 在重建的数字孪生中由智能体诊断失败原因、测试纠正程序，并分别采集任务执行与恢复策略的成功 rollout；部署时监控任务进度，调用学习型或程序化恢复，验证场景是否复原后再恢复执行；若无可用的恢复方案，则由人类示范解决失败并进入学习回路。真实 rollout 与人类示范按类型分别路由到对应策略进行 DAgger 训练，从而扩展恢复能力。
AI.result: 在六个 LIBERO-Pro 设置和四个 MolmoSpaces 类别上，Recova 平均成功率为 78.8% 与 64.9%，最强基线为 71.7% 与 38.0%；在四个真机工作站并行采集数据后，DAgger 微调将平均成功率从 23.8% 提升至 77.5%，加入恢复技能后进一步提升至 87.5%；单任务四轮采集中，观测到的人工干预率从 87.5% 降至 0%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体引导的恢复机制能够把失败转化为可复用能力，在提升鲁棒性的同时逐步减少人工干预。

title: AFD-CAMLs: Agile Force-Distribution-Aware Planning and Control for Cable-Suspended Aerial Multi-Lifting Systems
summary: Multiple UAVs can cooperatively transport heavy payloads while controlling their position and orientation. Trajectory-based methods offer high agility while satisfying system constraints, but can produce uneven force distributions when the tension-to-wrench allocation is redundant or ill-conditioned, particularly under geometric mismatch and low-level tracking errors. We propose a hybrid planning-and-control framework to address this problem. A global planner generates payload trajectories and cable-force references by exploring the allocation null space under a prescribed internal-force setting. These references augment the cost of a centralized local planner, promoting feasible force distributions while generating trajectories for all UAVs. An admittance filter then compares the planned forces with onboard cable-tension estimates and adjusts the kinematic references to improve force tracking in degenerate or near-degenerate configurations. Simulations and experiments involving four to ten UAVs demonstrate more balanced tension distributions during both hovering and demanding agile maneuvers, without compromising agility or payload-tracking performance.

AI.tldr: 提出混合规划-控制框架，通过全局规划器在分配零空间探索内部力设定，生成载荷轨迹与缆绳力参考，经局部规划器与导纳滤波调整运动参考，实现多无人机协同吊运中更均衡的张力分布。
AI.motivation: 多无人机协同吊运重载荷时需同时控制位置与姿态。基于轨迹的方法灵活且满足约束，但当张力-力旋量分配冗余或病态时（尤其在几何失配与底层跟踪误差下），会产生不均匀的力分布，影响系统安全与稳定。
AI.method: 采用混合规划与控制框架：1）全局规划器在规定的内部力设定下探索分配零空间，生成载荷轨迹与缆绳力参考；2）将这些参考作为集中式局部规划器代价的增广项，在生成所有无人机轨迹的同时促进可行力分布；3）导纳滤波器比较规划力与机载缆绳张力估计，调整运动学参考，以在退化或近退化构型下改善力跟踪。
AI.result: 针对4至10架无人机的仿真与实验表明，在悬停和高机动动作中均获得更均衡的张力分布，且未牺牲灵活性与载荷跟踪性能。
AI.conclusion: 该混合规划-控制框架有效缓解了冗余/病态分配下的力分布不均问题，兼顾灵活性与跟踪精度，适用于多无人机协同吊运场景。

title: EIDA: Execution-Interface Dynamics Adaptation for Real-to-Sim-to-Real Robot Navigation
summary: Simulation-to-robot transfer can fail when velocity commands produce motion and feedback that differ from those modeled during policy training. We present execution-interface dynamics adaptation (EIDA), which fits these responses from target-platform execution data without reconstructing actuator dynamics. A model of body-frame pose increments updates simulator geometry, while a separate model predicts the velocity feedback observed by the policy; a short history of velocity feedback is included in the policy input. The fitted models are used within a lightweight GPU-parallel simulator. On the full Jackal and Go2 validation sets, the fitted models reduced position and yaw prediction errors relative to the simulator's predefined motion model. Across 100 benchmark navigation environments evaluated in a separate physics-based simulator, EIDA achieved the highest success rate and navigation score among the compared learned policies, both with and without global guidance. Feedback ablations further supported the need to match policy-facing velocity estimates. On a physical Unitree Go2, EIDA reached the goal without collision in all 20 static-scene trials, compared with 4 of 20 for the baseline. These results show that execution-interface adaptation can improve navigation transfer without detailed actuator simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出执行接口动力学自适应(EIDA)，从目标平台执行数据拟合速度指令到运动与反馈的响应，无需重建执行器动力学，显著提升仿真到真实机器人的导航迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 仿真到机器人迁移失败的一个关键原因是：速度指令产生的实际运动与策略所观测的反馈，与策略训练时建模的情况不一致。传统做法依赖重建执行器动力学，过程复杂且难以精确。
AI.method: EIDA不重建执行器动力学，而是直接从目标平台执行数据拟合响应。包含两部分模型：一是机体坐标系位姿增量模型，用于更新仿真器几何；二是速度反馈预测模型，用于预测策略观测到的速度反馈。策略输入中加入短时速度反馈历史。拟合模型被嵌入轻量级GPU并行仿真器中使用。
AI.result: 在Jackal与Go2完整验证集上，相比仿真器预定义运动模型，拟合模型降低了位置与偏航预测误差。在100个基于独立物理仿真器的导航基准环境中，EIDA在有无全局引导两种设定下均取得最高成功率与导航得分。反馈消融实验支持匹配策略侧速度估计的必要性。在实体Unitree Go2上，EIDA在20次静态场景试验中全部无碰撞到达目标，基线仅4/20。
AI.conclusion: 执行接口自适应可在无需详细执行器仿真的前提下改善导航迁移效果，说明直接拟合策略面接口响应是提升仿真到真实迁移的有效途径。

title: ColoACT: Multi-Cue Action Chunking for Smooth Autonomous Colon Navigation on a Self-Propelled Endoscopic Robot
summary: Autonomous colonoscopic navigation can reduce operator burden and the risk of loop formation or tissue trauma, but remains challenging due to deformable anatomy, weak-texture and specular endoscopic visuals, and contact-rich viscoelastic interactions. Existing methods either rely on geometry-driven pipelines, which are efficient and interpretable yet brittle due to manually engineered features and switching logic, or adopt learning-based policies, whose inferred depth/geometry can become temporally inconsistent or overly smooth under weak texture and specular highlights while simulation-trained variants (e.g., deep reinforcement learning) may further suffer from a sim-to-real gap. We propose ColoACT, an autonomous navigation system that integrates an RGB-D-E based Action Chunking Transformer policy (ColoACT policy) for a compact self-propelled Bevel-Gear-Based Endoscopic Robot (BGER). The ColoACT policy augments RGB with estimated relative depth and a gradient-based pseudo-elevation map to enhance fold-ridge saliency and other high-frequency geometric cues, and enables smooth continuous control of the BGER by predicting overlapping action chunks and fusing them via temporal ensembling. In different \textit{ex-vivo} porcine colons (approximately 60 cm), our system achieves success rates of 85.4\% and 72.5\% in straight and curved segments, respectively, and achieves 70\% success in 90-degree turns and 60\% in double-bend sequences, with feasibility further demonstrated in challenging triple-bend segments. The project page is available at: https://Adamhu1.github.io/ColoACT/.

AI.tldr: 提出ColoACT自主结肠镜导航系统，融合RGB-D-E动作分块Transformer策略与自驱式斜齿轮内窥镜机器人，在离体猪结肠上实现多弯道场景的自主导航。
AI.motivation: 自主结肠镜导航可减轻操作者负担并降低成环与组织损伤风险，但面临变形解剖结构、弱纹理与高光内窥镜视觉、接触丰富的黏弹性交互等挑战。现有几何驱动流水线高效可解释但依赖手工特征与切换逻辑而脆弱；学习型策略在弱纹理和高光下深度估计时序不一致或过度平滑，且仿真训练（如深度强化学习）存在仿真到现实差距。
AI.method: 提出ColoACT系统：为紧凑型自驱式斜齿轮内窥镜机器人（BGER）设计RGB-D-E动作分块Transformer策略。在RGB基础上融合估计的相对深度与基于梯度的伪高程图，以增强褶皱脊线等高频几何线索的显著性；通过预测重叠动作块并采用时序集成（temporal ensembling）实现平滑连续控制。
AI.result: 在约60 cm的离体猪结肠上，直段成功率达85.4%，弯曲段72.5%；90度转弯成功率70%，双弯序列60%，并在三弯等挑战性场景中验证了可行性。
AI.conclusion: ColoACT通过多模态几何增强的表征与动作分块时序集成，兼顾了连续平滑控制与折皱几何显著性，在离体结肠多弯道场景中展现出较高的自主导航成功率，验证了该策略与自驱机器人协同方案的实际可行性。

title: PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics. Project website, code, and videos: https://amrmousa.com/promo/
summary: Quadrupedal locomotion requires balancing conflicting objectives such as command tracking, stability, and energy efficiency, yet conventional reinforcement learning (RL) hardcodes these priorities into a fixed scalar reward at training time. We present PROMO (Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning), a semantic multi-objective approach that makes this trade-off an explicit runtime input to a single locomotion policy. PROMO conditions the policy on deployment facing preferences while keeping embodiment-specific locomotion priors fixed, thereby separating operator intent from reward shaping terms required for viable gait generation. Compared with fixed-objective controllers, multi-objective baselines, and independently trained specialists, PROMO achieves objective specialization and robustness from a single deployable policy.
