Across 100 sampled preferences in simulation, 67 behaviors are non-dominated under exact Pareto dominance, with a mean preference-objective correlation of 0.843, demonstrating broad Pareto coverage and predictable preference response. The same policy transfers zero-shot to a Unitree Go2, where preference changes alone reduce specific energy by up to 30.4%, position error by 38.7%, and peak body-attitude deviation by 59.0% relative to the balanced preference. These results establish preference-conditioned multi-objective RL as a practical runtime interface for adaptive legged locomotion, extending its role beyond offline Pareto-set construction. Open-source code and videos are available at https://amrmousa.com/promo/.

AI.tldr: 提出PROMO，一种偏好条件化的语义多目标强化学习方法，将指令跟踪、稳定性与能效之间的权衡作为运行时输入交由单一四足运动策略处理，实现单一策略的Pareto覆盖与零样本真机迁移。
AI.motivation: 四足运动需平衡指令跟踪、稳定性与能效等相互冲突的目标，但传统强化学习在训练时将这些优先级固化为固定标量奖励，导致操作者意图与奖励塑形耦合，无法在部署阶段灵活调整权衡，也难以用单一策略覆盖多样化的行为需求。
AI.method: PROMO将部署面向的偏好作为策略的显式条件输入，同时保持与具体本体相关的运动先验固定，从而把操作者意图与保证可行步态所需的奖励塑形项解耦；在单一可部署策略上实现偏好条件化的语义多目标学习，并与固定目标控制器、多目标基线以及各自独立训练的特化策略进行对比。
AI.result: 仿真中采样100个偏好，其中67个行为在精确Pareto支配下非受支配，偏好—目标平均相关性达0.843，表明Pareto覆盖广泛且偏好响应可预测；同一策略零样本迁移至Unitree Go2真机，仅改变偏好即可使比能耗最多降低30.4%、位置误差降低38.7%、机体姿态峰值偏差降低59.0%（相对平衡偏好）。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了偏好条件化多目标强化学习可作为自适应腿式运动的实用运行时接口，将其作用从离线Pareto集构建拓展到在线部署阶段；代码与视频已开源。

title: Interaction-Stiffness-Guided Basis Allocation in Dynamic Movement Primitives for Efficient Skill Transfer
summary: Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs) provide a compact and stable formulation for trajectory representation and generalization in robot skill learning. However, their predefined basis layout limits the allocation of approximation capacity according to stage-dependent precision requirements. To address this issue, this article proposes Stage-Criticality-Guided Dynamic Movement Primitives (SC-DMPs) with adaptive basis allocation for precision-critical skill learning. Operator-robot interaction stiffness and a trajectory-consistency cue derived from cross-demonstration task-space variability are integrated to construct a stage-criticality index. Guided by this index, basis centers are redistributed in normalized time through inverse cumulative criticality and mapped to the canonical phase domain, while their bandwidths are refined to adjust local approximation support. This enables denser and more flexible representation at high-criticality stages while retaining sparser allocation elsewhere. Experiments on handwriting trajectories and three real-robot tasks show that the inferred criticality is concentrated in geometrically demanding and task-constrained regions. Comparisons with DMPs, ProMPs, ProDMP, GP-MP, and KMP demonstrate improved trajectory reproduction, endpoint generalization, and task-critical accuracy while retaining a compact model and the stable structure of classical DMPs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出阶段关键性引导的动态运动基元（SC-DMPs），通过自适应基函数分配，在高关键性阶段加密基函数、在其他阶段稀疏分配，从而提升精度关键型技能学习的轨迹表示与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统DMPs虽具备紧凑稳定的轨迹表示与泛化能力，但其基函数布局是预定义的，无法根据阶段相关的精度需求分配逼近能力，导致在高精度需求阶段表示不足。
AI.method: 构建阶段关键性指标：融合操作者-机器人交互刚度与由跨示教任务空间变异性导出的轨迹一致性线索。在该指标引导下，通过逆累积关键性在归一化时间上重新分布基函数中心，并映射到规范相位域，同时细化带宽以调整局部逼近支撑，实现高关键性阶段更密、更灵活的表示。
AI.result: 在手写轨迹和三个真实机器人任务上，推断出的关键性集中于几何要求高和任务约束强的区域；与DMPs、ProMPs、ProDMP、GP-MP和KMP相比，在轨迹复现、终点泛化和任务关键精度上均有提升，同时保持紧凑模型和经典DMP的稳定结构。
AI.conclusion: SC-DMPs通过阶段关键性驱动的自适应基函数分配，有效解决了DMP基函数布局预定义导致的逼近能力分配不均问题，在保持经典DMP紧凑性与稳定性的同时提升了精度关键型技能学习的表现。

title: Continual Learning for 6-DoF Grasp Synthesis via Experience and Demonstrations
summary: Most current grasp synthesis systems are trained offline and remain fixed during deployment. While this works well when deployment conditions resemble the training data, performance can degrade when robots encounter conditions they have not seen before, such as unfamiliar objects. In this work, we present a continual-learning framework for single-view 6-DoF grasp synthesis for a parallel-jaw gripper in cluttered scenes. Rather than finetuning a large parametric model, our method adapts through memory in a learned embedding space: grasp outcomes update future grasp scores, while optional user demonstrations are recalled and transferred to new scenes as additional candidate grasps. We evaluate our method in simulation and in extensive real-world experiments comprising over 1500 grasp trials. We show that our method matches the performance of existing 6-DoF grasping baselines even before adaptation, improves online on unseen objects from categories absent or underrepresented during training, and supports long-horizon continual learning with limited forgetting. In real-world experiments, our method reaches over 90\% success rates on several challenging object categories after only 50 online grasp attempts. Videos and code at https://giuschio.github.io/cl_grasping/.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于杂乱场景下单视角6-DoF平行夹爪抓取合成的持续学习框架，通过在学习到的嵌入空间中以记忆方式自适应，而非微调大型参数模型，实现在线提升未见物体抓取性能。
AI.motivation: 现有抓取合成系统多为离线训练、部署后参数固定。当部署条件与训练数据分布相似时表现良好，但遇到未见物体等新情况时性能下降，缺乏在线自适应能力。
AI.method: 在学习到的嵌入空间中引入记忆机制：抓取结果用于更新未来抓取评分；可选的用户示教被召回并迁移到新场景，作为额外候选抓取。整个框架用于单视角6-DoF平行夹爪在杂乱场景中的抓取合成，无需微调大型参数模型。
AI.result: 在仿真与超过1500次真实抓取试验中评估：自适应前即达到现有6-DoF抓取基线水平；对训练中缺失或欠代表类别的未见物体可在线提升；支持长时程持续学习且遗忘有限；真实实验中仅50次在线抓取尝试后，在多个挑战性类别上成功率超90%。
AI.conclusion: 基于嵌入空间记忆的持续学习框架可在不微调大模型的前提下实现抓取策略的在线自适应，兼顾基线性能、未见物体泛化与抗遗忘的长时程持续学习能力。

title: Ex vivo breach detection using electrical conductivity during robotic pedicle drilling in the spine
summary:
Purpose: Pedicle screw placement is technically demanding in scoliosis treatment. High precision is required due to limited visibility, anatomical variability, and the risk of complications. Although robotic systems assist CT-based planning and execution, they still rely on ionizing intraoperative imaging and complex registration. This study proposes robotic pedicle drilling with real-time preventive breach detection using electrical bioimpedance sensing.
  Methods: We developed a robotic approach combined with a pedicle-drilling tool equipped with a proprioceptive electrical bioimpedance sensor developed by SpineGuard. A real-time detection algorithm was designed to analyze the electrical bioimpedance signal during drilling and identify abrupt changes in conductivity associated with potential breaches towards the spinal canal. The method operates without external devices or sensors.
  Results: The ex vivo experiments showed that the proposed method prevented breaches in 100 of the 51 drilling cases. These findings demonstrate the system's ability to detect potentially hazardous events during drilling and to stop the procedure before. The ex vivo experiments demonstrated that the proposed method prevented breaches in all 51 drilling cases.
  Conclusions: This work demonstrates the feasibility of robotic pedicle drilling with electrical bioimpedance sensing for real-time breach prevention. Using only the tool signal, the method eliminates the need for external sensing systems and supports safer pedicle screw placement.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合SpineGuard本体感受式电阻抗传感的机器人椎弓根钻探方法，通过实时分析钻探过程中的生物阻抗信号检测导通性突变，实现穿破的实时预防；离体实验中51例钻探全部避免了穿破。
AI.motivation: 脊柱侧弯治疗中椎弓根螺钉置入技术难度高：视野受限、解剖变异大且并发症风险高，对精度要求极高。现有机器人系统虽可辅助基于CT的规划与执行，但仍依赖术中电离辐射成像和复杂的配准流程。因此需要一种无需额外外部设备、可在钻探过程中实时预防穿破的方案。
AI.method: 作者将机器人系统与配备SpineGuard本体感受式生物阻抗传感器的椎弓根钻探工具相结合，设计了实时检测算法，在钻探过程中分析电阻抗信号，识别与朝向椎管潜在穿破相关的电导率突变。该方法仅依赖工具自身信号，不依赖外部装置或传感器。
AI.result: 离体实验表明，该方法在全部51例钻探中均成功预防了穿破（摘要中称"100 of the 51"存在数据表述不一致，后文明确为全部51例）。结果证明系统能够在钻探过程中检测潜在危险事件，并在穿破发生前终止操作。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了机器人椎弓根钻探结合电阻抗传感实现实时穿破预防的可行性。仅利用工具信号，无需外部感知系统，有助于实现更安全的椎弓根螺钉置入。

title: Cross-entropy optimization with prioritized constraints
summary: When constraints conflict, an optimizer must determine which requirements to preserve and which to relax. On the one hand, a priority ordering specifies which requirements take precedence. On the other hand, penalty-based formulations encode their relative importance through numerical weights. Depending on these weights, a solution can improve its weighted score while violating intended priorities. We introduce TierCEM, a variant of the cross-entropy method that incorporates strict constraint priorities directly into elite selection without requiring per-constraint importance weights. TierCEM works by sequentially filtering sampled candidates, from highest- to lowest-priority constraint. If and when a constraint eliminates all remaining candidates, TierCEM returns to the last nonempty set and selects elites with the smallest violations of that blocking constraint, recursively preserving satisfaction of all higher-priority constraints. We evaluate TierCEM on 2D navigation and contact-rich pushing tasks in proprioceptive and learned world-model settings. Experiments show that reversing the constraint ordering changes which constraints are violated under conflict. Prioritizing progress toward the task objective also enables TierCEM to relax lower-priority constraints when they would otherwise prevent further progress.

AI.tldr: TierCEM 是一种改进的交叉熵方法，将严格的约束优先级直接嵌入精英选择过程，无需为每个约束设定重要度权重，在冲突场景下按优先级递归地放松低优先级约束。
AI.motivation: 在约束冲突时，确定性优化器必须在保留和放松哪些需求之间抉择。优先级排序可表明需求的主次，而基于惩罚的方法却用数值权重来编码相对重要性；这些权重可能导致解在提高加权得分的同时违反预期的优先级。因此需要一个不依赖逐约束权重、能直接体现严格优先级的选择机制。
AI.method: TierCEM 是交叉熵方法的变体：从最高优先级到最低优先级对采样候选进行顺序过滤。当某一约束淘汰掉所有剩余候选时，回到上一非空集合，选择对该阻断约束违反最小的精英，并递归地保持所有更高优先级约束的满足。
AI.result: 在二维导航和接触丰富的推动任务上，于本体感知和学习世界模型两种设置中进行了评估。实验表明：颠倒约束顺序会改变冲突下被违反的约束；将任务目标的进展置于优先位置，使 TierCEM 能够放松本会阻碍进一步进展的低优先级约束。
AI.conclusion: TierCEM 通过在精英选择中直接执行严格约束优先级，避免了逐约束权重带来的优先级违背问题，并在冲突场景中展现出可解释且可控制的约束放松行为。

title: Is Success All You Need? Investigating the Impact of Input Perturbations on VLA Behaviour in Tabletop Manipulation Tasks
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved high task success rates on robot manipulation task benchmarks. More recently, there has been an emphasis on evaluating the robustness of VLA models to perturbations. However, this robustness is still predominantly measured through Task Success Rate (TSR). In this work, we propose a benchmark-agnostic evaluation framework to measure the behavioural robustness of models by characterising how successful trajectories are executed under perturbation. We implement this methodology by extending the widely-used LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks. Across three state-of-the-art VLA models, four LIBERO task suites and seven perturbation conditions, we evaluate changes in both typical successful behaviour and its variability, including metrics of motion smoothness, efficiency and gripper behaviour. We find that perturbations can alter the behaviour of successful trajectories, a phenomenon which cannot necessarily be inferred from TSR alone. Across LIBERO suites, we identify cases where state-of-the-art VLA models achieve comparable TSR under the same perturbation condition, yet behaviour on successful trajectories diverges substantially. Therefore, to have a more robust assessment of task performance, we argue that suitable measures of robustness should capture not only whether a task is completed, but also how the robot behaves while completing it. When evaluating the robustness of VLA models, TSR may be complemented by behavioural evaluation metrics that characterise the nature and variability of successful task execution by robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种与基准无关的行为鲁棒性评估框架，通过刻画成功轨迹在扰动下的执行方式（平滑性、效率、夹爪行为及其变异性），扩展LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus，发现仅靠任务成功率（TSR）无法反映行为层面的鲁棒性差异。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型鲁棒性评估主要依赖任务成功率（TSR），而TSR只反映任务是否完成，无法揭示成功轨迹在扰动下行为是否发生改变；因此需要补充能够刻画成功任务执行性质与变异性的评估手段。
AI.method: 提出与基准无关的行为鲁棒性评估框架，通过扩展广泛使用的LIBERO与LIBERO-Plus基准实现；在3个SOTA VLA模型、4个LIBERO任务套件、7种扰动条件下，评估典型成功行为及其变异性的变化，指标涵盖运动平滑性、效率与夹爪行为。
AI.result: 扰动会改变成功轨迹的行为，而这一现象无法仅从TSR推断；在相同扰动条件下，不同SOTA VLA模型可获得相当（comparable）的TSR，但其成功轨迹上的行为显著分化（diverges substantially）。
AI.conclusion: 更稳健的任务性能评估应同时捕捉任务是否完成与机器人在完成任务过程中的行为方式；评估VLA模型鲁棒性时，TSR可由刻画成功任务执行性质与变异性的行为评估指标加以补充。

title: Continue, Abort, or Fall: Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS) for Safe Humanoid Acrobatics
summary: Dynamic humanoid motions such as flips risk hardware damage due to suboptimal policies, disturbances or sim-to-real gaps. A motion tracking policy offers no way out once the maneuver leaves its reference, and a backup policy needs to take over to protect the hardware for a minimum-damage landing. Which backup to use matters as much as when to switch. We present Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS), which treats safety as a policy-conditioned, receding-horizon decision. Besides a protective fall policy, we also train an abort policy which can abort the motion at any time, landing on its feet. At every control step, learned predictors estimate whether the nominal tracking policy and the abort policy remain viable over a short horizon, and a least-sacrificial hierarchy keeps the most task-ambitious behavior that remains viable. In simulation with randomized disturbances, VAPS sharply reduces head contact and hand contact, which are the dominant sources of hardware damage, with both a Unitree G1 and a LimX Oli; on the LimX Oli, we validate the viability predictors and the full VAPS controller for side-flip motions. VAPS Pareto-dominates the strongest single-network alternatives we could train, including an end-to-end safe-tracking policy and students distilled from VAPS's own oracle-routed decisions, in both task success and head impact. We also show that VAPS is a powerful framework to supervise undertrained policies and protect the hardware.

AI.tldr: VAPS将人形机器人动态动作中的安全接管建模为策略条件下的滚动时域决策，通过可调度预测器判断标称跟踪策略与中止策略的短时可行性，并按"最小牺牲"层级选择仍可行的最具任务进取性的行为，从而在翻腾等高风险动作失败时保护硬件。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人执行空翻等动态动作时，次优策略、扰动或仿真到现实差距都会带来硬件损坏风险。运动跟踪策略一旦偏离参考便无退路，必须有备份策略接管以实现最小损伤落地；而"用哪个备份"与"何时切换"同样关键，现有单网络方案难以兼顾任务成功与硬件保护。
AI.method: 提出Viability-Aware Policy Selection（VAPS），把安全性视为策略条件下的滚动时域决策。除保护性跌倒策略外，额外训练可随时中止动作并双脚着地的abort策略；每个控制步由学习到的预测器估计标称跟踪策略与abort策略在短时域内是否仍可行，再以最小牺牲层级（least-sacrificial hierarchy）保留仍然可行的最具任务进取性的行为。在Unitree G1与LimX Oli上以随机扰动进行仿真评估，并在LimX Oli上验证可行性预测器与完整VAPS控制器用于侧翻动作。
AI.result: 在随机扰动仿真中，VAPS显著降低头部接触与手部接触这两个硬件损伤的主要来源；在LimX Oli上完成侧翻动作的可行性预测器与完整控制器验证；在任务成功率与头部冲击两项指标上均Pareto优于可训练的最强单网络替代方案，包括端到端安全跟踪策略以及从VAPS自身oracle路由决策中蒸馏的学生策略；同时VAPS可作为监督欠训练策略并保护硬件的有效框架。
AI.conclusion: VAPS通过将安全接管拆解为"何时切换"与"用哪个备份"的策略条件滚动时域选择问题，配合可行性预测器与最小牺牲层级，在保任务进取性的同时显著降低动态人形动作的硬件损伤风险，并在Pareto意义上优于端到端与蒸馏类单网络方案，还可用于监督欠训练策略。

title: ALFRED: Requirement-driven development of an open-source mobile manipulator for long-term plant monitoring
summary: Tracking seasonal change in crops and forests requires observing the same plants repeatedly. Ground robots can do this at close range, and a manipulator gives their sensors more viewpoints. Yet the robots behind long-term field datasets are rarely released with their design files, and how a robot's own structure limits arm reach and occludes its sensors is seldom compared between builds. We present ALFRED, an open-source mobile manipulator built from commercially available components. It carries a six-degree-of-freedom arm, LiDAR, RGB-D cameras, RTK GNSS and an IMU on an Ackermann-steered base, all mounted on a reconfigurable aluminium strut frame, and runs containerised ROS software. It was developed through four builds against six requirements for repeated outdoor deployment: durability, modularity, repairability, sensing reach, endurance and reproducibility. Model-based analysis of the last three builds shows the usable share of the arm's reachable poses rising from 34.0% to 60.0% and then 66.1%, and ray casting shows that only the final build keeps the frame-mounted LiDAR's horizontal view clear both forwards and backwards. ALFRED completed a year of monthly forest surveys (528 traversals) without missing a scheduled collection. This was despite battery degradation, reconfiguration for another researcher's study, and the parallel development of ALFRED 2.0 for autonomous crop-row operation, with each switch between builds taking about six hours. The deployment also showed that mechanical modularity is only as dependable as the robot description that tracks it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ALFRED——一个基于商用组件、开源可复现的移动操作机器人，经四次迭代满足重复户外部署的六项需求，通过模型分析量化了机械结构对机械臂可达性与 LiDAR 视野的制约，并完成了一年共 528 次森林月度调查。
AI.motivation: 跟踪作物与森林的季节性变化需对同一植株重复观测；地面机器人可近距离作业，机械臂能提供更多视角。但长期野外数据集背后的机器人极少公开设计文件，且机器人自身结构如何限制机械臂可达范围、遮挡传感器，鲜有在不同构型之间进行对比。
AI.method: 构建 ALFRED：商用组件搭建的移动操作平台，Ackermann 转向底盘上集成六自由度机械臂、LiDAR、RGB-D 相机、RTK GNSS 与 IMU，安装于可重构铝型材框架，运行容器化 ROS 软件。以重复户外部署的六项需求（耐用性、模块化、可维修性、感知可达性、续航、可复现性）驱动四次构型迭代，并用基于模型的分析对比后三次构型。
AI.result: 模型分析显示，机械臂可达位姿的可用比例从 34.0% 提升至 60.0%，再到 66.1%；射线投射表明仅最终构型使框架安装的 LiDAR 前后水平视野均保持无遮挡。ALFRED 完成了一年共 528 次穿越的森林月度调查，未遗漏任何一次计划采集，期间经历了电池退化、为其他研究者研究而进行的重构，以及并行开发面向自主作物行作业的 ALFRED 2.0，每次构型切换约需六小时。
AI.conclusion: ALFRED 验证了基于商用组件的开源移动操作机器人可支撑长期野外重复观测；机械结构显著制约机械臂可达性与传感器视野，需通过迭代构型与模型分析予以优化；部署经验还表明，机械模块化的可靠性取决于与其同步维护的机器人描述文件。

title: OpenSpace Lab Solution to the IROS 2026 Indoor Exploration Competition
summary: This report presents the \textbf{OpenSpace Lab}'s solution to the Competition on Intelligent Information Gathering for Single and Multi-Robot Systems Workshops, organized as part of the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. Our team reached 1st place in the Single-Robot Public Track and 3rd place in both the Single- and Multi-Robot Private Tracks. The single-robot framework utilizes pre-trained map completion predictions for global planning to prioritize unexplored areas. To reconcile map coverage with limited operation time, we introduce a remaining-time-based exploration strategy that integrates homing constraints into the decision-making process. For multi-robot exploration, we utilize a utility-driven target selection strategy that balances observation gains, movement costs, and budget constraints, leveraging shared map and intent data to eliminate redundant search and maximize coordination efficiency. Our solution reached a 61.04\% coverage rate in the Single-Robot Public Track, while reaching 39.53\% and 39.91\% coverage in the Single- and Multi-Robot Private Tracks, respectively. An extended full-length paper based on this report is currently being prepared for submission, and the source code will be released upon acceptance of the full manuscript at https://github.com/OpenSpace-Lab/Indoor-Exploration-IROS2026.

AI.tldr: OpenSpace Lab 提出面向单/多机器人室内探索的智能信息采集方案，获 IROS 2026 竞赛单机器人公开赛道第一名、单/多机器人私有赛道第三名，公开赛道覆盖率达 61.04%。
AI.motivation: 在有限作业时间内实现高效地图覆盖，并解决单机器人的回程约束与多机器人的冗余搜索问题。
AI.method: 单机器人：利用预训练地图补全预测辅助全局规划，优先探索未探索区域，并引入基于剩余时间的探索策略融合回程约束；多机器人：采用效用驱动的目标选择策略，权衡观测增益、移动代价与预算约束，并共享地图与意图数据以消除冗余搜索。
AI.result: 单机器人公开赛道覆盖率 61.04%，单机器人与多机器人私有赛道覆盖率分别为 39.53% 与 39.91%；竞赛排名为单机器人公开赛道第 1 名，单、多机器人私有赛道均第 3 名。
AI.conclusion: 该方案有效兼顾覆盖效率与协调性，全文论文正在准备投稿，代码将在录用后开源。

title: Completion Aware Guidance for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) predict visual futures and robot actions, yet they remain susceptible to task-incomplete imagination, where plausible, action-consistent predictions omit the transition needed for task completion. In this paper, we show that this failure is not inherent to the world model backbone, but emerges when adapted for short-chunk control, which can repeatedly favor plausible local continuations over task-completing transitions. To address this, we introduce Completion Aware Guidance (CAG), a training-free sampling method that guides generation toward task completion. Across representative WAMs, CAG improves success from 64% to 70% on a RoboTwin 2.0 subset and from 69% to 75% in zero-shot simulation, while reducing task-incomplete imagination from 79% to 40%.

AI.tldr: 本文指出World Action Models任务失败源于短片段控制适配，提出免训练采样方法CAG引导生成偏向任务完成，提升成功率并降低不完整想象。
AI.motivation: World Action Models能预测视觉未来与机器人动作，但存在“任务不完整想象”问题：即预测虽合理且与动作一致，却缺失完成任务所需的关键过渡。作者认为该失败并非世界模型主干固有缺陷，而是适配短片段（short-chunk）控制时反复偏好局部合理延续、忽视任务完成过渡所致。
AI.method: 提出Completion Aware Guidance（CAG），一种免训练的采样方法，在生成过程中引导模型趋向任务完成。
AI.result: 在代表性WAM上，CAG将RoboTwin 2.0子集成功率从64%提升至70%，零样本仿真中从69%提升至75%，并将任务不完整想象从79%降至40%。
AI.conclusion: 短片段控制适配是任务不完整想象的主要来源，而通过CAG这种免训练引导采样可有效缓解该问题，提升任务完成率。

title: LiDARFlow: Real-Time Panel-Based MAV Guidance in Unknown Environments
summary: This paper presents a guidance algorithm for micro aerial vehicles operating in unknown, cluttered environments using only onboard sensing. The method is based on a panel formulation originally derived from aerodynamic potential-flow theory and generates smooth, collision-free guidance vectors from locally perceived obstacles. The approach is extended to unknown environments by constructing and updating the obstacle representation online from onboard LiDAR measurements. The resulting obstacle-avoidance field is integrated with a nominal guiding vector field to produce the final control input. The system is experimentally validated in indoor flight tests under two scenarios: waypoint navigation and directional guidance. In both cases, the vehicle successfully completes its task while avoiding all obstacles in real time using only onboard perception. The results demonstrate that the method is computationally lightweight and suitable for onboard implementation, with pointcloud processing identified as the main practical limitation. These results support the feasibility of lightweight onboard guidance in unknown environments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于气动势流面板法的轻量级机载制导算法，利用机载LiDAR在线构建障碍物表示，并结合标称引导向量场生成无碰撞控制输入，在室内飞行实验中验证了实时避障的有效性。
AI.motivation: 微型飞行器在未知、杂乱环境中飞行时，仅依靠机载感知实现实时避障具有挑战性，需要计算轻量、适合机载部署的制导方法。
AI.method: 以源自空气动力学势流理论的面板法为基础，从局部感知的障碍物生成平滑、无碰撞的制导向量；通过机载LiDAR测量在线构建并更新障碍物表示，将其扩展至未知环境；将所得避障场与标称引导向量场融合，生成最终控制输入。
AI.result: 在室内飞行实验中针对航点导航和方向引导两种场景进行验证，飞行器均仅依靠机载感知成功完成任务并实时避开所有障碍物；方法计算开销小，适合机载实现，点云处理被识别为主要实际限制。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在未知环境中实现轻量级机载制导的可行性。

title: ReCo: Response-Consistent Locomotion with Policy-Aware MPC for Legged Manipulation
summary: Continuous legged manipulation requires accurate end-effector tracking while the base keeps walking. Combining reinforcement learning (RL) with model predictive control (MPC) suits this task: the learned policy provides robust locomotion, while MPC coordinates the base and arm to compensate for tracking errors. However, MPC can compensate only for base motion that it can predict, and a learned policy's command response varies with gait phase, contact, and payload. We present ReCo, a framework that couples response-consistent locomotion with policy-aware MPC for legged manipulation. Response shaping trains the policy to respond to commands consistently and repeatably across randomized dynamics. An identified closed-loop response model then lets MPC jointly plan locomotion commands and arm motion. On the simulation benchmark, ReCo reduces position and orientation root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 28.7% and 27.4% relative to the best baseline for each metric. Real-world experiments demonstrate onboard continuous legged manipulation with coordinated base and arm motion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReCo 框架，将响应一致的运动控制策略与策略感知 MPC 结合，用于足式机器人连续操作任务，在仿真与真实实验中实现更优的末端跟踪精度。
AI.motivation: 足式连续操作要求机器人在行走过程中保持末端执行器精确跟踪。RL 与 MPC 结合是合适方案：学习策略提供鲁棒运动，MPC 协调基座与机械臂补偿跟踪误差。但 MPC 仅能补偿其可预测的基座运动，而学习策略的指令响应会随步态相位、接触和负载变化，导致协调效果受限。
AI.method: 提出 ReCo 框架：一方面通过响应塑造（response shaping）训练策略，使其在随机化动力学条件下对指令保持一致且可重复的响应；另一方面辨识闭环响应模型，使 MPC 能够联合规划运动指令与机械臂动作，实现策略感知的 MPC。
AI.result: 在仿真基准上，ReCo 相比各指标最佳基线分别降低位置 RMSE 28.7% 和姿态 RMSE 27.4%。真实世界实验展示了机载连续足式操作，基座与机械臂协调运动。
AI.conclusion: 通过将策略响应一致性与策略感知 MPC 耦合，ReCo 有效提升了足式连续操作中末端执行器的跟踪精度，并在真实机器人上验证了可行性。

title: SonarVoxNet: Diver Detection in 3D Bounding Box using 3D Sonar
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) assisting human divers must continuously track not only the diver's 3D position but also their full-body orientation. However, vision-based perception is unreliable underwater, and forward-looking sonar -- despite being widely used -- discards the elevation information needed for orientation estimation, posing a fundamental limitation. Recently commercialized 3D sonar preserves elevation but produces sparse, noisy returns, and existing detectors are built for dense LiDAR data and for targets that remain upright and rotate only about the yaw axis (e.g., vehicles, pedestrians), making them unable to represent a freely pitching and rolling diver. To address this gap, we present two contributions. First, SonarVoxNet adapts a voxel-based encoder and an anchor-free center-based detection head to 3D sonar data, replacing the conventional yaw-only rotation representation with a continuous 6D rotation parameterization to predict full 9-DoF oriented bounding boxes -- to our knowledge, the first 3D sonar diver detector to do so. Second, Diver3D is the first public 3D sonar dataset with full 3D orientation labels for divers in diverse, non-upright poses, collected at a natural cave-diving site. Through controlled ablations over the backbone and detection head, we show that the dominant factor behind accurate 3D sonar-based diver detection is the transition from yaw-only rotation to full-SO(3) rotation. This transition substantially improves detection accuracy and reduces orientation error. These results demonstrate that full-body diver orientation is recoverable from 3D sonar alone, laying the groundwork for future work on diver pose estimation and diver-robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出SonarVoxNet检测器与Diver3D数据集，实现3D声呐下潜水员全9自由度定向包围盒检测。
AI.motivation: AUV辅助潜水员需持续跟踪其3D位置与全身姿态，但视觉感知在水下不可靠；前视声呐丢失高度信息，商用3D声呐虽保留高度却点云稀疏含噪，而现有检测器面向稠密LiDAR且仅假设目标直立、仅绕偏航轴旋转，无法表达自由俯仰与翻滚的潜水员。
AI.method: 一，SonarVoxNet：将体素编码器与无锚框的中心式检测头适配到3D声呐数据，用连续6D旋转参数化替代传统仅偏航表示，预测完整9自由度定向包围盒。二，Diver3D：首个公开的3D声呐潜水员数据集，含多样非直立姿态的完整3D朝向标注，采集于天然洞穴潜水场景。并通过控制变量消融比较骨干网络与检测头。
AI.result: 消融实验表明，准确检测的主导因素是旋转表示从仅偏航转为完整SO(3)；该转变显著提升检测精度并降低朝向误差。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭3D声呐即可恢复潜水员全身朝向，为后续潜水员姿态估计与潜水员-机器人交互奠定基础。

title: Learning a Resolution-Consistent Jacobian Field for Bio-Inspired Rigid-Soft Finger
comment: 27 pages, 8 figures, including supplementary material. Under review at Robotics and Autonomous Systems
summary: Bio-inspired tendon-driven rigid-soft coupled dexterous fingers exhibit strong nonlinearity and configuration-dependent sensitivity, making accurate modeling challenging. In discrete-time control, Jacobian-based kinematic algorithms typically rely on point-wise local linear approximations, which makes their performance sensitive to sensor sampling frequency and controller update frequency. To address this issue, we propose Jacobian Flow Matching (JFM), a structured learning framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM), to learn a resolution-consistent Jacobian field that models actuation-to-motion transitions as a dynamical flow. The proposed framework supports both single-step prediction and continuous rollout via ODE integration, enabling consistent inference across temporal resolutions. Experiments on a tendon-driven rigid-soft finger show that the proposed method suppresses outlier errors and improves single-step prediction accuracy, reducing the global average RMSE by over 53% compared with a baseline discrete Jacobian learning approach. For long-horizon prediction, trajectories recovered via ODE integration achieve higher fidelity under sparse sampling (Stride = 8), reducing the RMSE median by 14.43% and the error variance by 24.87%. These results demonstrate that the learned flow-based Jacobian field provides an effective local model for offline multi-step trajectory optimization in rigid-soft coupled nonlinear systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Jacobian Flow Matching（JFM）框架，基于条件流匹配学习分辨率一致的雅可比场，将驱动-运动映射建模为动态流，在腱驱动刚柔耦合手指上显著降低单步与长时域预测误差。
AI.motivation: 腱驱动刚柔耦合灵巧手指具有强非线性和构型依赖敏感性，精确建模困难；离散时间控制中基于雅可比的运动学算法依赖逐点局部线性近似，性能对传感器采样频率和控制器更新频率敏感，缺乏跨时间分辨率的一致性。
AI.method: 提出Jacobian Flow Matching（JFM），一种基于条件流匹配（CFM）的结构化学习框架，学习分辨率一致的雅可比场，将驱动到运动的转换建模为动态流；框架支持单步预测与通过ODE积分的连续rollout，实现跨时间分辨率的一致推理。
AI.result: 在腱驱动刚柔手指实验中，方法抑制离群误差并提升单步预测精度，相比基线离散雅可比学习方法全局平均RMSE降低超过53%；长时域预测中，稀疏采样（Stride=8）下经ODE积分恢复的轨迹保真度更高，RMSE中位数降低14.43%，误差方差降低24.87%。
AI.conclusion: 学习得到的基于流的雅可比场为刚柔耦合非线性系统的离线多步轨迹优化提供了有效的局部模型。

title: Beyond Leaderboard Scores: A Deployment-Focused Protocol for Interpretable Tracking Evaluation in Pedestrian-Centric Environments
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures; supplementary video provided as ancillary material. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Mobile robots operating among pedestrians need trajectories that become available quickly, remain spatially credible through missed observations, preserve identity, and fit within an embedded computing budget. Aggregate tracking scores provide limited insight into when and how trajectories fail, while varying detector inputs can confound tracker and detector quality. We present a deployment-focused, tracker-only evaluation protocol that uses shared detections to isolate tracker behavior and directly evaluates initialization, detector-gap continuation, identity recovery, close-neighbor association, and load-dependent tracker-step runtime, while Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA) is retained as a complementary aggregate measure. We apply the protocol to the JackRabbot Dataset and Benchmark (JRDB) using six open-source trackers and our lightweight Pedestrian Reference Tracker (PedRefTrack), together with a GT-assisted variant that estimates the remaining tracker-side gap under idealized association and motion. Under fixed detections, the non-GT trackers span only 24.26%-29.67% HOTA yet exhibit markedly different capability profiles. After 1.0 s without detector support, no tracker without GT assistance maintains spatially correct, same-identity output in more than half of eligible cases, making missing-observation continuation the dominant limitation among the tested properties. Close-neighbor failures are smaller and increase mainly at the shortest separations. Tracker-step runtime on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin is heavy-tailed and load-sensitive, causing several trackers to fall below the 10 Hz real-time target in crowded frames. The protocol provides a reproducible way to characterize tracker behavior and deployment suitability in pedestrian-centric environments. Code and evaluation scripts are released at https://github.com/SCAI-Lab/tracker_eval.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向部署的纯跟踪器评估协议，在共享检测输入下隔离跟踪器行为，直接评估初始化、检测间隙续接、身份恢复、近邻关联和运行时等性能，并以JRDB数据集评测六个开源跟踪器及自研PedRefTrack。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人在行人环境中需要快速可得、在漏检下仍保持空间可信、维持身份并满足嵌入式算力预算的轨迹；聚合跟踪分数难以揭示轨迹何时及如何失败，且检测器输入差异会混淆跟踪器与检测器质量。
AI.method: 提出以部署为导向的纯跟踪器评估协议：使用共享检测隔离跟踪器行为，直接评估初始化、检测间隙续接、身份恢复、近邻关联及负载相关跟踪步运行时，并保留HOTA作为补充聚合指标。在JRDB上评测六个开源跟踪器、自研轻量PedRefTrack及GT辅助变体，用以估计理想关联与运动下剩余跟踪器侧间隙。
AI.result: 固定检测下，非GT跟踪器HOTA仅在24.26%–29.67%之间，但能力画像差异明显。检测器缺失1.0 s后，无GT辅助的跟踪器在超过半数可用案例中无法保持空间正确且身份一致的输出，漏检续接成为主导限制；近邻失败较小，主要在最短间距下增加。NVIDIA Jetson Orin上跟踪步运行时呈重尾且对负载敏感，若干跟踪器在拥挤帧低于10 Hz实时目标。
AI.conclusion: 该协议可复现地表征跟踪器行为与部署适用性，适用于以行人为中心的环境；代码与评估脚本已开源。

title: ActiveWAM: Evidence-Aware Active Vision for World-Action Models
summary: Active vision manipulation requires a policy to control both its camera and its end-effectors, yet camera motion determines which evidence remains visible within finite observation windows. Acquiring a new view can displace task-critical cues, while retaining a view forgoes potentially useful observations. We formulate this as an evidence-aware retain--acquire problem and present ActiveWAM, a unified world--action model that learns observation and manipulation jointly. To this end, we propose training-time inversion which constrains a frozen video prior by task-bearing source evidence and visible temporal changes, eliminating the need for test-time inversion or candidate ranking. At deployment, the policy generates bimanual and pan/tilt actions-including stay and reacquisition behaviors-from view-aware history, and updates context from newly measured RGB observations. Future-video prediction serves as a co-training signal, while action generation requires neither future-video decoding nor optimal viewpoint annotations. We introduce RoboTwin-AV, a 50-task benchmark with executable pan/tilt control and automatically generated demonstrations. ActiveWAM improves TAVIS out-of-distribution success by up to 17.0 percentage points over the strongest baselines, achieves 20.0 additional points over Fast-WAM on RoboTwin-AV, and outperforms it by 26.7 points on real-world physical kitchen tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ActiveWAM，一个统一的世界-动作模型，联合学习观测与操作以解决主动视觉操作中的"保留-获取"证据权衡问题；并构建了 RoboTwin-AV 基准，在多项任务上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 主动视觉操作需同时控制相机与末端执行器，而相机运动决定了有限观测窗口内哪些证据保持可见：获取新视角可能移出任务关键线索，保持原视角则放弃潜在有用观测。现有方法依赖测试时反演或候选排序，效率与鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为证据感知的 retain-acquire 问题。提出训练时反演（training-time inversion），用承载任务的源证据与可见时序变化约束冻结的视频先验，无需测试时反演或候选排序。部署时策略从视角感知历史生成双臂与云台/俯仰动作（含 stay 与 reacquisition 行为），并用新测得的 RGB 观测更新上下文。未来视频预测作为协同训练信号，动作生成不需要未来视频解码或最优视角标注。同时构建 RoboTwin-AV 基准（50 个任务，可执行云台控制、自动生成示范）。
AI.result: 在 TAVIS 分布外任务上成功率较最强基线提升最多 17.0 个百分点；在 RoboTwin-AV 上较 Fast-WAM 提升 20.0 个百分点；在真实物理厨房任务上较其提升 26.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ActiveWAM 通过统一世界-动作建模与训练时反演，在无需测试时优化的条件下有效权衡观测与操作，验证了其在仿真与真实主动视觉操作任务上的有效性。

title: Query-Conditioned Articulation Estimation from a Single Image
comment: Code and video are available at https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/
summary: Enabling robots to estimate the kinematic parameters of articulated objects unlocks a wide range of capabilities for interaction and manipulation. The estimation has to happen from the information the robot currently observes, often just a single RGB image of an object it has never seen before. Current single-image approaches couple articulation part segmentation with articulation estimation, making their predictions vulnerable to missed detections and incorrect part associations, and they regress metric 3D geometry that a single view fixes only up to scale. We present QueryArt, a model that estimates articulation parameters from a single RGB image, a 2D query point, and camera intrinsics. QueryArt is trained to estimate the 3D articulation geometry relative to the queried point and in units of its depth, which keeps its target identifiable from the image alone. A single depth measurement at the query point then supplies the scale and recovers the metric parameters. We train QueryArt on a curated mixture of synthetic and real-world articulation datasets. We evaluate QueryArt on several benchmarks and compare it against recent baselines. QueryArt outperforms recent baselines on most articulation metrics, including on out-of-distribution data. To demonstrate the model's capabilities in real-world settings, we evaluate QueryArt on a mobile manipulator across 57 manipulation trials spanning 16 object parts and five viewpoint classes, achieving a 70.2% success rate. We provide code and videos at: https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/

AI.tldr: QueryArt 仅用单张 RGB 图像、一个 2D 查询点和相机内参即可估计铰接物体运动学参数，通过以查询点深度为单位回归相对 3D 铰接几何，再用一次深度测量恢复真实尺度，在多个基准和真实移动操作任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 让机器人估计铰接物体（如抽屉、门）的运动学参数对交互与操作至关重要，但机器人通常只能获得当前观测，往往是未见物体的单张 RGB 图像。现有单图方法将铰接部件分割与铰接估计耦合，导致预测易受漏检和部件关联错误影响；同时它们回归度量尺度的 3D 几何，而单视图只能确定到尺度不确定的程度。
AI.method: 提出 QueryArt 模型，输入为单张 RGB 图像、一个 2D 查询点和相机内参。模型被训练为以查询点深度为单位、估计相对于该查询点的 3D 铰接几何，使目标在仅有图像时可识别；随后在查询点处进行一次深度测量即可提供尺度，恢复度量参数。训练数据为精心构建的合成与真实铰接数据集混合。
AI.result: 在多个基准上与近期基线对比，QueryArt 在大多数铰接指标上均优于基线，包括分布外数据。在真实环境下于移动操作平台上进行 57 次操作试验，覆盖 16 个物体部件和 5 类视角，成功率达 70.2%。
AI.conclusion: QueryArt 通过解耦分割与估计、并以查询点深度为单位建模相对几何，实现了从单张 RGB 图像出发的可识别铰接估计，并结合一次深度测量恢复度量参数，在基准与真实机器人任务中均展现有效性。代码与视频见 https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/。

title: World Motion Models: Flexible Sequence Modeling of SE(3) Trajectories
summary: Equipping artificial agents with spatial intelligence requires a comprehensive generative prior over the dynamic 3D world. We propose World Motion Models (WMMs) that capture "what was, is, and will be where across time" via sparse SE(3) pose trajectories. WMMs are built on the observation that elements of dynamic scenes can be well approximated by a set of rigid SE(3) trajectories, a minimal yet expressive primitive for 4D modeling. This representation unifies articulated objects, human bodies, hand-object interactions, piecewise-rigid scene dynamics, camera motion, and even robot states and actions into a single shared space. Given this representation, we cast the joint distribution of these entities as a flexible sequence modeling problem, utilizing flow-matching with per-token noise levels. Coupled with a context token mechanism for non-sequential conditioning, this formulation supports any-to-any marginal conditioning across an arbitrary number of entities and time steps. Tasks such as future prediction, motion infilling, model-predictive control, inverse kinematics, cross-embodiment retargeting, and policy learning all reduce to the application of different masks over the same network. Experiments on 6 diverse applications of 3D vision and robotics demonstrate the versatility and flexibility of WMMs with strong performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出世界运动模型（World Motion Models, WMMs），以稀疏SE(3)位姿轨迹统一表示动态3D世界中的各类实体，并将其联合分布建模为序列生成问题，用逐token噪声水平的流匹配与上下文token机制实现任意实体、任意时间步的任意到任意条件生成。
AI.motivation: 为人工代理赋予空间智能，需要关于动态3D世界的全面生成先验。现有表示难以统一建模关节物体、人体、手-物交互、分片刚体场景动态、相机运动乃至机器人状态与动作等异构实体，缺少一个共享且可做条件生成的4D建模原语。
AI.method: 核心观察是动态场景元素可被一组刚体SE(3)轨迹良好近似，据此提出稀疏SE(3)位姿轨迹作为极简且表达力强的4D建模原语。将各实体联合分布转化为灵活序列建模问题，采用流匹配（flow-matching）并结合逐token噪声水平；引入上下文token机制以支持非序列条件，从而在任意数量实体与时间步上实现任意到任意（any-to-any）边缘条件生成。不同任务仅需在同一网络上施加不同掩码。
AI.result: 在3D视觉与机器人学的6个多样化应用中验证，涵盖未来预测、运动补全、模型预测控制、逆运动学、跨本体迁移与策略学习，WMMs展现出强性能、通用性与灵活性。
AI.conclusion: WMMs通过统一的SE(3)轨迹表示与掩码化的条件生成框架，把多种动态建模与控制任务归约为同一网络的推理，为动态3D世界的空间智能提供了统一、可扩展的生成先验。

title: End-to-End Learning vs. Modular Architectures: Comparative Insights into Autonomous Driving Systems
summary: Autonomous driving systems have become a central focus of intelligent transportation research, with End-to-End Learning and Modular Architectures offering two prominent design paradigms for their implementation. E2E Learning uses deep learning algorithms to map raw sensory inputs directly to driving actuators, providing a streamlined and adaptable solution. while Modular Architectures employ a pipeline-based approach, dividing the system into distinct subsystems for perception, cognition, planning, and control. This paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of these paradigms, focusing on their strengths, limitations, and trade-offs to provide insights into their suitability for various autonomous driving applications. The study evaluates key factors such as interpretability, scalability, robustness, and real-world applicability. While End-to-End Learning emphasizes simplicity and adaptability in dynamic environments, it lacks transparency and is highly dependent on large datasets. Conversely, Modular Architectures offer superior interpretability and task-specific optimization, but face challenges related to integration complexity and scalability. To address these limitations, hybrid approaches that combine the strengths of both paradigms have emerged, offering a promising direction for overcoming these challenges. Beyond this comparative synthesis, following work proposes a Four-Dimensional Architecture Selection Framework, comprising twelve binary criteria across safety, operating environment, data/computational resources, and deployment context, and validate it against ten published autonomous driving systems, correctly recommending 7/10 deployed architectures. This work synthesizes existing literature to highlight key trade-offs between the paradigms and identifies hybrid architectures as a promising direction for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文对自动驾驶的两大实现范式——端到端学习与模块化架构——进行了系统性对比分析，提出一个四维架构选择框架（12项二元准则，覆盖安全、运行环境、数据/算力资源、部署场景），并在10个已发表的自动驾驶系统上验证，正确推荐7/10的部署架构，指出混合架构是未来有前景的方向。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶是智能交通研究的核心议题，而端到端学习与模块化架构是两种主流设计范式。二者各有优劣，业界缺乏对其权衡关系的系统梳理，也缺少可操作的架构选型指导，因此需要一项综合性的比较研究来厘清适用条件。
AI.method: 采用文献综合与对比分析的方法，围绕可解释性、可扩展性、鲁棒性和实际落地适用性等关键维度，对端到端学习与模块化架构进行系统比较；在此基础上构建四维架构选择框架，包含安全、运行环境、数据/计算资源、部署背景四个维度下的12项二元准则，并以10个已发表的自动驾驶系统作为案例进行验证。
AI.result: 对比结果显示：端到端学习在动态环境中具有简洁性和适应性，但缺乏透明度且高度依赖大规模数据集；模块化架构可解释性更强、便于任务级优化，但面临集成复杂度高与可扩展性受限的问题。所提出的架构选择框架在10个已部署系统上正确推荐了7个（7/10）架构。
AI.conclusion: 两种范式各有明确的优势与局限，混合架构通过结合二者长处，是克服各自瓶颈的有效路径。本文为架构选型提供了以安全、环境、资源和部署背景为依据的决策框架，并将混合架构确定为未来研究的重要方向。

title: FlashDexRetarget: Accelerating Dexterous Manipulation Data Generation through Multi-Motion Retargeting
summary: Human hand-object demonstrations offer a reusable source of dexterous robot manipulation data, but transferring them across embodiments requires physically feasible retargeting. Existing physics-based approaches face limitations in retargeting success, motion-specific training efficiency, or both. To address these limitations, we introduce FlashDexRetarget, an RL-based framework for high-success, efficient dexterous motion retargeting. To make the demonstrated interaction easier to learn, we combine object point-cloud observations, hand-object distance features, and future trajectory encodings with complementary rewards that supervise object motion and reference hand-object relationships. To further accelerate learning, we employ separate left- and right-hand actor critic networks and adapt the off-policy algorithm, FlashSAC to dexterous motion tracking. On a benchmark of 50 motions spanning single-object and two-object interactions, FlashDexRetarget achieves a 90% success rate, approximately 2.5x that of the evaluated sampling-based baselines, while requiring up to 100x less training compute than the evaluated RL-based baselines. Evaluations on both XHand and Sharpa Wave Hand show consistent gains, and component-wise ablations examine the contributions of our design choices. Beyond the 50-motion benchmark, experiments with 200, 500, and 1,000 motions demonstrate that our method remains stable at larger scales and produces successful retargeted motions more efficiently as the training set grows. Qualitative replay results using real-world-captured demonstrations further illustrate the applicability of our framework to recorded human manipulation. Videos and code are available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/FlashDexRetarget/

AI.tldr: FlashDexRetarget：基于强化学习的高成功率、高效手-物操作动作重定向框架，在50个动作基准上达90%成功率，训练算力较RL基线最多减少100倍。
AI.motivation: 人手-物演示是机器人灵巧操作的可复用数据源，但跨本体迁移需物理可行的重定向。现有基于物理的方法在重定向成功率、运动特定训练效率或两方面均存在局限。
AI.method: 提出RL框架FlashDexRetarget。为降低学习难度，融合物体点云观测、手-物距离特征与未来轨迹编码，并设计监督物体运动与参考手-物关系的互补奖励；为加速学习，采用左右手独立的actor-critic网络，并将off-policy算法FlashSAC适配到灵巧运动跟踪。
AI.result: 在涵盖单物体与双物体交互的50个动作基准上成功率达90%，约为所评估的采样类基线的2.5倍，训练算力比所评估的RL基线最多减少100倍。在XHand与Sharpa Wave Hand上均获一致提升，消融实验验证各设计贡献；200、500、1000个动作的扩展实验表明方法在大规模下稳定且随训练集增大更高效，真实录制演示的回放验证了适用性。
AI.conclusion: FlashDexRetarget实现了高成功率且训练高效的灵巧手-物动作重定向，可跨本体并具备良好扩展性与真实演示适用性。

title: ChunkVLA-AM: Parallel Action Chunking for Vision-Language-Action Robot Control in Additive Manufacturing
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models unify visual perception, language understanding, and action generation, offering new opportunities for automation in additive manufacturing (AM). However, deployment in AM remains challenging because adapting these models to unseen robot embodiments is costly, and performance can degrade under environment changes. In this work, we present a framework for deploying OpenVLA-OFT on a FAIRINO FR3 robot in a fixed AM workcell. A data pipeline converts monocular real-world demonstrations into OpenVLA-compatible TFDS/RLDS datasets to support adaptation to the FR3 embodiment. At runtime, each inference request predicts an eight-step chunk of 7-D actions. The FR3 executes each chunk open loop before capturing a new observation, providing closed-loop feedback between chunks. The system uses a cloud-edge architecture in which the FR3 client streams observations to a remote inference server through a FastAPI interface. In 42 physical A-to-B object-transfer trials, evenly split between red and blue targets, the system succeeded in 39 (92.9%). All three failures occurred during final placement, when insufficient release-height control caused the object to topple. An illumination sweep identified a low-error luminance range of 85-125 on a 0-255 scale, with the lowest mean spatial error at 95.

AI.tldr: 本文将 OpenVLA-OFT 部署于 FAIRINO FR3 机械臂的固定增材制造工位，通过数据流水线转换单目真实示范数据并以云边架构实现远程推理，在 42 次物块搬运试验中成功率 92.9%。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型融合视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成，为增材制造自动化带来新机遇；但将其适配到未见过的机器人本体成本高，且环境变化会导致性能下降，因此部署仍具挑战。
AI.method: 构建 OpenVLA-OFT 在 FAIRINO FR3 固定 AM 工位上的部署框架：数据流水线将单目真实示范转换为 OpenVLA 兼容的 TFDS/RLDS 数据集以支持本体适配；运行时每次推理预测 8 步、7 维动作块，FR3 开环执行整块后再采集新观测，实现块间闭环反馈；采用云边架构，FR3 客户端经 FastAPI 接口向远程推理服务器流式传输观测。
AI.result: 42 次 A 到 B 物块搬运试验（红蓝目标各半）中成功 39 次，成功率 92.9%；3 次失败均发生于最终放置阶段，因释放高度控制不足导致物体倾倒。光照扫描确定 0–255 尺度下 85–125 为低误差亮度区间，平均空间误差最低点出现在 95。
AI.conclusion: 该框架验证了 OpenVLA-OFT 在真实 AM 工位上的可行部署，块间闭环与云边推理可支撑较高任务成功率，后续需改进释放高度控制并利用最佳光照区间提升鲁棒性。

title: Towards Physical Underwater Robotic Assistance for Scuba Diver Movement in Confined Spaces
summary: Scuba divers are taught to control their depth to avoid rapid ascents and descents, which could result in serious injuries such as gas embolisms and barotrauma. However, many underwater tasks necessitate lateral control, maintaining distance between subsea structures such as coral reefs, submerged drilling instrumentation, or unexploded ordnance. In this work, we discuss a first-of-its-kind wearable robotic solution providing thruster-actuated directional guidance to a diver, as distinct from prior propulsive-assistance exoskeletons. We introduce ``Robotic Assisted Diver Movement in Confined Spaces'' (RADMCS), a wearable robot that assists divers in maintaining a fixed distance from subsea structures by leveraging perception techniques in monocular depth estimation and force-feedback from submersible thrusters to provide haptic feedback. Its small and compact form factor creates a foundational platform that could be expanded to include more sophisticated control and navigation behaviors. We present results from Institutional Review Board (IRB) in-water studies with eight human scuba diver participants on threshold sensitivity tests in both a closed-water swimming facility and ocean environments; distance-maintaining experiments in a closed-water facility; and form, fit, and function testing in the ocean. We demonstrate that relatively low thrust values (10 percent of maximum) allow robotic direction of a human's movement using the physical sensation of the robot's guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个可穿戴推进器式方向引导机器人RADMCS，通过单目深度估计与推进器力反馈向潜水员提供触觉引导，帮助其与水下结构保持固定距离；8名潜水员的IRB水中实验表明，仅10%最大推力即可实现人体方向引导。
AI.motivation: 潜水员通常被训练控制深度以避免快速升沉造成的气体栓塞与气压伤，但珊瑚礁、水下钻探仪器、未爆物等水下任务还要求横向控制，即与水下结构保持安全距离。现有推进辅助外骨骼侧重推进助力，而非方向引导，缺乏针对受限空间内定向引导的可穿戴方案。
AI.method: 提出可穿戴机器人RADMCS（受限空间中的机器人辅助潜水员运动），利用单目深度估计感知与水下推进器的力反馈，向潜水员提供触觉方向引导；机器人形态小巧紧凑，可作为可扩展至更复杂控制与导航行为的基础平台。开展IRB批准的水中人体研究，8名水肺潜水员参与，涵盖封闭水域游泳设施与海洋环境中的阈值敏感性测试、封闭水域中的距离保持实验，以及海洋中的形态、贴合与功能测试。
AI.result: 在两类环境中完成阈值敏感性测试、距离保持实验与形态/贴合/功能测试；结果显示仅需较低推力（最大值的10%）即可通过机器人引导的物理感觉实现对人体运动方向的控制。
AI.conclusion: 可穿戴推进器机器人能够以低推力提供有效的触觉方向引导，帮助潜水员在受限空间内与水下结构保持固定距离，验证了该平台作为可扩展基础方案的可行性。

title: Robot Learning on Discrete Surfaces: Theory and Applications
summary: All the objects composing our world are enclosed within surfaces. Yet, most robot learning and motion generation frameworks treat surfaces as constraints ignoring their intrinsic geometry. This gap is acute for polyhedral meshes--the standard output of CAD and 3D reconstruction--whose discrete geometric structure remains unexploited. In this paper, we propose a unified discrete Riemannian framework that enables robot learning directly on polyhedral surface meshes. Using discrete differential geometry, we define logarithmic and exponential maps, parallel transport, and ambient-space projections that remain well-defined across faces, edges, and vertices. We instantiate the framework in three learning paradigms: (i) Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs), an improved exponential-map computation and a fixed-tangent-cone forcing-term encoding with parallel transport yield better cross-surface generalisation and stability over prior mesh-based approaches. (ii) Gaussian Process (GP), a geodesic-based kernel with practical admissibility control, enables regression at arbitrary mesh locations without smoothness assumptions. (iii) Riemannian Flow Matching (RFM), mesh-native operators improve generative quality over spectral baselines while reducing training time. The framework is validated in simulation against state-of-the-art methods and demonstrated on two real-robot scenarios: generalising user-drawn trajectories across different surfaces and planning polishing motions on RGB-D-reconstructed surfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的离散黎曼框架，使机器人学习可直接在多面体表面网格上进行，并在DMP、GP、RFM三种学习范式中实例化并验证。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人学习与运动生成框架多将表面视为约束，忽略其内蕴几何；尤其对CAD与三维重建标准输出的多面体网格，其离散几何结构未被利用，存在明显空白。
AI.method: 基于离散微分几何，定义在多面体网格面、边、顶点上均良好定义的指数/对数映射、平行移动与环境空间投影。在三种范式中实例化：(i) DMP：改进指数映射计算与固定切锥强迫项编码结合平行移动；(ii) GP：基于测地线的核函数并引入可容许性控制；(iii) RFM：网格原生算子。
AI.result: DMP相比既有网格方法具有更好的跨表面泛化性与稳定性；GP的测地核无需光滑性假设即可在任意网格位置回归；RFM在生成质量上优于谱基线并减少训练时间。仿真中与SOTA方法对比验证，并在两个真实机器人场景演示：跨表面泛化用户手绘轨迹、在RGB-D重建表面上规划抛光运动。
AI.conclusion: 该离散黎曼框架为多面体表面网格上的机器人学习提供了统一、几何一致的建模范式，兼顾理论严谨性与实际可用性，可支撑轨迹泛化与表面作业规划等真实任务。

title: TouchTherm: Building Multimodal Digital Twins of Objects for Tactile and Thermal Rendering
summary: Robotic simulation and virtual reality increasingly require object assets that capture not only visual geometry but also the physical cues underlying tactile and thermal interaction. Existing 3D datasets and reconstruction methods primarily represent object-scale geometry and visual appearance, overlooking microscale surface structure for high-fidelity haptic rendering and transient temperature dynamics for temperature-aware interaction. We present TouchTherm, a framework for constructing simulation-ready visuo-tactile-thermal object assets from real-world objects. For visual and tactile reconstruction, we combine structured-light scanning with multiview normal maps obtained from photometric stereo. The normal maps are registered to the scanned geometry and transformed into tangent space to recover local micro-height fields for optical tactile rendering, while the coarse mesh handles collision detection. For thermal reconstruction, we capture synchronized multiview infrared videos of natural cooling following controlled heating and reconstruct a physics-regularized dynamic thermal field. Experiments on 20 objects show that the reconstructed micro-height fields preserve dominant surface structures and recover higher-frequency details beyond the coarse geometry, while the thermal fields achieve held-out surface-temperature MAEs of 0.465 degrees C and 0.592 degrees C at 30 s and 45 s, respectively. The resulting tactile assets support synthetic-to-real object recognition from tactile observations, while a glove-based VR system demonstrates spatially and temporally varying thermal feedback. These results highlight the potential of TouchTherm for multimodal sensory simulation and temperature-aware virtual interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出TouchTherm框架，从真实物体构建面向仿真的视觉-触觉-热学多模态资产：结构化光扫描+光度立体法恢复微观高度场，同步多视角红外视频重建物理正则化动态热场。20个物体实验中，热场在30s和45s的留出表面温度MAE为0.465℃和0.592℃，并支持触觉合成到真实物体识别与VR热反馈。
AI.motivation: 机器人与虚拟现实需要不仅包含视觉几何、还包含触觉与热交互物理线索的物体资产。现有3D数据集与重建方法主要表示物体尺度几何与视觉外观，忽略了用于高保真触觉渲染的微观表面结构，以及用于温度感知交互的瞬态温度动态。
AI.method: 视觉与触觉重建：将结构化光扫描与光度立体法获得的多视角法线图结合；法线图配准到扫描几何并转换至切空间，以恢复局部微观高度场用于光学触觉渲染，粗网格用于碰撞检测。热重建：在受控加热后采集自然冷却的同步多视角红外视频，重建物理正则化的动态热场。
AI.result: 在20个物体上的实验表明，重建的微观高度场保留了主导表面结构，并恢复了粗几何之外的更高频细节；热场在30s和45s的留出表面温度MAE分别为0.465℃和0.592℃。所得触觉资产支持从触觉观测进行合成到真实的物体识别；基于手套的VR系统展示了空间和时间变化的温度反馈。
AI.conclusion: TouchTherm在多模态感知仿真与温度感知虚拟交互方面具有潜力。

title: Training-Free Diffusion Planning with Analytical Local Scores
summary: Path finding and multi-robot motion planning require trajectories that are smooth, goal-directed, and collision-free in environments with complex geometric constraints. Recent diffusion-based planners have shown that trajectory generation can be cast as iterative denoising which has opened the doors to learning-based approaches that can handle multi-modal trajectory distributions and refine entire trajectories. However, a key limitation is that diffusion planners require training on large collections of feasible trajectories, rendering them map-specific, and difficult to deploy when high-quality demonstrations are unavailable. This paper introduces a training-free diffusion-based motion planner that replaces learned global trajectory scores with analytical local scores derived from obstacle, smoothness, velocity, and inter-agent feasibility terms. The proposed idea relies on a key observation: the score of a trajectory can be reconstructed by considering only local interactions between neighboring waypoints and nearby constraints. This structure exploitation yields a decomposed denoising procedure that retains the optimization structure of classical trajectory methods while inheriting the iterative refinement behavior of diffusion models. Experiments on a large collection of complex environments and large multi-agent planning tasks show that the proposed analytical score produces smooth and feasible trajectories within limited computational costs, for example in generating feasible paths for 300+ agents in environments containing 100+ obstacles in under 6 seconds on a GPU, outperforming strong learning-based and optimization baselines, while avoiding the data requirements of learned diffusion planners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免训练的扩散式运动规划器，用解析局部得分替代学习到的全局轨迹得分，实现快速、平滑、无碰撞的轨迹生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散式规划器需在大量可行轨迹上训练，导致其依赖特定地图，且在缺乏高质量示范数据时难以部署。作者希望去除数据依赖并保持扩散模型的迭代细化优势。
AI.method: 利用"轨迹得分可由相邻航点与邻近约束的局部交互重构"这一观察，将学习到的全局轨迹得分替换为由障碍、平滑度、速度与智能体间可行性项组成的解析局部得分。该结构利用产生分解式去噪流程，既保留经典轨迹优化结构，又继承扩散模型的迭代细化特性。
AI.result: 在大量复杂环境与大规摸多智能体任务上，解析得分在有限计算成本内生成平滑可行轨迹：在含100+障碍物的环境中为300+智能体生成可行路径不足6秒（GPU），优于强学习的与优化基线，且无需学习式扩散规划器的数据需求。
AI.conclusion: 免训练、解析得分的扩散式规划可在复杂几何约束下兼顾轨迹质量、可扩展性与计算效率，规避数据依赖，为多机器人运动规划提供了新范式。

title: BLT*: Informed Belief Localization Trees for Uncertainty-Aware Planning on Digital Twins
summary: We present Informed Belief Localization Trees* (Informed BLT*), a sampling-based belief space planning (BSP) algorithm that scales to large outdoor digital twins with point-cloud observations. We adapt RRT* and Informed RRT* to belief space using the $2$-Wasserstein ($W_2$) metric. Assuming isotropic Gaussian beliefs, sampled belief states can be connected efficiently while accounting for available information and probabilistic collision constraints. This enables steering and rewiring without repeatedly propagating observations, and allows previously computed measurement information to be reused. We present a framework to generate semantically labelled digital twins for planning in real-world environments with point-cloud-based localization. Experiments in simulated environments and digital twins show faster initial solution discovery in most maps with competitive cost convergence.

AI.tldr: 提出 Informed BLT*，将 RRT* 与 Informed RRT* 扩展到信念空间，采用 2-Wasserstein 度量，在点云观测下实现可扩展的室外数字孪生信念空间规划。
AI.motivation: 信念空间规划（BSP）在点云观测的室外大型数字孪生场景中难以扩展，需处理高斯信念连接、信息增益与概率碰撞约束，且避免反复传播观测带来的高昂计算开销。
AI.method: 将 RRT* 和 Informed RRT* 适配到信念空间，使用 2-Wasserstein（W2）度量；假设各向同性高斯信念，实现高效信念状态连接，兼顾可用信息与概率碰撞约束；支持无需重复传播观测的转向与重连，并复用已计算的量测信息；同时提出生成语义标注数字孪生的框架，用于真实环境点云定位规划。
AI.result: 在仿真环境和数字孪生上的实验表明，多数地图中初始解发现更快，且成本收敛具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Informed BLT* 通过 W2 度量下各向同性高斯信念假设与信息复用机制，有效提升了大尺度数字孪生点云环境下的信念空间规划效率，验证了其在真实环境数字孪生规划中的可行性。

title: H-SPAR: Hydrodynamic-aware Simulation for Particle Transport and Autonomous Robots
summary: Environmental robotic sampling requires considering the dual influence of water currents on robotic motion and particle transport. Existing marine robotics simulators generally model flow, autonomy, and sampling targets separately, limiting joint evaluation of mission cost and sampling performance. H-SPAR integrates spatially and temporally varying velocity fields, Lagrangian particle transport, probabilistic sampling, and ROS 2/Gazebo-based uncrewed surface vehicle (USV) autonomy. In this work, shared precomputed flow fields drive particle advection and current-induced forces during closed-loop vehicle execution. Path-planning experiments show that the existing current-aware planner SVF-RRT* achieves 69.4% lower upstream cost than conventional RRT* at the planning level, but this reduction falls to 41.7% during execution under time-varying currents, reflecting temporal flow variation, vehicle motion constraints, and path deviation omitted during planning. Coverage experiments show that sweep orientation changes the particle-sampling rate by up to 22.2% under the complete H-SPAR configuration. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating planning, vehicle execution, particle transport, and sampling together under consistent hydrodynamic conditions. The project webpage is available at https://sites.google.com/view/h-spar, and the open-source code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/naviiidz/h-spar-sim.

AI.tldr: H-SPAR 是一个集成时变流场、拉格朗日粒子输运、概率采样与 ROS 2/Gazebo USV 自主性的海洋机器人仿真框架，用共享预计算流场统一驱动粒子平流与流致受力。实验表明：SVF-RRT* 在规划层面比 RRT* 上游成本低 69.4%，但在时变流下执行时降为 41.7%；扫描方向可使粒子采样率变化达 22.2%。
AI.motivation: 环境机器人采样需同时考虑水流对机器人运动与粒子输运的双重影响，而现有海洋机器人仿真器通常将流场、自主性与采样目标分别建模，无法在一致水动力条件下联合评估任务成本与采样性能。
AI.method: H-SPAR 集成时空变化速度场、拉格朗日粒子输运、概率采样以及基于 ROS 2/Gazebo 的无人水面艇（USV）自主性；采用共享的预计算流场，在闭环车辆执行过程中同时驱动粒子平流与流致受力。
AI.result: 路径规划实验中，现有流感知规划器 SVF-RRT* 在规划层面的上游成本比传统 RRT* 低 69.4%，但在时变流场执行时该降幅降至 41.7%，反映规划阶段忽略的时变流、车辆运动约束与路径偏差。覆盖实验中，在完整 H-SPAR 配置下，扫描方向可使粒子采样率变化高达 22.2%。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调需在一致水动力条件下，联合评估规划、车辆执行、粒子输运与采样过程。项目网页与开源代码已公开。

title: UniWAM: Unified World-Action Model
summary: Vision-language-action models benefit from the understanding and reasoning capabilities of pretrained vision-language models, but action-only supervision provides limited grounding in world dynamics. Conversely, world-action models inherit spatiotemporal priors from video generation models, yet remain limited in semantic understanding and reasoning under distribution shifts. We introduce UniWAM, a unified architecture that integrates a physical reasoner, a world generator, and an action predictor to jointly learn semantic understanding of the physical world, visual generation, and action prediction. To ensure the quality of the training data, we developed a rigorous data cleaning and annotation pipeline for both human egocentric data and robot data. To adapt the vision-language component to embodied tasks while preserving its inherited language capabilities, we represent low-level actions in natural language and introduce a pre-training recipe that assigns complementary supervision from visual question answering (VQA) data, human egocentric data, and robot demonstrations to the appropriate model components. During post-training, future visual noise augmentation reduces reliance on precise future predictions, while history-conditioned flow matching uses encoded action history to initialize action generation. Together, these designs significantly reduce denoising steps while maintaining performance. UniWAM achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across multiple evaluations, including in-distribution performance, robustness, generalization, instruction following, and long-horizon task execution. Furthermore, we uncover a log-linear scaling law of unified human-robot co-training, demonstrating the effectiveness of large-scale pre-training on a mixture of human and robot data.

AI.tldr: UniWAM提出统一架构，融合物理推理器、世界生成器与动作预测器，实现语义理解、视觉生成与动作预测的联合学习，并通过数据清洗、互补监督预训练与后训练优化，在多项评测中达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作模型受限于仅动作监督，缺乏对世界动态的建模；世界-动作模型虽继承视频生成的时空先验，但语义理解与推理能力不足，且在分布偏移下表现受限。因此需要统一二者优势。
AI.method: 提出UniWAM统一架构，集成物理推理器、世界生成器与动作预测器。构建严格的数据清洗与标注流程（人类第一人称数据与机器人数据）。用自然语言表示低层动作，设计预训练配方将VQA数据、人类第一人称数据与机器人演示的互补监督分配给相应组件。后训练采用未来视觉噪声增强降低对精确未来预测的依赖，并用历史条件流匹配以编码动作历史初始化动作生成。
AI.result: 在分布内性能、鲁棒性、泛化性、指令跟随与长程任务执行等多项评测中达到SOTA；显著减少去噪步数同时保持性能；发现统一人-机器人协同训练的log-linear缩放律。
AI.conclusion: 统一架构与互补监督预训练、后训练设计可有效整合语义推理与时空生成能力，大规模人机混合数据预训练具备可扩展性，验证了统一建模范式的有效性。

title: HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution
summary: As robotic hardware and learning methods advance, humanoids need tools to perform tasks beyond their inherent physical limits. Successful tool use requires selecting a suitable tool and coordinating manipulation and, when needed, locomotion to complete the task. Existing benchmarks do not jointly evaluate these capabilities on a humanoid. We introduce HumanoidToolBench, an 18-task benchmark spanning three scenarios, three execution levels, and two tool-set modes, together with ToolBook, a dataset of 3.1k demonstrations collected in simulation and on a real Unitree G1. Evaluation of seven policies in simulation and three on the real robot reveals substantial gaps between selecting a suitable tool and completing the task. Focused GR00T N1.7 probes show reduced selection accuracy on unseen tools and continued task execution under unrelated instructions. Code and data are available at https://snu-pi.github.io/HumanoidToolBench/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HumanoidToolBench——首个联合评估人形机器人“工具选择+操作+移动”能力的基准，含18个任务、3种场景、3个执行层级、2种工具集模式，并发布3.1k示范数据集 ToolBook；实验揭示策略在工具选择与任务完成间存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 随着机器人硬件与学习方法进步，人形机器人需要借助工具完成超出自身物理极限的任务，这要求机器人既能选择合适的工具，又能协调操作甚至移动。然而现有基准未能在人形机器人上联合评估这些能力，因此缺少统一的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 HumanoidToolBench 基准：覆盖3种场景、3个执行层级、2种工具集模式，共18个任务；并采集 ToolBook 数据集，包含3.1k条示范，来源为仿真环境与真实 Unitree G1 机器人。在仿真中评测7种策略、在真机上评测3种策略，并对 GR00T N1.7 进行针对性探测。
AI.result: 实验显示策略在“选中合适工具”与“完成任务”之间存在明显能力鸿沟；GR00T N1.7 探测结果表明其在未见工具上的选择准确率下降，且会在无关指令下继续执行任务，说明其指令跟随与工具选择鲁棒性不足。
AI.conclusion: HumanoidToolBench 与 ToolBook 填补了人形机器人工具使用联合评测的空白，为后续研究提供统一平台与数据；结果指出现有策略在工具选择、泛化与指令遵循方面仍有较大提升空间。代码与数据已公开。

title: GlassGuard: Verified Glass Plane Mapping for Robot Navigation
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters
summary: Transparent and specular surfaces pose a serious challenge to LiDAR-based SLAM and navigation because laser returns may pass through glass, leaving collision boundaries absent from the map. Prior work attempts to reconstruct the missing surfaces, but inaccurate obstacle placement can create the opposite failure: contamination of traversable free space. Recognizing this dual requirement, we present GlassGuard, a navigation-oriented framework for reconstructing planar architectural glass from complementary visual and LiDAR evidence. We formulate success in terms of both glass coverage and free-space contamination and apply this principle throughout proposal verification and global map construction. A foundation vision model provides glass-instance masks, structural 3D cues generate metric plane hypotheses, and depth-free 2D projective geometry checks their orientations before they enter a consolidated global map. We evaluate GlassGuard in nine building-scale scenes spanning diverse glass structures, spatial scales, and lighting conditions, with more than one hour and 2.1 km of real-world robot traversal. GlassGuard achieves 85% of total glass coverage for its panoramic version. Under identical pinhole inputs, GlassGuard achieves 82% total coverage, compared with at most 61% for the evaluated baselines, while producing 5-17x fewer false voxels per frame. Qualitative examples with a navigation planner illustrate the reconstructed planes blocking paths through glass while leaving traversable routes open. The project page is available at https://glassguardproject.github.io/.

AI.tldr: GlassGuard：面向导航的玻璃重建框架，利用视觉+LiDAR互补证据恢复平面玻璃，同时优化玻璃覆盖率与自由空间污染。
AI.motivation: LiDAR对透明/镜面玻璃的激光回波会穿透，导致碰撞边界缺失；但若重建时障碍物放置不准，又会污染可通行自由空间，因此需同时兼顾"玻璃覆盖"与"自由空间污染"双重目标。
AI.method: 基础视觉模型提供玻璃实例掩码；结构3D线索生成度量平面假设；无深度的2D投影几何校验平面朝向；通过提案验证与全局地图构建进行整合。
AI.result: 在9个建筑尺度场景、超1小时/2.1km真实机器人行进中评估：全景版玻璃总覆盖率85%；相同针孔输入下82%覆盖率（基线最多61%），每帧假体素减少5-17倍。
AI.conclusion: 定性与规划器实验表明，重建平面能阻挡穿玻璃路径同时保留可通行路线，验证了双重目标设计的有效性。

title: SkeleWAM: Skeleton World-Action Modeling for Efficient Robotic Manipulation
summary: World action models (WAMs) combine robot action generation with future state prediction. Existing WAMs typically predict videos or learned visual latents, which represent interaction geometry only implicitly and may retain appearance information unrelated to control. We introduce SkeleWAM, a compact WAM that represents a manipulation scene as a sparse 3D skeleton composed of robot joints, object centers, and interaction points. Constructed online from current RGB-D observations and robot proprioception, the skeleton provides a unified geometric state for action generation and future skeleton prediction. Future skeleton prediction provides additional geometric supervision for action learning without requiring visual reconstruction. At inference, SkeleWAM generates actions directly from the current skeleton and language instruction, while Medoid Action Consensus (MAC) serves as an auxiliary consensus strategy for stochastic action samples. On LIBERO-Plus, SkeleWAM achieves an overall success rate of 85.9% with 57.1M parameters, outperforming Cosmos-Policy by 3.7 percentage points. These results demonstrate that sparse 3D robot--object structure provides an effective state space for robust and parameter-efficient world action learning. The project is available at https://skelewam-project.github.io/.

AI.tldr: SkeleWAM将操作场景表示为稀疏3D骨架（机器人关节、物体中心、交互点），作为动作生成与未来骨架预测的统一几何状态，在LIBERO-Plus上以57.1M参数取得85.9%成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）通常预测视频或学习到的视觉潜变量，仅隐式表达交互几何，并可能保留与控制无关的外观信息，导致状态表示冗余且不利于高效、鲁棒的动作学习。
AI.method: 提出SkeleWAM：在线从RGB-D观测与机器人本体感知构建稀疏3D骨架（机器人关节、物体中心、交互点），形成统一几何状态；未来骨架预测为动作学习提供额外几何监督，无需视觉重建；推理时直接由当前骨架与语言指令生成动作，并采用Medoid Action Consensus（MAC）对随机动作样本进行一致性聚合。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus上，SkeleWAM以57.1M参数达到85.9%的整体成功率，较Cosmos-Policy高出3.7个百分点，验证了稀疏3D机器人—物体结构作为状态空间的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏3D机器人—物体结构为稳健且参数高效的世界动作学习提供了有效状态空间，兼顾几何监督与动作生成的紧凑性。

title: DuoMind: Enabling Distributed Multi-Robot Coordination with Semantic Communication
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs) have recently driven rapid progress in general-purpose robots, yet most progress has focused on single-robot settings. Extending these capabilities to multi-robot systems remains challenging because robots must coordinate long-horizon behaviors while maintaining reliable, fine-grained execution. We introduce DuoMind, a distributed hierarchical framework for multi-robot coordination through semantic communication. Each robot uses a VLA-based action model for low-level execution and a VLM-based orchestrator for high-level reasoning and inter-agent coordination. At each planning step, the orchestrator at each robot reasons over the task instruction, local observations, and messages received from other robots. It then generates low-level instructions for the action model and semantic messages for peer robots. This architecture exploits the complementary strengths of pretrained models by combining the semantic reasoning capabilities of VLMs with the precise action-generation capabilities of VLAs. To address the scarcity of benchmarks for multi-robot coordination, we further develop RoboPoly, a benchmark comprising long-horizon manipulation tasks that require coordinated, closed-loop execution under distributed control. Experiments on RoboPoly and RoboTwin demonstrate that DuoMind improves multi-robot task performance, while ablation studies confirm the contributions of hierarchical orchestration and semantic communication. More details are available on our project page.

AI.tldr: 提出分布式分层多机器人协作框架DuoMind，通过语义通信协调VLM高层推理与VLA低层执行，并构建RoboPoly基准验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型(VLM)与视觉-语言-动作模型(VLA)推动了通用机器人的快速进展，但多数工作集中于单机器人场景。扩展至多机器人系统面临两大挑战：需协调长时程行为，同时保持可靠且精细的执行。此外，多机器人协作领域缺乏相应基准。
AI.method: DuoMind为分布式分层框架：每个机器人包含基于VLA的动作模型负责低层执行，以及基于VLM的编排器负责高层推理与智能体间协调。每个规划步中，编排器基于任务指令、局部观测和来自其他机器人的消息进行推理，输出给动作模型的低层指令及给同伴机器人的语义消息。该架构结合VLM的语义推理能力与VLA的精确动作生成能力。同时构建RoboPoly基准，包含分布式控制下需协调闭环执行的长时程操作任务。
AI.result: 在RoboPoly和RoboTwin上的实验表明，DuoMind提升了多机器人任务性能；消融实验证实了分层编排与语义通信的贡献。
AI.conclusion: DuoMind通过分层编排与语义通信有效实现多机器人长时程协作，验证了VLM与VLA能力互补结合的有效性。

title: Watch, Infer, Coordinate: Inferring Robot Partner Constraints for Zero-Shot Coordination
summary: Robots operating in the physical world will increasingly need to coordinate with other robots, particularly in manipulation tasks where an object may be too large or heavy for a single robot to carry alone. Physical limitations caused by hardware degradation or actuator faults can restrict the actions a robot can reliably execute, yet these limitations may be unknown to its partner. We study whether a helper can infer a robot partner's physical constraints from observing it coordinate with another robot, then use the inferred capability to coordinate with the same partner on a new task. This is difficult because a demonstration shows what the constrained robot did, but not what it could have done. In physically coupled tasks, the other robot may also compensate for its limitations, making those limitations difficult to identify from the constrained robot's behavior alone. Our key insight is that these constraints shape the joint behavior of the team, making the actions of both robots informative about the constrained partner's capability. We introduce Watch, Infer, Coordinate, a benchmark spanning three physically coupled manipulation settings, together with an inference approach that scores candidate constraints using observed joint behavior. Across all three settings, our method substantially improves constraint inference and zero-shot coordination, approaching an oracle with access to the true constraints.

AI.tldr: 论文提出WIC基准（Watch, Infer, Coordinate），研究助手机器人能否通过观察受限机器人与他人协作来推断其物理约束，并用于新任务的零样本协作；方法通过联合行为对候选约束打分，在三类物理耦合操作场景中显著提升约束推断与协作性能，接近已知真值约束的oracle。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协作中，单个机器人可能因硬件退化或执行器故障而存在物理限制，且其伙伴并不知情。难点在于：演示仅展示受限机器人做了什么，而非它本可以做什么；在物理耦合任务中，另一机器人还可能补偿其限制，导致仅从受限机器人行为难以识别约束。作者希望助手能在观察一次协作后推断伙伴约束，并迁移到新任务。
AI.method: 提出WIC（Watch, Infer, Coordinate）基准，涵盖三种物理耦合操作场景；提出一种约束推断方法，利用观察到的两机器人联合行为对候选约束进行打分（关键洞察：约束会塑造整个团队联合行为，因此双方动作都对受限方能力具有信息量），并将推断出的能力用于新任务的零样本协作。
AI.result: 在全部三种场景中，该方法在约束推断和零样本协作上均有显著提升，性能接近可直接访问真实约束的oracle。
AI.conclusion: 通过观测联合协作行为可有效推断伙伴的未知物理约束，并支持跨任务零样本协作；团队层面的联合行为信息比单独观测受限机器人行为更充分。

title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: We study test-time evolution for humanoid loco-manipulation: solving tasks that a controller was never trained for by repurposing its existing skills, improving from its own attempts, and retaining what it learns, without retraining. Our key insight is that a broad controller already holds much of the competence a new task needs, and that this competence becomes accessible through an interface between planning and control that is expressive enough to specify contact-rich, multi-stage interactions, yet executable and measurable enough that execution feedback can guide planning from experience. InterEvolve realizes this interface with two components. First, we develop an object-aware forward-backward (FB) behavioral foundation model, whose object residuals on a frozen body prior turn a new reward about the body or objects into loco-manipulation behavior at test time. Second, we specify tasks as reward programs: staged rewards with completion conditions and tunable constants. A large language model (LLM) agent revises the program structure in context, drawing on execution feedback and a skill library of verified programs, while a numerical optimizer tunes its constants. With every candidate verified across parallel simulation scenarios, the program explores new ways to induce, repurpose, and compose the controller's existing motor competence for the task at hand, and thus improves over iterations. Experiments show that human-designed rewards leave much of the FB model's loco-manipulation competence untapped, whereas the programs InterEvolve evolves release it, sometimes through novel strategies. It further produces behaviors for diverse tasks, complex scenes, and long-horizon compositions in simulation, and evolved skills run autonomously on a physical Unitree G1 from egocentric onboard perception.

AI.tldr: 提出InterEvolve框架，通过LLM智能体与数值优化器协同进化"奖励程序"，在测试时激活并复用冻结人形控制器已有的运动操作能力，无需重新训练即可完成新任务，并在仿真与Unitree G1真机上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有控制器通常只针对特定任务训练，面对未训练过的新任务需重新训练，成本高且浪费了控制器已具备的广泛操作能力；核心动机是探索如何在测试阶段复用、重组并保留这些既有技能。
AI.method: 核心是构建规划与控制的接口：1）物体感知的前向-后向（FB）行为基础模型，在冻结身体先验上加入物体残差，将关于身体或物体的新奖励在测试时转化为运动操作行为；2）以奖励程序（含完成条件的分阶段奖励与可调常数）形式指定任务，由LLM智能体依据执行反馈和已验证程序技能库修订程序结构，数值优化器调节常数，并在并行仿真场景中验证每个候选。
AI.result: 实验表明人工设计的奖励未充分挖掘FB模型的运动操作能力，而InterEvolve进化出的程序能释放该能力，有时产生新颖策略；在仿真中可生成面向多样任务、复杂场景和长时序组合的行为，进化技能还能基于G1本体第一视角感知在真机上自主运行。
AI.conclusion: 通过可表达、可执行、可度量的规划-控制接口，测试时进化能有效复用并组合既有运动技能，无需重训即可解决新任务，具备仿真到真机的迁移能力。

title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
summary: Building reliable robot capabilities across diverse tasks requires substantial human effort to develop and maintain skills, design rewards, and integrate perception with control. We present Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real (RPG), a framework for autonomous improvement of robot execution systems without updating model weights. RPG identifies manipulation capabilities in an offline dataset and constructs related practice tasks in simulation. During practice, RPG uses execution feedback, privileged simulator state, and available dataset videos to diagnose failures. It develops new reusable symbolic skills, refines existing skills, and revises the system prompt based on these diagnoses. Cross-task evaluation tests individual candidate changes and merged revisions before they are retained for reuse. At test time, a multimodal LLM uses the resulting system prompt and skill library to coordinate perception and robot control. On held-out initializations of 22 manipulation tasks, RPG improves task success from 28.6% after the first practice round to 95.0% after 15 rounds, outperforming all evaluated baselines, including ASPIRE (75.5%) and CaP-Agent0 powered by GPT-6 Astra Pro (60.0%). After a common calibration and hardware-adaptation procedure, the frozen system succeeds in all 30 physical trials, with ten trials on each of three tasks. Project Website: https://rpg-robot.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出RPG框架，通过离线数据构建仿真练习任务、利用执行反馈与特权状态诊断失败，迭代改进符号技能库与系统提示，不更新模型权重，使22项操作任务成功率从28.6%提升至95.0%，并在30次真机试验中全部成功。
AI.motivation: 构建跨多样任务的可靠机器人能力通常需要大量人力来开发与维护技能、设计奖励，并将感知与控制集成，成本高且难以扩展；因此需要一种无需更新模型权重即可自主改进机器人执行系统的方案。
AI.method: RPG（Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real）框架：1）从离线数据集中识别可操作（manipulation）能力，并在仿真中构造相关练习任务；2）练习阶段利用执行反馈、仿真器特权状态以及可用数据集视频进行失败诊断；3）据此开发新的可复用符号技能、精炼已有技能并修订系统提示；4）通过跨任务评估检验单个候选改动与合并修订，达标后才保留复用；5）测试时由多模态LLM依据最终系统提示与技能库协调感知与机器人控制。
AI.result: 在22项操作任务的留出初始化上，成功率由第一轮练习后的28.6%提升至15轮后的95.0%，优于所有对比基线，包括ASPIRE（75.5%）与由GPT-6 Astra Pro驱动的CaP-Agent0（60.0%）。经统一的标定与硬件适配流程后，冻结系统在三个任务各10次、共30次物理试验中全部成功。
AI.conclusion: RPG表明，在不更新模型权重的前提下，通过离线数据重建练习任务、结合执行反馈与特权状态进行失败诊断、并迭代维护符号技能库与系统提示，可显著提升机器人执行系统的跨任务成功率，且改进后的冻结系统具备良好的真机迁移能力。

title: STATERA: Hidden Mass Estimation via Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Kinematics using Frozen Temporal Tubelets
summary: Vision models pretrained for frame-level appearance often struggle to infer hidden physical properties from motion. We study center-of-mass (CoM) localization for opaque, asymmetric rigid bodies from short monocular videos, where surface cues and point tracking are unreliable under self-occlusion. We propose STATERA, which adapts a pretrained video backbone (V-JEPA) with mostly frozen weights and a lightweight temporal tubelet mixer to predict per-frame CoM heatmaps and trajectories. To support this task, we introduce the HiddenMass Benchmark, comprising 50K MuJoCo trajectories and a 63-sequence real-world test set with physically calibrated CoM ground truth. In simulation, STATERA-50K-Sigma improves normalized CoM error from 41.7% (DINOv2) to 25.2%. In zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, we observe a fundamental trade-off in supervision: phase-aware targets can induce bimodal predictions, while phase-agnostic targets can collapse toward statistically safe centroids. Nevertheless, our phase-aware STATERA-50K-Crescent is the only evaluated method that demonstrates consistent movement toward the true hidden offset. While this leads to a monocular vector overshoot artifact that marginally increases absolute Euclidean error compared to a static geometric centroid, it improves physics capture from 2.6% to 41.0%. These results suggest that frozen temporal representations can better separate inertial dynamics from visual geometry for hidden-parameter estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出 STATERA，用冻结的 V-JEPA 视频骨干加轻量时序 tubelet mixer，从短单目视频预测不透明非对称刚体的质心热图与轨迹，并发布 HiddenMass Benchmark，揭示相位感知与相位无关监督的权衡。
AI.motivation: 面向帧级外观预训练的视觉模型难以从运动中推断隐藏物理属性；在自遮挡下，表面线索与点跟踪不可靠，因此研究短单目视频中的质心（CoM）定位问题。
AI.method: 提出 STATERA：适配预训练视频骨干 V-JEPA，权重大部分冻结，仅用轻量时序 tubelet mixer 预测逐帧 CoM 热图与轨迹；构建 HiddenMass Benchmark，含 5 万条 MuJoCo 轨迹和 63 序列真实测试集，并提供物理标定的 CoM 真值。
AI.result: 仿真中 STATERA-50K-Sigma 将归一化 CoM 误差从 41.7%（DINOv2）降至 25.2%。零样本 sim-to-real 迁移中发现监督存在根本权衡：相位感知目标可致双峰预测，相位无关目标易塌缩至统计安全质心；相位感知的 STATERA-50K-Crescent 是唯一持续朝真实隐藏偏移移动的方法，虽因单目向量过冲略增绝对欧氏误差，但物理捕捉率从 2.6% 提升至 41.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明冻结的时序表征能更好地将惯性动力学与视觉几何分离，有助于隐藏参数估计。

title: EgoRefine: Ego-Referenced Predictive Alignment and Trajectory-Conditioned Reliability-Aware Fusion for Asynchronous Collaborative Perception
comment: The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine
summary: Collaborative perception enables connected agents to share complementary observations for 3D object detection, extending sensing range and mitigating occlusion. Under asynchronous communication, however, cooperative features arrive with temporal delay. Existing prediction-based methods compensate for these features mainly from the transmitting agent's own history, leaving residual misalignment with the ego agent's current observation; subsequent fusion also often overlooks spatial variations in alignment quality. We propose EgoRefine, an ego-referenced predictive alignment and reliability-aware fusion framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Its Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment module uses the current ego feature to guide cooperative trajectory-field prediction and refines the sampling offsets along an ego-referenced trajectory direction. Its Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion module treats the trajectory discrepancy between the ego and cooperative streams and the directional refinement magnitude as alignment cues, using them to condition the relation between aligned features and adaptively reweight the two streams before convolutional fusion. Experiments on V2V4Real and DAIR-V2X-Seq show that EgoRefine outperforms TraF-Align by 1.6 and 2.9 points on average in AP@0.5 and AP@0.7, respectively. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoRefine框架，用自车特征引导协同特征预测对齐并做可靠性感知融合，提升异步协同感知性能。
AI.motivation: 异步通信下协同特征存在时延，现有预测方法主要依赖发送方自身历史做补偿，与自车当前观测间仍残留错位；且后续融合常忽略对齐质量的空间差异。
AI.method: 包含两个模块：(1) Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment，用当前自车特征引导协同轨迹场预测，并沿自车参考轨迹方向精化采样偏移；(2) Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion，以自车与协同流之间的轨迹差异及方向精化幅度作为对齐线索，用于调制对齐特征间的关系，并在卷积融合前自适应重加权两路特征。
AI.result: 在V2V4Real与DAIR-V2X-Seq数据集上，EgoRefine在AP@0.5和AP@0.7上平均分别超越TraF-Align 1.6和2.9个点。源码将在https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine公开。
AI.conclusion: 以自车当前观测为参考的对齐与对齐质量感知的融合可有效缓解异步协同感知中的时空错位，提升3D目标检测精度。

title: MIKASA-Robo-VLA: Benchmarking Memory in VLA Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action policies often see only one or a few recent frames, which makes it difficult to evaluate how they use information that disappears during a task. We introduce MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. All but 10 hide the cue an action depends on. Those 10 are reactive controls. MIKASA-Robo, the suite it rebuilds, has 32 tasks and uses language only in a representative VLA subset. Here every task provides an instruction, while memory-dependent tasks hide a task-relevant cue and reactive controls keep it available. For 70 tasks, environment phase timings specify an information gap, and for 28 of them the gap exceeds the 16-frame window of the widest fixed-context VLA we survey.
