The gap counts only the interval the cue is provably absent, not the full duration a policy must retain it, so every memory-dependent task still requires memory by construction, including the ones whose measured gap is short. We release 22,500 oracle trajectories across 10 memory types in RLDS and LeRobotDataset v3. A reference $π_{0.5}$ baseline with current images and proprioception, but no observation history or explicit memory module, is fine-tuned on 14 tasks and achieves 0.211 $\pm$ 0.044 mean task success. Its lower success on the evaluated Long-split tasks is confounded by open-loop chunking and the memory types represented in that subset. Project page: https://mikasarobo.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MIKASA-Robo-VLA 基准，包含 90 个语言条件操作任务，其中 80 个任务隐藏动作所依赖的关键线索以考察记忆能力，10 个为反应式对照；发布 22,500 条 oracle 轨迹（覆盖 10 种记忆类型），并提供 $π_{0.5}$ 基线（平均任务成功率 0.211±0.044）。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作策略通常只观察最近一帧或少数几帧，难以评估其如何利用任务过程中消失的信息；现有基准缺乏系统性考察记忆依赖的设定。
AI.method: 构建 MIKASA-Robo-VLA 基准（重建自 32 任务的 MIKASA-Robo，并在代表性 VLA 子集中使用语言）。90 个任务全部提供指令：70 个记忆依赖任务通过环境阶段时序定义信息间隙（其中 28 个间隙超过最宽固定上下文 VLA 的 16 帧窗口），10 个反应式对照保留线索可用。发布 10 种记忆类型、共 22,500 条 RLDS 与 LeRobotDataset v3 格式的 oracle 轨迹，并微调一个使用当前图像与本体感知、无观察历史与显式记忆模块的 $π_{0.5}$ 基线。
AI.result: $π_{0.5}$ 基线在 14 个任务上微调后平均任务成功率为 0.211±0.044；其在 Long-split 任务上的较低成功率受开环分块（open-loop chunking）与该子集所含记忆类型的混淆影响。
AI.conclusion: 该基准通过构造性设计（线索可证明缺失）确保所有记忆依赖任务必须使用记忆，包括实测间隙较短的任务，为评估 VLA 的时序/记忆能力提供了系统性平台。

title: Spatial Strategies, Not Actions: Vector-Quantized Geodesics as Tools for LLM-Driven Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) based agents are often criticized for lacking spatial understanding and mainly exploiting statistical text patterns. We investigate their spatial comprehension through an architecture combining geometrical tools with a LLM serving as a high-level orchestrator in grid-world environments. The agent first collects geodesic trajectories, which are then vector-quantized to extract a representative subset. Offline, the LLM associates a natural language description of the underlying behavioral patterns to each selected trajectory, making it a tool. Online, the LLM chooses the appropriate tool conditioned on the current state and goal. Low-level control is handled by primitive actions that execute the trajectory associated with the tool. From an agentic AI perspective, this approach separates learning into two levels: tool discovery is handled through unsupervised quantization of trajectories, while reasoning and decision-making are handled by the LLM. We test the approach in a partially observable dynamic 2D grid environment with an open vision-language model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Pairing the geometry-derived tool library with an agent-centered zoom tool and a collision detection tool lets a fast, non-reasoning configuration match the goal-reaching rate of a much more costly chain-of-thought version, while cutting the cost of a decision from minutes to seconds.

AI.tldr: 该研究将几何工具与充当高层编排器的LLM结合，通过向量量化轨迹构建工具库，使智能体在网格世界中具备空间理解能力，以低成本实现与思维链版本相当的目标达成率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体常被批评缺乏空间理解能力，主要依赖统计文本模式；研究动机在于探究其空间理解水平，并探索如何通过架构设计提升其空间决策能力同时降低成本。
AI.method: 在部分可观测的动态2D网格环境中，智能体先采集测地轨迹，经向量量化提取代表性轨迹子集；离线时由LLM为每条选定轨迹关联自然语言行为模式描述，将其转化为工具；在线时LLM依据当前状态与目标选择合适的工具，底层控制由执行对应轨迹的基元动作完成。该方法将学习分为两层：工具发现通过轨迹的无监督量化处理，推理与决策由LLM负责。测试使用开放视觉语言模型Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。
AI.result: 将几何推导的工具库与智能体中心缩放工具及碰撞检测工具结合后，快速非推理配置能够达到与高成本思维链版本相当的目标达成率，同时将每次决策成本从数分钟降至数秒。
AI.conclusion: 该架构有效分离工具发现与LLM推理，证明几何工具与LLM编排器的结合可显著提升LLM智能体的空间理解与决策效率，在保持目标达成率的同时大幅降低计算成本。

title: Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation
summary: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. This enforces invariant behavior across different layouts, enabling skills to transfer effectively to other configurations. Finally, through comprehensive empirical evaluations, we show that skills learned in a given environment can be effectively applied to solve downstream tasks in various environment layouts, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向无监督技能发现的动作感知时序表征学习方法，通过满足函数等变性并保留局部时序结构，结合基于双模拟（bisimulation）的技能发现，使技能仅依赖影响执行的状态特征，从而实现跨布局的OOD泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督技能发现方法依赖专家数据或泛化能力有限，难以迁移到未见过的环境布局。核心挑战在于学习既能捕捉环境时序结构、又对布局变化保持鲁棒的表征。
AI.method: 提出一个动作感知时序表征学习目标，使表征满足函数等变性（functional equivariance），同时保留环境的局部时序结构；在该嵌入基础上，提出基于双模拟的无监督技能发现，将技能行为仅条件化于直接影响其执行的状态特征子集，从而强制跨布局的行为不变性。
AI.result: 在多种环境布局上进行综合实证评估，表明在给定环境中学习到的技能可有效应用于其他布局下的下游任务，展现出较强的分布外（OOD）泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过动作感知时序表征与基于双模拟的技能发现，可在无需专家数据的前提下学习可迁移技能，实现跨环境布局的强泛化。

title: Reward as Observation: Learning Reward-Based Policies for Rapid Adaptation
summary: This paper explores a reward-based policy to achieve zero-shot transfer between source and target environments with completely different observation spaces. While humans can demonstrate impressive adaptation capabilities, deep neural network policies often struggle to adapt to a new environment and require a considerable amount of samples for successful transfer. Instead, we propose a novel reward-based policy only conditioned on rewards and actions, enabling zero-shot adaptation to new environments with completely different observations. We discuss the challenges and feasibility of a reward-based policy and then propose a practical algorithm for training. We demonstrate that a reward policy can be trained within three different environments, Pointmass, Cartpole, and 2D Car Racing, and transferred to completely different observations, such as different color palettes or 3D rendering, or Stretch robot navigation in Habitat-Sim, in a zero-shot manner. We also demonstrate that a reward-based policy can further guide the training of an observation-based policy in the target environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅以奖励和动作为条件的基于奖励的策略，实现源环境与目标环境（观测空间完全不同）之间的零样本迁移，并在多个环境中验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络策略在适应新环境时往往表现不佳，且需要大量样本才能成功迁移；而人类却能展现出强大的适应能力。现有策略通常依赖观测信息，导致在观测空间完全不同的环境中难以直接迁移。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的基于奖励的策略，仅以奖励和动作为条件，不依赖观测信息；讨论了该策略的挑战与可行性，并提出一种实用的训练算法。
AI.result: 在Pointmass、Cartpole和2D Car Racing三种环境中训练基于奖励的策略，并实现零样本迁移到观测完全不同的场景，如不同配色、3D渲染，或Habitat-Sim中的Stretch机器人导航；此外该策略还能进一步引导目标环境中基于观测的策略训练。
AI.conclusion: 基于奖励的策略能够实现跨完全不同观测空间的零样本迁移，并可辅助目标环境中观测策略的训练。

title: Lang3DSeg: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation with Point Transformers
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Accurate 3D semantic perception is critical for safe autonomous navigation. However, supervised LiDAR segmentation remains tied to closed taxonomies and to the cost of point-wise manual annotation. Open-vocabulary methods avoid that cost by projecting the output of 2D vision-language models onto LiDAR and distilling it into a 3D network. These methods rely almost exclusively on voxel-based sparse convolutions, and point transformers have so far been limited to indoor environments, where 3D data is dense and bounded. We present Lang3DSeg, which establishes a point transformer as the backbone for annotation-free open-vocabulary segmentation of outdoor 3D LiDAR, and is trained from scratch without geometric pre-training. This training paradigm necessitates addressing the inherent noise in 2D-to-3D label projections; specifically, naive projection often suffers from depth ambiguity, where points behind an object are erroneously assigned its semantic label. We therefore composite masks using an explicit class-priority rule and truncate each projected instance at the first gap in its depth distribution, correcting the projection error directly rather than averaging it over registered sequences. Lang3DSeg achieves 52.8% mIoU on nuScenes validation and 41.4% on SemanticKITTI, the highest among published annotation-free methods on both benchmarks. Every 3D semantic segmentation is on a single LiDAR sweep, and inference operates in real-time without running vision-language models.

AI.tldr: Lang3DSeg首次将点Transformer作为室外LiDAR无标注开放词汇3D语义分割的主干，通过显式类别优先掩码合成与深度分布首间隙截断修正2D到3D投影噪声，在nuScenes验证集达52.8% mIoU、SemanticKITTI达41.4%，均为已发表无标注方法中最高，且单帧推理实时。
AI.motivation: 室外LiDAR语义分割受限于封闭分类体系与逐点人工标注的高成本；现有开放词汇方法虽借助2D视觉语言模型蒸馏规避标注，但几乎只依赖体素稀疏卷积，点Transformer因室内数据稠密有界而局限于室内场景，室外场景缺乏适用方案。
AI.method: 以点Transformer为骨干，从零训练、不做几何预训练；针对2D到3D标签投影中因深度模糊导致物体后方点被误赋标签的噪声，采用显式类别优先级规则合成掩码，并在投射实例深度分布的首个间隙处截断实例，直接纠正投影误差而非在配准序列上做平均。
AI.result: nuScenes验证集mIoU 52.8%，SemanticKITTI 41.4%，均为已发表无标注方法中的最高水平；每次3D语义分割仅基于单次LiDAR扫描，推理实时且无需运行视觉语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 点Transformer可作为室外LiDAR无标注开放词汇分割的有效主干；直接修正投影误差的策略优于序列平均，方法在精度与实时性上兼具优势。

title: In CEM, a World Model Is Also a Proposal Mechanism
summary:
The cross-entropy method (CEM) uses world-model scores to select action sequences and fit the distribution sampled in its next iteration. A scoring error can therefore change both the present decision and the candidates considered later. We evaluate these two roles separately. Four types of predictive model generate CEM traces, and every model rescores every saved candidate pool. Executing the same candidates in the environment provides a reference elite set and proposal update.
  Across twelve independently trained task-seed units on Walker and Cheetah, the pre-specified proposal distance falls from the first to the final CEM iteration in every unit. Proposal widths contract and fitted means separate relative to the remaining search width. Pairwise ranking agreement stays near chance on Walker and declines on Cheetah; elite-set agreement does not improve. This comparison shows greater variation between scorers than between pool sources on Cheetah; Walker has variation in both and in their pairings. We use the original six units to select Random nonlinear for a one-update intervention, without inspecting intervention outcomes. Replacing its first model-ranked update with an environment-ranked update lowers final realised selected-sequence cost in those six units and in six further units held out from the selection.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分了CEM中预测模型的两种作用——当前决策选择与后续候选分布拟合，并通过四类模型、跨任务种子的实验发现选择信号（合意集）与提案收缩信号出现解离，说明仅凭提案收缩不能证明评分正确；用环境重排序替换首次模型排序更新可降低最终实现代价。
AI.motivation: CEM依赖世界模型评分来选取动作序列并拟合下一轮迭代的分布，因此评分误差会同时影响当前决策和后续候选集。作者希望把"评分用于当前选择"与"评分用于塑造未来提案分布"这两个角色拆开评估，检验常规指标（如提案收缩）是否真能反映决策正确性。
AI.method: 用四类预测模型生成CEM轨迹，每个模型对每个已保存候选池重新评分；同时在真实环境中执行相同候选以获得参考合意集与提案更新。在Walker与Cheetah上设置十二个独立训练的任务—种子单元，预注册提案距离指标，比较提案宽度、拟合均值分离度、成对排序一致性与合意集一致性；随后用前六个单元挑选Random nonlinear做单次更新干预（不看干预结果），将其首次模型排序更新替换为环境排序更新，并在另外六个留出单元上验证。
AI.result: 在全部十二个单元中，预注册的提案距离从首个到最终CEM迭代均下降，提案宽度收缩、拟合均值相对剩余搜索宽度分离。但成对排序一致性在Walker接近随机水平、在Cheetah上下降，合意集一致性无改善。Cheetah上评分者间差异大于候选池来源间差异，Walker上两者及其配对均存在差异。将Random nonlinear的首次模型排序更新替换为环境排序更新后，最终实现的选择序列代价在六个选择单元及六个留出单元上均降低。
AI.conclusion: 提案收缩、均值分离等分布层面的收敛信号并不能保证候选评分与真实价值一致，二者可以解离。区分CEM中评分的"选择"与"提案塑造"两种角色有助于更准确地诊断世界模型质量；用环境反馈校正首次更新可改善最终决策代价，且该效果可外推至留出单元。

title: FutureWorlds: Learning Robotic World Models from Alternative Futures
comment: 32 pages, including references and appendix. Code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds
summary: Robotic world models predict action-conditioned future scenes, providing a foundation for understanding action outcomes. However, turning alternative predictions into useful learning signals remains challenging: similar candidates limit informative quality comparisons, while diverging trajectories require persistent maintenance of their individual histories. We introduce FutureWorlds, a framework that unifies candidate construction, history maintenance, and learning from relative quality. Built on a multimodal discrete autoregressive model, FutureWorlds uses diverse beam search during reinforcement learning to construct candidate futures that balance confidence and diversity. Candidate-specific bounded memory preserves scene states and ensures that generation and policy scoring use matching histories. We further propose MemSPO (Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization), which converts video trajectory rewards into group-relative advantages to optimize the world model. On RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa, FutureWorlds reduces LPIPS for 32-frame predictions by 14.78%, 20.84%, and 9.12%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. Under fixed evaluation configurations, only 200 MemSPO updates further improve generation quality and support continued prediction beyond the training horizon. Memory ablations, decoding sensitivity analysis, and optical-flow evaluation show that these gains extend beyond visual quality to more accurate motion prediction and more consistent object states. Project page and code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds.

AI.tldr: 提出 FutureWorlds 框架，统一候选构造、历史维护与相对质量学习，并引入 MemSPO 优化机器人世界模型，在多数据集上显著降低 LPIPS 并提升长时程预测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人世界模型虽能预测动作条件下的未来场景，但将"替代预测"转化为有效学习信号仍面临两个难点：候选之间过于相似导致质量比较信息量不足；候选轨迹分叉后需持续维护各自的独立历史，否则生成与策略打分所用历史不匹配。
AI.method: FutureWorlds 基于多模态离散自回归模型构建：(1) 在强化学习过程中使用多样化束搜索（diverse beam search），构造兼顾置信度与多样性的候选未来；(2) 提出候选特定的有界记忆，保存各候选的场景状态，保证生成与策略评分使用匹配的历史；(3) 提出 MemSPO（Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization），将视频轨迹奖励转换为组内相对优势，用于优化世界模型。
AI.result: 在 RT-1、BridgeV2 和 RoboCasa 上，相对各数据集最强基线，32 帧预测的 LPIPS 分别下降 14.78%、20.84% 和 9.12%。在固定评测配置下，仅 200 次 MemSPO 更新即可进一步提升生成质量，并支持超出训练时域（horizon）的持续预测。记忆消融、解码敏感性分析与光流评测表明，增益不仅限于视觉质量，还体现为更准确的运动预测和更一致的对象状态。
AI.conclusion: 通过将候选构造、候选特定有界记忆与基于相对质量的策略优化统一到同一框架，FutureWorlds 有效解决了候选相似与分叉历史维护问题，显著提升机器人世界模型的预测质量、长时程外推能力与运动/状态一致性。

title: PhysicsLENS: Diagnosing Physical Property Blindness in Video Generation Models
summary: Reliable video world models could provide scalable predictive environments for robot learning, planning, and evaluation. However, generated robot videos can violate physical principles and complete tasks through physically implausible behavior, limiting their reliability for robot learning and planning. Current video-generation benchmarks exclude physics that are inherently hidden by visuals (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction). Due to this, video models are evaluated on the fidelity of physics, not the underlying accuracy of physics. We introduce PhysicsLENS, a dataset and benchmark for evaluating plausibility of physical properties grounded in robotics. PhysicsLENS uses matched scenario pairs that hold the same conditioning frame and task, while varying underlying physics in the scene description. Scenarios are curated from public robot video sources and annotated across seven physical domains: collision, gravity, momentum, friction, deformation, fluid, and causality. We evaluate across four video generation models, producing over 400 human-annotated labels. Results show that plausible-looking videos often ignore the stated property (34 of 47), and that stating the property lowers plausibility only slightly and not significantly.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PhysicsLENS数据集与基准，通过控制物理参数的配对场景评估视频世界模型的物理合理性，发现看似合理的生成视频常忽略指定物理属性。
AI.motivation: 可靠的视频世界模型可为机器人学习、规划与评估提供可扩展的预测环境，但生成的机器人视频常违背物理原理，通过物理上不可信的行为完成任务，限制其可靠性。现有视频生成基准排除了视觉上隐藏的物理属性（如重量、粘度、摩擦），导致模型仅被评估物理保真度（外观），而非底层物理准确性。
AI.method: 构建PhysicsLENS数据集与基准，采用配对场景设计：保持相同条件帧与任务，仅在场景描述中改变底层物理属性。场景采集自公开机器人视频源，并针对七个物理域（碰撞、重力、动量、摩擦、形变、流体、因果）进行标注。在四种视频生成模型上评估，收集超过400个人工标注标签。
AI.result: 看似合理的视频往往忽略所陈述的物理属性（47例中有34例），且明确陈述物理属性仅略微降低合理性，且该差异不显著。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频生成模型对视觉隐藏的物理属性建模不足，倾向于生成视觉上合理但物理上错误的视频，表明需要以底层物理准确性为目标的评估方法与模型改进方向。

title: Supervise What Decides Success: Criterion-Aligned Auxiliary Losses for Latent World-Model Planning
summary: Latent world models plan by scoring candidate action sequences with distances in latent space. However, task success is judged by physical quantities, which we call the success-criterion quantities. In all four latent world models we examine, the end-effector position is encoded in the latent state with an error larger than the success criterion allows. Such a latent state cannot separate successful candidates from failing ones. We propose an auxiliary loss that uses success-criterion quantities as training targets, whereas existing latent world models take them only as inputs. During training, a linear head on the encoder and predictor outputs regresses the success-criterion quantities, and the regression error is added to the training loss. The head is discarded after training, so the model, its cost, and its inputs at test time are unchanged. This loss alone improves the success rate on PushT and cube by 3.5% and 3.4% (absolute), respectively, and both improvements are statistically significant. A success criterion thus specifies what a world model must retain in its latent state, and we show that it can serve directly as a training target.

AI.tldr: 提出一种辅助损失，将成功判据物理量作为训练目标，使潜世界模型在潜状态中保留任务评判所需的关键物理信息，无需改变测试时的模型结构与开销，即可提升规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 潜世界模型通过在潜空间中对候选动作序列打分来规划，但任务成功与否实际由物理量（成功判据量）决定。作者考察的四个潜世界模型中，末端执行器位置的编码误差均大于成功判据所允许的范围，导致潜状态无法区分成功与失败的候选动作。现有模型仅把这些物理量当作输入，而没有要求潜状态对其进行准确编码。
AI.method: 在编码器和预测器输出上增加一个线性回归头，用以回归成功判据物理量，并将回归误差加入训练损失作为辅助损失。该线性头仅在训练时使用，训练结束后即丢弃，因此测试阶段的模型结构、计算代价和输入均保持不变。
AI.result: 该辅助损失单独使用即可在PushT和cube任务上分别将成功率提升3.5%和3.4%（绝对值），且两项提升均具有统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 成功判据实际上规定了世界模型必须在潜状态中保留什么信息，因此可以直接作为训练目标来监督潜表示学习，从而在不增加推理成本的前提下提升规划表现。

title: FedCKA: Representation-Guided Layer Personalization for Federated 3D Perception Across Driving Domains
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Robust perception in intelligent vehicles demands 3D object detectors that remain dependable under domain shifts, such as changes in time of day, location, or weather. However, due to costly annotation and rare shifts, some environments lack sufficient data to train a standalone detector. Federated learning offers a privacy-preserving framework for collaborative model training, enabling clients to benefit from shared learning across diverse environments. Yet, this framework traditionally relies on a single global consensus model, which struggles to perform across heterogeneous local data distributions. Local conditions are better captured by adapting a subset of the model, but many personalization approaches rely on predefined layer partitions or fixed personalization ratios, thereby limiting adaptation to client-specific divergence. To reduce this rigidity, we propose FedCKA, a Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA)-based strategy that dynamically handles the personalization-globalization trade-off. Specifically, FedCKA computes layer-wise feature similarities between local client models and the global consensus model during training. By converting layer-wise similarity scores into client-specific aggregation masks, FedCKA selectively shares representation-consistent layers. Evaluation on a unified multi-domain benchmark based on nuScenes shows that FedCKA outperforms established federated baselines, including FedBN, FedRep, and FedSelect, improving average NDS by 7 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The findings offer both a comparative benchmark and a promising direction for robust federated 3D perception across shifts in location, weather, and illumination. Code is available at https://github.com/j-verhoog/FedCKA.

AI.tldr: 提出FedCKA，基于CKA层间特征相似度动态生成客户端个性化聚合掩码，在nuScenes多域基准上平均NDS较最强基线提升7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 智能车辆3D目标检测需在时间、地点、天气等域偏移下保持鲁棒，但部分环境因标注昂贵、偏移样本稀少而数据不足，难以独立训练检测器。联邦学习可隐私保护地协作训练，但传统单一全局共识模型难以适配异构本地分布；现有个性化方法依赖预定义层划分或固定个性化比例，灵活性受限。
AI.method: FedCKA：训练中计算各客户端本地模型与全局共识模型的逐层特征相似度（CKA），将逐层相似度得分转换为客户端特定的聚合掩码，从而选择性共享表示一致的层，实现个性化与全局化的动态权衡。
AI.result: 在基于nuScenes构建的统一多域基准上，FedCKA优于FedBN、FedRep、FedSelect等联邦基线，平均NDS较最强基线提升7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了跨地点、天气与光照偏移的联邦3D感知对比基准与稳健方向，代码已开源。

title: 3DROID: A Renderable 3D Gaussian Dataset with Measured Per-Scene Reliability
summary: Robot manipulation models primarily reason from 2D observations while acting in the 3D physical world. To bridge this gap, recent work has augmented robot data with geometric priors such as depth, point clouds, and 3D trajectories, while renderable 3D Gaussian representations provide another promising form of 3D supervision. However, 3DGS representation is designed mainly for photometric fidelity and may not preserve real-world metric scale, particularly when the supplied camera extrinsics are unreliable. We study the effect of extrinsic reliability and pose conditioning on feed-forward 3DGS, and propose a calibration-aware pipeline that anchors reconstructed scenes to the robot's metric workspace. Our experiments show that pose conditioning improves novel-view fidelity, while its geometric benefit depends on the reliability of the injected extrinsics. Using this pipeline, we present a renderable, metric-pose-anchored dataset with scene-level reliability information for robot manipulation research. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/wonguen/3DROID

AI.tldr: 提出校准感知的前馈3DGS流程,将重建场景锚定至机器人度量工作空间,并发布带可靠性信息的可渲染数据集3DROID。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作模型主要基于2D观测进行推理,却需在3D物理世界中行动。现有工作引入深度、点云、3D轨迹等几何先验,3D高斯(3DGS)作为可渲染的3D监督形式亦具潜力,但其设计偏重光度保真,在相机外参不可靠时难以保持真实世界的度量尺度。
AI.method: 研究外参可靠性与位姿条件对前馈3DGS的影响,提出校准感知(calibration-aware)流程,将重建场景锚定到机器人度量工作空间,并引入场景级可靠性信息。
AI.result: 实验表明位姿条件提升新视角保真度,其几何收益取决于所注入外参的可靠性;基于该流程构建了可渲染、度量位姿锚定且含场景级可靠性信息的数据集(https://huggingface.co/datasets/wonguen/3DROID)。
AI.conclusion: 外参可靠性是3DGS用于机器人操作的关键因素,校准感知流程可实现度量尺度锚定,所发布数据集为机器人操作研究提供可靠的3D监督资源。

title: Continuous Conditioning of VLAs with Augmenting EMG and Visual Task Descriptors
comment: Presented at IROS WORLDS Workshop 2026. Four main pages double-column format plus references and appendices
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely strongly on language for describing task information, despite having multimodal inputs. We hypothesize that other modalities in the state space may present opportunities for supplemental task conditioning, which may be particularly relevant in cluttered or otherwise ambiguous scenes. We introduce two tuned models to test this hypothesis: (1) an electrophysiology-conditioned VLA (EC-VLA) that incorporates 8-channel electromyography envelopes as continuous conditioning input concatenated to the proprioceptive vector, and (2) a visually-annotated VLA (VA-VLA) that incorporates visual segmentation annotations to the image inputs. On a cube-selection task evaluated across three participants, EC-VLA matches a language-prompted baseline in uncluttered, in-distribution conditions and substantially outperforms it in cluttered, out-of-distribution scenes. Similarly, VA-VLA shows modest improvements over a language-prompted baseline in in-distribution scenes with substantial improvement in cluttered, out-of-distribution trials. Together, these results provide strong evidence for the potential benefit of task-conditioning beyond language.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证了两种超越语言的任务条件化VLA模型（EC-VLA与VA-VLA），在杂乱、分布外场景中显著优于语言提示基线。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽为多模态输入，却严重依赖语言描述任务信息；作者假设状态空间中的其他模态（如生理信号、视觉标注）可提供补充性任务条件，在杂乱或语义模糊场景中尤为重要。
AI.method: 设计两个调优模型：(1) EC-VLA，将8通道肌电包络作为连续条件输入，拼接至本体感受向量；(2) VA-VLA，将视觉分割标注加入图像输入。在涉及三名被试的方块选择任务上评估。
AI.result: EC-VLA在无杂乱、分布内条件下与语言提示基线持平，在杂乱、分布外场景中大幅超越基线；VA-VLA在分布内场景较基线有小幅提升，在杂乱、分布外试验中提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 结果有力支持了语言之外任务条件化（如肌电信号、视觉标注）的潜在价值，为多模态任务条件化VLA提供了实证依据。

title: LiteReality-Agent: An Agentic System for Interactable 3D Indoor Scene Reconstruction
summary: We present LiteReality-Agent, an agentic system for reconstructing real indoor environments as realistic, articulated, and simulation-ready 3D scenes from RGB-D scans. At its core, LiteReality-Agent formulates 3D reconstruction as a coding problem, in which a coding agent gathers evidence using specialised tools and iteratively edits a Python script, Room.py, which can be executed to produce a 3D digital twin of the room. With this formulation, we develop a robust observe-edit-verify harness that supports evidence gathering, measurement, verification, layout optimisation, simulation readiness, and quality control throughout the reconstruction process. LiteReality-Agent produces high-quality reconstructions suitable for simulation and downstream embodied AI tasks. Furthermore, as agent capabilities continue to improve rapidly, the system introduced by LiteReality-Agent remains a strong orchestration framework for future agents: it equips them with specialised tools, structured workflows, and robust verification mechanisms that substantially improve reconstruction quality and reliability. We demonstrate that LiteReality-Agent produces reconstructions that are more geometrically accurate, visually realistic, and simulation-compatible than those generated by recent frontier models, such as Astra and Fable. We therefore view LiteReality-Agent as a practical and important building block for robust real-to-sim systems. Both the source code and the data-capture application are publicly available. Code:https://github.com/LiteReality/LiteReality-Agent/

AI.tldr: LiteReality-Agent 将室内 3D 重建建模为编码任务，通过编码智能体迭代编辑可执行的 Room.py 脚本，产出真实、可铰接、可仿真的 3D 场景，质量优于 Astra、Fable 等前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 从 RGB-D 扫描重建真实室内环境需要兼具几何精度、视觉真实感与仿真兼容性，而现有前沿模型（如 Astra、Fable）在此类任务上仍存在不足，缺乏可靠的工具化流程与验证机制。
AI.method: 将 3D 重建形式化为编码问题：编码智能体借助专用工具收集证据，并迭代编辑可执行的 Python 脚本 Room.py 以生成房间数字孪生；设计了 observe-edit-verify 框架，涵盖证据收集、测量、验证、布局优化、仿真就绪与质量控制。
AI.result: 生成的 3D 重建在几何精度、视觉真实感和仿真兼容性方面均优于 Astra 和 Fable 等近期前沿模型，且适配下游具身 AI 任务。
AI.conclusion: LiteReality-Agent 是构建稳健 real-to-sim 系统的实用且重要组件；其框架具备可持续性，能作为未来智能体的强有力编排框架。源代码与数据采集应用已公开。

title: CLoSeR: Closing the Loop for Long-Context Streaming Reconstruction
comment: Authors contributed equally to this work. Author order is interchangeable
summary: Feedforward foundation models have recently shown remarkable 3D reconstruction capabilities. However, existing models exhibit large tracking drift in long-context streaming reconstruction due to error accumulation. In this paper, we revisit loop closure with streaming reconstruction foundation models to enable accurate, drift-free, kilometer-scale reconstruction. Specifically, our method detects loop candidates through global descriptor retrieval, and constructs loop-conditioned windows to estimate the relative poses between looped frames. Given the observation that our adopted streaming reconstruction backbone produces a globally consistent scale, we optimize all frame poses on the SE(3) manifold with sequential and loop closure constraints, avoiding the pose graph optimization on the Sim(3) or higher-dimensional SL(4) manifolds employed in prior works. Extensive experiments show that our method reduces drift and produces consistent geometry on kilometer-scale sequences, significantly outperforming the state of the art. Code is available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/CLoSeR.git.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CLoSeR，将回环闭合引入流式重建基础模型，在SE(3)流形上优化位姿以消除漂移，实现公里级无漂移三维重建。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈基础模型虽具备强3D重建能力，但在长序列流式重建中因误差累积导致严重的跟踪漂移。
AI.method: 采用全局描述子检索检测回环候选，构建回环条件窗口估计回环帧间相对位姿；鉴于骨干网络输出全局一致尺度，直接在SE(3)流形上以序列约束和回环约束联合优化所有帧位姿，避开此前在Sim(3)或SL(4)流形上的位姿图优化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在公里级序列上显著降低漂移并产生一致的几何结构，性能大幅超越现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过回环闭合与SE(3)位姿优化，可在流式重建基础模型上实现准确、无漂移的公里级重建。

title: FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization
summary: Several state-of-the-art methods for online reinforcement learning in continuous control improve policies using action gradients of a learned critic. However, critics are typically trained to predict returns, and accurate value predictions do not necessarily yield accurate action derivatives, potentially leading to unreliable policy updates. We propose Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization (FERPO), an on-policy maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm that performs policy improvement using critic values without differentiating the critic with respect to actions. FERPO derives an optimal target action distribution from a policy-improvement objective regularized by entropy and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. We then fit the actor to this target by minimizing a forward-KL objective, estimated using self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS) with actions drawn from the rollout policy. By limiting the target distribution's deviation from the rollout policy, the KL regularization helps keep these importance weights well behaved. In contrast to reverse-KL objectives, which can favor a subset of the target distribution's modes, the forward-KL objective encourages coverage of multiple high-value modes and thereby promotes exploration. Experiments and ablations on MuJoCo Playground and ManiSkill show competitive performance and sample-efficiency gains. Computational benchmarks also demonstrate faster actor updates than Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization (REPPO).

AI.tldr: 提出FERPO算法，一种最大熵在线强化学习方，用critic值（而非其动作梯度）做策略改进，通过前向KL目标拟合最优动作分布，性能与样本效率优于基线，且actor更新更快。
AI.motivation: 现有连续控制在线RL方法多依赖critic的动作梯度改进策略，但critic通常以预测回报为目标训练，准确的值预测并不保证准确的动作导数，可能导致策略更新不可靠。
AI.method: FERPO为on-policy最大熵RL算法：由带熵与KL散度正则的策略改进目标推导最优目标动作分布；用自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）并以rollout策略采样的动作估计前向KL目标来拟合actor。对目标分布相对rollout策略的偏离进行KL正则，使重要性权重保持良好行为。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo Playground与ManiSkill上，实验与消融显示具备竞争力的性能与样本效率提升；计算基准表明actor更新快于REPPO。
AI.conclusion: FERPO无需对critic关于动作求导即可改进策略；相比反向KL（易偏向目标分布部分模态），前向KL鼓励覆盖多个高价值模态、促进探索，是有效且高效的在线RL方案。

title: Emergent Object Binding Has a Finite Spatial Horizon
summary: Pretrained Vision Transformers encode whether two image patches belong to the same object. This IsSameObject signal is decodable from frozen patch embeddings at high accuracy, which suggests that object binding emerges from self-supervised pretraining alone. We show that this single accuracy number hides the structure of the signal. Binding is local: the probability that two patches of the same object are decoded as bound falls off monotonically with the distance between them and levels off at a nonzero floor, a falloff well described by an exponential with a finite length scale. This decay holds across object sizes, across three families of probe, on both ADE20K and COCO, and across DINO and CLIP backbones, which indicates that it is a property of the representation rather than of the decoder. Reading binding as local spatial coherence with a finite range accounts for a set of behaviors that the aggregate score leaves unexplained: binding weakens on large objects, separates distinct objects of the same class less reliably than objects of different classes, and groups object parts with their wholes. It is, by contrast, unaffected by occlusion once object size is controlled. We map each behavior with confounds controlled. As a preliminary observation, the horizon and its floor are organized at different depths in DINOv2 and DINOv3, which we report as suggestive given the small number of layers probed and the confound between the two models.

AI.tldr: 预训练ViT的冻结patch嵌入中可解码出IsSameObject信号，但该聚合准确率掩盖了信号结构：绑定是局部的，概率随patch间距单调指数衰减并趋于非零下限。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明自监督预训练本身就能涌现出物体绑定（object binding）信号，即从冻结的ViT patch嵌入中可高精度解码"两个patch是否属于同一物体"。但作者指出，单一准确率数值掩盖了该信号的空间结构，因此需要剖析其性质，判断这是表征本身的属性还是解码器的产物。
AI.method: 跨多种设置系统探测绑定信号的空间结构：改变物体尺寸；使用三族不同探针（probe）；在ADE20K与COCO两个数据集上验证；跨DINO与CLIP骨干网络比较；用指数模型拟合衰减曲线并提取长度尺度与下限；在控制混淆因素（如物体尺寸）的前提下逐一映射各项行为，包括遮挡效应；并考察DINOv2与DINOv3中horizon与floor在不同深度的组织方式。
AI.result: 绑定具有局部性：同物体两patch被解码为绑定的概率随间距单调下降，并稳定在一个非零下限，衰减可由带有限长度尺度的指数函数良好描述。该衰减规律跨物体尺寸、跨三族探针、跨ADE20K与COCO、跨DINO与CLIP骨干均成立，说明是表征属性而非解码器属性。以"有限范围的局部空间连贯性"解释绑定，可说明聚合分数无法解释的现象：大物体上绑定减弱；同类不同物体的区分比异类物体更不可靠；物体部件倾向于与其整体归为一组。在控制物体尺寸后，遮挡对绑定无影响。此外初步观察到horizon与floor在DINOv2与DINOv3中组织于不同深度，但作者因探测层数少且两模型间存在混淆而仅作提示性报告。
AI.conclusion: IsSameObject并非一个均质的全局信号，而是具有有限空间范围的局部连贯性；这一视角统一解释了多项行为，并揭示了自监督预训练表征中物体绑定的空间结构与深度组织特征。

title: Spatial Lifting for Dense Prediction
summary: We present Spatial Lifting (SL), a novel methodology for dense prediction tasks. SL operates by lifting standard inputs, such as 2D images, into a higher-dimensional space and subsequently processing them using networks designed for that higher dimension, such as a 3D U-Net. Counterintuitively, this dimensionality lifting allows us to achieve good performance on benchmark tasks compared to conventional approaches, while reducing inference costs and \textbf{drastically lowering the number of model parameters}. The SL framework produces intrinsically structured outputs along the lifted dimension. This emergent structure facilitates dense supervision during training and enables single-forward-pass self-consistency-based quality and uncertainty estimation at test time. Spatial Lifting introduces a simple and general modeling strategy that offers a promising path toward more efficient, accurate, and reliable deep networks for dense prediction tasks in vision.

AI.tldr: 提出空间提升（SL）方法，将2D图像提升到高维空间后用高维网络（如3D U-Net）处理，在密集预测任务上提升性能的同时大幅减少参数与推理成本，并实现结构化输出、自一致性质量与不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 常规密集预测方法通常直接在原始2D空间处理图像，模型参数多、推理成本高，且缺乏内在的结构化监督与可靠的质量/不确定性评估机制。作者希望探索一种能兼顾性能、效率与可靠性的通用建模范式。
AI.method: SL将标准2D输入提升到更高维空间，再用为该高维空间设计的网络（如3D U-Net）进行处理。该提升使输出沿提升维度具有内在结构化特征，从而支持训练时的密集监督，并在测试时通过单次前向传播实现基于自一致性的质量与不确定性估计。
AI.result: 在基准任务上，SL相较传统方法取得了良好性能，同时降低了推理成本，并大幅减少模型参数量；输出沿提升维度呈现涌现结构，可用于密集监督与自一致性质量/不确定性估计。
AI.conclusion: 空间提升是一种简单通用的建模策略，为视觉密集预测任务提供了更高效、更准确、更可靠深度网络的有前景路径。

title: Encoded but Disconnected: Decomposing Vision-Language Model Failures under a Patching Null
summary: Across three vision-language model architectures (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B), we report a universal negative finding for mid-layer interpretability. On POPE -- the benchmark common to all three -- the mid layers encode the ground-truth answer in 68-91% of errors, yet this signal is not causally active for the final prediction: residual-stream patching yields 0% non-trivial flip at the layer level on all three architectures, and on two of three at the per-head level (Qwen: 0/12,600 patched forwards). The lone exception, InternVL3 layer-20 head-2, is a non-vocab, self-attending head whose effect is localized to that specific head (p < 1e-4). Despite the null, the errors separate operationally into three failure modes -- Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, Prior-Override -- learnable above 60% on all three architectures, and the architecture's prior direction predicts which of two interventions elicits a category-specific response. We report these mitigation effects under oracle labels as evidence the categories are mechanistically real, not as a deployable method.

AI.tldr: 在三种视觉语言模型上发现中层"答案已编码但因果失活"的普遍负向现象，并将错误操作性划分为三种可学习的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 检验中层表征的可解释性是否具有因果效力，即中间层编码的正确答案信号是否真正驱动最终预测，从而判断中层探针结果能否作为干预依据。
AI.method: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B上进行残差流与逐注意力头（per-head）的activation patching，结合POPE基准的错误分析与失效模式分类学习。
AI.result: POPE上中层在68-91%的错误中编码真值答案，但因果干预无效：层级别patching三种架构均为0%非平凡翻转，逐头级别三种中两种也为0%（Qwen为0/12,600）。唯一例外InternVL3第20层第2头为非词表自注意力头，效应局部化（p<1e-4）。错误可分为感知失败、编码但失联、先验覆盖三类，三架构均可达60%以上可学习性，且架构先验方向可预测两种干预中哪一个产生类别特异响应。
AI.conclusion: 中层答案信号普遍存在但非因果激活，说明该类可解释性信号不宜直接用于干预；错误分类具备机制真实性，但缓解效果仅在oracle标签下报告，不作为可部署方法。

title: Domain generalization and synthetic data in object detection: the enabler, the probe, and the gap
summary: Object detection models often experience performance degradation when deployed under distribution shifts, caused by for example changes in weather type, operational environment, or object appearance. Domain Generalization (DG) aims to develop models that remain robust under such shifts and generalize well to unseen domains. DG research specifically focused on object detection models is scarce, although these models face additional challenges around localization and multi-scale representations. Synthetic data is a promising tool to support in DG, by enabling large-scale generation of diverse new samples. In this paper, we present an object detection-centric review of DG and examine the role of synthetic data from three complementary perspectives. First, synthetic data acts as an enabler of DG through diversification and alignment strategies that aim to improve robustness to distribution shifts. Second, it serves as a probe that enables controlled experimentation to identify and understand failure modes. Third, we discuss the synthetic-to-real gap, a particularly challenging form of domain shift that arises when models trained on synthetic imagery are deployed on real-world data. Through reviewing these perspectives, we identify limitations of current DG approaches for object detection and argue that future research requires representation-aware methods that explicitly address both localization and classification under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 本文以目标检测为中心综述域泛化(DG)研究，从合成数据作为赋能者、探针以及合成-真实域差三个视角，探讨合成数据在DG中的作用，并指出未来需发展显式处理定位与分类的表示感知方法。
AI.motivation: 目标检测模型在部署于分布偏移场景（如天气、环境、目标外观变化）时性能会下降；域泛化旨在使模型对未见域保持鲁棒，但针对目标检测的DG研究稀缺，且该类模型还面临定位与多尺度表示的额外挑战。合成数据可大规模生成多样样本，有望支持DG研究，因此有必要系统梳理并明确现有方法的局限。
AI.method: 本文是一篇以目标检测为中心的域泛化综述，从三个互补视角分析合成数据的作用：1) 作为DG的赋能者，通过多样化与对齐策略提升对分布偏移的鲁棒性；2) 作为探针，支持受控实验以识别和理解失败模式；3) 讨论合成-真实域差这一域偏移的挑战形式，即模型在合成图像上训练后部署到真实数据时的问题。基于上述视角，作者识别现有DG方法在目标检测上的局限。
AI.result: 通过综述分析，作者指出当前针对目标检测的域泛化方法存在局限，且合成数据在赋能、诊断与揭示合成-真实域差方面具有重要作用，但合成-真实域差仍是特别具挑战性的域偏移形式。
AI.conclusion: 面向目标检测的域泛化未来研究需要发展表示感知(representation-aware)的方法，显式地在域偏移下同时处理定位与分类问题。

title: Seeing the City or Recognizing the Place? What Street-View Imagery Adds Beyond Existing Urban Data in VLM Urban Sensing
summary: Street-view imagery is increasingly used to infer urban attributes, but predictive accuracy alone does not reveal how much a photograph contributes beyond data already available for the same place. We compare image-based predictions with existing urban data across seven attributes from five public resources and three VLMs. The same urban units are evaluated using images, task context, nearby observations, and public records, while image replacements and conflicting records test source reliance. Existing urban data matched or exceeded image-only models for road damage, curb ramps, and house price, while neighbouring official statistics nearly matched the best image result for population. Images were more informative for building type, building function, and low-rise floor count. For floor count, image advantage increased by 5.7 percentage points per doubling of distance to the nearest labelled building and declined for tall buildings whose rooflines often fell outside the frame. Models frequently followed conflicting records. OpenFACADES floor annotations were generated with OpenStreetMap floor values and showed the opposite height-dependent error pattern from image-only reruns. Street-view image value therefore depends on visual legibility and local data coverage. Comparing images with existing urban data can guide image collection and clarify the provenance of derived urban maps.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较街景图像预测与既有城市数据在七类城市属性上的信息贡献，发现图像价值取决于视觉可辨识度与本地数据覆盖度。
AI.motivation: 街景图像被广泛用于推断城市属性，但仅凭预测精度无法说明图像相对于同一地点既有数据究竟带来了多少额外信息，因此需要将图像预测与既有城市数据进行对比。
AI.method: 在五个公共资源和三个视觉语言模型（VLM）上比较七类属性的图像预测与既有城市数据。对相同城市单元分别使用图像、任务上下文、邻近观测和公共记录进行评估，并通过图像替换与冲突记录测试模型对数据源的依赖。
AI.result: 既有城市数据在道路损坏、路缘坡道和房价上达到或超过纯图像模型，邻近官方统计在人口上接近最佳图像结果；图像在建筑类型、建筑功能和低层楼层数上更具信息量。楼层数方面，距最近标注建筑距离每翻倍，图像优势增加5.7个百分点，而对屋檐常出画的高层建筑优势下降。模型常跟随冲突记录。OpenFACADES楼层标注由OpenStreetMap楼层值生成，呈现与纯图像重跑相反的高度依赖误差模式。
AI.conclusion: 街景图像的价值取决于视觉可辨识度和本地数据覆盖度；将图像与既有城市数据比较可指导图像采集，并厘清派生城市地图的数据来源。

title: DSSR-3D: Decoupled Reasoning for View-Dependent Referring in 3D Gaussians
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have enabled open-vocabulary and referring segmentation by distilling semantic knowledge from 2D foundation models into 3D representations. However, existing referring fields embed language features in a globally view-invariant space, making them fundamentally unable to resolve observer-centric spatial relations (e.g., "to the left of") that depend on camera pose. We propose DSSR-3D, an inference-time framework for view-dependent referring segmentation on continuous 3D Gaussian fields, formalized as two interfaces - pose-invariant semantic localization and pose-conditioned spatial reasoning - such that any pair of functions satisfying these constraints yields a valid instantiation, requiring no retraining of the underlying semantic field and no reliance on discrete geometric proxies such as bounding boxes. We instantiate the two interfaces with a temperature-sharpened softmax localization mechanism and a projection-based directional scoring function, fused via a lightweight, training-free step, and show they transfer zero-shot to structurally distinct semantic fields without adaptation. We further propose ViewRef-GS, a benchmark isolating view-dependent segmentation on 3D Gaussian fields, evaluated jointly with an augmented Ref-LERF to provide a comprehensive testbed for viewpoint-dependent spatial grounding. Experiments show consistent gains over existing 3DGS-based referring methods, with no additional training beyond the base semantic field

AI.tldr: 提出DSSR-3D推理时框架，在3D高斯场实现视角依赖的指代分割，并构建ViewRef-GS基准，无需重训练即取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有指代场将语言特征嵌入全局视角不变空间，无法处理"左侧"等依赖相机位姿的观察者中心空间关系。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为两个接口：位姿不变语义定位与位姿条件空间推理；用温度锐化softmax定位机制与基于投影的方向评分函数实例化，通过轻量、免训练步骤融合，并可零样本迁移至不同语义场。同时提出ViewRef-GS基准及增强的Ref-LERF。
AI.result: 构建了视角依赖空间grounding的综合测试平台；实验在现有3DGS指代方法上取得一致增益，除基础语义场外无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: DSSR-3D以接口化、免重训练方式实现视角依赖指代分割，并验证其零样本迁移性与有效性。

title: Reachability Is Not Generalization: Understanding Verb--Noun Decomposition in Assembly Action Recognition
summary: Assembly actions are compositional: they combine a manipulation with a part or tool. In deployment, systems routinely encounter novel combinations of familiar components, yet an atomic action classifier assigns every unseen combination exactly zero probability by construction. The prevailing solution is verb--noun decomposition, which predicts components separately and recombines them to reach unseen actions. While widely adopted, how decomposition generalizes under compositional shift remains poorly understood. We present a systematic analysis of verb--noun decomposition across three assembly datasets (MECCANO, HAViD, and IMPACT). Although decomposition escapes the atomic ceiling, its generalization extends only partially beyond it. Unseen-composition performance remains strongly tied to the co-occurrence structure of the training data, indicating that much of the observed gain arises from interpolation within densely supported regions of the compositional space rather than from unconstrained recombination. Across datasets, failures consistently concentrate on the larger-vocabulary component, and IMPACT's verb-heavy vocabulary reverses the bottleneck from nouns to verbs. We further show that shared-encoder training introduces component entanglement, encouraging reliance on co-occurrence patterns that transfer poorly to unseen compositions and trailing independent recombination by up to $6.0\times$ in harmonic mean. Taken together, these findings explain why decomposition achieves only partial compositional generalization in practice. By identifying primitive support, vocabulary asymmetry, and component entanglement as connected sources of error, we provide a portable diagnostic framework for studying compositional recognition beyond aggregate accuracy. Code: https://github.com/hisalaheiyo/assembly.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统分析了装配动作识别中动词-名词分解在组合偏移下的泛化能力，发现其仅能部分突破原子分类器的组合上限。
AI.motivation: 装配动作具有组合性，部署中系统常遇到熟悉组件的新组合，但原子动作分类器对未见组合赋予零概率。主流的动词-名词分解虽被广泛采用，其在组合偏移下的泛化机制仍缺乏理解。
AI.method: 在MECCANO、HAViD和IMPACT三个装配数据集上对动词-名词分解进行系统性分析，考察其泛化行为、训练数据共现结构依赖、组件词表不对称以及共享编码器带来的组件纠缠现象。
AI.result: 分解虽突破原子上限，但泛化仅部分超越；未见组合性能强依赖训练数据共现结构，收益多来自稠密支持区域的插值。失败集中在词表更大的组件上，IMPACT的动词重词表使瓶颈由名词转向动词。共享编码器训练引入组件纠缠，调和平均落后独立重组达6.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 分解在实践中仅实现部分组合泛化。论文识别出原始支持、词表不对称与组件纠缠三个相互关联的误差来源，提供了超越聚合准确率的可移植诊断框架。

title: Robust Online Aero-Engine Blade Defect Detection via Dual-Alignment Test-Time Adaptation
comment: This manuscript is Accepted at conference PRCV 2026
summary: Reliable visual inspection is essential for quality assurance in aero-engine blade manufacturing, where defect appearance may vary across production lines, imaging conditions, blade poses, and surface backgrounds. Such domain shifts cause a mismatch between training and deployment data and degrade the reliability of deep defect detectors in online inspection. This problem is particularly challenging because aero-engine blade images usually contain sparse defects, making pseudolabel-based adaptation vulnerable to noisy or missing predictions. To address this issue, we propose Aero-engine Blade Defect Detector (ABDD), an online adaptive detection framework based on test-time adaptation. ABDD introduces a Dual-Alignment Strategy to jointly adapt global visual style and local defect morphology by combining feature-statistics alignment with pseudo-box alignment. To reduce error accumulation from unreliable pseudo labels, an Uncertainty-aware Box Filtering mechanism evaluates pseudo boxes using classification confidence, classification entropy, and localization entropy. In addition, a lightweight Sparse Dilated Mona module enables parameter-efficient delta tuning while limiting source-domain forgetting. ABDD is evaluated on CD-AeBD and HD-AeBD under multiple domain-shift scenarios, with TTA strategies compared under a unified RT-DETR + Swin-T architecture. Experiments show that ABDD consistently improves detection robustness under domain shifts, and its practicality is further validated on an industrial inspection platform.

AI.tldr: 提出面向航空发动机叶片缺陷检测的在线自适应框架ABDD，基于测试时自适应，通过双对齐策略、不确定性感知框过滤与轻量稀疏膨胀模块，在多种域偏移场景下提升检测鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 航空发动机叶片制造中的可靠视觉检测对质量保证至关重要，但缺陷外观会随产线、成像条件、叶片姿态和表面背景变化产生域偏移，导致训练与部署数据不匹配，降低深度缺陷检测器在线检测的可靠性。该问题尤具挑战性，因为叶片图像缺陷稀疏，使基于伪标签的自适应易受噪声或缺失预测影响。
AI.method: 提出ABDD在线自适应检测框架，基于测试时自适应（TTA）。核心包括：Dual-Alignment Strategy，结合特征统计对齐与伪框对齐，联合适配全局视觉风格和局部缺陷形态；Uncertainty-aware Box Filtering机制，利用分类置信度、分类熵和定位熵评估伪框，以降低不可靠伪标签导致的误差累积；轻量级Sparse Dilated Mona模块，实现参数高效的增量微调并限制源域遗忘。
AI.result: 在CD-AeBD和HD-AeBD数据集、多种域偏移场景下评估，并在统一的RT-DETR + Swin-T架构下比较TTA策略。实验表明ABDD在域偏移下持续提升检测鲁棒性，并在工业检测平台上进一步验证了实用性。
AI.conclusion: ABDD通过双对齐、不确定性感知伪框过滤与参数高效微调，有效缓解稀疏缺陷下的域偏移问题，提升航空发动机叶片在线缺陷检测的可靠性与工程实用性。

title: A Framework for Egocentric and Exocentric Procedural Understanding via Temporal Segmentation and Semantic Abstraction
comment: Accepted for oral and poster presentation at the ACVR Workshop, ECCV 2026. Non-archival abstract; not published in the workshop proceedings. 8 pages, 1 figure
summary: Long-horizon ego/exo data contains rich procedural evidence, but are redundant, noisy, and costly to process or retain. We propose a compact framework that converts continuous multimodal workplace video into a structured Procedural State Memory, implemented as a Work Environment Model (WEM). Inspired by event segmentation theory, we detect boundaries using changes in visual context, location, motion, narration, gaze/object interaction, and optional exocentric workspace evidence, rather than fixed windows or visual novelty alone. Each segment is abstracted into an evidence-linked event card containing actor, interval, location, action, objects/tools, pre/post state, confidence, and provenance. These event cards incrementally update the WEM, enabling compact, auditable documentation and retrieval under on-premise privacy constraints. We instantiate the design with frozen DINOv2 and VJEPA-2 encoders and a local language model, and outline evaluation criteria for segmentation quality, memory compression, retrieval fidelity, and long-horizon QA.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种紧凑框架，将连续多模态工作场所视频转化为结构化的程序状态记忆（WEM，工作环境模型），通过事件分割与事件卡片实现可审计的紧凑文档化与检索。
AI.motivation: 长时段自我/外部视角数据蕴含丰富的程序性证据，但存在冗余、噪声大、处理与存储成本高的问题；现有基于固定窗口或单纯视觉新颖性的分割方式不足以捕捉真实工作流程的结构。同时，在本地部署与隐私约束下需要紧凑、可审计的记忆表示。
AI.method: 受事件分割理论启发，通过视觉上下文、位置、运动、叙述、注视/物体交互以及可选的外部视角工作空间证据的变化来检测事件边界，而非固定窗口或单一视觉新颖性。每个片段被抽象为一条证据链接的事件卡片，包含动作主体、时间区间、位置、动作、物体/工具、前/后状态、置信度和来源溯源。事件卡片增量更新工作环境模型（WEM），从而在本地隐私约束下实现紧凑、可审计的文档化与检索。实现上采用冻结的 DINOv2 与 VJEPA-2 编码器及本地语言模型，并给出了分割质量、记忆压缩、检索保真度与长时问答的评估标准。
AI.result: 论文为设计性/框架性工作，实例化了编码器与本地模型组合，并提出了针对分割质量、记忆压缩、检索保真度和长时问答的评估标准，未报告具体实验数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可将长时段多模态工作视频压缩为结构化、证据可溯的程序状态记忆，支持在本地隐私约束下的紧凑、可审计文档化与检索，为长时程序理解与问答提供了可评估的设计基线。

title: DramaAgent: Agentic Storytelling Video Generation
summary: Recent diffusion and autoregressive models have substantially improved text-to-video generation, yet producing coherent long-form story videos with consistent characters and aligned audio remains challenging. Existing methods often suffer from narrative drift, unstable character identity, weak cross-scene continuity, and audio-visual mismatch over extended sequences. We propose DramaAgent, a hierarchical, agentic, and model-agnostic framework for long-form text-to-video-and-audio generation. Rather than improving the underlying video backbone itself, DramaAgent introduces an upper-level control layer that decomposes generation into story planning, persistent character conditioning, scene-wise synthesis, and reflection-guided targeted repair. The framework maintains reusable story and character states across scenes, diagnoses failures such as identity drift, missing scene semantics, temporal discontinuity, and cross-modal mismatch, and repairs problematic clips in a stage-specific manner. Experiments across multiple video generation backbones show that DramaAgent improves long-horizon coherence, character consistency, narrative fidelity, and scene-level audio-visual consistency over direct generation and strong baselines. These results suggest that hierarchical agentic control is a practical direction for controllable long-form audiovisual generation. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DramaAgent. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DramaAgent.

AI.tldr: DramaAgent 是一个分层、智能体化、模型无关的框架，用于长视频文本到视频-音频生成，通过引入上层控制层解决叙事漂移、角色不一致、跨场景连贯性弱和音画不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管扩散模型和自回归模型显著提升了文本到视频生成能力，但生成长篇故事视频仍面临叙事漂移、角色身份不稳定、跨场景连续性弱以及音画不匹配等挑战。
AI.method: DramaAgent 不改进底层视频骨干，而是引入上层控制层，将生成分解为故事规划、持久角色条件、逐场景合成和反思引导的定向修复，跨场景维护可复用的故事与角色状态，诊断身份漂移、场景语义缺失、时间不连续和跨模态不匹配等失败并进行分阶段修复。
AI.result: 在多个视频生成骨干上的实验表明，相比直接生成和强基线，DramaAgent 在长时程连贯性、角色一致性、叙事保真度和场景级音画一致性上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 分层智能体控制是实现可控长视频音视频生成的可行方向。

title: A Low Grounding Score Is Not an Ungrounded Judge: Identifying the Perceptibility Confound in Multimodal Oversight
summary: Model judges now supervise multimodal systems at scale, filtering training data, selecting outputs, and supplying the reward that shapes multimodal reasoning models. Trusting one means first checking that it uses its evidence, and that check is itself worth scrutinizing, so we ask whether a counterfactual probe of visual grounding measures what it claims to. The probe edits the image so the ground truth flips, holds the reasoning trace fixed, and asks whether the verdict follows. We formalize it as the Verdict Grounding Score and show it cannot be read the way such scores are read. A verdict responds only to an edit that reaches the judge's decision-relevant reading, so the score is capped by how perceptible the edit is, and unless editing makes the attribute easier to read, the error is one-sided: the score can only make a judge look less grounded than it is. The practical failure is therefore a false alarm, an auditor discarding a usable overseer. Under assumptions we state, we show this missing quantity is not merely bounded but identified from three quantities the same audit protocol already collects, which makes the false-alarm rate directly measurable rather than merely a concern. Auditing nine judges, we find the predicted ordering holds strictly across our entire primary pool, and the typical judge there acts on only about half of the edits whose attribute it can otherwise resolve. Applying a conservative rejection threshold certifies several cells as false alarms outright, the clearest being a judge that detects the injected error essentially every time while still scoring as if it had not used the image at all. The rule that follows is that an image-side counterfactual score should never be reported alone: a detection probe on the unedited image upper-bounds it, certifies its false alarms, and costs nothing extra to run.

AI.tldr: 本文指出视觉基础的反事实探针（Verdict Grounding Score）因受编辑可感知性上限约束，只会产生"误报"（把可用评审误判为不基础图像），并在给定假设下证明该缺失量可从审计协议已有三个量中识别，从而可测量误报率；九个评审的审计验证了预测排序，并提出应配合未编辑图像上的检测探针共同报告。
AI.motivation: 模型评审（model judges）已大规模用于监督多模态系统，包括过滤训练数据、挑选输出、提供奖励信号。信任评审的前提是确认它确实使用了图像证据，而检验其视觉基础的常用手段是反事实探针。作者要审视这一探针本身：它是否真的测量了它所声称的东西。
AI.method: 形式化反事实探针为 Verdict Grounding Score：修改图像使真值翻转、保持推理轨迹不变，观察裁决是否随之改变。分析表明裁决只对"能进入评审决策相关解读"的编辑作出响应，故得分被编辑的可感知性所封顶；若编辑未使属性更易读，则误差是单侧的，得分只会低估评审的基础性。作者在明确假设下证明该缺失量可由同一审计协议已收集的三个量识别，使误报率可被直接测量。随后对九个评审进行实证审计。
AI.result: 在主集合中预测的排序严格成立；典型评审仅对约一半"其本可分辨属性"的编辑作出响应。采用保守拒绝阈值可把若干单元直接判定为误报，最明显的一例是：某评审几乎每次都能检出注入错误，却在得分上表现得仿佛完全未使用图像。
AI.conclusion: 图像侧反事实得分不应单独报告：在未编辑图像上运行的检测探针可为其提供上界、认证其误报，且无需额外成本。该规则避免了审计者误弃可用监督者。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Anti-UAV Detection under Controlled Fog Degradation: Fog-Aware Training and Clear-Sky Tradeoff
summary: Vision-based anti-UAV systems must function in poor visibility, yet most benchmarks use only clear-sky footage, and previous robustness studies treat adverse weather as a simple present/absent condition. As a result, the impact of fog severity on ground-to-air UAV detection remains poorly understood. This work presents the first severity-controlled fog benchmark for this task: synthetic fog at ten severity levels is applied to the RGB modality of the Anti-UAV300 dataset, comparing a clear-trained YOLOv5m baseline to a fog-aware model trained on both clear and foggy images. Detection performance drops sharply and non-linearly: degradation is front-loaded across light-to-moderate fog (beta approximately 0.05-0.10), with a 96% reduction in mAP@0.5:0.95 from clear to thickest fog, mainly due to lost recall and confidence. On the comparable metric (mAP@0.5), this collapse exceeds the most extreme rain degradation reported in the closest prior benchmark. Fog-aware training boosts detection across all severities (up to +0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95) with only a 9.1% drop in clear-sky accuracy, raising the threshold for reliable detection while not preventing collapse under extreme fog. Since reliability is lost within a narrow visibility range, simple clear vs adverse tests underestimate operational risk.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个"雾浓度可控"的反无人机检测基准，在Anti-UAV300数据集的RGB模态上合成10级雾，对比清晰图像训练的YOLOv5m基线与雾感知模型。结果显示检测性能随雾浓度呈前重后轻的非线性急剧下降，清晰到最浓雾的mAP@0.5:0.95下降96%；雾感知训练可显著提升各浓度下性能（最多+0.320），但仅损失9.1%的晴空精度，且无法避免极端雾下的性能崩溃。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的反无人机系统需在低能见度下工作，但现有基准多只使用晴朗天气数据，且以往鲁棒性研究仅将恶劣天气简化为"有/无"的二值条件，导致雾浓度对地空无人机检测的影响缺乏细化理解，容易低估实际运行风险。
AI.method: 提出首个雾浓度可控基准：对Anti-UAV300数据集的RGB模态施加10个等级的合成雾，比较清晰图像训练的YOLOv5m基线模型与同时使用清晰和雾图训练的雾感知模型；采用mAP@0.5:0.95和mAP@0.5等指标，并结合召回率与置信度展开分析。
AI.result: 检测性能随雾浓度呈非线性、前重后轻的下降，在轻至中度雾（β约0.05–0.10）区间退化最剧烈；从清晰到最浓雾，mAP@0.5:0.95下降96%，主要由召回率和置信度损失导致；在mAP@0.5上，该崩溃程度超过最接近的既往基准中最极端的降雨退化。雾感知训练在所有雾浓度下均提升检测性能（mAP@0.5:0.95最多+0.320），仅使晴空精度下降9.1%，可提高可靠检测的阈值，但不能阻止极端雾下的崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 可靠检测仅在很窄的能见度范围内维持，性能崩溃发生得非常快；因此，简单的"清晰 vs 恶劣天气"对比测试会低估实际运行风险，需要采用浓度可控的细粒度评估。

title: GPEC: Efficient Pre-LLM Gaussian Process Embedding Correction for Cardiac Video Caption Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for video understanding and caption generation, but their performance may decline in specialized medical imaging domains such as echocardiography. This work introduces Gaussian Process Embedding Correction (GPEC), a modular and computationally efficient pre-LLM error-correction method that improves the visual representations used by VideoChat2 for cardiac ultrasound caption generation. GPEC is inserted between the visual projection layer and the language model and learns a residual correction that moves the projected visual representation toward an annotation-guided target. The target is constructed by converting structured video annotations into qualitative attributes, generating a fixed-format reference caption, and mapping it into the language-model embedding space. The correction is modeled using a sparse variational Gaussian Process with inducing points, natural-parameter variational updates, and a block-wise linear kernel, while the original VideoChat2 components remain frozen.The method is evaluated using representation-level, caption-level, content-oriented, and execution-time metrics by comparing the original VideoChat2 with VideoChat2 + GPEC under identical input and reference conditions. Results show improved caption similarity and content alignment after applying the proposed correction. Furthermore, GPEC adds less than 0.05 s of inference-time overhead per video in the evaluated setting. These findings indicate that GPEC can improve caption generation in specialized medical video domains with minimal computational cost, without requiring end-to-end fine-tuning of the pretrained multimodal backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高斯过程嵌入校正（GPEC），一种模块化、低开销的预LLM纠错方法，插入VideoChat2的视觉投影层与语言模型之间，通过学习残差校正提升心脏超声视频描述生成质量。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在通用视频理解与描述生成上表现优异，但在超声心动图等专业医学影像领域性能下降。为避免对预训练多模态骨干网络进行端到端微调的高昂代价，需要一种轻量、模块化的表示纠错方案。
AI.method: GPEC置于视觉投影层与LLM之间，学习一个残差校正，将投影后的视觉表示推向由标注引导的目标。目标构建方式为：将结构化视频标注转换为定性属性，生成固定格式参考描述，再映射至LLM嵌入空间。校正采用稀疏变分高斯过程建模，使用诱导点、自然参数变分更新与块状线性核；原VideoChat2各组件保持冻结。
AI.result: 在相同输入与参考条件下对比原始VideoChat2与VideoChat2+GPEC，采用表示级、描述级、内容导向与运行时间四类指标评估。结果显示描述相似度与内容对齐度均有提升；在评估设置下，GPEC每个视频的推理时间开销低于0.05秒。
AI.conclusion: GPEC能够以极低计算成本改善专业医学视频领域的描述生成，且无需对预训练多模态骨干进行端到端微调。

title: Query Independent Variable Rate Visual Token Coding
summary: Visual-token compression for vision--language models is posed almost entirely as a selection problem: decide which tokens to keep and discard the rest. The criteria that work best rank tokens by the attention the language model pays them, which makes the ranking a function of the question being asked. That is invisible in a single-turn benchmark and decisive whenever a compressed representation is written once and read many times, as when it is cached across the turns of a conversation or transmitted between a device and a server. We take the other half of the classical transform-coding toolkit instead: keep every token and vary its rate. A transform code exposes each token's measured distortion--rate curve, and a fixed bit budget is distributed across tokens by exact integer rate--distortion optimisation on those curves. No text enters the pipeline, so one compressed representation serves any query. At equal bit budgets, on two datasets and two capacities, it preserves the model's output distribution and its answers better than uniform-rate coding, the closed-form water-fill and distortion-ranked pruning. It matches attention-ranked pruning on the question pruning was tuned for, and overtakes it once the compressed image must answer a different question about the same image.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用率-失真优化替代视觉token选择范式，实现与查询无关的一次编码多次读取的视觉token压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token压缩几乎完全被表述为"选择问题"（保留或丢弃token），最优准则依赖语言模型注意力，因此排序随所问问题变化；这在单轮基准中不可见，但在压缩表示被写一次、读多次（跨轮缓存、端云传输）时是决定性的。
AI.method: 采用经典变换编码工具包的另一半：保留全部token而改变其码率。变换码为每个token显式给出实测的失真-率曲线，在固定比特预算下通过精确整数率-失真优化在曲线间分配比特。流程中不引入任何文本，因此单一压缩表示可服务任意查询。
AI.result: 在两个数据集、两种模型容量下，相同比特预算时，该方法在保持模型输出分布与答案方面优于均匀码率编码、闭式注水法和按失真排序剪枝；在与剪枝调优时相同的问题上，与注意力排序剪枝持平，而当压缩图像需回答同一图像的另一个问题时则超越后者。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉token压缩从"选择"转向"变率编码"，可在不依赖查询的前提下获得更优的率-失真权衡，尤其适合压缩表示被复用的多轮/传输场景。

title: Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion U-Net for Magnetic Resonance Imaging Segmentation
summary: The segmentation of anatomical structures in medical images and particularly in MRI scans, is essential for clinical diagnosis and monitoring disease progression. While Deep Learning (DL) architectures, such as U-Net and its extensions are very effective in medical image segmentation tasks, they often struggle with preserving fine-grained details and global contextual information. This is especially challenging for MRI data segmentation, where anatomical structures are characterized by irregular boundaries and variations in shape, contrast, and scale. To address this challenge, we propose a novel DL architecture for MRI segmentation across different anatomical structures. Specifically, the architecture introduces a module, named Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion (MRFF), that can be easily integrated into any U-Net-like architecture. The MRFF is integrated in all levels of an encode-decoder structure, along with attention mechanisms and skip connections to extract features at multiple resolutions, enabling the model to capture both fine-grained details and global contextual information. We evaluate the MRFFU-Net on two publicly available benchmark MRI datasets of different anatomical targets; one for Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) segmentation in spinal MR scans, and one for left atrium cardiac segmentation, from the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) challenge. Experimental results indicate that MRFFU-Net outperforms state-of-the-art models across multiple evaluation metrics, demonstrating its effectiveness in MRI segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为MRFFU-Net的新型深度学习架构，通过多分辨率特征融合模块（MRFF）提升MRI解剖结构分割中细节与全局上下文信息的保留能力。
AI.motivation: MRI解剖结构具有不规则边界以及形状、对比度和尺度上的差异，现有U-Net及其扩展虽在医学图像分割中有效，但难以同时保留细粒度细节与全局上下文信息。
AI.method: 提出可嵌入任意U-Net类架构的多分辨率特征融合模块MRFF，并将其集成于编码器-解码器结构的所有层级，结合注意力机制与跳跃连接，实现多分辨率特征提取。
AI.result: 在脑脊液（脊髓MR）与左心房心脏分割两个公开MRI基准数据集（MSD挑战赛）上评估，MRFFU-Net在多项评价指标上优于现有最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: MRFFU-Net能有效兼顾细粒度细节与全局上下文信息，证明了其在MRI分割任务中的有效性。

title: LENS-GRF: Permutation-Invariant Lesion Evidence Network with Gated Residual Fusion for Acne Severity Grading and Multi-Rater Clinical Oracle Analysis
comment: Submitted to Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine (Elsevier)
summary: Automated acne severity grading requires both whole-face context and fine-grained lesion evidence. We propose LENS-GRF (Lesion Evidence Network with Set-Transformer and Gated Residual Fusion), an interpretable multi-stage framework for four-class acne severity grading. The method combines Adaptive Facial Skin Segmentation and a global Vision Transformer prior with a permutation-invariant Lesion Set Transformer that encodes localized lesion patches and spatial geometry. Gated Residual Fusion adaptively controls the local residual contribution and reduces to the global prediction when the gate is zero. On ACNE04, fully automated LENS-GRF with YOLOv11s achieved 80.82% accuracy; with ground-truth lesion annotations, it achieved 95.89% +/- 0.59% accuracy and a Quadratic Weighted Kappa of 0.9753. A data-integrity audit identified 15 cross-split duplicate image pairs, including five with conflicting severity labels. In locked zero-shot evaluation on the full PLSBRACNE01 cohort (200 subjects, 600 views), automated LENS-GRF achieved 35.00% accuracy versus 42.50% for the global baseline. On the 148-subject common cohort used for three-dermatologist oracle analysis, ground-truth lesion inputs increased the best oracle accuracy to 47.97%, while the highest oracle QWK was 0.5799. Pairwise oracle agreement ranged from 49.32% to 66.22%, highlighting detector domain shift, annotation variability, and cross-criterion mismatch.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释的多阶段痤疮分级框架LENS-GRF，融合全局ViT先验与置换不变病灶集合Transformer，并以门控残差融合调节局部贡献；在ACNE04上全自动达80.82%准确率，含真值病灶标注达95.89%±0.59%、QWK 0.9753，但在PLSBRACNE01零样本评测中自动化性能（35.00%）低于全局基线（42.50%），且数据审计发现15对跨划分重复图像。
AI.motivation: 自动痤疮严重度分级既要全脸上下文，又需细粒度病灶证据，单一全局或局部建模难以兼顾；同时现有数据集存在标注与划分质量隐患，模型在跨域场景下的真实泛化能力缺乏检验，因此需要一个可解释、可分解全局与局部贡献的框架，并辅以严格的数据完整性与零样本评测。
AI.method: LENS-GRF采用多阶段设计：以自适应面部皮肤分割限定感兴趣区域，引入全局Vision Transformer先验提供全脸上下文；构建置换不变的Lesion Set Transformer编码局部病灶图像块与空间几何信息；通过Gated Residual Fusion自适应控制局部残差贡献，门控为零时退化为纯全局预测。具体检测使用YOLOv11s。
AI.result: 在ACNE04上，全自动LENS-GRF（YOLOv11s）准确率为80.82%；使用真值病灶标注时准确率达95.89%±0.59%，二次加权Kappa为0.9753。数据完整性审计发现15对跨划分重复图像，其中5对严重度标签冲突。在PLSBRACNE01全队列（200人、600视图）锁定零样本评测中，自动化LENS-GRF准确率35.00%，低于全局基线的42.50%。在用于三位皮肤科医生oracle分析的148人共同队列上，真值病灶输入将最佳oracle准确率提升至47.97%，最高oracle QWK为0.5799，成对oracle一致率为49.32%–66.22%。
AI.conclusion: LENS-GRF在标注完备时可实现高精度分级且具备可解释性，但其性能高度依赖病灶检测与标注质量；零样本跨队列表现不及全局基线，暴露检测器域偏移、标注变异及分级标准不一致等核心瓶颈，提示痤疮自动分级研究需重视数据完整性与跨域鲁棒性评估。

title: Decoding the Disaster: Multi-Task Geospatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models and Crowdsourced Imagery for Disaster Mapping
summary: Crowdsourced imagery provides timely, fine-grained, street-level observations for disaster mapping, complementing conventional remote sensing imagery (RSI) during emergency response. However, such imagery is often unstructured, spatially ambiguous, and lacks reliable geographic metadata, making manual geolocalization and interpretation labor-intensive and difficult to scale. This work proposes a multi-task Geospatial Reasoning Disaster mapping framework, namely GRDisaster, to examine the potential of vision-language models (VLMs) in understanding, geolocalizing, and reasoning over crowdsourced disaster imagery. GRDisaster is built on a newly curated benchmark dataset derived from PhotoMappers, comprising 26,340 images organized into human-validated volunteered geographic information (VGI), street-view imagery (SVI), RSI cross-view triplets covering multiple disaster events from 2018 to 2024. The framework combines deterministic and probabilistic cross-view geolocalization with multi-view fusion to associate VGI images with georeferenced SVI and RSI. It introduces two sets of spatial reasoning indicators for cross-view geolocalization validation and disaster damage assessment. These indicators use structural, environmental, and global-scene cues to validate cross-view correspondences and visually observable damage evidence with expert-verified annotations to assess disaster severity, improving the interpretability of VLM outputs. To our knowledge, this study provides the first systematic investigation and unified evaluation framework for examining how VLM-based spatial reasoning can transform crowdsourced disaster imagery into actionable geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI) through cross-view geolocalization validation, interpretable spatial reasoning, and damage-aware severity assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRDisaster多任务地理空间推理灾害制图框架，基于PhotoMappers构建的26,340张跨视角三元组基准数据集，结合确定性/概率性跨视角地理定位与多视角融合，并引入空间推理指标，系统评估视觉语言模型在众源灾害影像理解、定位与推理中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 众源影像可提供及时、细粒度的街景级灾后观测，弥补应急响应中传统遥感影像的不足；但此类影像非结构化、空间歧义强、缺乏可靠地理元数据，导致人工地理定位与解译成本高、难以规模化。因此需探索VLM在众源灾害影像理解、地理定位与推理上的潜力。
AI.method: 构建GRDisaster多任务地理空间推理灾害制图框架。基于PhotoMappers新整理基准数据集，含26,340张图像，组织为人验证的VGI、街景影像SVI、遥感影像RSI跨视角三元组，覆盖2018—2024年多次灾害事件。框架融合确定性/概率性跨视角地理定位与多视角融合，将VGI与带地理参考的SVI、RSI关联；并引入两组空间推理指标：一组用于跨视角地理定位验证，一组用于灾害损毁评估，利用结构、环境与全局场景线索及专家核验标注，评估灾情严重程度，提升VLM输出的可解释性。
AI.result: 据作者所述，本文首次对VLM空间推理如何将众源灾害影像转化为可操作GeoAI进行系统性研究与统一评估，通过跨视角地理定位验证、可解释空间推理与损毁感知的严重度评估实现。
AI.conclusion: GRDisaster提供了一个统一评估框架，证明VLM驱动的空间推理可有效支撑众源灾害影像的地理定位验证、可解释推理与损毁评估，推动众源影像向可操作GeoAI转化，为应急响应提供补充性数据支撑。

title: Beyond Pixel Reconstruction: Retrieval-Guided Glyph-Aware Restoration for Low-Resource Manchu Historical Documents
summary: Historical Manchu documents preserve invaluable linguistic and cultural heritage, yet their digitization is hindered by severe degradations and the scarcity of paired training data. Existing document restoration methods primarily optimize pixel-level reconstruction, which can produce visually plausible results while failing to preserve the structural identity of Manchu glyphs. To address this limitation, we propose a retrieval-guided glyph-aware restoration framework that goes beyond pixel reconstruction by explicitly incorporating glyph-level structural knowledge. Our method retrieves relevant glyph exemplars to provide structural guidance during restoration and integrates this information into the reconstruction process, improving the recovery of degraded character structures under low-resource conditions. Extensive experiments on Manchu historical documents demonstrate that the proposed approach improves both image restoration quality and glyph-level fidelity compared with existing restoration methods. These results highlight the importance of incorporating character-aware structural priors for reliable restoration of low-resource historical documents.

AI.tldr: 提出检索引导的字形感知修复框架，通过引入字形级结构知识来恢复满文历史文档。
AI.motivation: 满文历史文档具有重要语言文化价值，但数字化受严重退化和配对训练数据稀缺的阻碍。现有文档修复方法主要优化像素级重建，可能产生视觉上合理却无法保持满文字形结构身份的结果。
AI.method: 提出检索引导的字形感知修复框架，超越像素重建，显式引入字形级结构知识。方法检索相关字形样本，在修复过程中提供结构引导，并将该信息整合到重建流程中，从而在低资源条件下改善退化字符结构的恢复。
AI.result: 在满文历史文档上的大量实验表明，相比现有修复方法，所提方法在图像修复质量和字形级保真度上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了引入字符感知结构先验对于低资源历史文档可靠修复的重要性。

title: LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) aims to improve visual grounding while preserving the strong reasoning capabilities of language models. Recent multi-teacher approaches combine LLM and VLM teachers to provide complementary supervision. However, directly using a VLM's full predictive distribution entangles its visual grounding signal with its own language prior, preventing the grounding information from being transferred independently. Conversely, increasing the strength of visual supervision can improve perception but may overemphasize visual evidence and degrade language reasoning. To address this trade-off, we introduce LEGO-OPD, which selectively composes factors from a Language Expert and a Grounding expert into One teacher distribution for multimodal OPD. Under a generalized Bayesian formulation, the language expert provides a prior over candidate tokens, while the grounding expert contributes a visual likelihood that updates this prior, rather than transferring its complete predictive distribution. This factorized composition allows language reasoning and visual grounding to be controlled independently. We further introduce adaptive calibration to determine how strongly the visual likelihood should update the language prior at each decoding prefix. Specifically, LEGO-OPD uses the grounding expert's image-induced prediction shift as a prefix-dependent reference, preventing both insufficient and excessive visual supervision. Experiments with Qwen3 models show that LEGO-OPD consistently outperforms the evaluated single- and multi-teacher OPD baselines on both multimodal and text-only reasoning tasks. Moreover, it improves the initial student's visual perception while preserving text-only reasoning.

AI.tldr: LEGO-OPD提出将语言专家与视觉接地专家的预测分解组合为单一教师分布，并通过自适应校准控制视觉似然对语言先验的更新强度，在多模态与纯文本推理任务上超越单/多教师OPD基线，兼顾视觉感知与语言推理。
AI.motivation: 多模态在策略蒸馏需在提升视觉接地的同时保留语言模型的强推理能力。现有方法中，多教师方案结合LLM与VLM教师以提供互补监督，但直接使用VLM的完整预测分布会把视觉接地信号与其自身语言先验纠缠在一起，导致接地信息无法独立迁移；而单纯增强视觉监督虽能改善感知，却会过度强调视觉证据、损害语言推理。因此需要解决视觉接地与语言推理之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出LEGO-OPD，在广义贝叶斯框架下，将语言专家与接地专家的因素选择性组合为一个教师分布，用于多模态OPD。其中语言专家提供候选token上的先验，接地专家贡献视觉似然以更新该先验，而非迁移其完整预测分布，从而实现语言推理与视觉接地的独立控制。同时引入自适应校准，在每个解码前缀上确定视觉似然更新语言先验的强度，以接地专家由图像引起的预测偏移作为前缀相关的参考，避免视觉监督不足或过度。
AI.result: 在Qwen3模型上的实验表明，LEGO-OPD在多模态任务和纯文本推理任务上均持续优于所评估的单教师与多教师OPD基线；同时改善了初始学生的视觉感知能力，并保留了其纯文本推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过因子化组合语言先验与视觉似然并自适应校准视觉监督强度，LEGO-OPD实现了视觉接地与语言推理的解耦与可控平衡，为多模态在策略蒸馏提供了一种有效且可推广的范式。

title: Vmem-$\varphi$: Low-Compute Out-of-Distribution Detection in Spiking Neural Networks from Membrane-Potential Statistics
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient approach to processing event-camera data, yet out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging in this setting. Existing OOD detection methods often depend on model outputs or computational components that are unavailable in object detection SNNs or are poorly suited to low-compute deployment. To that effect, we show that the subthreshold membrane potential \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) provides a useful internal signal for detecting distribution shifts. Simple per-channel statistics derived from these membrane dynamics enable OOD detection. To evaluate this approach, we introduce Gen1-C, an event-camera corruption benchmark developed upon the Prophesee Gen1 automotive detection dataset, containing six sensor-motivated histogram-level stress tests at five severity levels. We further propose the Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD), a corruption-blind method that operates on membrane-potential statistics. At the highest corruption severity, MDD achieves an AUROC of more than 0.88 on five of the six corruptions using only a bounded 64-frame observation window. Notably, the remaining corruption is also the one that has the smallest effect on the underlying detector. These results show that the temporal membrane-potential dynamics can provide an effective and low-cost signal for OOD detection in SNN-based event perception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用脉冲神经网络内部的亚阈值膜电位动力学实现事件相机数据的OOD检测，并构建了Gen1-C损坏基准与MDD方法，在六类损坏中的五类上以64帧窗口取得AUROC>0.88。
AI.motivation: 事件相机数据的OOD检测在SNN场景下仍具挑战：现有方法依赖模型输出或目标检测SNN中不可用的计算组件，且不适合低算力部署。因此需要一种低成本、可从模型内部获取的信号来检测分布偏移。
AI.method: 1) 提出以亚阈值膜电位V_mem(t)作为内部信号，提取逐通道统计量刻画膜电位动力学；2) 构建Gen1-C基准：基于Prophesee Gen1车载检测数据集，设计六种传感器层面的直方图级压力测试，各含五个严重度等级；3) 提出Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD)，一种不依赖损坏标签、基于膜电位统计的多描述子偏差检测方法，仅使用有界的64帧观测窗口。
AI.result: 在最高损坏严重度下，MDD在六种损坏中的五种上AUROC超过0.88；剩余那一种损坏恰好是对底层检测器影响最小的一类。
AI.conclusion: 膜电位的时间动力学可为SNN事件感知提供有效且低成本的OOD检测信号，验证了内部膜电位统计在低算力目标检测SNN中的实用性。

title: From Image Latent Space to Fuzzy Rules: Interpretable Analysis of Gastrointestinal Foundation Model
comment: Accepted at the excv, ECCV 2026 Workshops. 17 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables
summary: Foundation models pretrained on large-scale datasets demonstrate strong transferability to medical imaging tasks. However, understanding how their latent representations encode clinically relevant information remains an open challenge in safety-critical domains. This study proposes a prototype-based fuzzy-rule framework that interprets the patch-level features produced by the inner layers of pretrained foundation models, without any fine-tuning. Class-specific prototypes are learned by clustering in the feature space, yielding compact visual patterns. Patch features are then expressed as prototype similarities and classified by fuzzy rules with linguistic IF-THEN conditions that are human readable. The framework is applied across the final two blocks of ViT-S/16 backbones pretrained on ImageNet-1K and GastroNet-5M, and benchmarked against k-nearest neighbours, kernel SVM, and linear probing under identical frozen features, on wireless capsule endoscopy classification, gastrointestinal endoscopy classification, and colonic polyp segmentation. The experimental analysis shows that the proposed method, without backbone fine-tuning, reaches accuracy comparable to these black-box classifiers, and that domain-specific pretraining yields features that are both discriminative and symbolically compressible. Because the resulting rules are extracted from real data and expressed in interpretable terms, they are further used as an instrument to investigate synthetic medical images, providing a human-readable account of which real prototypes and rules a generator reproduces or fails to reproduce, localising where a synthetic image departs from real tissue rather than summarising it with a single score. The framework thus offers a transparent, depth-resolved view of how foundation models organise clinically relevant structure, together with a practical downstream use of the extracted rules.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于原型的模糊规则框架，无需微调即可解释预训练基础模型中间层特征，用于医学影像分类与合成图像分析。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在医学影像任务上迁移性强，但其潜在表示如何编码临床相关信息仍不明确，在安全攸关领域尤为关键；同时合成医学图像通常只用单一分数评价，缺乏可读的定位性解释。
AI.method: 在冻结特征空间中聚类学习类特定原型，得到紧凑视觉模式；将patch特征表示为与原型的相似度，并用带语言化IF-THEN条件的模糊规则进行分类；应用于ImageNet-1K与GastroNet-5M预训练的ViT-S/16最后两个block。
AI.result: 在无线胶囊内镜分类、胃肠内镜分类和结肠息肉分割上，与k-NN、核SVM、线性探针在相同冻结特征下对比，所提方法无需微调即可达到与黑盒分类器相当的精度；领域特定预训练的特征兼具判别性与符号可压缩性；规则可用于分析合成医学图像。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了对基础模型如何组织临床相关结构的透明、深度分辨视角，并将提取的规则实用化，实现合成图像中真实原型的可读复现分析与偏离定位。

title: Scores That Hold, Benchmarks That Leak: Measuring Dataset Contamination in Public Brain-Tumor MRI Classification
summary: Automated classification of brain tumors from MRI is a heavily published application of deep learning in medical imaging, with reported accuracies on public benchmarks routinely exceeding 98%. However, accuracy does not capture a critical dimension of benchmark quality: dataset integrity, defined as the independence of test from training data at the image, patient, and acquisition-source levels. We introduce a three-layer contamination framework comprising duplicate, patient, and source-label leakage to assess the public corpora on which this literature rests. We audit the three most widely used corpora against a chest-radiograph negative control and quantify each layer's effect on measured performance across nine architectures and three evaluation conditions. Contamination is severe at every layer: 28.8% of the dominant corpus's official test split has a near-twin in its own training split, a second corpus leaks 22.3% of its test images byte-identically, 95.5% of traceable test images share a patient with training, and file-header features containing no anatomy separate tumor from no-tumor at 0.959 balanced accuracy, at parity with fine-tuned ResNet backbones. The unexpected result is that removing every identified leaked test image leaves balanced accuracy essentially unchanged: stable performance after deduplication does not establish benchmark integrity. Our findings establish dataset integrity as a distinct, measurable axis of benchmark quality that a stable leaderboard cannot certify. For biomedical research, reported accuracy on these corpora alone does not establish that a model has learned to recognize tumors rather than exploit dataset-specific cues. We release the contaminated-file lists, recovered patient identifiers, and deduplicated splits.

AI.tldr: 论文提出三层数据污染框架（重复、患者、来源-标签泄漏），审计三大常用脑肿瘤MRI公开数据集，发现各层污染严重，但剔除全部泄漏测试图像后平衡准确率几乎不变，说明榜单稳定性无法证明基准完整性。
AI.motivation: 该领域论文在公开基准上报告准确率普遍超过98%，但准确率无法反映基准质量的关键维度——数据完整性（测试数据在图像、患者、采集来源层面是否独立于训练数据）。作者希望揭示文献所依赖的公开语料可能存在系统性污染，且传统评估指标无法察觉。
AI.method: 提出三层污染框架：重复泄漏、患者泄漏、来源-标签泄漏。以胸部X光片作为阴性对照，审计三个最广泛使用的语料库，在九种架构与三种评估条件下量化各层污染对测得性能的影响；并进行去重后的性能对比。
AI.result: 污染在每一层都很严重：主导语料官方测试集中28.8%存在训练集近重复；第二个语料库22.3%的测试图像字节级完全相同；95.5%可追溯测试图像与训练集共享同一患者；不含解剖信息的文件头特征以0.959平衡准确率区分肿瘤与非肿瘤，与微调ResNet主干相当。关键结果是：剔除所有已识别的泄漏测试图像后，平衡准确率基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 数据完整性是基准质量的独立且可测量的维度，稳定的排行榜不能证明基准完整。对这些语料的准确率报告本身不足以说明模型学会了识别肿瘤，而非利用数据集特异线索。作者公开污染文件清单、恢复的患者标识符及去重后的划分。

title: PACT: End-to-End Learning of Human Pose, Contacts, and Forces from Video
summary: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. This separation limits joint reasoning and can propagate errors between stages. We introduce PACT, an end-to-end model that jointly learns to estimate human pose, contacts and contact forces from monocular video. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion. Joint prediction heads refine human poses and estimate contacts and forces, while physics-based supervision encourages consistency between the reconstructed motion and interaction forces. To address the scarcity of force annotations, we develop a data annotation pipeline that combines contact labeling with physics-based motion and force optimization, producing training supervision from synthetic and real-world videos. We also introduce a real-world climbing benchmark ForceWall with climbing videos and corresponding ground-truth contact forces obtained from the force sensors. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art contact and force estimation, outperforming staged reconstruction approaches and generalizing to interactions beyond the training distribution.
