These results support end-to-end joint learning as an effective approach to recovering human motion and physical interactions from video.

AI.tldr: PACT是一个端到端模型，从单目视频联合估计人体姿态、接触与接触力，通过接触力token、时序Transformer与物理监督实现，并提出标注流程与真实攀岩力基准ForceWall，性能优于分阶段方法。
AI.motivation: 人体运动、环境接触与交互力受共同物理规律约束，但现有方法将视觉姿态重建与接触/力估计分离，导致联合推理受限且阶段间误差传播。
AI.method: 以人体重建基础模型为骨干，加入可学习的接触力token与融合视觉特征及世界坐标运动的时序Transformer；联合预测头精修姿态并估计接触与力；引入物理监督保证运动与力的物理一致性。针对力标注稀缺，构建结合接触标注与物理运动-力优化的数据标注流程，从合成与真实视频生成训练监督；并构建含力传感器真值的真实攀岩基准ForceWall。
AI.result: 在接触与力估计上取得SOTA，优于分阶段重建方法，并能泛化到训练分布之外的交互场景。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持端到端联合学习是恢复人体运动与物理交互的有效途径。

title: PixelDense: Dense Prediction as Representation Alignment for Pixel Diffusion
summary: Representation alignment (REPA) accelerates diffusion transformer training, but its alignment targets are almost exclusively semantic encoders such as DINOv2 and CLIP. Recent analysis points to spatial structure, not global semantics, as the carrier of the alignment effect, yet dense-prediction foundation models trained to predict that structure remain overlooked as REPA targets. In pixel-space diffusion, SAM2, Depth Anything v2, and Metric3D v2 each outperform the DINOv2-only GenEval baseline, with the two geometric teachers leading the segmentation teacher. A flat sum of all four teachers, however, lands below the best single geometric teacher, as semantic and geometric gradients compete for one denoiser projection. We introduce PixelDense, which routes DINOv2 and SAM2 through a semantic projection stream, routes Depth Anything v2 and Metric3D v2 through a geometric projection stream, and adds a weight-space orthogonality penalty that keeps the two streams in disjoint subspaces. All four teachers are frozen during training and dropped at inference. Applied to PixelGen and DeCo with a single recipe, PixelDense improves GenEval, DPG-Bench, and HPS v2.1, raises PixelGen-XXL's GenEval Overall from 0.7927 to 0.8093, and beats every single-teacher and unfactored multi-teacher variant. In partial-noise reconstruction, independent panoptic, depth, and surface-normal probes show up to 53.1% PQ gain and 36.0% depth AbsRel reduction at $τ=0.5$ across COCO and Flickr30K. From random initialization, PixelDense also reaches the baseline's peak GenEval 1.23x faster. In SDEdit editing on PIE-Bench, PixelDense keeps more of the source background and layout at every edit strength, raising background PSNR by up to 2.2 dB.

AI.tldr: 提出PixelDense，将DINOv2与SAM2路由至语义投影流、Depth Anything v2与Metric3D v2路由至几何投影流，并加入权重空间正交惩罚使两流子空间不相交，从而在像素空间扩散模型中实现高效的表示对齐。
AI.motivation: REPA（表示对齐）能加速扩散Transformer训练，但其对齐目标几乎都是DINOv2、CLIP等语义编码器。近期分析指出对齐效果的载体是空间结构而非全局语义，但用于预测该结构的稠密预测基础模型却仍被忽视，未被用作REPA对齐目标。
AI.method: 先验证SAM2、Depth Anything v2、Metric3D v2在像素空间扩散中均优于仅用DINOv2的GenEval基线，且两个几何教师优于分割教师；但四者简单求和反而不如最佳单几何教师，原因是语义与几何梯度在同一去噪器投影上竞争。由此提出PixelDense：将DINOv2与SAM2经语义投影流、Depth Anything v2与Metric3D v2经几何投影流，并加入权重空间正交性惩罚使两流处于不相交子空间；四个教师训练时冻结、推理时丢弃。
AI.result: 在PixelGen与DeCo上用单一配方即提升GenEval、DPG-Bench与HPS v2.1，PixelGen-XXL的GenEval Overall从0.7927升至0.8093，优于所有单教师与未分解多教师变体。部分噪声重建中，独立全景、深度与表面法向探针在COCO与Flickr30K上于τ=0.5时最高取得53.1% PQ提升与36.0%深度AbsRel降低。从随机初始化起，达到基线峰值GenEval的速度快1.23倍。在PIE-Bench的SDEdit编辑中，各编辑强度下均保留更多源背景与布局，背景PSNR最高提升2.2 dB。
AI.conclusion: 稠密预测基础模型（尤其几何教师）作为REPA目标优于纯语义教师，但语义与几何梯度存在竞争；通过语义/几何双投影流分离并施加正交惩罚的PixelDense，在生成质量、训练加速、重建探针与编辑保真度上全面超越单教师及未分解多教师方案。

title: Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window
summary: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

AI.tldr: Memorizon 通过"长跨度监督但非长跨度注意力"的解耦，用共可见性检索的有界潜变量库（bank）实现对长间隔重访场景的一致渲染，跨度从100→400秒仅增12%步时。
AI.motivation: 流式世界模型需在重复访问同一地点时保持一致性，但直接监督重访需要同时包含两次访问、跨度可达数分钟的训练样本；对完整跨度做稠密注意力是二次复杂度，导致长跨度监督代价高昂。
AI.method: 解耦"监督所需的长跨度"与"注意力所需的长跨度"：训练样本可覆盖任意长跨度，但只对最后 k 个 chunk 计分；被计分 chunk 不做历史 token 化，而是按相机共可见性各自检索 top-K 潜变量，其并集构成共享 bank。bank 规模上界为 kK，序列长度与跨度无关。最短跨度时退化为常规训练。
AI.result: bank 引入只增加一次性开销，之后更长跨度成本很小（100→400 秒仅增 12% 步时）。相较滑动窗口基线，检索在每个划分上均提升重访一致性；跨度足以覆盖每次返回的首次访问时再提升 24%–30%（图像质量有所代价）；超过该跨度后长度不再有益。用其他 episode 填充 bank 使重访相关性下降 83%，说明模型确实依赖检索内容。
AI.conclusion: 长跨度监督不必伴随长跨度注意力；基于共可见性的检索库可在有界成本下显著提升长期间隔的重访一致性，且跨度存在收益饱和点，验证了检索内容被模型有效利用。

title: PhysVista: Benchmarking Physical Intelligence in VLMs via a Perception-Reasoning-Assessment Loop
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet whether they truly capture the physical consistency underlying real-world dynamics remains unclear. Existing benchmark paradigms often suffer from fragmented evaluation, focusing on isolated cognitive stages while overlooking the inherent synergy between perception, reasoning, and physical judgment. The lack of a holistic perspective limits the ability to diagnose whether VLMs can reliably evaluate the physical authenticity of emerging generative models. To address these issues, we introduce PhysVista, a benchmark designed to evaluate physical intelligence in VLMs through a closed cognitive loop framework inspired by the human seeing-reasoning-assessment process. PhysVista restores this loop by jointly evaluating physical state perception, physical dynamics reasoning, and physical plausibility assessment. It further distinguishes event-level reasoning and scale-level reasoning to enable fine-grained analysis of physical understanding. In addition, PhysVista incorporates both real-world and AI-generated videos, allowing evaluation across diverse domains and emerging generative scenarios. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of VLMs reveal substantial limitations in physical reasoning and plausibility assessment, highlighting a persistent gap between visual recognition and genuine physical understanding, and pointing toward more principled designs for physically grounded multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PhysVista 基准，通过"感知—推理—评估"闭环框架，联合评测视觉语言模型的物理状态感知、物理动态推理与物理合理性评估能力，并区分事件级与尺度级推理，覆盖真实及 AI 生成视频，实验揭示当前 VLM 在物理理解上存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽具备较强多模态推理能力，但其是否真正掌握真实世界动态背后的物理一致性尚不明确。现有基准多采用碎片化评测，仅关注孤立的认知阶段，忽视感知、推理与物理判断之间的协同，缺乏整体视角，难以诊断 VLM 能否可靠评估生成模型的物理真实性。
AI.method: 提出 PhysVista 基准，受人类"看—推理—判断"过程启发，构建闭环认知框架：联合评测物理状态感知、物理动态推理和物理合理性评估；进一步区分事件级推理与尺度级推理，以支持细粒度分析；同时纳入真实世界视频与 AI 生成视频，实现跨领域及新兴生成场景的评测。
AI.result: 在多样化 VLM 上的大量实验显示，模型在物理推理与合理性评估方面存在明显局限，表明视觉识别与真正的物理理解之间仍存在持续差距。
AI.conclusion: PhysVista 为物理基础型多模态智能提供了更系统的诊断工具，揭示了现有 VLM 物理理解的结构性缺陷，并指向更具原则性的物理落地多模态智能设计方向。

title: FORTE: Adaptive Scoring and Exact Keyframe Selection for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Query-aware keyframe selection enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process long videos using only a small set of question-relevant frames. Existing score-based methods, however, typically search within a fixed, uniformly sampled candidate pool, preventing evidence outside this pool from ever being selected. Given a limited relevance-scoring budget, the key challenge is to allocate evaluations adaptively to promising frames while continuing to explore underrepresented temporal regions. We introduce FORTE, a training-free framework that addresses this challenge through two stages: adaptive relevance scoring and global keyframe optimization. Starting from sparse, uniformly distributed observations, our efficient Gaussian-process relevance predictor estimates relevance for unscored frames, exploiting temporal locality and the approximately banded kernel structure to reduce the core computation from cubic to linear time in the number of frames for fixed bandwidth. The scoring stage then selects which frames to score next by balancing predicted relevance with temporal coverage, prioritizing promising regions while also exploring less-represented parts of the video. The optimization stage selects the final keyframes by maximizing an objective that jointly captures measured relevance and temporal coverage. We derive an exact algorithm that leverages the logarithmic coverage structure to identify the optimal subset of the scored candidate pool in time linear in the pool size, for a fixed final-frame budget. Experiments on four long-video question-answering benchmarks show that FORTE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the compared selectors under every tested scoring budget. Further evaluations demonstrate its consistent effectiveness across different relevance scorers and downstream MLLMs.

AI.tldr: FORTE：免训练、查询感知的关键帧选择框架，通过自适应相关性评分与全局关键帧优化，在有限评分预算下实现线性时间的高效视频问答。
AI.motivation: 现有基于分数的方法在固定且均匀采样的候选池内搜索，池外证据无法被选入；在有限相关性评分预算下，如何把评分评估自适应分配给有潜力的帧，同时持续探索覆盖不足的时间区域，是关键挑战。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1）自适应相关性评分：从稀疏均匀观测出发，用高效高斯过程相关性预测器估计未评分帧的相关性，利用时间局部性与近似带状核结构，将核心计算从立方复杂度降为关于帧数的线性时间；评分阶段在预测相关性与时间覆盖之间权衡，选择下一批待评分帧。2）全局关键帧优化：最大化同时刻画实测相关性与时间覆盖的目标函数，利用对数覆盖结构推导精确算法，在固定最终帧预算下以关于候选池规模的线性时间找出最优子集。
AI.result: 在四个长视频问答基准上，FORTE 在所有测试评分预算下均取得所比较选择器中最高的平均准确率；进一步评估显示其在不同相关性评分器与下游 MLLM 上具有一致有效性。
AI.conclusion: FORTE 以免训练方式解决了固定候选池的局限，通过自适应评分与精确优化在有限预算下兼顾相关性与时间覆盖，且具备线性时间效率与跨评分器、跨 MLLM 的泛化性。

title: Gestalt: Large Multimodal Interplay Model
summary: In this paper, we propose Gestalt, a new paradigm of large multimodal model built around multimodal interplay. Despite rapid advances, large multimodal models are reaching a bottleneck: existing approaches focus primarily on accommodating additional modalities while overlooking the distinct characteristics of each modality and the relations among them. Motivated by the multistage property of human multisensory perception, we propose a multimodal interplay pyramid that organizes multimodal modeling as a progression from modality-specific processing, through cross-modal alignment, to deeper multimodal integration. Guided by this pyramid, Gestalt adopts a unified discrete diffusion framework and an interplay-partitioned architecture, with learnable interplay tokens mediating cross-modal exchange and integration. The pyramid also structures its data organization and training strategy. Strong performance across image generation, multimodal understanding, and text-only evaluation shows that Gestalt significantly improves cross-modal integration while preserving modality-specific information, effectively harnessing the strengths of diffusion-based multimodal models and offering a promising path toward unified multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Gestalt，一种以多模态交互（multimodal interplay）为核心的新型大型多模态模型范式。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态模型主要致力于容纳更多模态，却忽视了各模态的独特特性及其相互关系，导致性能出现瓶颈。作者受人类多感官感知的多阶段特性启发，试图重构多模态建模的组织方式。
AI.method: 提出"多模态交互金字塔"（multimodal interplay pyramid），将建模组织为从模态专属处理、跨模态对齐到深层多模态整合的渐进过程。基于该金字塔，Gestalt 采用统一离散扩散框架与交互分区架构，并以可学习的交互 token（interplay tokens）作为跨模态交换与整合的中介；金字塔还用于指导数据组织与训练策略。
AI.result: 在图像生成、多模态理解以及纯文本评测中均取得强劲表现，显著提升了跨模态整合能力，同时保留模态专属信息。
AI.conclusion: Gestalt 有效发挥了基于扩散的多模态模型优势，为通向统一多模态智能提供了一条有前景的路径。

title: Discrete Annotation, Continuous Preference: Rethinking Supervision for Accurate and Generalizable Aesthetic Image Cropping
comment: Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC
summary: Aesthetic image cropping aims to identify the optimal crop of an image in terms of aesthetics and composition. While supervision based on annotated data is fundamental, the field has been hindered by a long-standing problem: existing datasets suffer from (1) human subjectivity and (2) rigid discreteness confined to fixed sampling grids. These flawed annotations not only limit the accuracy and generalization of trained models but also severely distort fair evaluation. To overcome this, we propose to model human cropping preference as a multi-peaked, continuous, and sharp field over the crop space. We introduce the Continuous Preference Field (CPF), which recovers a dense preference landscape from discrete annotations through (1) peak clustering, (2) off-lattice refinement, (3) negative shaping, and (4) field assembly. Based on this, we train CPIC, a VLM-based cropping model optimized via GRPO with the CPF reward, which overcomes template collapse, achieving state-of-the-art performance and exceptional out-of-domain generalization. Finally, to resolve the long-standing benchmark evaluation crisis, we introduce CPICD, a comprehensive recalibration of existing ground-truth boxes. By leveraging the CPF to correct grid-bound artifacts across mainstream benchmarks, CPICD establishes a rigorous and reliable foundation for future cropping research. Extensive experiments and user studies demonstrate the superiority of our CPF, CPIC, and CPICD. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对美学图像裁剪中标注数据存在的主观性和离散网格缺陷，提出连续偏好场（CPF）建模人类裁剪偏好，并基于此训练VLM裁剪模型CPIC，同时发布重新校准的基准数据集CPICD。
AI.motivation: 现有裁剪数据集存在两大问题：(1) 人类主观性导致标注不一致；(2) 标注局限于固定采样网格，具有刚性离散性。这些缺陷不仅限制模型精度与泛化能力，还严重扭曲了公平评估，造成长期存在的基准评估危机。
AI.method: 将人类裁剪偏好建模为裁剪空间上的多峰、连续且尖锐的场，提出连续偏好场（CPF），通过(1)峰值聚类、(2)离格精化、(3)负向塑形、(4)场组装四个步骤，从离散标注中恢复稠密偏好景观。基于CPF奖励，采用GRPO优化训练VLM裁剪模型CPIC，克服模板坍塌问题。并利用CPF修正主流基准中的网格绑定伪影，构建CPICD。
AI.result: CPIC达到最先进性能并具备出色的域外泛化能力；CPICD为主流基准建立了严谨可靠的评估基础，大量实验与用户研究验证了CPF、CPIC和CPICD的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 通过连续偏好场建模，论文同时解决了标注缺陷、模型训练与评估基准三大问题，为未来美学裁剪研究奠定了可靠基础。

title: Just Align $\bm{x}$: Aligning Predictions, Not Representations
summary: Representation alignment has become an effective way to accelerate diffusion training, but its benefits do not transfer reliably to pixel-space clean-image prediction. In JiT, we find that auxiliary feature alignment can improve access to semantic features while reducing access to image variation needed for clean-image prediction, creating a mismatch between the auxiliary objective and the denoising task. This suggests a different principle: auxiliary supervision should improve the prediction target itself rather than impose a separate representation target. We introduce JAx (Just Align x), a prediction-supervision method that aligns clean-image predictions across noise levels. JAx couples a noisier student observation with a cleaner observation through a Markov degradation that preserves the original JiT input distribution. Under this coupling, the oracle prediction from the cleaner state has the same conditional mean as the optimal JiT target, while its conditional target covariance is no greater. Thus, oracle prediction alignment preserves the population JiT objective up to a constant while providing a lower-variance training target. To make this construction practical with an imperfect EMA teacher, JAx combines ground-truth supervision with a reliability-gated coupling band that selects nearby teacher states based on prediction risk. On ImageNet 256x256, JAx consistently improves FID and accelerates convergence across JiT-B/16, L/16, and H/16, without an external encoder or changes to the architecture or sampling procedure. Gradient diagnostics further show reduced minibatch gradient variance, while ablations demonstrate that the gains cannot be explained by time reweighting alone. These results show that prediction-space supervision provides a simple and principled alternative to representation alignment for pixel-space generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JAx(Just Align x)，一种针对像素空间生成模型的预测监督方法，通过对齐不同噪声水平下的干净图像预测(而非对齐表征)来加速扩散训练，在不改变架构、采样流程且无需外部编码器的情况下提升FID并加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 表征对齐虽能加速扩散训练，但其收益无法可靠迁移到像素空间的干净图像预测任务。作者在JiT中发现辅助特征对齐在提升语义特征可获得性的同时，减少了干净图像预测所需的图像变化信息，导致辅助目标与去噪任务之间出现不匹配。由此提出新原则：辅助监督应改进预测目标本身，而非施加独立的表征目标。
AI.method: JAx通过对齐跨噪声水平的干净图像预测来实现监督。它通过一个保持原JiT输入分布的马尔可夫退化过程，将噪声更大的学生观测与更干净的观测耦合。在该耦合下，来自更干净状态的oracle预测与最优JiT目标具有相同的条件均值，而条件目标协方差不大于后者，因此在常数范围内保持总体JiT目标，同时提供更低方差的训练目标。为在存在不完美EMA教师时实用化，JAx结合真值监督与可靠性门控耦合带，根据预测风险选择邻近的教师状态。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，JAx在JiT-B/16、L/16和H/16上一致提升FID并加速收敛，且无需外部编码器，也不改变架构或采样流程。梯度诊断显示小批量梯度方差降低，消融实验表明收益不能仅由时间重加权解释。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，预测空间监督为像素空间生成模型提供了一种简单且有原则的表征对齐替代方案。

title: HAWK: Rethinking Multimodal Drafting for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding has achieved substantial lossless speedups for LLMs, but remains less effective for large vision-language models (LVLMs), where lightweight drafters struggle to use rich multimodal information. A second limitation is that standard distillation supervises the drafter only along the original training trajectory, without modeling how target predictions shift after the drafter's own proposals. As drafting moves away from this trajectory, the drafter can increasingly disagree with the target, reducing acceptance in later steps. We propose HAWK to address both limitations. HAWK uses representation similarity to select informative target layers and learns how to combine their hidden states. For visual information, it directly provides the drafter with compressed visual hidden states from the target model instead of raw visual tokens, making the visual information easier for a shallow drafter to use. HAWK also trains the drafter to capture how target predictions change after its own proposals, improving its agreement with the target during multi-step drafting. On SmolVLM-256M across ten multimodal benchmarks, HAWK raises average acceptance length from 3.32 to 4.08 and speedup from 2.19x to 2.60x over EAGLE-3 under greedy decoding, and from 2.89 to 3.41 and 1.92x to 2.19x under sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出HAWK方法，通过表征相似度选择目标层、直接提供压缩视觉隐状态、并训练草稿模型建模目标预测偏移，提升大规模视觉语言模型推测解码的接受长度与加速比。
AI.motivation: 推测解码（speculative decoding）对LLM已实现显著无损加速，但对大规模视觉语言模型（LVLM）效果有限：一是轻量草稿模型难以利用丰富的多模态信息；二是标准蒸馏仅在原始训练轨迹上监督草稿模型，未建模草稿模型自身提议后目标预测如何变化，导致多步草稿中与目标模型分歧增大、后续步骤接受率下降。
AI.method: HAWK包含三部分：（1）利用表征相似度选择信息量高的目标层，并学习如何组合其隐状态；（2）面向视觉信息，直接向草稿模型提供目标模型压缩后的视觉隐状态而非原始视觉token，使浅层草稿模型更易使用；（3）训练草稿模型捕获在其自身提议之后目标预测的变化，提升多步推测时与目标模型的一致性。
AI.result: 在SmolVLM-256M、十个多模态基准上，相对EAGLE-3：贪心解码下平均接受长度由3.32提升至4.08，加速比由2.19x提升至2.60x；采样解码下平均接受长度由2.89提升至3.41，加速比由1.92x提升至2.19x。
AI.conclusion: HAWK同时缓解了LVLM推测解码中多模态信息利用不足与多步草稿一致性下降两个问题，在多个多模态基准上稳定提升接受长度与加速比，验证了表征层选择、压缩视觉隐状态注入及预测偏移建模的有效性。

title: VisionQ: VLM-as-a-Judge Taxonomy, Dataset and Benchmark for Qualitative Analysis in Computer Vision
summary: Qualitative comparison figures are central evidence in computer vision papers, and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to judge them. Yet existing benchmarks score only scalar quality or overall preference, so a judge can be rewarded for picking the preferred image for the wrong visual reason. We introduce VisionQ, the first benchmark built from peer-reviewed CV comparison figures that grounds every judgment in a named visual criterion: each question states the criterion, and a judge is credited only when it selects the output the authors identify as best on that criterion. We call this task criterion-conditioned visual discrimination. VisionQ comprises (1) a corpus of 1,409 CVPR and ICCV papers with 1,800+ validated comparison figures and 3,911 hand-annotated data points linking method crops to author-stated visual claims; (2) a six-axis, 51-leaf taxonomy of the visual criteria behind qualitative judgment; (3) a criterion-conditioned evaluation protocol that hides method names, captions, and paper identity and reports accuracy per criterion; and (4) VisionQ-Judge, a DPO-tuned Gemma-4-E4B judge trained on symmetric evidence pairs, which reduces last-option predictions by 7.0pp and improves accuracy by 2.5pp on a held-out test set. Evaluating 20 open- and closed-source VLM judges, we find that the strongest reach only 63.1% accuracy (chance 32.2%) and that reliability varies sharply across criteria. Code: https://github.com/ReML-AI/visionq. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/visionq-anon-2026/VisionQ-1k.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VisionQ，首个基于同行评审 CV 定性对比图的基准，将评判锚定在明确的视觉准则上，并配套提出准则条件化评估协议与 DPO 调优的 VisionQ-Judge 模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅评估标量质量或整体偏好，导致评判模型可能因错误的视觉理由而"答对"，缺乏对评判依据的约束与可解释性。
AI.method: 构建 VisionQ 基准：包含 1,409 篇 CVPR/ICCV 论文、1,800+ 验证过的对比图、3,911 个人工标注数据点；提出六轴 51 叶的视觉准则分类体系；设计隐藏方法名、图注与论文身份的准则条件化评估协议；并基于对称证据对，用 DPO 微调 Gemma-4-E4B 得到 VisionQ-Judge。
AI.result: VisionQ-Judge 将末选项预测降低 7.0pp，在留出测试集上准确率提升 2.5pp；评测 20 个开源与闭源 VLM 评判模型，最强模型仅达 63.1% 准确率（随机基线 32.2%），且跨准则可靠性差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 准则条件化的视觉判别任务揭示了当前 VLM 评判模型在定性对比图理解上的严重不足，VisionQ 为该方向提供了可复现的基准、分类体系与评估范式。

title: Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Perceptual Quality Assessment and Autonomous Content Adjustment in Augmented Reality
comment: To be published in VRST 2026. Main Manuscript: 12 pages, 5 figures; Supplemental Materials: 7 pages, 10 figures. The accompanying public repository can be accessed by visiting https://github.com/Duke-I3T-Lab/RateAR
summary: Advancements in augmented reality (AR) continue to foster innovative solutions, facilitating novel methodologies within educational systems, healthcare delivery, and risk-mitigation protocols. However, optimizing for end-user immersion and comfort remains challenging, as AR head-mounted displays contend with constrained scene geometry, spatial jitter, and temporal instability. User studies are the standard AR evaluation method for visual quality, but their cost, diminishing scalability, and inflexibility pose bottlenecks during iterative application design. To address this problem, we present an automated framework for AR content evaluation and refinement, built on vision-language models (VLMs), to evaluate and predict the visual fidelity of AR scenes as perceived by users. First, we introduce RateAR, a benchmark of AR images and videos collected across diverse scenes and environmental conditions, with good-to-excellent reliability (ICC(2,5) >= .90) across perceptual factors, including object placement, scale, and shadow consistency. Subsequently, we evaluate eleven commercial VLMs on the crafted benchmark. Results support that VLM-based quality predictions strongly correlate with human subjective judgments, achieving Spearman's rank-order correlations of up to 0.8695. An ablation study further suggests that, compared to other prompting strategies, our contextual prompting yields better alignment with human ratings while balancing introduced complexity cues. Building on these findings, we construct an automated AR content adjustment system and conduct a 21-participant user study. More than 90% of participants found that the system improved placement and size coherence of virtual content.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自动化AR内容评估与优化框架，构建RateAR基准，验证VLM预测与人类主观评分高度相关，并实现自动内容调整系统。
AI.motivation: AR头显受限于场景几何、空间抖动与时间不稳定，用户沉浸感与舒适度优化困难；传统用户研究成本高、可扩展性差、灵活性低，成为迭代设计瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建RateAR基准（涵盖多场景与环境条件的AR图像/视频，感知因素含物体摆放、尺度、阴影一致性，ICC(2,5)≥.90）；评测11个商用VLM；开展消融实验比较提示策略；基于发现构建自动化AR内容调整系统并开展21人用户研究。
AI.result: VLM质量预测与人类主观判断强相关，Spearman等级相关最高达0.8695；情境化提示在与人评对齐和复杂度线索之间取得更优平衡；超过90%的参与者认为系统改善了虚拟内容的摆放与尺寸一致性。
AI.conclusion: VLM可有效替代或辅助传统用户研究，实现可扩展的AR视觉质量评估与自动内容优化。

title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
comment: 29 pages, 22 figures, including references and appendix; 9 pages of main text
summary: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone. SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\times$ its size, and larger SemanTok AR models further improve fidelity. It keeps semantic alignment on out-of-distribution classes and gives the decoder higher semantic alignment at every noise level, including pure noise. It performs well in both reconstruction and generation, and its short token prefixes are cheaper to predict and give better generation fidelity, with pixel detail deferred to later tokens.

AI.tldr: SemanTok是一种灵活长度的视频分词器，通过在编码器中注入冻结的DINO特征并添加轻量级重建头，使每个保留的token前缀都能重建语义特征，从而在语义对齐和视频保真度上超越更大规模的基线模型。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型需要在保真度和语义之间取得平衡，而分词器的选择至关重要。现有的灵活分词器仅在早期解码器隐藏状态上应用REPA损失，但解码器可以部分地从其含噪输入中满足这一目标，导致语义对齐不足。
AI.method: 提出SemanTok，将冻结的DINO特征输入编码器，并添加轻量级头从每个保留的token前缀中单独重建这些特征，实现粗到细的灵活长度视频分词。
AI.result: 201M的SemanTok AR模型匹配或超越3.4倍大小的VideoFlexTok AR模型；更大模型进一步提升保真度；在分布外类别上保持语义对齐；在每个噪声级别（包括纯噪声）为解码器提供更高的语义对齐；重建和生成均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: SemanTok通过将语义特征重建与token前缀直接绑定，实现了高语义对齐和高视频保真度，短token前缀预测成本低且生成保真度更好，像素细节推迟到后续token。

title: FedMAD: Modulation-Aware Directional Aggregation for Federated Learning in Remote Sensing Image Classification
summary: Federated learning (FL) has recently attracted increasing attention in remote sensing (RS) since it enables collaborative model training across decentralized RS image archives without requiring direct access to local data. However, FL performance significantly degrades when the data distributions between clients are heterogeneous, which often occurs due to geographical differences, seasonal changes, and varying image acquisition and atmospheric conditions. To address this challenge, in this letter, we propose a novel personalized FL framework (denoted as FedMAD) for RS image classification problems. The proposed framework separates globally shared representation parameters from client-specific adaptation parameters to preserve client-specific features while maintaining globally transferable representations. This is achieved by integrating lightweight modulation modules and local batch normalization layers into the backbone network. Although globally shared parameters are collaboratively optimized between clients, client-specific parameters remain local to preserve domain-specific feature characteristics. In addition, FedMAD introduces a modulation-aware directional aggregation strategy that dynamically adjusts the importance of aggregation for each client according to the alignment of local modulation updates. This allows the global optimization process to suppress conflicting client updates originating from heterogeneous data distributions while enhancing the contribution of clients with consistent adaptation behaviors. The experimental results obtained on the BigEarthNet-S2 and EuroSAT datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedMAD compared to state-of-the-art FL algorithms under heterogeneous RS data distributions. The code of the proposed framework will be publicly available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/rsim/fedmad.

AI.tldr: 提出个性化联邦学习框架FedMAD，通过分离全局共享表征参数与客户端特定适配参数，并引入调制感知的方向性聚合策略，缓解遥感图像分类中数据异构导致的性能下降。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在遥感领域受到关注，因其可在不直接访问本地数据的情况下实现去中心化遥感图像库的协同训练。但客户端间数据分布异构（由地理差异、季节变化、成像与大气条件不同引起）会显著降低联邦学习性能。
AI.method: 提出个性化联邦学习框架FedMAD。将全局共享表征参数与客户端特定适配参数分离，在骨干网络中集成轻量调制模块和本地批归一化层，以在保持全局可迁移表征的同时保留客户端特定特征；全局共享参数在客户端间协同优化，客户端特定参数保留在本地。此外引入调制感知的方向性聚合策略，根据本地调制更新的一致性动态调整各客户端的聚合重要性。
AI.result: 在BigEarthNet-S2和EuroSAT数据集上的实验结果表明，在异构遥感数据分布下，FedMAD相比现有最先进联邦学习算法具有有效性。
AI.conclusion: FedMAD能抑制源自异构数据分布的冲突客户端更新，并增强具有一致适配行为的客户端的贡献，从而提升异构遥感数据分布下的分类性能，代码将公开。

title: Personalized Image Generation with Reasoning and Reflection
summary: Personalized image generation has remained narrowly focused on conditional synthesis from curated visual exemplars, rather than capturing who a user is. In practice, however, a user's personal context is much richer, comprising reviews, posts, images, captions, and metadata accumulated over time. A truly personalized generator should leverage this history to produce images aligned with the user's lifestyle and aesthetic preferences. To this end, we introduce the first unified benchmark for personalized image generation from user histories. The benchmark comprises two complementary tasks and a multi-axis evaluation protocol that assesses target fidelity, visual quality, user distinguishability, semantic alignment with the user's history, and task-specific utility. Grounded in real-world e-commerce and social media settings, the benchmark includes: (1) Personalized Scene Generation, which places a given object in a scene that reflects a user's preferences and lifestyle, motivated by personalized product presentation; and (2) Personalized Creative Generation, which generates a novel image on a specified topic that is faithful to a user's aesthetic and visual identity, motivated by social media content creation. We further propose PEARL, which couples a multimodal reasoner with a frozen image generator in an interleaved reason-reflect loop optimized with differential data reward. Across both tasks, PEARL outperforms strong baselines, achieving an average improvement of 15% across personalization metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于用户历史的个性化图像生成统一基准（含个性化场景生成与个性化创意生成两项任务及多维度评估协议），并给出方法PEARL，在个性化指标上平均提升15%。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化图像生成局限于基于精选视觉样例的条件合成，无法刻画"用户是谁"；而真实场景中用户个人语境更丰富，包含随时间积累的评论、帖子、图像、标题与元数据，真正个性化的生成器应利用这些历史生成契合其生活方式与审美偏好的图像。
AI.method: 构建统一基准：包含两项互补任务（1）个性化场景生成，将给定物体置于反映用户偏好与生活方式的场景中，面向个性化商品展示；（2）个性化创意生成，围绕指定主题生成忠实于用户审美与视觉身份的新图像，面向社交媒体内容创作；并设计多轴评估协议，考察目标保真度、视觉质量、用户可区分性、与用户历史的语义一致性以及任务特定效用。同时提出PEARL，将多模态推理器与冻结的图像生成器耦合，在交错的"推理—反思"循环中运行，并用差分数据奖励进行优化。
AI.result: 在两项任务上，PEARL均优于强基线，个性化指标平均提升15%。
AI.conclusion: 基于用户历史的个性化图像生成具有实际价值，统一基准与多轴评估为该方向提供了可比较的评测框架，PEARL验证了"多模态推理+冻结生成器+奖励优化"范式的有效性。

title: What Builds the Scene? Luminance Dominates Geometry Formation in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) learns geometry and appearance jointly from RGB supervision, making it difficult to isolate how luminance and chroma contribute to the learned representation. We study this by training models under different channel supervision, freezing their non-appearance parameters (position, scale, rotation, and opacity), and re-estimating appearance with the same solver before comparing held-out reconstruction. Across eleven benchmark scenes with four independent runs each, geometry learned from luminance alone supports held-out reconstruction 0.085 dB below RGB-trained geometry on average. If chroma is deleted from a trained model, a sufficiently expressive solver can re-fit it on the frozen geometry to the original quality or slightly better. Higher-order spherical harmonics contribute much more reconstruction quality to luminance than to chroma, improving PSNR by 1.44 dB versus 0.19 dB on average, although on mirror-like surfaces hue does still change with viewpoint. The luminance advantage is even larger when geometry is being formed. Chroma-only supervision produces geometry 3.9-5.5 dB worse than luminance-only supervision after the same appearance solve; densification explains part of this gap. Overall, geometry formation in standard 3DGS is strongly luminance-dominated but not luminance-exclusive, and much of the chromatic appearance can be recovered after spatial support has formed.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分离亮度与色度监督，研究标准3DGS中几何与外观学习的分工，发现几何形成强烈由亮度主导但非排他，色度外观可在空间支撑形成后被重新拟合恢复。
AI.motivation: 标准3DGS从RGB监督中联合学习几何与外观，难以区分亮度与色度各自对所学表示的贡献。作者希望厘清这两种通道信息在几何形成与外观重建中的作用与可分离性。
AI.method: 在不同通道监督下训练模型，冻结非外观参数（位置、尺度、旋转、不透明度），用同一求解器重新估计外观，再比较留出集重建；在十一个基准场景、每场景四次独立运行下进行对比，并分析高阶球谐贡献、仅色度监督以及致密化对差距的影响。
AI.result: 仅用亮度学习的几何在留出重建上平均比RGB训练几何低0.085 dB；从训练模型删除色度后，足够表达的求解器可在冻结几何上重新拟合并达到原质量或略优。高阶球谐对亮度的重建质量贡献远大于色度，平均提升1.44 dB对比0.19 dB，尽管镜面表面上色调仍随视角变化。亮度优势在几何形成阶段更大；仅色度监督的几何比仅亮度监督差3.9–5.5 dB，致密化解释了部分差距。
AI.conclusion: 标准3DGS的几何形成强烈由亮度主导，但并非亮度排他；一旦空间支撑形成，大部分色度外观可以恢复。

title: Video Evidence Indexing: Learning Where to Look from Video Previews for Token-Budgeted Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Long-video question answering is limited by the high cost of visual tokens and by the fixed context width of current VLMs. A long-video question may require broad temporal coverage, but the answer is often supported by only a compact set of moments. To locate these moments efficiently, we propose token-budgeted Video Evidence Indexing (VEI): given a dense low-resolution Video Preview, the model constructs a compact high-resolution Evidence Set for final reasoning. We treat VEI as a policy that must jointly solve \textit{evidence localization}, which finds question-relevant moments, and \textit{budget planning}, which decides where to spend the limited high-resolution frame budget. We implement this idea with an inference pipeline: the Video Preview provides cheap global coverage, Video Evidence Indexing constructs the Evidence Set, and Answer Generation combines both inputs for final VQA. To address missing frame-level supervision, we adopt privileged self-distillation, where an answer-aware teacher guides the normal test-time policy on student-generated indexing traces. We explore previews at 1, 6, 12, and 24 visual tokens per frame, training a single policy that supports all four resolutions. Experiments show that Video Evidence Indexing improves accuracy under limited visual budgets, and self-distillation further improves both QA accuracy and temporal evidence localization.

AI.tldr: 提出Token预算的视频证据索引（VEI），把长视频问答分解为证据定位与预算规划，用低分辨率预览构建高分辨率证据集，并通过特权自蒸馏训练单策略。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答受限于视觉token高成本与VLM固定上下文宽度；长视频问题需广泛时间覆盖，但答案往往只依赖少量紧凑关键时刻，因此需高效定位这些时刻。
AI.method: 提出Token-budgeted Video Evidence Indexing（VEI）：由密集低分辨率Video Preview构建紧凑高分辨率Evidence Set。将VEI视为需联合求解证据定位（找问题相关时刻）与预算规划（分配高分辨率帧预算）的策略。推理流程为：Video Preview提供廉价全局覆盖，VEI构建Evidence Set，Answer Generation结合两者做最终VQA。针对缺失帧级监督，采用特权自蒸馏，由答案感知教师在全学生生成的索引轨迹上指导测试时策略。探索每帧1、6、12、24个视觉token的预览，训练一个支持四种分辨率的单一策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，在有限视觉预算下VEI提升准确率；自蒸馏进一步提升QA准确率与时间证据定位能力。
AI.conclusion: VEI通过预算化的证据索引与自蒸馏，在受限视觉预算下同时改善长视频问答精度与证据定位，验证了证据定位与预算规划联合建模的有效性。

title: VTV-FM: Flow Matching through Variational Terminal-Velocity Closure
summary: Flow matching (FM) learns generative transport by fitting continuous-time motion from a simple source distribution to the data distribution. Most existing methods use first-order bridges: once a source and a target sample are paired, the path is a straight motion with constant velocity. FM with optimal transport (OT) improves the pairing, but the bridge itself remains linear, limiting its ability to model curved motion, acceleration, and changing directions. A natural remedy is to use second-order phase-space dynamics; however, learning the bridge requires target-side terminal-velocity information that static datasets do not provide. We propose Variational Terminal-Velocity Flow Matching (VTV-FM), a second-order FM framework that derives the missing velocity by minimizing acceleration energy, yielding a closed-form closure for static data. The same minimum-acceleration variational construction also defines the OT pairing cost and the acceleration targets used for training. Experiments on low-dimensional datasets, PDE-governed physical fields, and CIFAR-10 show that VTV-FM improves transport geometry and generation quality over first-order and high-order FM baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VTV-FM，一种二阶流匹配框架，通过最小化加速度能量为静态数据推导缺失的终端速度，从而在静态数据集上实现二阶相空间动力学的闭式求解，并统一用于OT配对代价与加速度训练目标。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配方法多采用一阶桥：源样本与目标样本配对后路径为恒速直线运动。即使结合最优传输（OT）改进配对，桥本身仍为线性，难以建模曲线运动、加速度与方向变化。补救思路是采用二阶相空间动力学，但学习该桥需要目标侧的终端速度信息，而静态数据集不提供这一信息。
AI.method: 提出变分终端速度流匹配（VTV-FM）。核心是通过最小化加速度能量来推导缺失的目标侧速度，为静态数据给出闭式补全（closed-form closure）。同一最小加速度变分构造同时定义了OT配对代价与训练所用的加速度目标，从而将二阶桥的学习、配对与监督信号统一在同一变分框架下。
AI.result: 在低维数据集、PDE支配的物理场以及CIFAR-10上开展实验，结果显示VTV-FM在传输几何与生成质量两方面均优于一阶流匹配与高阶流匹配基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过最小加速度变分为静态数据补全终端速度，VTV-FM使二阶流匹配在无速度标注的静态数据集上可行，并统一了配对与训练目标；实验证明其二阶桥能改善传输几何与生成质量，优于现有流匹配基线。

title: Paying for Too Many Tokens? Valid and Cost-Efficient Multimodal LLM Annotation with Simple Heuristics
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable video annotation at scale, but costs accumulate quickly: processing a typical 60-second short-form video at one frame per second requires millions of tokens. To reduce costs, researchers rely on heuristics such as sampling a subset of frames, compressing videos into image grids, or using only a single modality. However, it remains unclear which heuristics save cost, and whether they preserve the downstream conclusions these annotations enable. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic evaluation of these heuristics using short-form videos, on two computational social science (CSS) tasks: sentiment and topic classification. We evaluate each configuration along three axes the literature typically treats separately: classification accuracy, validity of downstream inference, and per-video token cost. First, we find that accuracy and validity diverge: the highest-accuracy configuration can produce wrong conclusions. Second, modality value is not guaranteed: text alone can yield strong performance, indicating that adding modalities can add cost without adding signal. Finally, we find that cost can be decoupled from video length when annotating short-form videos: a single $2\times8$ image grid built via simple shot-transition detection approaches full-video understanding ($κ$ within~.05), at $\sim 15\%$ of the token cost. Based on these findings, we derive guidelines that can enable cost-aware VLM annotation in CSS.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了短格式视频中视觉语言模型（VLM）标注的三种节约成本启发式策略，在情感与主题分类两个计算社会科学任务上，从分类准确率、下游推断有效性和每视频token成本三轴进行评测，发现准确率与有效性存在分离、模态价值并非必然、且成本可与视频长度解耦。
AI.motivation: VLM使大规模视频标注成为可能，但成本高昂：处理一段典型60秒短视频（每秒1帧）需数百万token。研究者常用采样部分帧、压缩为图像网格或仅用单模态等启发式降低成本，但尚不清楚哪些启发式真正省钱，以及它们是否保留下游结论的有效性，因此需要系统评估。
AI.method: 在短格式视频上，针对计算社会科学（CSS）的情感与主题分类两项任务，系统评估上述启发式配置，并沿三个文献中通常被分开处理的维度进行衡量：分类准确率、下游推断的有效性、每视频token成本。
AI.result: 一、准确率与有效性出现分离：准确率最高的配置可能得出错误结论；二、模态价值并非保证：仅用文本即可获得较强性能，说明增加模态会增加成本而不增加信号；三、对于短格式视频，成本可与视频长度解耦：通过简单镜头切换检测构建的单一2×8图像网格，在约15%的token成本下即可接近完整视频理解（κ差异在~.05以内）。
AI.conclusion: 基于上述发现，本文提出可指导计算社会科学中成本感知的VLM标注的准则。

title: Video Generation Models: A Survey of Post-Training and Alignment
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. Project page: https://github.com/people-robots/Awesome-Video-Generation-Post-Training
summary: Video generation has rapidly progressed from short, low-quality clips to high-resolution, long-duration sequences with complex spatiotemporal dynamics. Despite strong generative priors learned through large-scale pretraining, pretrained video models often fail to reliably follow human intent, maintain temporal coherence, or satisfy physical and safety constraints. Compared with image and text generation, alignment in video generation presents unique challenges, including error accumulation over time, motion-appearance coupling, multi-objective trade-offs, and limited supervision for temporal properties. These challenges motivate systematic post-training strategies that adapt pretrained models without retraining them from scratch. In this survey, we present the first comprehensive review of post-training and alignment in video generation models. We frame post-training as a unifying framework and distinguish between implicit alignment and explicit alignment based on how alignment signals are enforced. From this perspective, we organize existing approaches into four broad categories: supervised fine-tuning methods, self-training and distillation methods, preference- and reward-based methods, and inference-time methods. This taxonomy provides a coherent view of how alignment signals shape model behavior across both training and deployment. Beyond methodological advances, we review commonly used datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation practices, and discuss open challenges such as scalable reward design, long-horizon temporal consistency, stability-expressiveness trade-offs, and safety-aware generation. This survey aims to provide a structured conceptual foundation and practical guidance for advancing controllable and reliable video generation models.

AI.tldr: 本文是首篇系统综述视频生成模型后训练与对齐工作的论文，提出统一框架并以"对齐信号如何施加"为标准将方法分为监督微调、自训练与蒸馏、偏好与奖励、推理时方法四大类，同时梳理数据集、基准与评估实践及开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 视频生成已从短片低质发展到高分辨率、长时长、复杂时空动态，但预训练视频模型常难以可靠遵循人类意图、保持时序一致性、满足物理与安全约束。相比图像和文本生成，视频对齐存在误差随时间累积、运动-外观耦合、多目标权衡、时序属性监督不足等独特挑战，因此需要不从头重训、而是适配预训练模型的系统性后训练策略。
AI.method: 作者将后训练作为统一分析框架，依据对齐信号的施加方式区分隐式对齐与显式对齐，并据此把现有方法归纳为四类：监督微调方法、自训练与蒸馏方法、基于偏好与奖励的方法、推理时方法；同时综述常用数据集、基准与评估实践。
AI.result: 该分类法给出了对齐信号在训练与部署阶段如何塑造模型行为的一致视角，并系统整理了相关数据集、基准与评估实践，指出可扩展奖励设计、长时程时序一致性、稳定性-表现力权衡、安全感知生成等开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该综述旨在为推进可控、可靠的视频生成模型提供结构化的概念基础与实践指导，并作为视频生成后训练与对齐领域的首个全面回顾。

title: Align Then Reason: A Multimodal Lip-Sync Judge for Dubbing
summary: Dubbing quality control requires a reference-free judge that can determine whether a candidate text line matches a speaker's visible articulation in both content and timing, using only silent video and text because dubbed audio may not yet exist. Existing visual speech recognizers and video-language models are poorly suited to this setting: even when fine-tuned to recover spoken content from lip motion, they remain largely insensitive to temporal errors. We introduce $\textit{Align Then Reason}$ (ATR), a multilingual lip-sync judge that first establishes a monotonic alignment between frame-level lip representations and the phonetic units of the candidate line, then reasons over this alignment to make the final judgment. An alignment scorer provides the LLM with both local evidence for each phonetic unit and a calibrated global alignment score, enabling it to reason jointly about content and timing. On a seven-language benchmark, our method improves mean AUC over the corresponding Qwen3.5 SFT baselines by 59.4%, 50.2%, and 50.8% with 2B, 4B, and 9B reasoners, respectively. The gains generalize across LLM families, reaching mean AUC improvements of 45.9% and 46.6% over the best baseline for LLaMA-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, respectively. They also transfer across datasets to three unseen MuAViC languages. Furthermore, we evaluate on two downstream tasks built from real dubbing lines. On dub-line reranking, ATR-9B outperforms the best lip-reading baseline by 52.0%, while on script-to-clip assignment, ATR-9B improves over the best lip-reading baseline by 17.7%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Align Then Reason (ATR)，一种多语言唇形同步评判器：先建立帧级唇部表征与候选文本音素单元之间的单调对齐，再基于该对齐进行推理，从而同时判断内容与时间的一致性，仅需无声视频与文本。
AI.motivation: 配音质检需要一个无参考评判器，仅凭无声视频与文本判断候选台词是否在内容和时间上与说话者可见口型匹配（因为配音音频可能尚不存在）。现有视觉语音识别器与视频-语言模型即便微调后可从唇动恢复内容，仍对时间错误不敏感，因此不适合该场景。
AI.method: ATR 首先在帧级唇部表征与候选台词的音素单元之间建立单调对齐，然后对该对齐进行推理以做出最终判断。对齐打分器为 LLM 提供每个音素单元的局部证据与校准后的全局对齐分数，使其能够联合推理内容与时间。
AI.result: 在七语言基准上，方法相对对应 Qwen3.5 SFT 基线，在 2B、4B、9B 推理器上平均 AUC 分别提升 59.4%、50.2%、50.8%；增益可跨 LLM 家族泛化，LLaMA-3.1-8B 与 Mistral-7B 分别较最优基线提升 45.9% 与 46.6%；并可跨数据集迁移到三个未见过的 MuAViC 语言。在下游任务中，配音行重排序上 ATR-9B 超过最佳唇读基线 52.0%，脚本到片段分配上提升 17.7%。
AI.conclusion: 先对齐后推理的范式显著提升了唇形同步评判在内容与时间上的判别力，具有多语言、跨模型与跨数据集泛化能力，并在真实配音行构成的下游任务中优于唇读基线。

title: Geometric Similarity in VLM Low-Level Vision Representations
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as powerful candidates for universal vision backbones, with representative architectures including autoregressive (AR) models and diffusion transformers (DiTs). Yet, adapting them efficiently for all-in-one low-level image restoration remains a challenge. Crucially, the field lacks an understanding of how VLMs organize hidden-layer representations and whether these structurally distinct paradigms share a common geometric organization for pixel-level perception. Such shared organization is a prerequisite for building highly transferable, unified restoration VLMs and adapters. In this paper, we systematically investigate representational similarity across 24 low-level tasks spanning 5 categories. We propose GeoSim, a unified four-level framework that analyzes task-conditioned representations from global similarity, local geometry, sparse feature decomposition, and topological verification perspectives. Our formulation applies to the analysis of hidden states in AR models and feature maps in DiTs across same- and cross-task/model settings. Our results reveal the organizing principles of low-level visual representations while exposing their limits in cross-task and cross-model agreement. Ultimately, GeoSim provides an interpretability lens for probing latent transferability in low-level vision and diagnosing model limitations in task- or model-specific scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GeoSim统一四层框架，系统分析自回归模型与扩散Transformer在24个底层视觉任务中的隐层表征几何组织，揭示可迁移性与局限。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）被视为通用视觉骨干的候选，但高效适配其完成一体化底层图像复原仍具挑战。关键问题在于：领域内尚不清楚VLM如何组织隐层表征，以及结构迥异的自回归（AR）模型与扩散Transformer（DiT）是否共享面向像素级感知的通用几何组织。这种共享组织是构建高可迁移、统一复原VLM与适配器的前提。
AI.method: 提出GeoSim——统一的四层分析框架，从全局相似性、局部几何、稀疏特征分解与拓扑验证四个视角分析任务条件化表征。该形式化方法可同时适用于AR模型的隐状态与DiT的特征图，并覆盖同任务与跨任务、同模型与跨模型等多种设置。实验在涵盖5大门类的24个底层任务上进行系统性的表征相似度研究。
AI.result: 结果揭示了底层视觉表征的组织原则，同时暴露了其在跨任务与跨模型一致性方面的局限性。
AI.conclusion: GeoSim为探测底层视觉中的潜在可迁移性提供了可解释性视角，并可用于诊断模型在任务特定或模型特定场景下的局限。

title: SmoothOperator: Enhancing Representations for Fine-grained Open-set Recognition via Modulated Label Smoothing
summary: Open Set Recognition (OSR) aims to enable models to accurately classify known classes while rejecting samples from unseen classes. A key challenge in OSR lies in the inability to model the unbounded distribution of unknown classes during training, often leading to the misclassification of samples from these classes. Rather than modeling unknowns, recent work shapes the feature space so that known classes are compact and well separated, and spherical representation learning methods have achieved strong results this way. Label smoothing has been identified as one of the key drivers of this success, yet it applies the same coefficient to every training sample, regardless of how well each sample is already embedded. We show that the spherical representation learning objectives used in OSR share a single alignment--uniformity structure in which labels enter only through the alignment term. Label smoothing therefore acts as an alignment dial, and a fixed coefficient sets this dial to the same value for every sample. We propose a plug-in, SmoothOperator (SmoothOP), which sets the smoothing coefficient of each sample from its \textbf{prominence}, an embedding-space signal measuring how clearly the sample's own class stands out against its strongest competing class. Our method integrates into four existing spherical representation learning methods at minimal training overhead. SmoothOP assigns strong smoothing to samples with high prominence, which reduces their alignment and relaxes their pull. On the Semantic Shift Benchmark, SmoothOP-augmented variants generally outperform their base objectives across datasets, degrees of semantic shift, and OSR post-processors, with gains of up to 4.7\% in AUROC, OSCR, and closed-set accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的样本自适应标签平滑方法 SmoothOP，用嵌入空间"显著度"调节每样本平滑系数，增强球面表示学习的开集识别性能。
AI.motivation: OSR 训练时无法建模无界的未知类分布，易将未知样本误分。近期工作转而塑形特征空间，使已知类紧凑且分离，球面表示学习效果突出，其中标签平滑是关键驱动因素，但它对所有训练样本使用同一系数，忽视样本自身嵌入质量。
AI.method: 作者指出 OSR 中的球面表示学习目标共享统一的 alignment–uniformity 结构，标签仅通过 alignment 项进入，因此标签平滑相当于一个 alignment 旋钮，固定系数即对所有样本设定同一值。据此提出 SmoothOP：以样本的 prominence（自身类相对最强竞争类在嵌入空间中的突出程度）设定该样本的平滑系数，高 prominence 样本获得强平滑、降低其 alignment 并放松拉近。该模块可嵌入四种现有球面表示学习方法，训练开销极小。
AI.result: 在 Semantic Shift Benchmark 上，SmoothOP 增强变体在多数数据集、语义偏移程度和 OSR 后处理方式下优于原始目标，AUROC、OSCR 与闭集准确率最高提升 4.7%。
AI.conclusion: 将标签平滑视为样本级 alignment 调节，并用嵌入显著度驱动的自适应系数替代固定系数，是一种通用、低开销的有效改进，可与多种球面表示学习 OSR 方法结合。

title: CtrlWAM: Controllable World Action Models with Aligned Intent and Foresight
summary: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict actions (intent) and visual future (foresight). Standard training adds noise to recorded actions and video simultaneously, but such training paradigms introduce a mismatch: perturbed actions imply counterfactual future visual, while the noised video remains tied to the GT recording. In low-noise regime, the scene geometry and even the dynamic behavior remain clearly visible from the noisy future frames despite the added noise. We present CtrlWAM, which executes perturbed actions in a simulator and pairs them with their noised visual consequences for joint WAM learning. To accommodate the different denoising requirements of video and actions, we introduce warped video--action noise schedules that aim to keep visual layout responsive as action predictions evolve. We further extend the action interface from ego-only control to a variable number of agent streams, allowing a unified model to represent predicted or commanded futures for multiple agents. Driving experiments show more accurate action forecasts, closer agreement between generated video and actions, and better following of supplied commands; robotics experiments show stronger motion fidelity and controllability. Matched controls support the benefit of off-path renders for command following and manipulation fidelity. Together, these findings contribute to a more controllable world action model. Project page: https://ctrl-wam.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出CtrlWAM，通过在仿真器中执行扰动动作并配对其加噪视觉后果，解决世界动作模型中动作与视频扰动不一致问题，实现更可控的联合预测。
AI.motivation: 标准WAM训练同时对视频与动作加噪，造成语义错配：扰动的动作隐含反事实未来视觉，而被加噪的视频仍绑定于真实录制。且在低噪声下，噪声未来帧中场景几何与动态行为依然清晰可见，削弱了模型对动作与视觉因果联系的学习。
AI.method: 核心思路是在仿真器中真实执行扰动动作，并将其产生的视觉结果加噪后与扰动动作配对，用于联合WAM学习；设计"扭曲"的视频-动作噪声调度，使视频布局随动作预测演化而保持响应性；将动作接口从单主体控制扩展为可变数量的多智能体流，统一表示多个智能体的预测或指令未来。通过匹配对照实验验证离轨渲染的作用。
AI.result: 驾驶实验中动作预测更准确、生成视频与动作一致性更高、对给定指令的遵循更好；机器人实验中运动保真度与可控性更强；匹配对照支持离轨渲染对指令遵循与操作保真度的收益。
AI.conclusion: 通过仿真执行扰动动作并配对对应视觉后果、配合扭曲噪声调度与多智能体动作接口，CtrlWAM实现了更可控的世界动作模型，为动作-视觉联合建模提供了新范式。

title: Machine Translation for Sign Languages
comment: Accepted for publication in the Annual Review of Linguistics, Volume 13
summary: Sign language machine translation has progressed substantially over the past decade, evolving from isolated sign recognition to end-to-end translation systems. Advances in pose estimation, transformer architectures, and large-scale dataset collection have driven progress, yet challenges remain. Datasets are limited compared to spoken-language resources; evaluation metrics inadequately capture the linguistic quality of output; and models must capture the simultaneous, multi-layered, and three-dimensional structure of sign languages. This manuscript provides a comprehensive review that seeks to balance technical challenges with stakeholder considerations. We examine the linguistic properties that make sign languages computationally unique, trace the evolution of recognition, translation, and production systems, and analyze ongoing technical challenges. Crucially, we address ethical considerations around data governance, community involvement, and appropriate use. Drawing on interdisciplinary perspectives spanning computer vision, sign language linguistics, and deaf studies, our analysis emphasizes that continued progress requires sustained collaboration across these fields and with deaf communities.

AI.tldr: 本文综述手语机器翻译，梳理其从孤立手语识别到端到端翻译的演进，剖析语言特性、技术挑战与伦理议题，强调跨学科协作及与聋人社群共建。
AI.motivation: 手语机器翻译虽因姿态估计、Transformer架构与大规模数据集的进步而快速发展，但仍面临数据资源匮乏、评价指标无法充分反映输出语言质量，以及模型难以刻画手语同时性、多层性与三维结构等难题；同时数据治理与社群权益等伦理问题也亟需纳入考量。
AI.method: 采用综合性文献综述方法，兼具技术与社会双重视角：分析手语在计算上独特的语言学属性，追溯识别、翻译与生成系统的演进脉络，梳理现存技术挑战，并从数据治理、社群参与与合理使用等维度讨论伦理议题。
AI.result: 综述系统归纳了手语机器翻译的技术发展路径与关键瓶颈，指出数据集规模远不及口语资源、评价指标缺乏语言学效度，以及三维同时性建模不足等问题；同时明确了伦理与社群参与在研究与落地中的核心地位。
AI.conclusion: 手语机器翻译的持续进步依赖计算机视觉、手语语言学与聋人研究等跨学科领域的长期协作，并需与聋人社群共同推进，方能兼顾技术可行性与社会适切性。

title: EyeTAG: Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation
summary: Gaze estimation under natural head-eye motion underpins applications from driver monitoring to human-computer interaction. Single-frame methods predict each frame independently, so consecutive outputs fluctuate as jitter. Multi-frame methods reduce this, but they learn motion implicitly inside appearance features, so the gaze trajectory is never an explicit variable. We propose EyeTAG (Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation), a causal multi-frame framework built around an explicit first-order gaze prior: at each step it differentiates its own recent predictions and feeds the resulting trajectory back as a compact kinematic token. Because differencing is translation-invariant in gaze space, this token carries subject-invariant motion rather than personal gaze offsets. Face and eye streams supply visual evidence, fused by cross-attention and a causal Transformer decoder. EyeTAG reduces the mean angular error by about 1.0$^\circ$ on Gaze360 and performs on par with the strongest baseline on EVE (2.56$^\circ$ vs. 2.58$^\circ$). Within-model ablations, which keep the encoder and the rest of the architecture fixed and vary only the gaze history, show that the differential formulation, rather than temporal context alone, removes the systematic saccade bias that persists even with an absolute gaze-history prior. Our code is available at https://github.com/peter8366/EyeTAG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EyeTAG，一种围绕显式一阶注视先验构建的因果多帧视线估计框架：每一步对其近期预测做差分，将得到的轨迹作为紧凑运动学token反馈。在Gaze360上平均角度误差降低约1.0°，在EVE上与最强基线持平（2.56° vs. 2.58°）。
AI.motivation: 自然头眼运动下的视线估计对驾驶监控、人机交互等应用至关重要。单帧方法逐帧独立预测，连续输出存在抖动；多帧方法虽能缓解抖动，但将运动隐式地学习在表观特征中，视线轨迹从未作为显式变量建模。
AI.method: EyeTAG是一个因果多帧框架，以显式一阶注视先验为核心：每一步对其自身近期预测进行差分，将所得轨迹作为紧凑的运动学token反馈回去。由于差分在注视空间中具有平移不变性，该token携带的是与受试者无关的运动而非个人注视偏移。人脸流与眼部流提供视觉证据，通过交叉注意力与因果Transformer解码器进行融合。
AI.result: 在Gaze360上平均角度误差降低约1.0°；在EVE上与最强基线性能相当（2.56° vs. 2.58°）。模型内消融实验（固定编码器和其余架构、仅改变注视历史）表明，是差分形式而非单纯的时序上下文消除了即便存在绝对注视历史先验时仍持续存在的系统性扫视偏置。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模差分注视轨迹可有效去除系统性扫视偏置并提升视线估计精度，验证了将视线轨迹作为显式变量而非隐式表观特征的重要性。

title: Joint Branch-Space Transform Coding for Diffusion Activation Quantization with Classifier-Free Guidance
summary: Post-training quantization for diffusion models increasingly exploits timestep, feature, and layer structure. While recent work has begun incorporating CFG structure into diffusion quantization, activation quantization still operates independently across conditional and unconditional coordinates, leaving cross-activation structure unexploited. We show that matched CFG activations form a strongly correlated two-dimensional source and that, under a fixed bit budget, the choice of branch coding basis materially affects quantization fidelity. Motivated by this observation, we introduce branch-space transform coding, which rotates matched CFG branches via an offline derived 2x2 orthogonal matrix, requiring minimal modifications to model parameters or the quantization pipeline. We further derive the Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT), which jointly incorporates the CFG guidance direction and cross-branch second moments. Under an equal-rate quantization-noise surrogate, GCBT admits a closed-form per-layer solution without gradient optimization or angle search. Applied on top of existing diffusion PTQ methods, GCBT yields statistically significant fidelity gains in most evaluated comparisons with no statistically significant degradation, while leaving the underlying host quantization pipeline unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分支空间变换编码，通过离线2x2正交矩阵旋转匹配的CFG分支激活，并推导出GCBT闭式解，在不改变宿主量化流程的前提下提升扩散模型PTQ的保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型后训练量化虽已利用时间步、特征和层结构，甚至开始引入CFG结构，但激活量化仍在条件与无条件坐标上独立进行，未挖掘跨激活结构；作者发现匹配的CFG激活形成强相关的二维源，且在固定比特预算下分支编码基的选择显著影响量化保真度。
AI.method: 提出分支空间变换编码：用离线导出的2x2正交矩阵旋转匹配的CFG分支；进一步推导Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT)，联合建模CFG引导方向与跨分支二阶矩，在等速率量化噪声代理下给出逐层闭式解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索。对模型参数和量化流程改动极小。
AI.result: 将GCBT叠加于现有扩散PTQ方法之上，在大多数对比中取得统计显著的保真度提升，且无统计显著退化，同时保持底层宿主量化流程不变。
AI.conclusion: 匹配CFG激活的跨分支相关性是可利用的量化自由度，GCBT以闭式、低侵入的方式有效提升扩散模型PTQ保真度。

title: A Matched-Budget Audit Framework for Recaptioned Image-Text Supervision Distributions
summary: Recaptioned image-text corpora are now standard for text-to-image (T2I) training, with vision--language model (VLM) captioners replacing sparse alt-text by dense descriptions. A recaptioned corpus is a supervision distribution induced by a documented captioning policy ($π$), captioner ($V_c$), and source corpus ($C$). Length-correlated proxies miss caption-register artifacts and downstream T2I benchmarks entangle the corpus with training choices, so this distribution is hard to audit at corpus scale. We introduce a reusable matched-budget audit framework for recaptioned supervision distributions $D_{π,V_c,C}$: at a fixed text budget of $B = 64$ it reports a five-axis profile spanning prompt-side coverage, image-conditioned faithfulness, and caption-surface health, with claimed controllable basic units (CBU) as the common claim unit. We instantiate the framework on seven paired comparisons over five public source corpora. Across the four cross-corpus pairs, the released surface raises supported CBU per caption by $+3.39$ to $+6.36$ under both Qwen and Gemma Judges, and on CC12M the same framework exposes a long-vs-dense frontier that is consistent across both judges and four budgets. We release the audited multi-source recap corpus ($\approx$ 490M) together with the audit-artifact bundle.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可复用的匹配预算审计框架，用于在固定文本预算下对重标注图文语料的监督分布进行五维画像审计。
AI.motivation: 重标注语料已成为T2I训练标准，但其监督分布由标注策略、标注器和源语料共同诱导，现有基于长度相关的代理指标无法捕捉标注文体伪影，下游T2I基准又将语料与训练选择纠缠，导致语料规模的分布审计困难。
AI.method: 将重标注语料形式化为由标注策略π、标注器V_c和源语料C诱导的监督分布D_{π,V_c,C}；在固定文本预算B=64下，以可控基本单元（CBU）为统一声明单位，报告覆盖提示侧覆盖度、图像条件忠实度和标注表层健康度的五轴画像；在五个公开源语料上的七组配对比较中实例化，并使用Qwen与Gemma两个Judge。
AI.result: 四个跨语料配对中，发布表面在Qwen和Gemma Judge下每张标注所支持的CBU提升+3.39至+6.36；在CC12M上揭示出在两个Judge和四个预算下一致的长文本vs密集文本前沿。发布约490M的受审多源重标注语料及审计工件包。
AI.conclusion: 该匹配预算审计框架可复用地刻画重标注监督分布，避免长度代理与下游基准的混淆，为语料规模审计提供统一声明单位与多轴证据，并配套释放受审语料与审计工件。

title: Two Clocks in Diffusion MLLMs: When Answers Stabilize Before Rationales Unfold
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on BeNTo (Beyond Next-Token Prediction - Diffusion & Flow Models for Next-Generation Decoding)
summary: An answer candidate in a masked diffusion MLLM can stabilize while its rationale is still unfolding. We distinguish retrospective stabilization of the logged candidate from token commitment, and examine these two clocks relative to rationale generation. Analyzing our results across three visual question-answering benchmarks, we find that 89.4-98.1% of the rationale-side canvas remains unwritten at stabilization in single-block, EOS-suppressed LaViDa runs. On V*Bench, reducing block length from 128 to 8 changes this fraction from 89.4% to 1.7%, together with answer coverage and the eligible observation window. Under EOS-enabled prompting, direct instructions improve Nemotron's overall accuracy by 15.0 and 19.5 percentage points on M3CoT and ScienceQA, but reduce LaViDa/V*Bench accuracy by 11.0 points. A symmetric decomposition associates the larger absolute component of each change with coverage rather than conditional accuracy. Matched-canvas image ablations measure visual sensitivity alongside answer stabilization, separating the two temporal readouts. Together, these measurements distinguish answer stabilization, rationale unfolding, and visual sensitivity, and identify coverage as the larger component of the prompting differences.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分了掩码扩散多模态大模型中"答案候选的回顾性稳定"与"令牌承诺"，并相对推理解展开过程考察这两个时间尺度，通过三个VQA基准与图像消融实验量化答案稳定、推理解展开与视觉敏感性三者的时序关系。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散MLLM中，答案候选可能在推理解尚未展开完毕时就已稳定，这一现象易被误解为模型已"承诺"该答案。论文旨在厘清"回顾性稳定"与"令牌承诺"的区别，明确答案稳定相对于推理解生成的时间位置，并识别提示词差异背后的主要成因。
AI.method: 以单块、抑制EOS的LaViDa运行为主，在三个视觉问答基准上统计答案稳定时推理解侧画布的未写入比例（89.4%-98.1%）；将块长度从128改为8进行对照；采用启用EOS的提示与直接指令，测试Nemotron与LaViDa的准确率变化；用对称分解将变化拆为覆盖率与条件准确率；并做匹配画布的图像消融以测量视觉敏感性。
AI.result: 单块、抑制EOS的LaViDa中，答案稳定时89.4%-98.1%的推理解画布仍未写入；V*Bench上块长度由128降至8使该比例从89.4%降至1.7%，同时改变答案覆盖率与可用观察窗口。启用EOS时，直接指令使Nemotron在M3CoT和ScienceQA上分别提升15.0与19.5个百分点，但使LaViDa/V*Bench准确率下降11.0个百分点。对称分解表明，每项变化中绝对量较大的成分来自覆盖率而非条件准确率。
AI.conclusion: 这些测量将答案稳定、推理解展开与视觉敏感性三类时间读数区分开来，并确认覆盖率是提示差异中更大的组成部分；同时表明答案稳定并不等同于令牌承诺，推理解可在答案稳定后继续展开。

title: Video-Index: A Curated Meta-Benchmark for Video Understanding
summary: A video benchmark should reward the capability it claims to measure, yet models can exploit answer options, question text, or partial visual evidence. We introduce the attack pyramid, five levels of shortcut attacks with increasing access to each item, and audit 115 video benchmarks with it. On 35 benchmarks, attackers that never see a frame approach full-video accuracy. On 51 benchmarks with temporal probes, shuffled frames keep a median 96% of full-video accuracy. Near-duplicate questions make up at least half the items in 63 benchmarks. We screen 505,518 question-answer pairs from 112 of them into an audited pool. Agents turn evaluation requests into specifications, and a deterministic selector with a red-team gate composes reproducible benchmarks. We release Video-Index, the 210 hardest verified items under these attacks in each of four capability groups, 840 items from 76 sources. With the same fixed input, Claude Opus 5 outscores every open-source model by over 37 percentage points, and agent tools add about 20 more, yet all systems leave room to improve efficiency and accuracy. Blog: https://www.enxinsong.com/blog/video-index/ GitHub: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/Video-Index Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Video-Index/Video-Index

AI.tldr: 提出"攻击金字塔"审计框架，系统检验视频基准是否可被捷径利用，并据此构建去偏的 Video-Index 基准。
AI.motivation: 视频基准理应衡量其宣称的能力，但模型可利用答案选项、问题文本或部分视觉证据等捷径通过测试，导致评测结果失真，因此需要系统审计并构建更可靠的评测集。
AI.method: 提出攻击金字塔（五个层级的捷径攻击，对每个样本的访问权限逐级增加），据此审计 115 个视频基准；从 112 个基准的 505,518 个问答对中筛选出审计池；用智能体将评测需求转为规范，并通过带红队门控的确定性选择器组合出可复现的基准。
AI.result: 35 个基准上，完全看不到任何帧的攻击者即可接近全视频精度；51 个基准中打乱帧顺序仍保留中位数 96% 的全视频精度；63 个基准中近重复问题至少占一半。发布 Video-Index（四个能力组各 210 个最难验证样本，共 840 项，来自 76 个来源）。相同固定输入下，Claude Opus 5 领先所有开源模型 37 个百分点以上，智能体工具再提升约 20 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频基准广泛存在捷径漏洞，其宣称衡量的能力与实际测量内容脱节；Video-Index 通过攻击审计与红队筛选提供更严谨的评测，但所有系统在效率与准确率上仍有提升空间。

title: RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation
summary: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction have progressed from per-scene optimization to feed-forward inference, and semantic scene understanding has followed suit -- yet existing methods remain confined to object-centric perception, neglecting spatial relations between objects. We formulate 3D spatial relation segmentation in a feed-forward, pose-free multi-view setting: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query, the model segments the target across views without receiving its category name. To this end, we propose RelationVGGT, a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model and leverages a relation transformer for subject-conditioned, cross-view relation prediction -- requiring neither per-scene optimization nor known camera poses. We additionally provide a fully automated annotation pipeline built on ScanNet++ with VLMs and LLMs, enabling scalable training data generation for this new task.

AI.tldr: 论文提出前馈、无需位姿的多视图"3D空间关系分割"任务，并给出RelationVGGT框架及基于ScanNet++的自动标注流程。
AI.motivation: 现有3D重建与语义场景理解已从逐场景优化转向前馈推理，但语义理解仍局限于物体中心感知，忽视物体间空间关系。且该设定要求在多视图、无位姿、无目标类别名的条件下完成关系分割，尚属空白。
AI.method: 提出RelationVGGT：融合视觉基础模型的语义特征与3D几何基础模型的几何感知表示，并引入关系变换器进行以主体为条件、跨视图的关系预测；无需逐场景优化，也无需已知相机位姿。同时基于ScanNet++构建结合VLM与LLM的全自动标注流水线，以生成可扩展训练数据。
AI.result: 在给定视觉指定的主体与关系文本查询下，模型可在多变视图中分割目标，且不接收其类别名称；所需训练数据可通过自动标注流程规模化生成。
AI.conclusion: 工作将前馈3D场景理解从物体中心扩展到物体间空间关系，提出任务设定与可行框架，并配套自动化数据构建方案，为新任务的可扩展研究提供基础。

title: Concept Driven Domain Adaptation: Finding an Abstract Needle in a Haystack
summary: Science teachers frequently search for documentary excerpts not by describing what appears on screen, but by querying the abstract concepts they intend to teach. This use case exposes a limitation of existing language-based video moment retrieval methods, which typically assume that queries describe observable events, whereas instructional search requires retrieving concrete visual phenomena that instantiate an underlying scientific principle. We study this setting as concept-to-example video retrieval, an abstract-needle-in-a-haystack problem where compact curriculum concepts must be grounded in temporally sparse documentary evidence. To bridge this abstraction gap, we propose Concept-Driven Domain Adaptation (CDDA), a three-stage framework for adapting two-tower vision-language models to concept-level retrieval. CDDA treats concepts as intermediate semantic anchors: it first structures the textual embedding space with textbook and teacher-handbook example-concept pairs, then transfers this concept-aware geometry to documentary visuals under a frozen visual encoder, and finally jointly adapts both encoders with sparse visual concept supervision. From a geometric perspective, this staged alignment reduces text-concept and vision-concept angular gaps, thereby encouraging concept-level adaptation while preserving the pretrained model's concrete image description alignment. On a curated middle-school physics retrieval benchmark, CDDA achieves stronger pedagogically oriented concept retrieval than several competitive multimodal baselines, including Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, while maintaining concrete image-text matching after adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"概念到实例视频检索"任务，并设计了CDDA三阶段框架，将双塔视觉-语言模型适配至概念级检索，在初中物理检索基准上优于Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B等基线。
AI.motivation: 科学教师检索纪录片片段时，通常查询的是想要讲授的抽象概念，而非屏幕上的具体画面。现有基于语言的视频片段检索方法假设查询描述可观察事件，无法满足这种教学检索需求——即需要检索体现科学原理的具体视觉现象。该场景形成了"概念到实例"的抽象针找大海捞针问题：紧凑的课程概念需落地于时间上稀疏的纪录片证据中。
AI.method: 提出概念驱动域适应（CDDA）三阶段框架，将概念作为中间语义锚点：1）用教科书和教师手册中的示例-概念对结构化文本嵌入空间；2）在冻结视觉编码器的条件下，将该概念感知几何迁移到纪录片视觉表征；3）用稀疏视觉概念监督联合适配两个编码器。从几何角度看，这种分阶段对齐缩小了文本-概念和视觉-概念的角度差距。
AI.result: 在自建初中物理检索基准上，CDDA在教学导向的概念检索上优于包括Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B在内的多个竞争性多模态基线，同时在适配后仍保持具体的图文匹配能力。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段的概念对齐能在实现概念级域适应的同时，保留预训练模型原有的具体图像描述对齐能力，为教学场景中的抽象概念检索提供了有效方案。

title: VIEScore2: Unified Image Evaluation with Spatially Grounded Explanations
summary: Existing synthetic image evaluators typically provide only a scalar quality score and do not identify the image regions that support it. We introduce VIEScore2, a unified evaluator for image generation and editing tasks with optional conditioning images. VIEScore2 represents an image as an N x N grid and jointly predicts quality scores and defect locations in a single model pass. Its text-native grid representation provides a common interface for heterogeneous spatial supervision and enables directly verifiable post-training objectives. We train on 38K examples spanning score-only, localization-only, and joint supervision across generation and editing tasks. Starting from supervised fine-tuning, we further apply GRPO to improve defect localization using rewards that combine cell-level Dice overlap, score accuracy, and output-format validity. A parameter-free parser converts the structured predictions into readable explanations. On the primary suite, VIEScore2 achieves an overall-score SRCC of 0.601, compared with 0.491 for Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest zero-shot general-purpose VLM baseline under matched inputs. For defect localization, VIEScore2 outperforms both general-purpose VLMs and specialized spatial evaluators on three of six benchmarks in per-image grid IoU and ranks among the top three on five, including datasets beyond its training sources.

AI.tldr: VIEScore2 是一个统一的图像生成与编辑评估器，将图像表示为 N×N 网格，单次前向即可同时预测质量分数与缺陷位置，并通过文本原生网格表示支持可验证的后训练，在 SRCC 与缺陷定位上优于零样本通用 VLM 及专用空间评估器。
AI.motivation: 现有合成图像评估器通常只输出标量质量分数，无法指出支撑该分数的图像区域，缺乏可解释性与空间定位能力。
AI.method: 将图像建模为 N×N 网格，在单一模型前向中联合预测质量分数与缺陷位置；文本原生网格表示统一了异构空间监督并支持可验证的后训练目标。训练数据 38K，涵盖仅分数、仅定位与联合监督三类，覆盖生成与编辑任务。先做监督微调，再用 GRPO 优化缺陷定位，奖励结合单元格级 Dice 重叠、分数准确率与输出格式有效性；并用无参数解析器将结构化预测转为可读解释。
AI.result: 主测试集上总体分数 SRCC 达 0.601，高于最强零样本通用 VLM 基线 Gemini-3-Flash 的 0.491。缺陷定位在六个基准中的三个取得每图网格 IoU 最优，五个进入前三，且包含训练来源之外的数据集。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模分数预测与空间定位可行且有效，文本原生网格表示为统一评估、可验证后训练与可解释输出提供了通用接口，使 VIEScore2 在评分与定位两方面均超越通用 VLM 与专用空间评估器。

title: Watch Your Speech: Text-aware Video-to-Speech Synthesis with Textual Conditioning
summary: Video-to-speech synthesis aims to generate natural-sounding speech from silent talking-face videos while ensuring phonetic accuracy. A fundamental challenge in this task is the inherent one-to-many mapping problem, where visual dynamics often lack sufficient information to uniquely determine the corresponding utterance. To address this, we propose Watch Your Speech (WYS), a video-to-speech synthesis framework that incorporates textual conditioning as an explicit linguistic cue to mitigate visual ambiguity. Our framework features an attention-based embedding fusion module that synergistically integrates textual context with video sequences, coupled with a conditional flow matching objective for high-fidelity speech generation. Extensive experiments on the LRS2 and LRS3 datasets demonstrate that WYS achieves superior performance, establishing new state-of-the-art results in audio-visual synchronization (LSE-C/D) while maintaining highly competitive textual accuracy (WER). Subjective evaluations further confirm that our model generates speech with near-human naturalness, validating the effectiveness of textual conditioning in content-controlled video-to-speech synthesis. Project page: https://github.com/gunwoo5034/Watch-your-Speech

AI.tldr: 提出WYS框架，引入文本条件作为显式语言线索，结合注意力嵌入融合与条件流匹配，缓解视频到语音合成的一对多映射问题，在LRS2/LRS3上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 视频到语音合成需从无声说话人脸视频生成自然且音素准确的语音，但视觉动态信息不足，存在一对多映射的固有挑战，即同一视觉序列可能对应多种语音内容。作者希望引入文本条件作为显式语言提示来消除视觉歧义。
AI.method: 提出Watch Your Speech（WYS）框架：包含基于注意力的嵌入融合模块，将文本上下文与视频序列协同融合；采用条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）目标进行高保真语音生成。
AI.result: 在LRS2和LRS3数据集上，WYS在音视频同步指标（LSE-C/D）上刷新SOTA，同时保持极具竞争力的文本准确率（WER）；主观评测显示生成语音接近人类自然度。
AI.conclusion: 文本条件在内容可控的视频到语音合成中有效，可缓解视觉歧义并提升同步性与自然度。

title: VASC: Value-Aware Sparse Attention with Cross-Layer Memory for Efficient 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D vision models such as VGGT have achieved remarkable progress, unifying camera estimation and dense scene reconstruction in a single pass. However, their quadratic global attention makes long image sequences expensive, while existing sparse methods may favor highly attended yet value-redundant regions. To address these limitations, we introduce VASC, a training-free sparse attention method combining value-aware block selection and execution-aware cross-layer memory. Our value-aware block selection integrates pooled query--key relevance with neighboring value contrast, reducing redundancy while preserving query-relevant and distinctive content. Cross-layer memory tracks unserved demand across layers and updates this state according to actual execution, enabling previously underserved blocks to compete under a fixed computation budget. Experiments on 7Scenes and NeuralRGB-D with VGGT and $π^3$ demonstrate improved pose estimation and reconstruction quality compared with FasterVGGT, together with up to $2.29\times$ faster inference than dense VGGT. Code is available at https://github.com/kosakayamahoo-design/VASC.

AI.tldr: VASC是一种免训练的稀疏注意力方法，通过值感知块选择与跨层记忆机制，在固定计算预算下提升长序列3D重建效率与质量。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D视觉模型（如VGGT）虽统一了相机估计与稠密重建，但其二次全局注意力使长图像序列计算代价高昂；现有稀疏方法倾向于选择注意力高但价值冗余的区域，效率与质量受限。
AI.method: 提出免训练的稀疏注意力方法VASC，包含两部分：（1）值感知块选择：将池化的query-key相关性与邻域value对比度结合，降低冗余并保留与查询相关且具区分度的内容；（2）执行感知的跨层记忆：跨层跟踪未被服务的需求，并依据实际执行情况更新状态，使此前未被充分服务的块能在固定计算预算下参与竞争。
AI.result: 在7Scenes与NeuralRGB-D数据集上，结合VGGT与π³模型，相比FasterVGGT在位姿估计与重建质量上均有提升，同时推理速度较稠密VGGT最高快2.29倍。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: VASC通过值感知选择与跨层记忆，在免训练条件下有效缓解稀疏注意力的价值冗余问题，兼顾效率与精度，为前馈3D视觉模型的长序列处理提供可行方案。

title: Towards Automatic Video Annotation with ASH: Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking and Segmentation
summary: Memory-attention-based Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) methods have demonstrated strong zero-shot tracking capability, yet their substantial memory requirements confine them to short video clips and their single-prompt inference design makes multi-category open-vocabulary tracking computationally prohibitive. This work introduces two contributions toward fully automated tracking annotation of arbitrary video. The Generalized Presence Token (GPT) reformulates SAM3's inference pipeline to process N text prompts simultaneously via virtual prompt batching, reducing image encoding cost from O(N) to O(1) with no modifications to any learned component. The Annotation and Segmentation Handler (ASH) extends any memory-attention VIS tracker to sequences of arbitrary length through overlapping temporal chunks with IoU-based inter-chunk identity matching, requiring no dataset-specific training. Instantiated on SAM3, the resulting pipeline -- SAM3-ASH -- achieves state-of-the-art HOTA on MOTS20 under fully zero-shot conditions and remains competitive with trained specialists across seven additional benchmarks, while peak GPU memory consumption stays below 25 GB, establishing a practical baseline for scalable, training-free automated video annotation.

AI.tldr: 提出GPT与ASH两个模块，将SAM3等记忆-注意力VIS追踪器扩展到任意长视频与多类别开放词汇场景，实现免训练自动化视频标注。
AI.motivation: 现有基于记忆-注意力的视频实例分割（VIS）方法虽具零样本跟踪能力，但受限于巨大显存开销只能处理短视频片段；且其单提示推理设计使多类别开放词汇跟踪的计算代价过高，难以支撑任意视频的全自动标注。
AI.method: 一、Generalized Presence Token (GPT)：重构SAM3推理流程，通过"虚拟提示批处理"同时处理N个文本提示，在不修改任何已学习组件的前提下，将图像编码成本由O(N)降至O(1)。二、Annotation and Segmentation Handler (ASH)：通过重叠时间分块与基于IoU的跨块身份匹配，将任意记忆-注意力VIS跟踪器扩展至任意长度序列，且无需数据集特定训练。二者在SAM3上实例化为SAM3-ASH。
AI.result: SAM3-ASH在完全零样本条件下于MOTS20取得SOTA HOTA；在另外七个基准上与经过训练的专业模型相比仍具竞争力；峰值GPU显存保持在25 GB以下。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可扩展、免训练的全自动视频标注确立了实用基线，验证了免训练零样本管线在长视频、多类别开放词汇跟踪场景下的可行性。

title: Bootstrapping Video Interaction Generation with Synthetic State Transitions
summary: While recent video generative models can synthesize high-fidelity videos, they struggle to portray plausible physical interactions and the resulting state transitions, a critical bottleneck for applications in robotics and VR/AR. To address this, we introduce a framework to generate a scalable synthetic dataset of controllable interactions. Our pipeline leverages a structured taxonomy and state-of-the-art image editing models to create explicit `start' and `end' state images, which serve as visual anchors for the interaction. To generate a seamless video utilizing these anchors, we propose State-Guided Sampling (SGS), a novel sampling technique that mitigates artifacts common in naive conditional generation. Furthermore, we develop and validate a new automated evaluation system that aligns with human judgments to ensure data quality. Experiments show that fine-tuning a base model on our dataset significantly enhances its ability to generate plausible interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出可控交互合成数据集生成框架，利用起止状态图像锚点与State-Guided Sampling采样技术，减少伪影并提升视频物理交互生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能合成高保真视频，但难以呈现合理的物理交互及状态转移，这成为机器人、VR/AR等应用的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建结构化分类体系，借助先进图像编辑模型生成显式的“起始”和“结束”状态图像作为视觉锚点；提出State-Guided Sampling（SGS）采样技术，在这些锚点引导下生成无缝视频并抑制朴素条件生成的伪影；同时开发并验证与人类判断一致的自动化评估系统。
AI.result: 实验表明，在该数据集上微调基础模型可显著提升其生成合理交互视频的能力，且自动化评估系统与人类判断对齐，保障了数据质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过状态锚点引导采样与自动化评估，为提升视频模型的物理交互生成能力提供了可扩展的数据与训练方案。

title: Towards Subject Consistency over Dynamic Subject Sets in Video Generation
summary: We argue that as video generation extends to longer durations, subject consistency should be evaluated over \textit{dynamic subject sets}. We therefore introduce \textbf{DynSC-Eval}, an evaluation framework that dynamically tracks eligible subjects throughout their visible lifespans and measures local continuity and global identity preservation using six complementary object-level metrics, with explicit detection of inconsistency events. To validate its effectiveness, we design synthetic experiments that actively inject inconsistency events, demonstrating both the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and the limitations of existing metrics. Evaluations of diverse models on 5s, 15s, and 60s video generation further reveal substantial subject consistency differences that are obscured by conventional metrics. Beyond evaluation, we construct rewards from DynSC-Eval and apply DiffusionNFT post-training in an autonomous-driving testbed. On 5s generation, our approach reduces the six inconsistency metrics by an average of 13.82\% for Wan-2.1-1.3B and 5.66\% for SANA-2B, with improvements also observed on the I2V model ReSim. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. We then extend generation to 10s and 30s through curriculum learning and show that consistency optimization remains effective while largely preserving other capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DynSC-Eval，一个面向长时视频生成的动态主体集一致性评测框架，通过跟踪主体可见生命周期并使用六个对象级指标衡量局部连续性与全局身份保持，并据此构建奖励进行DiffusionNFT后训练。
AI.motivation: 随着视频生成时长增加，传统主体一致性评测使用固定主体集，无法反映主体出现、消失的动态过程，导致评测结果失真且掩盖了模型间真实差异。
AI.method: 提出DynSC-Eval框架：动态跟踪合法主体在其可见生命周期内的状态，采用六个互补的对象级指标度量局部连续性与全局身份保持，并显式检测不一致事件；通过注入不一致事件的合成实验验证灵敏度；进一步由DynSC-Eval构建奖励，在自动驾驶场景对Wan-2.1-1.3B、SANA-2B及I2V模型ReSim进行DiffusionNFT后训练，并借助课程学习扩展至更长时长。
AI.result: 合成实验证明DynSC-Eval的灵敏度优于现有指标；在5s、15s、60s视频生成评测中揭示出被传统指标掩盖的显著一致性差异；5s生成任务中，六个不一致指标平均降低13.82%（Wan-2.1-1.3B）和5.66%（SANA-2B），ReSim亦获提升；经课程学习扩展至10s和30s后，一致性优化仍然有效且基本保持其他能力。
AI.conclusion: 主体一致性评测应基于动态主体集；DynSC-Eval既能更敏感、准确地评测长时视频生成的一致性，又可作为奖励驱动后训练，显著提升一致性且具备向更长时长扩展的潜力。

title: HierGF: Hierarchical Gaussian Fields via Geometry-perception Message Passing for Sparse-view 3D Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM), 2026
summary: Sparse view 3D reconstruction is an important and common scenario in multimedia applications, such as augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) content creation, cultural heritage digitization, and certain robotic applications, where only a limited number of randomly captured views may be available. However, sparse views contain only limited 3D information, posing two major challenges:1) too few images are available for matching, making it difficult to build multi-view consistency; 2) insufficient view coverage leads to a lack of information in under-sampled regions, resulting in missing parts of object structure. Existing methods mostly still rely on limited reprojection errors and regularization terms, which are prone to overfitting to a single view and inconsistent appearances across views. In geometrically under-sampled regions, they often rely on heuristic density control, lacking reliable guidance and often resulting in blurring and structural holes.To address these issues, this paper proposes Hierarchical Gaussian Fields (HierGF), which revisits sparse-view reconstruction from a hierarchical geometry-perception perspective and converts limited observations into reliable self-generated supervision beyond fixed priors and heuristic density control. In particular, we transform coarse 3D geometric information and additional 2D generative priors into structured pseudo-supervision through a two-stage geometry-perception backbone network, thereby enhancing multi-view consistency with very few input views. In addition, we introduce a learnable confidence network to guide gradients toward cross-view consistent content, and a geometrically consistent densification module to improve the reconstruction of multi-view alignment and under-sampled regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层次化高斯场（HierGF），从层次化几何感知视角解决稀疏视角三维重建问题，将有限观测转化为可靠的自生成监督，通过两阶段几何感知骨干网络、可学习置信度网络和几何一致致密化模块提升多视角一致性与欠采样区域重建质量。
