AI.motivation: 稀疏视角三维重建广泛应用于AR/VR内容创作、文化遗产数字化与机器人等领域，但存在两大挑战：1）可用图像过少，难以建立多视角一致性；2）视角覆盖不足导致欠采样区域信息缺失，造成物体结构缺失。现有方法多依赖有限的重投影误差与正则项，易过拟合单一视角、跨视角外观不一致；在几何欠采样区域依赖启发式密度控制，缺乏可靠引导，常导致模糊和结构空洞。
AI.method: 提出层次化高斯场（HierGF），从层次化几何感知视角重新审视稀疏视角重建。具体地：通过两阶段几何感知骨干网络，将粗粒度三维几何信息与额外二维生成先验转化为结构化伪监督；引入可学习置信度网络，引导梯度流向跨视角一致的内容；设计几何一致致密化模块，改善多视角对齐与欠采样区域的重建。
AI.result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果与数据集信息（仅说明方法在极少输入视角下增强了多视角一致性并改善欠采样区域重建）。
AI.conclusion: HierGF将有限观测转化为超越固定先验与启发式密度控制的可靠自生成监督，缓解了稀疏视角下的视角不一致与结构缺失问题。

title: Overcoming Kernel Redundancy for Scaling Logic Gate Networks
summary: Differentiable logic gate networks, which operate using only logic gates, have recently attracted attention as an efficient alternative to conventional neural networks. However, despite their efficiency, the scaling behavior of logic gate networks remains underexplored. By contrast, scaling model capacity is a central design principle in deep neural networks and typically leads to improved performance. This discrepancy raises a key question: Can similar scaling benefits also be achieved in logic gate networks? In this work, we focus on width as a primary scaling axis and conduct a systematic analysis of its behavior in logic gate networks. We observe that naive width scaling often introduces redundancy among logic kernels, limiting the effective use of additional kernels and leading to performance saturation. To address this limitation, we propose a dynamic logic kernel framework that reorganizes kernel utilization by promoting specialization across kernel groups. This enables the network to better utilize increased width via input-dependent kernel routing, while ensuring that both routing and computation are implemented entirely with gate-level Boolean operations at inference time. We further find that kernel redundancy is most pronounced at the first gate level, motivating an early-stage dynamic logic kernel strategy that concentrates adaptation at this level. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves kernel utilization and increases kernel diversity, leading to higher accuracy with improved parameter efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了可微逻辑门网络（DLGN）的宽度缩放行为，发现朴素宽度扩展会因逻辑核冗余导致性能饱和，并提出动态逻辑核框架以提升宽度利用效率与准确率。
AI.motivation: 可微逻辑门网络作为高效替代方案受到关注，但其缩放行为尚未充分研究；而深度神经网络中扩大模型容量的缩放原则通常带来性能提升。二者之间的差异引出一个关键问题：逻辑门网络能否同样获得缩放收益。本文聚焦宽度这一主要缩放轴，系统分析其行为。
AI.method: 观察到朴素宽度缩放常在逻辑核间引入冗余，限制额外核的有效利用并导致性能饱和。为此提出动态逻辑核（dynamic logic kernel）框架，通过促进核组间特化来重组核利用，实现输入依赖的核路由，且路由与计算在推理时完全由门级布尔运算实现。进一步发现核冗余在第一个门级最显著，因此提出早期阶段动态逻辑核策略，将自适应集中在首层。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法提高了核利用率并增加了核多样性，在提升参数效率的同时获得更高准确率。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑门网络的宽度缩放并非天然有效，需通过动态核路由与阶段化自适应设计来缓解早期层的核冗余；该策略可在门级布尔运算约束下实现更优的宽度-性能-参数效率权衡。

title: Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation
comment: Preprint. 51 pages, 19 figures, 23 tables. Code, dataset and project website linked in the paper
summary: Video generation models are increasingly being explored as world simulators for embodied planning and learning. To do so effectively, these models must not only generate visually appealing frames, but also predict how environments dynamically evolve when executing goal-directed actions. While evaluating these capabilities is crucial, existing benchmarks focus mainly on single short actions or step-by-step instructions. This leaves multi-step physical reasoning underexplored, especially in egocentric video generation that requires planning to simulate proper execution to accomplish high-level goals by carrying out multiple real-world manipulations. We introduce Ego2Act, a goal-directed benchmark featuring 2,640 videos from 110 real-world tasks across day-to-day settings, varying object clutter and multi-step complexity. Given an initial scene image and a high-level goal, Ego2Act evaluates whether video generation models can produce realistic egocentric videos of a hand manipulating objects to carry out the task. To support scalable evaluation, we also introduce Ego2ActJudge, a reference-free evaluation pipeline that achieves better task completion and physics plausibility evaluation alignment with human consensus compared to relevant baselines. Our findings reveal that models' generated simulations often skip or partially execute steps, leaving later steps missing dependent states, which leads to unfulfilled goal. Furthermore, models consistently fail at fine-grained physical dynamics, particularly during complex object manipulation and persistent world modeling. We hope Ego2Act provides a rigorous testbed for advancing video models toward physically plausible, goal-directed simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ego2Act，一个面向目标导向的自我中心视频生成基准（110 个真实任务、2,640 段视频），并配套无参考评估流程 Ego2ActJudge，揭示现有视频生成模型在多步物理推理与世界建模上的显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型正被用于具身规划与学习的世界模拟器，但不仅需生成视觉上合理的画面，还需预测执行目标导向动作时环境的动态演化。现有基准多聚焦单一短动作或分步指令，对多步物理推理（尤其是需规划以完成高层次目标的自我中心视频生成）探索不足。
AI.method: 构建 Ego2Act 基准：涵盖 110 个日常真实任务、2,640 段视频，任务在物体杂乱度与多步复杂度上有变化。给定初始场景图像与高层目标，评估模型能否生成"手操作物体完成任务"的真实自我中心视频。同时提出无参考评估流程 Ego2ActJudge，用于可扩展评估。
AI.result: Ego2ActJudge 在任务完成度与物理合理性评估上，与人类共识的对齐程度优于相关基线。模型生成的模拟常跳过或部分执行步骤，导致后续步骤缺失依赖状态，目标无法达成；在细粒度物理动态、复杂物体操作与持久世界建模上持续失败。
AI.conclusion: Ego2Act 为推进视频模型走向物理合理、目标导向的模拟提供了严格测试平台。

title: MVDG: Efficient Multi-view 3D Disambiguation on Unconstrained Real-World Images
summary: Illusory matches between distinct yet visually similar 3D surfaces--doppelgangers--remain a fundamental obstacle for large-scale, in-the-wild 3D reconstruction and visual localization. Prior work mitigates this issue with pairwise classifiers, but this design limits multi-view contextual reasoning and incurs O(n^2) inference complexity for downstream structure-from-motion (SfM). We present MVDG, a scalable multi-view disambiguation framework built on the 3D foundation model VGGT, which jointly reasons over an arbitrary number of multiview images. By incorporating 3D-aware multi-view features, our method reduces dependence on pairwise comparisons by encoding and decoding views in a single pass. We further observe that direct multi-view fine-tuning of VGGT can be unstable under noisy supervision; motivated by label ambiguity in Doppelgangers, we construct a pseudo-pairwise training set from AerialMegaDepth and show that fine-tuning on sampled subsets yields stable optimization and strong generalization to held-out scenes. Finally, because full SfM evaluation (even with faster pipelines such as GLOMAP) remains expensive, we process a pseudo-pairwise dataset for efficient validation; we derive a predictive relationship between regular SfM metrics and the classification accuracy on this pseudo-pairwise test. Experiments show that our method achieves comparable pairwise accuracy while improving both SfM accuracy and inference speed over baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MVDG，一个基于 3D 基础模型 VGGT 的可扩展多视角消歧框架，通过单次编码-解码对任意数量多视角图像进行联合推理，缓解 3D 重建中的"二重身"（doppelgangers）问题，在保持成对匹配精度的同时提升 SfM 精度与推理速度。
AI.motivation: 大规模野外 3D 重建与视觉定位中，视觉上相似但实际不同的 3D 表面（doppelgangers）会产生误导性匹配，是根本性障碍。现有方法多采用成对分类器，限制了多视角上下文推理能力，且对下游 SfM 造成 O(n²) 推理复杂度。
AI.method: 1) 基于 3D 基础模型 VGGT 构建多视角消歧框架，联合推理任意数量多视角图像；2) 引入 3D 感知的多视角特征，在单次前向中完成编码与解码，降低对成对比较的依赖；3) 针对 VGGT 直接多视角微调在噪声监督下不稳定的问题，利用 Doppelgangers 的标签模糊性，从 AerialMegaDepth 构建伪成对训练集；4) 采用采样子集微调以获得稳定优化与对留出场景的良好泛化；5) 构建伪成对数据集进行高效验证，并推导常规 SfM 指标与该伪成对测试分类精度之间的预测关系。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在成对精度上与基线相当，同时在 SfM 精度和推理速度上均优于基线；验证了子集采样微调可实现稳定优化并泛化到未见场景。
AI.conclusion: 多视角联合推理的消歧框架能有效替代 O(n²) 的成对分类方案，提升 SfM 效率与精度；伪成对验证与 SfM 指标的预测关系为高效评估提供了可行途径。

title: Affine-Aligned Atlas for Canonical Gaussian Construction in Video Representation
summary: Gaussian splatting has recently emerged as an efficient representation for images and videos due to its explicit structure and fast rendering capability. Existing Gaussian-based video representations often decompose a video into canonical Gaussians and temporal deformation. However, when a video contains large global motion such as camera movement, the canonical representation may become misaligned with individual frames, increasing the burden on the temporal deformation model. In this paper, we propose an affine-atlas canonical Gaussian representation, which constructs canonical Gaussians in a larger affine-aligned atlas space. Frame-wise affine transforms absorb global motion before canonical Gaussian construction, reducing the gap between the canonical representation and target frames. Since the proposed method only modifies the canonical construction stage, it can be integrated into existing canonical-Gaussian-based methods with negligible additional parameter cost. Experiments show that our method improves reconstruction quality especially for sequences with large camera motion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出仿射图集（affine-atlas）规范高斯表示，将全局运动通过逐帧仿射变换在构建规范高斯前吸收，从而缓解大全局运动下规范表示与目标帧错位问题，可无缝集成到现有规范高斯视频方法中。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯的视频表示通常将视频分解为规范高斯（canonical Gaussians）与时间形变。当视频存在大幅全局运动（如相机运动）时，规范表示会与单帧发生错位，加重时间形变模型的负担，导致重建质量下降。
AI.method: 提出仿射图集规范高斯表示：在更大的仿射对齐图集空间（affine-aligned atlas space）中构建规范高斯。在规范高斯构建之前，用逐帧仿射变换（frame-wise affine transforms）吸收全局运动，缩小规范表示与目标帧之间的差距。该方法仅修改规范构建阶段，可集成到现有基于规范高斯的方法中，参数开销可忽略。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法提升了重建质量，尤其对存在大相机运动的序列效果更明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全局运动建模为仿射对齐的图集空间，并在规范构建阶段前置吸收全局运动，能够有效缓解大全局运动带来的错位问题；方法具有良好的通用性与低参数成本，可作为现有规范高斯视频表示的即插即用改进。

title: Open Vocabulary Word Recognition From Transcribed Bangla Texts
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 26th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT). Code: https://github.com/FaiasPromit/Optical-Character-Recognition-From-Handwritten-Bangla-Texts
summary: An optical character recognition (OCR) can scan a paper and extract text using technology, making people's jobs easier. While various OCR systems are available in the software industry, finding a reliable equivalent solution for Bangla takes much work. When it comes to handwritten texts, the situation is much more unusual. Recognizing words from word images is the most critical stage in any OCR process. It is the second stage after segmenting words from text pictures. If this stage fails, the overall performance of the OCR will be poor, regardless of how well the other phases perform. This study aims to recognize words using deep learning in a handwritten Bangla word image. Three object detection models, SSD with MobileNetV2, Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2, and an ensemble model of these two, have been used to train and test handwritten word images. A modified Non-Maximum Suppression has been introduced to enhance the effectiveness of the models' results. A customized dataset of 9841 handwritten Bangla word images has been compiled, featuring diverse handwriting styles from various individuals. All three models' performances have been checked against the test dataset, and the ensemble model has been the most impressive, with an F1-score of 92.61%. Also, at the word level, the ensemble model correctly recognizes 96.12% of the words to some extent. The system can be further improved by introducing a post-processing phase to correct errors generated by the system.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对手写孟加拉语单词识别问题，构建了9841张图片的自定义数据集，采用SSD+MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN+InceptionResNetV2及二者集成模型进行训练与测试，并提出改进的非极大值抑制以提升效果。集成模型表现最佳，F1-score达92.61%，单词级别识别率达96.12%。
AI.motivation: OCR可自动扫描文档并提取文本，但孟加拉语缺乏可靠的等效方案，手写文本尤为困难。单词识别是OCR流程中（词分割之后的第二阶段）最关键环节，若该阶段失败，其他阶段表现再好，整体OCR性能仍会很差。因此本文旨在实现手写孟加拉语单词图像的识别。
AI.method: 将手写孟加拉语单词识别建模为基于深度学习的目标检测任务，采用三种模型：SSD结合MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN结合InceptionResNetV2，以及二者的集成模型。引入改进的非极大值抑制（NMS）以提升检测效果。自建包含9841张手写孟加拉语单词图像的数据集，涵盖不同书写者的多样笔迹风格。
AI.result: 在测试集上评估三种模型性能，集成模型效果最佳，F1-score为92.61%；在单词级别上，集成模型对96.12%的单词能实现一定程度的正确识别。
AI.conclusion: 集成模型在手写孟加拉语单词识别中表现最优。可通过引入后处理阶段纠正在识别过程中产生的错误，进一步改进该系统。

title: The RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset
summary: Intracranial aneurysm rupture is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, yet aneurysm detection remains challenging, particularly for small lesions and on routine non-angiographic imaging examinations. To support the development and evaluation of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms for intracranial aneurysm detection and localization, the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), in collaboration with the American Society of Neuroradiology (ASNR), the Society of Neurointerventional Surgery (SNIS), and the European Society of Neuroradiology (ESNR), curated the RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset. Developed for the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge, RSNA-ICA is a large, publicly available, expert-annotated dataset comprising 7202 CTA, MRA, and MRI series from 4278 adult patients collected across 21 institutions in 12 countries spanning five continents. The dataset includes 2566 CTA, 2166 MRA, and 2470 MRI series from patients with and without intracranial saccular aneurysms, providing substantial geographic and imaging diversity. Expert annotations indicate both aneurysm presence and location, and 178 series additionally include three-dimensional segmentations of challenge-defined vascular locations. RSNA-ICA was used to develop and evaluate algorithms in the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge. Of the 7202 image series, 5041 are publicly available through MIRA (https://mira.rsna.org/dataset/7), while the remainder were used for challenge public and private test sets. The dataset is freely available to the research community for noncommercial use and provides a comprehensive resource for advancing AI-based aneurysm detection across both angiographic and routine neuroimaging examinations.

AI.tldr: RSNA联合ASNR、SNIS、ESNR构建了公开的颅内动脉瘤检测数据集RSNA-ICA，包含来自12国21家机构4278名患者的7202个CTA/MRA/MRI序列，用于2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛。
AI.motivation: 颅内动脉瘤破裂致死致残率高，但检测困难，尤其小病灶及常规非血管成像检查中更易漏诊。为支持AI算法在颅内动脉瘤检测与定位方面的开发与评估，需构建大规模、专家标注的数据集。
AI.method: 构建RSNA-ICA数据集：涵盖CTA、MRA、MRI序列共7202个（2566 CTA、2166 MRA、2470 MRI），来自12国21家机构4278名成人患者，含动脉瘤有无病例；提供动脉瘤存在与位置的专家标注，178个序列附带三维分割标注；数据用于2025年RSNA挑战赛的算法开发与评估。
AI.result: 数据集提供显著的地理与影像多样性；7202个序列中5041个通过MIRA公开，其余用于挑战赛公开与私有测试集；数据集免费向研究界开放用于非商业用途。
AI.conclusion: RSNA-ICA为推进基于AI的动脉瘤检测（涵盖血管成像与常规神经影像检查）提供了全面资源，支持AI算法开发与基准评估。

title: OptimusMesh: Compact Autoregressive Mesh Generation from Point Clouds via Sparse Latent Pivots
summary: Generating compact and geometrically faithful 3D meshes directly from point clouds remains a fundamental challenge. Point clouds are unordered and sparse, whereas meshes exhibit irregular structure and varying topology. As a result, many existing approaches rely on implicit representations followed by surface extraction or reconstruction. Although effective, these pipelines can produce dense or over-smoothed meshes, often requiring computationally expensive post-processing and simplification. We present OptimusMesh, a framework for direct compact triangle mesh generation from point clouds using sparse latent pivot conditioning. Our key idea is to compress $2{,}048$ oriented input points into only $16$ sparse latent pivots, reducing the geometric conditioning set by $128\times$. These pivots provide a compact structural representation shared across a two-stage autoregressive framework that first generates mesh vertices and then predicts triangular faces conditioned on the generated vertices and the same pivots. Compared with the evaluated recent point-cloud-conditioned autoregressive methods, which use $257$ decoder-conditioning tokens, OptimusMesh uses only $16$, yielding a $16.1\times$ shorter conditioning sequence. Experiments show that OptimusMesh produces the most compact outputs among the compared recent autoregressive methods, using $25.7\%$--$94.1\%$ fewer faces while maintaining competitive geometric fidelity and distributional quality.

AI.tldr: 提出OptimusMesh，用16个稀疏潜枢轴压缩2048个输入点，实现从点云直接生成紧凑三角网格的两阶段自回归框架。
AI.motivation: 点云无序稀疏而网格结构不规则、拓扑多变，直接从点云生成紧凑且几何保真的3D网格仍是基础难题。现有方法多依赖隐式表示加表面提取或重建，虽有效但易产生稠密或过度平滑的网格，且需昂贵的后处理与简化。
AI.method: OptimusMesh采用稀疏潜枢轴条件化实现从点云直接生成紧凑三角网格：将2048个带方向输入点压缩为仅16个稀疏潜枢轴，使几何条件集缩小128倍；这些枢轴作为紧凑结构表示，共享于两阶段自回归框架，第一阶段生成网格顶点，第二阶段基于生成顶点与相同枢轴预测三角面。
AI.result: 相比近期点云条件自回归方法使用257个解码器条件token，OptimusMesh仅用16个，条件序列缩短16.1倍；在对比的近期自回归方法中输出最紧凑，面数减少25.7%–94.1%，同时保持有竞争力的几何保真度与分布质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过稀疏潜枢轴大幅压缩几何条件并使用共享的两阶段自回归生成，OptimusMesh可在无需隐式重建与繁重后处理的情况下，直接从点云生成紧凑且几何保真的三角网格。

title: CineMR: Tool-Integrated Vision-Language Reasoning for Quantitative Cardiac MRI Assessment
comment: Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR
summary: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), including cine imaging, is a reference standard for the noninvasive assessment of cardiac morphology and ventricular function. Cine CMR interpretation integrates qualitative visual assessment with quantitative measurements of ventricular volumes, ejection fraction, myocardial mass, wall thickness, and regional wall motion. Current medical vision-language models (VLMs) cannot reliably derive quantitative measurements from multidimensional cine images without analysis tools. We present CineMR, a tool-augmented VLM that invokes cardiac image-analysis tools and integrates their outputs into interleaved reasoning for quantitative CMR assessment. We also construct a multi-cohort visual question answering benchmark covering quantitative metric extraction, multiclass diagnosis, and differential diagnosis, together with tools for segmentation, phase selection, volumetry, morphometry, and regional wall motion analysis. CineMR is trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-interaction traces followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with conditional tool-use rewards. On the multi-cohort cine CMR benchmark, CineMR achieves 35.9% pass@1 and 58.9% pass@4, compared with 1.5% pass@1 for the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone and 0.0% and 7.0% pass@1 for LLaVA-Med v1.5 and MedGemma-4B, respectively. Correct tool invocation reaches 99.8% after GRPO, up from 78.9% after SFT. Live tool outputs improve ventricular measurement accuracy by 20.4--23.7% over direct model predictions, and removing all tools reduces pass@1 from 35.9% to 27.9%. These results highlight the importance of reliable tool use for quantitative cine CMR reasoning and support CineMR as a promising approach for assistive cardiac image assessment. Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR.

AI.tldr: 提出工具增强的视觉语言模型CineMR，通过调用心脏影像分析工具并结合交错推理，实现电影CMR定量评估，并构建多队列VQA基准。
AI.motivation: 电影CMR是评估心脏形态与心室功能的无创金标准，但现有医学视觉语言模型无法在多维电影图像中可靠地导出定量测量，需依赖分析工具；因此需要能可靠调用工具并融合其输出进行定量推理的方法。
AI.method: CineMR为工具增强VLM，调用分割、相位选择、容积测量、形态测量与局部室壁运动分析等工具，并将其输出整合进交错推理；构建覆盖定量指标提取、多类诊断与鉴别诊断的多队列VQA基准。训练采用SFT（工具交互轨迹）后接GRPO（条件工具使用奖励）。
AI.result: 在多队列电影CMR基准上，CineMR达35.9% pass@1、58.9% pass@4；Qwen3-VL-8B骨干为1.5% pass@1，LLaVA-Med v1.5与MedGemma-4B分别为0.0%和7.0%。GRPO后正确工具调用率从SFT的78.9%升至99.8%。实时工具输出使心室测量精度较直接预测提升20.4–23.7%；移除全部工具使pass@1由35.9%降至27.9%。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的工具使用对定量电影CMR推理至关重要，CineMR可作为辅助心脏影像评估的有前景方法；代码、基准资源与模型权重已开源。

title: Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting: Training-Free Negation Understanding for Vision-Language Models
summary: Despite the strong performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a wide range of visual question answering (VQA) tasks, these models consistently struggle to understand negation and produce incorrect answers when questions involve negated clauses. To address this limitation, we propose Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting (\textbf{SSP}), a training-free, in-context learning method that improves VLM negation understanding capabilities without any parameter updates. Given a negation question, our method first abstracts the underlying question structure into a skeleton, retrieves a small set of same-skeleton questions from a lightweight question pool, then prompts the VLM to analyze their shared negation pattern and synthesize a single-sentence answering strategy. The skeleton and strategy are prepended to the test sample to guide the model correctly tackle the negation problems. Experiments on multiple negation VQA benchmarks show that SSP achieves state-of-the-art performance on negation-focused VQA tasks while remaining computationally efficient.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting (SSP)，一种免训练、基于上下文学习的方法，通过抽象问题骨架、检索同骨架样例并合成否定处理策略，提升VLM的否定理解能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型（VLM）在广泛的视觉问答（VQA）任务上表现强劲，但在涉及否定从句的问题上持续表现不佳，容易产生错误答案。现有模型缺乏对否定语义的鲁棒理解能力。
AI.method: SSP是一种免训练、基于上下文学习的方法，无需任何参数更新。给定一个否定问题，首先将其底层问题结构抽象为骨架（skeleton），随后从轻量级问题池中检索一小组同骨架的问题，再提示VLM分析其共享的否定模式，并合成一句式的回答策略（strategy）。最后将骨架与策略前置拼接至测试样本，引导模型正确应对否定问题。
AI.result: 在多个否定VQA基准上的实验表明，SSP在否定聚焦的VQA任务上取得了当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能，同时保持计算高效。
AI.conclusion: SSP通过结构抽象与策略合成的方式，在不更新参数的前提下有效增强了VLM的否定理解能力，验证了免训练上下文学习方法在否定VQA任务中的有效性与效率优势。

title: Color Independent Word Segmentation From Transcribed Bangla Passages
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 6th International Conference on Electrical Information and Communication Technology (EICT)
summary: An optical character recognition(OCR) system can scan paper and extract text, making people's jobs easier. While numerous OCR systems are accessible in the software sector, finding a dependable equivalent solution for Bangla is tough. When it comes to handwritten texts, the case is even more rare. The first fundamental step to any OCR is to segment words from text images. If this stage fails, the total OCR's performance will be poor no matter how promising the later stages perform. This research aims to segment words in a handwritten Bangla text image. This research can be implemented on any smartphone-captured image, irrespective of the color and type of paper and ink. Furthermore, as smartphone-captured images can create shadow interferences, the custom dataset built for this research is created in such a way that every possible obstacle that can be faced is included. For 7374 words, a total of 7278 bounding boxes are generated, which have recall of 90.60 %, precision of 91.80 %, and F1-score of 91.20 %. The system can be further improved with nested operations on bounding boxes containing several words or by adjusting the adaptive thresholding and dilation filter sizes to a more precise level.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对手写孟加拉语文本图像，提出一种可在任意智能手机拍摄图像上运行的单词分割方法，在自建数据集（7374个词）上生成7278个边界框，取得90.60%召回率、91.80%精确率和91.20% F1值。
AI.motivation: OCR系统能扫描纸质文档并提取文本，但孟加拉语缺乏可靠的OCR方案，手写场景更为稀缺。单词分割是OCR的首要基础步骤，若该阶段失败，后续环节再优秀也无法保证整体性能。因此需要解决手写孟加拉语文本图像的单词分割问题。
AI.method: 以单词分割为核心任务，方法不依赖纸张颜色与类型、墨水种类，可适用于任意智能手机拍摄图像。针对手机拍摄图像可能存在阴影干扰的问题，专门构建了涵盖各种潜在障碍的自定义数据集。
AI.result: 在包含7374个单词的数据集上，共生成7278个边界框，召回率为90.60%，精确率为91.80%，F1值为91.20%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统可通过以下方式进一步改进：对包含多个单词的边界框执行嵌套操作，或将自适应阈值化与膨胀滤波器的尺寸调整到更精细的水平。

title: FlashBack: Knowing When to Remember in Streaming Vision-Language Models
summary: Streaming vision-language models must process continuously growing video streams under a bounded compute budget, creating a persistent tension between real-time perception and long-term memory. Retrieving historical information provides a natural remedy, yet historical recall is not uniformly beneficial: unnecessary history may introduce irrelevant context into current reasoning and interfere with native real-time perception. Effective streaming memory should therefore address not only what to remember, but also when and how to access it. To this end, we introduce FlashBack, a training-free framework for selective, multi-level memory in streaming vision-language models. Before retrieving history, FlashBack draws on the semantic understanding of the frozen streaming VLM to infer whether a query calls for historical evidence. This assessment determines whether inference remains on the Native trajectory or invokes an isolated Recall trajectory. The Recall trajectory combines recent context with retrieved long-term memory through a query-local Side-KV pathway, preserving local temporal continuity without modifying the persistent Native state. We instantiate FlashBack on StreamingVLM and Mage-VL-4B and evaluate it on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench. The results show improvements on several long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks while largely preserving real-time perception, with performance competitive with strong training-based streaming methods despite requiring no additional training. Our code will be announced later.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 FlashBack，通过选择性地、多层级地调用历史记忆，在有限算力下缓解流式视觉语言模型中实时感知与长期记忆的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 流式视觉语言模型需在有限算力下处理持续增长的视频流，实时感知与长期记忆之间存在持久矛盾。检索历史信息虽可缓解，但并非总是有益：无关历史会引入无关上下文并干扰原生实时感知。因此有效的流式记忆不仅要解决"记什么"，还要解决"何时"及"如何"访问。
AI.method: FlashBack 是一个免训练的选择性多层级记忆框架。检索历史前，先利用冻结流式 VLM 的语义理解判断查询是否需要历史证据；该判断决定推理保持 Native 轨迹还是调用独立的 Recall 轨迹。Recall 轨迹通过查询局部的 Side-KV 通路融合近期上下文与检索到的长期记忆，在不修改持久 Native 状态的前提下保持局部时间连续性。
AI.result: 在 StreamingVLM 与 Mage-VL-4B 上实例化，并在 OVO-Bench 与 StreamingBench 上评估。结果显示在若干长时程和依赖记忆的任务上有所提升，同时基本保持实时感知能力，性能与强训练式流式方法相当，且无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: 选择性地、按需检索历史记忆的多层级设计，可在不额外训练的情况下兼顾流式 VLM 的实时感知与长期记忆能力。

title: iSEE: Object Permanence Through Self-Supervision
summary: Object permanence, keeping track of an object's identity and position while it is occluded, is central to video representations that track, predict and plan. Trackers that achieve it learn from boxes, track identities and visibility labels. On the other hand, self-supervised object-centric methods discover objects without labels: through slot attention, it represents a video as slots that bind to objects and follow them across frames. However, these slots are lost under occlusion, making the desired permanence impossible. Reasoning permanence is a hard problem because it requires to detect when an object becomes occluded, re-identify when object reappears, and keep the object's hidden position continuous, using reapperance as the only learning cue. To address this, we propose iSEE, a novel framework that offers all three aforementioned requirements, without any labels whatsoever. We built iSEE using the following three proposed components: (i) Object evidence modelling: a slot's attention, compared with its own past, reveals when its object is hidden. (ii) Appearance-position separation: two slot streams let the appearance be held for re-identification while the position keeps changing. (iii) Permanence from reappearance: a walker follows the hidden object's position, trained only on where the object reappears. On LA-CATER static, iSEE returns a reappearing object to its own slot after 86% of occlusions, against 32% for SlotContrast, and localises it while hidden within 4.1 mAP of the label-trained SoTA RAM. The two streams also allow downstream planning, with the position stream as the action of a world model. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/iSEE/

AI.tldr: iSEE是一个无需任何标签的自监督框架，通过对象证据建模、外观-位置分离与重现驱动的永存性学习，使slot attention在遮挡下保持对象身份与位置，实现视频对象永存性。
AI.motivation: 对象永存性要求在被遮挡时仍跟踪对象身份与位置，对有标签跟踪器至关重要。但自监督的slot attention方法在遮挡下会丢失slot，无法实现永存性。而解决该问题困难在于需同时检测遮挡发生、对象重现时重识别、并保持隐藏位置连续，且仅有重现场景作为学习信号。
AI.method: 提出iSEE框架，包含三个组件：(i)对象证据建模：将slot的注意力与其自身历史对比，判断对象何时被隐藏；(ii)外观-位置分离：使用两条slot流，一条保持外观用于重识别，另一条持续更新位置；(iii)基于重现的永存性：用一个walker跟随被遮挡对象的位置，仅以对象重现场景进行训练。
AI.result: 在LA-CATER static上，iSEE在86%的遮挡后能将重现对象归回其原slot（SlotContrast为32%），并在隐藏期间定位精度达到与有标签SoTA RAM相差4.1 mAP以内。两条流还支持下游规划，位置流可作为世界模型的action。
AI.conclusion: iSEE在完全无标签条件下实现了遮挡下的对象永存性，显著优于现有自监督方法，并接近有标签SoTA，同时支持下游规划任务。

title: Semantic RGB--Depth Based Surgical Skill Assessment in Microscopic Stereo Videos
summary: Objective assessment of microsurgical technical skill is essential for competency-based training and quality assurance, yet existing video-based approaches predominantly rely on RGB images and therefore overlook the 3D spatial relationships that characterize instrument-anatomy interactions. Although stereo operating microscopes provide complementary depth information, conventional stereo matching algorithms can produce sparse and unreliable depth estimates under high-magnification imaging conditions, limiting their use for automated skill assessment. This work presents a semantic RGB-Depth framework for surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. A regression-based depth fusion method combines sparse metric stereo depth with dense monocular depth estimates to generate a dense geometric representation of the surgical scene. This representation is integrated with semantically decomposed RGB streams corresponding to individual surgical instruments and surrounding anatomy. A hierarchical attention architecture jointly encodes these streams to capture discriminative patterns of instrument use and instrument-anatomy interaction across surgeons at different training levels. The framework was evaluated on 33 ex vivo transoral microlaryngeal procedures performed by six surgeons, comprising attending surgeons and surgical residents, using leave-one-surgeon-out cross-validation. The proposed semantic RGB-Depth model achieved an F1 score of 0.938 for skill-level classification, compared with 0.696 for semantic RGB and 0.929 for semantic depth. These results suggest that geometric information can improve automated surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. The learned spatial, temporal, and semantic attention patterns also support qualitative examination of the scene regions, video segments, and semantic streams emphasized by the model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种语义RGB-Depth框架,利用显微立体视频进行手术技能自动评估。通过回归式深度融合将稀疏立体深度与稠密单目深度结合,并与语义分解的RGB流融合,用层次化注意力架构联合编码。在33例离体经口喉显微手术上,F1达0.938,优于语义RGB(0.696)和语义深度(0.929)。
AI.motivation: 显微外科技能客观评估对胜任力培训和质控至关重要,但现有视频方法多依赖RGB图像,忽略了器械-解剖交互的3D空间关系。立体显微镜虽提供深度信息,但传统立体匹配在高倍放大条件下深度估计稀疏且不可靠,限制了其在自动技能评估中的应用。
AI.method: 提出语义RGB-Depth框架:采用基于回归的深度融合方法,将稀疏度量立体深度与稠密单目深度估计结合,生成稠密几何表示;将该表示与语义分解的RGB流(分别对应各手术器械与周围解剖)集成;使用层次化注意力架构联合编码这些流,捕捉不同训练水平外科医生在器械使用及器械-解剖交互上的判别性模式。评估采用留一医生交叉验证。
AI.result: 在6名医生(含主治医师与住院医师)完成的33例离体经口喉显微手术上评估。语义RGB-Depth模型技能水平分类F1为0.938,语义RGB为0.696,语义深度为0.929。
AI.conclusion: 几何信息可提升基于显微立体视频的自动手术技能评估。所学到的空间、时间与语义注意力模式亦支持对模型所关注的场景区域、视频片段和语义流进行定性检查。

title: Resolving Mixed Single-Photon LiDAR Returns for Foreground-View and Hidden Scene Reconstruction
summary: Partially transmissive screens and protective covers are common in robotic inspection, but they create mixed LiDAR returns from both the foreground material and the scene behind it. Conventional peak-based LiDAR usually discards weak hidden returns, while single-photon LiDAR records time-resolved histograms that preserve attenuated and overlapping echoes. However, existing transient reconstruction methods typically fit a single scene representation to the measured waveform. Under occlusion, weak or nearby foreground--hidden echoes can form a broad peak or subtle shoulder. Because such waveforms can also be explained by a displaced single surface or a thick density distribution, accurate transient fitting does not necessarily imply correct geometry. We propose a state-aware framework for foreground-view and hidden scene reconstruction from occluded single-photon histograms. For each ray, we estimate local echo evidence, identifying no reliable surface evidence, single-return evidence, or two returns. The inferred echo state routes supervision for a two-head neural field: all rays constrain waveform reconstruction, while reliable anchors provide geometry localization. We also introduce a real paired single-photon LiDAR occlusion dataset with occluded and clean captures at fixed poses. Experiments on a real dataset show improved hidden scene depth and point-cloud accuracy over baselines. Our results demonstrate single-photon layered reconstruction as a practical route for 3D perception through partially transmissive occluders.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种状态感知框架，从被部分透射遮挡物遮挡的单光子LiDAR直方图中重建前景与隐藏场景，并引入真实配对遮挡数据集，提升隐藏场景深度与点云精度。
AI.motivation: 机器人巡检中常遇到部分透射屏幕与防护罩，会产生前景材料与后方场景混合的LiDAR回波。传统峰值型LiDAR会丢弃弱隐藏回波，而单光子LiDAR虽保留时间分辨直方图，能记录衰减与重叠回波，但现有瞬态重建方法通常对波形拟合单一场景表示。遮挡下弱或邻近的前景—隐藏回波会形成宽峰或微弱肩峰，这类波形也可被位移的单表面或厚密度分布解释，因此瞬态拟合正确并不必然意味着几何正确。
AI.method: 提出状态感知框架用于前景—隐藏场景重建。对每条射线估计局部回波证据，判定为无可靠表面证据、单回波证据或双回波，并将推断的回波状态用于双头神经场的监督路由：所有射线约束波形重建，可靠锚点提供几何定位。同时构建真实配对单光子LiDAR遮挡数据集，包含固定位姿下的遮挡与干净采集。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上，相比基线方法，隐藏场景深度与点云精度均得到提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，单光子分层重建是通过部分透射遮挡物实现3D感知的可行路径。

title: EgoFound3R: End-to-End Egocentric Hand Reconstruction in World Space with Point-Wise Interaction Attributes
summary: Egocentric video has become a primary source of supervision for embodied models, and its value rests on recovering hand motion in world coordinates, which camera motion and hand occlusion make difficult. Existing reconstruction pipelines typically separate hand and scene estimation, leave interaction attributes to separate task-specific models, and invoke several models per video, so no prior reconstruction model estimates these attributes and throughput becomes a practical constraint on large-scale annotation. We therefore introduce EgoFound3R, a unified end-to-end model that estimates world-space hand geometry in a metric scale shared with the scene, and predicts point-wise interaction attributes, including visibility, contact, and distance. The model integrates three designs: (i) structured hand prompts that transfer pretrained geometric priors to world-space hand reconstruction; (ii) an explicit hand representation that decodes hand geometry and interaction attributes; and (iii) a shared-parameter multi-rate design that lowers inference cost. Together, these designs predict hand geometry and point-wise attributes in one pass. On OakInk-v2, TACO, and HOI4D, EgoFound3R reduces the mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 43.2%, 22.4%, and 11.6% over previous methods and predicts point-wise contact and distance alongside the geometry in the same pass, while attaining approximately 6x higher throughput.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的端到端模型EgoFound3R，在单次前向中恢复与世界坐标共享度量尺度的手部几何并预测逐点交互属性，同时将吞吐量提升约6倍。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频已成为具身模型监督的主要来源，其价值取决于在世界坐标系中恢复手部运动，但相机运动与手部遮挡使这一任务困难。现有重建流程将手部与场景估计分离，将交互属性留给独立的任务特定模型，并需对每个视频调用多个模型，导致没有单一重建模型同时估计这些属性，吞吐量成为大规模标注的实际瓶颈。
AI.method: EgoFound3R包含三项设计：(i) 结构化手部提示，将预训练几何先验迁移到世界空间手部重建；(ii) 显式手部表示，用于解码手部几何与交互属性；(iii) 共享参数的多速率设计，以降低推理成本。三者结合可在一次前向中同时预测手部几何与逐点属性（含可见性、接触与距离）。
AI.result: 在OakInk-v2、TACO与HOI4D上，EgoFound3R相较先前方法的MPJPE分别降低43.2%、22.4%与11.6%，并在同一轮中预测逐点接触与距离，吞吐量提升约6倍。
AI.conclusion: 统一端到端建模可同时提升世界空间手部重建精度与交互属性预测能力，并显著改善推理效率，为大规模第一人称视频标注提供可行方案。

title: AutoGUIWorld: Image Generators as Visual World Models for GUI Agent
summary: GUI agents require high-quality interaction trajectories to learn how software environments respond to actions, maintain state, and support multi-step workflows. However, the diversity of available trajectories is constrained by the applications, interface states, and workflows accessible in the underlying environments. Expanding this coverage requires deploying increasingly diverse and complex software, with specialized applications imposing additional installation, configuration, and runtime costs. We introduce AutoGUIWorld, a data generation framework that combines the visual priors of image generators with the task knowledge of a planner to synthesize GUI interaction trajectories without deploying or running the corresponding software environments. AutoGUIWorld samples initial GUI scenes from structured specifications of operating-system context, visual appearance, and interface state, and generates tasks conditioned on those scenes. A planner then specifies atomic actions and their intended visual consequences, while an image generator iteratively edits the current screenshot to produce subsequent observations. Action grounding and transition-level quality filtering yield 79,266 spatially annotated step-level training samples across Ubuntu, Windows, macOS, and Chrome. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoGUIWorld trajectories improves the mean task score on OSWorld from 33.0% to 40.8% and the task success rate on ScienceBoard from 14.0% to 32.2%. These results show that generated trajectories improve GUI-agent performance on real desktop and scientific tasks.

AI.tldr: AutoGUIWorld：利用图像生成器的视觉先验与规划器的任务知识，在不部署真实软件环境的情况下合成GUI交互轨迹，产出79,266条样本，微调Qwen3.5-35B-A3B后在OSWorld与ScienceBoard上显著提升。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体训练依赖高质量交互轨迹，但轨迹多样性受限于底层环境中可访问的应用、界面状态与工作流。扩展覆盖范围需部署日益多样且复杂的软件，专用应用还会带来额外的安装、配置与运行时成本。
AI.method: 提出AutoGUIWorld数据生成框架：基于操作系统上下文、视觉外观与界面状态的结构化规格采样初始GUI场景，并据此生成任务；由规划器指定原子动作及其预期视觉后果，图像生成器迭代编辑当前截图以产生后续观测；再通过动作定位（action grounding）与转移级质量过滤筛选样本。
AI.result: 在Ubuntu、Windows、macOS和Chrome上获得79,266个带空间标注的步级训练样本。用AutoGUIWorld轨迹微调Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，OSWorld平均任务得分由33.0%提升至40.8%，ScienceBoard任务成功率由14.0%提升至32.2%。
AI.conclusion: 生成的轨迹能够提升GUI智能体在真实桌面与科学任务上的表现，表明无需部署真实软件环境即可合成有效的GUI交互训练数据。

title: A Compact Explicit 4D Representation for Dynamic Scenes
summary: A compact dynamic-scene representation must retain both the surfaces seen over time and the appearance needed to render them from new viewpoints. We present Sparc4D, a feed-forward autoencoder that encodes a monocular video with known cameras into a sparse 4D scene state. Static features are shared across the clip, while spatially anchored temporal slots compress time-varying features. A sparse decoder produces 2D Gaussian surfels, while stored source pixels preserve fine texture through geometric re-projection. The state includes one full source frame and dynamic-region pixels sampled every fourth frame, alongside learned features and sparse occupancy. For a 32-frame MultiCamVideo clip, it averages 0.95M 32-bit-equivalent values on random windows and 0.92M on the first-32 protocol. On first-32, Sparc4D reaches 21.70\,dB, compared with 20.40\,dB for MoVieS. On randomly placed windows, their PSNR scores are comparable. With stored texture disabled, temporal slots compress the time-varying feature state by a median $4.0\times$ and reduce the mean state from 1.04M to 0.42M values, with essentially unchanged target-view reconstruction quality. Without fine-tuning on real data, Sparc4D transfers to DyCheck and Neu3D, where stored texture improves LPIPS while slightly reducing PSNR.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sparc4D——一种前馈自编码器，将已知相机的单目视频编码为稀疏 4D 场景状态，兼顾静态与动态特征，并以稀疏解码器生成 2D Gaussian surfels。
AI.motivation: 紧凑的动态场景表示需同时保留随时间观察到的表面与新视角渲染所需的外观信息，现有方法在状态紧凑性与重建质量之间难以兼顾。
AI.method: 静态特征跨片段共享；以空间锚定的时序槽（temporal slots）压缩时变特征；稀疏解码器产生 2D Gaussian surfels，同时存储源像素通过几何重投影保留精细纹理。状态包含一帧完整源帧、每四帧采样的动态区域像素，以及学习到的特征与稀疏占用。
AI.result: 在 32 帧 MultiCamVideo 片段上，随机窗口平均 0.95M 个 32 位等价值，first-32 协议为 0.92M；first-32 下 PSNR 达 21.70 dB，优于 MoVieS 的 20.40 dB，随机窗口下二者 PSNR 相当。关闭存储纹理时，时序槽将时变特征状态中位数压缩 4.0 倍，均值状态从 1.04M 降至 0.42M，目标视角重建质量基本不变。
AI.conclusion: Sparc4D 实现紧凑且高效的稀疏 4D 表示；无需真实数据微调即可迁移至 DyCheck 与 Neu3D，其中存储纹理提升 LPIPS 但略微降低 PSNR。

title: Flow Matching Reinforcement for 3D Mesh Generation via Dynamic Homing Optimization
summary: Flow matching is central to 3D generation, yet in practice its reinforcement learning (RL) methods are largely adapted from 2D visual generation. Representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives, when applied to negative trajectories, mainly steer predicted velocities away from the corresponding directions without explicitly specifying a target velocity field toward preferred samples. In 3D generation, constrained by pretrained model capabilities, rollout diversity, and reward-distribution complexity, directly applying these RL methods yields limited gains in geometric quality. We introduce a forward-process RL method \textbf{Dynamic Homing Optimization (DHO)}, which reformulates negative-trajectory optimization as positive-sample attraction-guided dynamic homing. Specifically, Minimum-Cost Attractive Matching (MAM) assigns each negative sample a distinct positive target, and Time-Aware Dynamic Correction (TDC) then redirects its trajectory toward the target using a remaining-time-aware corrective velocity. Building on asynchronous online DHO, we develop \textbf{Flow3D-Pro}, an image-to-3D geometry generation framework. Experiments show that DHO outperforms representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives in 3D generation, while Flow3D-Pro produces higher-quality 3D geometry than existing mesh generation methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出前向过程强化学习方法DHO，将负轨迹优化重构为受正样本吸引引导的动态归航，并基于此构建图生3D几何生成框架Flow3D-Pro。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成的强化学习方法多直接沿用2D视觉生成的DPO、GRPO、NFT式目标，对负轨迹仅使预测速度远离对应方向，而未显式指定指向偏好样本的目标速度场；受预训练模型能力、rollout多样性与奖励分布复杂性限制，直接套用这些方法在几何质量上收益有限。
AI.method: 提出前向过程的强化学习方法DHO，将负轨迹优化重构为“正样本吸引引导的动态归航”：由最小代价吸引匹配（MAM）为每个负样本分配一个不同的正目标，再由时间感知动态校正（TDC）利用剩余时间感知的校正速度将其轨迹重定向至目标；在此基础上构建异步在线DHO的图生3D几何生成框架Flow3D-Pro。
AI.result: 实验表明，DHO在3D生成中优于代表性的DPO、GRPO与NFT式目标，Flow3D-Pro生成的3D几何质量优于现有网格生成方法。
AI.conclusion: 将负轨迹优化转化为正样本吸引引导的动态归航可有效提升3D生成中的强化学习效果，Flow3D-Pro验证了该范式在图像到3D几何生成任务上的优越性。

title: When the Judge Acts: Auditing VLM-Guided Image Selection on Culturally Situated Prompts
comment: 25 pages including appendix. Code and project page: https://github.com/seochan99/JudgeActs ; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/seochan99/JudgeActs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly act as judges that pick the best of several generated images, so their choices decide what users see. Such judges are usually validated by score agreement with human ratings, not by the images they return. We audit VLM judges as decision-makers: on 300 culturally situated prompts, we compare the returned image with human ratings the judge never sees and with random choice from the same candidates, and repeat every decision with the candidates reordered. A 4B-parameter judge barely beats random and falls short of a CLIP similarity baseline. It picks the first image shown in 49% of calls (chance: 28%), and reordering changes its choice on 60% of prompts. For this judge, agreement across orders is informative: decisions that survive reordering are much better than random, whereas agreement with a weaker second judge keeps the wrong ones. An 8B judge shows almost no position bias and outperforms CLIP, yet for it the same filter mostly discards good decisions. Agreement helps only when it targets the judge's failure mode, so filters must be re-audited whenever the judge changes. The 4B judge's slight rise in stereotype ratings is no longer detectable after aggregating across orders or with the larger judge.

AI.tldr: 该论文将视觉语言模型（VLM）评判器作为决策者进行审计，而非依赖与人类评分的分数一致性。在300个文化情境提示上，研究表明4B参数评判器几乎仅略优于随机选择，存在严重位置偏差；8B评判器几乎无位置偏差且优于CLIP基线，但相同的重排序一致性过滤策略对其反而丢弃大量正确决策。一致性过滤只在针对评判器特定失败模式时有效。
AI.motivation: VLM日益充当从多张生成图像中挑选最佳图像的评判器，其选择直接决定用户所见内容。然而现有验证方法主要依赖评判器评分与人类评分的一致性，而非检验其实际返回的图像决策。论文动机在于揭示这种"评分一致性"验证方式的不足，并系统审计VLM作为决策者的真实行为，包括位置偏差与决策稳定性。
AI.method: 在300个文化情境提示上，将评判器返回的图像与评判器未见的人类评分、以及从同一候选集中的随机选择进行比较；对每个决策进行候选图像重排序后重复测试。同时对比4B与8B参数评判器，并以CLIP相似度作为基线，分析位置偏差、重排序一致性，以及跨评判器一致性作为过滤策略的效果。
AI.result: 4B评判器几乎仅略优于随机，且低于CLIP相似度基线；49%的调用中选择第一张图像（随机概率为28%），重排序在60%的提示上改变其选择。对该评判器而言，跨顺序一致性具有信息量：重排序后仍保持的决策显著优于随机，而与较弱第二评判器的一致性则保留了错误决策。8B评判器几乎无位置偏差并优于CLIP，但同一过滤策略对其主要丢弃正确决策。聚合跨顺序或使用更大评判器后，4B评判器在刻板印象评分上的轻微上升不再可检测。
AI.conclusion: 一致性过滤只在针对评判器特定失败模式时才有效，因此每当评判器更换时，过滤策略都必须重新审计。评判器的验证不应仅依赖评分一致性，而应基于其实际决策行为进行评估。

title: PickMoment: Continuous-Time Single-Image-to-Video via Learning Deblurring and Blur-to-Video
summary: Motion blur arises from the temporal integration of a continuous sharp signal over a finite exposure window, yet existing learning-based methods sidestep this physical model and predict only the sharp signal itself: most single-image deblurring methods recover a single frame at the exposure center, while blur-to-video methods predict a fixed set of frames. We introduce PickMoment, a continuous-time reformulation that directly learns the interval-mean blur over arbitrary sub-intervals of the exposure with a single deterministic model. Drawing an analogy to MeanFlow's average-velocity formulation, we train the model with three supervisions derived from the blur integral: an empirical reconstruction loss from available subframes, an additivity loss that enforces self-consistency across overlapping sub-intervals, and a sharp-frame loss anchored at the zero-interval limit. A single trained model unifies single-image deblurring, blur-to-video generation, and continuous-time pick-a-moment recovery as different queries to the same network, with no separate training for each task. Our PickMoment achieves state-of-the-art performance among generative-based deblurring methods on GoPro and HIDE while competitive against restoration-based methods on RealBlur, and the highest per-frame fidelity on GoPro-7 blur-to-video, all in a single forward pass without iterative sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出 PickMoment，将去模糊重新表述为连续时间学习曝光区间平均模糊，用单一确定性模型统一单图去模糊、模糊转视频与任意时刻清晰帧恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式去模糊方法偏离了运动模糊的物理形成模型：单图去模糊只恢复曝光中心的一帧，模糊转视频只预测固定数量帧，无法在任意子区间上查询曝光内的清晰信号，也无法统一多种任务。
AI.method: 借鉴 MeanFlow 的平均速度表述，直接学习任意子区间上的区间均值模糊。训练使用三种源自模糊积分的监督：基于可用子帧的经验重建损失、约束重叠子区间自一致性的可加性损失、以及锚定零区间极限的清晰帧损失。单一模型将三类任务视为对同一网络的查询。
AI.result: 在 GoPro 与 HIDE 上取得生成式去模糊方法中的最优性能，在 RealBlur 上与复原类方法相当；在 GoPro-7 模糊转视频上取得最高的单帧保真度，且均为单次前向、无需迭代采样。
AI.conclusion: PickMoment 以连续时间区间均值建模回归模糊物理本质，用一个确定性模型、一次前向推理统一单图去模糊、模糊转视频与连续时间任意时刻恢复，无需分任务训练。

title: ShelfChange3D: Object-Level 3D Change Detection for Retail Shelf Monitoring
comment: Our code will be available on our project website at https://zerone0011.github.io/ShelfChange3D/
summary: Reliable shelf monitoring is an important capability for retail automation, yet existing out-of-stock detection methods mainly operate in image space and lack metric 3D localization for downstream robotic systems. We formulate shelf monitoring as object-level 3D change detection: given two RGB-D observations captured at different times, the goal is to identify changed products and localize each change with a 3D bounding box. To support this task, we introduce ShelfChange3D, comprising 145K synthetic and 5K real-world paired RGB-D observations with object-level 3D change annotations. We further propose ChangeBox, an end-to-end framework that jointly reasons over paired observations and predicts object-level 3D change boxes. To improve localization accuracy, we introduce a geometry-based refinement stage that exploits depth and gravity prior to estimate relative pose and refine predicted boxes. Experiments show that ChangeBox outperforms existing change detection baselines, with further gains from refinement and effective transfer from synthetic to real-world observations.

AI.tldr: 本文将货架监测定义为对象级3D变化检测任务，提出包含14.5万合成与5千真实配对RGB-D观测的ShelfChange3D数据集，并提出端到端框架ChangeBox，联合推理配对观测并预测对象级3D变化框，结合基于几何的细化阶段提升定位精度，实验验证其优于现有基线并具备合成到真实的迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 零售自动化需要可靠的货架监测，但现有缺货检测方法主要在图像空间操作，缺乏面向下游机器人系统的度量3D定位能力。因此需要将货架监测重新形式化为对象级3D变化检测，以识别变化商品并给出3D包围盒定位。
AI.method: 论文将货架监测形式化为对象级3D变化检测：输入为不同时刻采集的两组RGB-D观测，输出为变化商品及其3D包围盒。为此构建ShelfChange3D数据集，含145K合成与5K真实配对RGB-D观测及对象级3D变化标注。提出ChangeBox端到端框架，联合推理配对观测并预测对象级3D变化框；并引入基于几何的细化阶段，利用深度与重力先验估计相对位姿并优化预测框。
AI.result: 实验表明ChangeBox优于现有变化检测基线，几何细化带来进一步提升，且从合成数据到真实观测的迁移有效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为零售货架监测提供了具备3D度量定位能力的新任务、数据集与端到端方法，验证了几何细化与合成到真实迁移的有效性。

title: Dyna3: VLM-Guided Training-Free 4D Reconstruction via Depth Foundation Models
summary: Recent depth foundation models like Depth Anything 3 (DA3) achieve remarkable multi-view depth estimation but assume static 3D scenes, limiting their applicability to real-world dynamic environments. Existing training-free 4D methods like Easi3R and VGGT4D rely on correspondence-trained backbones whose attention encodes cross-frame matching, a property absent in depth-only models like DA3. We present Dyna3, a training-free framework that extends DA3 for 4D dynamic scene reconstruction without any fine-tuning. Our key insight is that DA3's cross-view features, though trained only for depth consistency, implicitly encode motion-discriminative signals when combined with best-match feature search across frames. Its static surfaces find consistent matches globally, while dynamic objects cannot. We further adopt vision-language models (VLM) to automatically generate scene-specific semantic prompts for SAM 3, enabling precise instance-level segmentation that distinguishes which objects move from what objects exist. For reconstruction, we decouple the scene into a cross-frame aligned static background and per-frame dynamic point clouds. Experiments on four datasets demonstrate that Dyna3 surpasses correspondence-trained methods with +5.5pp J-Mean over state-of-the-art VGGT4D on dynamic object segmentation, while achieving up to 13x faster pose estimation and 3x faster 4D reconstruction with 4 to 8x lower memory. Dyna3 could therefore enable much denser temporal sampling that prior methods cannot support.

AI.tldr: Dyna3：免训练框架，将深度基础模型DA3扩展至4D动态场景重建，通过跨帧最佳匹配特征搜索实现动态对象分割，并解耦静态背景与动态点云。
AI.motivation: 现有深度基础模型（如DA3）假设静态3D场景，难以适用于真实动态环境；而已有的免训练4D方法（Easi3R、VGGT4D）依赖对应关系训练的骨干网络，其注意力机制编码了跨帧匹配，而纯深度模型DA3缺乏这一特性。
AI.method: 核心洞察：DA3的跨视图特征虽仅针对深度一致性训练，但结合跨帧最佳匹配特征搜索后，隐式编码了运动判别信号——静态表面能全局一致匹配，动态物体则不能。进一步采用视觉语言模型（VLM）自动生成场景特定的语义提示，驱动SAM 3实现实例级分割，区分哪些物体在运动。重建时将场景解耦为跨帧对齐的静态背景与逐帧动态点云。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，Dyna3在动态对象分割上以+5.5pp J-Mean超越SOTA的VGGT4D；位姿估计提速最高13倍，4D重建提速3倍，内存降低4至8倍。
AI.conclusion: Dyna3无需微调即可超越对应关系训练的方法，可支持更密集的时间采样，突破现有方法的能力限制。

title: ODDR: One-Step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward Guidance
summary: Recent advances in deep learning for shadow removal have significantly enhanced image quality and realism. However, most approaches rely on real-world paired datasets, which are costly to collect and often limited in scene diversity, leading to limited generalization. To address these limitations, we propose One-step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward guidance (ODDR), a new framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity shadow removal without relying on real-world paired supervision. Our method begins with One-step Deshadow Diffusion (ODD), a baseline model trained on synthetic shadow data for efficient one-step shadow-free reconstruction. We further adapt ODD into ODDR using ShadowReward. In contrast to traditional, annotation-heavy approaches, ShadowReward is the first reward model for shadow removal trained entirely without human annotation. It learns to mimic human perceptual judgments by ranking synthetically generated images with controlled degradations, such as texture distortion and boundary artifacts. This reward-guided fine-tuning enables ODDR to close the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Extensive experiments show that ODD achieves strong performance without relying on real-world paired supervision, and ODDR further improves the results, narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods trained on real-world paired data while maintaining higher computational efficiency as a single-step model.

AI.tldr: 提出ODDR框架，通过奖励引导的单步扩散模型，在不依赖真实配对监督的情况下实现高效高保真阴影去除。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习阴影去除方法大多依赖真实世界配对数据集，采集成本高、场景多样性有限，导致泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 先构建基于合成阴影数据训练的单步阴影去除扩散基线模型ODD，再用ShadowReward将其适配为ODDR。ShadowReward是首个无需人工标注的阴影去除奖励模型，通过排序带受控退化（如纹理失真、边界伪影）的合成图像来模仿人类感知判断，实现奖励引导微调。
AI.result: ODD在不依赖真实配对监督下已具强性能，ODDR进一步提升，缩小了与基于真实配对数据全监督方法的差距，同时作为单步模型保持更高计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 奖励引导的单步扩散框架可有效弥合合成到真实的域差距，为高效、免配对监督的阴影去除提供新思路。

title: STAGE: Subspace-Targeted Affine Generative Erasure for Text-to-3D Models
summary:
Concept erasure suppresses a target concept while preserving behavior on unrelated inputs. Existing closed-form methods were designed for 2D image diffusion and assume a single generative pathway, so one edit must cover geometry and texture at once. Native 3D generators, which synthesize structured 3D representations directly rather than by lifting 2D samples, violate this assumption. We show that shape and object concepts must be erased in the structural stage of the pipeline and material concepts in the appearance stage. We therefore formulate erasure in native text-to-3D as a stage-aware editing problem and introduce STAGE, a training-free, closed-form framework. STAGE confines each edit to the low-dimensional subspace spanned by the differences between erase and anchor embeddings, and relaxes the norm-preserving (orthogonal) constraint of prior editors into a least-squares affine correction that maps target activations onto safe anchors subject to a penalty on the displacement of retained prompts. The correction applies to the structural stage, the appearance stage, or both. We find that the stage an edit must reach is determined by concept type. On TRELLIS, the standard open native 3D generator, across 15 shape, material, and object concepts, STAGE reaches 66.7 on a composite score that balances forgetting the target concept against preserving everything else, aggregating CLIP-based semantic and physical metrics, versus 53.2 for the strongest adapted baseline.
  Code: https://github.com/gmum/STAGE/
  Project Page https://gmum.github.io/STAGE/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出STAGE，一个面向原生文本到3D生成器的免训练、闭式、阶段感知概念擦除框架，根据概念类型将编辑限定在结构阶段或外观阶段，并在TRELLIS上取得优于基线的综合表现。
AI.motivation: 现有闭式概念擦除方法面向2D图像扩散模型，假设存在单一生成通路，因此一次编辑需同时覆盖几何与纹理。原生3D生成器直接合成结构化3D表示，而非对2D样本进行提升，违背了该假设，导致既有方法难以适用。
AI.method: 作者将原生文本到3D的概念擦除形式化为阶段感知编辑问题：形状与物体概念须在流水线的结构阶段擦除，材质概念须在外观阶段擦除。STAGE为免训练闭式框架，将每次编辑限制在由擦除嵌入与锚点嵌入之差张成的低维子空间内，并把先前编辑器的保范（正交）约束松弛为最小二乘仿射校正，将目标激活映射到安全锚点，同时对保留提示的位移施加惩罚；校正可作用于结构阶段、外观阶段或二者。
AI.result: 在标准开源原生3D生成器TRELLIS上，针对15个形状、材质和物体概念，STAGE在兼顾遗忘目标概念与保留其他内容的综合得分上达到66.7（聚合基于CLIP的语义与物理指标），而最强的适配基线为53.2。
AI.conclusion: 编辑所需触及的阶段由概念类型决定；阶段感知的闭式仿射校正能有效实现原生3D生成器的概念擦除，并在遗忘与保留之间取得更优平衡。

title: ARROW: Arbitrary Reconstruction and Tracking of 4D Observations in the Wild
summary: Dynamic scenes may be captured by a moving camera, multiple video streams, or images taken at different times. These observations reveal complementary aspects of scene geometry and motion, yet bringing them together requires establishing correspondence across viewpoints, capture times, and visibility changes. We introduce ARROW, a feed-forward model that unifies 3D reconstruction and 3D point tracking from arbitrary image sets. At its core is a novel order-invariant querying approach, which allows the association of queries with observations across arbitrary inputs. We show that exposing the model to more diverse sets of inputs during training results in improved task performance. Moreover, the resulting model is capable of generalization to a wider range of tasks including multi-view tracking. Trained with this strategy, ARROW establishes a new state of the art in 3D tracking on WorldTrack and TAPVid-3D and outperforms dedicated multi-view trackers on an adapted RGB-only MVTracker benchmark, while remaining competitive across 3D reconstruction tasks. Code and weights are publicly available.

AI.tldr: ARROW 是一个前馈模型，通过顺序无关的查询机制统一任意图像集合的 3D 重建与 3D 点跟踪，并在多项跟踪基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 动态场景可由移动相机、多路视频流或不同时间拍摄的图像捕捉，这些观测揭示互补的几何与运动信息；但整合它们需在视角、拍摄时间和可见性变化之间建立对应关系，现有方法难以统一处理。
AI.method: 提出 ARROW 前馈模型，核心是顺序无关（order-invariant）查询方法，使查询能与任意输入中的观测建立关联；训练时向模型暴露更多样化的输入集合以提升任务表现。
AI.result: 在 WorldTrack 与 TAPVid-3D 上取得新 SOTA 的 3D 跟踪性能；在改造的 RGB-only MVTracker 基准上超越专用多视图跟踪器；在 3D 重建任务上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 多样输入训练策略使模型可泛化至包括多视图跟踪在内的更广任务，统一了 3D 重建与 3D 点跟踪，代码与权重已公开。

title: CLASP: Continual Low-rank Adapters for Spatially Placed Concepts from One Hypernetwork
comment: 31 pages. Code: https://github.com/genwro-ai/clasp, project page: https://genwro-ai.github.io/clasp
summary: Continual personalization of text-to-image diffusion models requires sequentially acquiring new concepts while retaining previously learned ones. However, existing methods either suffer from catastrophic forgetting or rely on storing additional concept-specific parameters and spatial components, causing their parameter footprint to grow with the concept stream. This limits their ability to scale to long sequences of personalization tasks. We propose a rehearsal-free approach that uses a single fixed-size hypernetwork to continually personalize a frozen diffusion model. Instead of expanding the model as new concepts are acquired, the hypernetwork dynamically produces the concept-specific adaptations required for personalization while preserving previously learned concepts. Our framework further integrates spatial control into the personalization process, allowing users to specify where a personalized concept should appear without introducing additional per-concept components. This formulation enables continual personalization with a parameter footprint that remains independent of the number of learned concepts, aside from compact concept representations. Experiments demonstrate strong retention of previously learned concepts and reliable spatial grounding, matching or improving upon existing methods while scaling effectively to long streams of personalization tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免回放的持续个性化方法，用单一固定规模超网络为冻结扩散模型动态生成概念适配，无需随概念增长扩充参数，并将空间控制融入个性化，实现参数足迹不随概念数增长。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型的持续个性化需在顺序学习新概念时保留旧概念。现有方法或存在灾难性遗忘，或依赖存储额外的概念专属参数与空间组件，导致参数足迹随概念流增长，难以扩展到长序列个性化任务。
AI.method: 免回放框架；使用单个固定规模超网络对冻结扩散模型进行持续个性化；超网络动态生成各概念所需的个性化适配，而非扩充模型参数；将空间控制整合进个性化过程，用户可指定个性化概念出现位置，且不引入额外逐概念组件；参数足迹与已学概念数量无关，仅保留紧凑的概念表示。
AI.result: 实验表明对已学概念具有较强保留能力，空间定位可靠；在匹配或优于现有方法的同时，能有效扩展到长序列个性化任务。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过固定规模超网络动态生成概念适配并融合空间控制，实现免回放、参数足迹不随概念数增长的持续个性化，兼顾旧概念保留、空间可控性与长序列可扩展性。

title: MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Open multimodal reasoning models have benefited from large-scale reasoning supervision, yet reliable post-training remains challenging due to uneven data quality, inefficient supervision construction, imbalanced difficulty, and cross-domain interference. We introduce MMVistaReason (MVR), an open-data post-training recipe with three components: (1) broader capability coverage across complementary Analytical and Real-World reasoning groups, emphasizing structured reasoning versus visual perception and spatial grounding; (2) efficient SFT and RL data construction, standardizing heterogeneous open data through staged cleaning and annotation, combining difficulty-aware cascaded teacher distillation with answer-likelihood-based trajectory selection to construct MVR-SFT-528K, and applying scale-specific frontier filtering for MVR-RL-63K; and (3) specialize-then-integrate training, which trains complementary RL experts and consolidates their capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Our analyses reveal a capacity-dependent interaction between supervision difficulty, trajectory quality, and model capacity: smaller students benefit more from selected supervision, while larger students are robust to trajectory variation and mixed-domain interference. Mixed-domain RL introduces benchmark-level negative transfer, whereas MOPD provides consistent capability integration, with the preferred KL direction varying across model scales. Across 15 multimodal benchmarks, MVR-4B achieves an average score of 72.8, outperforming Qwen3.5-9B (Instruct) and MMFineReason-8B while using about 70% fewer samples than MMFineReason. Scaling to 9B improves the average to 74.4, surpassing Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Instruct). Overall, MMVistaReason demonstrates that systematic open-data construction and capacity-aware post-training provide a practical and scalable path toward reliable multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MMVistaReason（MVR），一套开放数据后训练配方，包含能力覆盖更广的数据分组、高效的 SFT/RL 数据构建流程（MVR-SFT-528K、MVR-RL-63K）以及“先专精后整合”的多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）训练策略，在 15 个多模态基准上以 4B/9B 规模超越多个更大规模模型。
AI.motivation: 开放多模态推理模型虽受益于大规模推理监督，但后训练仍面临数据质量参差、监督构建低效、难度分布失衡以及跨域干扰等挑战，亟需系统化的数据构建与容量感知的后训练方案。
AI.method: MVR 包含三部分：(1) 覆盖 Analytical 与 Real-World 两类互补推理能力的数据分组，强调结构化推理与视觉感知、空间定位；(2) 高效数据构建——通过分阶段清洗与标注标准化异构开放数据，结合难度感知级联教师蒸馏与基于答案似然的轨迹筛选构建 MVR-SFT-528K，并以规模特定前沿过滤构建 MVR-RL-63K；(3) specialize-then-integrate 训练——分别训练互补的 RL 专家，再用多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）整合能力。
AI.result: 分析揭示了监督难度、轨迹质量与模型容量之间依赖容量的交互关系：小模型更受益于精选监督，大模型对轨迹变化与混合域干扰更鲁棒。混合域 RL 会引起基准级负迁移，而 MOPD 实现一致的能力整合，且最优 KL 方向随模型规模变化。在 15 个多模态基准上，MVR-4B 平均分 72.8，超越 Qwen3.5-9B (Instruct) 与 MMFineReason-8B，且样本量比 MMFineReason 少约 70%；扩展至 9B 平均分达 74.4，超过 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Instruct)。
AI.conclusion: MMVistaReason 表明，系统化的开放数据构建与容量感知的后训练是通往可靠多模态推理的一条实用且可扩展的路径。

title: Smoother Flow Matching via Contrastive Trajectory Repulsion
summary: Trajectory crossing remains a critical bottleneck in Flow Matching (FM), and previous works typically view these crossings from a theoretical optimization perspective causing velocity averaging. They attempt to address it indirectly by post-hoc distillation or endpoint coupling, without explicitly regulating the intermediate trajectories. In this paper, we introduce a new network learning perspective: crossing points inherently induce large local Lipschitz constants in the target velocity field, leading to two drawbacks. First, high Lipschitz constants correspond to high-frequency signals in the velocity field that neural networks struggle to fit due to spectral bias. Second, they also imply drastic velocity variations, leading to severe numerical integration errors in few-step inference. To alleviate this, we propose CoFlow, a framework that introduces the contrastive learning paradigm into FM to explicitly repel trajectories during training, thereby lowering the local Lipschitz constants of the velocity field. Specifically, we formulate CoFlow from a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) perspective by injecting a repulsive drift term. This drift actively guides the forward process of positive samples away from negative trajectories, effectively reducing the local Lipschitz constant. Furthermore, we derive an equivalent stochastic interpolant formulation from this SDE, providing a simple and tractable design space to control the influence of negative samples. Extensive experiments on ImageNet 256x256 demonstrate that CoFlow significantly reduces FID compared to standard FM in few-step inference (e.g., 20 steps), with no added training overhead. The code can be accessed at: https://github.com/HKUST-LongGroup/CoFlow

AI.tldr: CoFlow：从SDE视角引入对比学习排斥漂移项，降低速度场局部Lipschitz常数，缓解轨迹交叉，提升少步采样质量。
AI.motivation: Flow Matching中轨迹交叉是瓶颈，已有工作多从理论优化角度解释为速度平均化，并通过后验蒸馏或端点耦合间接处理，未显式调控中间轨迹。本文提出新视角：交叉点会在目标速度场中诱导较大的局部Lipschitz常数。
AI.method: 指出高Lipschitz常数带来两个问题：一是速度场中的高频信号因神经网络的谱偏差难以拟合；二是速度剧烈变化导致少步推理中数值积分误差严重。为此提出CoFlow，将对比学习范式引入FM，在训练中显式排斥轨迹以降低速度场局部Lipschitz常数。具体从SDE视角构建，注入排斥漂移项，引导正样本前向过程远离负样本轨迹；并推导出等价的随机插值（stochastic interpolant）形式，提供简单可处理的设计空间来调控负样本影响。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256上的大量实验表明，与标准FM相比，CoFlow在少步推理（如20步）下显著降低FID，且不增加训练开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过对比学习显式排斥轨迹以降低速度场局部Lipschitz常数，是缓解FM轨迹交叉、提升少步生成质量的有效途径，且实现简洁、无额外训练成本。

title: Localisation-Aware Uncertainty for Pretrained Object Detection
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying object detectors when distribution/covariate shift and adversarial attacks may occur. Existing approaches often require detector retraining, architectural modification, or repeated inference, which may be infeasible or incur significant overheads. We introduce a lightweight post-hoc evidential meta-model that learns when object localisations should be considered uncertain while keeping the base detector frozen. Our approach automatically identifies localisation-relevant features and uses saliency-guided modification to construct an increasingly challenging curriculum. Detection-level targets combine localisation error, modification level, and prediction instability to guide an evidential meta-model to estimate uncertainty for each predicted bounding box. Our approach requires no changes to the detector and preserves its original localisation outputs. Across adversarial attacks and evaluated strengths, GRACE improves TP-FP AUROC by 22% relative to the strongest comparator in some cases while maintaining in-distribution detection performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRACE，一种轻量级事后证据元模型，在不改动基础检测器的前提下估计每个预测框的定位不确定性，通过显著性引导的课程构建与多源检测级目标训练，在对抗攻击下显著提升不确定性估计性能。
AI.motivation: 目标检测器在分布/协变量偏移与对抗攻击下的可靠部署需要准确的不确定性估计。现有方法通常需要重新训练检测器、修改网络结构或进行多次推理，这些做法要么不可行，要么带来显著计算开销。
AI.method: 提出事后（post-hoc）轻量级证据元模型，保持基础检测器冻结；自动识别与定位相关的特征，并利用显著性引导的修改构建难度递增的课程；检测级训练目标融合定位误差、修改程度与预测不稳定性，引导证据元模型为每个预测边界框输出不确定性；不改变检测器结构且保留其原始定位输出。
AI.result: 在多种对抗攻击及不同攻击强度下，GRACE在某些情形下将TP-FP AUROC相比最强对比方法提升22%，同时保持在分布内（in-distribution）检测性能。
AI.conclusion: GRACE提供了一种无需检测器重训练、无架构改动、单次推理的即插即用不确定性估计方案，在对抗扰动下显著改善定位不确定性的区分能力，且不牺牲原始检测性能。

title: MWOP: Modality-aware Width-wise Operation Pruning for Efficient MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial inference costs when processing long visual-textual sequences. While existing operation compression methods exploit modality-level redundancy, they largely treat computation within attention heads and shared feed-forward network (FFN) channels as unified units, leaving finer-grained redundancy underexplored. We find that redundancy varies both across modality-interaction paths within the same attention head and across visual and textual executions of the same FFN channel. Based on these findings, we propose Modality-aware Width-wise Operation Pruning (MWOP), which independently prunes visual-to-visual (V2V), text-to-visual (T2V), and text-to-text (T2T) attention paths within each layer, and separately selects FFN channels for visual and textual inputs. A first-order Taylor criterion guides the pruning process, with FFN importance re-evaluated after attention pruning and LoRA-based recovery training. To translate the resulting fine-grained sparsity into practical acceleration, we further develop path-sparse Triton attention kernels and compact visual-side FFN execution. MWOP preserves the token sequence while reducing attention and FFN computation, making it complementary to token compression and enabling simultaneous reduction of sequence length and per-token computation. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, MWOP alone achieves a $1.6\times$ prefill speedup with 99.7\% average performance retention across 12 benchmarks. Combined with two representative token compression methods, it further increases their prefill speedups from $2.0\times$ and $1.9\times$ to $2.9\times$ and $2.7\times$, respectively. Results on Qwen2.5-VL-7B further demonstrate its applicability across architectures. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/MWOP.

AI.tldr: 提出MWOP，通过细粒度的模态感知宽度剪枝降低MLLM长序列推理成本。
AI.motivation: MLLM处理长视觉-文本序列时推理成本高；现有操作压缩方法将注意力头和共享FFN通道视为统一单元，仅利用模态级冗余，忽略了更细粒度的冗余。
AI.method: 发现冗余在注意力头的模态交互路径间及FFN通道的视觉/文本执行间均存在差异。据此提出MWOP：逐层独立剪枝V2V、T2V、T2T注意力路径，并分别选择视觉与文本输入的FFN通道。采用一阶泰勒判据指导剪枝，FFN重要性在注意力剪枝后重估，辅以LoRA恢复训练；并开发路径稀疏Triton注意力核与紧凑视觉侧FFN执行以实现加速。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-OneVision-7B上，MWOP单独实现1.6倍预填充加速，12个基准平均性能保留99.7%；与两种令牌压缩方法结合，将其预填充加速从2.0倍和1.9倍提升至2.9倍和2.7倍。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上验证了跨架构适用性。
AI.conclusion: MWOP在保留令牌序列的同时减少注意力与FFN计算，与令牌压缩互补，可同时降低序列长度与每令牌计算量。

title: The Impact of Processing Parameters on High-Accuracy Measurements in UAV Photogrammetry
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry is increasingly used in applications requiring high accuracy, such as determining ground surface changes caused by landslides, mining, or microrelief transformation. While acquisition strategies have been widely studied, the influence of the processing workflow-particularly Bundle Block Adjustment parameter settings-remains insufficiently explored. This study addresses this gap through a systematic, full-factorial evaluation of 768 processing variants applied to ten UAV datasets collected over 1.5 years in a 220 ha study area. Eight key parameters were analysed. The results show substantial variability in final 3D accuracy: the best performing variant achieved a root mean square error (RMSE) of 16 mm, whereas the weakest reached 303 mm. The most influential factors were the number of ground control points, the application of additional camera calibration corrections, and the use of the Post-Processing Kinematic GNSS method for determining camera projection center coordinates. The study also evaluates how workflow optimization affects the accuracy of displacement, tilt changes, and horizontal strain determination. While random displacement errors remained stable (RMSE of ~6-7 mm), systematic errors were significantly reduced by over half in all axes, with vertical median absolute error decreasing from 14 mm to 7 mm in the optimized configuration compared to the baseline previously used by the authors. This study provides the first large-scale, practice-oriented assessment of how processing parameter selection shapes the accuracy of both photogrammetric products and deformation indices determination. The results offer actionable guidance for developing more robust and repeatable UAV photogrammetry workflows tailored to high-precision monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对10个无人机数据集、8个关键参数的768种处理组合进行全因子实验，系统评估了光束法平差参数设置对无人机摄影测量三维精度及形变指标的影响。
AI.motivation: 无人机摄影测量已广泛用于滑坡、采矿、微地貌变化等高精度监测，但影像获取策略研究较多，而处理流程（尤其光束法平差参数设置）对精度的影响尚缺乏系统认识。
AI.method: 在220公顷研究区采集跨1.5年的10个无人机数据集，对8个关键参数进行系统性全因子评估，共形成768种处理变体，并进一步分析工作流优化对位移、倾斜变化与水平应变精度的影响。
AI.result: 最终三维精度差异显著，最优变体RMSE为16 mm，最差为303 mm；影响最大的因素为地面控制点数量、附加相机检校改正以及采用PPK GNSS确定摄站投影中心坐标。随机位移误差稳定在约6-7 mm，系统误差在各轴均降低逾一半，垂直方向中位绝对误差由14 mm降至7 mm。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次开展大规模、面向实践的处理参数选择评估，揭示了参数配置对摄影测量产品与形变指标精度的作用，可为构建稳健、可重复的高精度无人机摄影测量工作流提供可操作指导。

title: Uncertainty-Guided Handshake: Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Refinement for Surgical-Grade Glioma Segmentation
summary: While state-of-the-art automated models for medical image segmentation achieve high mean performance, they frequently suffer from localized, catastrophic failures that preclude safe clinical deployment, particularly in neuro-oncology. Interactive segmentation frameworks mitigate this by incorporating human oversight, but traditionally impose prohibitive cognitive and temporal workloads by requiring clinicians to manually search for errors. In this project, we present an efficient, Hybrid Structural-Aleatoric Human-in-the-Loop framework for glioma segmentation that bridges the gap between automated baseline performance and surgical-grade precision, achieving sub-2.0 mm HD95 on curated benchmarks while providing safety-net routing for structural failures across real-world clinical data. By extracting voxel-wise Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) uncertainty and applying hierarchical topological filtering, our method proactively isolates high-risk structural anomalies. We comprehensively evaluated our approach on a challenging out-of-distribution clinical stress-test cohort (N = 362). Operating under a simulated Human Oracle, the framework improved the Whole Tumor (WT) Dice score from 0.891 to 0.914 and reduced the 95th percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95) from 5.82 mm to 4.76 mm. Critically for surgical safety, the system rescued severe boundary failures in the Tumor Core, reducing mean HD95 from 17.96 mm to 14.83 mm (improving absolute TC Dice to 0.356). These spatial rescues were achieved while demanding a median interactive workload of just 11.3% of the target volume. Acknowledging this as a simulated upper bound lacking real-world cognitive friction, the framework nevertheless demonstrates a highly Pareto-efficient pathway for safely deploying clinical AI.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合结构与偶然不确定性的混合人在回路（Human-in-the-Loop）胶质瘤分割框架：利用体素级TTA不确定性与层次拓扑滤波，主动定位高风险结构异常并进行安全网路由，在N=362的分布外临床压力测试队列中，以约11.3%目标体积的中位交互工作量，将整体肿瘤Dice从0.891提升至0.914、HD95由5.82 mm降至4.76 mm，并显著挽救肿瘤核心的边界失效，实现帕累托高效的临床AI安全部署路径。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割模型虽平均性能高，但在神经肿瘤等领域存在局部灾难性失效，无法安全用于临床。交互式分割虽可引入人工监督，却因需临床医生手动查找错误而带来过高的认知与时间负担。因此需在保证安全性的同时将人工工作量降至可接受水平。
AI.method: 提取体素级测试时增强（TTA）不确定性，并施加层次拓扑滤波，以主动隔离高风险结构异常；在此基础上构建混合"结构—偶然（Aleatoric）"不确定性的模拟Oracle人在回路框架，将高风险区域路由给人工审查与修正。
AI.result: 在N=362的分布外临床压力测试队列上，模拟Human Oracle下整体肿瘤（WT）Dice由0.891升至0.914，HD95由5.82 mm降至4.76 mm；肿瘤核心（TC）平均HD95由17.96 mm降至14.83 mm，TC Dice绝对提升至0.356；交互工作量中位数仅占目标体积的11.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在模拟条件下实现了高帕累托效率的安全临床AI部署路径，可弥合自动化基线与外科级精度之间的差距；但结果被视为模拟上界，未包含真实世界的认知摩擦，实际临床收益仍需进一步验证。

title: FiVOS: A Fish Segmentation Algorithm Based on Interactive Video Object Segmentation and Filter Enhancement
summary: With the continuous expansion of aquaculture, precise and efficient monitoring of fish behavior has become increasingly critical for improving farming efficiency and reducing economic losses. In particular, with the ongoing enhancement of computational capabilities in deep learning models, vision-based fish segmentation methods are garnering growing attention. By analyzing video segmentation results, fish behavior can be effectively tracked, thereby providing reliable data support for the precise regulation of aquaculture environments. However, existing deep learning-based video segmentation methods for aquaculture scenarios often overlook the dynamic correlations between video frames. In contrast, Interactive Video Object Segmentation (IVOS) employs an interaction-propagation scheme to achieve high-precision segmentation while minimizing user effort, thereby enhancing monitoring efficiency. Yet, IVOS applications in aquaculture remain limited due to data scarcity, and are susceptible to error accumulation and mask loss over long sequence propagation due to high intra-class similarity. In response, this paper proposes an improved interactive video object segmentation method (FiVOS) and constructs two fish-specific datasets. FiVOS utilizes a mask block filter to enable early detection and correction of erroneous propagated mask blocks, enhancing filtering accuracy through a rule-based thresholding approach. Additionally, it serializes noise filters to further eliminate erroneous mask noise, thereby improving model robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that FiVOS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in fish video segmentation tasks, providing robust technical support for fish behavior research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出改进的交互式视频目标分割方法FiVOS，并构建两个鱼类专用数据集，实现鱼类视频分割的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 水产养殖规模扩大对鱼类行为精准高效监测需求迫切。基于视觉的分割方法受到关注，但现有深度学习视频分割方法忽视视频帧间的动态关联。交互式视频目标分割（IVOS）能以较少用户交互实现高精度分割，但在水产场景中受数据稀缺限制，且因类内高相似性易出现长序列传播中的误差累积与掩码丢失问题。
AI.method: 提出改进的交互式视频目标分割方法FiVOS：利用掩码块过滤器（mask block filter）实现错误传播掩码块的早期检测与纠正，并通过基于规则的阈值方法提升过滤精度；同时将噪声过滤器串行化，进一步消除错误掩码噪声，增强模型鲁棒性。此外构建了两个鱼类专用数据集。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FiVOS在鱼类视频分割任务中达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: FiVOS为鱼类行为研究提供了稳健的技术支持，推动了交互式视频目标分割在水产养殖监测中的应用。

title: SALD: Self-Referenced Advantage Learning for Diffusion Models
summary: Recent work on language-model adaptation has shown that single models can obtain informative training signals by evaluating their behavior in demonstrationor feedback-augmented contexts, with the help of a teacher network, which is driven by the student's learned parameters. Inspired by this internal-reference principle, we investigate how diffusion models can identify self-referenced training signals without external demonstrations or teacher networks. We introduce SALD, a self-referenced training framework that evaluates each image-caption pair at two noise levels using the same model. The easier, lower-noise path is evaluated without gradient tracking to provide a reference, while the harder, higher-noise path provides the training gradient. Rather than directly distilling the easy-path prediction, SALD uses the difference between two path errors to adapt the hardpath objective. The proposed Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) converts this relative error into a differentiable sample-level weight. Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) accumulates relative difficulty across training and adapts the future gap between the two noise levels. Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) further compares the residual power spectra of the two paths and constructs a differentiable, frequency-derived latent-element weight. All components share a single set of model parameters, requiring neither an external teacher network nor additional trainable parameters during training or inference, and no modification to the inference procedure. Experiments across multiple architectures and datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in generation quality, while component-wise ablations quantify the contributions of the proposed components.

AI.tldr: 提出SALD自参考训练框架，让扩散模型在无外部演示或教师网络条件下，通过同一模型在两个噪声水平上的误差差生成训练信号，并用AGD、TAM、SAD三个组件将相对误差转化为可微权重。
AI.motivation: 已有语言模型适配工作表明，模型可通过在演示或反馈增强的上下文中评估自身行为来获得训练信号，但这类方法依赖教师网络，并由学生参数驱动。本文受此内部参考原则启发，探究扩散模型能否在无外部演示、无教师网络的条件下自行识别自参考训练信号。
AI.method: SALD在同一模型下对每个图文对在两个噪声水平上评估：低噪声的较易路径不跟踪梯度以提供参考，高噪声的较难路径提供训练梯度。方法不直接蒸馏易路径预测，而是利用两条路径误差之差来调整难路径目标。具体包含三个组件：Advantage-Guided Diffusion（AGD）将相对误差转换为可微的样本级权重；Temporal Advantage Memory（TAM）累积训练过程中的相对难度并自适应调整未来两个噪声水平之间的间隔；Spectral Advantage Decomposition（SAD）比较两条路径的残差功率谱，构建可微的、由频率导出的潜元素权重。所有组件共享同一套模型参数，无需外部教师网络或额外可训练参数。
AI.result: 在多种架构和数据集上的实验显示生成质量得到一致性提升，组件级消融实验量化了各提出组件的贡献。训练与推理阶段均不需要额外可训练参数，也不修改推理流程。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明扩散模型可借鉴语言模型中的内部参考原则，实现无需外部演示或教师网络的自参考训练，通过相对误差而非直接蒸馏来指导优化，并保持推理流程不变。

title: VTR-Bench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Video Generation
summary: Recent video generation models can produce highly realistic videos from natural language instructions, with visual quality approaching cinematic standards. Existing evaluation benchmarks, however, predominantly assess visual quality, aesthetic appeal and physical plausibility, while paying limited attention to text, an essential medium for conveying information in everyday scenes. A generated video may appear visually compelling and feature lifelike subjects, yet still render the text within the scene incorrectly. To address this overlooked dimension, we introduce \textbf{VTR-Bench}, a systematic benchmark for evaluating the \textbf{V}isual \textbf{T}ext \textbf{R}endering capabilities of video generation models. VTR-Bench situates text within concrete application scenarios, such as advertisements and scientific videos, with 300 carefully constructed prompts spanning five scenario categories. We develop an automated evaluation pipeline with human alignments that separately assesses text fidelity through carrier-specific transcription and scene and motion requirements through a prompt-specific chain of query. Beyond evaluation, we introduce a \textbf{Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework} in which a Director agent coordinates image and video generation with visual evaluation, guiding iterative refinement and candidate selection through visual feedback. Experiments on 11 state-of-the-art models reveal widespread difficulties in accurately rendering scene text, with the best-performing model recording an overall word error rate (WER) of 0.250. We further analyze text rendering failures to characterize the challenges faced by current video generation models. These findings highlight visual text rendering as a key challenge for video generation and demonstrate a practical path toward improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/hardenyu21/VTR-Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出VTR-Bench基准，系统评测视频生成模型的场景文字渲染能力，并给出关键帧引导的智能体改进框架。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成评测主要关注视觉质量、美学与物理合理性，忽视文字这一日常场景中的关键信息载体；视频可能视觉出色却把场景内文字渲染错误。
AI.method: 构建VTR-Bench：将文字置于广告、科学视频等具体场景，含5类场景共300条精心设计的提示词；设计自动化评测流水线并与人工对齐，通过载体特定转录评估文字保真度，通过提示词特定的查询链评估场景与运动要求；此外提出关键帧引导的智能体框架，由Director智能体协调图像/视频生成与视觉评估，借助视觉反馈迭代优化与候选筛选。
AI.result: 在11个先进模型上实验，普遍存在场景文字渲染困难；最佳模型整体词错误率（WER）为0.250；进一步分析文字渲染失败以刻画当前模型的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 视觉文字渲染是视频生成的关键挑战，本文基准与智能体框架为改进提供了可行路径；代码已开源。

title: VoxelSynth3D: Interpretable Volumetric Image-Domain Metal Artifact Reduction with a Paired Synthetic CLINIC-Metal Benchmark
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication at BHI 2026
summary: Metal artifacts in postoperative musculoskeletal CT obscure bone-implant and adjacent soft-tissue interfaces. Many metal artifact reduction (MAR) methods require unavailable raw projections or learned models that may shift across scanners and implants. We present VoxelSynth3D, a training-free 3D image-domain framework for reconstructed CT. The framework combines support masking, normalized tissue synthesis, deviation gating, and restricted edge refinement. Detected implant voxels are preserved in the output, while correction targets metal-induced artifacts in the surrounding tissue. We also construct Synthetic CLINIC-Metal, a controlled paired synthetic evaluation resource, from no-metal CTPelvic1K volumes with clean targets, metal/artifact masks, fixed seeds, and patient-level splits; 75 unpaired real metal cases receive qualitative/no-reference evaluation only. The operating point was fixed in a near-flat validation basin. With exact-mask oracle localization, all methods share a metal-excluded tissue ROI. On 40 held-out cases, VoxelSynth3D reduced RMSE from 801.48 to 786.18 HU (paired gain 15.30 HU, 95% CI 11.68-19.23), improving every case and exceeding the evaluated 3D Gaussian smoother by 13.58 HU. Clean-edge agreement decreased next to metal but exceeded input beyond 5 mm.
