Thus, VoxelSynth3D provides case-consistent within-distribution tissue-error reduction with a localized structural tradeoff. Spacing-aware sensitivity retained aggregate broad-region improvement and identified near-metal calibration as a target.

AI.tldr: VoxelSynth3D：一种无需训练的3D图像域金属伪影减少框架，在合成配对数据上实现一致的组织误差降低。
AI.motivation: 术后肌骨CT中的金属伪影干扰骨-植入物及邻近软组织界面的观察。现有金属伪影减少方法多依赖难以获取的原始投影或可能随扫描仪与植入物变化的已训练模型，限制了临床适用性。
AI.method: 提出无需训练的3D图像域框架VoxelSynth3D，作用于已重建CT，结合支持掩码、归一化组织合成、偏差门控与受限边缘精修；保留检测到的植入物体素，仅校正周围组织的金属诱导伪影。同时构建Synthetic CLINIC-Metal配对合成评估资源（基于无金属CTPelvic1K体数据，含干净目标、金属/伪影掩码、固定随机种子与患者级划分）；75例非配对真实金属病例仅做定性/无参考评估。工作点固定于近平坦验证盆地。
AI.result: 在精确掩码oracle定位下，所有方法共享金属排除的组织ROI。40例留出病例中，VoxelSynth3D将RMSE从801.48降至786.18 HU（配对增益15.30 HU，95% CI 11.68–19.23），逐例改善，并较所评估的3D高斯平滑器优13.58 HU。金属邻近处干净边缘一致性下降，但超过5 mm处优于输入。
AI.conclusion: VoxelSynth3D在分布内实现病例一致的组织误差降低，但伴随局部结构权衡；间隔感知敏感性分析保留了整体宽区域改善，并将近金属标定确定为改进目标。

title: SuperMotion: Source-Preserving Denoising for Text-Driven Human Motion Editing
summary: Text-driven human motion editing aims to realize a requested change while preserving compatible source content. Existing diffusion editors rely largely on learned conditioning for preservation of the unedited part, yet their outputs can lose temporal detail as denoising proceeds. We propose the \textbf{Source-Preserving Denoising framework (SuperMotion)}, which explicitly reuses the source at each reverse step for source preservation. We first align the source motion to the output timeline and predict a preservation gate that controls reuse across frames and feature dimensions. A clean-space source anchor then utilizes the learned preservation gate to blend the predicted clean motion with the aligned source and passes the corrected estimate directly to the sampling posterior. Because the aligned source is a realized motion rather than a regression output, the anchor injects sample-level temporal detail that a reconstruction-trained denoiser tends to smooth away. To learn effective source reuse, we supervise the anchored estimate against the editing target and match its second temporal differences through a temporal high-frequency loss. These objectives require no explicit edit masks. Extensive experiments show that SuperMotion improves editing accuracy, reaching 33.20\% full-pool R@1 on MotionFix, while reducing temporal-detail attenuation and preserving motion dynamics as it realizes the requested changes. Ablations confirm that the learned preservation gate is responsible for the gain and that it reuses the source to retain the unedited content properly.

AI.tldr: 提出SuperMotion框架，在扩散反步采样中显式复用源动作，通过可学习保留门与干净空间源锚点注入样本级时间细节，实现文本驱动动作编辑并缓解时间细节衰减。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动动作编辑的扩散编辑器主要依赖学习到的条件化来保留未编辑部分，但随着去噪推进，输出容易丢失时间细节（temporal detail），难以在实现编辑需求的同时完整保留兼容的源内容。
AI.method: 提出Source-Preserving Denoising框架SuperMotion：1) 将源动作对齐到输出时间线，并预测一个保留门（preservation gate），在帧与特征维度上控制复用；2) 干净空间源锚点（clean-space source anchor）利用该门将预测的干净动作与对齐源融合，并把校正后的估计直接送入采样后验；3) 由于对齐源是真实动作而非回归输出，锚点引入样本级时间细节，避免重建训练的降噪器平滑掉细节；4) 用编辑目标监督锚定估计，并通过时间高频损失匹配其二阶时间差分；无需显式编辑掩码。
AI.result: 在MotionFix上达到33.20% full-pool R@1，提升编辑准确率，同时减少时间细节衰减并保持动作动力学；消融实验证实增益来自可学习的保留门，其通过复用源正确保留未编辑内容。
AI.conclusion: 显式在去噪各反步复用源动作、并以学习到的保留门进行帧/特征级融合，可有效兼顾编辑准确性与时间细节保持，且无需编辑掩码监督。

title: Synthetic training for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation in data-scarce settings
summary: Cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) and cortical superficial siderosis (cSS) are imaging markers of cerebral small vessel disease, but their automated segmentation is limited by the scarcity of positive cases and voxel-level annotations. We propose a synthetic training framework for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation that requires no real lesion annotations for training and leverages radiological description of the lesions. Starting from anatomical brain parcellations, the framework applies spatial augmentation and voxel resampling, procedurally inserts cSS and CMB labels using clinical priors on lesion location and morphology, and synthesises images through randomised intensity assignment, blurring, and Rician noise simulation. Models were trained on dynamically generated image-label pairs and evaluated against manual delineations in 10 cSS cases and 13 CMB cases. The proposed configurations outperformed classical filter baselines. For cSS, the hypointensity constrained model achieved higher AUPRC and AUROC than the Frangi filter (AUPRC: 0.284 vs 0.083; AUROC: 0.907 vs 0.731). For CMBs, explicit synthesis of blood vessels as lesion mimics improved performance over the classical baseline (AUPRC: 0.538 vs 0.004; AUROC: 0.999 vs 0.968). These results support our proposal as a feasible strategy for data-scarce haemorrhagic lesion segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需真实病灶标注的合成训练框架，利用影像学先验程序化生成cSS和CMB图像-标签对，在数据稀缺条件下超越传统滤波器基线。
AI.motivation: 脑微出血（CMB）与皮层表面铁沉积（cSS）是脑小血管病的影像标志物，但其自动分割受限于阳性样本稀少和体素级标注的匮乏，传统监督学习难以开展。
AI.method: 从解剖脑分区出发，施加空间增强与体素重采样；依据病灶位置与形态的临床先验，以程序化方式插入cSS和CMB标签；通过随机强度赋值、模糊与Rician噪声模拟合成图像。模型在动态生成的图像-标签对上训练，无需真实病灶标注。
AI.result: 在10例cSS与13例CMB病例上与人工勾画对比：cSS方面，低信号约束模型的AUPRC（0.284 vs 0.083）和AUROC（0.907 vs 0.731）均优于Frangi滤波器；CMB方面，显式合成血管作为混淆结构使AUPRC（0.538 vs 0.004）和AUROC（0.999 vs 0.968）优于经典基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持该方案作为数据稀缺情形下出血性病灶分割的一种可行策略。

title: Revisiting Cross-Reconstruction for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
summary: Existing image forgery detectors often suffer from generalization to unseen manipulation methods due to the limited ability to capture transferable forensic cues. Recent cross-reconstruction based methods attempt to improve generalization through semantic-artifact disentanglement, but typically align heterogeneous artifacts across generators and exclude artifact representations during reconstruction, which may overlook the inherent diversity and visual cues of manipulation artifacts. In this work, we revisit cross-reconstruction and introduce an artifact-oriented disentanglement framework for robust image forgery detection. We argue that \textbf{artifact diversity}, i.e., the intrinsic variations of manipulation artifacts introduced by different generation processes, contains complementary forensic cues rather than undesirable domain variations. Instead of enforcing explicit artifact alignment, our framework preserves diverse artifact characteristics through semantically aligned cross-generator reconstruction. Furthermore, we incorporate artifact representations into the reconstruction process and introduce a masked frequency-aware reconstruction strategy to emphasize manipulation-related residuals while reducing semantic interference. This design enables the model to learn transferable forensic representations from diverse artifacts. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate improvements under both cross-dataset and cross-generator evaluation settings. Further analysis and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of artifact diversity preservation and artifact-aware cross-reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出面向伪影的解耦框架，通过保留伪影多样性、语义对齐的跨生成器重建及掩码频率感知重建策略，提升图像伪造检测的跨数据集与跨生成器泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有图像伪造检测器因难以捕捉可迁移的取证线索，对未见篡改方法泛化能力不足。近期跨重建方法试图通过语义-伪影解耦提升泛化，但通常对不同生成器的异质伪影强行对齐，并在重建中排除伪影表示，忽视了篡改伪影的固有多样性与视觉线索。
AI.method: 重新审视跨重建范式，提出面向伪影的解耦框架。核心假设：伪影多样性（不同生成过程带来的内在差异）包含互补取证线索而非有害域变化。方法上：不以显式伪影对齐为目标，而通过语义对齐的跨生成器重建保留多样伪影特征；同时将伪影表示纳入重建过程，引入掩码频率感知重建策略，强化与篡改相关的残差并抑制语义干扰。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，跨数据集与跨生成器评估设置下均取得提升；进一步分析与消融实验验证了伪影多样性保留与伪影感知跨重建的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将伪影多样性视为互补取证线索而非域噪声，并让伪影参与重建，可使模型从多样伪影中学习到可迁移的取证表示，从而增强伪造检测的泛化能力。

title: PAGER: Partial-to-global Alignment via Geometric and Relational Distillation
summary: Pretrained 3D encoders are typically developed on globally reconstructed scenes expressed in a consistent world coordinate frame, whereas embodied systems must reason from partial, viewpoint-dependent observations in camera coordinates. We show that this shift from globally learned 3D feature spaces to realistic partial observations exposes a severe representation mismatch, which we find consistently across representative state-of-the-art encoders, including Sonata and Concerto. A frozen Sonata encoder with a global linear probe achieves 72.47 mIoU on full ScanNet scenes, but 2.57 mIoU on single-frame camera-coordinate inputs. Training-free gravity alignment recovers performance to 41.64 mIoU, showing that coordinate-frame mismatch is a dominant source of degradation but cannot be fully resolved through canonicalization alone. We introduce PAGER, a label-free adaptation method that aligns partial-view features with a frozen global 3D semantic space using only paired partial/global geometry. It learns lightweight adaptation modules while keeping the pretrained encoder and global segmentation probe frozen. Matched-point feature alignment anchors partial features to their global counterparts, while relational supervision preserves their similarity structure with respect to the global representation. Global geometry provides supervision only during training. Inference operates directly on the partial observation. Without partial-view labels, PAGER outperforms label-supervised PEFT on both Sonata and Concerto, and in zero-shot ScanNet$\rightarrow$ScanNet++ transfer surpasses fully fine-tuned Sonata ($53.93$ vs.\ $48.09$ mIoU), suggesting that preserving the frozen global representation can improve cross-dataset transfer.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示预训练3D编码器在全局重建场景与部分视角观测之间存在严重表示错配，并提出无需标签的适应方法PAGER，通过匹配点对齐与关系监督，在冻结全局表示的前提下显著提升部分视角3D语义分割性能与跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 预训练3D编码器通常基于一致世界坐标系下的全局重建场景开发，而具身系统必须从相机坐标系下部分、依赖视角的观测中进行推理。这一从全局学习3D特征空间到现实部分观测的转变，暴露出严重的表示错配，且该问题在Sonata、Concerto等先进编码器中普遍存在，成为性能退化的主要来源。
AI.method: 提出PAGER标签无关适应方法：仅利用成对的部分/全局几何，将部分视角特征对齐到冻结的全局3D语义空间。方法学习轻量适应模块，保持预训练编码器与全局分割探针冻结；通过匹配点特征对齐将部分特征锚定到其全局对应物，并用关系监督保持其相对于全局表示的相似性结构。全局几何仅在训练时提供监督，推理直接在部分观测上进行。
AI.result: 冻结Sonata编码器加全局线性探针在完整ScanNet场景上达72.47 mIoU，但单帧相机坐标输入仅2.57 mIoU；免训练重力对齐恢复至41.64 mIoU，说明坐标框架错配是主要退化来源，但仅靠规范化无法完全解决。在无部分视角标签下，PAGER优于标签监督的PEFT，在Sonata与Concerto上均如此；零样本ScanNet→ScanNet++迁移中超过全微调Sonata（53.93 vs. 48.09 mIoU）。
AI.conclusion: 坐标框架与表示错配是预训练3D编码器应用于部分视角具身感知的关键瓶颈。PAGER表明，在不使用部分视角标签的情况下，通过将部分特征对齐到冻结的全局3D语义空间，可有效提升性能；同时保留冻结的全局表示有助于改善跨数据集迁移能力。

title: Before It Fades: Reinforcing Temporal Representations at Inference Time in VideoLLMs
summary: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) receive frames in sequential order and interpret how visual content evolves along the temporal axis, yet temporal reasoning remains a persistent weakness across architectures. Reversing the frame order of a video, a transformation that should invert temporal answers, often leaves the final prediction unchanged. We investigate where this failure originates by defining the temporal divergence vector $τ_l$, the layer-wise representational difference induced by reversing temporal order. Tracking its magnitude across layers reveals a consistent temporal divergence profile where the divergence peaks at intermediate layers and progressively diminishes toward the output. We confirm this peak is specific to temporal reasoning and functionally critical for predictions, establishing that VideoLLMs acquire temporal information at intermediate layers but fail to maintain it to the output. This progressive fading motivates our method, Temporal Activation Injection (TAI), which extracts $τ_l$ at the peak of the profile for each input and reinjects it into subsequent layers following the measured decay. TAI requires no training and consistently improves temporal reasoning across three VideoLLMs and four benchmarks with negligible impact on non-temporal tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/Youngwoo-git/Before-It-Fades.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究VideoLLM时序推理失败的原因，提出时序发散向量τ_l并发现其在中间层达到峰值后逐渐衰减，据此提出无需训练的Temporal Activation Injection（TAI）方法，在三个VideoLLM和四个基准上持续提升时序推理能力。
AI.motivation: VideoLLM按顺序接收帧并应理解视觉内容的时间演化，但时序推理始终是跨架构的薄弱环节：将视频帧序反转（本应反转时序答案）往往不改变最终预测。作者希望定位这一失败的来源，探究模型究竟在何处获取时序信息、又为何丢失。
AI.method: 定义时序发散向量τ_l，即由时间顺序反转引起的逐层表征差异，并追踪其随层数的幅度变化；验证该峰值是否时序推理特有且对预测功能关键。基于发现的衰减特性，提出Temporal Activation Injection（TAI）：对每个输入在发散轮廓峰值处提取τ_l，并按测得的衰减规律将其重新注入后续层，无需训练。
AI.result: 追踪τ_l幅度揭示了稳定的时序发散轮廓：发散在中间层达到峰值，并向输出层逐步减弱；该峰值被证实为时序推理所特有且对预测功能关键，说明VideoLLM在中间层获得时序信息但未能保持到输出。TAI在三个VideoLLM和四个基准上持续提升时序推理，且对非时序任务影响可忽略。
AI.conclusion: VideoLLM的时序信息在中间层被获取却在向输出传播过程中逐渐衰减，是时序推理失败的关键机制。通过在峰值处提取并按衰减规律重注入时序发散向量，TAI以无需训练的方式有效缓解这一问题，代码已开源。

title: Hob-VL: A Benchmark for Visually Grounded Boolean Reasoning
summary: Reliable visual reasoning requires composing multiple visual observations and returning consistent answers to logically equivalent questions. We introduce Hob-VL, a benchmark for visually grounded Boolean reasoning. Hob-VL comprises two tasks: (1) evaluating whether a Boolean rule holds in an image, and (2) identifying the (unique) object satisfying a Boolean description. Hob-VL contains 6,000 human-verified balanced Yes/No questions, each defined by a Boolean combination of ten visual statements, across 1,000 generated scenes and 46 diverse labeled photographs, along with 1,000 object-identification questions over the same photographs. Our question families are deliberately constructed to challenge reasoning through misleading local cues and nested logical operations, and include symbolic and structured natural-language presentations. Across eight model configurations with thinking disabled or minimized, Boolean accuracy ranges from 48.52% to 50.57%, while the identification accuracy reaches at most 43.0%. A thinking-enabled GLM configuration achieves uneven gains while retaining substantial errors and inconsistencies. Hob-VL exposes these failures through executable reference answers and matched evaluations.

AI.tldr: Hob-VL：一个用于视觉接地布尔推理的基准，包含规则验证与对象识别两类任务，揭示当前多模态模型在组合式逻辑推理上的严重缺陷。
AI.motivation: 可靠视觉推理需要组合多个视觉观察，并对逻辑等价问题给出一致答案，而现有模型在这类能力上表现存疑，缺乏针对性评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 Hob-VL 基准，包含两个任务：（1）判断布尔规则在图像中是否成立；（2）识别满足布尔描述的唯一对象。数据含 6,000 条人工核验的均衡 Yes/No 问题，每条由十个视觉语句的布尔组合定义，覆盖 1,000 个生成场景与 46 张多样化标注照片，并附加 1,000 个对象识别问题。题目刻意设置误导性局部线索与嵌套逻辑运算，提供符号化与结构化自然语言两种呈现形式，并配有可执行参考答案与匹配评测。
AI.result: 在八种关闭或最小化思考的模型配置下，布尔准确率仅 48.52%–50.57%，识别准确率最高 43.0%；启用思考的 GLM 配置增益不稳定，仍存在大量错误与不一致。
AI.conclusion: Hob-VL 通过可执行参考答案与匹配评测，系统暴露了当前多模态模型在视觉接地布尔推理上的失败，为可靠视觉推理研究提供了诊断工具。

title: Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models
summary: Generative video world models can now synthesize open-ended environments that agents can navigate and interact with in simple ways. Yet open-ended generation does not imply full interaction: as a generated world expands, newly created content through navigation should expand what the agent can act upon, and as the agent changes the world, those changes should become persistent parts of the environment rather than transient visual effects. We characterize these two requirements as Open-World Interactivity, where newly generated or encountered entities are incorporated into the actionable world, and Persistent State, where interaction outcomes are committed to the world state and continue to influence subsequent observations and interactions. We present Oneira, an interactive video world model that closes the loop between generation and interaction through an explicit, extensible world state managed by a coding agent. Given the current observation and an action or high-level goal, the agent reads the world state, grounds the relevant entities, plans the interaction, and writes its outcome back into a world state table. When exploration reveals new objects, the agent incorporates them from generated observations, allowing the interaction space to expand with the generated world. Meanwhile, previously induced state changes are carried across video segments, making the consequences of interaction persistent parts of subsequent world evolution. The updated world state is rendered along the camera action trajectory into a coarse conditioning video, from which a video generator fills in the appearance, motion, and interaction details not represented in the state. Experiments show that Oneira enables direct and consistent interaction with newly generated objects, while preserving the effects of prior interactions over long horizons. Project page: https://madaoer.github.io/projects/oneira

AI.tldr: 提出交互式视频世界模型 Oneira，通过编码智能体维护显式可扩展世界状态，实现开放世界可交互性与持久状态。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式视频世界模型虽能合成开放环境，但"开放式生成"不等于"完整交互"：新生成内容未被纳入可作用对象，且交互结果只是短暂视觉效应，无法持久影响后续演化。
AI.method: 定义两项需求——开放世界可交互性（新生成/遇到的实体纳入可作用世界）与持久状态（交互结果写入世界状态）。Oneira 用编码智能体管理显式可扩展世界状态：读取状态、定位相关实体、规划交互并回写结果到状态表；新物体从生成观测中并入，状态变化跨视频片段传递；更新后的状态沿相机轨迹渲染为粗略条件视频，再由视频生成器补全外观、运动与交互细节。
AI.result: 实验表明 Oneira 能与新生成物体进行直接且一致的交互，并在长时程上保留先前交互的效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式世界状态闭合生成与交互的环路，Oneira 实现了开放世界可交互性与持久状态，支持长时程一致交互。

title: Beyond Domain-Level Adaptation: Margin-Oriented Semantic-Appearance Interaction Correction for Personalized Federated Vision-Language Models
summary: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables distributed clients to adapt pretrained vision-language models without sharing raw data or updating the full backbone. Its effectiveness, however, is limited by domain heterogeneity across clients. Existing personalized methods separate globally shared knowledge from client-specific style, but they largely treat each domain as a class-agnostic transformation. We show that this abstraction is insufficient: the cross-domain displacement associated with a fixed domain varies across semantic classes, and only a subset of these class-domain residuals damages the image-text decision margin. We therefore propose Margin-Oriented Semantic-Appearance Interaction Correction (MOSAIC), which first constructs a decision-aware harmfulness score that measures whether a training-derived class-domain residual favors a competing text prototype over the true class. It then models fine-grained class-domain interactions with a low-rank residual adapter whose class factors and residual basis are globally shared while domain factors remain client-private. An image-conditioned gate further controls candidate-wise correction, and harmful-pair-aware reweighting prioritizes decision-relevant residuals during local optimization. Extensive experiments on Office31, OfficeHome, and DomainNet100 demonstrate that MOSAIC consistently improves macro-client top-1 accuracy across all evaluated domain-shift and joint domain-label-shift settings.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC通过建模细粒度类-域交互并优先校正损害决策边界的残差，提升联邦参数高效微调的个性化效果。
AI.motivation: 联邦参数高效微调受限于客户端间的域异质性；现有方法将各域视为类别无关的变换，但作者指出同一域的跨域位移在不同语义类别上不同，且仅部分类-域残差会损害图文决策边界。
AI.method: 提出MOSAIC：1）构建决策感知的有害性评分，衡量训练所得类-域残差是否使竞争文本原型优于真实类；2）用低秩残差适配器建模细粒度类-域交互，类因子与残差基全局共享，域因子客户端私有；3）图像条件门控控制候选校正；4）有害对感知重加权，在本地优化中优先处理决策相关残差。
AI.result: 在Office31、OfficeHome、DomainNet100上的大量实验表明，MOSAIC在所有评估的域偏移及联合域-标签偏移设定下持续提升客户端宏平均Top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: 类-域交互建模与面向决策边界的残差校正对联邦个性化PEFT至关重要，MOSAIC实现了更精细的个性化迁移并验证其有效性。

title: Fusing Visual and Textual Representations via Multi-layer Fusing Transformers for Vietnamese Visual Question Answering
summary: In recent decades, artificial intelligence has made significant progress in understanding and interacting with images. One of the important applications of this technology is Visual Question Answering (VQA), a research field that requires computers to understand and answer questions about images in a natural manner. Despite extensive research and development in VQA for English, there have been very few similar efforts made for other languages, especially Vietnamese. This gap presents a significant challenge and opportunity for the advancement of VQA technology in the Vietnamese language context. By bridging this gap, the field of Vietnamese VQA not only enriches the diversity of research in artificial intelligence but also enables practical applications in various domains, such as education, healthcare, and entertainment, catering to Vietnamese-speaking populations worldwide. Thus, the exploration and development of Vietnamese VQA systems hold immense potential for advancing both research and practical applications in the intersection of computer vision and natural language processing. In this paper, we propose a Multi-layer Fusing Transformer model utilizing a cross attention module to combine multiple modality features of images and texts from different layers in an aggregated representation. Our architecture allows us extract information from low level to high level. Through detailed experiments and ablation studies, our model achieves promising results against the competitive baselines in ViVQA dataset for Vietnamese language.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多层融合Transformer模型，利用交叉注意力机制聚合图像与文本多层多模态特征，在越南语ViVQA数据集上取得优于基线的结果。
AI.motivation: VQA在英语领域研究广泛，但越南语等语言的VQA研究极少，存在显著空白。填补该空白不仅能丰富AI研究多样性，还可服务于教育、医疗、娱乐等实际应用场景。
AI.method: 提出Multi-layer Fusing Transformer模型，采用cross attention模块，将来自不同层的图像与文本多模态特征进行聚合表示，从而同时提取低层到高层的语义信息；并开展详细实验与消融研究。
AI.result: 在越南语ViVQA数据集上，模型取得了具有竞争力的结果，优于多个基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 越南语VQA系统的开发在计算机视觉与自然语言处理交叉领域兼具研究价值与应用潜力，所提多层融合Transformer为该方向提供了有效方案。

title: Not All Error Yields to Scale: Where Scaling Stops in Vision-Language Inference
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) face a fixed-budget trade-off between processing more visual information for fine-grained perception and using a larger language backbone for complex reasoning. Existing studies do not tell us which combination of backbone size and input resolution to deploy, especially in high-resolution deployments. To address this gap, we propose the Separable Law that describes how VLM performance changes with language backbone size and visual token count. We fit the law to measurements from 26 InternVL and QwenVL models, with language backbone sizes from 1B to 72B, on four high-resolution benchmarks with image sizes from 224 pixels to 8K. We find that the questions responding to scaling can be predicted from the skill they require, while a substantial fraction never responds at all. We also find that the two model families gain similarly from a larger backbone, while their gains from more visual tokens differ sharply. Combined with a cost law, the Separable Law gives a closed-form rule for allocating compute between backbone size and visual tokens. When deployment is limited to available configurations, the law identifies model and image sizes that perform close to the best feasible choice under the same budget. We hope our work offers a principled way to decide how much a model should be allowed to see at high resolution, given what it must reason about.

AI.tldr: 提出"可分离定律"（Separable Law），刻画VLM性能随语言骨干规模与视觉token数量的变化规律，并据此给出计算资源分配的闭式规则。
AI.motivation: VLM在固定算力预算下需权衡：增加视觉信息以提升细粒度感知，还是扩大语言骨干以增强复杂推理。已有研究未回答在高分辨率部署中应如何组合骨干规模与输入分辨率。
AI.method: 在26个InternVL与QwenVL模型（骨干1B–72B）上，于4个高分辨率基准（224像素–8K）拟合"可分离定律"，并联合成本定律推导计算分配的闭式规则。
AI.result: 可扩展性问题可由其所需技能预测，但相当一部分问题完全不响应扩展；两个模型家族从更大骨干中获益相似，而从更多视觉token中获益差异显著。在仅限可用配置时，该定律能识别接近同等预算下最优可行选择的模型与图像尺寸。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为"在给定推理需求下，模型在高分辨率下应被允许看多少"提供了有原则的决策依据。

title: DiVid: Diagnosing Dimension-Specific Diversity Collapse in Video Generation Models
summary: Despite remarkable progress, video generation models often produce highly similar outputs when repeatedly sampled from the same prompt, limiting their usefulness for creative exploration. Existing diversity evaluations primarily rely on global scalar metrics, which obscure where diversity collapses in the spatiotemporal space of videos. We introduce DiVid, a dimension-level diagnostic framework that decomposes video generation diversity into six interpretable dimensions: Semantic, Style, Subject, Scene, Motion, and Camera. Each dimension is measured through a reproducible computer-vision pipeline and analyzed alongside quality and instruction faithfulness to examine potential trade-offs. Systematic evaluation of representative video generation models reveals that diversity is highly dimension-specific: models with strong global diversity scores still collapse on specific factors, particularly Motion and Camera. These rankings persist after filtering unfaithful generations, indicating genuine capability differences rather than off-prompt outputs. Beyond measurement, controlled prompt interventions identify two fundamental bottlenecks: default mode convergence, where models fall back to dominant patterns under open-ended prompts; and realization gaps, where models fail to faithfully realize diverse, explicitly requested alternatives, particularly for temporal factors. The larger faithfulness losses for temporal factors highlight the difficulty of controlling motion and camera variation through text alone. DiVid thus shifts the study of diversity from measuring whether it exists to diagnosing where and why it collapses, and provides actionable directions for dimension-aware training objectives and control signals. The framework will be released to facilitate future research on diverse and controllable video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出DiVid维度级诊断框架，将视频生成多样性分解为语义、风格、主体、场景、运动、镜头六个维度，通过可复现CV流程量化，揭示多样性塌缩的具体所在与成因。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型在相同提示下重复采样往往输出高度相似，限制创意探索；现有评估依赖全局标量指标，掩盖了多样性在视频时空空间中塌缩的位置。
AI.method: DiVid将多样性拆解为六个可解释维度（Semantic、Style、Subject、Scene、Motion、Camera），每维用可复现的计算机视觉流程度量，并与质量、指令忠实度联合分析以考察权衡关系；进一步通过受控提示干预识别瓶颈。
AI.result: 代表性模型评估显示多样性高度维度特异：全局多样性得分高的模型在特定维度（尤其Motion与Camera）仍塌缩；过滤不忠实生成后排序依旧，说明是真实能力差异。提示干预识别出两个瓶颈——默认模式收敛与实现差距，且时序因素（运动、镜头）的忠实度损失更大。
AI.conclusion: DiVid将多样性研究从"是否存在"推进到"何处、为何塌缩"，为维度感知的训练目标与控制信号提供可行方向，框架将开源以促进多样且可控的视频生成研究。

title: Do MLLM Judges Judge the Edit? Auditing Bias in Image Editing Evaluation with Verified Quality Preservation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for instruction-based image editing and as reward signals for model training. However, systematically auditing whether these judges are influenced by cues irrelevant to editing quality is challenging because visual interventions may themselves alter the quality being evaluated. A judgment shift can therefore be attributed to bias only when the intervention is verified to preserve the underlying editing quality. To address this challenge, we introduce EditJudgeBias, a counterfactual benchmark with verified quality preservation, comprising 1,196 real editing samples and 13 cues injected across four evaluation sites. We verify quality preservation for the requested edit using calibrated multimodal validators, controls, and human inspection. We then audit five MLLM judges along three complementary dimensions: invariance to quality-preserving cues, agreement with human judgments, and stability of pairwise preferences. Importantly, observed shifts are evaluated against each judge's own zero-dose and re-query noise floors rather than against zero. Experiments show that quality-preserving cues move every judge beyond its own noise. Fabricated majority opinions increase ratings, irrelevant visual elements cause larger shifts than whole-image manipulations, and swapping candidate order reverses up to 60.9% of pairwise decisions. Edit-region cues also tend to reduce human agreement. The three measures characterize judges differently, showing that robustness cannot be captured by a single metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EditJudgeBias 反事实基准，通过已验证质量保持的视觉干预审计多模态大模型作为图像编辑评判者时的偏差。
AI.motivation: MLLM 日益被用作指令图像编辑的自动评判者与训练奖励信号，但其判断是否受与编辑质量无关的线索影响尚缺乏系统审计。难点在于视觉干预本身可能改变被评估的质量，只有当干预被验证保持了底层编辑质量时，判断偏移才能归因于偏差。
AI.method: 构建 EditJudgeBias 基准，包含 1,196 个真实编辑样本、在四个评估位置注入的 13 种线索；用校准的多模态验证器、对照实验与人工检查验证质量保持；从三个维度审计五个 MLLM 评判者：对质量保持线索的不变性、与人类判断的一致性、成对偏好的稳定性；并将观测偏移与各评判者自身的零剂量与重查询噪声下限比较，而非与零比较。
AI.result: 质量保持线索使每个评判者的偏移均超出自身噪声下限；伪造的多数意见提高评分；无关视觉元素造成的偏移大于整图操纵；交换候选顺序可逆转多达 60.9% 的成对决策；编辑区域线索倾向于降低与人类判断的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 三个度量从不同角度刻画评判者，说明鲁棒性无法用单一指标衡量；验证质量保持的反事实设计可将判断偏移可靠地归因于偏差。

title: When Text-to-Image Helps Editing: The Effects of Conditioning During Denoising
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Unified models are trained for both instruction-based image editing and text-to-image (T2I) generation, but standard editing pipelines keep source-image conditioning throughout denoising. We ask whether editing can benefit from T2I, and study how the effects of conditioning vary across edits and denoising stages. In pure editing, source attention declines for some edits over the sampling trajectory. This observation led us to task switching, which lets the model draw on its T2I capabilities. Across three unified editors and four benchmarks, switching to the T2I task for bounded intervals improves edit quality, while mean perceptual preservation remains close to pure editing across all three models. Unified editors therefore benefit from using both conditioning modes they are trained for, and the timing of the switch sets the balance between quality and preservation.

AI.tldr: 研究表明统一编辑模型可通过在去噪过程中切换至T2I任务提升编辑质量，切换时机决定质量与保真度的平衡。
AI.motivation: 统一模型同时具备指令编辑与T2I生成能力，但标准编辑流程在去噪全程保留源图条件，作者质疑这种纯编辑范式是否最优，并希望探究编辑能否受益于T2I能力。
AI.method: 观察不同编辑任务与去噪阶段中源注意力随采样轨迹的变化，发现纯编辑下部分编辑的源注意力衰减，据此提出任务切换方法：在有界区间内将模型切换至T2I任务，并在三个统一编辑器、四个基准上验证。
AI.result: 在三个统一编辑器与四个基准上，于有限区间内切换至T2I任务均提升了编辑质量，且平均感知保真度在三个模型上均接近纯编辑水平。
AI.conclusion: 统一编辑器可从其训练涉及的两种条件模式中获益，切换时机决定了编辑质量与内容保真度之间的权衡。

title: Architectural Sampling: Test-Time Scaling via Computational Diversity in Frozen Vision-Language Models
summary: Test-time scaling often seeks better answers by sampling multiple responses from a frozen model, yet conventional temperature sampling generates every candidate along the same fixed computation path. We introduce architectural sampling, a training-free method that generates candidates through distinct forward computations by reusing selected blocks of decoder layers. Varying the block location and repetition count introduces computational diversity without updating model weights or adding auxiliary parameters. Across five Qwen checkpoints and twelve multimodal benchmarks, architectural sampling improves pass@9 over standard-path temperature sampling by 6.58 percentage points on average at the same nine-candidate budget. Reusing early layers yields the strongest gains, and the improvement in candidate coverage persists even under greedy decoding. The resulting candidates show lower lexical overlap and improve accuracy when used as rollouts for label-free test-time reinforcement learning. These findings extend the benefits of our architectural sampling beyond candidate coverage, demonstrating more effective learning from a model's own outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的"架构采样"（architectural sampling）：通过复用解码器层块以不同前向计算路径生成候选，在相同候选预算下提升多模态任务的pass@9，并改善无标签测试时强化学习。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展常依赖对冻结模型多次采样以获得更好答案，但传统温度采样让所有候选共享同一条固定计算路径，导致候选间多样性受限、覆盖不足。作者希望在不更新权重、不引入额外参数的前提下，从计算路径层面引入多样性，从而提升候选覆盖与后续利用效果。
AI.method: 架构采样：一种免训练方法，通过复用被选中的解码器层块，使不同候选经由不同的前向计算产生。通过改变块的位置与重复次数来引入计算多样性，不更新模型权重、不增加辅助参数；并可与贪婪解码结合使用。作者在五个Qwen检查点、十二个多模态基准上评估，比较同一九候选预算下的pass@9，并将生成候选作为rollout用于无标签测试时强化学习。
AI.result: 在五个Qwen检查点、十二个多模态基准上，架构采样在同一九候选预算下将pass@9相比标准路径温度采样平均提升6.58个百分点。复用早期层收益最强；即使在贪婪解码下，候选覆盖的提升依然存在。生成的候选间词汇重叠更低，并作为无标签测试时强化学习的rollout时提升了准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过层块复用引入计算路径多样性，可在不训练、不加参数的情况下显著改善候选覆盖，并进一步惠及下游的测试时强化学习，表明其收益超出单纯的候选多样性，实现了更有效地从模型自身输出中学习。

title: MEGA: Object-Level Mesh Extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting via Spatial Visual Distillation
summary: Mesh extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to endow 3D Gaussians with accurate geometric structures, enabling explicit and precise 3D occupancy. However, existing methods primarily focus on scene-level mesh extraction, making them unable to represent object-level occupancy and often resulting in non-watertight surfaces. To overcome these limitations, we propose \textbf{MEGA} (\underline{M}esh \underline{E}xtraction from \underline{GA}ussians), a ``segment-then-mesh'' framework for extracting object-level, watertight meshes from complex 3DGS scenes. At the core of MEGA are \textbf{Spatial Visual Distillation (SVD)} and a mask-guided neural surface reconstruction module. SVD treats the 3DGS model as a teacher, sampling diverse camera poses and rendering the corresponding views of each segmented object. These observations are then used to train a mesh reconstruction model through photometric supervision. Extensive experiments on several widely used benchmarks demonstrate that MEGA achieves state-of-the-art performance in recovering accurate object-level 3D occupancy. Moreover, MEGA enables complex physical interactions by combining high-quality object-level meshes for geometric occupancy with 3DGS representations for photorealistic rendering.

AI.tldr: MEGA提出"先分割后重建"框架，从复杂3DGS场景中提取对象级水密网格。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS网格提取方法主要针对场景级，无法表示对象级占用，且常产生非水密表面。
AI.method: 提出MEGA框架，核心为空间视觉蒸馏（SVD）与掩码引导的神经表面重建模块。SVD将3DGS模型作为教师，采样多样相机位姿并渲染每个分割对象的对应视图，通过光度监督训练网格重建模型。
AI.result: 在多个广泛使用的基准上，MEGA在恢复准确的对象级3D占用方面达到最先进性能；结合高质量对象级网格与3DGS表示可实现复杂物理交互。
AI.conclusion: MEGA实现了从复杂3DGS场景提取对象级水密网格，兼顾几何占用与真实感渲染。

title: Rethinking Memorization Mitigation in Diffusion Models: Reinforcing Text Conditioning
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in image synthesis, yet can exhibit memorization by closely reproducing individual training examples. Effective mitigation must preserve useful prompt information to guide alternative depictions. We introduce a training-free method that redistributes cross-attention with Gaussian smoothing before reinforcing content-token contributions and attenuating padding contributions, without additional denoiser evaluations. With this intervention, stronger content conditioning can improve prompt alignment at comparable training-image similarity. A local analysis identifies when reinforcement preserves shared value information while redistribution reduces localized attention mass. On Stable Diffusion v1.4 and v2.0, all evaluated smoothing widths lie on the empirical Pareto frontiers for training-image similarity versus both prompt alignment and image preference. A configuration selected on Stable Diffusion reduces template reproduction in DeepFloyd IF without further tuning. These findings support jointly controlling conditioning allocation and strength to generate prompt-consistent alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免训练方法，通过高斯平滑重分配交叉注意力并强化内容token贡献、削弱padding贡献，在不增加去噪器评估的情况下缓解文生图扩散模型的记忆化问题，同时在提示对齐和图像偏好上与训练图像相似度达成Pareto最优。
AI.motivation: 文生图扩散模型虽在图像合成上进展显著，但存在记忆化问题，会紧密复现个别训练样本。有效缓解需在保留有用提示信息以引导替代性描绘的同时降低对训练图像的复现。
AI.method: 提出免训练方法：在强化内容token贡献并衰减padding贡献之前，用高斯平滑重分配交叉注意力，且不增加额外的去噪器评估。通过局部分析确定强化何时保留共享value信息、重分配何时降低局部注意力质量。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion v1.4和v2.0上，所有评估的平滑宽度均位于训练图像相似度对提示对齐和图像偏好两者的经验Pareto前沿上。在Stable Diffusion上选定的配置无需再调参即可降低DeepFloyd IF中的模板复现。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现支持联合控制条件分配与强度，以生成与提示一致的替代图像。

title: ATI-VLA: Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection
summary: Predictive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to improve robotic manipulation via future observation or world dynamics forecasting. However, existing approaches often fail to realize this potential and underperform direct action prediction models. We argue that these limitations stem from modality misalignment between observations and actions, together with joint optimization conflicts that drive learning away from an action-centric objective. To this end, we introduce ATI-VLA, an Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action framework via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection. Specifically, it follows a two-step design: 1) Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook. It aligns predictive observation and action representations by mapping both modalities into a shared discrete latent space via a unified codebook, making predictive observation latents readily usable for action generation and mitigating modality misalignment. 2) Action-Centric Adaptive Injection of Predictive Latents. Building upon this, it then injects predictive observation latents into action decoding as explicit predictive priors via a lightweight adaptive side-path, enabling adaptive predictive guidance under a single action-centric objective. Extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that ATI-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.

AI.tldr: 提出ATI-VLA框架，通过共享码本对齐预测观测与动作表示，并以自适应侧路注入预测潜变量，实现以动作为中心的可预测VLA，取得SOTA性能与更快收敛。
AI.motivation: 预测式VLA（通过未来观测或世界动态预测提升操作）潜力未被充分释放，常不如直接动作预测模型。作者认为原因在于观测与动作间的模态错位，以及联合优化冲突使学习偏离以动作为中心的目标。
AI.method: 两阶段设计：1）基于共享码本的可操作表征对齐，将预测观测与动作映射到统一离散潜空间，使预测观测潜变量可直接用于动作生成，缓解模态错位；2）以动作为中心的自适应预测潜变量注入，通过轻量自适应侧路将预测观测潜变量作为显式预测先验注入动作解码，在单一动作中心目标下实现自适应预测引导。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人任务上的大量实验表明，ATI-VLA达到SOTA性能，且收敛更快。
AI.conclusion: 以动作为中心的“先对齐再注入”设计可有效利用预测信息，解决模态错位与优化冲突，为预测式VLA提供可行范式。

title: FFBL-Coop: Association-Decoupled Cooperative 3D Multi-Object Tracking
comment: 9 pages (main content), 21 pages total including references and appendix; 11 figures; under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Cooperative 3D tracking must integrate complementary observations across agents and time while maintaining consistent identities. When evidence integration and identity inheritance share a matching decision, errors arising from cross-view appearance differences and spatial misalignment can compromise both feature fusion and track continuity. We propose FFBL-Coop, a fuse first, bind later framework that separates instance admission from identity management. Confidence-ranked Slot Admission (CSA) allocates cooperative queries to available ego slots using confidence and spatial proximity. Unified Representation Aggregation (URA) uses cooperative semantic features and aligned anchors to guide ego-feature retrieval, refining the augmented query bank within a shared transformer decoder. After refinement, Cooperative-Priority Identity Anchoring (CPIA) combines learned association with persistent mappings to establish accepted identity assignments across frames. A shared codebook reduces transmitted payload while retaining AP and AMOTA close to the uncompressed variant. FFBL-Coop achieves AMOTA/AP of 0.611/0.548 on V2X-Seq and 0.688/0.653 on Griffin-25M. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 FFBL-Coop 协作 3D 跟踪框架，将实例接纳与身份管理解耦，在 V2X-Seq 与 Griffin-25M 上取得领先的 AMOTA/AP 表现。
AI.motivation: 协作 3D 跟踪需跨智能体与时序整合互补观测并保持身份一致。当证据融合与身份继承共用同一匹配决策时，跨视角外观差异和空间失配引发的错误会同时损害特征融合与轨迹连续性。
AI.method: 采用"先融合、后绑定"范式，分离实例接纳与身份管理：置信度排序槽位接纳（CSA）按置信度与空间邻近度为自车槽位分配协作查询；统一表征聚合（URA）利用协作语义特征与对齐锚点引导自车特征检索，在共享 Transformer 解码器中精炼增强查询库；协作优先身份锚定（CPIA）在精炼后结合学习关联与持久映射完成跨帧身份分配；共享码本降低传输开销。
AI.result: 在 V2X-Seq 上达到 AMOTA/AP 0.611/0.548，在 Griffin-25M 上达到 0.688/0.653；共享码本在降低传输负载的同时，AP 与 AMOTA 接近未压缩版本。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦融合与身份绑定，FFBL-Coop 缓解了跨视角外观差异与空间失配带来的耦合误差，同时兼顾通信效率与跟踪精度，代码将开源。

title: Cog-VADU: A Training-Free Cognitive Reasoning Framework for Video Anomaly Detection and Understanding
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. 39 pages
summary: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to temporally localize abnormal events in videos. Most existing approaches rely on dataset-specific training and curated annotations, limiting generalization in open-set scenarios. Recent zero-shot methods based on Large Vision- Language Models (LVLMs) alleviate this dependency but often lack temporal continuity and structured reasoning. We propose Cog-VADU, a fully training-free framework that reformulates VAD as a sequential cognitive reasoning task. Cog-VADU introduces Chain-of- Anomaly Detection Thought Prompting (CoADTP), which unrolls an LVLM into a recurrent reasoning chain across video segments. By propagating structured rationales over time, the model maintains implicit temporal memory, enabling robust discrimination between com- plex anomalies and high-motion normal activities. To improve reliability, we further design a cross-modal re-ranking stage that aligns textual rationales with visual embeddings, enforcing semantic consistency and temporal coherence for refined and stable predictions. Extensive experiments on multiple public VAD benchmarks demonstrate that Cog-VADU achieves competitive zero-shot performance. Moreover, cross-model evaluations show that CoADTP consistently enhances reasoning-based anomaly detection in a model-agnostic manner, pro- viding interpretable and generalizable anomaly understanding for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: Cog-VADU是一个完全免训练的视频异常检测框架，将VAD重构为序列化认知推理任务，通过跨视频片段的循环推理链保持隐式时序记忆，并结合跨模态重排序提升预测可靠性，在零样本设定下取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VAD方法多依赖数据集特定训练和人工标注，限制了开放集场景下的泛化能力；近期基于大视觉语言模型（LVLM）的零样本方法虽缓解了标注依赖，但普遍缺乏时序连续性和结构化推理能力。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架Cog-VADU，包含两个核心组件：(1) CoADTP（异常检测思维链提示），将LVLM展开为跨视频片段的循环推理链，通过随时间传播结构化推理依据来维持隐式时序记忆，从而区分复杂异常与高运动量的正常活动；(2) 跨模态重排序阶段，将文本推理依据与视觉嵌入对齐，强制语义一致性与时序连贯性以精化预测。
AI.result: 在多个公开VAD基准上的大量实验表明Cog-VADU取得了有竞争力的零样本性能；跨模型评估显示CoADTP能以模型无关的方式持续增强基于推理的异常检测。
AI.conclusion: Cog-VADU为真实世界应用提供了可解释、可泛化的异常理解能力，验证了将VAD重构为序列化认知推理任务的有效性与通用性。

title: GenCOPE: Syn2Real Generalized Category-Level Object Pose Estimation for Robotic Picking
summary: Category-level object pose estimation (COPE), capable of generalizing to intra-class unknown objects, has become a core technique for robotic 3D scene understanding. However, existing COPE methods still require labor-intensive recollection of real-world training data for novel object categories, which limits their scalability in practical applications. This paper aims to achieve synthetic-to-real (Syn2Real) generalized COPE, where a model is trained solely on rendered synthetic data and directly generalized to real-world deployments. The central challenge lies in the significant domain gap between synthetic and real-world data, particularly in texture appearance. To address this, we aim to enhance domain generalization by learning domain-invariant representations that capture semantic commonalities among objects within the same category. We introduce 2D and 3D semantic consistency constraints to reduce the sensitivity of feature encoders to domain-specific features. In addition, we propose an end-to-end pose regression framework that performs 2D-3D cross consistency learning, leveraging dense cross-modality fusion to further refine pose estimation. Since simplicity and effectiveness are essential for real-world robotic deployment, our model operates exclusively on global features, yielding a highly lightweight and efficient architecture. Extensive experiments on the REAL275 and Wild6D benchmarks, as well as real-world robotic manipulation scenes, show superior Syn2Real generalization performance of our paradigm. Code and demos are released at https://paperreview99.github.io/GenCOPE/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenCOPE，实现仅用合成数据训练即可泛化到真实场景的类别级物体位姿估计（Syn2Real COPE），通过2D/3D语义一致性约束学习域不变表示，并结合端到端的2D-3D交叉一致性位姿回归框架，在REAL275、Wild6D及真实机器人操作场景中取得优越的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有类别级物体位姿估计（COPE）方法在新类别上仍需耗费大量人力采集真实训练数据，可扩展性差。本文旨在实现合成到真实（Syn2Real）的广义COPE，即仅在渲染合成数据上训练，直接泛化到真实部署。核心挑战在于合成与真实数据之间的显著域间隙，尤其是纹理外观差异。
AI.method: 1）引入2D与3D语义一致性约束，降低特征编码器对域特有特征的敏感性，从而学习捕捉同类物体语义共性的域不变表示，提升域泛化能力；2）提出端到端位姿回归框架，进行2D-3D交叉一致性学习，利用密集跨模态融合进一步精炼位姿估计；3）为满足机器人部署对简洁高效的要求，模型仅基于全局特征运行，架构轻量高效。
AI.result: 在REAL275和Wild6D基准以及真实机器人操作场景上的大量实验表明，该范式具有优越的Syn2Real泛化性能。代码与演示已发布。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义一致性约束与2D-3D交叉一致性学习，仅依赖合成数据的轻量级COPE模型可有效弥合合成-真实域间隙，实现强泛化的真实世界部署，为机器人3D场景理解提供了可扩展方案。

title: PhysDEM: Physics-Defined Energy-Matching Diffusion for Spatiotemporal Field Generation under Scarce Measurements
summary: Generating and predicting spatiotemporal physical fields from scarce measurements is challenging, as observations are insufficient to characterize a distribution over complete fields. This limits conventional data-driven diffusion models that rely on full-field datasets. We introduce PhysDEM, a physics-defined diffusion framework that combines governing equations with spatially sparse observations to generate multiple plausible fields. First, we construct a Gibbs target by reweighting a measurement-conditioned Gaussian reference with PDE residual energy. Second, we derive an exact conditional-mean identity that reduces denoising to supervised learning of the standardized energy-induced mean correction. Third, a physics-displacement probability flow cancels Gaussian reference terms and enables amortized sampling with changing measurements through Gaussian conditioning, without retraining. Experiments on synthetic PDE systems and real-world-informed applications demonstrate that PhysDEM supports coherent field recovery and efficient sampling while maintaining stable diagnostics under tested noise levels, illustrating its practical value for field assessment. To our knowledge, PhysDEM is the first physics-defined diffusion model enabling amortized spatiotemporal field inference without preassembled full-field datasets.

AI.tldr: PhysDEM是一个物理定义的扩散框架，结合控制方程与稀疏观测生成多个合理的时空物理场，无需完整场数据集，实现了摊销式时空场推断。
AI.motivation: 从稀缺测量生成和预测时空物理场具有挑战性，因为观测不足以刻画完整场的分布，这限制了依赖完整场数据的传统数据驱动扩散模型。目标是摆脱对预组装完整场数据集的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 通过PDE残差能量对测量条件高斯参考进行重加权，构建Gibbs目标；2) 推导精确的条件均值恒等式，将去噪简化为对标准化能量诱导均值修正的监督学习；3) 设计物理位移概率流，抵消高斯参考项，通过高斯条件化实现随测量变化的摊销采样，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在合成PDE系统及真实世界信息驱动的应用上，PhysDEM支持连贯的场恢复和高效采样，在测试噪声水平下保持稳定诊断，展现其实用价值。
AI.conclusion: PhysDEM是首个物理定义的扩散模型，能够在无需预组装完整场数据集的情况下实现摊销式时空场推断。

title: OneStreamer: Unifying Perception, Memory, and Proactive Response in Streaming Video Interaction
comment: 29 pages, 12 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://mcg-nju.github.io/OneStreamer
summary: Streaming video LLMs must retain evidence before its relevance to future tasks is known and respond when sufficient evidence becomes available. The challenge is to form reusable factual memory without compromising real-time perception. We introduce OneStreamer, which jointly learns query-independent evidence recording and task response through a shared proactive generation process. Its Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory (PHCM) produces time-grounded local-detail captions and summaries of completed events. Streaming caption targets supervise the interpretation of observed video prefixes during training. At inference, model-generated records complement a recent visual window, providing reusable factual context without revisiting historical visual features. Proactive State Transition Learning (PSTL) reduces the dominance of repeated waiting states by preserving supervision at all output anchors and selecting representative state-change and state-persistence tokens. We further develop a streaming data synthesis pipeline that aligns output content and timing with available evidence. Combining the resulting streaming captions and QA with cleaned open-source data yields OneStreamer-1M, a broad-coverage streaming video interaction dataset with over one million records spanning diverse tasks. Our 4B model achieves the best results among the compared methods across all eight evaluated streaming video understanding benchmarks. Ablations show that retaining generated captions improves historical QA without degrading real-time perception. PSTL also outperforms dense state supervision while supervising only 27.5% of annotated state tokens. Together, these results support proactive generation as a shared learning interface connecting perception, memory formation, and timely response in streaming video interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OneStreamer，通过共享的主动生成过程联合学习查询无关的证据记录与任务响应，在八项流式视频理解基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 流式视频大模型需在与未来任务的关联性尚不明确时保留证据，并在证据充分时及时响应；核心挑战在于构建可复用的事实性记忆，同时不损害实时感知能力。
AI.method: 提出 OneStreamer：1）主动分层字幕记忆（PHCM）生成带时间锚定的局部细节字幕与已完成事件的摘要，训练时以流式字幕目标监督对已观测视频前缀的解读，推理时用模型自生成记录补充近期视觉窗口，无需回访历史视觉特征；2）主动状态转移学习（PSTL）通过保留所有输出锚点上的监督并选取代表性的状态变化与状态保持 token，缓解重复等待状态的主导问题；3）流式数据合成流水线，使输出内容与时机与可用证据对齐，并结合清理后的开源数据构建 OneStreamer-1M 数据集。
AI.result: 4B 模型在所有八项评测的流式视频理解基准上均优于对比方法；消融实验表明保留生成字幕可提升历史问答且不损害实时感知；PSTL 仅监督 27.5% 的标注状态 token，性能仍优于稠密状态监督。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持主动生成作为连接感知、记忆形成与及时响应的共享学习接口，适用于流式视频交互。

title: GIFTBench: Diagnosing Generalization in Image Forgery Localization and Informing Model Design
summary: Reliable evaluation of image forgery localization (IFL) requires assessing models under diverse distribution changes, yet existing benchmarks often cover limited manipulation conditions or entangle multiple factors in cross-dataset evaluation. Consequently, aggregate performance provides an incomplete view of localization generalization. We introduce GIFTBench, a multi-axis benchmark of 115,013 manipulated images with pixel-level annotations spanning manipulation source, semantic target, editing operation, and composition complexity. GIFTBench supports axis-specific transfer analysis and evaluation on twelve external datasets. Its diagnostic studies reveal asymmetric cross-source transfer, recall-dominated failures, and heterogeneous degradation across semantic, operational, and compositional changes. Beyond diagnosis, the scale and diversity of GIFTBench provide a substantially broader training distribution than conventional IFL datasets. Training representative localizers on GIFTBench consistently improves their aggregate transfer to external datasets, showing that the benchmark serves not only as an evaluation tool but also as an effective training resource for cross-domain localization. Guided by the diagnostic findings, we further develop ForenScope, a detection and localization framework combining classification-adapted representations with multi-depth, multi-scale spatial features, learned layer fusion, and selective coarse-scale conditioning. Experiments show improved cross-dataset localization while retaining image-level detection capability. The GIFTBench dataset showcase page is available at https://giftbench-preview.doudoudouya337.chatgpt.site.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多轴图像伪造定位基准 GIFTBench，并基于其诊断结论构建 ForenScope 框架，在跨域定位上取得改进。
AI.motivation: 现有图像伪造定位（IFL）评测基准覆盖的篡改条件有限，跨数据集评测常混淆多个因素，导致聚合性能无法完整反映定位泛化能力，因而需要可分解、多轴的评测与训练资源。
AI.method: 构建 GIFTBench：包含 115,013 张带像素级标注的篡改图像，覆盖篡改来源、语义目标、编辑操作、组合复杂度四个轴，支持单轴迁移分析与十二个外部数据集评测；同时将其作为训练分布使用。基于诊断结论提出 ForenScope，融合分类适配表征、多深度多尺度空间特征、可学习层融合与选择性粗尺度条件化。
AI.result: 诊断研究揭示跨来源迁移的非对称性、以召回为主导的失败模式，以及语义、操作、组合变化下的异质退化；在 GIFTBench 上训练代表性定位器可稳定提升对外部数据集的聚合迁移性能；ForenScope 在保持图像级检测能力的同时改善了跨数据集定位。
AI.conclusion: GIFTBench 既是细粒度诊断评测工具，也是有效的跨域训练资源；结合其诊断发现设计的 ForenScope 验证了该思路在跨域伪造检测与定位上的有效性。

title: VETO: Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision Language Models
summary: Processing long videos with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of visual tokens, making long-form inference prohibitively expensive. While single-axis compression methods mitigate this, they hit a hard efficiency floor because they treat spatial and temporal redundancy independently. We present VETO (Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision-Language Models), a training-optional plug-in that eliminates this bottleneck through dual-axis compression: (i) an intra-frame compressor that merges semantically similar tokens within each frame via optimal-transport inspired matching, and (ii) an inter-frame compressor that identifies and merges temporally redundant frames. The key design insight is hierarchical ordering: by first compressing spatial dimensions, VETO drastically reduces the cost of subsequent global temporal matching, bypassing the efficiency wall of single-axis approaches, with an advantage that grows with modern fully-fused attention infrastructure. Empirically, VETO achieves up to 45% faster inference (e.g., on LLaVA-OneVision-7B) while preserving or improving accuracy. Under extreme token starvation (10% budget), VETO outperforms VFlowOpt (54.9%), VisionZip (52.6%), and FastV (47.9%) with 55.7% accuracy. We demonstrate universal applicability across LLaVA-OneVision, InternVL-2.5, and LongVA, with zero-shot accuracy preserved or improved in all cases.

AI.tldr: VETO是一个训练无关的即插即用方法，通过双轴（帧内+帧间）压缩视频视觉token，缓解VLM处理长视频时的二次成本瓶颈，在保精度甚至提精度的同时最高提速45%。
AI.motivation: 长视频输入使视觉token数量激增，带来二次计算成本，导致长视频推理极其昂贵；现有单轴压缩方法分别处理空间与时间冗余，存在难以突破的效率下限。
AI.method: VETO采用双轴压缩：(i) 帧内压缩器基于最优传输启发的匹配，合并每帧内语义相似的token；(ii) 帧间压缩器识别并合并时间上冗余的帧。核心设计是分层排序——先做空间维度压缩，大幅降低后续全局时间匹配的成本，从而绕过单轴方法的效率墙，且其优势随现代全融合注意力基础设施而增大。方法为训练可选（training-optional）的即插即用模块。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-OneVision-7B上推理最高提速45%，同时保持或提升精度。在极端token预算（10%）下，VETO达到55.7%准确率，优于VFlowOpt（54.9%）、VisionZip（52.6%）和FastV（47.9%）。在LLaVA-OneVision、InternVL-2.5和LongVA上均验证了通用性，零样本准确率全部保持或提升。
AI.conclusion: VETO通过先空间后时间的双轴分层压缩，有效突破单轴方法的效率瓶颈，实现高压缩比下的高效长视频推理，且具有跨模型通用性与训练无关的易用性。

title: PhaseAT: Fourier Phase Adversarial Training for Medical Image Domain Generalization
comment: The paper is accepted in MICCAI 2026
summary: Reliable clinical deployment of deep medical image models is hindered by distribution shifts across scanners, sites, and acquisition protocols. Existing domain generalization (DG) methods often focus on style or intensity diversification, but they can still leave networks dependent on domain-specific texture correlations. Inspired by evidence that Fourier phase encodes semantic structure, we introduce PhaseAT, a phase-aware adversarial training framework for medical DG. PhaseAT forms phase-perturbed training views in the Fourier domain by iteratively updating a bounded phase perturbation while keeping the amplitude spectrum unchanged, thereby stressing spatial organization under matched appearance statistics. Perturbations are applied only to the luminance channel in YCbCr color space to avoid chromatic artifacts. Additionally, a simple phase-saliency mask concentrates updates on the most influential frequencies. The model is trained with a weighted combination of losses on clean and phase-perturbed samples, supporting both single-source and multi-source DG. We validate our method on two challenging medical datasets and demonstrate that PhaseAT achieves over 20% improvement in single-source domain generalization, outperforming several state-of-the-art DG methods. The code implementation is available at: https://github.com/ahmed-sharshar/PhaseAT.

AI.tldr: PhaseAT：一种基于傅里叶相位扰动对抗训练的医学图像领域泛化框架，在保持幅度谱不变的前提下施加有界相位扰动，配合YCbCr亮度通道约束与相位显著性掩码，在单源与多源DG上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 深度医学图像模型在跨扫描仪、站点与采集协议部署时受分布偏移影响，可靠性不足。现有领域泛化方法多聚焦风格或强度多样化，网络仍可能依赖域特有的纹理相关性。受"傅里叶相位编码语义结构"这一证据启发，作者希望通过扰动相位来削弱此类依赖。
AI.method: 提出PhaseAT相位感知对抗训练框架：在傅里叶域中迭代更新有界相位扰动、保持幅度谱不变，从而在匹配外观统计下施压空间组织；扰动仅施加于YCbCr色彩空间的亮度通道以避免色度伪影；引入简单的相位显著性掩码，将更新集中于最具影响力的频率；训练使用干净样本与相位扰动样本上的加权组合损失，兼容单源与多源DG设定。
AI.result: 在两个具挑战性的医学数据集上验证，PhaseAT在单源领域泛化上取得超过20%的提升，优于多种当前最先进（SOTA）的领域泛化方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过相位感知的对抗扰动构造训练视图，可在不改变外观统计的前提下迫使模型学习更稳健的语义结构表征，为医学图像领域泛化提供了一条有效且可复现的新路径。

title: From Pixels to Policy: A Multi-Agent System for Intervention and Geo-Spatial Decision Support
summary: Urban environments are shaped by design choices with long-term implications for health, safety, and quality of life, yet evaluating proposed interventions remains costly, time-consuming, and often impractical. Existing geospatial vision methods largely focus on monitoring urban indicators from aerial and street-view imagery, rather than proposing interventions and estimating their effects on such indicators. Moving beyond recognition, we introduce the problem of discovering interventions that improve target indicators for a given aerial or street-view image. We argue that a black-box indicator model, combined with a generative editing model, can serve as an implicit digital twin for testing intervention hypotheses. We present VIDA-Geo , a multi-agent system that explores this intervention space by coordinating segmentation, diffusion-based inpainting, and indicator scoring models to produce interventions that are both perceptually realistic and aligned with real-world policies. We evaluate our system on 8 indicators across aerial and street-view imagery, measuring changes in factors such as perceived safety and greenery. Our approach outperforms existing baselines in many cases, achieving up to 2X higher perceptual quality and policy alignment scores. Finally, our model provides users with multiple candidate interventions, supporting an expert city-planner-in-the-loop workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"干预发现"新问题：给定航拍或街景图像，自动搜索能改善目标指标的干预方案。作者提出多智能体系统VIDA-Geo，协调分割、扩散修复与指标评分模型，作为隐式数字孪生以测试干预假设，在8项指标上感知质量与政策对齐最高提升2倍。
AI.motivation: 城市设计决策对健康、安全与生活质量有长期影响，但评估拟议干预成本高、耗时长、常常不现实。现有地理空间视觉方法多聚焦于从航拍与街景图像中监测城市指标，而非提出干预并估计其对指标的影响，因此需要一种低成本、可测试干预假设的方案。
AI.method: 将黑盒指标模型与生成式编辑模型结合，作为隐式数字孪生来检验干预假设；提出多智能体系统VIDA-Geo，通过协调分割模型、基于扩散的修复(inpainting)模型与指标评分模型，在该干预空间中搜索，生成既感知真实又符合现实政策的干预方案。
AI.result: 在航拍与街景图像上针对8项指标（如感知安全性、绿化程度等）进行评估，所提方法在多数情况下优于现有基线，感知质量与政策对齐分数最高提升2倍；系统还可给出多个候选干预方案。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将城市视觉研究从"识别/监测"推进到"干预发现"，验证了生成式编辑+黑盒指标模型作为隐式数字孪生的可行性，支持专家城市规划师在环(in-the-loop)的工作流。

title: EvenSplat: Coupled 2D-3D Decomposition for Gaussian Splatting under Exposure and Illumination Variation
summary: A surface photographed under even light presents nearly the same appearance from every angle; the same surface under uneven light does not. Exposure changes between views, illumination varies within a single image, and locally strong light sources leave one region bright and its neighbor in shadow. Multi-view reconstruction methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting treat these lighting artifacts as if they were properties of the scene, entangling capture-specific illumination with the geometry and color they recover. We present EvenSplat, a framework that separates the two. EvenSplat couples an image-space illumination decomposition with an illumination field carried by the Gaussians, so that the same explanation of the lighting is shared between the two-dimensional and three-dimensional views of the scene; a camera-response network and a local exposure-compensation module absorb the global and residual differences that remain across training images. Through extensive experiments across multiple datasets and diverse forms of uneven illumination (cross-view exposure, spatial illumination variation, and high-contrast lighting) on both real-world captured and simulated benchmarks, EvenSplat generally outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under high-contrast illumination.

AI.tldr: EvenSplat 通过将图像空间光照分解与高斯携带的光照场耦合，把光照伪影与场景几何颜色解耦，在多种不均匀光照下（尤其高对比度光照）优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现实中同一表面在均匀光照下各视角外观一致，但在不均匀光照下并非如此：视角间曝光变化、单张图像内光照不均、局部强光源造成亮暗相邻。3D Gaussian Splatting 等多视图重建方法把这类光照伪影当作场景固有属性，导致捕获相关的光照被错误地纠缠进几何与颜色中。因此需要将光照与场景本质属性分离。
AI.method: 提出 EvenSplat 框架。核心是将图像空间的光照分解与由高斯携带的光照场相耦合，使同一套光照解释在二维与三维视角之间共享；同时用相机响应网络吸收训练图像间的全局差异，用局部曝光补偿模块吸收残余差异。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种不均匀光照形式（跨视角曝光、空间光照变化、高对比度光照）上，分别在真实拍摄与模拟基准中进行大量实验，EvenSplat 总体优于现有最先进方法，尤其在高对比度光照下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 将图像空间光照分解与三维光照场耦合、并辅以相机响应网络和局部曝光补偿，可有效解耦捕获光照与场景几何颜色，提升多视图重建在复杂光照下的鲁棒性与质量。

title: Memory-Guided B-Roll Generation from User Video Collections
summary: We introduce an approach for collection-grounded B-roll sequence generation. Given a user's video collection, a directive given in natural language, and a target duration, the goal is to produce a multi-shot sequence that complements the user's primary footage (A-roll) while preserving the collection's characters, settings, objects, and style. This task is challenging as one must choose the visual evidence from hours of captured footage that should guide the generation of each shot in the sequence. We address this challenge with MemComposer, a three-stage system that turns raw footage into a structured memory with visual references (characters, settings, objects, and style) and uses it to plan, retrieve, and generate grounded B-roll sequences. First, in a one-time offline stage, MemComposer constructs an entity-centric memory from raw video. Second, it uses the memory and user directive to plan a grounded sequence and retrieve conditioning frames for each shot. Third, it iteratively generates and critiques the sequence to enforce identity, setting, and sequence-level consistency. We evaluate MemComposer in a user preference study along two dimensions: prompt adherence and visual alignment to the user's collection. Against an ungrounded text-to-video planner, MemComposer wins 60.0\% of prompt-adherence and 92.8\% of visual-alignment comparisons, showing the grounding benefit of collection memory and reference retrieval. Against retrieval-only sequences assembled from captured footage, MemComposer wins 94.5\% of prompt-adherence comparisons, showing the value of generating missing shots, while retrieval-only sequences are preferred for visual alignment in 58.2\% of comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出 MemComposer 三阶段系统，用于基于用户视频合集的 B-roll 序列生成，通过实体中心记忆与参考帧检索实现可控、身份一致的视频生成。
AI.motivation: 用户拥有大量拍摄素材，但生成与主镜头（A-roll）互补的 B-roll 序列时，需从数小时素材中挑选合适的视觉证据来指导每个镜头的生成，同时保持人物、场景、物体与风格一致，这一任务极具挑战性。现有文生视频规划缺乏对用户合集的“落地”（grounding），而纯检索方案又无法生成素材中缺失的镜头。
AI.method: MemComposer 采用三阶段流程：(1) 一次性离线阶段，从原始视频构建以实体为中心的记忆（人物、场景、物体、风格）；(2) 利用该记忆与用户自然语言指令规划有依据的序列，并为每个镜头检索条件帧；(3) 迭代生成并自我批判（critique）序列，以强制身份、场景与序列级一致性。
AI.result: 用户偏好研究中：对比无落地的文生视频规划器，MemComposer 在提示遵循上胜出 60.0%，在视觉对齐上胜出 92.8%；对比仅检索序列，MemComposer 在提示遵循上胜出 94.5%，而仅检索序列在视觉对齐上以 58.2% 被偏好。
AI.conclusion: 集合记忆与参考检索带来显著的落地收益；生成能力在补全缺失镜头上具备价值，但纯检索素材在视觉对齐上仍具竞争力，说明真实素材的像素级保真度难以完全由生成替代。

title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Enhanced Radiometer Image Precipitation Estimation using Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Deep generative networks have recently achieved unprecedented performance in precise image and video editing using sophisticated textual prompts. However, the effectiveness of such models heavily depends on access to very large supervised and annotated image datasets, which can be very difficult to obtain. This is particularly true for satellite instruments, which very rarely overlap with labelled data, and suffer from domain shifts in the rare occasions they do. In this paper, we investigate the potential of flow matching models for unsupervised domain adaptation of satellite radiometer images. Our main contribution is a novel unsupervised method that achieves precise domain alignment by leveraging parts of the deterministic ordinary differential equations in flow matching models, conditioned on different satellite instruments. A key strength of our approach is its ability to preserve essential information while adapting across any domains since the perturbations are in theory bijective. Extensive experiments conducted on the GPM-Core constellation show the benefit of our conditional domain adaptation, particularly in improving rain precipitation estimation from radiometer imagery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于流匹配模型的无监督域自适应方法，利用流匹配中确定性ODE的部分环节，在不同卫星仪器条件下实现辐射计图像的精确域对齐，并成功用于改进降水反演。
AI.motivation: 深度生成模型在图像/视频编辑上表现优异，但依赖大规模有监督标注数据。卫星辐射计图像标注稀缺，且不同仪器间存在域偏移，导致跨卫星应用困难，因此需要一种无需标注的域自适应手段。
AI.method: 以流匹配模型为基础，利用其确定性常微分方程（ODE）的局部环节进行域间扰动；以不同卫星仪器作为条件变量构造条件流匹配，实现跨域（不同卫星仪器）的无监督域对齐；由于扰动在理论上具有双射性，可在迁移过程中保留原有信息。
AI.result: 在GPM-Core星座上的大量实验表明，该条件域自适应方法有效，尤其在基于辐射计图像的降水估计任务上带来了明显性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 利用流匹配ODE构造的、以卫星仪器为条件的双射扰动，能够在完全无监督的情形下完成跨卫星辐射计图像的域自适应，并提升下游降水反演等任务的精度。

title: MapLightning: Online Vectorized HD Map Construction with 1D Map Tokens
summary: Online vectorized HD map construction is essential for scaling safe autonomous driving and requires accurate, real-time inference. Prior methods typically rely on dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) grids as the intermediate representation. We propose \textit{MapLightning}, which replaces the dense BEV grid with a compact set of 1D learnable map tokens. To construct map tokens from image features, we choose self-attention over vanilla cross-attention because it enables joint interactions and contextual aggregation among image and map tokens. Our transformer-based mapper concatenates map and image tokens, applies full self-attention, discards the image tokens, and retains the updated map tokens for decoding. This design offers three advantages. First, our representation is efficient, using fewer tokens, consuming less memory, and running faster. Second, the lightweight design allows the map decoder to use full rather than deformable cross-attention for better global context. Third, unlike BEV-based methods, our network does not use camera projection parameters, making it robust to camera-extrinsic perturbations. MapLightning uses up to 16.7$\times$ fewer intermediate tokens than dense BEV-based methods and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on nuScenes and Argoverse~2. Its lightweight variant surpasses MapTRv2 by +10.1 mAP on nuScenes and +16.2 mAP on Argoverse~2, while delivering 1.73$\times$ faster inference (40+ FPS) with 53\% less memory. We further show improvements on uncertainty-aware map construction and downstream trajectory prediction. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: MapLightning用一组紧凑的1D可学习地图token替代密集BEV栅格作为中间表示，通过自注意力实现图像与地图token的联合交互，在nuScenes与Argoverse 2上实现更少token、更快推理与更高精度的在线矢量高精地图构建。
AI.motivation: 在线矢量化高精地图构建对安全自动驾驶的可扩展性至关重要，需要准确且实时的推理。现有方法通常依赖密集BEV栅格作为中间表示，存在token冗余、内存占用大、推理慢的问题，且依赖相机投影参数，对相机外参扰动敏感。
AI.method: 提出MapLightning，以紧凑的1D可学习地图token替代密集BEV栅格。在从图像特征构建地图token时，采用自注意力而非普通交叉注意力，以支持图像与地图token的联合交互与上下文聚合。其Transformer mapper将地图token与图像token拼接后做全自注意力，丢弃图像token并保留更新后的地图token用于解码。该轻量设计使地图解码器可采用全交叉注意力而非可变形交叉注意力以获得更好全局上下文，同时网络不使用相机投影参数。
AI.result: 相比密集BEV方法最多减少16.7倍中间token；在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上取得精度与效率的领先表现。轻量版本相较MapTRv2在nuScenes提升+10.1 mAP、在Argoverse 2提升+16.2 mAP，同时推理速度提升1.73倍（40+ FPS）、内存减少53%。在不确定性感知地图构建与下游轨迹预测任务上也有改进。
AI.conclusion: 以1D地图token替代密集BEV栅格、并用自注意力建模图像与地图token交互，是一种高效且精确的在线矢量高精地图构建方案，同时具备对相机外参扰动的鲁棒性，并可惠及不确定性估计与下游轨迹预测。

title: DecomVoxel: Harnessing 3D-Native Priors with Guided In-situ Denoising Optimization for Decompositional Scene Reconstruction
comment: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 - Journal Track (TOG). Project page: https://decomvoxel.github.io/DecomVoxel-Webpage/
summary: Decompositional scene reconstruction aims to reconstruct high-quality objects and background, yet existing methods still struggle with the level of quality under heavy occlusions. While generative priors offer a potential solution, 2D image-based priors often suffer from multi-view inconsistency due to a lack of 3D awareness. Conversely, 3D-native priors provide stronger structural inductive biases but frequently lead to spatial drift and misalignment within complex scenes. To address these issues, we propose DecomVoxel, formulating object completion as a guided in-situ denoising optimization that bridges 3D-native priors with neural scene reconstruction. Our framework introduces a reformulated epsilon-based distillation loss to ensure stable latent refinement, alongside adaptive spatial guidance that utilizes occupied and vacant anchors with temporal annealing to suppress generative hallucinations and mitigate spatial drift. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ show that DecomVoxel significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while faithfully preserving the original spatial layout, structural fidelity, and style-consistent texture. Our method pushes the boundary of decompositional reconstruction by delivering high-quality textured meshes with clean topology, geometry, and appearance, providing a robust solution for the decompositional reconstruction of complex real-world scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/DecomVoxel/DecomVoxel.

AI.tldr: 提出DecomVoxel，将物体补全建模为引导式原位去噪优化，桥接3D原生先验与神经场景重建，实现重度遮挡下的高质量分解式场景重建。
AI.motivation: 分解式场景重建需重建高质量物体与背景，但现有方法在重度遮挡下质量不足。2D图像先验缺乏3D感知导致多视角不一致；3D原生先验虽具结构归纳偏置，却易在复杂场景中产生空间漂移与错位。
AI.method: 将物体补全表述为引导式原位去噪优化，连接3D原生先验与神经场景重建；引入重表述的基于epsilon的蒸馏损失以稳定隐空间细化；并采用自适应空间引导，利用占用与空置锚点并结合时间退火，抑制生成幻觉与空间漂移。
AI.result: 在Replica和ScanNet++数据集上，DecomVoxel显著优于现有最先进方法，同时忠实保持原始空间布局、结构保真度与风格一致的纹理。
AI.conclusion: 该方法输出具有干净拓扑、几何与外观的高质量带纹理网格，推进了分解式重建边界，为复杂真实场景的分解式重建提供稳健方案。

title: MoLE: Mixture of Latent Experts for Complementary Visual Reasoning
summary: Latent visual reasoning equips vision--language models with continuous intermediate states that can process visual evidence without explicit textual reasoning traces or repeated image operations. However, existing methods often allow multiple latent tokens to access the same visual evidence through shared value projections, providing no mechanism for them to extract complementary visual information; simply increasing the latent budget can therefore yield redundant latent representations. We argue that effective latent reasoning should encourage different latent tokens to extract complementary visual information, and thereby act as specialized visual experts. Based on this insight, we propose MoLE, a Mixture of Latent Experts framework that controls both what visual evidence each latent visual expert observes and how it transforms that evidence. MoLE isolates latent visual experts during evidence extraction and uses dedicated latent summary experts to aggregate the complementary representations of latent visual experts. A two-stage training pipeline first forces visual evidence through this latent pathway and then restores direct visual access, requiring neither predefined expert roles nor intermediate visual targets. Across five visual reasoning benchmarks, MoLE achieves an average score of 78.6, outperforming data-matched supervised fine-tuning by 4.9 and the strongest evaluated latent visual reasoning baseline at the same latent budget by 3.6. Representation analyses show lower latent-state similarity and more diverse visual attention, while masking the latent pathway reduces average performance by 9.2. These results demonstrate that specializing latent computation is more effective than merely increasing the number of latent tokens.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MoLE（潜在专家混合）框架，通过让不同潜在视觉专家提取互补的视觉信息，提升视觉语言模型的潜在视觉推理能力，在五个基准上平均得分78.6，超过数据匹配的监督微调4.9分、最强潜在视觉推理基线3.6分。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在视觉推理方法中，多个潜在token通过共享的值投影访问相同的视觉证据，缺乏提取互补视觉信息的机制，单纯增加潜在token数量会产生冗余的潜在表示。作者认为有效的潜在推理应促使不同潜在token提取互补的视觉信息，从而充当专门的视觉专家。
AI.method: 提出MoLE（Mixture of Latent Experts）框架，同时控制每个潜在视觉专家观察哪些视觉证据以及如何转换这些证据。MoLE在证据提取阶段隔离各个潜在视觉专家，并使用专用的潜在摘要专家来聚合这些视觉专家的互补表示。采用两阶段训练流程：先强制视觉证据通过该潜在通路，再恢复直接视觉访问，无需预定义的专家角色或中间视觉目标。
AI.result: 在五个视觉推理基准上，MoLE平均得分78.6，优于数据匹配的监督微调4.9分，在相同潜在预算下优于最强的潜在视觉推理基线3.6分。表示分析显示潜在状态相似度更低、视觉注意力更多样；遮蔽潜在通路会使平均性能下降9.2。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对潜在计算进行专门化（specialization）比单纯增加潜在token数量更有效。

title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
summary: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.

AI.tldr: PyRUA-Lean 是一个交互式代码执行框架，通过反馈驱动的原语组合与选择性观测，降低 VLM 机器人智能体的 token 开销并提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLM 智能体虽能借助视觉反馈和动作原语控制机器人，但反复调用模型和冗余观测带来巨大的 token 开销。
AI.method: 该框架将经典机器人原语与学习到的 VLA 策略组合为 Python 单元，在其中执行条件判断与局部重试，仅返回显式请求的图像和状态反馈用于重新规划。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0 和 RoboCasa365 的 700 个模拟任务实例上，与使用相同 GPT-6 Astra 规划器和底层原语的工具调用基线相比，相同 LLM 调用预算下整体成功率从 63.1% 提升至 71.7%；在两者均解决的实例上，LLM 调用减少 49%，输入 token 减少 65%。
AI.conclusion: 将反馈驱动的原语组合与选择性观测结合于代码执行框架，可在不增加调用预算的前提下显著提升机器人任务成功率并大幅降低 token 消耗。

title: Latent-Foresight: End-to-End Learning Predictable Representations for Latent World Models
summary: Predicting the future evolution of a scene is a fundamental capability for world modeling. Recent work has shown that operating in the feature space of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) yields semantically rich representations that support diverse future scene understanding tasks. However, existing approaches rely on two-stage pipelines, where VFM features are first compressed using fixed dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA) or independently trained autoencoders, and a separate predictor is trained on top of the resulting frozen latent space. This decoupling between representation learning and temporal prediction, as well as approaches that apply predictors directly on raw VFM features, provides no guarantee that the latent space is structured for predictable dynamics. In this work, we propose Latent-Foresight, an end-to-end framework that jointly learns a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model, explicitly shaping the representation to support temporal predictability. To enable stable joint optimization, we introduce several key design choices that prevent latent collapse and align reconstruction with generative objectives. Extensive experiments show that our approach learns more temporally coherent latent representations and consistently outperforms two-stage baselines across multiple future scene understanding tasks and prediction horizons, while eliminating separate training stages, including during high-resolution adaptation. We provide the implementation code and model weights at https://github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight

AI.tldr: 提出Latent-Foresight端到端框架，联合学习潜在分词器与flow-based生成动力学模型，显式塑造支持时序可预测性的表征，消除两阶段训练，在多个未来场景理解任务上持续超越两阶段基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VFM特征空间的世界建模方法采用两阶段流程（先用固定降维如PCA或独立自编码器压缩，再在冻结潜在空间上训练预测器），表征学习与时序预测解耦，无法保证潜在空间结构化以适应可预测动力学；直接在原始VFM特征上应用预测器同样缺乏此保证。
AI.method: Latent-Foresight为端到端框架，联合学习潜在分词器（latent tokenizer）与基于流的生成式动力学模型（flow-based generative dynamics model），通过专门设计的关键技术选择防止潜在坍塌，并使重建目标与生成目标对齐，从而实现稳定的联合优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法学到更时序一致的潜在表征，在多种未来场景理解任务及不同预测时间跨度上持续优于两阶段基线，同时消除了分离的训练阶段（包括高分辨率适配阶段）。代码与模型权重已开源。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化表征与动力学预测可提升潜在空间的时序可预测性，避免两阶段解耦的局限，为世界建模提供更统一高效的方案。

title: Anti-Persona: Disrupting Unauthorized Identity Binding and Recognition in Personalized Vision--Language Models
summary: Few-shot personalization enables large vision--language models (LVLMs) to learn user-specific visual concepts for applications such as personalized retrieval and subject-aware querying. However, it also creates a privacy risk: an adversary can bind a target identity from a few reference images and subsequently detect that identity in new images through natural-language queries. We introduce Anti-Persona, an image-level defense against unauthorized identity binding and recognition in personalized LVLMs. Our key insight is that identity personalization relies on visual features shared across multiple reference images. We aggregate these features into an identity prototype and optimize visually subtle perturbations that disrupt prototype alignment in the vision-encoder space. Spatial smoothing and low-frequency preservation further promote visual fidelity and practical resilience to image compression. The resulting protection does not depend on a specific prompt and supports both proactive anti-personalization and reactive image protection. Experiments on two representative personalized LVLMs demonstrate protection rates of up to $95.0\%$ while preserving visual fidelity. The method remains stable across prompt variations and evaluated identity-query tasks, and improves black-box transfer under encoder mismatch.

AI.tldr: 提出 Anti-Persona，一种图像级防御方法，通过扰动视觉编码器特征以破坏身份原型对齐，防止个性化 LVLM 被用于未授权身份绑定与识别，保护率最高达 95.0% 且保持视觉保真度。
AI.motivation: 少样本个性化使大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）能学习用户特定的视觉概念，但带来隐私风险：攻击者可用少量参考图像绑定目标身份，并通过自然语言查询在新图像中检测该身份。现有工作缺乏针对个性化 LVLM 中未授权身份绑定与识别的图像级防御。
AI.method: 核心洞察是身份个性化依赖多张参考图像共享的视觉特征。方法将这些特征聚合为身份原型，在视觉编码器空间中优化视觉上微弱的扰动，破坏原型对齐；并引入空间平滑与低频保持以提升视觉保真度和对图像压缩的鲁棒性。该保护与具体提示无关，同时支持主动反个性化与被动图像保护两种模式。
AI.result: 在两个代表性个性化 LVLM 上，保护率最高达 95.0%，同时保持视觉保真度；方法在提示变化和所评估的身份查询任务上表现稳定，并在编码器不匹配情况下提升黑盒迁移性。
AI.conclusion: Anti-Persona 通过扰乱身份原型特征对齐，有效防御个性化 LVLM 的未授权身份绑定与识别，兼具高保护率、视觉保真度与跨提示、跨任务稳定性，为个性化视觉-语言应用提供实用隐私保护方案。

title: EndoLive: Real-Time Style Transfer for Endoscopic Endonasal Skull Base Surgical Video
summary: Complex surgical procedures around critical anatomy, such as the endoscopic endonasal skull base surgery, requires significant practice and training on the part of the surgeon before they are allowed to perform the operation on a live patient. This training in typically done in cadaveric specimens, due to them containing the same critical structures as a living human. However, cadavers are not a perfect 1-to-1 substitute for a living patient. The dead and preserved tissues of a cadaver are colored completely differently than a living human, and -- without complex and expensive pumping systems -- do not bleed in the same way. As a result, identifying the critical pieces of anatomy that make this procedure so complex can be quite different in a live case than in a surgeon's cadaveric practice. This paper presents EndoLive, a framework for real-time style transfer between cadaveric endoscopic video and living human endoscopic video. Our method combines the ConStructS GAN model for realistic style transfer for surgical applications, with the HyPER-GAN model that can learn complex translations and perform them in real-time. We train EndoLive on unpaired cadaveric and live images taken from an endoscope, and test the trained model with cadaveric video, on a variety of devices. Experimental results demonstrate that EndoLive can perform cadaveric-to-live translation at speeds well above the minimum necessary for real-time, while maintaining semantic consistency of critical anatomical structures. Our source code is available at https://github.com/griffhurt/endolive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EndoLive 框架，实现尸体内镜视频与活体内镜视频之间的实时风格迁移，帮助外科医生在尸体训练中更接近真实手术视觉条件。
AI.motivation: 内镜颅底手术等复杂手术需要在尸体上进行训练，但尸体组织经固定保存后颜色与活体差异显著，且无法自然出血，导致解剖结构辨识体验与活体手术不同，训练效果受限。
AI.method: EndoLive 结合 ConStructS GAN（面向手术场景的逼真风格迁移）与 HyPER-GAN（学习复杂翻译并实时执行），在非配对的尸体内镜图像与活体内镜图像上训练，并用尸体内镜视频在多种设备上测试。
AI.result: EndoLive 能以远高于实时最低要求的速率完成尸体到活体的翻译，同时保持关键解剖结构的语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可为尸体训练提供接近活体视觉的实时视频转换，提升手术训练的解剖辨识真实性，代码已开源。

title: RASteer: Retain-Aware Activation Steering for Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
summary: Concept erasure aims to remove a target concept, such as a copyrighted style, a recognizable character, or unsafe content, from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model while preserving its ability to generate other content. Existing activation steering methods build an erasure direction mainly from the target concept and adjust model activations along it at inference time. However, target and retained concepts often overlap in the model's representation space, so this direction also contains shared components that retained concepts rely on. Steering directly along this direction can therefore suppress retained concepts and harm the generation of non-target content. To address this issue, we propose Retain-aware Activation Steering (RASteer), a training-free method. RASteer first builds a retain subspace from the concepts to preserve. Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) then removes components aligned with this subspace from the erasure direction, making steering more specific to the target. Since fully removing the shared components can weaken erasure, we further introduce Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC). At each layer and denoising step, OAC uses the overlap between the erasure direction and the retain subspace to control how much of each shared component is removed, balancing target erasure and concept preservation. Experiments on unsafe-content, instance, and artistic-style erasure across multiple backbones and benchmarks show that RASteer matches or outperforms the activation steering and weight editing baselines we evaluate, achieving a better balance between erasure and preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的概念擦除方法 RASteer，通过保留子空间正交化与重叠自适应校准，在擦除目标概念的同时更好保留非目标概念。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法仅依据目标概念构建擦除方向，但目标概念与保留概念在表示空间中存在重叠，该方向含有保留概念所依赖的共享成分，直接沿其引导会抑制保留概念、损害非目标内容生成。
AI.method: RASteer 为免训练方法：先由待保留概念构建保留子空间；再用 Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) 从擦除方向中去除与保留子空间对齐的成分，提高擦除特异性；并引入 Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC)，在每层与每个去噪步依据擦除方向与保留子空间的重叠程度，控制共享成分的去除比例，平衡擦除与保留。
AI.result: 在不安全内容、实例与艺术风格擦除任务上，跨多个骨干网络与基准，RASteer 达到或超过所对比的激活引导与权重编辑基线，在擦除与保留之间取得更优平衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过在擦除方向中剔除并自适应校准与保留概念共享的成分，可在免训练条件下实现更具特异性的概念擦除，兼顾目标擦除效果与非目标概念的生成能力。

title: Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for video generation usually assigns one scalar reward to an entire sampled video.
