summary: Models specialized for the same task converge to similar behavior, yet the parameter updates that produce it share no common coordinate system, so weight-space task arithmetic stays confined to a single model and cannot cross architectures without a structural correspondence. Drawing on Plato's allegory of the cave, we hypothesize that these model-specific updates are shadows of one shared, model-agnostic object, which we call the platonic task vector. To make it operational for models that pair an image or audio encoder with a text encoder, we introduce Universal Task Descriptors: matrices whose shape is independent of architecture and embedding dimension, which record a task's functional effect and support addition and negation as matrix operations. Transferring a descriptor into a target means editing the target until it reproduces the descriptor on the task's unlabeled probe images and class-name prompts, requiring no per-image labels. We realize this edit in two ways. First, the descriptor factorizes into a shift field on image embeddings, so a single least-squares solve yields a linear operator that folds into the target's last layer as a weight edit; by linearity, a bank of such operators admits any composition at any strength as a signed sum. Second, a low-rank adapter trained on the same objective reaches every layer and fits compositions jointly, at the cost of one optimization per edit. Heterogeneous models share this object only partially, with a model-specific residual comparable in norm to the shared component, yet cross-model transfer still retains 74-80 percent of the gain of the target's own descriptors. Experiments across six model families, eight classification tasks, and an audio-text setting show that task knowledge transfers and composes across heterogeneous models under both realizations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"柏拉图任务向量"假说，认为不同模型为同一任务学到的更新是同一模型无关对象的"影子"，并引入通用任务描述符（UTD）实现跨架构的任务知识迁移与组合。
AI.motivation: 专为同一任务训练的模型虽收敛到相似行为，但其参数更新不共享坐标系，导致权重空间的任务算术局限于单一模型、无法跨架构迁移。作者受柏拉图洞穴寓言启发，假设这些模型特定的更新是某个共享的、模型无关对象的投影（影子）。
AI.method: 作者提出通用任务描述符（UTD）：形状与架构和嵌入维度无关的矩阵，记录任务的功能效果，并支持矩阵加法与取负。迁移时，用无标签探针图像和类名提示编辑目标模型以复现该描述符。实现分两种：(1) 将描述符分解为图像嵌入上的位移场，用单次最小二乘求解得到线性算子，折入目标末层作为权重编辑，按线性性可将一组算子以带符号求和实现任意强度组合；(2) 在相同目标上训练低秩适配器，可触达所有层并联合拟合组合，代价是每次编辑需一次优化。
AI.result: 异构模型仅部分共享该对象，模型特定残差的范数与共享分量相当，但跨模型迁移仍保留了目标自身描述符增益的74–80%。在六个模型族、八个分类任务及一个音频-文本设置上，任务知识在两种实现下均可跨异构模型迁移与组合。
AI.conclusion: 任务知识可以被抽象为架构无关的描述符，并在异构模型之间实现迁移与组合，支持"柏拉图任务向量"作为共享功能的可操作近似。

title: Dataset Identity, Not Novelty: The Source of an Inflated OOD Detection Gain
summary: A post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detector reads the activations of a trained classifier and returns a score. It fits that score on in-distribution data, and the benchmarks that evaluate it supply a second piece of OOD data for the fitting itself. Some detectors tune a constant on it. Others fit a direction in feature space or train a flexible combiner and report the number that it reaches as the gain that is still available. Every such fit is validated on held-out samples of the same OOD dataset. That check rules out memorizing individual images. It says nothing about a fit that has instead learned which dataset it is looking at, and a direction that recognizes one OOD dataset rather than novelty passes it perfectly. The detector that a practitioner installs meets OOD data from a source that nobody fitted it on, so the difference decides what the reported number is worth. We measure it by holding out the whole OOD dataset rather than a sample of it, and we call that gap the inflation. We read it across a range of combiners on ImageNet and CIFAR-100 backbones. Most of the gain that the usual protocol reports turns out to be dataset identity rather than novelty. The size of the fit does not move what survives, so the effect is not ordinary overfitting. The share depends instead on whether the input exposes class identity, and two controls that vary that property alone separate the inflation on every backbone of both benchmarks. A closed form accounts for the effect and computes it from the fitting rows, so a practitioner can tell which fits will inflate without running the hold-out protocol. One of these fits survives, namely the single constant that the field already picks on a designated validation dataset. Anything above it reports a gain that the hold-out protocol does not return, and on one benchmark what survives falls while what is reported climbs.

AI.tldr: 后验OOD检测器的拟合步骤会学习"OOD数据集身份"而非"新颖性"，导致标准held-out协议报告的增益被系统性高估；作者将整份OOD数据集留出，测得该差距为"膨胀(inflation)"，并给出可从事先拟合行计算该效应的闭式解。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测基准在拟合检测器时提供了第二份OOD数据，并在同一OOD数据集的留出样本上验证拟合。这种验证只能排除"记忆单张图像"，却无法排除"学会识别是哪一个OOD数据集"。实际部署时检测器面对的是从未被拟合过的OOD来源，因此需要量化报告增益中有多少来自数据集身份而非新颖性。
AI.method: 将留出单位从"OOD数据集的样本"改为"整个OOD数据集"，以此测得标准协议与真实迁移之间的差距（inflation）。在ImageNet与CIFAR-100骨干网络上，对多种combiner（常数、特征空间方向、灵活组合器）测量该膨胀；用仅改变输入是否暴露类别身份的两个控制实验进行分离；并推导出可从拟合行直接计算的闭式表达式。
AI.result: 标准协议报告的增益大部分来自数据集身份而非新颖性；膨胀大小不随拟合规模变化，故非普通过拟合；其份额取决于输入是否暴露类别身份，两个控制实验在两个基准的所有骨干上都能分离该效应；闭式解可预测哪些拟合会膨胀，无需运行held-out协议。唯一存活的拟合是领域已在指定验证集上选取的单一常数，其他任何更复杂的拟合所报告的增益都得不到留出协议的支持，且在某一基准上出现"存活部分下降而报告值上升"的现象。
AI.conclusion: OOD检测器评估应留出整个OOD数据集而非其样本；除领域惯用的单一常数外，超出该常数的一切增益均为数据集身份导致的膨胀，不能代表对未知来源新颖性的真实检测能力。

title: AiSearch: Interactive Multi-Modal Search with VLMs
comment: The demo paper with 1 page main paper, 7 pages supplementary material accepted and presented in ECCV 2026
summary: Modern retrieval systems must both be automated and interactive, allowing users to search and refine results in real time. We present AiSearch, a flexible multimodal retrieval framework that leverages the zero shot capabilities of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for natural language search over images and videos. AiSearch supports interactive search refinement through user feedback to tailor results to the user's intent, and allows visual benchmarking across multiple VLMs, enabling users to select the most suitable model for their task.

AI.tldr: AiSearch 是一个利用视觉语言模型零样本能力的多模态检索框架，支持图像和视频的自然语言搜索、基于用户反馈的交互式精化以及多模型可视化基准对比。
AI.motivation: 现代检索系统需同时满足自动化与交互性，让用户能实时搜索并精化结果；现有系统在多模态（图像/视频）自然语言检索以及模型可选择性方面仍存在不足。
AI.method: 构建 AiSearch 框架，借助视觉语言模型（VLM）的零样本能力实现图像与视频的自然语言检索；通过用户反馈支持交互式搜索精化，并提供跨多个 VLM 的视觉化基准测试，以供用户挑选最适配任务的模型。
AI.result: 实现了支持自然语言图像/视频搜索、交互式结果精化及多 VLM 可视化基准对比的功能框架（摘要未给出量化评测结果）。
AI.conclusion: AiSearch 为多模态检索提供了一套灵活方案，兼顾自动化、交互性与模型可选择性，可帮助用户按任务需求选择最合适的 VLM。

title: Towards Reliable Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language models (VLMs) are increasingly being explored in autonomous driving for tasks such as scene understanding, driving reasoning, decision-making, and end-to-end driving. As their role becomes more prominent, ensuring their robustness and reliability is increasingly important. In real-world conditions, visual inputs may be degraded by sensor imperfections and environmental conditions, potentially affecting both model predictions and their associated confidence. Such degradation is especially concerning in autonomous driving, where safety-critical decisions require models to make accurate predictions and recognize when their predictions may be unreliable. In this work, we evaluate five VLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, LLaVA-OneVision-7B, DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B, and NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B) across four driving-related QA datasets with different visual input settings, including single-frame, multi-view, multi-frame, and monocular inputs. Our results show that the effects of visual corruption vary across models, datasets, and input settings, with changes in accuracy and confidence reliability and also differing across conditions. We then apply Visual Evidence Augmentation ($\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$), a recent inference-time method to examine whether it can improve model reliability under degraded visual conditions. We find that $\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$ improves performance for some models and datasets, although the gains are not consistent across all settings.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了五种视觉语言模型（VLMs）在四种驾驶相关问答数据集及不同视觉输入设置下对视觉退化的鲁棒性与置信度可靠性，并检验了推理时方法视觉证据增强（VEA）能否改善退化条件下的模型可靠性。
AI.motivation: VLMs在自动驾驶中承担场景理解、驾驶推理、决策与端到端驾驶等任务，其鲁棒性与可靠性日益重要。真实条件下视觉输入可能因传感器缺陷和环境因素而退化，既影响模型预测，也影响其置信度。在自动驾驶这类安全关键场景中，模型不仅要预测准确，还需识别自身预测何时不可靠，因此有必要系统评估视觉退化对VLM的影响。
AI.method: 选取五个VLM（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-E4B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B、DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B、NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B），在四个驾驶相关QA数据集上进行评估，覆盖单帧、多视角、多帧和单目四类视觉输入设置；随后将推理时方法视觉证据增强（VEA）应用于退化视觉条件，考察其能否提升模型可靠性。
AI.result: 视觉损坏的影响因模型、数据集和输入设置而异；准确率与置信度可靠性的变化在不同条件下也表现出差异。VEA对部分模型和数据集有性能提升，但增益并非在所有设置下都一致。
AI.conclusion: 视觉退化对VLM在自动驾驶中的预测与置信度可靠性影响具有条件依赖性，尚无普遍适用的改善手段；VEA可作为部分场景下的推理时缓解方法，但其效果有限且不稳定。

title: Two Routes to the Middle: Placement Search and Brain Readouts Converge on Where Continual Learners Should Specialize
summary: Continual learners that keep a task-specific adapter in every block of a pre-trained vision transformer accumulate storage linearly with the number of tasks; keeping task-specific adapters in only a few blocks curbs this growth but raises the question of where to place them. We investigate this question from two perspectives. Algorithmically, training all contiguous four-block placements yields an inverted U: final accuracy peaks at intermediate depth and varies by up to 3.5 percentage points (pp), while inexpensive criteria based on weight spectra or activation statistics favor the deepest blocks. From neuroscience, the hierarchical organization and intermediate-stage plasticity of the visual cortex motivate us to ask whether a measurement taken outside the learner can guide layer specialization without placement search. LS-B observes the first tasks through a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas and commits task-specific capacity once to the blocks whose readouts vary most across tasks relative to their stable structure. Across three ViT-B/16 backbones, LS-B yields stable, backbone-specific allocations. On the two backbones with placement search, AugReg and iBOT, the selected blocks overlap the intermediate-depth region identified by search. Under matched storage and observation budgets, the selected blocks outperform the shallowest and deepest four-block configurations. On Split ImageNet-R, LS-B uses 60% of full-BiLoRA adapter storage while remaining within 1.5 pp of its final accuracy. The allocation requires no labels or backpropagation, adds under 0.6% runtime, and exhibits backbone-specific cortical signatures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LS-B方法：利用冻结的fMRI编码模型观测首批任务，将任务特定容量一次性分配到跨任务读数变化最大、结构最稳定的视觉皮层对应区块，无需标签、反向传播或放置搜索，即可以60%存储接近全量适配器精度。
AI.motivation: 持续学习者在预训练ViT每个区块放置任务特定适配器会导致存储随任务数线性增长；仅在少数区块放置可抑制增长，但"放在哪里"缺乏原则性指导。作者希望寻找一种无需放置搜索、由学习者外部测量引导层专门化的方法，并从视觉皮层的层级组织与中间阶段可塑性中获得启发。
AI.method: 算法角度：训练所有连续四区块放置，观察精度随深度的变化；并测试基于权重谱或激活统计的低成本准则。神经科学角度：提出LS-B，用冻结的fMRI编码模型（12个人类视觉区）观测首批任务，将任务特定容量一次性分配给跨任务读数变化最大、同时保持稳定结构的区块；无需标签与反向传播。
AI.result: 连续四区块放置的最终精度呈倒U形，峰值出现在中间深度，波动达3.5个百分点；低成本准则偏好最深区块。LS-B在三个ViT-B/16骨干上产生稳定且骨干特定的分配；在AugReg与iBOT上所选区块与搜索得到的中深度区域重叠，在同等存储与观测预算下优于最浅与最深四区块配置；Split ImageNet-R上使用60%的全量BiLoRA适配器存储，最终精度差距在1.5pp内；额外运行时开销低于0.6%，并呈现骨干特定的皮层特征。
AI.conclusion: 适配器放置位置对持续学习性能有实质影响且存在中深度最优区间；基于外部fMRI编码模型的任务相关读数可作为层专门化代理，实现无需标签、无需反向传播、无需放置搜索的高效容量分配，在存储与精度间取得良好折中。

title: CoEvolve: Construct-to-Edit Visual Grounding with Bidirectional State Refinement
summary: Visual grounding localizes an object described by language with a bounding box. Most multimodal grounding models compress target identification, spatial reasoning, and boundary estimation into one terminal prediction. Free-form rationales make reasoning linguistically explicit but do not necessarily expose measurable, editable spatial states. Intermediate localization errors are therefore difficult to diagnose and correct, allowing incorrect region choices and imprecise boundaries to persist in the final box. We introduce CoEvolve, a construct-to-edit framework that separates grounding into explicit state construction and state editing. Region-Evolution Reinforcement (RER) organizes grounding analysis into a progressive semantic--spatial trajectory, with each reasoning step committing to an explicit candidate region. Bidirectional Denoising Refiner (BDR) treats the reasoning text as fixed semantic context and refines the trajectory's coordinate fields through bidirectional same-position reconstruction. Geometry- and behavior-level objectives provide target geometry and edit-preference signals for consolidating reliable candidates, preserving accurate inputs, or correcting toward annotations. Evaluations cover natural-image and remote-sensing grounding. With a 9B backbone, CoEvolve rivals models up to 241B parameters in grounding accuracy. Under controlled corruption, a single BDR pass improves mean box overlap by over 27 percentage points, demonstrating strong recovery from substantial localization errors. State-source comparisons further support the complementarity of explicit state construction and source-matched editing. The project is at https://sundongwei.github.io/CoEvolve_Project/.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoEvolve 框架，将视觉定位拆解为显式状态构建与状态编辑两个阶段，通过区域演化强化与双向去噪精修实现可诊断、可纠正的定位过程。
AI.motivation: 现有大多数多模态定位模型将目标识别、空间推理与边界估计压缩为一次性终端预测。自由形式的推理文本虽使推理在语言上显式，但未必暴露可量化、可编辑的空间状态，导致中间定位错误难以诊断与纠正，错误区域选择与不精确边界会保留在最终框中。
AI.method: CoEvolve 为 construct-to-edit 框架：Region-Evolution Reinforcement（RER）将定位分析组织为渐进式语义—空间轨迹，每个推理步骤承诺一个显式候选区域；Bidirectional Denoising Refiner（BDR）将推理文本视为固定语义上下文，通过双向同位重建精修轨迹的坐标字段；此外引入几何级与行为级目标，提供目标几何与编辑偏好信号，用于巩固可靠候选、保留准确输入或向标注纠正。
AI.result: 评测覆盖自然图像与遥感定位。以 9B 骨干，CoEvolve 的定位精度可媲美参数量高达 241B 的模型；在受控破坏条件下，单次 BDR 传递使平均框重叠率提升超过 27 个百分点，显示对显著定位错误的强恢复能力；状态来源对比进一步支持显式状态构建与来源匹配编辑的互补性。
AI.conclusion: 显式空间状态构建与来源匹配的编辑机制相结合，可有效诊断并纠正中间定位错误，在较小参数量下取得强定位性能，且具备良好的错误恢复能力，为视觉定位提供了可编辑、可解释的新范式。

title: VideoEvolve: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Video temporal grounding aims to localize events in videos from natural-language queries. For agents built around frozen video-language models, the harness determines how queries guide temporal predictions and how those predictions are refined. Manually refining these harnesses requires diagnosing grounding failures and coordinating changes to both agent workflows and instructions. We introduce VideoEvolve, a framework that automatically evolves agent harnesses for video temporal grounding. VideoEvolve uses a Cloze-Structured Harness Representation that preserves stage interfaces while leaving agent workflows and instructions open to evolution. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution preserves promising code branches for continued refinement, using execution feedback to guide local edits and validation to determine which improvements are carried forward. Experiments demonstrate improved grounding performance across multiple benchmarks. Component analyses identify instruction refinement as a consistent source of gains, while the benefits of evolved code vary across evaluation settings. Together, these results support automated harness evolution as an effective approach to improving video temporal grounding. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/VideoEvolve .

AI.tldr: VideoEvolve是一个自动演化智能体harness的框架，用于视频时序定位，通过Cloze结构化harness表示与分支引导演化提升定位性能。
AI.motivation: 围绕冻结视频-语言模型构建的智能体，其harness决定查询如何引导时序预测及预测如何被精化；人工精化harness需要诊断定位失败并协调修改工作流与指令，成本高且困难。
AI.method: 提出VideoEvolve框架：采用Cloze-Structured Harness Representation，在保留各阶段接口的同时让智能体工作流与指令开放演化；采用Branch-Guided Harness Evolution，保留有前景的代码分支继续精化，利用执行反馈指导局部编辑，并通过验证决定哪些改进被保留。
AI.result: 在多个基准上取得定位性能提升。组件分析表明指令精化是稳定一致的增益来源，而演化代码带来的收益随评测设置而变化。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持自动harness演化作

title: SIEVE: Selective attention-value Suppression for Vision-Language Models Unlearning
summary: The ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to associate visual identities with biographical information creates a need for selective unlearning of personally identifiable information (PII) while preserving permitted knowledge about the same individual. This setting is challenging because both sensitive and retained information can share the same visual inputs and intermediate representations. We introduce SIEVE, a simple and effective framework for selective VLM unlearning. SIEVE directly regularizes attention-value representations while also controlling model outputs. SIEVE suppresses attention values for forget examples toward a constant zero, while preserving retain-example representations by matching them to a frozen reference model. These objectives are combined with sequence-level forget and retain supervision, enabling targeted forgetting without largely affecting retained knowledge. Extensive experiments show that SIEVE achieves state-of-the-art performance on unlearning with multiple model-modality settings, while maintaining competitive retained utility. Ablation studies further show that value suppression and negative cross-entropy contribute complementary forgetting signals, while reference-based value matching substantially reduces utility degradation. These results demonstrate that attention values provide an effective intervention point for selective multimodal unlearning when sensitive and retained knowledge are closely related.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SIEVE框架，用于视觉语言模型（VLM）的选择性遗忘，在去除个人可识别信息（PII）的同时保留对同一人物的许可知识。
AI.motivation: VLM能将视觉身份与传记信息关联，因此需要在保护PII的同时保留许可知识。难点在于敏感信息与保留信息可能共享相同的视觉输入和中间表示，导致难以区分处理。
AI.method: SIEVE直接正则化注意力值（attention-value）表示并控制模型输出：将遗忘样本的注意力值抑制至常数零，同时通过匹配冻结的参考模型来保持保留样本的表示；再结合序列级的遗忘与保留监督。
AI.result: 在多种模型-模态设置下，SIEVE在遗忘任务上达到state-of-the-art，同时保持有竞争力的保留效用。消融实验显示，值抑制与负交叉熵提供互补的遗忘信号，而基于参考的值匹配显著减少效用退化。
AI.conclusion: 注意力值是选择性多模态遗忘的有效干预点，尤其适用于敏感知识与保留知识密切相关的场景。

title: Controllable Multi-label Video Safety Detection via Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization
summary: The rapid growth of video-based social media has increased users' exposure to harmful content, creating a need for reliable automated video safety detection. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show strong video understanding capabilities, existing harmful video detection systems face two key limitations: they typically reduce safety detection to binary classification, overlooking the inherently multi-label nature of unsafe videos, and they rely on static training objectives that do not support controllable precision-recall trade-offs, though the desired operating point may vary across moderation pipelines and unsafe categories. To address these gaps, we propose Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization (ATPO), a reinforcement learning framework for Multi-label Video Safety Detection (Multi-VSD). ATPO introduces the Adaptive Tversky Reward (ATR), which dynamically adjusts false-positive and false-negative penalties during training to enable controllable precision-recall trade-offs. Experiments on SafeWatch-Bench and XD-Violence show that ATPO substantially improves multi-label performance, increasing the Jaccard Index from 40.66 to 75.44 on SafeWatch-Bench-Real. Moreover, ATR enables reliable steering of the precision-recall operating point, supporting deployment scenarios with heterogeneous policy requirements. Code and checkpoints are provided at https://bruceyg.github.io/ATPO-project-page/ .

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应Tversky策略优化（ATPO），一个面向多标签视频安全检测（Multi-VSD）的强化学习框架，通过自适应Tversky奖励（ATR）动态调整假阳性/假阴性惩罚，实现可控的精确率-召回率权衡。
AI.motivation: 视频社交媒体的快速增长使用户暴露于有害内容的风险增加，亟需可靠的自动化视频安全检测。现有VLM视频检测系统存在两个关键局限：一是将安全检测简化为二分类，忽视了不安全视频固有的多标签特性；二是依赖静态训练目标，无法支持可控的精确率-召回率权衡，而不同审核流程和不安全类别所需的操作点各异。
AI.method: 提出自适应Tversky策略优化（ATPO），一个用于多标签视频安全检测（Multi-VSD）的强化学习框架。其核心是自适应Tversky奖励（ATR），在训练过程中动态调整假阳性与假阴性的惩罚权重，从而实现可控的精确率-召回率权衡。
AI.result: 在SafeWatch-Bench和XD-Violence数据集上，ATPO显著提升多标签性能，在SafeWatch-Bench-Real上将Jaccard Index从40.66提升至75.44。同时ATR能够可靠地调控精确率-召回率操作点，支持异构策略需求的部署场景。代码与检查点已公开。
AI.conclusion: ATPO有效解决了多标签视频安全检测中的多标签建模与可控精度-召回权衡问题，兼顾检测性能提升与部署灵活性，具有实际应用价值。

title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
comment: Tech report. An early version of this manuscript was in a blogpost published in Aug 5, 2026: https://vista-research.github.io/
summary: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA's simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA's potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VISTA——一种视觉框架（harness），赋予通用多模态模型长时程视觉能力，通过无损视觉记忆与主动检索重排视觉输入，显著提升复杂交互环境中的推理表现。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型本身具备较强推理能力，但缺乏合适的框架来释放其在多样交互环境中的潜力，尤其在需要长时程视觉感知与记忆的任务中受限。
AI.method: VISTA让模型直接以视觉观察感知环境，并维护无损视觉记忆，保留历史观察的原始形式；模型可在推理过程中主动检索这些观察并重新组织视觉输入。该设计简洁，可低适配成本迁移到多种视觉环境。
AI.result: 在ARC-AGI-3上，VISTA将Claude Opus 5.0的相对人类动作效率分数从40.68提升至满分100.00，并完成全部25个公开游戏，所用动作比首次参与的人类少57.4%。在覆盖多样视觉游戏与谜题的另外三个基准上，VISTA也大幅超越使用同一底层模型配合极简框架的基线。
AI.conclusion: VISTA有望成为通用视觉框架，推动多模态智能体在复杂视觉环境中的能力提升。

title: High-Value Synthetic Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of a Compact Japanese Speech Model
comment: Submitted to On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (NeurIPS 2026 workshop). 4 pages, 0 figures, 1 table
summary: Private domain speech is difficult to collect and redistribute, while compact models need task-specific supervision. We study an auditable synthetic pipeline that maps Japanese care handoffs directly to six-field structured notes. Using 182 synthetic training and development clips, we adapt a 1.47B audio model by full fine-tuning and rank-16 LoRA. On a 39-clip scenario-seed-disjoint synthetic test, an unadapted model obtains a model-judged factuality-recall score of 0.0500, full tuning 0.8664, and LoRA 0.8461. LoRA reaches 97.7% of the full-tuning aggregate as a descriptive ratio while project telemetry reports 12.4M trainable parameters, about 0.85% of the backbone. Both adaptations show large paired gains over the same base; the full-versus-LoRA interval crosses zero, and differing optimization settings preclude an equivalence claim. This is a parameter-efficient capability-acquisition result, not a device-performance result: latency, memory, energy, and real-time factor were not measured. All evaluation speech and targets are synthetic, references are model-proposed, and the judge is uncalibrated. The evidence shows that a compact model can acquire a narrow audio-to-structure transformation from a few hundred provenance-linked synthetic examples; it does not establish clinical validity, real-speech transfer, or superiority to a clean cloud system.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了可审计的合成流水线，将日语护理交接语音映射为六字段结构化笔记；用182段合成数据对1.47B音频模型进行全量微调与rank-16 LoRA适配，在39段留出测试上LoRA达到全量微调聚合得分的97.7%，可训练参数仅约0.85%，表明紧凑模型可凭少量合成样本习得窄域语音到结构转换能力。
AI.motivation: 私域语音难以采集与再分发，而紧凑模型又需要任务特定监督，因此需要可审计的合成数据与参数高效适配路径，以在无法使用真实语音与云端大系统的前提下获得窄域音频到结构化笔记的能力。
AI.method: 构建合成流水线，将日语护理交接直接映射为六字段结构化笔记；使用182段合成训练与开发片段，对1.47B音频模型分别做全量微调与rank-16 LoRA适配；在39段场景种子不相交的合成测试集上，以模型评判的事实性召回得分进行评估，并对比未适配基线。
AI.result: 未适配模型得分为0.0500，全量微调为0.8664，LoRA为0.8461；LoRA以描述性比例计达到全量微调聚合得分的97.7%，可训练参数为12.4M，约占主干0.85%；两种适配相对同一基线均有大幅配对增益；全量与LoRA的置信区间跨零，且优化设置不同，故不能声称二者等价。
AI.conclusion: 这是一个参数高效的能力获取结果，而非设备性能结果：延迟、内存、能耗与实时因子均未测量；全部评估语音与目标为合成数据，参考由模型提出，评判器未校准。证据仅表明紧凑模型可从数百条带来源链的合成样本中习得窄域音频到结构转换，尚不能确立临床有效性、真实语音迁移性或对干净云系统的优越性。

title: How Robust Are Neural Audio Codecs for African Speech? A Multi-Task Benchmark and the Limits of Perceptual Quality
comment: Accepted to IEEE Speech Language Technology
summary: Neural audio codecs enable low-bitrate speech compression and tokenization, yet their robustness on accented and multilingual speech remains under-evaluated. We benchmark seven open-source neural codecs (DAC, EnCodec, FocalCodec, LanguageCodec, SemantiCodec, UniCodec, WavTokenizer) on three African speech datasets afrinames, afrispeech dialog, afrispeech multilingual, reporting signal-level quality (NISQA, UTMOS, ViSQOL, STOI, F0-RMSE) alongside two downstream tasks: automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speaker verification (ASV). Our analysis yields four findings. First, signal metrics differ sharply in downstream validity: reference-based structural/intelligibility measures (ViSQOL, STOI) and prosodic error (F0-RMSE) track ASR and ASV degradation far more reliably than neural mean-opinion-score predictors (NISQA, UTMOS). Second, intelligibility and speaker-identity preservation diverge sharply across architectures, and the apparent identity ranking itself depends on the ASV backend. Third, degradation is strongly domain-dependent and largest for conversational dialog. Fourth, the resulting degradation is partly recoverable: parameter-efficient \emph{codec} adaptation (LoRA, $\sim$1--3\% of parameters) on roughly 35 hours of African speech reduces the compression-induced word-error-rate gap, recovering recognition toward the uncompressed baseline (developed in companion work). These results motivate task-aware, domain-representative, and adaptation-aware evaluation of speech codecs as a prerequisite for inclusive deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文在三个非洲语音数据集上对七种开源神经音频编解码器进行基准评测，比较信号级指标与ASR、ASV下游任务，并提出基于LoRA的编解码器适配以缓解压缩带来的性能损失。
AI.motivation: 神经音频编解码器虽已实现低码率语音压缩与离散化，但其在带口音及多语言语音上的鲁棒性缺乏评估，限制了包容性部署。
AI.method: 在afrinames、afrispeech dialog、afrispeech multilingual三个非洲语音数据集上评测DAC、EnCodec、FocalCodec、LanguageCodec、SemantiCodec、UniCodec、WavTokenizer七种开源编解码器，报告NISQA、UTMOS、ViSQOL、STOI、F0-RMSE等信号级指标，并评估ASR与ASV两个下游任务；进一步采用LoRA（约1–3%参数）在约35小时非洲语音上做参数高效适配。
AI.result: 信号指标的下游有效性差异显著：ViSQOL、STOI等参考型结构/可懂度指标与F0-RMSE比NISQA、UTMOS等神经MOS预测器更能反映ASR与ASV退化；可懂度与说话人身份保持能力在不同架构间差异明显，身份排序还依赖ASV后端；退化呈强域依赖性，对话式语音最严重；LoRA适配可缩小压缩导致的词错误率差距，使识别性能向未压缩基线恢复。
AI.conclusion: 应推动面向任务、具域代表性且考虑适配的语音编解码器评测，将其作为包容性部署的前提。

title: ProxyMOS: Label-Free Speech Quality Assessment by Multi-Teacher Distillation with Adaptive Routing
comment: Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027. 5 pages + 7 pages supplementary material. Model: https://huggingface.co/lab260/ProxyMos, benchmark: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lab260/mos260, code: https://github.com/lab260ru/ProxyMOS
summary: Human mean opinion scores (MOS) are costly to collect, and non-intrusive MOS predictors degrade sharply outside their training domain. ProxyMOS turns a pool of public MOS predictors into a single stronger model without new human labels. Eight predictors are benchmarked against human ratings; the five most informative enter a subset search under uniform, correlation-weighted, error-weighted, MSE-optimised and adaptive per-utterance routing; and the best routed four-model ensemble labels 807k unlabeled utterances that train a wav2vec 2.0 student. On URGENT the student reaches Spearman $ρ=0.802$ against $0.773$ for the best teacher. On mos260, a new Russian TTS benchmark of 4,600 utterances from 38 synthesis conditions, it reaches $ρ=0.636$ against $0.613$ per utterance and $0.95$ per condition, matching its own routed ensemble in one forward pass. Adaptive routing is the only rule that does not degrade when weak predictors are added. Model, ONNX exports and mos260 are released. It's about 950 characters; arXiv's limit is 1,920. I kept $ρ$ because arXiv renders it on the abstract page. If you'd rather avoid math, replace $ρ=0.802$ with rho = 0.802 and do the same for the other $...$ values.

AI.tldr: ProxyMOS 将公开 MOS 预测器集成为单一更强模型，无需新人工标注：筛选8个预测器中最具信息量的5个做子集搜索（含自适应逐句路由），用最优四模型集成标注80.7万条无标签语音训练 wav2vec 2.0 学生模型，在 URGENT 与新建俄语 TTS 基准 mos260 上均超过最强教师。
AI.motivation: 人工 MOS 采集成本高昂，且非侵入式 MOS 预测器在训练域外性能急剧下降；本文旨在不新增人工标签的前提下，把已有公开 MOS 预测器池转化为单一更强模型。
AI.method: 对8个预测器与人工评分做基准比较，取信息量最高的5个进入子集搜索，比较均匀、相关性加权、误差加权、MSE优化与自适应逐句路由五种融合规则；用最优路由四模型集成标注80.7万条无标签语音，训练 wav2vec 2.0 学生模型。
AI.result: URGENT 上学生模型 Spearman ρ=0.802，优于最佳教师的0.773；mos260（38种合成条件、4,600条语音的俄语 TTS 基准）上 ρ=0.636，优于逐句0.613，条件级达0.95，单次前向即匹配自身路由集成；自适应路由是唯一在加入弱预测器时性能不下降的规则。
AI.conclusion: 代理标签蒸馏可在零新增人工标注下超越最强教师预测器，自适应路由对弱预测器具有稳健性；作者发布模型、ONNX 导出与 mos260 基准。

title: Collapse, Not Invariance: Diagnosing Auxiliary Objectives in Speech Anti-Spoofing
summary: Speech anti-spoofing countermeasures degrade when the generator, codec or channel changes, and a common remedy is an auxiliary objective that shapes the embedding space; whether it does is invisible to EER, a pure ranking metric. We compare seven such objectives with cross-entropy over 113 runs on five corpora, AASIST3 at three seeds plus four pre-trained detectors, and measure the embedding space of the 24 AASIST3 runs directly. Raw augmentation displacement makes cosine consistency look effective, but the gain is a smaller space, not a more stable one: normalised by the spread, no configuration consistently improves on cross-entropy. Every trained space is dominated by the single decision axis expected for two classes, whose training-set structure does not transfer, and four runs collapse to a near-constant output that displacement rewards and EER reports as poor accuracy. No auxiliary objective keeps an advantage over cross-entropy across architectures, corpora and seeds.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较7种辅助目标与交叉熵在语音反欺骗任务中的表现，发现归一化后无任何辅助目标能稳定优于交叉熵，EER掩盖了嵌入空间结构的真实变化。
AI.motivation: 语音反欺骗系统在生成器、编解码器或信道变化时性能下降，常用辅助目标塑造嵌入空间作为补救，但其效果无法通过纯排序指标EER观察到，因此需要直接测量嵌入空间来验证这些目标是否真正有效。
AI.method: 在5个语料库上进行113次实验，对比7种辅助目标与交叉熵；使用AASIST3（3个随机种子）及4个预训练检测器，直接测量24次AASIST3运行的嵌入空间（含原始位移与归一化后的一致性）。
AI.result: 原始增强位移使余弦一致性看似有效，但增益来自更小的空间而非更稳定的空间；按空间扩散归一化后，无任何配置能稳定优于交叉熵；所有训练空间被两分类预期的单一决策轴主导，且其训练集结构不可迁移；4次运行坍缩为近常数输出，位移目标却给予奖励，而EER将其报告为低准确率。
AI.conclusion: 没有任何辅助目标在架构、语料库和随机种子之间保持对交叉熵的优势，EER作为纯排序指标无法揭示嵌入空间的真实退化。

title: On Evaluating Quantum Kernel Robustness for Low-Resource Cross-Corpus Audio Deepfake Detection
summary: Synthetic speech detection is critical for audio security, but performance can degrade when labeled data are scarce and evaluation conditions differ from training. This study examines quantum kernel methods and lightweight neural models for cross-corpus audio deepfake detection under limited training data. We compare a Quantum Support Vector Machine (QSVM), a classical support vector machine (SVM), and a multilayer perceptron (MLP), all trained on frozen wav2vec 2.0 embeddings using a strict budget of 200 training samples. To match the qubit budget of near-term quantum hardware, embeddings are reduced to four dimensions using principal component analysis, and all models use the same reduced features. Experiments on ASVspoof 2019, ASVspoof 5, the ADD 2023 Challenge, and the In-the-Wild dataset show that under severe domain shift from ASVspoof 2019 to ADD 2023, the MLP degrades to near-random performance, with an area under the curve of approximately 50% and an equal error rate of 50.0%. In contrast, the QSVM maintains meaningful discrimination, achieving an area under the curve of 76.0% and an equal error rate of 27.0%. This advantage is not consistent across transfer directions. When trained on ADD 2023, the QSVM falls below chance on two of three transfers, while the MLP performs better. These results suggest that quantum kernel methods can be competitive under severe cross-corpus shifts and strict low-resource constraints, but do not provide a consistent advantage under near-domain transfer. We interpret these findings as an empirical characterization of quantum kernel inductive bias under distribution shift, rather than evidence of quantum advantage, since the four-qubit kernel can be simulated exactly on classical hardware.

AI.tldr: 在200样本低资源预算下，比较QSVM、SVM与MLP在跨语料合成语音检测中的表现：QSVM在严重域偏移下保持判别力，但优势不稳定。
AI.motivation: 合成语音检测对音频安全至关重要，但标注数据稀缺且评测条件与训练条件不一致时性能会显著下降，因此需要考察在这一低资源、跨域场景下量子核方法与轻量神经模型的表现。
AI.method: 基于冻结的wav2vec 2.0嵌入，采用严格的200条训练样本预算，比较量子支持向量机（QSVM）、经典支持向量机（SVM）与多层感知机（MLP）。为匹配近期待量子硬件的比特预算，使用主成分分析将嵌入降至4维，所有模型使用相同的降维特征。评测数据集为ASVspoof 2019、ASVspoof 5、ADD 2023 Challenge和In-the-Wild。
AI.result: 在ASVspoof 2019到ADD 2023的严重域偏移下，MLP退化至接近随机水平（AUC约50%，EER 50.0%），而QSVM保持有效判别力（AUC 76.0%，EER 27.0%）。但该优势不具备方向一致性：以ADD 2023为训练集时，QSVM在三分之二的迁移任务中低于随机水平，而MLP表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 量子核方法在严重跨语料偏移和严格低资源约束下可具竞争力，但在近域迁移中并无一致优势。作者将其定位为对分布偏移下量子核归纳偏置的经验性刻画，而非量子优势的证据，因为该四量子比特核可在经典硬件上精确模拟。

title: Balalaika-Longform: A Russian Speech Corpus for Continuous Long-Form Text-to-Speech
comment: Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lab260/Balalaika-longform ; code: https://github.com/lab260ru/balalaika-longform
summary: Long-form text-to-speech must retain requested words over extended generations, yet sentence-level training and evaluation can hide omissions and early stops. We introduce Balalaika-Longform, an open Russian corpus of 189 hours in continuous units of 30 seconds to 15 minutes. Long units and matched short windows support fine-tuning comparisons on the same source recordings, and the accompanying evaluation retains every synthesis attempt. We fine-tune CosyVoice3, Qwen3-TTS, VoxCPM2 and F5-TTS on either view and test continuous synthesis on 50 text-voice pairs with voices unseen in fine-tuning, at about 75, 300 and 1,200 words. At 1,200 words, CosyVoice3 WER falls from 99.9% after short-window fine-tuning to 47.3% with long targets, and to 16.6% with punctuated, format-matched transcripts; paired intervals favor long targets for Qwen3-TTS and VoxCPM2, and by a small margin for F5-TTS, whose absolute WER stays above 90%. The results isolate the effect of training sequence length under a fixed continuous-generation protocol.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Balalaika-Longform，一个包含 189 小时俄语长音频的开放语料库，用于研究长文本语音合成中训练序列长度对连续生成的影响。通过在同一批录音上对比长单元与短窗口微调，发现在 1200 词的长文本合成中，长目标微调显著降低 WER。
AI.motivation: 长文本语音合成需要在长距离生成中保持所请求的词语完整无误，但句级训练与评测范式会掩盖漏词和提前停止等问题；同时缺乏在同一录音源上对比长、短训练视图的开放资源与统一评测协议。
AI.method: 构建 Balalaika-Longform：189 小时俄语连续音频单元，长度覆盖 30 秒至 15 分钟，并提供与之匹配的短窗口切片，使长、短视图可在同一批源录音上微调对比；评测保留每次合成尝试。基于 CosyVoice3、Qwen3-TTS、VoxCPM2 与 F5-TTS 分别按长目标或短窗口微调，在 50 组未见音色的文本-音色对上，以约 75、300、1200 词的连续生成协议进行测试。
AI.result: 在 1200 词设置下，CosyVoice3 的 WER 由短窗口微调后的 99.9% 降至长目标的 47.3%，若使用带标点且格式匹配的转写则进一步降至 16.6%；配对区间显示 Qwen3-TTS 与 VoxCPM2 在长目标下更优，F5-TTS 亦有小幅优势，但其绝对 WER 仍高于 90%。
AI.conclusion: 在固定连续生成协议下，训练序列长度是影响长文本语音合成保真度的独立关键因素；长目标微调明显优于短窗口微调，且转写格式匹配可进一步带来大幅提升。

title: AnchorPrompt: Self-Distilled Soft Prompts for Robust Audio-Language Models
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) are sensitive to input perturbations, such as noise, waveform corruption, and adversarial injections. We propose AnchorPrompt, an efficient adaptation method that keeps the model frozen and learns a single block of prompt vectors inserted at the decoder input, between the audio and question embeddings. We train these vectors through self-distillation over diverse audio and text perturbations. To improve answer consistency and mitigate hallucination, we use the model's prediction on the clean recording as the target for answerable inputs, and assign a refusal target when the audio lacks sufficient evidence to answer. Furthermore, AnchorPrompt is perturbation-agnostic at inference, requiring no prior detection of perturbations and enabling zero-shot transfer to unseen distortions. We evaluate three LALMs across three benchmarks and show that AnchorPrompt improves answer consistency in most tested conditions. Clean accuracy improves in six of nine model-benchmark pairs, with minimal impact on the remainder of 1.2% at most. Crucially, AnchorPrompt reduces hallucinations under severe audio corruption while keeping false refusals on clean audio rare. Finally, these consistency gains transfer to unseen perturbations, such as choice permutations and reverberation.

AI.tldr: 提出 AnchorPrompt：冻结模型，仅在解码器输入端插入一组可学习提示向量，通过自蒸馏在多种音频与文本扰动下训练，实现扰动无关的鲁棒适配，减少幻觉且几乎不损干净精度。
AI.motivation: 大型音频语言模型对输入扰动（噪声、波形损坏、对抗注入）敏感，输出不一致并易产生幻觉；已有方法通常需检测扰动或微调模型，成本高且难以迁移到未见失真。
AI.method: 保持模型参数冻结，在解码器输入处、音频嵌入与问题嵌入之间插入单块可学习提示向量；以自蒸馏方式在多样的音频与文本扰动上训练这些向量。对有答案输入，以干净录音上的模型预测为目标；当音频证据不足时，将目标设为拒答。推理阶段与扰动无关，无需事先检测扰动。
AI.result: 在3个LALM与3个基准上评估：多数测试条件下答案一致性提升；9组模型-基准中有6组干净精度提升，其余下降最多仅1.2%；在严重音频损坏下显著降低幻觉，同时干净音频上的误拒答很少；一致性收益可迁移至未见扰动，如选项置换与混响。
AI.conclusion: AnchorPrompt 以极轻量的提示向量适配方式，在冻结模型的前提下提升了鲁棒性与答案一致性，兼顾干净性能与抗幻觉能力，并具备零样本迁移到未见失真的能力。

title: Where the Body Keeps the Beat: Structured Motion Conditioning and Music Dynamics Supervision for Dance-to-Music Generation
summary: Dance-to-music (D2M) generation aims to synthesize musically plausible soundtracks whose temporal structure aligns with a given dance performance. Representative D2M methods do not explicitly distinguish motion cues across body parts and frequency bands, while standard flow matching lacks a dedicated objective for supervising local music-latent dynamics. To address these issues, we propose Dyna2Music, a latent flow-matching framework that combines structured motion conditioning with explicit supervision of music-latent dynamics. An empirical analysis on AIST++ quantifies how spatial partitioning and frequency separation affect raw music-to-kinematic beat alignment and motion-reference density, informing the conditioning design. Accordingly, Dyna2Music decomposes joint velocities into slow and fast components and hierarchically fuses the resulting part-wise motion energy with pretrained joint features to condition music generation. To complement this representation, we introduce latent dynamics consistency (LDC), an auxiliary objective that matches adjacent-frame change magnitudes between a single-step clean-latent estimate and the paired reference. LDC makes local music-latent variation an explicit training target without adding trainable parameters or inference computation. Dyna2Music supports variable-length music generation, and experiments on AIST++ and TikTok demonstrate improved rhythmic alignment and audio quality over representative D2M baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Dyna2Music，一种结合结构化运动条件与音乐潜变量动态显式监督的潜空间流匹配框架，用于舞蹈到音乐生成，在AIST++和TikTok数据集上提升了节奏对齐与音频质量。
AI.motivation: 现有舞蹈到音乐（D2M）生成方法未明确区分身体部位与频带上的运动线索，而标准流匹配也缺乏专门监督局部音乐潜变量动态的目标。
AI.method: 在AIST++上进行实证分析，量化空间划分与频率分离对音乐-运动节拍对齐及运动参考密度的影响，据此指导条件设计。Dyna2Music将关节速度分解为慢、快分量，并把得到的部位运动能量与预训练关节特征分层融合以条件化音乐生成；同时提出潜变量动态一致性（LDC）辅助目标，通过匹配单步干净潜变量估计与配对参考在相邻帧上的变化幅度，将局部音乐潜变量变化作为显式训练目标，且不增加可训练参数或推理计算。该方法支持可变长度音乐生成。
AI.result: 在AIST++和TikTok数据集上的实验表明，Dyna2Music在节奏对齐和音频质量上优于代表性D2M基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化运动条件与潜变量动态显式监督的结合，Dyna2Music有效改善了舞蹈到音乐生成中的节奏对齐与音频质量，并支持可变长度生成。

title: RMS-AQA: A Two-Stage Spatial Audio Question Answering Benchmark for Real-World Domestic Environments
summary: Embodied assistants in domestic environments must infer what happened, where and when it occurred, and how to respond. To address this, we introduce RMS-AQA, a spatial audio question answering (SAQA) benchmark for real-world domestic environments. The benchmark features a two-stage question-answering (QA) format to comprehensively assess the ability of audio-language models (ALMs) to first ground audible sound events and subsequently perform complex spatio-temporal reasoning based on that grounding. To maximize acoustic realism, our dataset combines authentic real-world first-order Ambisonics (FOA) recordings with high-fidelity synthetic data generated using measured room impulse responses (RIRs). Furthermore, we provide a lightweight spatial plug-in that injects FOA-format data into frozen audio-language backbones. Experimental results reveal that the primary challenges stem from concurrent sources, far distance, and sim-to-real domain gap between RIR-synthesized and authentic recordings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RMS-AQA，一个面向真实家庭环境的空间音频问答基准，采用两阶段 QA 格式评估音频语言模型的声音事件定位与时空推理能力，数据集融合真实 FOA 录音与基于实测 RIR 的合成数据，并提供轻量空间插件将 FOA 数据注入冻结的音频语言骨干。
AI.motivation: 家庭环境中的具身助手需要推断发生了什么、在哪里、何时发生以及如何响应，而现有模型难以完成这种基于空间音频的复杂时空推理，且缺乏面向真实家庭场景的 SAQA 评测基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建 RMS-AQA 基准，采用两阶段问答格式：先对可听声音事件进行定位（grounding），再基于定位结果进行复杂时空推理；2) 数据集结合真实世界一阶 Ambisonics（FOA）录音与使用实测房间脉冲响应（RIR）生成的高保真合成数据，以最大化声学真实性；3) 提供一个轻量级空间插件，将 FOA 格式数据注入冻结的音频语言骨干模型。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，主要挑战来自并发声源、远距离以及 RIR 合成数据与真实录音之间的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）域差距。
AI.conclusion: RMS-AQA 为真实家庭环境下的空间音频问答提供了系统评测手段，揭示当前音频语言模型在声音定位与时空推理上的关键瓶颈，为后续研究指明方向。

title: Toward Elastic Speech Inference: Training-Free Wake-Word Detection from Pretrained ASR
summary: Recent ASR development has placed growing emphasis on generalization across diverse domains and acoustic conditions. Existing approaches typically adapt pretrained ASR models to front-end functions such as wake-up word (WuW) detection through additional training or task-specific modules. In this work, we explore the use of a shared pretrained ASR backbone for WuW detection without gradient-based fine-tuning and examine whether a compact encoder can be extracted using the PCA-based structured pruning approach of SliceGPT. Experiments with Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 and Moonshine-base show that WuW detection performance remains relatively stable when the encoder channel dimension is reduced by 50%. These results suggest that task-relevant compact encoders can be derived from pretrained ASR models without fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文探索无需微调、直接复用预训练ASR骨干进行唤醒词检测，并用SliceGPT的PCA结构化剪枝提取紧凑编码器；在Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3与Moonshine-base上，编码器通道维度缩减50%后唤醒词检测性能仍相对稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常需额外训练或任务专用模块，将预训练ASR模型适配到唤醒词检测等前端任务，成本较高。作者希望验证能否在不进行基于梯度的微调的前提下，直接共享预训练ASR骨干完成唤醒词检测，并考察其可压缩性。
AI.method: 以共享的预训练ASR骨干直接用于唤醒词检测，不做梯度微调；采用SliceGPT的基于PCA的结构化剪枝方法，从预训练ASR模型中提取紧凑编码器；在Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3和Moonshine-base两个模型上开展实验，观察编码器通道维度压缩对性能的影响。
AI.result: 当编码器通道维度缩减50%时，唤醒词检测性能保持相对稳定，说明大幅压缩并未带来明显性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 任务相关的紧凑编码器可以从预训练ASR模型中直接导出，无需微调，为前端任务复用ASR骨干提供了可行路径。

title: AudioJev: Direct Audio Decisions with Order-Calibrated Probabilities
summary: Audio decisions often depend on evidence that a transcript does not preserve, while their probability estimates can depend on how answer options are ordered. AudioJev maps a waveform, question and supplied alternatives directly to a candidate distribution through one shared full-parameter model. We define order calibration as preserving an answer's probability under meaning-preserving option permutations. Random-derangement SKL training pairs each question with a reordered view in which every alternative changes position, supervises both answers, and aligns the two distributions before applying a symmetric KL penalty. Inference retains a single candidate-scoring forward, with no calibration head or order ensemble. Across three training seeds, AudioJev reaches 68.88%/55.33% mean accuracy on complete MMAU/MMAR and reduces random-order SKL by 43.8%/60.5% relative to the single-view removal ablation. The same model handles intent, environmental sound, note properties, speech activity and conversational transitions. Paired removal ablations and multi-order evaluation measure predictive accuracy and probability stability together, establishing a direct audio interface whose calibration objective acts on candidate meaning rather than presentation position. Inference code and model weights are available at https://github.com/SihanLv/AudioJev-Inference and https://huggingface.co/shlv/AudioJev.

AI.tldr: AudioJev 将音频波形、问题与候选选项直接映射为候选分布，提出"顺序校准"概念与随机错排 SKL 训练，在 MMAU/MMAR 上取得 68.88%/55.33% 准确率并显著提升概率稳定性。
AI.motivation: 音频决策常依赖转录文本无法保留的证据，且其概率估计易受答案选项排列顺序影响。现有方法难以在保持音频原生信息的同时实现选项顺序不变的校准。
AI.method: 采用单一全参数共享模型，将波形、问题与给定选项直接映射为候选分布。定义顺序校准为语义等价选项置换下保持答案概率不变。提出随机错排 SKL 训练：为每题构造每个选项位置均改变的错排视图，监督两个视图的答案，并在应用对称 KL 惩罚前对齐两分布。推理仅需单次候选打分前向，无需校准头或顺序集成。
AI.result: 在三个训练种子下，AudioJev 在完整 MMAU/MMAR 上平均准确率分别为 68.88%/55.33%；相比单视图移除消融，随机顺序 SKL 分别降低 43.8%/60.5%。同一模型可处理意图、环境声、音符属性、语音活动与对话转换等任务。成对移除消融与多顺序评估同时衡量预测准确率与概率稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 建立了直接音频接口，其校准目标作用于候选语义而非呈现位置，兼顾准确率与概率稳定性。推理代码与模型权重已开源。

title: Multi-Party Backchannel Prediction: a Diagnosis, a Benchmark, and a Ceiling
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshops ReMuCAI (Paris) and RTCA (Sydney). 8 pages main text, 9 figures, 5 tables, plus appendices. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/HafsatiMohammed/bc_multiparty_release
summary: Backchannel prediction has been studied almost entirely in dyadic conversation. We introduce a multi-party benchmark based on the AMI corpus, comprising 682 masked-listener views from 171 meetings, 190 speakers, and 18,697 backchannel events, with a person-disjoint held-out split. A state-of-the-art dyadic model applied zero-shot to meeting audio performs at chance (AUROC 0.499); nevertheless, its frozen acoustic features remain informative: a linear probe reaches 0.704, and retraining the predictor raises performance to 0.751. Retraining reveals a second limitation. Listener conditioning improves prediction for listeners seen during training but not for unseen listeners, and the gap remains under capacity reduction, listener-adversarial training, per-listener adaptation, and oracle lexical conditioning. Adversarial training removes only part of the speaker-identity information, while stronger removal hurts prediction, suggesting that identity is entangled with cues that are useful for backchanneling. A within-model control helps explain this pattern: with the same features and data splits, turn-onset prediction transfers to unseen listeners, while backchannel prediction does not. Backchannel rates also vary about twice as much across individuals as turn-onset rates. Since backchannels occupy only about 1% of frames, frame-level F1 is strongly affected by the base rate. We therefore report AUROC alongside event-F1 on listener-active regions. We release the benchmark and evaluation tools at https://github.com/HafsatiMohammed/bc_multiparty_release.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个基于AMI语料的多方对话反向信道（backchannel）预测基准，发现现有多方/二元模型零样本性能仅为随机水平，但冻结声学特征仍具信息量；且听众条件化无法泛化到未见听众，揭示说话人身份与反向信道线索的纠缠。
AI.motivation: 反向信道预测此前几乎只在二元对话中研究，而真实多方会议场景中反向信道行为更为复杂，缺乏相应基准与对模型泛化能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 基于AMI语料构建多方基准，包含171场会议、190位说话人、18,697个反向信道事件、682个掩蔽听众视角，并设person-disjoint留出集。评估零样本二元SOTA模型、线性探针与重训练，并尝试容量削减、听众对抗训练、逐听众自适应及oracle词汇条件化等手段，辅以turn-onset预测的within-model对照分析。
AI.result: 零样本二元模型在会议音频上仅为随机水平（AUROC 0.499）；线性探针达0.704，重训练升至0.751。听众条件化仅对训练中见过的听众有效；对抗训练仅移除部分说话人身份信息，更强的移除反而损害预测。对照实验中turn-onset预测可泛化至未见听众，而反向信道预测不能。反向信道率跨个体差异约为turn-onset率的两倍，且反向信道仅占约1%帧，故同时报告AUROC与listener-active区域的event-F1。
AI.conclusion: 多方反向信道预测存在零样本迁移与未见听众泛化两大瓶颈，说话人身份与有效预测线索相互纠缠，难以简单解耦；评估需同时考虑AUROC与event-F1以规避基率影响。论文开源了基准与评测工具。

title: Q-SPT: Learnable Query-Based Compression for Low-Frame-Rate Speech Tokenization
summary: Neural speech codecs increasingly serve as tokenizers for speech language models (SLMs). Lowering the frame rate reduces the computational and memory costs of SLMs, but makes it difficult to preserve both linguistic information and acoustic detail. Existing approaches rely on rule-based compression: average pooling can discard linguistic information, whereas similarity-based merging uses a fixed threshold on adjacent-frame similarity and applies the resulting boundaries to the acoustic stream. We propose Q-SPT, a low-frame-rate dual-stream speech tokenizer with separate, context-aware, learnable query-based compressors specialized for semantic and acoustic representations. In particular, queries at a fixed rate independently attend to the semantic and acoustic streams as separate key-value sources, enabling stream-specific, context-aware aggregation through two separately learned compressors. In addition, an autoregressive text loss explicitly supervises the semantic compressor to preserve linguistic information. Experimental results show that Q-SPT achieves the best reconstruction among the evaluated codecs at the same frame rate. In downstream SLMs, it yields the best speech recognition accuracy and text-to-speech perceptual quality with competitive intelligibility.

AI.tldr: Q-SPT：低帧率双流语音分词器，用可学习查询压缩器分别处理语义与声学流，实现流特定、上下文感知的压缩，在重建、语音识别与TTS上表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 神经语音编解码器常作为语音语言模型（SLM）的分词器。降低帧率可减少SLM的计算与内存开销，但难以同时保留语言信息与声学细节。现有方法依赖规则式压缩：平均池化会丢失语言信息，而基于相似度的合并使用固定阈值判断相邻帧相似性，并将所得边界直接应用于声学流，缺乏针对性与灵活性。因此需要一种流特定的、上下文感知的可学习压缩方案。
AI.method: 提出Q-SPT，一种低帧率双流语音分词器，包含分别针对语义与声学表示的、独立学习且上下文感知的查询式压缩器。固定速率的查询分别作为独立键值源对语义流与声学流进行注意力聚合，从而实现流特定、上下文感知的聚合；此外引入自回归文本损失显式监督语义压缩器以保留语言信息。
AI.result: 在相同帧率下，Q-SPT在所评估的编解码器中取得最佳重建效果；在下游SLM中，取得最佳语音识别准确率与文本到语音感知质量，且可懂度具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过可学习的查询式双流压缩替代规则式压缩，Q-SPT在低帧率下兼顾了语言信息与声学细节，在重建与下游任务上均优于现有编解码器。

title: Beyond Decodability: Do Acoustic Factors Drive Predictions in Speech-Based Alzheimer's Assessment?
summary: Speech-based Alzheimer's disease (AD) assessments increasingly rely on pretrained self-supervised learning (SSL) models that learn acoustic representations directly from raw audio, exposing the model to recording factors. We ask whether such factors are merely encoded in SSL representations or can systematically alter predictions. Using ADReSSo and three large SSL backbones, we apply controlled noise and reverberation interventions to participant-speech-only, non-speech, and full-recording audio. We combine layer-wise linear decoding, input- and representation-space interventions, and geometric alignment analysis to distinguish acoustic decodability from influence on AD prediction. Our results show that controlled acoustic interventions alter AD predictions across all three SSL backbones. Noise, despite showing no significant diagnostic-group difference in the original data, produces the strongest intervention effects. Importantly, these effects are systematically structured relative to the classifier's decision direction, replicate on the held-out test set and reverse when the representation-space intervention direction is reversed. Together, these findings show that high predictive performance and the absence of a significant diagnostic-group difference in a measured acoustic factor are not sufficient for robustness. We argue that intervention-based robustness tests should become standard for trustworthy clinical speech models.

AI.tldr: 该研究质疑基于自监督学习(SSL)语音表征的阿尔茨海默病(AD)预测是否对录音因素稳健，通过对ADReSSo数据集与三种SSL骨干施加受控噪声和混响干预，发现这些声学干预会系统性地改变AD预测，且噪声影响最强，即使原始数据中噪声无显著组间差异。
AI.motivation: 基于语音的AD评估越来越依赖从原始音频直接学习声学表征的预训练SSL模型，这使得模型暴露于录音因素之下。作者想探究这些因素是否仅被编码于SSL表征中，还是能系统性地改变预测结果。
AI.method: 使用ADReSSo数据集和三种大型SSL骨干，对仅参与者语音、非语音和完整录音三类音频施加受控的噪声与混响干预；结合逐层线性解码、输入空间与表征空间干预，以及几何对齐分析，区分声学的可解码性与对AD预测的影响。
AI.result: 受控声学干预在三种SSL骨干上均改变了AD预测。噪声尽管在原始数据中无显著诊断组差异，却产生最强的干预效应。这些效应相对分类器决策方向呈系统性结构，在留出测试集上可复现，并在表征空间干预方向反转时随之反转。
AI.conclusion: 高预测性能以及某一声学因素无显著诊断组差异，并不足以证明模型的稳健性；作者主张应将基于干预的稳健性测试作为可信临床语音模型的标准流程。

title: From Isolated Feature to Orbits: Discovering Music Concepts via Multi-SAE Alignment
summary: How can we understand what a music foundation model has learned \textit{internally}? Most interpretability approaches, such as probing and Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), focus on identifying individual features with minimal structural assumptions. We argue that many concepts are better understood as \textit{structured relations} rather than isolated features. This is especially prominent in music, where tonal structures are organized in the space of pitch and time. For example, concepts such as chords or keys are naturally expressed as structured sets (e.g., the 12 transpositions of a chord or the diatonic system within a key), rather than isolated features. In this study, \textbf{we shift from feature identification to structure-based analysis}, asking whether the learned inner representations of music foundation model emerge as organized structures over features. To this end, we introduce a framework that uses pitch transposition as an inductive bias to induce ordered orbits via multi-view SAE alignment. Concretely, we generate pitch-shifted input pairs and align their SAE representations to discover structured groups of pitch-related features. Experimental results show that this approach recovers orbit structures corresponding to chords, keys, and melodic patterns across two state-of-the-art music foundation models, while requiring only minimal grounding (e.g., a few anchor examples) to interpret entire concept families.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从"特征识别"转向"结构分析"，利用音高移调作为归纳偏置，通过多视图SAE对齐来诱导有序轨道，从而发现音乐基础模型中与和弦、调性及旋律模式对应的结构化表示。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法（如探针和稀疏自编码器SAE）聚焦于以最小结构假设识别孤立特征，但许多概念（尤其在音乐中）更适合被理解为结构化关系。例如和弦与调性自然表现为结构化集合（和弦的12个移调、调内的自然音体系），而非孤立特征。因此需要探究音乐基础模型的内部表示是否以组织化结构的形式涌现。
AI.method: 提出一个以音高移调作为归纳偏置的框架，通过多视图SAE对齐来诱导有序轨道。具体做法是生成音高移调的输入对，对齐其SAE表示，从而发现音高相关特征的结构化分组。
AI.result: 在两个最先进的音乐基础模型上，该方法恢复了对应和弦、调性和旋律模式的轨道结构，且仅需极少的锚定（如少量锚示例）即可解释整个概念族。
AI.conclusion: 音乐基础模型的内部表示确实以组织化结构（而非孤立特征）的形式涌现，结构化的可解释性分析为理解音乐模型所学概念提供了有效新视角。

title: LAST: Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer
summary: Increasing depth of transformer models improves recognition, but it comes at a substantial cost. Each additional layer requires more parameters, which makes the process computationally inefficient. We ask whether additional processing can focus on integrating features already computed. Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer (LAST) first processes all tokens, then reuses the same blocks to refine only the class token over fixed audio features, thereby making later passes inexpensive. On AudioSet, ten-pass LAST achieves 0.345 mean average precision, exceeding a twelve-layer sequential transformer by 2.1% relative with 49.4% fewer parameters, 42% fewer multiply-accumulate operations, and 9.8% higher measured throughput. Across separately trained models, increasing the pass count from two to ten improves accuracy while adding only 1.2% computation. Further evaluations show improved robustness to temporal masking and various other auditory augmentations, with better generalization on classification tasks with music, environmental, and event sounds.

AI.tldr: 提出 Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer (LAST)，通过复用相同模块仅对类别 token 进行多轮精炼，在更少参数与计算量下超越更深的顺序 Transformer。
AI.motivation: 增加 Transformer 深度可提升识别性能，但每增加一层都带来更多参数与计算开销，效率低。作者试图探究：额外的处理是否可以聚焦于对已计算特征的整合，而非堆叠新层。
AI.method: LAST 先对所有 token 进行一次处理，随后复用同一组模块，在固定的音频特征上仅对类别 token 进行多轮精炼，使后续轮次计算开销很低。
AI.result: 在 AudioSet 上，十轮 LAST 达到 0.345 mAP，相对十二层顺序 Transformer 提升 2.1%，同时参数减少 49.4%、MAC 减少 42%、实测吞吐提高 9.8%。在不同训练的模型上，轮数从 2 增至 10 仅增加 1.2% 计算量即提升精度，并对时间掩蔽等多种音频增强更鲁棒，在音乐、环境与事件声音分类任务上泛化更好。
AI.conclusion: 通过循环复用模块精炼类别 token，可在显著降低参数与计算成本的同时提升识别性能与鲁棒性，为音频 Transformer 的高效深度扩展提供了新思路。

title: AURAL: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Joint Chunk for Speech Language Models
summary: Model intelligence and fast response jointly shape the quality of interaction with speech language models, yet remain difficult to achieve together. Explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning and audio understanding, but generating intermediate reasoning tokens delays responses. Describing fine-grained acoustic cues further lengthens CoT and increases latency. Latent reasoning can reduce this overhead, yet existing methods often trail CoT and remain limited by single-path supervision and reasoning budgets that do not adapt to problem difficulty. We introduce AURAL, which models a distribution over multiple plausible reasoning continuations in latent space and jointly predicts chunks of future states to reduce sequential forward passes and reasoning latency. To provide initial supervision for latent reasoning, we construct AuralReason-683K: 683K bilingual speech utterances (about 1,000 hours) with concise CoT for emotion recognition, empathetic dialogue, and general reasoning. AURAL-RL then explores beyond these traces, rewarding concise reasoning that yields high-quality answers and adapting reasoning effort to each problem. Across two backbones, AURAL-RL achieves performance comparable to CoT-RL, with larger gains over the respective supervised checkpoints on most metrics. Analysis further shows that harder questions elicit more latent reasoning steps. On Qwen2.5-Omni, it reduces time to the first answer token by 11.8x, from 1.22 to 0.10 s, versus 0.05 s for direct answering.

AI.tldr: 提出AURAL，通过在潜空间建模多条推理路径并联合预测未来状态块，实现语音语言模型的快速且高智能响应，配合AuralReason-683K数据集与AURAL-RL强化学习，性能媲美显式CoT-RL并将首答延迟从1.22s降至0.10s（11.8倍加速）。
AI.motivation: 语音语言模型难以同时兼顾智能水平与快速响应。显式思维链（CoT）虽提升推理与音频理解能力，但生成中间推理token会延迟响应；描述细粒度声学线索进一步加长CoT并增加延迟。潜空间推理可降低开销，但现有方法效果不及CoT，且受限于单路径监督和不适应问题难度的固定推理预算。
AI.method: 1) AURAL在潜空间对多条可能的推理延续建模分布，并联合预测未来状态块，以减少顺序前向传播和推理延迟；2) 构建AuralReason-683K数据集（683K双语语音语句，约1000小时），涵盖情绪识别、共情对话和通用推理，附简洁CoT作为潜推理初始监督；3) AURAL-RL在已有轨迹之外探索，奖励能产生高质量答案的简洁推理，并根据问题难度自适应调整推理力度。
AI.result: 在两个骨干模型上，AURAL-RL性能与CoT-RL相当，且在多数指标上相较各自的有监督检查点有更大提升。分析表明更难的问题会触发更多潜推理步骤。在Qwen2.5-Omni上，首个答案token的时间从1.22s降至0.10s，减少11.8倍，而直接回答为0.05s。
AI.conclusion: AURAL通过潜空间多路径推理与强化学习，在保持与显式CoT相当推理性能的同时大幅降低响应延迟，并实现随问题难度自适应的推理力度分配，为语音语言模型兼顾智能与速度提供了有效方案。

title: Exposing the Cost of Deep Learning Audio Development
summary: The environmental impact of deep learning has attracted increasing attention over the past decade. Existing studies mainly focus on the energy and carbon emissions of model training and inference, while the whole development phase is often overlooked. Yet, architecture prototyping and intensive experiments are conducted during this stage, which is highly energy-demanding. In this article, we propose a methodology to estimate these costs, based on activity logs from the Grid5000 shared computing platform used by the LORIA laboratory. As a case-study, we focus on audio projects developed in the Multispeech research team. We evaluate the overall energy cost of four projects, and we compare them to those of training the reported models. Our results show that the energy required for the development phase is 3 to 256 times greater than that required to train the best-performing model alone. These results advocate for a more systematic reporting of energy consumption across the entire life cycle of deep learning-based audio projects.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于Grid5000平台活动日志的方法，估算深度学习音频项目开发阶段的能耗。结果表明开发阶段能耗是训练最佳模型单独能耗的3至256倍，呼吁对深度学习音频项目全生命周期能耗进行系统化报告。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习环境影响研究主要关注模型训练与推理的能耗和碳排放，而架构原型设计、密集实验等开发阶段的能耗常被忽视，但该阶段能耗需求极高。
AI.method: 基于LORIA实验室使用的Grid5000共享计算平台的活动日志，提出估算开发阶段能耗的方法；以Multispeech研究团队开发的音频项目为案例，评估四个项目的整体能耗，并与报告中模型的训练能耗进行对比。
AI.result: 开发阶段所需能耗是单独训练最佳性能模型所需能耗的3至256倍。
AI.conclusion: 应更系统性地报告基于深度学习的音频项目全生命周期的能耗。

title: AVSD-Scenes: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Description of Urban Scenes
summary: Natural language descriptions can provide rich semantic representations of audio-visual urban scenes, yet datasets that jointly describe both auditory and visual information remain limited. In this paper, we introduce AVSD-Scenes, a paired audio-visual scene description dataset for urban environments. The dataset contains 12,291 audio-visual scene descriptions generated from the TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes dataset. To construct the dataset, we first generate audio- and visual-based descriptions using Qwen2-Audio-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, respectively. These modality-specific descriptions are then combined using large language models, namely Qwen3-14B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, and Gemma-3-27B-it, to produce multimodal descriptions that capture complementary information from both modalities. We benchmark AVSD-Scenes using semantic alignment, cross-modal retrieval, scene classification, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human subjective assessment. Results show that multimodal descriptions improve semantic alignment and cross-modal retrieval performance compared with modality-specific descriptions while preserving strong scene-discriminative information. The generated descriptions achieve up to 94.5% accuracy in urban scene classification, while combining audio, visual, and description embeddings further improves accuracy to 95.4%. Furthermore, the descriptions remain highly scene-discriminative even when scene labels are removed from the prompting instructions, indicating that they capture semantic information derived from the audio-visual content rather than merely reflecting label information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVSD-Scenes——一个面向城市环境的成对音视频场景描述数据集，包含12,291条描述，并通过语义对齐、跨模态检索、场景分类、LLM评判及人工主观评估表明：多模态描述优于单模态描述，音视频与文本嵌入融合后城市场景分类精度可达95.4%。
AI.motivation: 自然语言可为音视频城市场景提供丰富的语义表征，但同时描述听觉与视觉信息的联合数据集仍然有限，制约了多模态场景理解与跨模态检索等研究。
AI.method: 基于TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes数据集，先用Qwen2-Audio-7B与Qwen2.5-VL-7B分别生成音频与视觉的单模态描述，再用Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506和Gemma-3-27B-it等大语言模型融合为多模态描述；随后采用语义对齐、跨模态检索、场景分类、LLM-as-a-judge及人工主观评估进行基准测试。
AI.result: 多模态描述在语义对齐与跨模态检索上优于单模态描述，同时保留强场景判别信息；生成描述在城市场景分类中最高达94.5%准确率，融合音频、视觉与描述嵌入后进一步提升至95.4%；去除提示指令中的场景标签后描述仍具高度场景判别性，说明其捕获的是源自音视频内容的语义信息而非标签信息。
AI.conclusion: AVSD-Scenes为城市音视频场景描述提供了成对多模态基准，验证了LLM驱动的多模态描述生成在语义对齐、检索与分类上的有效性，并表明描述蕴含真实的音视频语义而非标签泄漏。

title: Weighted Data Selection: Sharp Upper-Half and Five-Dimensional Laws
comment: 35 pages, 2 figures; supplementary verification code included
summary: How much risk does a small reweighted training support retain? For finite weighted least squares with the minimum-norm learner, we prove the exact law $Γ_d(n)=3-n/d$ throughout $\lceil3d/2\rceil\leq n\leq2d-1$. The guarantee covers every observed feature rank and uses selections that preserve the full feature span. Balanced simplex anchors reduce dimension; positive-weight lifting and independent-line compression close the risk bound. Shifted coordinate pairs attain the matching lower bound. The complete dataset-level upper bound and sharpness construction are verified in Lean 4. At the smaller budget $(d,n)=(5,6)$, we also prove $Γ_5(6)=11/5$, matching the simplex-block prediction from $5=3+2$ over arbitrary interacting configurations. Circuit covers, comparison second moments, and circuit-plane probabilities give the sharp excess $6/5$, while polar-face geometry resolves shared rank-three circuits. The general simplex-block frontier connects these laws within the intermediate-budget selection problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究小规模重加权训练支持集的风险，针对最小范数学习者的有限加权最小二乘问题，证明了精确风险律 Γ_d(n)=3−n/d（当 ⌈3d/2⌉≤n≤2d−1 时成立），并在 Lean 4 中验证了数据集层面的上界与紧性构造，此外在小预算 (d,n)=(5,6) 情形证明 Γ_5(6)=11/5。
AI.motivation: 作者关心在训练样本预算较小、且对训练样本进行重加权（reweighting）时，重加权训练支持集究竟保留了多少风险。这一问题涉及最小范数学习者下有限加权最小二乘的风险刻画，尤其是中间预算区间（⌈3d/2⌉≤n≤2d−1）此前缺乏精确的风险律，因此需要建立紧的上界与下界。
AI.method: 方法上，针对最小范数学习者的有限加权最小二乘，作者通过平衡单纯形锚点（balanced simplex anchors）进行降维，利用正权提升（positive-weight lifting）与独立线压缩（independent-line compression）来闭合风险界；用平移坐标对（shifted coordinate pairs）构造匹配下界。在 (d,n)=(5,6) 的特例中，使用电路覆盖（circuit covers）、比较二阶矩（comparison second moments）与电路平面概率（circuit-plane probabilities）得到紧的超额 6/5，并用极面几何（polar-face geometry）处理共享的三阶电路。整体上界与紧性构造在 Lean 4 中完成形式化验证。
AI.result: 主要结果为精确风险律 Γ_d(n)=3−n/d，在整个 ⌈3d/2⌉≤n≤2d−1 区间成立，且保证覆盖所有观测特征秩，所用选择保持完整特征张成。下界由平移坐标对达到。在小预算 (d,n)=(5,6) 处证明 Γ_5(6)=11/5，与由 5=3+2 得到的单纯形块预测一致，且对任意交互配置成立；电路覆盖、比较二阶矩与电路平面概率给出紧的超额 6/5。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：小规模重加权训练支持集的风险可由精确律 Γ_d(n)=3−n/d 刻画，并配有匹配的紧性构造；小预算特例 Γ_5(6)=11/5 进一步验证该律。一般单纯形块前沿（general simplex-block frontier）将这些风险律统一到中间预算选择问题框架内，相关工作已在 Lean 4 中形式化验证。

title: Transferable Graph Metanetworks
summary: A weight space network (or metanetwork) takes the weights of another neural network as input and predicts properties of it. Most prior work trains such models on input networks of one or a few fixed sizes and evaluates them in-distribution. The few attempts at out-of-distribution size generalization remain limited in scope and have achieved only modest success. Consequently, the potential efficiency gains of training on small networks and evaluating on much larger ones remain largely unrealized. We propose Transferable Graph Metanetworks, which extend the graph metanetwork paradigm with a set of modifications that make performance transferable across input networks of different widths. The modifications follow two principles: invariance to the ways in which networks of different widths represent the same function, and continuity, such that weights representing similar functions receive similar predictions. We further study whether size generalization is possible for input networks trained independently from random initialization. Empirically, our modifications significantly improve size generalization on every task we consider. Performance is strongest on input networks trained under the maximal-update parameterization ($μ$P), where it remains robust up to $42\times$ the training width. Theoretically, we explain these observations with infinite-width limit theory: we prove size-generalization guarantees for our model on $μ$P-trained inputs, and explain why it can fail under other parameterizations.

AI.tldr: 提出Transferable Graph Metanetworks，通过不变性与连续性两类修改，实现权重空间网络在不同宽度输入网络间的尺寸泛化，在μP训练下可稳健泛化至42倍训练宽度。
AI.motivation: 权重空间网络（metanetwork）以其他神经网络的权重为输入并预测其性质，多数工作仅在固定规模输入网络上训练并做分布内评估，少数跨规模泛化尝试范围有限且效果一般，导致“小网络训练、大网络评估”的效率收益未能实现。
AI.method: 提出Transferable Graph Metanetworks，在图metanetwork范式上引入一组修改，遵循两条原则：对不同宽度网络表示同一函数的方式保持不变性，以及连续性（相似函数对应相似预测）。同时研究输入网络独立随机初始化训练时的尺寸泛化问题，并结合无穷宽极限理论进行分析。
AI.result: 在所有考察任务上显著提升尺寸泛化性能；在最大更新参数化（μP）训练的输入网络上表现最佳，可稳健泛化至训练宽度的42倍。理论上，证明了μP训练输入下的尺寸泛化保证，并解释了其他参数化下失效的原因。
AI.conclusion: 尺寸泛化需结合模型设计上的不变性与连续性，并与合适的参数化（如μP）相配合；无穷宽极限理论为跨宽度泛化提供了理论解释与保证。

title: Learning to Cover Locally: Graph Neural Combinatorial Optimization under a Hard Information Horizon
summary: Neural combinatorial optimization typically assumes a centralized solver that reads the whole instance. We study the opposite: combinatorial optimization under a hard information horizon, where every node commits to its share of a global solution seeing only its $k$-hop neighborhood, and those commitments must compose into a globally feasible solution. We formalize this as local set cover and instantiate it on weighted multipoint relay (MPR) selection, the NP-hard 2-hop covering problem of the Optimized Link State Routing Protocol version 2 (OLSRv2) routing protocol (RFC~7181), whose horizon is imposed by the protocol, not chosen by the modeler. We prove two results. Any deterministic selector whose horizon is one hop short must either fail coverage or land a factor $Δ$ from optimal, and an $L$-layer graph neural network (GNN) read out at the deciding node is exactly an $L$-hop selector, so capacity cannot buy back radius. Conversely, at the horizon a \ac{GNN} of depth $O(Δ)$ reproduces the RFC~7181 covering greedy, and at width $O(c_{\max}Δ)$ its metric-aware weighted analogue, inheriting the $(1+\lnΔ_2)$-approximation in both cases. Empirically, a 3-layer \ac{GATv2} with a coverage-completing decoder, behavior-cloned from the CP-SAT optimum, reaches $\text{cost}/\text{opt}=1.030\pm0.001$ against greedy's $1.138$, closing $79.1\%$ of the gap at $100\%$ coverage. Restricting the same learner to one hop, on identical instances with the same decoder and demonstrations, collapses it to $1.344$, far worse than greedy. Two transfer checks target real-world networks. OLSRv2's unmodified selection code matches our cardinality greedy on $200/200$ unit-cost instances, and on $40{,}308$ instances of real battalion mobility the frozen model closes $48\%$ of the gap at full coverage. The information horizon, not the model capacity, is the most significant variable.

AI.tldr: 本文将组合优化置于"硬信息视野"约束下（每个节点仅见 k 跳邻域并独立承诺局部解，且须构成全局可行解），形式化为局部集合覆盖，并以 OLSRv2 的 MPR 选择（RFC 7181）为实例；证明 L 层 GNN 等价于 L 跳选择器，容量无法补偿半径，而足够深度/宽度可复现 RFC 7181 贪心及其加权变体并继承 (1+ln Δ₂) 近似保证。
AI.motivation: 神经组合优化通常假设集中式求解器可读取整个实例，忽略了现实（如路由协议）中节点只能基于局部信息做出全局约束下的决策。作者希望研究在视野由协议强制、而非建模者自由选择的场景下，局部承诺如何组合成全局可行解，并厘清"信息视野"与"模型容量"哪个是决定性变量。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为局部集合覆盖，实例化为加权 MPR 选择（NP 难的 2 跳覆盖问题）。理论上：(1) 证明任何比协议要求少一跳的确定性选择器要么无法覆盖要么偏离最优 Δ 倍；(2) 证明 L 层 GNN 在决策节点读出恰好等价于 L 跳选择器；(3) 证明深度 O(Δ) 的 GNN 可复现 RFC 7181 覆盖贪心，宽度 O(c_max Δ) 时复现其度量感知加权版本，均继承 (1+ln Δ₂) 近似。实验上采用 3 层 GATv2 加覆盖补全解码器，从 CP-SAT 最优行为克隆；并做两项真实网络迁移检验（OLSRv2 原始选择代码对比、真实营级机动网络）。
AI.result: 3 层 GATv2 + 覆盖补全解码器达到 cost/opt = 1.030±0.001，优于贪心的 1.138，在 100% 覆盖下弥合 79.1% 的差距；同一学习器限制为一跳视野时崩溃至 1.344，远劣于贪心。OLSRv2 未修改的选择代码在 200/200 单位成本实例上与基数贪心一致；在 40,308 个真实营级机动实例上，冻结模型在完全覆盖下弥合 48% 的差距。
AI.conclusion: 在硬信息视野下的组合优化中，信息视野而非模型容量是最重要的变量。理论证明 GNN 深度与选择半径严格对应，容量无法买回半径；实验表明在满足协议视野前提下学习器可显著超越经典贪心，且能迁移到真实路由网络。

title: Target-Dependent Limits of Causal Repair: A Leading-Log Frontier in a Gaussian Model
summary: Knowing how much a causal predictor could improve need not reveal the gain of the repair actually learned. We quantify this gap in a scalar Gaussian causal experiment with known intervention geometry: auxiliary data identify effect magnitude up to bounded contamination, while diagnostics identify direction. The target is the squared-loss gain of the realized trained repair relative to a fitted reference. Jointly optimizing the learner and assessor under uniform learning MSE $η$ avoids the trivial solution of making no repair. At the usual $1/k$ learning scale, every feasible learner incurs a $k^{-2}$ assessment floor, even when oracle potential is estimable at a faster rate. In the magnitude-rich regime, we characterize a sharp leading-log frontier: the assessment exponent is $\min{\ell_k,2kη_k/U}$ to first relative order, where $\ell_k=\log(1/(k^2E_k))$ and $E_k$ is auxiliary precision. A diagnostic-abstention rule attains this exponent with unknown nuisance parameters. We also bound the critical allowance window and transfer the frontier to adaptive sampling by exact Gaussian simulation. Finite-grid experiments distinguish sign-tail suppression from total MSE and expose conservative finite-budget behavior. The result isolates how the assessment target changes information requirements in this experiment; it is not a general causal identifiability claim.

AI.tldr: 本文在已知干预几何的标量高斯因果实验中量化"可预测的因果增益"与"实际学到的修复所获增益"之间的信息差距：在均匀学习MSE η下联合优化学习器与评估器，得到 k^{-2} 的评估下界，并在幅度充足区间刻画前沿指数 min{ℓ_k, 2kη_k/U}，给出可达到该指数的诊断-弃权规则。
AI.motivation: 知道某个因果预测器能够带来多大改进，并不等同于知道实际训练出的修复方案真正获得了多少增益；论文旨在量化这一评估目标上的信息需求差距，而非给出一般性的因果可识别性结论。
AI.method: 构建标量高斯因果实验：辅助数据在有界污染下识别效应幅度，诊断信息识别方向；目标是已实现训练修复相对拟合参考的平方损失增益。在学习者与评估器联合优化、学习MSE为 η 的设定下分析评估误差，在幅度充足区间推导前沿指数 ℓ_k=log(1/(k^2E_k)) 与 2kη_k/U 的取小，并提出诊断-弃权规则；辅以精确高斯模拟与有限网格实验。
AI.result: 在最常见的 1/k 学习尺度下，任何可行学习器都承受 k^{-2} 的评估下界，即使 oracle 潜力可更快估计；幅度充足区间评估指数为 min{ℓ_k,2kη_k/U}（一阶相对精度）；诊断-弃权规则在未知冗余参数下仍达到该指数；同时给出临界容许窗口的界，并通过精确高斯模拟将前沿迁移到自适应采样；有限网格实验区分了符号尾部抑制与总MSE，并揭示有限预算下的保守行为。
AI.conclusion: 评估目标本身会改变信息需求：可实现修复的增益评估受限于 k^{-2} 的评估下界与由辅助精度、学习MSE共同决定的前沿指数；该结论限于本文实验设定，不构成一般因果可识别性主张。

title: ChainLoRA: Geometry-Preserving Task Vector Merging for Continual Learning in LLMs
summary: Continual parameter-efficient fine-tuning for large language models (LLMs) must balance retention of previously acquired knowledge, adaptation to new tasks, and strict parameter budgets. We present \textbf{ChainLoRA}, a replay-free continual merging framework built on chain-updated task-vector geometry. From a parameter-merging perspective, we formulate a geometric view of forgetting through a measurable interaction between task updates, separating directional overlap from coefficient coupling. Building on this view, ChainLoRA combines chain-updated training with post-stream adaptive SVD merging. During training, initialization and a one-sided orthogonality proxy use only the last carrier, keeping their historical-state footprint and regularization overhead constant as the task stream grows. At merging time, Adaptive SVD extracts a shared carrier and aligns it to the latest task through Procrustes adaptation. Our theoretical analysis shows that Procrustes adaptation facilitates geometric approximate separation of shared and task-specific components. The one-sided proxy further bounds inter-task interference. An effective-rank penalty additionally promotes efficient utilization of the task subspace during continual learning. Experiments show that ChainLoRA achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated replay-free methods on the Large and SuperNI benchmarks, while remaining competitive on Standard CL and attaining almost the closest average scores to the evaluated replay-based method across all three benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChainLoRA，一种免回放的持续参数高效微调框架，基于链式更新的任务向量几何，结合训练阶段的单侧正交代理与合并阶段的自适应SVD，在参数预算受限下平衡知识保留与新任务适应。
AI.motivation: 持续参数高效微调需在旧知识保留、新任务适应与严格参数预算间取得平衡；免回放方法虽避免存储历史数据，但任务流增长时易出现任务间干扰与历史状态开销膨胀，因此需要一种可度量遗忘、开销恒定的持续合并机制。
AI.method: 从参数合并视角提出任务更新的几何交互度量，将方向重叠与系数耦合分离以刻画遗忘；构建ChainLoRA，训练阶段采用链式更新，初始化与单侧正交代理仅依赖最近载体，使历史状态占用与正则开销随任务流增长保持恒定；合并阶段用自适应SVD提取共享载体，并通过Procrustes对齐适配最新任务；同时引入有效秩惩罚促进任务子空间高效利用。
AI.result: 理论分析表明Procrustes适配有助于共享与任务特定成分的几何近似分离，单侧代理可约束任务间干扰；实验显示ChainLoRA在Large与SuperNI基准上取得所评估免回放方法中的最优性能，在Standard CL上具竞争力，并在三个基准上平均得分接近所评估的回放式方法。
AI.conclusion: ChainLoRA通过链式任务向量几何与自适应SVD合并，在无回放与恒定开销设定下有效缓解持续微调中的遗忘与干扰，兼顾参数效率与性能，可作为免回放持续参数高效微调的有效方案。

title: Fractional Laplace Neural Operators: Exact Architectures, an Expressivity Frontier at Criticality, and Certified Stability for Memory-Driven Network Dynamics
summary: Neural operators learn maps between function spaces, while hereditary network dynamics are described by Volterra resolvents with non-rational Laplace symbols. We introduce a fractional Laplace neural operator (fLNO) that embeds this structure in the learned map. For commuting excitation--Laplacian pairs, one block graph-spectral layer represents the full linear Volterra solution operator exactly. We establish an expressivity frontier for finite rational realizations: they approximate fractional memory geometrically on compact frequency windows, but cannot reproduce the non-integer critical asymptotics generated by a branch point, and on the half-line the best rational rate is root-exponential. The same theory yields trainable parametrizations that enforce a prescribed stability margin by construction, and a graphon-transfer theorem separates genuine operator consistency from parameter sharing. In a common-data benchmark, positive rational operators can match or exceed fLNO accuracy on finite horizons, whereas in controlled near-critical experiments fLNO recovers the branching coordinate more faithfully with far fewer parameters; unconstrained rational fits can cross the stability boundary, while certified parametrizations cannot. A four-parameter spectral law transfers without retraining from graphs of size 48 to 192 with 0.51--0.62% relative error. Applications to Chilean aftershock sequences and to renewal models for Chile and 21 Italian regions illustrate structured inference with explicit uncertainty. The contribution is an operator-learning architecture in which exact memory structure, physical coordinates and stability guarantees coexist with competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出分数阶拉普拉斯神经算子（fLNO），将Volterra解算子结构嵌入算子学习框架，兼顾精确记忆结构、物理坐标与稳定性保证。
AI.motivation: 神经算子学习函数空间映射，但遗伝网络动力学由具有非有理Laplace符号的Volterra预解式描述，现有有理逼近难以刻画分数阶记忆与分支点产生的非整数临界渐近行为。
AI.method: 构造fLNO，对可交换激励-拉普拉斯对用单个块图谱层精确表示线性Volterra解算子；建立有限有理实现的可表达性边界，给出半直线上根指数最优有理逼近率；用同一理论导出按构造强制稳定裕度的可训练参数化，并证明图极限（graphon）迁移定理区分算子一致性与参数共享。
AI.result: 共同数据基准中，正有理算子在有限时域上可达到或超过fLNO精度；近临界实验中fLNO以更少参数更忠实恢复分支坐标；无约束有理拟合会越过稳定边界，而认证参数化不会。四参数谱律从图规模48免重训迁移到192，相对误差0.51–0.62%。应用于智利余震序列及智利与意大利21个地区的更新模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出一种算子学习架构，使精确记忆结构、物理坐标与稳定性保证可同时与有竞争力的精度共存。

title: Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Image Regression Models with Application to an Inertial Confinement Fusion Emulator
summary: Uncertainty quantification is critical in scientific machine learning, where black-box, image-based models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings. In many such applications, model outputs inform costly decisions, yet most methods provide only point estimates without quantifying predictive uncertainty. This challenge is compounded by the limited accessibility and interpretability of model internals, making it difficult to assess reliability across different regions of the input space. As a result, there is a growing need for methods that can provide input-dependent uncertainty estimates to guide both model development and downstream experimentation. To address this need, we propose Adaptive Conformal Prediction using Nearest Neighbors (ACPNN), an input-adaptive conformal framework for image regression. ACPNN leverages information from neighboring samples to produce locally adaptive uncertainty estimates while maintaining low computational cost. The neighborhood structure is defined using a scaled distance metric learned via a Gaussian Process with an automatic relevance determination (ARD) kernel. We demonstrate the effectiveness of ACPNN on a diffusion model for emulating inertial confinement fusion (ICF) simulations, showing that it achieves reliable and adaptive uncertainty quantification.

AI.tldr: 提出ACPNN——一种基于最近邻的输入自适应共形预测框架，用于图像回归，利用高斯过程ARD核学习的缩放距离度量构建邻域结构，在惯性约束聚变扩散模型代理上实现了可靠且自适应的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 在科学机器学习中，黑箱、基于图像的模型越来越多地用于高风险场景，其输出会影响代价高昂的决策；但多数方法仅给出点估计，缺乏预测不确定性量化。同时模型内部难以获取和解释，难以评估输入空间不同区域的可靠性，因此需要能够提供输入相关不确定性估计的方法，以指导模型开发和下游实验。
AI.method: 提出ACPNN（Adaptive Conformal Prediction using Nearest Neighbors），一个面向图像回归的输入自适应共形预测框架。ACPNN利用邻近样本的信息产生局部自适应的不确定性估计，同时保持较低计算成本；其邻域结构通过一个缩放距离度量来定义，该度量由带ARD核的高斯过程学习得到。
AI.result: 在一个用于模拟惯性约束聚变（ICF）仿真的扩散模型上验证了ACPNN的有效性，结果表明其能够实现可靠且自适应的不确定性量化。
AI.conclusion: ACPNN通过将共形预测与由高斯过程ARD核学习的缩放距离度量相结合，在图像回归任务中以低计算成本实现了输入自适应的不确定性量化，适用于黑箱图像模型的高风险科学应用。

title: Learning to Price Electricity for Optimal Demand Response
summary: There is considerable interest in using time-varying electricity prices to shape consumer demand response, and better align energy demand with renewable production. However, optimal prices generally vary over time in response to complex signals such as weather forecasts, sunrise/sunset times, and day-of-week patterns; and existing methods are not able to make efficient use of such rich contextual information. Here, we propose a neural-network-based algorithm for contextual energy pricing, modeling pricing as a Stackelberg game and leveraging a mean-field solution representation from Mehrabi et al.~(2024). The approach learns constrained mappings from contextual features to feasible price signals. We validate our approach by simulating the energy grid in several US cities, and show that incorporating contextual information can considerably increase the value of the demand response programs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于神经网络的上下文能源定价算法，将定价建模为Stackelberg博弈并利用平均场解表示，学习从上下文特征到可行价格信号的约束映射，仿真表明引入上下文信息可显著提升需求响应计划价值。
AI.motivation: 利用时变电价引导消费者需求响应、使能源需求更好匹配可再生能源发电具有重要价值。但最优价格通常随时间变化，需响应天气预报、日出日落时间、星期模式等复杂信号，现有方法难以有效利用这些丰富的上下文信息。
AI.method: 提出基于神经网络的上下文能源定价算法：将定价问题建模为Stackelberg博弈，借助Mehrabi等（2024）的平均场解表示，学习从上下文特征到可行价格信号的约束映射。
AI.result: 通过模拟若干美国城市的能源电网进行验证，结果显示融入上下文信息能够显著提升需求响应计划的价值。
AI.conclusion: 上下文信息对能源定价至关重要，所提神经网络方法可有效学习可行价格映射并提升需求响应效益。

title: Inference for stochastic differential equations driven by weighted sub-fractional Brownian motion using neural networks and the Euler approximation
summary:
We consider the estimation of drift, diffusion, and noise covariance from discrete observations of stochastic differential equations driven by Gaussian processes. For a fixed observation horizon $T>0$ and a known initial state $x_0\in\mathbb R$, we study \begin{equation*}
  dX_t=a(X_t)\,dt+σ(X_t)\,dZ_t^{β,f},
  \qquad X_0=x_0,\quad 0\leq t\leq T. \end{equation*} \smallskip\noindent Here $a:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is the drift coefficient, $σ:\mathbb R\to(0,\infty)$ is the diffusion coefficient, and $Z^{β,f}$ is a centered Gaussian process from the weighted sub-fractional Brownian family, with covariance \begin{equation*}
  \operatorname{Cov}(Z_s^{β,f},Z_t^{β,f})
  =\int_0^{s\wedge t} f(r)q_β(s-r,t-r)\,dr,
  \qquad 0\leq s,t\leq T. \end{equation*} \smallskip\noindent Here $s\wedge t=\min\{s,t\}$. The temporal weight $f:[0,T]\to[0,\infty)$ is measurable, bounded, and positive almost everywhere, and $β\in(0,2)$ is the covariance exponent. For $u,v\geq0$, the kernel is $q_β(u,v)=[u^β+v^β-(u+v)^β]/(1-β)$ when $β\ne1$. Its continuous extension at $β=1$ is $q_1(u,v)=(u+v)\log(u+v)-u\log u-v\log v$, with $0\log0=0$.
  Using the Euler approximation, we reconstruct the Gaussian driving increments from observed transitions and use their joint density to obtain a trajectory likelihood.
