Neural and radial-basis representations model the drift, diffusion, and normalized temporal weight, while a likelihood profile estimates the covariance exponent and diffusion scale. We compare the method with two neural alternatives on the same simulated trajectories in twenty coefficient settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究加权次分数布朗运动驱动的随机微分方程中漂移、扩散、噪声协方差及协方差指数的估计问题，通过Euler近似重构高斯增量并结合轨迹似然、神经网络与径向基表示进行参数估计，并与两种神经方法在二十种系数设定下进行比较。
AI.motivation: 从离散观测中估计随机微分方程的漂移、扩散与噪声协方差是重要问题，而现有工作多针对标准布朗运动驱动情形。对于加权次分数布朗族这一类具有一般协方差结构的高斯过程驱动方程，如何在固定观测区间内联合估计漂移、扩散、时变权重及协方差指数尚缺乏系统方法，因此本文提出相应估计框架。
AI.method: 考虑方程 dX_t=a(X_t)dt+σ(X_t)dZ_t^{β,f}，其中 Z^{β,f} 为加权次分数布朗过程，协方差由时间权重 f 与核 q_β 给出。利用Euler近似从观测转移中重构高斯驱动增量，并用其联合密度构造轨迹似然。采用神经网络与径向基表示来建模漂移、扩散及归一化时间权重，再通过似然剖面估计协方差指数 β 与扩散尺度。
AI.result: 在二十种系数设定下，将所提方法与两种神经替代方法在相同模拟轨迹上进行比较，以评估其估计性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了针对加权次分数布朗驱动随机微分方程的似然估计框架，可联合估计漂移、扩散、噪声协方差及协方差指数，并通过仿真对比实验验证方法表现。

title: Block Optimism for Nonstationary Bandits with Latent Linear Dynamics
summary: We study an endogenous nonstationary stochastic bandit problem with latent linear dynamics, where actions affect both immediate rewards and the future evolution of an unobserved latent state. Rewards are bilinear in the current action and latent state, inducing history-dependent rewards and a nontrivial long-horizon planning problem. The existing explore-then-commit approach achieves $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret by uniformly exploring to estimate the latent dynamics and then committing to an optimized open-loop action sequence. We show that this rate can be improved via adaptive block-level optimism. Our key step is a cyclic approximation: under stable dynamics, the infinite-memory reward process can be truncated, and the open-loop benchmark can be approximated by optimizing a finite-memory block-level proxy. Building on this reduction, we propose a UCB-based block algorithm that maintains confidence sets for the truncated dynamics parameters and selects blocks optimistically. We prove a regret bound of order $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$, significantly improving over the previous $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ guarantee for the same model. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$ regret guarantee for latent linear-dynamics bandits with bilinear reward observations and an open-loop action-sequence benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究具有潜在线性动态的内生非平稳随机赌博机问题，通过自适应块级乐观算法将遗憾从 $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ 改进至 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$。
AI.motivation: 在此类问题中，动作同时影响即时奖励与未观测潜在状态的未来演化，奖励为动作与潜在状态的双线性函数，导致奖励依赖历史且存在非平凡的长程规划难题。已有 explore-then-commit 方法仅达到 $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ 遗憾，作者希望突破这一速率瓶颈。
AI.method: 核心是循环近似（cyclic approximation）：在稳定动态下，将无限记忆奖励过程截断，并用有限记忆的块级代理来近似开环基准。基于此归约，提出一种基于 UCB 的块算法，维护截断动态参数的置信集并乐观地选择动作块。
AI.result: 证明了 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$ 的遗憾上界，显著优于同模型下此前的 $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ 保证；据作者所知，这是首个针对具有双线性奖励观测和开环动作序列基准的潜在线性动态赌博机达到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$ 遗憾的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过循环近似与块级乐观策略，可有效处理潜在线性动态赌博机中的长程规划与历史依赖问题，实现接近最优的 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt T)$ 遗憾。

title: The Price of Correlated Tests: How Strict Should a Model Release Gate Be?
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Submitted to ACDSA 2027
summary: Before a machine learning model ships, it often has to pass a suite of automated tests. Requiring every test to pass looks safe, yet it can reject many models that would have served users well, and it does not say how trustworthy a passing model actually is. We treat the release gate as a design problem: choose how many tests a model must pass so that cleared models meet a stated reliability target, while keeping as many good models as possible. A two-class latent-factor model makes both costs explicit and reduces each calculation to a one-dimensional integral. We prove that when both classes share the same latent correlation, a stricter gate always raises reliability, so the gate that keeps the most good models is the most lenient one that still meets the target. Under pass-all gating, any reliability target short of perfection is attainable within the model, but the share of good models kept tends to zero as the suite grows. Correlation between tests sets the price. In one configuration, a 99 percent target needs 8 independent tests, but 74 tests at a latent correlation of 0.3 and 5,182 at 0.5, where the gate keeps fewer than one good model in ten. We also give a validation procedure, built on exact binomial bounds, that certifies a gate from labelled data even when the gate is chosen from a fixed shortlist.

AI.tldr: 将模型发布门控形式化为设计问题：在满足可靠性目标前提下，选用最少测试数以最大化保留优质模型；用两类潜因子模型推导解析结果并给出验证程序。
AI.motivation: 现有做法要求模型通过全部自动化测试，虽看似安全，却会错误拒绝许多本可服务用户的模型，且无法量化“通过模型”的实际可信度。
AI.method: 采用两类潜因子模型刻画优质/劣质模型与测试相关性，将门控代价计算化为单维积分；证明同类共享潜相关时严格门控单调提升可靠性；分析全通过门控下的可达性与测试相关性影响；基于精确二项界提出可对固定候选短名单中选出的门控进行认证的验证流程。
AI.result: 全通过门控下任意非完美可靠性目标在模型内可达，但随测试集增大，保留的优质模型比例趋于零；相关性决定成本：某配置下99%目标需8个独立测试，潜相关0.3需74个，0.5需5,182个，且此时十中留不足一个优质模型。
AI.conclusion: 发布门控应被视为可靠性—保留率的权衡设计；最松但达标门控最优，测试间相关性是成本核心，且可用精确二项界在有标签数据上认证门控。

title: Tolerance-Based Fairness Auditing: Violation Certification and Sensitivity Screening
summary: As artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed, algorithmic unfairness has raised growing concerns and intensified demands for transparent fairness auditing. In practice, the tolerable degree of algorithmic unfairness depends on the specific legal, ethical, or application context. Given a prespecified tolerance threshold, an important statistical question is how to determine whether a group disparity exceeds the allowable tolerance across different auditing objectives. To address this problem, we develop a unified tolerance-based fairness auditing framework for two complementary auditing objectives: violation certification, which prioritizes control of false violation declarations, and sensitivity screening, which prioritizes reducing missed violations. For the first objective, we develop a constrained empirical likelihood test for formal settings that uses least-favorable-point calibration and can be combined with false flagging rate control for simultaneous subgroup auditing. For the second objective, we develop split empirical likelihood and adjusted split empirical likelihood tests using an adaptive boundary-proxy principle for early-warning settings. Numerical experiments show the distinct error-control--sensitivity trade-offs of these procedures. A COMPAS analysis illustrates the framework in predictive fairness auditing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的基于容忍度阈值的公平性审计框架，针对“违规认证”和“敏感性筛查”两个互补目标，分别构建约束经验似然检验与（调整）分裂经验似然检验，实现错误控制与灵敏度的可调权衡，并在数值实验与COMPAS数据中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能部署增多，算法不公平引发关注，实践中可容忍的不公平程度取决于具体法律、伦理或应用场景。给定预设容忍阈值后，如何在不同审计目标下判断群体差异是否超出允许容忍度，是一个重要的统计问题。
AI.method: 提出统一的基于容忍度的公平性审计框架，面向两个互补目标：(1) 违规认证——优先控制错误的违规声明，采用约束经验似然检验，使用最不利点校准，并可结合错误标记率控制以实现子群同时审计；(2) 敏感性筛查——优先减少漏检违规，采用分裂经验似然检验与调整分裂经验似然检验，基于自适应边界代理原则，面向早期预警场景。
AI.result: 数值实验展示了这些程序在错误控制与灵敏度之间存在明显不同的权衡关系；COMPAS分析示例说明了该框架在预测公平性审计中的应用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为基于容忍阈值的算法公平性审计提供了统一的统计推断工具，通过针对不同审计目标设计相应检验程序，实现错误声明控制与漏检减少之间的灵活平衡，并具备实际应用可行性。

title: Posterior sampling by source-space MCMC via prior-based few-step transport maps
summary: Bayesian inference increasingly uses informative but implicit priors represented only by samples, such as historical ensembles, simulator outputs, and pretrained generative models. The same computational problem appears in the test-time guidance task (generalized Bayes), where an explicit positive weight, e.g., an exponentiated reward, tilts an implicit prior. We develop a framework for source-space generalized Bayesian inference that combines inexpensive few-step prior transports with posterior stability guarantees. Specifically, we represent the prior using a one- or few-step improved MeanFlow (iMF) map and perform posterior sampling in its Gaussian source space. We establish Wasserstein error bounds between the exact and learned posteriors in terms of the joint population iMF and auxiliary-velocity loss, decomposed into training suboptimality and model-class approximation error. In the iMF source space, we adopt parallel tempering with preconditioned Crank-Nicolson updates and introduce a hybrid variant that incorporates split Hamiltonian Monte Carlo to improve sampling efficiency. Synthetic experiments show that the proposed framework can approximate posterior distributions accurately and efficiently, while CLIP-guided ImageNet experiments demonstrate its ability to steer a pretrained iMF image prior toward text-specified preferences.

AI.tldr: 提出源空间广义贝叶斯推断框架，用少步iMF映射表示隐式先验并在高斯源空间采样，给出Wasserstein误差界，配合PT-pCN与混合HMC提升采样效率，在合成与CLIP引导ImageNet任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 隐式先验（历史集合、模拟器输出、预训练生成模型）只能以样本形式给出，无法写出显式密度；测试时引导（广义贝叶斯）中显式正权重会扭曲该隐式先验。现有方法缺乏对学习后验与精确后验之间误差的量化保证，也缺少在低代价条件下的高效采样方案。
AI.method: 用1步或少数步改进MeanFlow（iMF）映射表示先验，将后验采样转移到其高斯源空间；理论建立精确后验与学习后验的Wasserstein误差界，误差由联合总体iMF损失与辅助速度损失刻画，并分解为训练次优性与模型类逼近误差。采样上采用带预条件Crank–Nicolson更新的并行回火（PT-pCN），并提出引入分裂哈密顿蒙特卡洛的混合变体。
AI.result: 合成实验表明框架能以较高精度和效率逼近后验分布；CLIP引导的ImageNet实验表明可将预训练iMF图像先验引导至文本指定的偏好方向。
AI.conclusion: 将隐式先验的广义贝叶斯后验采样转化为iMF源空间问题，可同时获得采样效率与可证明的稳定性保证（Wasserstein误差界），并可通过PT-pCN及混合HMC变体进一步提升效率，具备向文本引导图像生成等实际任务推广的能力。

title: Optimal Transport Meets Reinforcement Learning: A Survey
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms frequently compare probability distributions, such as state visitation distributions induced by policies and experts, action distributions from learned policies and offline datasets, or transition distributions from learned models and environments. However, commonly used divergences may become ineffective when these distributions overlap weakly, which is frequently encountered in imitation learning, offline RL, and deployment under distribution shift. Optimal transport (OT) offers an alternative by measuring the cost of \emph{moving} probability mass from one distribution to another under a ground cost that encodes task geometry. This survey covers how OT is used inside RL objectives and algorithms. For each method, we identify: the role OT plays, the distributions compared, the OT formulation used, and the treatment of temporal structure. Beyond categorising existing methods, we discuss the motivations behind different OT choices, practical considerations such as cost design and computational challenges, and highlight open problems including scalable trajectory-level transport, principled handling of mass mismatch, and theoretical analysis for OT-regularised RL.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了最优传输（OT）如何在强化学习（RL）的目标函数与算法中用于比较概率分布，并归纳了各方法的OT角色、比较对象、OT形式与时间结构处理方式。
AI.motivation: RL算法常需比较概率分布（如策略与专家的状态访问分布、学习策略与离线数据集的动作分布、学习模型与环境的转移分布）。但常用散度在分布重叠较弱时失效，而这一情形在模仿学习、离线RL和分布偏移下的部署中频繁出现，因此需要OT这类通过"移动"概率质量来度量差异的工具。
AI.method: 综述性研究：对每类方法进行结构化分析，明确四个维度——OT所扮演的角色、被比较的分布、采用的OT公式（formulation）、以及时间结构的处理方式；并进一步讨论不同OT选择背后的动机、代价设计与计算挑战等实践考量。
AI.result: 形成了对OT-RL方法的分类体系，并揭示了若干开放问题：可扩展的轨迹级传输、质量不匹配（mass mismatch）的原则化处理、以及OT正则化RL的理论分析。
AI.conclusion: OT为弱重叠分布下的RL提供了有效的分布比较工具，已被嵌入多种RL目标与算法；但轨迹级可扩展性、质量不匹配处理与理论分析仍是待解决的关键方向。

title: Zero Flux: Flow-Based Comparison of High-Dimensional Discrete Distributions
summary: Comparing two high-dimensional discrete distributions has always been a challenging task due to the exponentially growing state space and complex changes in interactions. A recent work suggests comparing distributions through a vector field trained using flow matching between two continuous distributions. The resulting vector field at mid-point vanishes if and only if two distributions identical. However, such a flow-based criterion does not naturally apply to discrete distributions. We extend this principle to the discrete domain and introduce the \emph{Zero Flux} criterion, a discrepancy based on local probability fluxes. Under independent coupling, we show that all local probability fluxes vanish at the midpoint if and only if two distributions are the same. This discrepancy decomposes the joint distributional difference into smaller, local contributions and can be efficiently estimated from samples. We establish finite sample error bounds for our estimator. Experiments on synthetic and real categorical data demonstrate reliable recovery of sparse dependence signals and stable tracking of distribution shifts in high dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该论文将连续域中基于流匹配的"中点向量场消失"判据推广到离散分布，提出Zero Flux判据，通过局部概率通量刻画两个高维离散分布的差异，并给出有限样本误差界与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 高维离散分布的比较因状态空间随维度指数增长、变量间交互复杂而极具挑战。已有工作利用流匹配在连续分布间训练向量场，以中点向量场是否消失判断分布是否相同，但该方法无法自然适用于离散分布，因此需要将其原理推广到离散域。
AI.method: 提出Zero Flux判据：基于离散概率的局部通量构造差异度量。在独立耦合下证明，两个分布在"中点"处的所有局部概率通量均消失当且仅当两分布相同。该方法将联合分布差异分解为若干局部贡献，可由样本高效估计，并建立了估计量的有限样本误差界。
AI.result: 理论上证明了中点局部通量消失与分布相等之间的等价性，并给出有限样本误差界；在合成数据与真实类别数据上的实验表明，方法能可靠恢复稀疏依赖信号，并在高维情形下稳定追踪分布漂移。
AI.conclusion: Zero Flux为高维离散分布比较提供了一个可分解、可高效估计且具有理论保证的新判据，在稀疏依赖检测与分布漂移追踪等任务上表现稳定有效。

title: The hidden advantage of mask resampling: a theory of masked autoencoders
summary: Why can masked prediction learn useful representations that unmasked reconstruction misses? We study this question in a high-dimensional model of a masked autoencoder (MAE) trained on data with shared latent structure and heterogeneous noise. We prove that masked linear reconstruction can recover the latent feature at linear sample complexity in regimes where unmasked linear reconstruction, equivalent to PCA, fails. The analysis also quantifies the statistical advantage of mask resampling, an established ingredient of masked pretraining. By introducing a fixed collection of $K$ masks per sample, we characterize its effect on feature recovery and downstream performance, identifying regimes where greater mask diversity lowers sample complexity. Guided by this prediction, we find that random cropping and flipping in standard image-training pipelines can obscure the advantage of mask resampling by renewing the prediction task even when the patch mask is fixed. Removing these transformations reveals a downstream advantage for dynamic over static masking in CNN autoencoders and vision transformers. A complementary BERT pilot finds benefits from greater mask diversity on downstream language tasks. Our results separate the benefit of the masked prediction objective from that of mask diversity, and show how a tractable theory can guide experiments that uncover advantages hidden by standard training practices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高维理论模型证明掩码线性重建在PCA失效时仍能以线性样本复杂度恢复潜在特征，并量化掩码重采样（掩码多样性）的统计优势，进而指导实验发现：标准图像训练中的随机裁剪与翻转会掩盖动态掩码的优势，去除后可见动态掩码优于静态掩码，BERT实验也验证了更大掩码多样性的下游收益。
AI.motivation: 掩码预测（如MAE、BERT）能学到有用表征，而无掩码重建（等价于PCA）却常常失败，但二者差异的理论根源尚不清晰；同时掩码预测目标本身的收益与掩码重采样/多样性带来的收益未被分离，且标准训练实践可能隐藏了掩码多样性的优势。
AI.method: 构建共享潜在结构、异构噪声的高维掩码自编码器理论模型；用理论分析掩码线性重建与无掩码线性重建（PCA）的样本复杂度差异；引入每样本K个固定掩码的集合，刻画掩码多样性对特征恢复与下游性能的影响；并据此设计受理论引导的实验：在CNN自编码器与ViT上比较动态与静态掩码，控制随机裁剪/翻转，另做BERT验证实验。
AI.result: 理论上证明掩码线性重建可在无掩码重建（PCA）失败的区间以线性样本复杂度恢复潜在特征，并量化掩码重采样优势，给出掩码多样性越大样本复杂度越低的区间；实验发现标准图像训练中随机裁剪与翻转会通过更新预测任务而掩盖掩码重采样的优势，去除后CNN自编码器与ViT上动态掩码均优于静态掩码；BERT初步实验显示更大掩码多样性对下游语言任务有益。
AI.conclusion: 研究将掩码预测目标的收益与掩码多样性的收益分离开来，表明掩码预测的优势部分来自掩码多样性/重采样；并说明可处理的理论可以指导实验，揭示被标准训练实践所掩盖的有利因素。

title: Error-Corrected Inference-Time Scaling for Imperfect Diffusion Models
summary: Inference-time scaling adapts pretrained diffusion models to new sampling tasks without additional training. Existing methods rely primarily on Monte Carlo sampling with more particles, yet are premised on the pretrained model being exact. In practice, data and training limitations make the model imperfect, and these methods inherit its error. More particles reduce Monte Carlo error but cannot remove the mismatch between the endpoint and the desired target or the error in tracking the prescribed probability path. We introduce the Energy-based Feynman-Kac Corrector (EBFKC), a framework for energy-based diffusion models that corrects these errors on the fly given a reference energy. We first derive Feynman-Kac dynamics that track a prescribed path exactly in the continuous-time population limit even when the model is imperfect, and approximate these dynamics using sequential Monte Carlo with variance-controlling guidance. To remove the endpoint mismatch, we use the pretrained energy as a surrogate along the diffusion path and progressively incorporate the discrepancy between the learned and target terminal energies. Experiments on Gaussian mixture models, particle systems, alanine dipeptide, and alanine tetrapeptide show that our method closely matches target distributions and molecular free-energy profiles under annealing and reward tilting, whereas standard inference-time scaling baselines retain substantial sampling errors.

AI.tldr: 提出基于能量的Feynman-Kac校正器（EBFKC），在推理阶段实时校正不完美扩散模型的路径跟踪误差与端点失配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时扩展方法依赖蒙特卡洛采样增加粒子数，但前提是预训练模型精确；实际中数据与训练限制使模型不完美，增加粒子只能降低蒙特卡洛误差，无法消除端点与目标分布的失配及概率路径跟踪误差。
AI.method: 针对基于能量的扩散模型，推导Feynman-Kac动力学，在连续时间总体极限下即使模型不完美也能精确跟踪指定路径；用带方差控制引导的序贯蒙特卡洛近似该动力学；将预训练能量作为扩散路径上的代理，并渐进引入学习到的终端能量与目标终端能量之间的差异以消除端点失配。
AI.result: 在高斯混合模型、粒子系统、丙氨酸二肽和丙氨酸四肽上的实验表明，方法在退火与奖励倾斜设置下能紧密匹配目标分布和分子自由能曲线，而标准推理时扩展基线仍保留显著采样误差。
AI.conclusion: EBFKC为不完美扩散模型提供了实时误差校正的推理框架，显著提升采样对目标分布与自由能剖面的匹配精度。

title: Wasserstein Gradient Flows and Forward-Only Diffusion Are Not Enough for Multimodal Sampling
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Position Track
summary: There has been a proliferation of sampling algorithms based on Wasserstein gradient flows (WGF) and forward-only diffusion processes (FODP), often accompanied by theoretical guarantees of exponentially fast convergence to the target distribution. These guarantees are frequently interpreted as evidence that such methods can efficiently sample complex multimodal distributions, often supported by empirical results. In this work, we argue that this interpretation is fundamentally misleading. By invoking the Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) scheme and Otto calculus, we establish that the canonical WGF sampling dynamics and overdamped forward diffusion share the same density evolution and therefore inherit the same metastability and slow-mixing phenomena long understood in nonequilibrium statistical physics. We analyze this family of samplers using two complementary tools -- spectral analysis and mean first-passage time (MFPT) analysis -- and show that well-separated multimodality can induce exponentially long mixing times associated with small spectral gaps and rare inter-mode transitions. For the commonly adopted log-linear annealing schedule studied here, we find that introducing intermediate distributions does not remove the exponential scaling of the total transport time. The limitation is structural rather than implementation-specific: purely local, gradient-driven transport mechanisms can require exponentially long times to transport probability mass across well-separated modes. We argue that this represents a fundamental limitation of WGF- and FODP-based sampling in their standard forms, and motivates future development of fundamentally nonlocal mechanisms for efficient multimodal sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文论证基于Wasserstein梯度流(WGF)与纯前向扩散(FODP)的采样算法在采样多模态分布时存在结构性局限：其密度演化与非平衡统计物理中的过阻尼扩散相同，共同继承亚稳态与慢混合问题，间距较大的多模态会引发指数级长的混合时间。
AI.motivation: WGF与FODP采样算法广泛被赋予"指数快速收敛到目标分布"的理论保证，且这些保证常被解读为能够高效采样复杂多模态分布，并辅以经验结果支持。作者认为这种解读在根本上具有误导性，需要澄清其真实能力边界。
AI.method: 借助Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO)格式与Otto微积分，证明典型WGF采样动力学与过阻尼前向扩散具有相同的密度演化；并使用谱分析与平均首达时间(MFPT)分析两套互补工具，针对常用的对数-线性退火调度研究该类采样器的混合行为。
AI.result: 间距良好的多模态会诱发指数级长的混合时间，对应小谱隙与稀少的模态间跃迁；在所研究的标准对数-线性退火调度下，引入中间分布并不能消除总传输时间的指数缩放。
AI.conclusion: 该局限是结构性的而非实现细节：纯局部、梯度驱动的传输机制跨越良好分离模态传输概率质量时可能需指数级时间，构成WGF与FODP标准形式采样的根本局限，并提示未来需发展本质非局部的机制以实现高效多模态采样。

title: Partial AUC Maximization from Positive-unlabeled Data
summary: The partial area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (pAUC) is an important performance metric for binary classification that summarizes true positive rates within a specific range of false positive rates (FPRs). Classifiers that achieve high pAUC need to be obtained in many real-world applications such as cybersecurity, medical care, and advertising. Although many methods for maximizing the pAUC have been proposed, they typically require both labeled positive and negative data for training. However, in practice, labeled negative data are often difficult to collect due to privacy concerns or the need for high expertise to annotate them. In this paper, we propose a method for maximizing the pAUC from positive and unlabeled (PU) data without negative data. Within an empirical risk minimization framework, we show that the pAUC, including its FPR-dependent thresholds, can be represented using only the positive and marginal densities, and derive an empirical estimator from PU data. A classifier is then trained by maximizing the derived smoothed empirical pAUC estimator. We experimentally demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method with ten real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在仅有正样本和无标签数据的PU设定下最大化部分AUC（pAUC）的方法，通过将pAUC及其FPR相关阈值表示为仅依赖正类密度与边缘密度，推导出PU数据的经验估计量，并训练分类器。
AI.motivation: pAUC是二分类中重要的性能指标，用于刻画特定假正率（FPR）范围内的真正率，广泛用于安全、医疗、广告等场景。但现有pAUC最大化方法通常需要标注的正负样本，而实际中负样本因隐私或标注专业性难以获取。
AI.method: 在经验风险最小化框架下，证明pAUC（包括依赖FPR的阈值）可仅用正类密度和边缘密度表示，据此从正样本与无标签数据（PU数据）推导经验估计量，并最大化平滑后的经验pAUC估计量来训练分类器。
AI.result: 在十个真实数据集上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够在无负样本的PU数据条件下有效最大化pAUC，为负样本难以获取的实际应用提供了可行的分类器训练方案。

title: M$^2$Weather: A Benchmark for Joint Multi-Station and Multi-Variable Weather Forecasting
summary: Station weather forecasting is fundamentally shaped by both complex spatial dependencies across stations and strong physical coupling among weather variables. However, existing studies often consider these relationships separately and use different datasets and experimental settings, hindering systematic assessment of their individual and joint contributions. In this paper, we introduce $M^2$Weather, a benchmark for joint multi-station and multi-variable weather forecasting. Through multi-criteria quality control and station stratification, we collect 2,809 high-quality stations with 5 physically coupled weather variables across three spatial scales: France, Europe, and Global. This multi-scale design lets us examine whether conclusions persist from national to global station networks. We also introduce unified training and evaluation protocols to enable fair comparison of different station-variable modeling paradigms. To further examine the benefits of modeling station-variable relationships, we design a lightweight, plug-and-play adapter. With a trained weather forecasting model, this adapter can introduce missing station or variable relationships without retraining the model. This enables fair and efficient investigation of station-variable relationships. Systematic evaluation of 16 representative models shows the benefits of jointly modeling station and variable relationships. Completing missing relationships further reduces MSE for all adapted models on all three datasets. Together, these results identify the complementary information across stations and variables as an important resource for improving station weather forecasting. Our code can be obtained at https://github.com/hnu-vis/M2-Weather.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 $M^2$Weather 基准，用于多站点-多变量联合天气预报，涵盖法国、欧洲、全球三个空间尺度，共 2,809 个高质量站点和 5 个物理耦合变量，并提供统一训练评估协议与即插即用适配器，系统评估 16 个代表性模型。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将站点间空间依赖与气象变量间物理耦合分开处理，且使用不同数据集和实验设置，难以系统评估二者各自的贡献及联合建模效果。因此需要一个统一基准来公平比较不同建模范式。
AI.method: 通过多标准质量控制和站点分层，收集法国、欧洲、全球三个空间尺度下的 2,809 个高质量站点与 5 个物理耦合气象变量；提出统一的训练和评估协议以支持不同站点-变量建模范式的公平比较；设计轻量级即插即用适配器，可在不重新训练预报模型的情况下引入缺失的站点或变量关系。
AI.result: 对 16 个代表性模型的系统评估表明，联合建模站点与变量关系具有明显收益；补齐缺失关系后，所有适配模型在三个数据集上的 MSE 均进一步降低。
AI.conclusion: 站点间与变量间的互补信息是提升站点天气预报的重要资源；$M^2$Weather 基准与统一协议为系统研究多站点-多变量联合建模提供了标准化平台。

title: STCFormer: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Modeling with Dynamic Cluster Transformer for Station-based Weather Forecasting
summary: Station-based weather forecasting supports daily life and economic activity, yet accurate forecasts require modeling complex spatial dependencies among stations. Recent clustering-based selective modeling offers a promising alternative to dense inter-station interactions. However, a grouping shared across an observation window may obscure local changes in station relationships, while intra-cluster interactions alone may miss important global context. The theoretical advantages of selective interactions over dense connectivity also remain insufficiently understood. We therefore propose STCFormer, an adaptive spatio-temporal Transformer that dynamically groups stations according to their local evolution within each temporal patch. Its Cluster-Guided Attention Block combines fine-grained local attention within clusters and global attention over regional state summaries, allowing each station to access information beyond its own cluster. We further show that a derived Lipschitz upper bound for cluster-conditioned local attention is no larger than its fully connected counterpart, explaining a potential robustness benefit and motivating the design of InfoLoss. Experiments on three real-world weather datasets spanning eight temperature and wind forecasting tasks show that STCFormer achieves the lowest 24-hour mean squared error on all eight tasks and ranks first or second in 47 of 48 comparisons across metrics and forecasting horizons. Ablations and case studies further confirm the benefits of locally adaptive grouping and complementary local-global interactions. Our code can be obtained at https://github.com/hnu-vis/STCFormer.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应时空Transformer模型STCFormer，通过时序片段内的动态站点分组与聚类引导注意力，兼顾局部与全局信息，在多个气象预测任务上取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: 基于站点的气象预报需建模站点间复杂的空间依赖。稠密站点交互计算代价高，而现有基于聚类的选择性建模存在两个缺陷：1）在整个观测窗口内共享的分组会掩盖站点关系的局部变化；2）仅依赖簇内交互会遗漏重要的全局上下文。此外，选择性交互相对稠密连接的理论优势尚缺乏充分理解。
AI.method: 提出STCFormer，一种自适应时空Transformer，在每个时序片段（temporal patch）内依据站点局部演化动态分组。其Cluster-Guided Attention Block结合簇内细粒度局部注意力与基于区域状态摘要的全局注意力，使每个站点能获取簇外信息。理论上推导出聚类条件局部注意力的Lipschitz上界不大于全连接对应形式，解释其鲁棒性优势，并据此设计InfoLoss。
AI.result: 在三个真实气象数据集、涵盖八个温度与风速预测任务上，STCFormer在所有八个任务中取得最低的24小时均方误差，并在跨指标与预测时长的48次比较中47次排名第一或第二。消融实验与案例研究进一步验证了局部自适应分组及局部-全局互补交互的有效性。
AI.conclusion: STCFormer通过时序片段内动态站点分组与局部-全局互补注意力，克服了固定分组和纯簇内交互的局限，并在理论与实验层面验证了选择性交互的优势，代码已开源。

title: FAER: Auditable Utility-Aligned Trajectory Replay for Language Model Post-Training
summary: Replay selectors often rank cached trajectories by format feedback, confidence, freshness, or response length, although cache-level correctness and downstream learner utility are distinct objectives. We formalize this selection-to-learning gap and introduce FAER as an auditable full-trajectory replay framework. Its training-free fixed selector is a protocol baseline; FAER-UTILITY is the learner-aware selector fitted on disjoint calibration blocks. The normalized gradient alignment is reported as a baseline, while a disposable optimizer-aware virtual update supplies a magnitude-aware utility surface. The audit contract freezes observed fields and replay traces before evaluation labels are joined. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, the matched learner study reports quality 0.6329 for the fixed selector, compared with 0.5482 for uniform and 0.6037 for format-feedback under 128 updates. Metadata-only cross-fitted calibration reaches $0.6476\!\pm\!0.0139$ over eight seeds (median 0.6481; paired 95% interval $[+0.079,+0.122]$) at 63,276 target-run tokens; its recorded full cost is 189,642 tokens and 3.48 GPU-hours including calibration. The completed FAER-UTILITY row reaches 0.6624 at 62,844 target-run tokens and 4.26 GPU-hours. Format-feedback selects records with correctness 0.6953, compared with 0.3594 for the fixed selector, despite the different downstream ranking. The completed comparison surfaces report the learner-aware ablation, same-seed gap, policy-optimization rows, and strict zero-shot transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了回放选择目标与下游学习效用之间的"选择-学习差距"，提出可审计的全轨迹回放框架FAER，其中FAER-UTILITY为学习者感知选择器。在GSM8K上，FAER-UTILITY达到0.6624，优于固定选择器(0.6329)、格式反馈(0.6037)与均匀采样(0.5482)。
AI.motivation: 回放选择器常以格式反馈、置信度、新鲜度或响应长度对缓存轨迹排序，但缓存层面的正确性与下游学习者的效用是两个不同目标。作者旨在形式化这一"选择-学习差距"，并构建可审计的回放框架以弥合该差距。
AI.method: 提出FAER可审计全轨迹回放框架。训练无关的固定选择器作为协议基线；FAER-UTILITY为学习者感知选择器，在不相交的校准块上拟合。归一化梯度对齐作为基线，一次可丢弃的优化器感知虚拟更新提供幅度感知的效用曲面。审计契约在评估标签并入前冻结观测字段与回放轨迹。
AI.result: GSM8K + Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，128次更新下：固定选择器质量0.6329，均匀0.5482，格式反馈0.6037。仅元数据交叉拟合校准八种子达0.6476±0.0139（中位数0.6481；配对95%区间[+0.079,+0.122]），目标运行token 63,276，含校准总成本189,642 token与3.48 GPU小时。FAER-UTILITY达0.6624，62,844目标运行token，4.26 GPU小时。格式反馈选取记录的缓存正确率0.6953，固定选择器为0.3594，与下游排序不一致。
AI.conclusion: 缓存层正确性与下游学习效用呈不一致性，学习者感知选择可显著提升回放质量。FAER-UTILITY在质量与成本上均优于各基线，验证了选择-学习差距的形式化及可审计框架的有效性。

title: MatrixReward: Reward from Rubric Matrix for Open-Ended Generation
summary: Open-ended query generation lacks standard answers, thus necessitating an effective reward mechanism. Pointwise scoring rubrics provide limited information about the relative quality of sample answers under the same prompt; merging multiple rubric judgments into a single score may also mask the differences between these answers. We propose MatrixReward, which constructs rewards from a rollout-by-rubric win-rate matrix obtained by comparing every pair of sampled responses under each rubric. The spread of each matrix column captures how strongly that rubric distinguishes the current rollouts, while correlations between columns reveal rubric repetition; together, these statistics yield data-dependent rubric weights. We combine these weights with the prior weights of rubrics. After column normalization and weighting, the observed per-rubric maxima and minima define positive and negative ideal profiles. Each rollout's distances to these two ideals determine its relative-closeness quality reward. Evaluated using Qwen3-8B on four open-ended query-answering benchmarks, MatrixReward achieves an average score of 63.02, outperforming the strongest baseline by approximately 2.0%. These results support the idea that matrices derived from relative comparisons can be used to construct rewards more reasonably for open-ended generative reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 MatrixReward，用 rollout-by-rubric 胜率矩阵构建数据依赖的评分权重与相对贴近度奖励，在四个开放式问答基准上以 Qwen3-8B 平均得分 63.02，超出最强基线约 2.0%。
AI.motivation: 开放式查询生成缺乏标准答案，亟需有效的奖励机制。逐点评分（pointwise scoring）量规仅提供有限信息，难以反映同一提示下样本答案的相对质量；将多个量规判断合并为单一分数还可能掩盖答案之间的差异。
AI.method: MatrixReward 通过在每个量规下两两比较采样回答，构建 rollout-by-rubric 胜率矩阵。矩阵各列的离散度反映该量规对当前 rollouts 的区分能力，列间相关性揭示量规重复性，二者共同产生数据依赖的量规权重，并与量规先验权重结合。经列归一化与加权后，用观测到的各量规最大值与最小值定义正、负理想画像（ideal profiles）；每个 rollout 到两个理想点的距离决定其相对贴近度质量奖励。
AI.result: 在四个开放式查询问答基准上使用 Qwen3-8B 评测，MatrixReward 平均得分 63.02，较最强基线提升约 2.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于相对比较构建的矩阵能够为开放式生成式强化学习更合理地构造奖励。

title: RACE: Residual-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Neighbor-Rich Time-Series Foundation Model Forecasting
comment: 25 pages including references and appendices; 8 figures
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) perform strongly across forecasting tasks, but their per-series inference is ill-suited to neighbor-rich forecasting, where each query has access to related but nonidentical historical series. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) and Web/cloud workloads exemplify this setting: CGM trajectories share physiological patterns but vary across individuals, devices, and conditions, while Web/cloud workloads combine common operating regimes with non-stationarity, heavy tails, and bursts. These histories share useful structure, yet neighbors are not equally relevant. Existing methods either fine-tune TSFMs for each target domain, incurring additional costs and offering limited transferability across backbones, or append retrieved series without verifying whether they support the current forecast. The key challenges are conflicting residual evidence from neighboring series and residual patterns that vary across TSFMs and forecasting tasks. We formulate test-time neighborhood scaling: using same-domain neighbor evidence without modifying the backbone. We propose RACE (Residual-Aware Correction of Forecasting Errors), a two-stage framework for using historical neighbors. We first retrieve query-compatible neighbors, align their residuals to the query scale, and aggregate coherent evidence into the training-free RACE-TF correction. Full RACE then uses a lightweight, domain-specific Gate to determine when applying the correction is beneficial, with a reusable training workflow across TSFM backbones. Across four TSFMs, RACE improves all three domain-aggregate metrics on both primary domains, with the largest gains on high-error queries. Within each domain, a Gate trained on one TSFM transfers to other backbones without adaptation, and the resulting pipeline improves all 72 cross-backbone metric comparisons over the matched frozen targets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出测试时邻域缩放（test-time neighborhood scaling）问题，并提出RACE框架，在不修改骨干模型的前提下利用同域邻居证据校正时序基础模型的预测误差，在CGM与Web/云负载两大域、四个TSFM上均取得一致提升，且跨骨干迁移性良好。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型（TSFM）在预测任务上表现强劲，但其逐序列推理方式不适合"邻居丰富"的预测场景——即每个查询序列都存在相关但非同源的历史序列可供参考（如CGM与Web/云负载）。这些历史序列共享有用结构，但相关性并不均等。现有方法要么为每个目标域微调TSFM（成本高、跨骨干迁移性差），要么直接拼接检索序列而不验证其是否支持当前预测。核心难点在于：邻居残差证据可能相互冲突，且残差模式随TSFM与任务而变化。
AI.method: 提出测试时邻域缩放设定，即在冻结骨干的前提下使用同域邻居证据。具体提出RACE（Residual-Aware Correction of Forecasting Errors）两阶段框架：首先检索与查询兼容的邻居，将其残差对齐到查询尺度，并聚合一致证据形成免训练的RACE-TF校正；完整RACE进一步引入轻量、域特定的Gate，判断何时施加校正有益，并配有一套可跨TSFM骨干复用的训练流程。
AI.result: 在四个TSFM上，RACE在两大主域的全部三项域聚合指标上均有提升，且在高误差查询上增益最大。在每个域内，于某一TSFM上训练的Gate可无需适配地迁移到其他骨干；由此得到的流程在匹配冻结目标的全部72项跨骨干指标比较中均获改善。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，无需修改骨干即可在测试时利用同域邻居证据有效校正TSFM预测误差；RACE通过残差对齐与聚合、以及可迁移的轻量Gate，实现了跨骨干的一致增益，为邻居丰富场景下的时序基础模型部署提供了低成本、可复用的解决方案。

title: VANDAM: Viewing a nucleotide sequence with DNA molecular priors
summary: Contemporary Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) rely on a DNA-as-a-string paradigm that employs masked token prediction objectives for pretraining. However, this abstraction does not explicitly model the biochemical, structural, and physical properties essential to biological function. Many molecular properties can be estimated from sequence using established biophysical models, so their utility lies not in providing an independent modality, but in introducing priors that training objectives can explicitly exploit. We introduce VANDAM, a framework that extends the training of GFMs with DNA molecular priors. In self-supervised training, VANDAM predicts regional molecular properties from pooled representations. When functional labels are available and can reward retaining molecular priors, local features are additionally injected at the input. VANDAM consistently improves downstream performance across four architecture families and nine held-out genomic tasks by complementing token-based objectives. Probing experiments further demonstrate that the use of molecular priors generalizes to other unseen molecular properties.

AI.tldr: VANDAM通过引入DNA分子先验（区域分子性质预测与局部特征注入）扩展基因组基础模型的自监督训练，在四类架构、九个基因组任务上稳定提升下游性能，并可泛化到未见分子性质。
AI.motivation: 现有基因组基础模型（GFMs）采用"DNA即字符串"范式，仅以掩码token预测为预训练目标，未显式建模对生物功能至关重要的生化、结构与物理性质；而这些分子性质可由序列借助成熟生物物理模型估计，其价值在于作为训练目标可显式利用的先验，而非独立模态。
AI.method: 提出VANDAM框架，在GFM训练中引入DNA分子先验：自监督训练时，由池化表示预测区域分子性质；当具备可奖励保留分子先验的功能标签时，在输入端额外注入局部特征。
AI.result: 在四种架构家族、九个留出基因组任务上，VANDAM通过补充基于token的目标一致提升下游性能；探针实验表明分子先验的使用可泛化至其他未见分子性质。
AI.conclusion: 将可估计的分子性质作为显式先验融入预训练目标，是对token级目标的有效补充，能跨架构与任务提升基因组基础模型表现并展现泛化性。

title: IrekoGPT: Turning Structured Pruning into Post-Hoc Slimmable LLMs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "AXIOM: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning". 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: We introduce IrekoGPT, a post-hoc method for converting pretrained LLMs into slimmable models whose width can be adjusted at inference time. Building on SliceGPT, we retain its projection matrices without pruning them, allowing a single model to expose nested subnetworks at different widths. We improve robustness by calibrating each layer across multiple compression ratios, and correct downstream linear layers through gradient-free ridge regression. Across Llama and Qwen models, preliminary results show improvements over naive PCA-based slimming, with the largest gains at high compression. Code is available at https://github.com/aimagelab/IrekoGPT

AI.tldr: IrekoGPT 是一种后处理方法，可将预训练 LLM 转换为宽度可在推理时调节的 slimmable 模型，基于 SliceGPT 保留投影矩阵并校准多层压缩率，结合无梯度岭回归修正，在 Llama 和 Qwen 上优于朴素 PCA 剪裁，高压缩率下增益最大。
AI.motivation: 现有 slimmable/剪裁方法（如 SliceGPT、PCA 剪裁）在单一压缩率下工作，无法让同一模型在推理时灵活暴露不同宽度的嵌套子网络；且高压缩率下性能退化明显，需要更鲁棒的后处理方案。
AI.method: 基于 SliceGPT，保留其投影矩阵而不剪裁，从而使单一模型在不同宽度下暴露嵌套子网络；对每一层在多个压缩率下进行校准以提升鲁棒性；并通过无梯度岭回归（gradient-free ridge regression）修正下游线性层。
AI.result: 在 Llama 和 Qwen 系列模型上，初步结果显示该方法优于基于朴素 PCA 的剪裁，且在高压缩率下取得最大增益。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: IrekoGPT 提供了一种简单有效的后处理途径，将预训练 LLM 转为可调宽度的 slimmable 模型，在高压缩场景下优势尤其明显；未来可进一步扩展到更多模型与更系统的评测。

title: Exact information accounting for SGD methods
summary: As an alternative to the standard geometric analyses, we give an exact, information-theoretic analysis of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants. We show that a preconditioned SGD step is the posterior-mean update of a Gaussian Bayes model, and that its one-step regret splits into an intrinsic-time cost and a change in comparator information. The split extends to an identity for the objective itself. Convex convergence, strict-saddle-point escape, the link between flatness and generalization, the standard learning-rate schedules, adaptive optimizers, and the noisy, momentum, heavy-tailed, and gradient-free variants of SGD each correspond to a term or a special case of this identity. We measure its terms on synthetic and real training runs. On real networks it attributes the slack of classical convergence bounds to the terms their derivations drop and separates optimizers that reach the same training loss. That separation follows the number and consistency of their steps. Its relation to which of them generalizes better differs between networks. For gradient-free SGD the identity determines how a curvature preconditioner should enter the update. The sharpness-based generalization certificate it yields, with a data-independent isotropic prior, is vacuous at network scale unless the curvature spectrum is nearly flat across all parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种精确的信息论分析框架，揭示（预条件）SGD 步骤等价于高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，其单步遗憾可分解为"内在时间成本"与"比较器信息变化"两项，并将凸收敛、鞍点逃逸、平坦性与泛化、学习率调度、自适应优化器及各类 SGD 变体统一为该恒等式的特例或项。
AI.motivation: 标准几何分析仅给出收敛界的近似刻画且常留有余量，作者希望用信息论给出精确、可解释的分解，从而统一理解各类 SGD 变体及其泛化性质。
AI.method: 将预条件 SGD 步骤解释为高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，据此把单步遗憾分解为内在时间成本与比较器信息变化；将目标函数本身也写成相同的恒等式；在合成数据与真实训练中测量各项。
AI.result: 该恒等式将凸收敛、严格鞍点逃逸、平坦性-泛化联系、学习率调度、自适应优化器及噪声/动量/重尾/无梯度变体统一为其中某项或特例；在真实网络上，落差可归因于经典收敛界推导中丢弃的项，并能区分到达相同训练损失的优化器（依据步数与一致性），但优化器区分与泛化优劣的关系随网络而异；对无梯度 SGD 确定了曲率预条件子的进入方式；所导出的基于锐度的泛化证书在网络规模下（数据无关各向同性先验）除非曲率谱在所有参数上近乎平坦，否则为空泛。
AI.conclusion: 该信息论恒等式为 SGD 及其变体提供了精确且具统一性的分析视角，能够解释收敛界的松弛来源并区分优化器，但其锐度泛化证书在网络规模下受曲率谱约束而实际无效。

title: Grand Canonical Generators
summary: We introduce Grand Canonical Generators (GCG), a generative framework that extends Boltzmann generators to the grand canonical ensemble. We present two designs. The first conditions a variable-size generative model on the chemical potential, sampling particle number and configuration jointly. The second factorizes the grand canonical distribution into a particle-number distribution and the corresponding canonical Boltzmann density. This factorized formulation can use any existing Boltzmann generator for the canonical component, encodes the known linear chemical-potential dependence analytically, and yields a tractable likelihood that supports self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Empirically, GCG accurately reproduces grand canonical observables on a Lennard--Jones fluid and methane adsorption in a zeolite, demonstrating generalization across chemical potentials and correction via SNIS and grand canonical Monte Carlo.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Grand Canonical Generators (GCG)，将Boltzmann生成器扩展至巨正则系综，包含两种设计：以化学势为条件联合采样粒子数与构型，以及将巨正则分布分解为粒子数分布与正则Boltzmann密度。
AI.motivation: Boltzmann生成器此前主要针对正则系综（固定粒子数）建模，无法处理粒子数可变且由化学势调控的巨正则系综场景，这在吸附、相平衡等开放体系模拟中十分重要，因此需要将生成式建模推广至巨正则情形。
AI.method: 提出GCG框架，含两种设计：一是将可变尺寸生成模型以化学势为条件，联合采样粒子数与构型；二是将巨正则分布因子化为粒子数分布与对应正则Boltzmann密度的乘积，后者可复用任意现有Boltzmann生成器，并以解析形式编码已知的化学势线性依赖，同时给出可计算的似然，从而支持自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）。
AI.result: 在Lennard-Jones流体与沸石中甲烷吸附两个体系上，GCG能准确复现巨正则系综观测量，展示出跨化学势的泛化能力，并可通过SNIS与巨正则蒙特卡洛进行校正。
AI.conclusion: GCG成功将生成式建模拓展到巨正则系综，所提出的因子化设计兼容既有Boltzmann生成器并提供可计算似然，兼具泛化性与可校正性，为开放体系的生成式采样提供了有效方案。

title: How Divergence Becomes Decision Flips in Compressed Language Models
summary: Compression reports summarize how far a compressed language model moved from the dense one, usually by a KL divergence; a deployment that relies on the dense model's outputs needs to know how many of its decisions changed. We show that total variation, not KL, answers this directly. Across 802 compressed and perturbed copies of 19 open models on five corpora and nine mechanically unrelated perturbation families, the rate at which the arg-max token changes (the \emph{flip rate}) tracks total variation at a ratio with median $1.05$, with no fitted constant. KL converts into flips only through its square root and a factor that varies fourfold across models and corpora, because KL averages over tokens before the root is taken; first-order statistics averaged per token, such as Hellinger distance, avoid this, but reports rarely give them. As a result, of two compressors reported on different models and corpora whose flip rates differ by at least $10%$, KL assigns the smaller divergence to the one that changes more decisions in $11%$ of cases, total variation in $1%$. Two pre-registered tests mark the limits: on a held-out code corpus the ratio held for all eight models while three predictions about KL each failed for half of them or more, and on three new models with real kernels it stayed in its band for 37 of 38 checkpoints but fell below one on code for two models. In vLLM speculative decoding, total variation measured under teacher forcing predicts greedy draft acceptance with a mean relative error of $1.1$--$2.4%$, without the task-specific calibration that KL needs.

AI.tldr: 压缩语言模型的偏离度应以总变差（TV）而非KL散度衡量：arg-max token翻转率与TV之比中位数为1.05，无需拟合常数，而KL需经开方并受四倍变动因子影响。
AI.motivation: 压缩报告通常用KL散度总结压缩模型相对稠密模型的偏离，但部署方真正关心的是稠密模型输出中有多少决策发生改变。KL并不能直接回答这一问题，因为它先对token取平均再开方，导致换算关系随模型和语料剧烈变动。
AI.method: 在19个开源模型的802个压缩与扰动副本上，覆盖五个语料和九个机制上互不相关的扰动族，比较arg-max token翻转率与总变差、KL散度及一阶统计量（如Hellinger距离）的关系。另设两项预注册测试：留出代码语料上的比例验证，以及三个使用真实kernel的新模型在38个检查点上的验证；并在vLLM投机解码中用TV预测贪心草稿接受率。
AI.result: 翻转率与总变差之比中位数为1.05，无拟合常数；KL只能通过其平方根及一个在模型与语料间四倍变动的因子换算为翻转率。当两个压缩器翻转率相差至少10%时，KL在11%的案例中错误地把更小散度分配给改变决策更多的一方，TV仅1%。预注册测试中，代码语料上八模型比例保持而KL三项预测半数以上失败；新模型38个检查点中37个保持在区间内，但两模型在代码上低于1。在vLLM投机解码中，教师在位强制下测得的TV预测贪心草稿接受率，平均相对误差1.1%–2.4%，无需任务特定校准。
AI.conclusion: 总变差是比KL散度更直接、更稳健的压缩语言模型偏离度指标，能无校准地预测决策翻转与投机解码接受率；建议压缩报告优先给出TV等逐token一阶统计量。

title: Sequential Functional Structured Tucker Compression for Large Language Model Attentions
summary: Post-training compression of LLM attention is often formulated as independent matrix approximation, ignoring both the shared structure among attention projections and the representation shift introduced by earlier compression. We propose FTC, a sequential structured compression framework that adapts the approximation to the current compressed model while jointly exploiting the native Q/K/V head structure under a fixed storage budget. The output projection is handled separately to account for the changed post-attention representation. FTC requires neither fine-tuning nor gradient-based recovery. Across seven decoder-only LLMs from 6B to 32B parameters, FTC achieves the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity among the compared methods at every tested keep ratio on five modern GQA models, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. The improvements transfer to downstream tasks and remain substantial at the 32B scale.

AI.tldr: FTC：面向LLM注意力后训练压缩的顺序结构化框架，联合利用Q/K/V头结构并适配压缩后表示漂移，无需微调或梯度恢复，在6B–32B的GQA模型上取得最低WikiText-2困惑度。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM注意力后训练压缩多被建模为独立的矩阵近似，忽略了注意力投影之间的共享结构，以及前序压缩导致的表示漂移（representation shift），从而在激进压缩下性能下降明显。
AI.method: 提出FTC顺序结构化压缩框架：在固定存储预算下，将近似适配到当前已压缩模型，并联合利用原生的Q/K/V头结构；对输出投影单独处理以应对注意力后表示的变化；全程不需要微调或基于梯度的恢复。
AI.result: 在7个6B–32B的decoder-only LLM上，FTC在五个现代GQA模型的每个测试保留率下均取得对比方法中最低的WikiText-2困惑度，激进压缩时增益最大；改进可迁移到下游任务，且在32B规模仍显著。
AI.conclusion: 将注意力压缩建模为顺序结构化问题、并兼顾共享头结构与表示漂移，是无需训练即可提升LLM压缩效果的有效途径。

title: Scalable Multi-Task Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: By learning transferable rewards, inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) enables counterfactual evaluation of agents under modified environments. Such transfer places strict requirements on coverage since target environments affect agents' state occupancy. We propose a multi-task IRL method that pools data across multiple agents with different rewards in the same environment under a low-rank assumption. In addition to alleviating coverage requirements, so each task need not visit every state as long as others do, the method offers scalable evaluation of multiple tasks under new environments as computationally intensive planning scales with rank rather than the number of tasks. We provide finite sample guarantees on reward recovery and on policy learning in new environments. Experiments show our method is robust to limited coverage, recovers rewards on and off of each task's support, transfers to target environments at lower regret than baselines, with its computational advantage over per-task methods widening as tasks grow.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多任务逆强化学习方法，在低秩假设下跨多个不同奖励的智能体汇总数据，缓解覆盖要求并实现可扩展的迁移评估，附带有限样本保证。
AI.motivation: 逆强化学习通过学得可迁移奖励，可在修改后的环境中对智能体进行反事实评估，但目标环境会改变智能体的状态占用，因而对数据覆盖提出严格要求，单任务数据往往难以满足。
AI.method: 在同一环境中对多个具有不同奖励的智能体数据进行汇总，在低秩假设下进行多任务逆强化学习；利用多任务间的共享结构，使每个任务无需访问所有状态，仅需其他任务覆盖即可；规划的计算开销随秩而非任务数量增长。
AI.result: 给出了奖励恢复以及新环境下策略学习的有限样本保证；实验显示方法对有限覆盖具有鲁棒性，能恢复任务支撑集内外的奖励，在新环境中迁移时取得比基线更低的后悔值，且随着任务数增加，其相对逐任务方法的计算优势不断扩大。
AI.conclusion: 多任务低秩逆强化学习可有效缓解覆盖要求并支持可扩展的多任务环境迁移评估，兼具理论保证与实证优势。

title: Learning Multiple Timescales for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Existing approaches to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) struggle with long-horizon tasks. Discounting shrinks value differences between distant states until they fall below the function approximation error, leaving the agent with no signal for ranking states. Temporal abstraction, which treats k environment steps as a single transition, restores this signal at long range, but no single fixed k suits all state-goal distances: large k preserves value differences across long temporal distances while collapsing distinctions between nearby states, and small k does the reverse. We make this trade-off explicit and introduce Generalized Implicit Temporal Abstraction (GITA), which conditions a single value function on k. GITA trains one policy by aggregating advantage-weighted supervision across multiple k values, so scales assigning larger positive advantages to a state-goal pair contribute more strongly to its update. GITA does not need to choose between local resolution and long-range signal; it retains both without committing to a single k. On OGBench, GITA outperforms a broad range of offline GCRL baselines, raising average success rate across all tasks by 25 percentage points (73% relative improvement) over HIQL. It also improves over the strongest fixed-k method, OTA, by 7 percentage points (14% relative).

AI.tldr: 该论文针对离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）中的长时序任务提出 Generalized Implicit Temporal Abstraction（GITA），通过条件化单一价值函数于时间抽象尺度 k，聚合多 k 下的优势加权监督，兼顾局部分辨率与长程信号，在 OGBench 上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 离线 GCRL 在长时序任务中面临困境：折扣会使远距离状态间的价值差异缩小到低于函数逼近误差，导致状态排序信号丢失。时间抽象（将 k 步环境交互视为单步转移）可以恢复远距离信号，但固定 k 存在权衡——大 k 保持长时距的价值差异却模糊近邻状态区分，小 k 则相反，没有单一 k 适用于所有状态-目标距离。
AI.method: 作者显式刻画上述权衡，提出 GITA：将单一价值函数以 k 为条件，通过对多个 k 值聚合优势加权监督来训练一个策略，使给状态-目标对分配更大正优势的尺度对更新贡献更强。GITA 无需在局部分辨率与长程信号间做选择，而是在不固定单一 k 的前提下同时保留两者。
AI.result: 在 OGBench 上，GITA 优于多种离线 GCRL 基线，相比 HIQL 平均成功率提升 25 个百分点（相对提升 73%）；相比最强固定 k 方法 OTA 提升 7 个百分点（相对提升 14%）。
AI.conclusion: GITA 通过条件化价值函数于时间抽象尺度并聚合多尺度优势加权监督，有效缓解离线 GCRL 长时序任务中的信号消失问题，且无需选择单一 k，在基准上实现一致且显著的性能提升。

title: Counterfactual Generation via Flow Matching: Coupling-Sensitive End-to-End Rates
summary: Counterfactual generation seeks to sample outcomes under a hypothetical intervention or decision using observational data collected under the factual assignment mechanism. We develop a flow-matching approach that combines a sample-split, doubly robust training objective with a learned coupling between observed source outcomes and target outcomes drawn from a fitted conditional outcome model. To enable finite-step generation, we leverage a score-corrected stochastic sampler based on a Gaussian-smoothed interpolation. Our main theoretical contribution is a coupling-sensitive KL bound for constant-step Euler discretization: the error is controlled by moments of the source--target displacement under the chosen coupling, rather than by global uniform regularity of the velocity field, and has near-linear dependence on the ambient dimension. We also establish finite-sample non-parametric guarantees for the learned velocity and score fields when both the conditional outcome model and the source-target coupling are estimated from data. These bounds separate approximation, coupling-replacement, nuisance-estimation, generalization, and Monte Carlo errors and, combined with the sampler analysis, yield an end-to-end guarantee for counterfactual generation. Experiments on synthetic and semi-synthetic image benchmarks support the coupling-dependent theory and show that, at finite discretization budgets, the stochastic sampler can outperform the corresponding deterministic ODE sampler.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于流匹配的反事实生成方法，结合样本分割的双稳健训练目标与学习到的源-目标耦合，并给出耦合敏感的KL误差界与端到端保证。
AI.motivation: 反事实生成需在仅观测到事实分配机制下采样假设干预或决策的结果，传统方法在有限步离散化与耦合选择上缺乏理论刻画。
AI.method: 采用流匹配框架，结合样本分割的双稳健训练目标与从拟合条件结果模型抽取的目标结果之间学习耦合；使用基于高斯平滑插值的分数校正随机采样器实现有限步生成。
AI.result: 给出常数步Euler离散化的耦合敏感KL界，误差由所选耦合下源-目标位移矩控制而非速度场全局均匀正则性，且对环境维度近似线性；在条件结果模型与耦合均从数据估计时，建立学习到的速度场与分数场的有限样本非参数保证；误差分解为近似、耦合替换、nuisance估计、泛化与蒙特卡洛误差，并结合采样器分析得到端到端保证。合成与半合成图像基准实验支持耦合相关理论，且在有限离散化预算下随机采样器可优于确定性ODE采样器。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为反事实生成提供了耦合敏感的离散化误差理论与端到端统计保证，并表明有限步预算下随机采样具有实证优势。

title: IQS-BO: In-Context Query Selection for Bayesian Optimisation
summary: Bayesian Optimisation (BO) is a powerful framework for the optimisation of expensive black-box functions, but typically requires refitting a surrogate and maximising an acquisition function at every evaluation step. In-context approaches based on Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) amortise part of this cost by pre-training transformers on functions drawn from synthetic priors. PFNs4BO amortises the surrogate but still relies on a numerically maximised acquisition function, while FIBO performs BO fully in-context by sampling optimiser locations from a learned density, which fixes the decision rule and admits no surrogate. Learned acquisition functions score a finite candidate set with a trained network, but, lacking a label for the query, learn the score by reinforcement learning on previously solved tasks. We propose IQS-BO, a PFN that learns the query decision by supervised learning on synthetic priors. In a single forward pass, IQS-BO predicts the probability that each candidate maximises the objective over the set, and we show that the minimiser of its objective is the posterior probability of this event. The model can be pre-trained without a surrogate for fully in-context BO, or take the predictions of a fixed probabilistic surrogate as additional input, amortising only the decision step. Our method proposes queries at a fraction of the cost of acquisition-based methods, while either matching or outperforming standard BO with Gaussian processes (GPs) and available in-context methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. Finally, we propose a mixture prior for pre-training PFNs which combines samples from GPs with functions exhibiting warped inputs, isolated narrow optima, or plateaus that are poorly modeled by stationary kernels common in GP surrogates. We show that pre-training on this prior can lead to improved optimisation performance.

AI.tldr: IQS-BO 是一种基于 PFN 的贝叶斯优化方法，通过监督学习在合成先验上直接学习查询决策，单次前向传播即可预测每个候选点为最优解的概率，实现全上下文或摊销决策步骤的 BO，并配套提出混合先验提升预训练效果。
AI.motivation: 传统 BO 每步需重拟合代理模型并数值最大化采集函数，计算昂贵；PFNs4BO 虽摊销代理但仍依赖数值最大化采集函数，FIBO 固定决策规则且无代理，学习型采集函数又需强化学习且缺乏标签。因此需要一种能用监督学习高效学习查询决策、降低查询成本的方法。
AI.method: 提出 IQS-BO：在合成先验上监督训练 PFN，单次前向传播预测每个候选点在整个集合上最大化目标函数的概率，并证明其目标函数的最小化子即该事件的后验概率。模型可无代理预训练实现全上下文 BO，也可将固定概率代理的预测作为额外输入，仅摊销决策步骤。此外提出混合先验用于 PFN 预训练，将 GP 采样与具有扭曲输入、孤立窄最优或平台特征（平稳核难以建模）的函数结合。
AI.result: IQS-BO 以远低于基于采集函数方法的成本提出查询，在合成与真实基准上匹配或超越标准高斯过程 BO 及现有上下文方法；在混合先验上预训练可进一步提升优化性能。
AI.conclusion: IQS-BO 通过监督学习实现高效的上下文查询决策，显著降低查询成本并保持竞争力；混合先验预训练为提升 PFN 的 BO 性能提供了有效途径。

title: Clifford Sheaf Neural Networks
summary: We introduce the Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN), an equivariant sheaf neural network for geometric graphs that places a Clifford algebra on each stalk of a cellular sheaf and transports multivector features along edges. The canonical choice of restriction map for sheaves with algebra-valued stalks is algebra homomorphism. Adding the constraint of equivariance, the naive choice becomes versor conjugation. However, versor conjugation is expressively weak, so we drop algebra homomorphism and arrive at the K-term sandwich. The resulting sheaf Laplacian is positive semidefinite by construction, needs no versor constraint, and still mixes grades. Our main contribution characterizes the resulting family of restriction maps along three axes: which grades a map couples, how much of the endomorphism space it reaches, and how well it is conditioned. The K-term sandwich spans half of the endomorphism space, and in Cl(3, 0, 0) it corresponds to the maps that commute with the central pseudoscalar. The number of terms controls expressivity. CSNN is the reversion member, a first-order model by construction and the grade-mixing corner of this family, developed as a sheaf construction for graph-level equivariant regression.

AI.tldr: 提出 Clifford 层神经网络（CSNN）：在胞腔层的每个茎上赋予 Clifford 代数，用 K 项三明治（K-term sandwich）作为限制映射，沿边传输多向量特征，构造出半正定的层拉普拉斯算子，用于图级等变回归。
AI.motivation: 几何图上的等变神经网络需要兼顾代数结构与等变性。层（sheaf）框架对代数型茎的自然限制映射是代数同态，加上等变约束后最自然的选择是 versor 共轭；但 versor 共轭表达力偏弱，需要一种既保持等变性、又比 versor 共轭更灵活的构造。
AI.method: 在胞腔层的每个茎上放置 Clifford 代数，沿边传输多向量特征。放弃代数同态约束，改用 K 项三明治（K-term sandwich）作为限制映射族；由此得到的层拉普拉斯算子按构造即为半正定，无需 versor 约束，且仍能混合不同 grade。论文沿三个维度刻画该限制映射族：耦合哪些 grade、能达到自同态空间的多少、以及条件数（良态程度）。CSNN 是该族中的 reversion 成员，按构造为一阶模型，处于 grade-混合的角点，作为图级等变回归的层构造。
AI.result: K 项三明治可达自同态空间的一半；在 Cl(3,0,0) 中，它对应与中心伪标量（pseudoscalar）对易的映射。项数 K 控制表达力：K 越大表达能力越强。CSNN 作为 reversion 成员，是一阶且 grade-混合的模型实例。
AI.conclusion: 通过 K 项三明治替代 versor 共轭，得到一族无需 versor 约束、天然半正定且能混合 grade 的等变层限制映射，并给出其表达力与条件数的三轴刻画；CSNN 作为其中的 reversion 实例，为图级等变回归提供了一种新的层网络构造。

title: Tight Transition Time Bounds for Separable Logistic Regression at the Edge of Stability
summary: We study logistic regression on linearly separable data under gradient descent with a large constant stepsize $η$. Such dynamics may exhibit a characteristic Edge of Stability phenomenon, in which the loss initially oscillates before transitioning to a stable phase of monotone decrease. Existing work provides a tight $Θ(1)$ bound in dimension $d=2$ as $η\to \infty$ and conjectures a bound independent of $η$ in arbitrary dimensions $d\geq 2$. In this paper, we disprove this conjecture by showing that, for every fixed sample size $n\geq 2$ and sufficiently small margin $γ$, the worst-case transition time is $$Θ\!\left((\logη)^{\min\{n-2,d-2\}}\right)$$ uniformly over $d\geq2$. The key challenge in establishing a tight bound is that the sample contributing most strongly to the gradient can change repeatedly across iterations. To address this issue, we control such changes by induction on dimension and sample size, and construct matching hard instances.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大常数步长梯度下降在线性可分数据上logistic回归的稳定性边缘动态，否定了现有关于过渡时间与η无关的猜想，证明最坏情况下过渡时间为Θ((logη)^{min{n-2,d-2}})。
AI.motivation: 现有工作仅给出d=2时Θ(1)的紧界，并猜测任意维度d≥2时过渡时间与步长η无关。本文旨在检验并推翻该猜想，刻画高维下过渡时间对η的依赖关系。
AI.method: 通过构造匹配的困难实例，采用对维数和样本数进行归纳的方法，控制贡献最强梯度的样本在迭代中反复变化这一难点，从而建立紧界并给出下界构造。
AI.result: 对每个固定样本量n≥2和足够小的间隔γ，最坏情况过渡时间为Θ((logη)^{min{n-2,d-2}})，且对d≥2一致成立；由此否定原猜想。
AI.conclusion: 过渡时间并非与η无关，而是随logη以min{n-2,d-2}次幂增长，其行为由样本量n和维数d中较小者共同决定。

title: No Model Required: Text Entropy Rate Filtering Mitigates Iterative Fine-Tuning Collapse
summary: Iterative fine-tuning on synthetic data causes \emph{model collapse}: output diversity narrows as rare patterns are progressively lost, a signature most visible as phrase-level repetition. Existing mitigations either require model log-probabilities, an external oracle, or continued access to real human data. Here we develop a new approach grounded in mathematical information theory: the non-parametric Kontoyiannis entropy rate estimator $h_k$, computed entirely from raw text via match-length statistics, with no model of any kind. We show that this is in fact a \emph{superior} training-data filter on text-diversity metrics in a fully-synthetic, single-lineage fine-tuning setting. In a six-generation QLoRA collapse experiment on Llama-3.1-8B, logprob-based filtering (the most established model-access-requiring baseline) provides no significant text-diversity benefit on any metric ($p > 0.23$), whereas $h_k$-filtering yields $+42\%$ unique trigrams, $+30\%$ vocabulary, and $-19\%$ repetition (all $p < 0.001$). We validate $h_k$ as a cross-domain entropy proxy ($β= 0.924$, $R^2 = 0.746$) and collapse detector ($ρ= +0.454$, $p < 0.0001$) across 4~domains, 2~temperatures, 2~generator--scorer model pairs, and 1{,}520 generated documents. Our results demonstrate that information theoretic approaches to collapse mitigation are efficient, and suggest new approaches for maintaining multi-agent diversity.

AI.tldr: 提出基于非参数Kontoyiannis熵率估计器 h_k 的无模型数据过滤方法，仅用原始文本即可缓解合成数据迭代微调导致的模型坍塌，效果显著优于依赖对数概率的滤波基线。
AI.motivation: 迭代微调合成数据会引发模型坍塌：罕见模式逐步丢失、输出多样性收窄，表现为短语级重复。现有缓解手段依赖模型对数概率、外部预言机或持续获取真实人类数据，均存在资源或权限限制，亟需一种无模型、仅依赖原始文本的方案。
AI.method: 基于数学信息论，采用非参数Kontoyiannis熵率估计器 h_k，完全通过匹配长度统计从原始文本计算得到，无需任何模型。在纯合成、单谱系的微调场景中，将其作为训练数据过滤器；在Llama-3.1-8B上进行六代QLoRA坍塌实验，与基于对数概率的滤波基线对比，并在4个领域、2种温度、2组生成器-评分器模型对、1520篇生成文档上验证 h_k 作为跨域熵代理与坍塌检测器的有效性。
AI.result: 基于对数概率的滤波（最成熟的需模型访问基线）在所有指标上均无显著文本多样性收益（p > 0.23）；而 h_k 滤波带来 +42% 唯一三元组、+30% 词表量、-19% 重复度（均 p < 0.001）。h_k 作为跨域熵代理（β = 0.924，R² = 0.746），坍塌检测相关系数 ρ = +0.454（p < 0.0001）。
AI.conclusion: 信息论方法在缓解模型坍塌方面高效可行，h_k 可作为一种无需模型的优越文本多样性过滤器与坍塌检测器，并为维持多智能体多样性提供新思路。

title: Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning: Replacing Target Samples by Black-Box Feedback
summary: Many scientific and machine learning systems, from molecular dynamics to diffusion models and beyond, are governed by stochastic dynamics with low-dimensional structure, evolving on slow timescales. However, target trajectories, used to identify and interpret such dynamics, are often inaccessible: only biased or static samples that explore the underlying manifold are available. We introduce Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning (LITL), a framework for recovering target Langevin dynamics from biased source samples using only black-box feedback. LITL learns the leading spectral structure of the target infinitesimal generator and the projected drift through Dirichlet representation learning, enabling kinetic reconstruction in spectral form and slow-manifold gradient field estimation. We further introduce a spherical variant well suited to steering normalized latent representations commonly used in learning systems toward desired objectives. We establish finite-sample guarantees for eigenvalue, eigenfunction, and projected drift estimation in Sobolev norms, thereby ensuring generalization of these quantities and their first-order derivatives. Empirically, LITL recovers physical transition timescales from biased molecular simulations, builds kinetic structure from static samples of generative models, reconstructs spherical symmetries of physical systems, and enables post-hoc latent steering of trained neural networks under black-box feedback. Together, these results position spectral operator learning as a practical framework for recovering stochastic dynamics under distribution shift and unlock applications across machine learning and the physical sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LITL 框架，利用仅有黑箱反馈的有偏源样本恢复目标 Langevin 动力学，学习无穷小生成元的谱结构与投影漂移，并提供有限样本理论保证与多领域实证。
AI.motivation: 许多科学与机器学习系统（如分子动力学、扩散模型）由低维、慢时间尺度的随机动力学支配，但用于识别与解释这些动力学的目标轨迹往往不可获得，只有探索该流形的有偏或静态样本。因此需要一种在分布偏移下恢复目标动力学的方法。
AI.method: 提出 Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning (LITL)，仅使用黑箱反馈从有偏源样本中恢复目标 Langevin 动力学。通过 Dirichlet 表示学习学习目标无穷小生成元的主导谱结构与投影漂移，实现谱形式的动力学重构与慢流形梯度场估计。进一步提出球面变体，用于将归一化潜表示导向期望目标。
AI.result: 在 Sobolev 范数下建立特征值、特征函数与投影漂移估计的有限样本保证，确保这些量及其一阶导数的泛化。实验上，LITL 从有偏分子模拟中恢复物理跃迁时间尺度，从生成模型静态样本构建动力学结构，重建物理系统的球面对称性，并在黑箱反馈下对训练后的神经网络实现事后潜空间引导。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果将谱算子学习定位为在分布偏移下恢复随机动力学的实用框架，并在机器学习与物理科学中开启广泛应用。

title: Exact Distinguishability in Non-Markovian Decision Processes
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures. Code and Lean 4 proofs: https://github.com/Kcbir/pec
summary: Non-Markovian environments are often modeled as Regular Decision Processes (RDPs), where dynamics depend on the interaction history through a finite automaton. Existing offline guarantees for RDPs rely on a distinguishability assumption on the behaviour policy but provide no means of verifying it. When the assumption is violated, distinct models may explain the data equally well. We study when data collected under a fixed behaviour policy can distinguish two candidate RDPs. We prove that the posterior odds between observationally equivalent candidates remain equal to the prior odds at every sample size, even when the policy visits every automaton state, and verify both results formally in Lean 4. We then characterize this equivalence exactly and derive PEC, an algorithm that decides it in time linear in the size of the product automaton. The distinguishability assumption of prior work fails on three of our four test environments, and the experiment identified by PEC restores it in each case.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究固定行为策略下离线数据区分两个候选正则决策过程（RDP）的条件，证明观测等价候选的后验几率恒等于先验几率，形式化验证于Lean 4，并刻画该等价关系、提出线性时间算法PEC。
AI.motivation: 现有RDP离线保证依赖行为策略的可区分性假设，但无法验证该假设；假设被违反时，不同模型可能同样好地解释数据，导致模型不可辨识。
AI.method: 将非马尔可夫环境建模为RDP；证明观测等价候选的后验几率在任意样本量下均等于先验几率，用Lean 4形式化验证；精确刻画该等价关系，并提出PEC算法，在乘积自动机规模线性时间内判定等价。
AI.result: 证明了即使策略访问每个自动机状态，后验几率仍等于先验几率；给出等价的精确刻画与线性时间判定算法；在四个测试环境中，先前工作的可区分性假设有三个失败，而PEC识别出的实验在每个情况下都恢复了该假设。
AI.conclusion: 固定行为策略下的数据可能无法区分观测等价的RDP候选，需通过PEC等工具主动识别可区分实验；该结论经Lean 4形式化验证，并在实验中修正了先前假设的失效。

title: In-context Learning of Single-index Targets: Comparing Kernel and Feature Learners
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables a pretrained model to infer a task from demonstrations without updating its parameters. While much of the existing theory focuses on linear target functions, in this paper we study nonlinear cases by comparing two one-layer attention architectures on the same family of single-index tasks. A kernel learner first maps inputs through a fixed nonlinear feature map and then applies linear attention, whereas a feature learner applies attention to the original input, followed by a learned nonlinear readout. We derive predictions for their memorization and generalization errors using the replica method, retaining the effects of pretraining size, task-pool diversity, and training and inference context lengths. The resulting predictions closely match numerical experiments across a broad range of regimes. Our analysis yields phase diagrams that characterize when each architecture is advantageous as the amount of pretraining data, task diversity, and context lengths vary. We further identify qualitatively different context-length scalings for the two learners. Together, these results clarify how architectural choices interact with the dataset and govern nonlinear in-context learning.

AI.tldr: 本文用副本方法对比两种单层注意力架构（核学习器与特征学习器）在单指标非线性任务上的记忆与泛化误差，预测与数值实验高度吻合，并给出相图与上下文长度标度规律。
AI.motivation: 现有ICL理论多聚焦线性目标函数，非线性情形下的架构选择如何与数据规模、任务多样性及上下文长度相互作用尚不清楚。作者希望刻画非线性ICL中不同注意力架构的优劣边界。
AI.method: 在同一单指标任务族上比较两种单层注意力架构：核学习器先用固定非线性特征映射再用线性注意力；特征学习器直接对原始输入做注意力，后接可学习的非线性读出。利用副本方法推导记忆误差与泛化误差的解析预测，并保留预训练规模、任务池多样性和训练/推理上下文长度的影响。
AI.result: 理论预测在广泛区间内与数值实验高度一致；得到相图，刻画随预训练数据量、任务多样性与上下文长度变化时各架构何时更优；并发现两种学习器在上下文长度上具有定性不同的标度行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了架构选择如何与数据集相互作用并共同决定非线性上下文学习性能，为理解非线性ICL提供理论依据。

title: Inferring Multi-Timescale Neural Dynamics with Switching Linear Dynamical Systems
summary: Neural activity often exhibits multiple timescales that can vary with behavioral states and task conditions. Identifying these timescales from neural recordings is important for better understanding neural computation and function. However, traditional approaches based on autocorrelation fitting are difficult to scale to high-dimensional population recordings and can become unreliable when neural dynamics change with behavior. State-space models have been a powerful framework for modeling high-dimensional neural population activity through latent dynamical systems, but standard formulations and inference methods do not explicitly account for multiple timescales and therefore do not guarantee accurate recovery of the underlying temporal structure. Motivated by these questions, we introduce the Multi-Timescale Switching Linear Dynamical System (MTS-SLDS), a framework for identifying regime-specific latent timescales from continuous or spiking neural observations. MTS-SLDS combines a multi-lag moment initialization, which captures temporal structure across multiple observation lags, with \textit{regime-conditioned} Laplace-EM inference, which reduces mixing of dynamical statistics across uncertain regimes. Characteristic timescales can then be extracted directly from the eigenvalues of the learned latent transition matrices. In synthetic and neural experiments with Gaussian and Poisson spike observations, MTS-SLDS accurately recovers timescales and switching structure over multiple datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多时间尺度切换线性动力系统（MTS-SLDS），用于从连续或脉冲神经观测中识别随状态/任务变化的隐性时间尺度，并通过合成与真实神经数据验证其能准确恢复时间尺度与切换结构。
AI.motivation: 神经活动常呈现多种时间尺度，且随行为状态与任务条件变化。传统基于自相关拟合的方法难以扩展到高维群体记录，且在神经动力学随行为改变时可能不可靠；标准状态空间模型虽能建模高维群体活动，但未显式考虑多时间尺度，无法保证准确恢复潜在时间结构。
AI.method: 提出MTS-SLDS框架：结合多滞后矩初始化（multi-lag moment initialization）以捕获跨多个观测滞后的时间结构，以及以状态为条件的拉普拉斯-EM推断（regime-conditioned Laplace-EM inference）以减少不确定状态下动态统计的混合；并从学习到的潜在转移矩阵特征值中直接提取特征时间尺度。
AI.result: 在模拟数据和神经实验中，使用高斯观测与泊松脉冲观测，MTS-SLDS在多个数据集上准确恢复了时间尺度和切换结构。
AI.conclusion: MTS-SLDS为从高维神经群体活动识别状态特异的多时间尺度提供了有效框架，并优于传统自相关拟合与标准状态空间模型在该任务上的局限。

title: Sharp Non-Asymptotic Analysis of the Penalized Challenger in $β$-EB-TCI for Bernoulli Bandits
summary: Top-two algorithms are simple and effective for fixed-confidence best-arm identification, but their sharp non-asymptotic behavior is still not well understood. We study this problem for Bernoulli bandits through $β$-EB-TCI, the empirical-best top-two rule of Jourdan et al., whose challenger is chosen using a Bernoulli transportation cost with a logarithmic count penalty. We prove that, after the empirical leader has become the true best arm and its sampling fraction stays close to $β$, the stopping time is $T_β^{\star}(μ)\log(1/δ)$ up to lower-order concentration terms. We also show that, in this regime, every challenger is sampled linearly often. Thus, for the original algorithm without forced exploration, the main remaining difficulty is to control when the empirical leader becomes permanently correct. These results imply a non-asymptotic high-probability bound for all Bernoulli instances with a unique best arm. If the algorithm satisfies a finite-mean sufficient-exploration condition, the bound further yields the sharp expected sample complexity. In particular, this gives the sharp expectation result for the unguarded Bernoulli rule when all arm means are pairwise distinct, using the sufficient-exploration result of Jourdan et al. Finally, if we add a mild forced-exploration rule that contributes only $O(\sqrt{Kt})$ pulls up to time $t$, we obtain a self-contained expected sample-complexity theorem for any number of arms under the unique-best-arm assumption. We also identify a limitation of proof strategies that try to handle equal suboptimal means through a single index-comparison argument.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Bernoulli臂下top-two固定置信度最佳臂识别算法β-EB-TCI的非渐近停时行为，证明当经验最优臂成为真实最优且采样比例接近β时，停时约为T_β^⋆(μ)log(1/δ)，并给出高概率界及渐近最优期望样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: Top-two算法对固定置信度最佳臂识别简单有效，但其精确的非渐近行为仍缺乏理解，尤其是停时的尖锐刻画及期望样本复杂度。
AI.method: 针对Jourdan等人的经验最优top-two规则β-EB-TCI，挑战者由对数计数惩罚的Bernoulli传输代价选取。证明经验最优臂成为真实最优且采样比例接近β后，停时为T_β^⋆(μ)log(1/δ)加低阶集中项；并证明该阶段每个挑战者线性采样。对无强制探索的原始算法，控制经验最优臂永久正确的时刻；在有限均值充分探索条件下导出尖锐期望复杂度，并加入仅O(√(Kt))拉动的温和强制探索规则。
AI.result: 得到所有唯一最优臂Bernoulli实例的非渐近高概率界；在有限均值充分探索条件下给出尖锐期望样本复杂度；对无强制探索的Bernoulli规则，在臂均值两两不同时得到尖锐期望结果；加入温和强制探索后得到任意臂数下自包含的期望样本复杂度定理；并指出通过单一索引比较处理相等次优均值的证明策略的局限。
AI.conclusion: β-EB-TCI在经验最优臂稳定后具有尖锐非渐近停时与线性采样性质，可导出高概率与期望样本复杂度界；强制探索仅需极少拉动即可覆盖任意臂数，同时揭示了单一索引比较证明策略的不足。

title: The Curvature of Regret in Contextual Linear Optimization
comment: 4 pages main body plus appendix, 3 figures. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on MLxOR
summary: Decision-focused learning for linear optimization is complicated by the discontinuity of the optimizer, where small cost errors may leave the decision unchanged or move it to a different vertex. We show that this non-smooth pointwise behavior becomes locally quadratic after averaging over the data distribution, and we derive the curvature in closed form, specifically, a matrix-valued measure supported on the walls of the normal fan. This measure depends only on the feasible set, with the data distribution entering only as a weight. We then offer a tractable approximation for this curvature, computable with just one projection to the feasible set. We prove that the approximation weakly converges to the true population curvature. We offer one application of our findings, a decision-aware scenario generation method for expected-cost linear optimization. Our experiments test the quadratic and weak convergence laws and show a 30.8% regret improvement over uniform allocation on battery arbitrage.

AI.tldr: 本文证明决策聚焦学习（DFL）中线性优化的非光滑点态行为在数据分布平均后呈局部二次曲率，该曲率可闭式表达为支撑在正规扇壁上的矩阵值测度，仅依赖可行集、数据分布仅以权重形式进入；作者给出仅需一次投影到可行集即可计算的可行近似，并证明其弱收敛于真实总体曲率，进而提出一种决策感知的场景生成方法，在电池套利实验中相较均匀分配取得30.8%的后悔值提升。
AI.motivation: 决策聚焦学习用于线性优化时，优化器的不连续性使目标函数在小成本误差下可能出现决策不变或跳到不同顶点的不稳定现象，导致梯度信号不佳、训练困难。作者希望理解并刻画这种非光滑性在数据分布平均意义下的整体几何结构，从而为DFL提供可用的曲率信息与优化工具。
AI.method: 1) 分析线性优化决策映射在点态意义下的不连续行为；2) 对数据分布取平均，证明平均后的风险呈局部二次型，并以闭式推导曲率；3) 将该曲率刻画为支撑于正规扇（normal fan）壁上的矩阵值测度，该测度只由可行集决定，数据分布仅作为权重；4) 提出可计算近似：仅需一次向可行集的投影即可估计曲率，并证明该近似弱收敛到真实总体曲率；5) 基于该曲率设计决策感知的场景生成方法用于期望成本线性优化。
AI.result: 实验验证了所推导的二次曲率规律与弱收敛定律；在电池套利（battery arbitrage）任务上，相比均匀分配场景，所提方法取得30.8%的后悔值（regret）改进。
AI.conclusion: DFL中线性优化看似病态的非光滑性，在分布平均后具有良好局部二次结构，其曲率可闭式表示为仅依赖可行集的矩阵值测度，并可被单次投影型近似有效估计。该理论为决策感知场景生成提供了依据，并在实际任务中显著降低后悔值，表明分布层面曲率分析是缓解DFL非光滑难题的可行路径。

title: Muon meets Tamed Langevin: Momentum Preconditioning beyond Convex and gradient-Lipschitz Potentials
summary: We consider the problem of sampling from Gibbs distributions on matrix spaces whose potential energies are neither convex nor globally gradient-Lipschitz. We introduce a family of non-quadratic kinetic energies that lead to a new underdamped Langevin system with momentum preconditioning, in which the gradient of the kinetic energy acts as a smooth spectral taming of the momentum. We prove that, under these relaxed assumptions on the potential, the resulting dynamics leaves the target Gibbs measure invariant, and we establish exponential convergence to equilibrium in a weighted total variation distance. Finally, we show that the corresponding Euler-Maruyama discretization admits moment bounds that are uniform in time, without any modification of the potential gradient, which ensures the stability of the resulting sampling algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非凸且非全局梯度Lipschitz势能下矩阵空间Gibbs分布的采样问题，提出一族非二次动能，构造了带动量预条件的欠阻尼Langevin系统，并证明其保持目标测度不变、以加权全变差距离指数收敛，且其Euler-Maruyama离散化具有时间一致矩界。
AI.motivation: 采样Gibbs分布通常依赖势能的凸性或全局梯度Lipschitz假设，以借助Langevin动力学实现收敛与算法稳定性。但矩阵空间上的实际势能往往既不凸也不全局梯度Lipschitz，这使经典欠阻尼Langevin方法的理论与稳定性保证失效，因此需要放宽这些假设，构造新的动力学以处理更一般的势能。
AI.method: 引入一族非二次动能，使动能梯度充当动量的光滑谱驯化（spectral taming），从而得到带动量预条件的欠阻尼Langevin系统。在势能非凸、梯度非全局Lipschitz的放宽假设下，分析该动力学的测度不变性与遍历收敛性，并研究相应Euler-Maruyama离散化的矩有界性，且不对势能梯度作任何修正。
AI.result: 在该动力学下，目标Gibbs测度保持不变；在加权全变差距离下得到向平衡态的指数收敛。相应的Euler-Maruyama离散化在不修改势能梯度的前提下具有时间一致矩界，保证了采样算法的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过非二次动能与动量预条件的欠阻尼Langevin框架，可在非凸、非全局梯度Lipschitz的矩阵空间势能下实现具有理论保证且数值稳定的Gibbs采样，放宽了传统方法的凸性与Lipschitz限制。

title: Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices
summary: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 将反向IRT引入药物基因组学药敏分析，把癌种视为具"耐药能力"的潜被试、药物视为具"规避难度"的题目，在GDSC2的242,036条药敏测量上统一估计癌种体外耐药度与药物广谱活性；验证表明其在缺失数据下比简单平均更稳健，但跨平台复现的排序一致性有限。
AI.motivation: 传统药敏汇总多采用简单平均，忽视癌种与药物之间的交互结构及数据缺失带来的偏差；作者希望借助心理测量学中的IRT框架，在共享潜变量尺度上同时刻画癌种耐药性与药物活性，并检验该方法在碎片化评估条件下的稳健性，而非构建普适的临床耐药排行榜。
AI.method: 提出反向IRT：将癌种建模为具"耐药能力"的潜被试、药物建模为具"规避难度"的题目；在GDSC2数据库242,036条药物敏感性测量上拟合，联合估计癌种层面体外耐药度与药物层面广谱活性。通过四种缺失机制（MCAR、癌种偏置、药物偏置缺失）下的潜排序恢复实验，与简单平均比较；留出预测采用Brier评分对比五种方法；用Bootstrap置信区间评估分类稳定性；并在PRISM平台进行跨平台复现检验。
AI.result: 在60%缺失率下，MCAR、癌种偏置与药物偏置稀疏条件下，反向IRT对全数据潜排序的恢复优于简单平均，Delta-rho = +0.089至+0.095；留出预测中IRT在五种评估方法里Brier评分最优；Bootstrap置信区间显示28个癌种中19个具有稳定的耐药/敏感分类；跨平台PRISM复现显示82%的方向一致率，但排序相关性较弱（rho = 0.25）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的贡献在于碎片化评估条件下的方法学稳健性，而非提供普适的临床耐药排行榜；反向IRT可作为药敏数据缺失与偏差情形下的稳健汇总与潜变量估计工具，但跨平台排序迁移性仍受限。

title: How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?
summary: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了Adam优化器与自然梯度下降(NGD)的几何关系，发现Adam的几何轨迹依赖于具体情境，其优化能力可能源于结构近似误差与动量平滑的平衡，而非紧密跟踪自然梯度路径。
AI.motivation: Adam是深度学习中的标准优化器，但其与自然梯度下降(NGD)之间的几何关系仍存在未解决的问题。作者希望厘清Adam的完整更新规则（包括动量）在何种程度上可视为NGD的近似，并理解其实际优化能力的来源。
AI.method: 作者将Adam的完整更新规则（含动量）建模为对角经验Fisher近似，并考虑对角截断、经验标签替换和时间滞后三种因素。采用尺度不变的γ(Δθ)度量，在四种损失景观上测量Adam与真实NGD的几何偏差：良态线性回归、病态线性回归、逻辑回归以及一个非凸小神经网络。
AI.result: Adam的几何轨迹具有情境依赖性。在良态设置下偏差较低，但在病态条件下显著上升，在神经网络中错配程度达到约10^3。较高的几何漂移与初始优化较慢相关，但不会恶化最终目标最小化，Adam始终能达到低损失。此外，改进的经验Fisher(iEF)比标准经验Fisher(EF)跟踪更稳定的路径，后者经常振荡或发散。
AI.conclusion: Adam的实际优化能力可能源于结构近似误差与动量平滑之间的平衡，而非对自然梯度路径的紧密跟踪。

title: FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law
summary: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控消融实验，检验带通滤波内积（FourierQK）中滤波器形状的五个假设，发现DC/Nyquist分量有害、最优单尺度带宽σ≈2（段落尺度约70 token）可带来+1.15 nats增益，且双向注意力场景下该机制有效，自回归生成需因果谱变体。
AI.motivation: 频率坍缩注意力（Frequency-collapse attention）用可学习频率上的带通滤波内积替代Q/K点积，取得显著增益。本文随之追问：何种滤波器形状最优、原因何在，以厘清该机制有效性的谱结构本质。
AI.method: 在字符级语言建模任务（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上，对DC抑制、Nyquist抑制、带宽、中心频率、多尺度覆盖五个滤波器属性假设进行受控消融实验。
AI.result: (1) DC与Nyquist分量有害（val≈2.0，等同相位随机化），证明振荡带通结构不可或缺；(2) 最优单尺度带宽σ≈2 bins、中心在段落尺度（约70 token），较BASE-DOT增益Δ=+1.15 nats；(3) 可容许滤波器（零均值、墨西哥帽DOG m=2）在同尺度下优于非可容许高斯，并部分抵御双侧FFT泄漏；(4) 双侧FFT泄漏随谱覆盖单调增大，窄带（gap>+4）干净、宽带（gap<+2）泄漏；(5) 字符尺度因果时域Morlet无法超越BASE-DOT（K=128 taps仅覆盖T=256上下文的50%）。
AI.conclusion: FourierQK在双向注意力（编码器式，如BERT，训练与推理均可获全序列上下文）中有效；自回归生成需采用因果谱变体如MorletQK（解码器式，如GPT）。

title: Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System
summary: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds.
