The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将RL-MIL、对抗去偏与偏好条件超网络结合的多目标框架，用于学生风险预测，但超网络扩展出现模式崩塌，偏好权重无法有效控制公平性-性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 从教育交互数据预测学生表现需要模型兼具准确性与透明性以支持有效干预，同时人口统计信息会带来不公平预测风险，因此需要可控的多目标建模方法。
AI.method: 构建多目标框架，融合基于强化学习的多实例学习（RL-MIL）、对抗去偏和偏好条件超网络。MIL将每个学生表示为弱标注交互的包，RL智能体选择信息量高的实例用于下游分类；并评估两种超网络变体，检验用户定义的偏好标量能否连续控制预测性能与Equalized Odds之间的权衡。
AI.result: RL-MIL基线取得较强分类性能，但两种超网络扩展均出现模式崩塌：改变偏好权重几乎不能使模型沿预期的公平性-性能前沿发生系统性移动。该失败与目标支配、条件机制中梯度传播微弱以及动态生成参数间的相互作用有关。
AI.conclusion: 公平目标可以嵌入可解释的RL-MIL流程，但仅靠偏好条件化无法保证多目标行为可控；稳健的公平RL-MIL需要梯度平衡、目标分离和稳定性分析的显式机制。

title: Fast Polynomial Transcendentals for LLMs
summary: Graphics processing unit (GPU) generations scale matrix, special-function, and memory pipelines at different rates, so kernel bottlenecks move as hardware evolves. FlashAttention-4 exposed this imbalance inside attention on NVIDIA Blackwell. We test whether short polynomial programs can accelerate other special-function-unit (SFU) operations in large language models (LLMs). We first compare native PyTorch evaluation with packed fused multiply--add (FMA) programs in an isolated IEEE binary16 (FP16) sweep spanning L2-resident and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM)-resident working sets. We then replace native sigmoid, tanh, and sigmoid linear unit (SiLU) with degree-3 or degree-4 bfloat16 (BF16) programs in four GB200 integration tasks: dense SiLU, tanh-softcapped attention, sigmoid attention, and routed-expert Swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU). The programs combine analytical symmetry, target-format rounding, and packed arithmetic inside consuming kernels. The isolated paths improve by 1.19--2.19x in L2 and 1.00--1.70x in HBM. The dense-SiLU, tanh-softcapped-attention, and routed-expert substitutions improve complete training-step throughput by 2.7\%, 2.9\%, and 8.0\%, respectively. The sigmoid-attention substitution improves complete-attention forward by 7.4\% and the complete GPU step by 0.3\%. Same-checkpoint open-weight ablations and one paired pre-training comparison per task extend the evaluation to model behavior. At common horizons near 100 billion tokens, the final smoothed training-loss differences (polynomial minus native) range from $-0.107$ to $+0.079$ across the four tasks.

AI.tldr: 测试短多项式程序能否加速LLM中其他SFU操作；在GB200四项任务中以BF16多项式替换sigmoid/tanh/SiLU，训练步吞吐提升最高8.0%，孤立路径加速1.19–2.19x(L2)，训练损失差异−0.107~+0.079。
AI.motivation: GPU各代在矩阵、特殊函数与内存管线的扩展速率不一致，导致kernel瓶颈随硬件演进迁移；FlashAttention-4已在Blackwell上暴露注意力内部这种失衡，因此需检验短多项式程序能否同样加速LLM中其他SFU操作。
AI.method: 先在孤立FP16扫描中比较原生PyTorch与打包FMA程序，覆盖L2驻留与HBM驻留工作集；再在四项GB200集成任务（dense SiLU、tanh-softcapped attention、sigmoid attention、routed-expert SwiGLU）中用degree-3/4 BF16多项式替换原生sigmoid、tanh、SiLU，程序结合解析对称性、目标格式舍入与消费kernel内的打包算术。
AI.result: 孤立路径在L2提升1.19–2.19x、HBM提升1.00–1.70x；dense-SiLU、tanh-softcapped-attention与routed-expert替换使完整训练步吞吐分别提升2.7%、2.9%、8.0%；sigmoid-attention替换使完整注意力前向提升7.4%、完整GPU步提升0.3%。同checkpoint开放权重消融与每任务一次配对预训练比较用于评估模型行为，约1000亿token时最终平滑训练损失差（多项式−原生）在−0.107~+0.079之间。
AI.conclusion: 短BF16多项式程序可有效替换原生SFU激活函数，在Blackwell GB200上获得可观吞吐收益且训练损失影响在正负小范围内，说明针对硬件扩展失衡的函数级替换是可行的LLM加速途径。

title: SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials
comment: 22 pages, Code and pretrained models available at: https://github.com/amirhoseinazarpour/SW-KAN
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. To address this limitation, we propose the Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN), a novel architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials defined on the semi-infinite domain (0, infinity). We introduce a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping that stably bridges the domain gap while preserving well-conditioned gradients, and leverage a numerically stable three-term recurrence that evaluates polynomial expansions in O(N) operations without special-function calls. Through comprehensive experiments spanning image classification and continuous function approximation, we demonstrate that SW-KAN achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across diverse tasks. The log-normal weight structure and learnable q-parameter of Stieltjes-Wigert polynomials provide a distinct inductive bias that enables robust performance under resource-constrained conditions, including reduced feature dimensionality and limited training data. The proposed architecture not only outperforms established polynomial KAN baselines on standard benchmarks but also exhibits strong representational capacity for approximating complex multivariate functions with remarkably few parameters, making it a compelling alternative for efficient function approximation and classification in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SW-KAN，用定义在半无限域(0, ∞)上的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式替代KAN中的固定激活，并设计指数-tanh映射桥接无界输入与半无限支撑的域不匹配，实现O(N)稳定求值，在精度-效率权衡上优于现有多项式KAN基线。
AI.motivation: KAN用边上的可学习单变量函数替代固定节点激活，提升可解释性与参数效率。但已有基于多项式的KAN变体面临一个根本且未被充分探讨的问题：无界实数输入与正交多项式基的有界或半无限支撑之间存在域不匹配，限制了多项式KAN的表达与稳定性。
AI.method: 提出Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN)：采用定义在半无限域(0, ∞)的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式；引入平滑的指数-of-tanh映射，稳定桥接域间隙并保持良态梯度；利用数值稳定的三项递推，在O(N)操作内完成多项式展开求值，无需调用特殊函数。
AI.result: 在图像分类与连续函数逼近任务上，SW-KAN实现了更优的精度-效率权衡；其对数正态权重结构与可学习q参数带来独特归纳偏置，在特征维度缩减、训练数据有限等资源受限条件下仍保持稳健性能；在标准基准上超过现有多项式KAN基线，并能以极少参数逼近复杂多元函数。
AI.conclusion: SW-KAN通过Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式与指数-tanh域映射，有效解决了多项式KAN的域不匹配难题，兼具O(N)高效求值与强表达能力，是资源受限场景下高效函数逼近与分类的有力候选方案。

title: Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining
summary:
Four-bit floating-point (FP4) Tensor Cores accelerate matrix multiplication, but scale computation, operand packing, layout construction, and saved backward state can erase the gain. We present \emph{format-aware fusion}, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout for native \mxfp{}, global 
vfp{}, and cooperative-thread-array-local 
vfp{}. We evaluate Llama-3-family 8B pretraining through 160 billion tokens using bfloat16 output projections and compiled cross entropy. In matched same-accelerator probes, bfloat16 and Transformer Engine 
vfp{} reach 18.8K and 27.6K tokens/s/GPU, while our fastest custom route reaches 37.9K. \mxfp{} with row-gradient stochastic rounding and fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning reaches 37.2K tokens/s/GPU (86.3\% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization) and ends 2.11\% above the raw bfloat16 training-loss endpoint. A Transformer Engine recipe with four final bfloat16 blocks ends 0.87\% above bfloat16 at 27.1K tokens/s/GPU. Downstream rankings differ from training-loss rankings, showing that FP4 outcomes depend jointly on scale contract, operand, and execution path.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"格式感知融合"方法，将量化生成器与尺度域、消费者布局协同设计，用于MXFP4、全局NVFP4和CTA局部NVFP4,在Llama-3系列8B预训练中实现了比bfloat16和Transformer Engine NVFP4更高的吞吐，同时保持训练损失接近。
AI.motivation: FP4 Tensor Core虽能加速矩阵乘法，但尺度计算、操作数打包、布局构建以及反向传播状态的保存会抵消其收益，因此需要从系统层面协同设计量化、尺度与执行路径，才能获得真正的端到端加速。
AI.method: 提出格式感知融合：为每种量化生成器协同设计其尺度域与消费者布局，分别针对原生MXFP4、全局NVFP4以及协作线程数组局部的NVFP4。在Llama-3系列8B预训练（160B tokens）中评估，使用bfloat16输出投影与编译版交叉熵。MXFP4路线结合行梯度随机舍入与固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预条件。
AI.result: 在同加速器对比中，bfloat16和Transformer Engine NVFP4分别达到18.8K和27.6K tokens/s/GPU，最快的自定义路线达37.9K。MXFP4方案达到37.2K tokens/s/GPU（86.3% bfloat16模型FLOP利用率），最终训练损失比原始bfloat16高2.11%。含四个最终bfloat16块的Transformer Engine配方比bfloat16高0.87%，吞吐27.1K tokens/s/GPU。下游任务排名与训练损失排名不一致。
AI.conclusion: FP4的最终效果取决于尺度契约、操作数与执行路径三者的联合设计；仅看训练损失可能无法反映下游性能，因此需以端到端格式感知融合来评估FP4训练方案。

title: "very likely" Means "uncertain"? How LLMs Diverge from Humans in Linguistic Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Humans express uncertainty verbally via markers (e.g., "possible," "likely"), yet most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) relies on costing likelihood- or consistency-based signals. From a cognitive perspective, accurate verbal uncertainty reflects metacognitive monitoring, representing knowledge boundaries ("knowing that you don't know") to support regulation and information seeking. In this paper, we investigate how LLMs diverge from humans in verbal uncertainty quantification and whether verbal markers can reliably quantify LLM uncertainty. We curate a corpus of human uncertainty markers from psychology and decision-science literature and benchmark LLMs against it. We observe that LLMs encode verbal uncertainty with numerical levels that differ substantially from those of humans. We then introduce METHODNAME, a novel optimization-based algorithm that learns an optimal uncertainty profile over uncertainty markers directly from LLM outputs. By fitting a marker-uncertainty mapping to best explain empirical correctness, METHODNAME discovers how much probability mass each verbal marker should convey, rather than estimating uncertainty via repeated sampling. METHODNAME enables a direct, marker-level comparison of confidence semantics between humans and LLMs, disentangling mismatch and revealing systematic confidence disparities in verbal expressions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM与人类在语言不确定性标记上的量化差异，提出METHODNAME算法，从LLM输出中学习最优的标记-不确定性映射，实现无需重复采样的置信度语义对比。
AI.motivation: 人类通过"可能""很可能"等语言标记表达不确定性，体现元认知监控；而现有LLM不确定性量化（UQ）多依赖似然或一致性信号，忽视了语言标记这一认知视角，且尚不清楚语言标记能否可靠量化LLM不确定性。
AI.method: 从心理学与决策科学文献中整理人类不确定性标记语料库并以此对LLM进行基准测试；提出基于优化的算法METHODNAME，直接从LLM输出中学习不确定性标记上的最优不确定性剖面，通过拟合标记-不确定性映射以最佳解释经验正确性，而非依赖重复采样估计。
AI.result: 发现LLM对语言不确定性编码的数值水平与人类存在显著差异；METHODNAME可揭示每个语言标记应承载的概率质量，实现标记层面的人机置信度语义直接对比。
AI.conclusion: 语言标记可作为量化LLM不确定性的可靠途径；METHODNAME能解耦人机置信度语义的不匹配，揭示语言表达中的系统性置信度差异。

title: Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures; code and reproducibility package available at https://github.com/Pranavsingh431/nous-state/tree/main/research/decision-certification
summary: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

AI.tldr: 论文区分了记忆系统中的学习、校准与修正认证三类任务，证明在特定隐马尔可夫族中，学习并认证优于现有策略的决策所需样本量（Theta(l^-2)）可比重建信息源可靠性（Theta(l^-4)）少一个数量级的平方，且无需先校准信息源；在未知身份加背景的汇报信道下给出政策改进的锐识别区间与有限样本认证方法，并通过MiniGrid实验验证认证效果。
AI.motivation: 基于信念的智能体记忆需要可靠地判断当前状态，但其证据可能有噪声、被复制或已过时。核心问题是：记忆是否必须先校准信息源，才能改进决策？论文旨在厘清学习、校准与修正认证之间的关系，明确在何种条件下可以绕过信息源可靠性重建而直接获得有依据的决策改进。
AI.method: 在一个含四模型的隐马尔可夫族上分析样本复杂度：学习未知贝叶斯决策、以O(l^-2)个来自同一观测律的新鲜记录认证其相对具信息量现有策略的改进，而固定精度信息源估计需Theta(l^-4)。将此结果推广到更广模型类，保留决策速率与信息源下界。在未知身份加背景汇报信道下，刻画政策改进的锐识别区间，并基于可观测见证区域构造有限样本证书，无需纯类锚点。进一步给出容忍有界历史依赖误设定与条件复制的鲁棒性扩展，分裂训练的见证可适用于任意历史空间并给出显式功效条件。
AI.result: 将政策边界凭证与Nous Dimensions集成，在45,000条留出的可变状态历史和三个外部MiniGrid记忆环境中（引入含噪汇报接口）的9,000个回合上测试。新证书在MiniGrid中相对常量现有策略接受9/9项改进、相对last-write-wins接受4/9项改进，而先前证书未接受任何改进。已有的强推理基线仍具竞争力或更优。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了一个统计学解释：记忆决策可以在不恢复信息源可靠性的情况下被学习并获得认证。这一结论并非主张某个普遍更优的记忆算法，而是界定记忆决策可被学习与证成的条件。

title: One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models
summary: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery. The best-balanced threshold varied substantially across models and settings. In half of the tested settings, neural models and BKT differed by more than 0.10 in their selected thresholds, although this gap became smaller when greater priority was placed on reducing extra practice and allowing more students to advance. Stricter thresholds also did not reliably reduce performance gaps and could disproportionately restrict advancement, with stronger-prior students advancing up to 3.26 times as often as weaker-prior students. These results show that mastery thresholds should be recalibrated when the KT model or instructional priorities change and evaluated by their effects on performance, practice, advancement, and access.

AI.tldr: 本文考察六个知识追踪（KT）模型在四个公开数据集上、12个掌握阈值（0.50–0.99）下的表现，发现同一数值阈值在不同模型下含义与后果不同，阈值需随模型与教学优先级重新校准。
AI.motivation: 辅导系统用掌握阈值决定学生何时停止练习并进阶，但同一数值阈值在底层KT模型变化时会导致截然不同的决策，因此需要系统评估阈值与模型的交互效应。
AI.method: 在四个公开教育数据集上比较六种KT模型，评估从0.50到0.99的12个阈值，指标包括进阶后表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担及不同先前表现群体间的差异；并在30种预设教学设置下识别兼顾表现、额外练习与进阶的平衡阈值。
AI.result: BKT对阈值变化相对不敏感，而神经模型随阈值升高变得更具选择性；这源于输出语义差异——BKT估计潜在掌握概率，神经模型估计下一题答对的概率。最优平衡阈值在不同模型和设置下差异显著，半数设置中神经模型与BKT所选阈值相差超过0.10，但当更强调减少额外练习和允许更多学生进阶时差距缩小。更严格的阈值并未可靠缩小表现差距，反而可能不成比例地限制进阶，先前表现较强的学生进阶频率最高可达较弱学生的3.26倍。
AI.conclusion: 掌握阈值在KT模型或教学优先级变化时应重新校准，并应从表现、练习、进阶与可及性（access）四个方面评估其影响。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Multi-Expert Interval Targets
summary: Many machine learning (ML) applications rely on expert labels, and qualified experts may provide different but plausible interpretations of the same observation. Such variation across expert labels may reflect genuine disagreement or ambiguity rather than annotation error. When individual experts additionally report intervals rather than exact values, the supervision contains two distinct sources of label uncertainty: within-label imprecision and between-expert variation. Existing methods treat these forms separately: multi-expert approaches collapse labels to a consensus, interval-target methods often yield a single prediction, and predictive-uncertainty methods rarely validate their uncertainty estimates against observed expert disagreement. To address this problem, we propose an approach that preserves individual expert intervals, separates within-label imprecision from between-expert variation, and validates the corresponding predictive uncertainty components. First, heterogeneous label vocabularies are harmonized into a common probabilistic label space, separating encoding differences from expert judgement. Second, individual label intervals are retained and modeled with a mixture of Beta distributions trained using a proper Cramér-distance objective, preserving distinct expert-reported labels. Third, we decompose predictive uncertainty into within-component, between-component, and model uncertainty, and evaluate whether these components correspond to within-label uncertainty, between-label uncertainty, and model error, respectively. Because this correspondence is not guaranteed, we introduce decomposition matching, which aligns the predictive components to their intended label-side sources. On sea-ice concentration the model reduces MAE by 31\% over hard labels and outperforms aggregation, interval-distribution, and interval-regression baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种保留个体专家区间、分离标签内不精确性与专家间差异、并验证预测不确定性成分的方法，通过Beta混合模型与Cramér距离目标训练，并引入分解匹配机制。
AI.motivation: 许多机器学习应用依赖专家标注，而不同专家对同一观测可能给出不同但合理的解释。这种差异反映真实分歧或模糊性而非标注错误。当专家报告区间而非精确值时，监督信号包含两类标签不确定性：标签内不精确性和专家间差异。现有方法将二者分开处理，无法同时建模并验证。
AI.method: 方法包含三个步骤：1）将异构标签词表协调到统一概率标签空间，分离编码差异与专家判断；2）保留个体标签区间，用Beta混合分布建模，采用合适的Cramér距离目标训练，保留不同专家报告的标签；3）将预测不确定性分解为组内、组间和模型不确定性，并评估其是否分别对应标签内不确定性、标签间不确定性和模型误差。由于该对应关系不保证成立，引入分解匹配将预测成分对齐到预期的标签侧来源。
AI.result: 在海冰浓度数据集上，该模型相比硬标签将MAE降低31%，并优于聚合、区间分布和区间回归等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过保留个体专家区间并显式分离两类标签不确定性，结合分解匹配机制，该方法能有效建模并验证预测不确定性的来源，显著提升预测精度。

title: The Hidden Costs of 99% Accuracy: A Trustworthiness Audit of the Telco Customer Churn Benchmark
summary: Customer churn prediction on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (n = 7,043) routinely reports test accuracies above 95%, with the most cited published study reporting 99.01%. We audit this benchmark for four trustworthiness failures invisible to the accuracy- and F1-centred reporting that dominates the literature. First, pre-split SMOTE inflates churn-class F1 by 13.1 percentage points across ten classifiers and fifteen seeds (Wilcoxon p < 10^-4 per classifier); the same leaky pipeline ordering paired with class weighting yields no inflation, isolating the effect to SMOTE's geometric construction. We measure the mechanism directly: approximately 36% of synthetic training points are nearest-neighbour interpolations of test-set instances. Second, the TotalCharges field is approximately determined by tenure multiplied by MonthlyCharges (R2 = 0.999); removing it changes accuracy by less than 0.2 percentage points, yet TreeSHAP ranks it ninth in mean absolute attribution - a pattern that materially corrupts SHAP-based interpretation. We propose an R2 > 0.95 pre-modelling diagnostic. Third, in a 15-seed calibration audit, isotonic regression is the strongest default; temperature scaling fails on class-weighted tree ensembles whose predicted-probability distribution is bimodal. Fourth, the cost-optimal decision threshold (under a 50 USD retention offer and 24-month CLV proxy) is approximately 5-10 times lower than the F1-optimal threshold, saving approximately 77,000 USD per 1,000 customers. We replicate F1 and F2 on Iranian Telecom Churn (within domain) and Bank Customer Churn (across domain): F1 generalises; F2 generalises only within telecom. We synthesise these findings into a four-component reporting checklist - pipeline disclosure, redundancy diagnostic, calibration audit, and cost-sensitive thresholds - and release a reproducible implementation.

AI.tldr: 该论文对IBM Telco客户流失基准（n=7,043）进行可信度审计，揭示被高准确率掩盖的四类失效：SMOTE预分割导致数据泄漏、TotalCharges冗余扭曲SHAP解释、校准方法选择问题、以及成本最优阈值与F1最优阈值差异巨大，并提出四项报告清单。
AI.motivation: IBM Telco流失基准上普遍报告95%以上准确率（最高99.01%），但以准确率和F1为中心的评估掩盖了潜在的不可信问题，作者旨在系统审计这些对标准报告不可见的可信度失效。
AI.method: 在n=7,043样本上对十种分类器和十五个随机种子进行审计：比较预分割SMOTE与类权重流水线顺序；直接测量合成点与测试集的最近邻插值关系；通过R2诊断评估TotalCharges与tenure×MonthlyCharges的冗余及TreeSHAP排名；进行15种子校准审计（等渗回归 vs 温度缩放）；计算50美元挽留成本与24个月CLV下的成本最优阈值；并在伊朗电信（同域）和银行客户流失（跨域）数据集上复现F1、F2发现。
AI.result: 预分割SMOTE使流失类F1虚高13.1个百分点（每分类器Wilcoxon p<10^-4），约36%合成训练点是测试集样本的最近邻插值；TotalCharges约由tenure×MonthlyCharges决定（R2=0.999），移除后准确率变化不足0.2个百分点却仍被TreeSHAP排第九；等渗回归校准最优，温度缩放在双峰分布加权树集成上失效；成本最优阈值比F1最优低约5-10倍，每千客户节省约77,000美元；F1跨域可泛化，F2仅在同域电信中泛化。
AI.conclusion: 提出包含流水线披露、冗余诊断（R2>0.95）、校准审计与成本敏感阈值的四要素报告清单，并发布可复现实现，以提升流失预测研究的可信度与实用决策价值。

title: Generalized Biomedicine Discovery
summary: In real-world clinical practice, medical images face open-world shifts: (i) long-tailed rare diseases, (ii) subtle lesions dominated by normal anatomy, and (iii) hierarchical taxonomies. Yet most open-world paradigms assume flat, balanced label spaces, leaving these biomedical demands unresolved. We introduce Generalized Biomedicine Discovery (GBD) and a unified benchmark spanning long-tail, anomaly, and taxonomy-aware discovery. Our key insight is that dominant known patterns form a visual manifold that masks subtle novelty. Inspired by expert diagnosis, we propose SCAN (Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN), which follows a cognition-inspired perceptual progression: it applies predictive suppression to filter expected norms, triggers surprise-evoked salience to highlight unexpected deviations, and performs complementary accommodation to integrate these shifts into global representations. Extensive experiments show that SCAN improves novel concept discovery while generally preserving established clinical knowledge, and it plugs into existing architectures to better navigate the known-unknown trade-off in medical imaging. Code is available at https://github.com/lytang63/generalized-biomedicine-discovery.

AI.tldr: 论文提出广义生物医学发现（GBD）任务与统一基准，覆盖长尾、异常与层次化 taxonomy 发现，并提出认知启发的 SCAN 方法，通过预测抑制、惊讶诱发显著性与互补适应，在保留已知临床知识的同时提升新概念发现能力。
AI.motivation: 真实临床医学图像面临开放世界偏移：长尾罕见病、被正常解剖结构主导的细微病灶、以及层次化分类体系。而多数开放世界范式假设标签空间是扁平且平衡的，无法满足这些生物医学需求。
AI.method: 关键洞察是主导性的已知模式构成视觉流形，掩盖了细微新颖性。受专家诊断启发，提出 SCAN（Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN），遵循认知启发的感知递进：先用预测抑制过滤预期常态，再以惊讶诱发显著性突出意外偏差，最后通过互补适应将这些偏移整合进全局表示。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SCAN 提升了新概念发现性能，同时总体保留既有临床知识；可插入现有架构，更好权衡医学影像中的已知-未知取舍。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: SCAN 为开放世界医学影像中的新概念发现提供了认知启发的统一方案，兼顾新颖发现与已知知识保持，并可兼容现有模型架构。

title: Classification Based on Association Rules Algorithm for Breast Cancer
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table, accepted & presented at Advances in Science and Engineering Technology International Conferences (ASET) 2024
summary: Breast cancer is a significant contributor to female mortality across the world, displaying one of the highest oc currence rates among the various cancer types. In response to the need for early breast cancer detection, researchers have increasingly turned to association rule-based classification as a favored method. Association Rule mining is a data mining approach which offers the benefit of yielding results that are readily understandable for medical professionals. This paper introduces a novel association rule-based data mining technique for breast cancer classification based on a weighted classification approach. This implementation employs three core algorithms: Rule Generation, Rule Pruning, and Rule Prediction. Rule Generation identifies frequent itemsets and creates association rules. Rule Pruning eliminates rules using specific criteria and separates them into major and minor groups based on their influence on training data. Rule Prediction applies the pruned rules to classify test data. The final prediction algorithm was tested on several testing samples to show the feasibility and performance of the approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于加权分类的关联规则挖掘技术，用于乳腺癌分类，包含规则生成、规则剪枝与规则预测三个核心算法。
AI.motivation: 乳腺癌是全球女性死亡的重要原因，发病率居各类癌症前列，早期检测需求迫切；关联规则分类因结果易于被医疗专业人员理解而受到关注。
AI.method: 采用加权分类的关联规则挖掘方法，实现三个核心算法：规则生成（识别频繁项集并生成关联规则）、规则剪枝（依据特定准则剔除规则，并按对训练数据的影响程度分为主要与次要两组）、规则预测（利用剪枝后的规则对测试数据进行分类）。
AI.result: 在多个测试样本上对最终预测算法进行验证，展示了该方法的可行性与性能。
AI.conclusion: 该加权关联规则分类方法可用于乳腺癌分类，具备可行性与良好性能，且规则形式便于医学人员理解。

title: Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn
comment: 10 pages, 4 tables. Code and measurement scripts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22718897
summary:
Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions actually buys, measured under one fixed protocol in tree-structured and constructive models, and gives an exact diagnosis and a fix for the one that buys nothing.
  The diagnosis concerns the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so that the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and, with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn. Unlike the symmetry that Net2Net breaks with noise or the saddle point that splitting steepest descent escapes with second-order information, first-order information here is not weak but absent. Over three seeds of five-fold cross-validation the construction loses 19.6 accuracy points on Iris, 19.1 on Wine and 55.6 on Digits against the same depth trained from scratch. The fix is a small random perturbation of the children, whose size barely matters. The practical rule is one line in a test: after adding parameters, assert that their gradient is nonzero.
  The other three decisions each buy one thing. Fitting a new hidden unit to the residual error before installing it buys a smaller network on every dataset, though not a more accurate one, and on Digits it costs accuracy significantly. Splitting the leaf with the largest expected error buys sparsity, reaching 0.885 with 3.7 splits where a complete depth-six tree uses 63, but loses 4.3 points on a harder problem. Requiring statistical significance before a node receives a more expressive split buys nothing: the tree gets larger and less accurate.
  Every number in the paper is inserted from the measurement script.

AI.tldr: 本文在同一固定协议下考察树结构与构造式分类器中四种"生长"决策各自的收益，并对其中唯一"买不到任何收益"的决策（软决策树的对称加深）给出精确诊断与修复方案。
AI.motivation: 构造式分类器在训练过程中不断添加结构（树加一层、隐藏层加单元、叶节点加分裂），但这些生长决策究竟各自带来什么收益缺乏统一的、可比的度量；作者希望对"最自然的加深软决策树方式"为何失效给出诊断，并提供一个实用修复。
AI.method: 在统一的固定协议下，对树结构与构造式模型中的四种生长决策进行对照测量；对"将每个叶节点变为门、两个子节点继承父节点类别分布"的加深方式做梯度分析（证明新门梯度恒为零、门在1/2时两子节点梯度相同）；采用三个随机种子、五折交叉验证与"从零训练的同深度模型"对比；其余三种决策分别考察残差拟合新隐藏单元、按最大期望误差分裂叶节点、分裂前要求统计显著性；所有数值由测量脚本自动插入。
AI.result: 对称加深的构造在Iris上损失19.6个准确率点、Wine 19.1点、Digits 55.6点；小随机扰动即可修复，扰动幅度影响甚微。残差拟合新隐藏单元在各数据集上得到更小的网络但未更准确，在Digits上显著损失准确率。按最大期望误差分裂获得稀疏性，3.7次分裂达0.885，而完整六层树需63次分裂，但在更难问题上损失4.3点。分裂前要求统计显著性则无收益：树更大且更不准确。
AI.conclusion: 四种生长决策中，对称加深"买不到任何东西"，其原因是新参数处一阶信息并非弱而是完全缺失（区别于Net2Net用噪声打破的对称性与分裂最速下降用二阶信息逃离的鞍点）；实用准则是添加参数后断言其梯度非零。残差拟合买来更小的网络，最大期望误差分裂买来稀疏性，而统计显著性门槛不买任何东西。

title: Energy Time-Series Imputation with Differentially Private Diffusion Models via Clipping-Aware Objective Conditioning
summary: Reliable recovery of missing measurements is important for monitoring and analysis in energy time-series systems, where fine-grained measurements may contain sensitive temporal information. Diffusion models trained with differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) provide a promising framework for privacy-sensitive energy time-series imputation. Under cosine diffusion schedules, late timesteps correspond to low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, where standard $\varepsilon$-prediction can induce large pre-clipping gradients. Such gradients are more likely to be clipped, reducing the retained optimization signal. The artificial intelligence (AI) contribution lies in formulating this objective--clipping interaction as an objective optimization problem under fixed-threshold DP-SGD and developing timestep-aware objective conditioning for diffusion-based energy time-series imputation. The method adopts $v$-prediction to mitigate late-timestep gradient amplification, uses static loss weighting as a uniform-scaling control, and introduces diffusion-schedule-aware dynamic weighting for stronger attenuation before clipping. For the engineering application, we evaluate the method on five real-world energy time-series datasets across random point missingness, contiguous block missingness, persistent outages, and multiple missing-data severities. Under matched DP-SGD settings, the proposed method consistently improves imputation utility over the $\varepsilon$-prediction baseline. Gradient diagnostics reveal lower upper-tail pre-clipping gradient norms, reduced clipping fractions, and stronger attenuation at late low-SNR timesteps, supporting the effectiveness of clipping-aware objective conditioning for energy time-series imputation.

AI.tldr: 在固定阈值DP-SGD下，将扩散模型目标函数与梯度裁剪的交互建模为优化问题，提出时间步感知的目标条件化方法（v-prediction+动态损失加权），在不牺牲隐私的前提下提升能源时间序列插补精度。
AI.motivation: 能源时序细粒度测量含敏感时间信息，需在差分隐私下可靠插补缺失值。但在余弦扩散调度下，晚期时间步处于低信噪比（SNR）状态，标准ε-prediction会产生较大的裁剪前梯度，易被裁剪，导致有效优化信号流失、插补效用下降。
AI.method: 将"目标函数—裁剪"交互形式化为固定阈值DP-SGD下的目标优化问题，并进行时间步感知的目标条件化：采用v-prediction缓解晚期时间步梯度放大；使用静态损失加权作为均匀缩放对照；引入扩散调度感知的动态加权，在裁剪前实现更强的梯度衰减。
AI.result: 在五个真实能源时序数据集上评测随机点缺失、连续块缺失、持续中断及多种缺失严重度。匹配DP-SGD设置下，所提方法一致优于ε-prediction基线；梯度诊断显示裁剪前梯度上尾范数更低、裁剪比例下降、晚期低SNR时间步衰减更强。
AI.conclusion: 裁剪感知的目标条件化能有效缓解低SNR时间步的梯度放大与裁剪问题，在保持差分隐私的同时提升扩散式能源时序插补效用，具有较强的工程适用性。

title: Useful to Whom? Sample Value Is Defined Only Relative to the Learner
summary: What kind of data does a model need in order to learn? Coreset selection makes this question concrete: under a budget, keep the samples most useful for training. Easy-first and geometric coverage criteria can win in different budget regimes, separated by a crossover boundary. We ask whether this boundary is fixed by the data or changes with the target learner. Controlled experiments freeze the selected subsets and manipulate only the training learner. On low-resolution ImageNet-100, doubling ResNet-18's width moves the crossover from 57 to 85 samples per class: the learner changes the relative value of the same samples. A wider sweep reveals an interaction between input grid and capacity. Enlarging the grid while retaining the same image information shifts the boundary left, and this shift weakens as width increases. Stride controls reproduce and reverse the grid effect without changing the input grid; removing only the last downsampling stride is sufficient to recover the leftward shift. Under the native-224px ImageNet-1k protocol, width effects are smaller and depend on the probe: LFrac remains nearly flat, while EL2N shifts modestly right. Swapping the convolutional learning system for a ViT makes coverage win throughout the measured range, even when the easy subsets come from the convolutional proxy. These results establish learner dependence through frozen-subset interventions and identify network structure that can move the boundary. They do not yield a universal scaling law. Their practical implication is direct: a selection strategy's preferred budget regime must be evaluated with respect to the target learner.

AI.tldr: 核心集选择的"易样本优先"与"几何覆盖"准则之间存在一个交叉边界，该边界并非由数据固定，而是随目标学习器（网络宽度、输入分辨率、下采样步幅、架构类型）而变化。
AI.motivation: 回答"模型需要什么样的数据才能学习"这一问题，现有工作通常把核心集选择的准则优劣视作数据的固有属性。本文质疑这一假设，探究在固定所选子集的前提下，交叉边界是否会随目标学习器改变，从而厘清选择策略与学习器之间的依赖关系。
AI.method: 采用冻结子集干预（frozen-subset intervention）：先固定已选出的样本子集，仅操纵训练学习器。在低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上改变 ResNet-18 的宽度；开展输入网格与容量的交叉扫描；通过步幅（stride）控制在不改变输入网格的情况下复现并反转网格效应；在原生 224px ImageNet-1k 协议下比较 LFrac 与 EL2N 两种探针；并将卷积学习系统替换为 ViT 进行对照。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-100 上，将 ResNet-18 宽度加倍使交叉点从每类 57 个样本移至 85 个，说明学习器改变了相同样本的相对价值。输入网格与容量存在交互：在保留相同图像信息下增大网格使边界左移，且该位移随宽度增加而减弱；仅移除最后一个下采样步幅即可复现左移。在 ImageNet-1k 原生 224px 协议下，宽度效应较小且依赖探针：LFrac 近乎持平，EL2N 略微右移。换成 ViT 后，覆盖类准则在整个测量区间内均占优，即便易样本子集来自卷积代理模型。
AI.conclusion: 研究通过冻结子集干预确立了核心集选择边界的"学习器依赖性"，并识别出可移动该边界的网络结构因素（宽度、输入网格、步幅、架构）。结果不支持普适的缩放定律。实践含义明确：评估某选择策略所偏好的预算区间时，必须以目标学习器为参照。

title: Constant-Memory Recall: Learned Associations in a Fixed Matrix State
summary: Fixed-size recurrent memory limits storage growth during inference, but successful recall depends on the task and training. We study a small DeltaNet variant with fixed token-specific key biases, trained to remember 32 new key-value pairings per sequence. With 32 KiB of recurrent matrix state, it achieves 99.95% mean accuracy across three training seeds when choosing among the sequence's values. Recall remains near perfect when filler extends the pre-query context to 1,798 tokens without adding pairings. Zeroing the first memory block removes this recall. An exploratory 48-pair test remains near chance after one quarter of the primary training budget and does not locate a capacity limit. Parameter-matched vector and Transformer baselines remain near chance, including the Transformer after additional training searches. This unresolved baseline failure prevents a memory-efficiency comparison.

AI.tldr: 小规模 DeltaNet 在 32 KiB 循环状态下实现 32 组键值对的近乎完美召回，但 Transformer 和向量基线失败，导致效率对比悬而未决。
AI.motivation: 探索固定大小循环记忆能否在不增长存储的情况下实现可靠召回。以往成功召回取决于任务与训练条件，因此需要一个可控的键值记忆基准来检验容量与泛化边界。
AI.method: 使用带固定 token 特定键偏置的小型 DeltaNet 变体，每序列训练记忆 32 个新键值对；循环矩阵状态限定为 32 KiB；通过填充延长预查询上下文至 1,798 token、置零首个记忆块等消融，并设置参数量匹配的向量基线与 Transformer 基线（含额外训练搜索）。
AI.result: 三个训练种子下平均准确率 99.95%；填充延长上下文后召回仍近乎完美；置零首个记忆块则召回消失。探索性 48 对测试在四分之一训练预算下仍接近随机，未定位容量上限。参数量匹配的向量与 Transformer 基线（含额外训练搜索）均接近随机。
AI.conclusion: DeltaNet 在固定 32 KiB 状态下可稳健召回 32 组配对且对填充长度具鲁棒性，并依赖首个记忆块；但基线未解决的学习失败阻碍了内存效率比较，48 对设置下容量上限尚未确定。

title: How Many Categories Are Enough? Distribution-Free Certification Limits for Few-Shot Anomaly Thresholds
summary: Few-shot anomaly detectors are judged by ranking metrics, yet deployment requires an alarm threshold with a controlled false-alarm rate (FAR). We ask how much normal evidence, in images or category units, is needed to certify such a threshold for an unseen category. Using a frozen DINOv2 principal component analysis (PCA) residual ranker on 15 MVTec and 12 VisA categories under four corruption types, we show that target-only leave-one-image-out (LOIO) calibration is resolution-limited and shift-fragile: rank values cannot fall below $1/(k+1)$, and at the attainable level $α=0.20$, empirical FAR reaches 0.341 on Gaussian-corrupted MVTec at $k=4$, 1.7 times the nominal level. A category-count feasibility calculus is then derived: even with all-zero category losses and no multiplicity charged, any deterministic, uniformly valid, distribution-free 95% upper confidence bound (UCB) requires at least 14, 29, and 59 independent and identically distributed (iid) category draws at $α=0.20$, $0.10$, and $0.05$; these counts are necessary but not sufficient. The Cross-category Reliability Estimation with Source Support (CRESS) protocol splits source categories into disjoint reference, proposal, and certification roles. With only three or four certification categories, all 960 frozen configurations return the fail-closed threshold $τ^\star=0$, and the smallest category-level UCB is 0.950. Image-unit analyses of the same archive select positive thresholds in 36.7% to 60.3% of target cells; these bounds hold for the selected source mixture, not for the marginal risk of a new-category draw. The contribution is a quantitative feasibility boundary and an estimand-aware protocol specifying when source evidence can, and cannot, support a transferable reliability claim.

AI.tldr: 本文研究少样本异常检测中可控误报率阈值认证所需的正样本证据量，提出类别计数可行性下界并设计CRESS协议，指出源类别证据无法支撑跨类别可靠性声明。
AI.motivation: 少样本异常检测虽以排序指标评估，但实际部署需要设定具有受控误报率（FAR）的报警阈值。本文追问：为未见类别认证这样一个阈值，究竟需要多少正常证据（以图像或类别为单位）。目标仅用留一图像（LOIO）校准受分辨率限制且对分布偏移脆弱，因此需要明确源证据在何种条件下可以支撑可迁移的可靠性声明。
AI.method: 在15个MVTec与12个VisA类别、四种损坏类型下，使用冻结的DINOv2主成分分析（PCA）残差排序器。分析目标仅用LOIO校准的分辨率上限与偏移脆弱性；推导类别计数可行性演算，给出确定性、一致有效、无分布假设的95%上置信界（UCB）所需的最少独立同分布类别抽取数；提出CRESS协议，将源类别划分为互斥的参考、提议与认证三种角色。
AI.result: LOIO校准时秩值无法低于1/(k+1)；在可达水平α=0.20、k=4时，高斯损坏MVTec上的经验FAR达0.341，为标称水平的1.7倍。可行性演算表明，即使类别损失全为零且不计多重性，任何确定性、一致有效、无分布假设的95% UCB在α=0.20、0.10、0.05时分别至少需要14、29、59个独立同分布类别抽取，且为必要非充分条件。CRESS在仅3或4个认证类别时，960种冻结配置全部返回故障关闭阈值τ*=0，最小类别级UCB为0.950。同一归档的图像单元分析在36.7%至60.3%的目标单元中选出正阈值。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献了一个定量的可行性边界与一个关注估计目标的协议，明确了源证据在何时能够、何时不能支撑可迁移的可靠性声明。图像单元边界仅适用于所选源混合，不适用于新类别抽取的边际风险。

title: Contingent Exposure Routing for Financial AI: Outage Risk and the Cost of Indivisible Decisions
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/shi1720/contingent-exposure-routing
summary: Model failover restores availability, but changes which financial institutions share decision errors. We formulate outage-contingent routing through a local market-impact response matrix and study expected squared price displacement. A symmetric construction shows that a shared backup can leave an order-one concentration floor as the number of primary endpoints grows, while balanced fallback risk decreases inversely with the surviving endpoint count. For indivisible decisions, we derive the exact second moment of independent randomized routing and an effective-exposure granularity that determines its gap from fractional allocation. Conditional-expectation rounding gives a finite-agent bound without coupled quotas; a separate swap procedure preserves endpoint counts and is assessed against dual lower bounds. Across 60 synthetic portfolio networks and 11,340 scenario evaluations, the latter reduces risk by 6.57% and 10.53% for single and double endpoint removals at the central feedback setting with independent errors. A replay of 1,024 recorded API responses on constructed rebalancing tasks gives a smaller held-out reduction of 3.30% (paired bootstrap interval 2.07--4.57%). Strongly aligned errors, inferior endpoints, and indivisibility limit diversification. The contribution is an auditable routing stress test and implementation analysis, not an estimate of real-market crash probabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文将故障转移下的机构路由建模为局部市场冲击响应矩阵问题，研究预期平方价格位移，刻画集中度下限与分散化收益，并提出可审计的路由压力测试方法。
AI.motivation: 模型故障转移虽能恢复可用性，但会改变哪些金融机构共享决策误差，从而可能加剧风险集中。作者希望在故障情景下评估路由对价格位移的预期平方影响，并量化分散化能否真正降低风险。
AI.method: 通过局部市场冲击响应矩阵形式化"故障条件下"的路由问题；用对称构造证明共享备份在主要端点增长时可留下O(1)集中度下限；对不可分决策推导独立随机路由的精确二阶矩及有效暴露粒度；采用条件期望取整获得有限代理上界，并设计保持端点数量的交换程序，与对偶下界比较；在60个合成组合网络、11,340个情景评估及1,024条API响应回放上进行验证。
AI.result: 交换程序在中心反馈、独立误差设定下对单端点与双端点移除分别降低风险6.57%和10.53%；在构建的再平衡任务API回放中，留出集降低3.30%（配对自助法区间2.07–4.57%）。强相关误差、较差端点和不可分性会限制分散化收益。
AI.conclusion: 故障转移下路由分散化收益取决于相关性、端点质量与可分性；该研究提供可审计的路由压力测试与实现分析，而非对真实市场崩盘概率的估计。

title: The Null Is the Hard Part: Exact Tests for Memorization in Generative Models
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures. Code and measurement outputs at https://github.com/sushovan4/memorization-audits
summary: Memorization audits of generative models read similarity scores against thresholds, with no null distribution, and the conclusions they support can be wrong. By MemBench's rule, the benchmark's mitigations roughly halve Stable Diffusion's memorization; audited with false-discovery control, two thirds of the certified images are no longer detected under random prompt perturbations, five sixths under attention rescaling, and all of them under embedding optimization. The field's data-copying test, read against its own null, flags ten of twenty-four generators that reproduce nothing. We argue that for memorization the null is the hard part, and supply two. For a whole model, training and held-out images are exchangeable given its samples, and relabelling them is a permutation test, exact for any statistic when the held-out images are a random split; under it, a nearest-neighbour preference still fires on seven of those twenty-four, and a count restricted to the near-duplicate scale on none (McNemar p=0.016). For single images, the natural nulls fail twice, measurably: ranking an image among random images yields 596 false discoveries among 2,365 controls, and resampling independent generations makes the null three times too narrow. Calibrated against matched controls, the audit certifies 36 of 61 MemBench images at 5% false-discovery rate, held-out controls are certified in 0.01% of calibration splits, and on this benchmark two generations per image recover that count. A calibrated maximum, which reads occasional rather than typical copying, certifies 46. As the scale-restricted statistic we recommend the small-scale mass of the Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile, which also counts distinct images copied and tests whether two models copy the same ones.

AI.tldr: 该文指出生成模型记忆化审计普遍缺乏零分布、阈值化判读易致误判，提出并验证两类精确可校准的零假设（置换检验与匹配对照），据此大幅修正已有基准与检测器的记忆化结论。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆化审计直接将相似度分数与阈值比较，不设零分布，因而支撑的结论可能错误：MemBench的缓解措施看似将Stable Diffusion记忆化减半，数据复制检验却把24个生成器中10个"复制了不存在的图像"判定为阳性。作者认为记忆化检验的难点在于零假设本身，故需补上两类零分布。
AI.method: 对整体模型：利用"给定模型样本时训练集与留出集可交换"的性质，将两者重新标注构成置换检验；当留出集为随机划分时，该检验对任意统计量都精确，并据此比较最近邻偏好与近重复尺度计数（McNemar检验）。对单张图像：指出两类自然零假设失败——在随机图像中排序产生596个假发现（共2365个对照），独立重采样使零分布过窄三倍；改用匹配对照校准，在5%假发现率下审计MemBench图像，并提出校准最大值统计量以捕捉偶发而非典型复制；推荐使用交并欧拉特征剖面的小尺度质量作为尺度受限统计量。
AI.result: 按MemBench规则，缓解措施约将Stable Diffusion记忆化减半；但施加假发现控制后，随机提示扰动下三分之二的被认定图像不再被检出，注意力缩放下去掉六分之五，嵌入优化下全部消失。数据复制检验相对自身零分布，将24个生成器中的10个误报。置换检验下，最近邻偏好仍在24个中7个上触发，而近重复尺度计数一个都不触发（McNemar p=0.016）。校准后审计在5%假发现率下认定61张MemBench图像中的36张，留出对照仅在0.01%的校准划分中被认定，且该基准下每图两次生成即可恢复该计数；校准最大值认定46张。
AI.conclusion: 记忆化审计的关键在于零假设的构造，缺乏零分布会导致系统性误判。作者提供的两类零假设（模型级置换检验、图像级匹配对照）在保持统计效力的同时有效控制假发现，并推荐以交并欧拉特征剖面小尺度质量作为尺度受限统计量，该统计量还能计数被复制的不同图像并检验两模型是否复制同一批图像。

title: Sharp Oracle-Regret Tradeoffs for Projection-Free Online Convex Optimization
summary: We characterize the regret attainable in online convex optimization when access to the feasible set is limited to an exact linear optimization oracle. The learner is given an inscribed ball and a diameter bound and must remain feasible on every consistent instance. For convex $G$-Lipschitz losses, diameter at most $D$, a total allowance of $Q$ oracle calls, and a strict limit of $B$ calls per round, the dimension-free minimax expected regret is $Θ(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$. The lower bound applies to arbitrary randomized learners. Universal feasibility first forces each action into the hull of the supplied ball and the preceding oracle replies. A fixed-body construction then couples fresh phase directions to a shared simplex, making useful replies costly repeatedly even though all losses have a common minimizer. A counted approximate-gradient method with interleaved blocks attains the matching rate. Total-budget and strict per-round guarantees follow as special cases, including the $T^{3/4}$ rate with one call per round and the quadratic total budget needed for $\sqrt T$ regret. For prescribed smoothness $β$, an analytic construction yields a curvature-dependent lower bound and identifies the threshold above which the general characterization remains sharp.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了在线凸优化中仅能访问精确线性优化预言机时的最优遗憾界，给出维度无关的极小极大期望遗憾为 Θ(GD·max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})。
AI.motivation: 研究可行集访问受限（仅能调用精确线性优化预言机）这一实际场景下的在线凸优化最优性能边界。
AI.method: 建立不可行可行性的结构性约束（当前动作须落在给定球与既往预言机回复的凸包内）；构造固定体（fixed-body）下界实例，将各阶段新方向耦合到共享单纯形上，使有用回复反复代价高昂；并设计交错分块的计数近似梯度方法达到匹配速率。
AI.result: 给出维度无关极小极大期望遗憾 Θ(GD·max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})，下界适用于任意随机化学习器；总预算与严格每轮限制作为特例，包括每轮一次调用时的 T^{3/4} 速率以及达到 √T 遗憾所需的二次总预算；对给定光滑度 β，给出曲率相关下界并确定一般刻画仍紧的阈值。
AI.conclusion: 在仅有线性优化预言机访问可行集的约束下，全面刻画了可达到的最优遗憾及其对预言机调用预算与每轮限制的依赖关系，并明确了结果在光滑性下的适用范围。

title: Verification Pulses and the Cost of Escaping Wrong Consensus
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures; code and raw experimental records: https://github.com/shi1720/verification-pulses
summary: External verification can correct individual outputs while leaving a self-reinforcing population in the basin of a wrong consensus. We study how the timing and addressing of a fixed verification budget affect recovery in an asynchronous binary register. For a general nonlinear response, we derive the minimum fuel required to cross a basin boundary under a peak verification constraint. For a finite population, an exact birth--death calculation gives the probability of subsequent wrong consensus after a pulse. Our main asymptotic result identifies the critical budget window: a leading term $N\log(x_0/b)$ and a correction of order $\sqrt N$, with separate variance contributions from repeated verification targets and autonomous amplification after verification stops. The distinction is substantial: with 16 majority-updated slots and 14 initially wrong, 9 random checks cross the mean-field budget threshold, whereas 23 are required for 95% eventual recovery in the exact model. A prospectively specified experiment records 13,392 language-model responses, including calibration and 108 held-out trajectories. Calibration produces different fitted response regimes, but all four adjusted schedule-comparison intervals include zero. A distributional audit also finds that modest mean-prediction error can conceal a large underestimate of terminal consensus occupancy. The results support risk-calibrated reset scheduling under a specified update contract, while explicitly separating it from distinct-target checking and unrestricted evidence broadcast.

AI.tldr: 研究在异步二元寄存器中,固定验证预算的时机与目标选择如何影响系统从错误共识的恢复,给出跨盆地边界的最小"燃料"、脉冲后错误共识概率的精确计算,以及临界预算窗口的渐近结果,并用语言模型实验验证调度方案的区间效应。
AI.motivation: 外部验证能纠正个体输出,但可能无法打破自我强化的错误共识盆地。作者希望刻画在固定验证预算下,验证的时机与作用对象如何决定系统能否恢复,从而支撑风险校准的重置调度设计。
AI.method: 在异步二元寄存器上建模:对一般非线性响应推导峰值验证约束下跨越盆地边界所需的最小燃料;对有限种群用精确生灭过程计算脉冲后出现错误共识的概率;给出临界预算窗口的渐近展开,主项N log(x0/b)加√N阶修正,并区分重复验证目标与验证停止后自主放大的方差贡献;另开展预先设定的语言模型实验(13,392条响应,含校准与108条留出轨迹),比较调整后的调度方案。
AI.result: 16个多数更新槽位中14个初始错误时,9次随机检查即可跨过平均场预算阈值,而精确模型需23次才能达到95%最终恢复;校准拟合出不同响应机制,但四个调整后的调度比较区间均含零;分布审计发现均值预测误差不大时仍可能严重低估终端共识占有率。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在指定更新契约下的风险校准重置调度,并明确将其与面向不同目标的检查和无限制证据广播区分开来;预算阈值与恢复概率之间存在显著差距,提示决策需按风险而非仅按均值校准。

title: Attention Manifolds: Steering or Blocking Language Models by Editing Learned B-Spline Surfaces
summary: In standard transformer attention, a source token sends the same value vector to every receiver. The query determines \emph{how much} to attend but not \emph{what} to extract. This work introduces \textbf{attention manifolds}: learned 2D B-spline surfaces $S_d(q_d, k_d)$ that modulate each value dimension based on the query-key interaction. Each surface is a tensor-product cubic B-spline initialized to zero, preserving pretrained behavior. Applied to LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct and 3B-Instruct, attention manifolds reduce WikiText-2 validation perplexity by 2--2.5 points with 0.3\% parameter overhead. Across 112 diverse prompts, surfaces change greedy-decoded output for 69\% (1B) to 83\% (3B) of cases, with the strongest effects on ambiguous and polysemous inputs (94--100\% change rate). The surfaces improve output quality: correcting factual errors (\emph{``the CAP theorem has three main components''} $\to$ \emph{``it is impossible to guarantee all three''}), increasing precision (\emph{``impossible to know certain properties''} $\to$ \emph{``impossible to know both position and momentum''}), and adding specificity (a generic quote $\to$ an attributed Saint Augustine citation, consistently at both scales). The learned surfaces are also mechanically editable: inverting a layer's coefficients changes greedy output for 9/10 prompts (KL~0.010), providing a geometric mechanism for model steering. Setting surface coefficients to $-1$ creates ``attention walls'' that block value flow through specific dimensions. In a preliminary experiment, a layer-wide wall redirects an explosive-device prompt from specific instructions to general educational content, suggesting a path toward safety-oriented manifold shaping.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"注意力流形"（attention manifolds），即基于查询-键交互调制各值维度的可学习二维B样条曲面，以极低参数量（0.3%）提升LLaMA模型困惑度并改善输出质量，且曲面可机械编辑以实现模型引导。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer注意力中，源token向每个接收者发送相同的值向量，查询只决定"关注多少"而非"提取什么"，缺乏对值内容的条件化调制能力。
AI.method: 引入注意力流形S_d(q_d, k_d)，即学习得到的二维张量积三次B样条曲面，依据查询-键交互调制每个值维度；曲面初始化为零以保持预训练行为，应用于LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct与3B-Instruct。
AI.result: 在WikiText-2验证困惑度上降低2–2.5点，参数开销仅0.3%；112条多样化提示中，69%（1B）至83%（3B）的贪心解码输出发生变化，歧义与多义输入影响最强（94–100%）；输出质量提升（纠正事实错误、提高精确性、增加具体性）；反转某层系数可改变9/10提示的输出（KL≈0.010），系数置-1形成"注意力墙"阻断特定维度值流。
AI.conclusion: 注意力流形以几何可编辑的机制实现了模型引导，为安全导向的流形塑造提供了可行路径，但仍属初步探索。

title: Large Language Bayes Is Not Reparameterisation-Invariant
summary: Large Language Bayes (LLB) answers an informal modelling question by sampling candidate probabilistic programs from a language model, running approximate inference on each, and averaging them with weights proportional to an exponentiated evidence bound. We show that this weighting depends on how a model is written. The log marginal likelihood is invariant to reparameterisation; the evidence bound is not. On eight schools the centered and non-centered programs are the same measure to $5.7\times10^{-14}$, yet their weights differ by $6.1\times$; importance weighting reduces this only to $2.2\times$, and reproducing the inference LLB actually runs, a full-covariance Gaussian matched to the posterior moments, still leaves $1.9\times$ on eight schools and $8.9\times$ in $64$ dimensions. Across likelihood families, dimensions and funnel severities the discrepancy reaches $31.9\times$ and reverses sign, so no single writing is uniformly preferable. It inverts Bayes factors against eight natural competitors, and the induced error in the model posterior, and in any downstream target, is controlled by the spread $Δ$ of the bound shortfalls through a known sharp Hilbert-distance bound. Across $360$ programs from six language models the parameterisation written ranges from $0\%$ to $100\%$ centered and is stable within a model. Detecting equivalent programs statistically can falsely merge genuinely different models at practical sample budgets; verifying reparameterisations we generate ourselves cannot, and closes the window.

AI.tldr: LLB通过采样概率程序并按证据界的指数加权来回答建模问题，但该加权对程序的参数化写法不具不变性，导致权重严重偏离，可通过直接验证等价重参数化来消除该窗口。
AI.motivation: LLB以证据界（而非对数边际似然）的指数作为模型平均权重。对数边际似然对重参数化不变，但证据界不是，因此模型的具体书写方式可能人为影响权重与下游推断，这一隐患此前未被系统检验。
AI.method: 以八所学校为中心化与非中心化程序做对照，比较二者的测度一致性与权重差异；采用重要性加权、以及复现LLB实际推断的与后验矩匹配的全协方差高斯近似；跨似然族、维度与漏斗严重程度（共360个程序、来自6个语言模型）统计权重差异、Δ的散布与符号变化，并用已知的Hilbert距离尖锐界推导模型后验及下游目标的误差控制；再比较统计检测等价程序与直接验证重参数化两种识别策略。
AI.result: 八所学校上中心化与非中心化程序为同一测度（差异5.7×10⁻¹⁴），但权重相差6.1×；重要性加权仅降至2.2×；复现实际推断（矩匹配全协方差高斯）仍留有1.9×，64维下达8.9×。跨似然族、维度与漏斗严重程度差异最高达31.9×且符号反转，无一致更优写法。该效应对八个自然竞争者的贝叶斯因子造成反转；模型后验及任意下游目标的误差由界缺口的散布Δ经尖锐Hilbert距离界所控制。360个程序中参数化写法从0%到100%中心化，且模型内稳定。统计检测等价程序在实用样本预算下会错误合并真正不同的模型；而自行生成并验证重参数化则不会，可关闭该窗口。
AI.conclusion: 证据界的指数加权对重参数化不具不变性，使LLB的模型平均与下游推断受书写方式任意左右；正确做法是对自身生成的重参数化进行直接验证而非统计合并，从而在不牺牲模型区分度的前提下消除该窗口。

title: MOVE: Multimodal Open-world Verification and Expansion for Graph Learning
summary: Multimodal graph learning faces a fundamental challenge: new classes may emerge after deployment, while models are trained with a fixed label space. Existing approaches typically detect unknown nodes and use LLMs to generate candidate class descriptions, but they do not determine whether existing classes are insufficient to cover these nodes or whether a generated class is reliable enough to expand the class space. Our empirical study reveals three challenges: multimodal information beyond individual modalities is required for unknown-node identification, LLM-generated class descriptions may not fully capture multimodal class characteristics, and directly adding candidate classes can introduce redundant categories. Based on these observations, we propose MOVE, a multimodal open-world class verification and expansion framework. MOVE identifies nodes that cannot be assigned to existing classes by jointly considering visual tokens, textual attributes, and graph context, leverages a multimodal LLM to generate candidate classes, and selectively expands the class space only when candidates are consistently supported by multimodal evidence without introducing unnecessary categories. Experiments demonstrate that MOVE achieves an average improvement of 11.87\% across unknown recognition, open-domain annotation, and downstream graph learning tasks.

AI.tldr: MOVE：多模态开放世界类别验证与扩展框架，联合视觉、文本与图上下文识别未知节点，用多模态LLM生成候选类别并在多模态证据支持下选择性扩展类别空间。
AI.motivation: 多模态图学习面临部署后新类别涌现而训练标签空间固定的问题。现有方法虽能检测未知节点并用LLM生成候选描述，但无法判断：现有类别是否不足以覆盖这些节点，以及生成的类别是否可靠到足以扩展类别空间。
AI.method: 基于三项实证发现（未知节点识别需超越单一模态的多模态信息、LLM生成描述可能未充分捕获多模态类别特征、直接添加候选类别会引入冗余类别），提出MOVE框架：联合视觉token、文本属性与图上下文识别无法归入现有类别的节点；利用多模态LLM生成候选类别；仅当候选类别被多模态证据一致支持且不引入冗余类别时，才选择性扩展类别空间。
AI.result: 在未知识别、开放域标注与下游图学习任务上，MOVE平均提升11.87%。
AI.conclusion: 多模态证据驱动的类别验证是实现开放世界类别空间可靠扩展的关键，MOVE在多项任务上验证了该思路的有效性。

title: Coupling Perception and Reasoning in Federated Multimodal Graph Foundation Models
summary: Federated multimodal graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to adapt pretrained multimodal models to decentralized graph data, where each client owns a private multimodal graph and cannot share raw information. These models typically combine a multimodal Encoder that extracts semantic evidence from heterogeneous modalities and a graph neural network (GNN) that performs relational reasoning over graph structures. However, existing federated GFM adaptation methods mainly update graph-side modules while keeping the multimodal Encoder frozen, limiting adaptation to \emph{how information is propagated} while fixing \emph{what information is extracted}. Through empirical studies, we reveal that Encoder and GNN adaptations are not independent: Encoder adaptation is affected by graph relations, while cross-client module swapping reveals substantial pairing sensitivity between separately parameterized Encoder and GNN updates. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{FedCORE}, a federated adaptation framework that represents Encoder and GNN updates through a shared low-dimensional latent state. FedCORE jointly optimizes this core from multimodal and structural signals and performs federated evolution directly in the shared state space, preserving compatibility between perception and reasoning adaptations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedCORE reduces the Encoder--GNN pairing gap from $30.6$ to $5.9$, corresponding to an $80.7\%$ reduction over independent joint adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 FedCORE，用共享低维隐状态统一编码器与GNN更新，实现联邦多模态图基础模型的高效适配。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦图基础模型适配只更新图侧模块而冻结多模态编码器，只能调整"信息如何传播"而固定了"提取何种信息"；实证发现编码器与GNN适配并非独立，存在显著的配对敏感性。
AI.method: FedCORE 用共享低维隐状态表示编码器与GNN的更新，从多模态与结构信号联合优化该核心，并在共享状态空间内直接进行联邦演化，保持感知与推理适配的兼容性。
AI.result: 实验表明 FedCORE 将编码器–GNN配对差距从 30.6 降至 5.9，相比独立联合适配降低 80.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享隐状态的联合演化策略，可有效缓解编码器与GNN适配间的配对敏感性问题，提升联邦多模态图基础模型的适配效果。

title: Stable and Counterfactually Robust Physical World Models from Imposed Structure and Learned Physics
summary: A world model learns to forecast how a physical system evolves from recorded trajectories, yet the systems it imitates obey physical laws that are neither fully supplied nor reliably respected. The model may create energy, drift or diverge over long rollouts, and answer a changed law query using the law observed during training. We ask how much general physical structure must be hard coded into a world model, and how much system-specific physics can then be learned from data, for four properties to hold simultaneously: second law compatible dissipation, correct responses to interventions on physical parameters, stability out to one hundred times the training horizon, and robustness to disturbances. The imposed structure is general: dynamics are generated from the gradient of a learned energy through a fixed reversible operator, the energy is restricted to a confining class, a one way port can remove energy but never inject it, the drive channel is known, and the intervened parameter enters through a separable map. The model learns the energy functional, constitutive relations, dissipation rate, and couplings. Across an electromagnetic cavity, a particle in cell grid, and a shallow-water fluid, models with roughly nine thousand parameters recover constitutive functions with unit slope, separate conserving from dissipating worlds by four orders of magnitude using a single set of weights, and transfer changes in sign, magnitude, rate, and gravity to unseen values, where equal-capacity models without the same structure perform at chance or worse. A nonlinear constitutive law is recovered with its curvature preserved and predicts a held-out intervention $2$-$17\times$ better than a converged linear model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅需硬编码少量通用物理结构（能量梯度+固定可逆算子+单向耗散端口+可分离参数映射）的世界模型，其余系统特定物理（能量泛函、本构关系、耗散率、耦合）全部从数据学习。在电磁腔、粒子网格、浅水三类系统上，约9000参数的小模型即可同时满足耗散相容、参数干预响应正确、超长时程稳定和抗扰动。
AI.motivation: 世界模型从轨迹中学习物理系统演化时，既没有完整的物理定律输入，也难以保证遵守物理定律：可能出现无中生有的能量、长rollout漂移或发散、以及用训练时的定律回答改变后的定律查询。核心问题是：要让四个性质同时成立（第二定律相容耗散、参数干预响应正确、训练时程100倍的稳定性、抗扰动鲁棒性），究竟需要硬编码多少通用物理结构，又能从数据学到多少系统特定物理。
AI.method: 硬编码唯一通用结构：动力学由学习能量的梯度经固定可逆算子生成；能量限制在约束类（confining class）内；单向port只耗能、不注入能量；驱动通道已知；被干预参数通过可分离映射（separable map）进入。模型学习能量泛函、本构关系、耗散率与耦合。用等容量但无此结构的模型作对照。
AI.result: 在电磁腔、particle-in-cell网格、浅水三类系统上：约9000参数的模型恢复出单位斜率的本构函数；用同一套权重将守恒世界与耗散世界分离达四个数量级；对符号、幅度、速率、重力的干预迁移到未见取值。等容量无结构模型表现仅为随机或更差。非线性本构定律在保持曲率的情况下被恢复，对留出干预的预测比收敛线性模型好2–17倍。
AI.conclusion: 少量通用物理结构（能量梯度动力学、可逆算子、单向耗散、可分离参数入口）即可使小容量世界模型同时具备耗散相容性、干预正确性、超长时程稳定性与抗扰动性，且系统特定物理可完全从数据学习。结构缺失时等容量模型失败，表明这些结构是必要条件。

title: Bellman-Certified Rounding for Sparse Policy Deployment in MDPs
summary: Continuous policy optimization may spread an update across many states, even when deployment permits only a few complete state-level changes. We study how much discounted return can be retained when continuous row mixtures are rounded to sparse binary policies in finite MDPs. Policy-dependent visitation couples the row edits, while long horizons make global curvature bounds conservative. From $2d+2$ Bellman solves, we derive reusable envelopes that support uniform and candidate-specific guarantees before rounding. A rank-two rational representation of each exchange further permits weighted curvature integration along the realized trajectory. We prove that linear dimension dependence is unavoidable when the budget scales, and that exact global curvature thresholding is hard. Candidate-specific bounds raise pre-rounding certification coverage from $48.2\%$ to $74.1\%$ on the structured suite. At $γ=0.95$, local integration lowers the median bound-to-loss ratio from $402.3$ to $2.08$ on coupled instances.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限MDP中将连续行混合策略舍入为稀疏二值策略时的折扣回报保留问题，提出基于Bellman求解的可复用包络与秩二有理表示，给出舍入前认证界并证明相关复杂性下界。
AI.motivation: 连续策略优化的更新往往分散于大量状态，而实际部署只允许少量完整的状态级改动（稀疏二值策略）。同时，策略相关的访问分布使各行修改相互耦合，长时域又令全局曲率界过于保守，因此需要更紧的舍入前认证手段。
AI.method: 利用2d+2次Bellman求解构造可复用包络，支持统一与候选特异的舍入前保证；对每次交换建立秩二有理表示，从而沿实际轨迹进行加权曲率积分。并分析线性维度依赖的必然性以及精确全局曲率阈值的计算难度。
AI.result: 候选特异界将结构化测试集上的舍入前认证覆盖率从48.2%提升至74.1%；在γ=0.95的耦合实例上，局部分积分将界与真实损失的比值中位数从402.3降至2.08。理论上证明当预算扩展时线性维度依赖不可避免，且精确全局曲率阈值化是困难的。
AI.conclusion: 通过可复用包络与轨迹上的加权曲率积分，可在舍入前给出显著更紧、且具可扩展性的稀疏二值策略回报保证，同时刻画了该方法的内在复杂度界限。

title: Beyond Diagonal State Space Models: Exact Non-Abelian Group Tracking, Solvability Barriers, and Geometric Physical Manifolds
comment: 26 pages, 1 table, 5 theorems. Source code and reproducible benchmarks available
summary: Selective state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, S4D, and LRU, are bounded by transition matrix commutativity (A_t A_t' = A_t' A_t) and solvable affine transformation groups (Aff_D of derived length <= 2). Consequently, stacked multi-layer diagonal networks face severe optimization degradation on non-solvable simple groups such as A_5 due to the exponential circuit emulation depth required to simulate non-abelian commutators. We propose Non-Commutative State Space Models (NC-SSM), their real-orthogonal counterpart SO(3)-SSM, and arbitrary-dimension Cayley-SSM, lifting state transitions to compact Lie groups SU(2), SO(3), and SO(N). Via closed-form Euler-Rodrigues maps and rational Cayley transforms, NC-SSM achieves exact norm-preserving isometry (||U_t|| = 1). We introduce pure Hopf-fibration Bloch projective readouts (S^3/{+-1} =~ S^2 =~ SO(3)) to eliminate sign ambiguity, true quaternion parallel prefix scans (9.06x speedup at T=2048), and Identity-Gated Lie SSMs to eliminate sparse syntax phase drift. Extensive benchmarks across 14 experimental regimes show: (1) NC-SSM achieves 100% tracking on S_3, D_4, Q_8 and simple group A_5, where a 3-layer deep diagonal baseline collapses to 6.60% (p = 8.81e-4); (2) Cayley-SO(5)-SSM breaks Klein's 1884 ceiling on symmetric group S_5 (50.92% vs diagonal 5.25%, p = 0.0015, delivering 7.8x variance reduction over SO(3)); (3) SO(3)-SSM preserves Riemannian manifolds across 300 steps (< 3.12e-6 drift, > 580,000x advantage), achieving 0.04 deg dead-reckoning error and active tangent denoising; (4) NC-SSM achieves 74.36% on Dyck-2 and 30.26% on deep AST scope tracking (p = 0.0081); and (5) ablation confirms strict isometry is mathematically necessary for lossless long-range associative memory.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出非交换状态空间模型（NC-SSM）、其实正交版本 SO(3)-SSM 及任意维 Cayley-SSM，将状态转移提升到紧致李群 SU(2)、SO(3)、SO(N)，突破对角 SSM 的可解性上限，在多类群跟踪、流形保持和长程记忆任务上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 选择性状态空间模型（如 Mamba、S4D、LRU）受限于转移矩阵可交换性和可解仿射变换群（Aff_D，导出长度≤2），导致堆叠多层对角网络在非可解单群（如 A_5）上优化严重退化，因为模拟非阿贝尔交换子需要指数级电路模拟深度。因此需要将状态转移提升到非交换紧致李群以突破该瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 NC-SSM 及其实正交对应 SO(3)-SSM 和任意维 Cayley-SSM，将状态转移提升至紧致李群 SU(2)、SO(3)、SO(N)。通过闭式 Euler-Rodrigues 映射与有理 Cayley 变换实现精确保范等距（‖U_t‖=1）；引入纯 Hopf 纤维化 Bloch 射影读出（S^3/{±1}≅S^2≅SO(3)）消除符号歧义；采用真四元数并行前缀扫描（T=2048 时 9.06 倍加速）；并设计 Identity-Gated Lie SSM 消除稀疏语法相位漂移。
AI.result: 在 14 组实验体系中：(1) NC-SSM 在 S_3、D_4、Q_8 及单群 A_5 上实现 100% 跟踪，而 3 层深对角基线崩溃至 6.60%（p=8.81e-4）；(2) Cayley-SO(5)-SSM 打破 Klein 1884 对对称群 S_5 的上限（50.92% vs 对角 5.25%，p=0.0015），较 SO(3) 方差降低 7.8 倍；(3) SO(3)-SSM 在 300 步内保持黎曼流形（漂移<3.12e-6，优势>580,000 倍），航位推算误差 0.04 度并具备切空间去噪能力；(4) NC-SSM 在 Dyck-2 上达 74.36%，深层 AST 作用域跟踪达 30.26%（p=0.0081）；(5) 消融实验证实严格等距是无损长程联想记忆的数学必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 将状态转移从可解对角/仿射群提升到非交换紧致李群，可从根本上解除现有选择性 SSM 的可解性限制，在群跟踪、流形保持与长程联想记忆任务上取得显著改进，且严格等距是长程无损记忆的必要条件。

title: The Weakest Link: Distilling LLM Reasoning with Worst-Case Constrained Reinforcement Learning
summary: Distilling the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) into smaller students is a central challenge for efficient deployment. Current approaches face a fundamental tension: optimizing purely for verifiable task rewards (e.g., via GRPO) leads to reward hacking, where students arrive at correct final answers through flawed intermediate logic, while regularizing with soft divergence penalties against a teacher (e.g., KL-based distillation) dilutes task performance and, critically, allows the student to compensate for severe logical violations at one step with high teacher agreement at others. We argue that this averaging is fundamentally misaligned with the nature of reasoning: a chain-of-thought is only as valid as its weakest link. Motivated by this observation, we formulate reasoning distillation as a constrained reinforcement learning problem in which the task reward is maximized subject to a worst-case constraint on the teacher log-likelihood along every prefix of the trajectory. To avoid the prohibitive cost of dual Lagrangian solvers and the test-time teacher dependence of state-augmented methods such as Saute, we derive an unaugmented constrained MDP whose reward transformation preserves the hard-constraint semantics, admits a low-variance policy gradient decomposition into single-step and long-term terms, and provably satisfies the worst-case constraint almost surely in the penalty limit. Through extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks, we demonstrate that our method significantly expands the accuracy-fidelity Pareto front. By matching the high Final Answer Correctness of pure RL and drastically reducing teacher constraint violations, we ultimately achieve the highest rigorous Reasoning Success Rate across all evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将推理蒸馏建模为约束强化学习问题，通过对教师对数似然在整个轨迹前缀上的最坏情况约束来避免奖励黑客与软散度惩罚的缺陷，并推导出无需增广状态的约束MDP与低方差策略梯度分解。
AI.motivation: 将LLM推理能力蒸馏到更小的学生模型时存在根本性矛盾：纯任务奖励优化（如GRPO）导致奖励黑客，学生用错误中间逻辑得到正确答案；而基于KL软散度对教师正则化会稀释任务性能，且允许学生在某一步严重违反逻辑却用其他步的高教师一致性来补偿。这种平均化与"思维链的有效性取决于最弱环节"的本质相悖。
AI.method: 将推理蒸馏形式化为约束强化学习问题：在轨迹每个前缀上对教师对数似然施加最坏情况约束的同时最大化任务奖励。为避免对偶拉格朗日求解器的高昂成本和Saute等状态增广方法的测试期教师依赖，推导出一个非增广的约束MDP，其奖励变换保持硬约束语义，并将策略梯度分解为单步项与长期项，具有低方差特性，且在惩罚极限下几乎必然满足最坏情况约束。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上的大量实验表明，该方法显著扩展了准确率-保真度的帕累托前沿：在匹配纯RL的高最终答案正确率的同时，大幅降低教师约束违反率，在所有评估设置下取得最高的严格推理成功率。
AI.conclusion: 推理蒸馏应遵循"最弱环节"原则，采用前缀级最坏情况约束的约束强化学习框架，可在不牺牲任务性能的前提下保证推理链的逻辑有效性，实现优于纯RL与KL蒸馏的严格推理成功率。

title: Benchmarking System One decision models against trained classifiers and language models for automated decision gates
summary: Software that hands branching decisions to a model needs a declared option and a probability it can threshold. Typed decision models, also called System One models, return such probabilities without generating text, while supervised classifiers and generative language models are the established alternatives. Under matched conditions, one harness sends eight decision-model checkpoints from six families, including the hosted model Jev, and two generative comparators the same semantic requests, and scores supervised and zero-shot classifiers on the same workflow, intent and social-science items. The ranking of the model classes depends on the conditions. With the task's own labels, small trained classifiers are the most accurate on intents and not significantly different from the best decision models on workflows. Without labels, every decision model except the encoder-based checkpoints exceeds a zero-shot entailment classifier on workflows and intents. Read through option-key likelihoods, a larger generative model is level with Jev on workflows and intents and accepts more workflow decisions at five percent risk, and fine-tuned decision checkpoints gain intent accuracy over their untuned backbones. Stored temperatures fitted on few options raise calibration error with many options, and a held-out threshold for five percent in-scope risk still lets Jev accept 0.310 of out-of-scope requests. Swapping yes and no flips 50.5 answers per hundred for Jev, while fine-tuned checkpoints cut their backbones' social-science flips. An intent-trained first stage escalating to Jev matches its accuracy at 0.43 of its cost at full graphics-processor utilization. The results yield condition-dependent design rules for automated decision gates.

AI.tldr: 在统一测试条件下比较了类型化决策模型（System One）与监督分类器、生成式语言模型的决策门控表现，发现模型类别优劣依条件而定，并给出条件相关的设计规则。
AI.motivation: 软件将分支决策交给模型时，需要一个可声明、可设阈值的选项及概率；类型化决策模型能直接返回此类概率而不生成文本，但相较监督分类器与生成式语言模型的优劣尚缺乏匹配条件下的系统比较。
AI.method: 用同一测试架向六个家族共八个决策模型检查点（含托管模型 Jev）及两个生成式对照模型发送相同语义请求，在工作流、意图与社会科学条目上对监督及零样本分类器进行评分；并考察选项键似然读取、温度校准、阈值设定、是/否标签互换及两阶段升级等设置。
AI.result: 有任务标签时小型训练分类器在意图上最准，在工作流上与最佳决策模型无显著差异；无标签时除编码器检查点外所有决策模型在工作流和意图上均超过零样本蕴涵分类器。通过选项键似然读取，更大的生成模型在工作流和意图上与 Jev 持平，并能在 5% 风险下接受更多工作流决策；微调决策检查点较未调优骨干提升意图准确率。少量选项上拟合的温度在多选项时提高校准误差，5% 在域风险阈值下 Jev 仍接受 0.310 的域外请求；互换是/否使 Jev 每百次翻转 50.5 个答案，微调检查点则减少其骨干的社会科学翻转。意图训练的一级阶段升级到 Jev 可在满 GPU 利用率下以 0.43 成本达到其准确率。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型与分类器、生成式模型的相对优势取决于是否有标签等条件，据此提出面向自动化决策门控的条件相关设计规则。

title: Deep Learning for Anomaly Detection in Railway Systems: A Structured Survey
comment: Survey paper. Published in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence (EAAI), 2026
summary: Ensuring safe and reliable operation of modern railway systems increasingly relies on data-driven monitoring and intelligent fault detection. Deep learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for railway anomaly detection, driven by the growing availability of heterogeneous sensor data from rolling stock and infrastructure. This paper presents a structured survey of deep learning-based anomaly detection approaches for railway systems. The surveyed methods are organized using a unified taxonomy covering anomaly location, data representation and manifestation, sensing modality, and temporal characteristics. Existing approaches, including convolutional, recurrent and attention-based architectures, autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, and transformers, are structured into classification-based, prediction-based, reconstruction-based, and hybrid learning paradigms. The survey also examines data-centric challenges, evaluation practices, performance metrics, and practical deployment aspects, including edge-cloud architectures, computational constraints, and hardware-aware optimization. Finally, a decision-oriented framework links anomaly characteristics, data properties, and operational constraints to suitable detection paradigms and deployment configurations. This work provides a structured reference for selecting and deploying deep learning solutions for railway anomaly detection and highlights open challenges toward reliable and scalable intelligent monitoring systems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于深度学习铁路异常检测的结构化综述，提出统一分类法，梳理四大学习范式，并给出面向决策的选型与部署框架。
AI.motivation: 现代铁路系统的安全可靠运行日益依赖数据驱动的监测与智能故障检测，铁路车辆与基础设施的多源异构传感器数据不断丰富，使深度学习成为铁路异常检测的有效范式；但缺乏统一、系统的梳理来指导方法选择与部署。
AI.method: 采用结构化综述方式，建立统一分类法，涵盖异常位置、数据表示与表现形式、传感模态、时间特性四个维度；将卷积、循环、注意力架构、自编码器、生成对抗网络、Transformer等方法归纳为基于分类、基于预测、基于重构、混合学习四大范式；并考察数据中心挑战、评估实践、性能指标与部署层面的问题（边缘-云架构、计算约束、硬件感知优化）。
AI.result: 形成覆盖方法、数据、评估与部署的系统性归纳；给出将异常特征、数据属性与运行约束映射到合适检测范式与部署配置的决策导向框架。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为铁路异常检测中深度学习方案的选择与部署提供了结构化参考，并指出了实现可靠、可扩展智能监测系统的开放挑战。

title: MoRA: MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable parameter scaling with limited per-token computation by activating only a small subset of experts for each token, but deploying them still requires loading the complete expert pool into memory. Structured expert pruning can effectively reduce the memory usage by removing experts. However, existing pruning methods either use expert ranking criteria that are not well aligned with model performance or rely on effective expert subset searching that is computationally expensive. Moreover, these methods typically overlook the routing-behavior redundancy among the retained experts. In this paper, we propose MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation (MoRA), a framework for structured MoE expert pruning. We introduce a learnable router bias for each expert and optimize these biases by minimizing the language-modeling loss and a routing-diversity regularizer. The learned router biases sharpen the routing probability distributions to identify experts critical to model performance while encouraging the selection of experts with diverse routing preferences. In addition, we introduce an expert approximation mechanism as a post-pruning enhancement. It leverages the remaining experts to approximate the outputs of pruned experts by affine transformation, further improving the performance of the pruned model. We evaluate MoRA on Qwen3-30B-A3B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and Moonlight-16B-A3B, removing 25\% and 50\% of the routed experts in each MoE layer. Extensive experiments on nine zero-shot benchmarks show that MoRA outperforms state-of-the-art pruning algorithms. Our code will be released.

AI.tldr: MoRA：通过路由器偏置学习与专家近似实现结构化 MoE 专家剪枝，在多个模型与零样本基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: MoE 部署需加载全部专家池至内存；现有结构化专家剪枝方法的排序准则与模型性能不对齐，或依赖计算昂贵的子集搜索，且忽视了保留专家间的路由行为冗余。
AI.method: 为每个专家引入可学习路由器偏置，通过最小化语言建模损失与路由多样性正则项优化偏置，锐化路由分布以识别关键专家并鼓励路由偏好多样性；并设计剪枝后专家近似机制，用保留专家以仿射变换近似被剪专家的输出。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Moonlight-16B-A3B 上每层移除 25% 与 50% 路由专家，九个零样本基准上优于 SOTA 剪枝算法。
AI.conclusion: MoRA 是一种有效的结构化 MoE 专家剪枝框架，兼顾关键专家识别与路由多样性，并通过专家近似进一步提升剪枝模型性能。

title: When Do Attention-Head Ablations Support Causal Claims? Projection-Level Confounds, Floor Effects, and Matched Controls
comment: Code available in the accompanying repository. 2 figures
summary: Attention-head ablation, zeroing a head and measuring the resulting change in task performance, is a common method for inferring which components of a language model are causally responsible for a behavior. We show using GPT-2 small that this inference can be fragile unless the intervention semantics, evaluation metric, and controls are carefully validated. A natural post-projection implementation of "zeroing a head" is nearly uncorrelated with a corrected pre-projection ablation (Pearson r = 0.057) and selects a completely disjoint top-5 set of important heads. We also show that binary accuracy can hide effects at behavioral floors and near ceilings, whereas gold-token log-probability remains graded. Using a discovery/held-out split and 1,000 matched random-head and layer-matched-head control draws, the corrected per-head effect ranking is highly stable across splits (Spearman rho = 0.974), and the top-5 selected heads significantly exceed both control distributions (Monte Carlo p = 0.001). However, evidence for task specificity is not robust on GPT-2. Replication on DistilGPT2 preserves the intervention-semantic and matched-control findings. These results show that single-head ablation does not by itself justify a causal claim; defensible interpretation requires correct intervention placement, a non-saturated continuous metric, and matched held-out controls.

AI.tldr: 本文以GPT-2 small为例表明，单头消融的因果推断在干预语义、评估指标与控制未经验证时并不可靠：后投影消融与校正的前投影消融几乎不相关（r=0.057），且选出的top-5重要头完全不相交；提出校正的前投影消融、连续指标（gold-token对数概率）与匹配对照，可使排序高度稳定（Spearman rho=0.974）并显著超越对照（p=0.001），但任务特异性证据在GPT-2上不稳健，DistilGPT2复现了干预语义与匹配对照的结论。
AI.motivation: 注意力头消融（将某个头置零并测量任务性能变化）被广泛用于推断语言模型哪些组件对某行为具有因果责任。作者质疑这一推断链条的稳健性，指出若干预语义（消融位置）、评估指标和对照设置未经严格验证，结论可能脆弱甚至错误。动机在于为单头消融提供可辩护的方法学规范，避免仅凭消融结果就下因果断言。
AI.method: 以GPT-2 small为对象，比较"后投影"（post-projection）消融与校正的"前投影"（pre-projection）消融，用Pearson相关与top-5头集合重合度衡量差异；评估指标上对比二元准确率（存在行为地板/天花板饱和问题）与gold-token对数概率（连续、分级）；采用发现集/留出集划分，并进行1,000次匹配的随机头与同层匹配头对照抽样；使用Spearman rho评估跨划分的排序稳定性，用蒙特卡洛检验判断top-5头是否显著超过对照分布；并在DistilGPT2上做复现。
AI.result: 后投影消融与校正的前投影消融几乎不相关（Pearson r=0.057），两者选出的top-5重要头完全不相交（disjoint）。二元准确率在行为地板和天花板附近会掩盖效应，而gold-token对数概率保持分级的效应度量。在发现/留出划分下，校正后的逐头效应排序高度稳定（Spearman rho=0.974）；top-5选出的头显著超过随机头与同层匹配头两种对照分布（蒙特卡洛 p=0.001）。但任务特异性（task specificity）的证据在GPT-2上不稳健。在DistilGPT2上的复现保留了干预语义与匹配对照的发现。
AI.conclusion: 单头消融本身不足以支撑因果主张。可辩护的解释需要三个条件：正确的干预位置（前投影消融）、非饱和的连续评估指标（如gold-token对数概率）、以及匹配的留出对照。这些方法学要求应作为注意力头因果分析的标准实践。

title: A First Glance at Jev for Network Traffic Classification: Accuracy, Processing Time, and Cost
summary: We evaluate Jev on ten dataset-defined application labels in CESNET-QUICEXT-25 using only the first ten packets' sizes, directions, and inter-packet times. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first empirical study of general-purpose decision models, represented here by Jev, for application classification of network flows. Across 52,000 records from 26 collection weeks following the training period, 40 fixed labeled examples raise Jev's accuracy from 9.80% to 28.42%. Random Forest and Extra Trees trained on 8,000 records achieve 69.95% and 66.80% and outperform Jev in every week. Increasing Jev's context to 150 examples yields 34.50% on the first test week. On a paired 100-record subset, Jev with 40 examples achieves 29% accuracy at a median request time of 0.750 s, versus 37% and 6.036 s for the generative language model OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol with high reasoning effort through Azure; Jev also incurs lower API charges. The paired subset does not establish an accuracy advantage for either service, and the timing reflects different service configurations. Thus, labeled examples substantially improve Jev, but the tested Jev configurations remain less accurate than trained tree ensembles; unequal supervision budgets and fixed configurations prevent attributing the gap to a single cause.

AI.tldr: 在CESNET-QUICEXT-25上，用每条流前10个包的大小、方向与包间时延评估通用决策模型Jev的流量应用分类性能；少量带标签示例可大幅提升Jev准确率，但仍不及树集成模型。
AI.motivation: 探究通用决策模型（以Jev为代表）能否用于网络流的应用分类，并与传统树集成模型及生成式语言模型服务进行比较，检验少样本示例（in-context examples）对其性能的提升作用。
AI.method: 使用CESNET-QUICEXT-25数据集上10个数据集定义的应用标签，仅取每条流前10个包的包长、方向、包间时延作为输入特征。在训练期后的26个采集周、52,000条记录上进行评估：Jev分别使用40个固定标注示例与150个示例（上下文扩充）；对比在8,000条记录上训练的Random Forest与Extra Trees；并在100条记录的配对子集上，与经Azure调用、高推理强度的生成式语言模型OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol比较准确率、请求时延与API费用。
AI.result: 40个固定标注示例将Jev准确率从9.80%提升至28.42%；Random Forest与Extra Trees分别达69.95%与66.80%，在每一周都优于Jev；Jev上下文扩至150个示例时，首个测试周达34.50%。在100条记录的配对子集上，Jev（40示例）准确率29%、中位请求时间0.750 s，GPT-5.6 Sol为37%、6.036 s，且Jev的API费用更低。该配对子集未能确立任一服务的准确率优势，时间差异反映服务配置不同。
AI.conclusion: 标注示例能显著改善Jev，但所测Jev配置的准确率仍低于训练好的树集成模型；由于监督预算不等且配置固定，尚无法将性能差距归因于单一原因。

title: Fusion techniques of time frequency-based images to predict the outcome of rTMS depression therapy
comment: Published in the Biomedical Signal Processing and Control
summary: Depression is a mental condition that can lead to suicide and self-harm. Predicting the outcome of depression treatment is one of the most difficult tasks for clinicians. Among various treatment options, repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS) is a widely used non-invasive method. Predicting rTMS response using Electroencephalogram (EEG) data is difficult because of high inter-subject variability and limited features from single-domain analysis. We introduce two fusion techniques, montage and blending, to overcome these limitations and extract richer features from EEG-derived Time-Frequency (TF) images. We then propose a lightweight custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained on fused TF representations. \textcolor{black}{We use a primary dataset of 15 patients and a secondary dataset of 46 patients. We run two sets of experiments. The first set uses segment-level 10-fold cross-validation. In this setup segments from the same patient can appear in both training and testing. The Montage CWT\_ST fusion reaches 99.90\% accuracy on the primary dataset and 91.90\% on the secondary dataset. The second set uses strict subject-disjoint cross-validation. All segments of a patient stay in one fold and no patient appears in both training and testing. Performance collapses. We test four time-frequency methods, six fusion mechanisms, and fourteen model architectures. With one exception, every configuration on both cohorts falls between AUC 0.31 and 0.54 and every 95\% confidence interval contains 0.5. A patient-level permutation test on the best standalone method returns $p = 0.703$. The best subject-level result is Montage CWT\_ST on the primary cohort, which reaches AUC $0.874 \pm 0.183$ and 82.7\% accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出montage与blending两种EEG时频图像融合技术及轻量CNN预测rTMS抑郁疗效；分段级交叉验证下准确率高达99.90%，但严格按受试者分离验证时性能崩塌，提示此前结果主要源于数据泄漏。
AI.motivation: 抑郁治疗疗效预测是临床难题；基于EEG预测rTMS响应受限于高受试者间变异和单域特征不足，因此需要融合技术提取更丰富的时频特征。
AI.method: 使用两套数据（15人与46人），提出montage与blending两种融合技术生成EEG时频图（TF）表示，并设计轻量自定义CNN训练；实验分两组：分段级10折交叉验证（同一患者分段可跨训练/测试）和严格受试者分离交叉验证；共测试4种时频方法、6种融合机制、14种模型架构，并进行患者级置换检验。
AI.result: 分段级验证中Montage CWT_ST融合在主数据集达99.90%、次数据集91.90%准确率；受试者分离验证下性能崩塌，除个别外所有配置AUC在0.31–0.54且95%置信区间含0.5，最佳独立方法患者级置换检验p=0.703；受试者级最佳结果为主队列Montage CWT_ST，AUC 0.874±0.183、准确率82.7%。
AI.conclusion: 高分段级准确率很可能来自患者分段泄漏导致的乐观偏差；在严格受试者分离评估下多数配置无法区分疗效，仅个别配置显示有限信号，表明EEG预测rTMS响应仍具挑战性，需严格验证协议。

title: OmniMed-Jev: Calibrating LVLM Confidence for Trustworthy Medical Multimodal Decisions via System One
comment: We introduce OmniMed-Jev, a decision-native interface based on Jev that outputs Choice, Noul or Score decisions with calibrated probabilities
summary: Medical models are judged not only on correctness, but on whether reported confidence matches actual accuracy. Generalist multimodal medical models have expanded what a single model can perceive, yet they still express bounded decisions such as diagnoses, findings or cell counts as generated text, so the reported probability reflects the next token rather than the decision itself.
