Motivated by decision-native interfaces such as Jev, we introduce OmniMed-Jev, which represents each medical decision as a Choice, Noul or Score decision over a runtime-supplied candidate set and returns a full distribution over that set: mutually exclusive classes, binary presence of a finding, or a bounded ordered value. The design is omni in three respects: it accepts diverse imaging modalities, covers different prediction tasks, and expresses them through one candidate-conditioned probability model, so heterogeneous outputs become comparable probabilities rather than task-specific strings. In an interface-controlled comparison against a generative baseline trained on the same backbone, data and schedule, OmniMed-Jev's reported probabilities track observed correctness far more closely, reducing calibration error by up to an order of magnitude and reliability error by up to two, while point-prediction performance remains comparable; counting is the one family where the generative baseline stays ahead. Making the decision distribution the model's output is not a format change but what turns reported numbers into probabilities that mean what they say. These results support explicit decision modeling as a way to make reported confidence meaningful within the evaluated tasks, and they are not evidence of clinical readiness: the comparison cannot separate the interface from associated training differences, which we state alongside the results. Code is available at github.com/lytang63/OmniMed-Jev.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OmniMed-Jev，将医学决策表示为对运行时候选集的 Choice/Noul/Score 决策并输出完整概率分布，使报告置信度更贴近真实准确率。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态医学模型虽扩展了感知能力，但仍以生成文本表达诊断、发现或细胞计数等有界决策，所报概率反映的是下一 token 而非决策本身，导致置信度与准确率不匹配。
AI.method: 借鉴 Jev 等决策原生接口，将每个医学决策建模为对运行时候选集的 Choice、Noul 或 Score 决策，返回候选集上的完整分布，统一处理互斥类别、二值存在性与有界有序值；采用候选条件概率模型，兼容多种影像模态与任务。
AI.result: 在与同骨干、同数据、同训练计划的生成式基线进行接口控制对比时，OmniMed-Jev 的报告概率更贴近观测正确率，校准误差最多降低一个数量级，可靠性误差最多降低两倍，点预测性能相当；计数任务是生成式基线唯一占优的类别。
AI.conclusion: 将决策分布作为模型输出并非格式变化，而是使报告数字成为名实相符的概率；结果支持显式决策建模在所评估任务中赋予置信度意义，但不构成临床就绪证据，且对比无法分离接口与相关训练差异。

title: EvoGen-Harness: Learning Where and How to Evolve Image-Generation Harnesses
summary: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems can be improved without modifying generator parameters by adapting the external system around frozen generators. However, existing approaches typically optimize a predefined dimension, such as prompts, routing, or workflows, restricting the space in which generation failures can be corrected. Allowing multiple generator-external responsibilities to evolve provides a broader adaptation space, but introduces a new challenge: visual feedback reveals what failed, but not where persistent evolution should occur or how this space should be explored efficiently. We introduce EvoGen-Harness, a generator-agnostic framework for multi-responsibility image-generation harness evolution, together with Trace (Trajectory-Relative Attribution and Coordinated Evolution). Trace aggregates evidence across stochastic executions, uses failure attribution as a search prior to focus candidate updates, and progressively re-attributes residual failures to coordinate evolution across responsibilities, while No-Patch and held-out validation prevent unnecessary or harmful updates. Across GenEval2, T2I-CompBench++, and WISE, EvoGen-Harness improves over the strongest evaluated baselines by +0.2633, +0.0720, and +0.0752, respectively, while achieving 87.9-91.4% attribution recall, 94.8% No-Patch accuracy, and only 1.9% regression. These results demonstrate that attribution-guided multi-responsibility evolution can substantially enhance frozen T2I systems beyond single-dimension adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoGen-Harness 框架与 Trace 方法,对冻结 T2I 生成器的多个外部职责进行协同演化,在多个基准上显著优于单维适配基线。
AI.motivation: 现有冻结生成器的外部适配方法通常只优化单一预设维度(如提示、路由或工作流),限制了可纠正生成失败的搜索空间;而放开多职责演化虽能扩大适配空间,却带来"视觉反馈只揭示失败现象、不揭示持久演化应发生于何处及如何高效探索"的新难题。
AI.method: EvoGen-Harness 为与生成器无关的多职责图像生成 harness 演化框架;核心方法 Trace(Trajectory-Relative Attribution and Coordinated Evolution)跨随机执行聚合证据,以失败归因作为搜索先验聚焦候选更新,并逐步重新归因残余失败以协调各职责的演化,同时用 No-Patch 与留出验证避免无必要或有害的更新。
AI.result: 在 GenEval2、T2I-CompBench++ 与 WISE 上,分别较最强评估基线提升 +0.2633、+0.0720、+0.0752;归因召回率 87.9–91.4%,No-Patch 准确率 94.8%,回归率仅 1.9%。
AI.conclusion: 归因引导的多职责演化能够显著增强冻结的 T2I 系统,效果超越单维度适配。

title: T2SPO: Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to learn multi-step behaviors through interaction with their environments. However, rewards in many interactive tasks reflect only the final outcome, providing limited guidance on which intermediate decisions advance the task. Successful training trajectories contain intermediate states that can provide supervision for subsequent interactions. We introduce Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization (T2SPO), a method that uses past interaction trajectories to provide step-level feedback for policy learning. T2SPO derives remaining-distance targets from successful trajectories and pairs them with representations of the states visited along the way. Conditioned on these examples, a pretrained TabPFN regressor estimates the remaining distance to success at each state of a new rollout. Changes in this distance estimate across consecutive states yield auxiliary credit for agent steps alongside task-level supervision. As training proceeds, newly completed trajectories refresh the estimator's context, incorporating new experience without updating its parameters. Experiments with 1.5B and 7B language models on ALFWorld and WebShop show that T2SPO consistently improves overall task success over GRPO.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization (T2SPO)，利用历史成功轨迹训练一个TabPFN回归器来估计状态到成功的剩余距离，并将其变化作为步骤级辅助信用信号，与任务级监督结合，提升大语言模型智能体在交互任务中的策略学习效果。
AI.motivation: 强化学习虽能让LLM智能体通过与环境交互学习多步行为，但许多交互任务中的奖励仅反映最终结果，对哪些中间决策有助于推进任务缺乏指导。成功轨迹中蕴含大量可提供过程监督的中间状态信息，如何有效利用成为关键问题。
AI.method: T2SPO从成功轨迹中提取"剩余距离"目标，并与沿途访问状态的表示配对，构建训练样本。基于这些示例，利用预训练的TabPFN回归器对新轨迹中每个状态估计到达成功的剩余距离。相邻状态间该估计值的变化被用作智能体步骤的辅助信用信号，与任务级监督共同指导策略更新。随训练推进，新完成的轨迹不断刷新估计器的上下文，从而在不更新其参数的情况下纳入新经验。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop任务上，使用1.5B和7B语言模型的实验表明，T2SPO相较GRPO方法能够稳定提升整体任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: T2SPO通过将成功轨迹转化为步骤级剩余距离监督信号，有效缓解了稀疏结果奖励带来的信用分配难题，为LLM智能体的多步策略学习提供了一种无需更新估计器参数的可行方案，且在不同模型规模和任务上均具一致改进效果。

title: Interpretable Synthetic Medical Tabular Data Generation for Clinical Decision Support Using Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE 39th International Symposium on Computer-Based Medical Systems (CBMS), Limassol, Cyprus
summary: Synthetic medical tabular data generation has become essential for developing and validating computer-based medical systems (CBMSs) when real clinical data is restricted due to privacy, ethical, or data availability limitations. Existing probabilistic and deep generative models often lack interpretability and fail to preserve clinically meaningful dependencies, limiting their suitability for safety-critical applications. This paper proposes a novel application of Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) in a framework for synthetic medical tabular data generation with explicit causality and privacy preservation. Clinical features are described using linguistically interpretable fuzzy sets, and inter-feature dependencies are encoded as FCM edge weights computed from fuzzy set intersections. Synthetic patient records are generated by propagating randomly initialized linguistic activation vectors through the FCM until convergence, followed by defuzzification to produce clinically coherent numerical values. The approach natively handles mixed data types, and domain constraints common in health records. Experimental evaluation on UCI medical benchmark datasets demonstrates competitive performance under a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) protocol. The proposed method achieves accuracy of up to 0.81 and AUROC of up to 0.90 on the Heart Disease dataset, matching or exceeding TVAE and Gaussian Copula baselines while running exclusively on CPU. Fidelity metrics including KS Complement (up to 0.91) and Correlation Similarity (up to 0.95) confirm strong statistical coherence, and DCR Baseline Protection scores consistently exceed those of TVAE, confirming adequate privacy guarantees. These results demonstrate that causally grounded, interpretable fuzzy modeling offers a computationally efficient and transparent alternative to deep generative models for trustworthy synthetic data generation in CBMSs.

AI.tldr: 提出基于模糊认知图(FCM)的合成医疗表格数据生成框架，具备显式因果性与隐私保护，在CPU上即可运行，性能匹配或超越TVAE与高斯Copula基线。
AI.motivation: 真实临床数据受隐私、伦理与可获得性限制，而现有概率与深度生成模型缺乏可解释性，难以保持临床有意义的依赖关系，不适合安全攸关的CBMS应用。
AI.method: 用语言可解释的模糊集描述临床特征，以模糊集交集计算FCM边权来编码特征间依赖；随机初始化语言激活向量并在FCM中传播至收敛，再经去模糊化得到临床连贯的数值，原生支持混合数据类型与领域约束。
AI.result: 在UCI医疗基准数据集上采用TSTR协议评估：心脏病数据集准确率达0.81、AUROC达0.90，匹配或超越TVAE与高斯Copula，且仅用CPU运行；保真度指标KS Complement达0.91、Correlation Similarity达0.95，DCR Baseline Protection持续高于TVAE。
AI.conclusion: 因果支撑、可解释的模糊建模为CBMS中可信合成数据生成提供了计算高效且透明的深度生成模型替代方案，并具备隐私保障。

title: Forking: Sudden Overfitting Under Replay
comment: 42 pages, 22 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/guoshaoyang-pku/forking/tree/release
summary: This paper studies forking, a generalization failure discovered in NanoGPT autoresearch. Under data replay, models with an over-encoding n-gram memory branch show a sharp separation of training and validation loss at epoch boundaries, resembling the shape of forks. We study this phenomenon in a controlled vanilla NanoGPT setting and reproduce it in a DeepSeek-style model with Engram. Mechanistically, repeated updates sharpen the continuations observed in training while suppressing the probability of unseen continuations, whose loss grows with each pass. The n-gram module creates weakly interacting context-specific subspaces, amplifying this effect. Low-frequency contexts contribute most of the gap, whereas larger training budgets and heavily crowded tables suppress it. We also observe forking in short-budget, heavily repeated SFT and RL-like regimes. The contributions of this paper are twofold: (1) Forking reveals yet another curious phenomenon in deep learning, in addition to grokking and double descent. (2) Forking is an unexpected and unpleasant by-product of tricks proposed by autoresearch agents. While these agents produce an enormous number of results that seem useful, we should always be careful with their results.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 NanoGPT 自动研究中发现的泛化失效现象"分叉"（forking）：在数据回放下，带过度编码 n-gram 记忆分支的模型在 epoch 边界处训练损失与验证损失急剧分离，形态类似分叉。
AI.motivation: 作者希望理解并复现 NanoGPT 自动研究（autoresearch）智能体所提技巧带来的意外副作用。这类智能体能产出大量看似有用的结果，但其可靠性存疑，因此需要深入剖析其副产物"分叉"现象，并把它作为深度学习中的新奇特现象加以研究。
AI.method: 在受控的 vanilla NanoGPT 设定中研究该现象，并在带 Engram 的 DeepSeek 风格模型中复现。从机制上分析重复更新对训练中出现的延续与未见延续概率的影响，考察 n-gram 模块所创造的弱交互、上下文特定子空间如何放大该效应；同时分析上下文频率、训练预算规模、表拥挤程度的影响，并在短预算、高度重复的 SFT 与类 RL 训练范式中观察分叉。
AI.result: 分叉被成功复现于受控 NanoGPT 与带 Engram 的 DeepSeek 风格模型，并在短预算、高度重复的 SFT 与类 RL 范式中也观察到。重复更新会锐化训练中见过的延续、抑制未见延续的概率，其损失随每轮遍历而增大；n-gram 模块形成的弱交互、上下文特定子空间放大了该效应。低频上下文贡献了大部分损失差距，而更大的训练预算和高度拥挤的表可抑制分叉。
AI.conclusion: 贡献有二：（1）分叉是继 grokking 与双下降之后深度学习中的又一奇特现象；（2）分叉是自动研究智能体所提技巧带来的意外且不愉悦的副产品，提醒人们即便这些智能体能产出大量看似有用的结果，也应对其结果保持谨慎。

title: Specificity-Aware Diffusion Steering via Variance-Reduced Sequential Monte Carlo
summary: Inference-time steering enables pretrained diffusion models to satisfy new constraints without full retraining. However, specificity-aware generation is difficult: repelling samples from a negative reference distribution can also erode the positive distribution where the two overlap. The key challenge is to suppress negative mass while minimally distorting the positive distribution. We address this problem by formulating specificity-aware steering as a target-design problem and deriving a target distribution from an overlap-based objective. The resulting target keeps the desired reference distribution only in regions where it is sufficiently preferred over the undesired reference distribution, giving a likelihood-ratio interpretation of specificity. To sample from the corresponding time-dependent target path, we develop a Sequential Monte Carlo sampler with a variance-minimized local proposal. We further introduce a practical fixed-noise optimization procedure with the Jacobian--vector products with the desired and undesired score fields. Experiments on synthetic task, class-contrastive generation, text-to-image tasks and peptide-MHC (p-MHC) binder show that the proposed method suppresses undesired regions more effectively, reduces mode shift, and improves sampling stability by decreasing the SMC weight collapse compared with negative-guidance baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/WangLuran/Specificity-Aware-Diffusion-Steering

AI.tldr: 本文将特异性感知引导建模为目标分布设计问题，通过基于重叠的目标推导出仅在正参考优于负参考区域保留正分布的似然比目标，并用方差最小化局部提议的序贯蒙特卡洛采样器采样，实现抑制负样本同时最小化正分布畸变。
AI.motivation: 预训练扩散模型可通过推理时引导满足新约束而无需重训练，但特异性感知生成存在困难：从负参考分布排斥样本时会侵蚀正负分布重叠区域的正分布，核心挑战在于抑制负质量的同时最小化对正分布的扰动。
AI.method: 将特异性感知引导形式化为目标设计问题，从基于重叠的目标推导目标分布，仅在正参考足够优于负参考的区域保留其分布，给出特异性的似然比解释；为从时间相关目标路径采样，提出使用方差最小化局部提议的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）采样器，并引入结合期望与不期望分数场雅可比-向量积的固定噪声优化过程。
AI.result: 在合成任务、类别对比生成、文本到图像任务及肽-MHC（p-MHC）结合物实验上，该方法相比负面引导基线能更有效地抑制不期望区域、减少模式偏移，并通过降低 SMC 权重崩塌提升采样稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的目标设计框架与 SMC 采样方法为扩散模型的特异性感知引导提供了一种有效方案，在抑制负区域、减少模式偏移和提升采样稳定性方面优于负面引导基线，代码已开源。

title: NEUROTOKEN: Joint Source and Directional AAD with Envelope Decoding via Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Identifying which speaker a listener is attending to in a noisy room -- the cocktail-party problem -- is the missing ingredient for next-generation hearing aids and brain-computer interfaces: it tells the device whose voice to amplify. Auditory attention decoding (AAD) reads this answer from EEG, but the literature splits into disconnected pieces: directional-AAD classifies side but does not map side to stream; regression-based source-AAD ranks candidate streams by a single Pearson correlation that is intrinsically noisy at the 1-5 s windows real devices need; and envelope reconstruction has no native AAD rule. We argue the right object is not any single statistic but the conditional likelihood of the attended envelope given EEG, and we make this practical with NEUROTOKEN: a single network whose three heads share one EEG front-end, with a conditional flow-matching head (ATTUNEFLOW) that scores candidates by an integrated velocity-residual likelihood ratio. Two inference-time ensembles -- QUADTRACK (four complementary statistics) and ENV-FLOW (z-normalised QUADTRACK+ATTUNEFLOW) -- absorb per-statistic failure modes for free. On KU Leuven, DTU, and NJU at 5 s, ATTUNEFLOW lifts per-segment source-AAD by 9%-16% over the strongest non-generative baseline and shrinks across-subject variance by ~3x; trial-level fusion exceeds 93% on two of three datasets. In parallel reproductions we show that canonical 95-97% direction-AAD numbers collapse by 17%-45% under a strict trial-disjoint protocol, clarifying both the true ceiling and why a likelihood-based formulation is needed.

AI.tldr: 论文提出NEUROTOKEN网络，用条件流匹配头（ATTUNEFLOW）从EEG估计被注意包络的条件似然，并配合QUADTRACK与ENV-FLOW推理集成，实现稳健的听觉注意解码（AAD）。
AI.motivation: 鸡尾酒会问题要求设备判断听者注意哪位说话人，以决定放大哪路语音。现有AAD研究割裂：方向AAD只分左右不映射到语音流；回归式source-AAD仅用单一皮尔逊相关，在1-5秒窗下噪声大；包络重建缺乏原生AAD判据。作者认为应直接建模给定EEG下被注意包络的条件似然。
AI.method: NEUROTOKEN为单网络，三个头共享一个EEG前端；其中ATTUNEFLOW为条件流匹配头，通过积分速度残差似然比对候选流打分。推理时采用两种免费集成：QUADTRACK（四种互补统计量）与ENV-FLOW（z归一化的QUADTRACK+ATTUNEFLOW），以吸收单统计量的失效模式。
AI.result: 在KU Leuven、DTU、NJU三个数据集上，5秒窗时ATTUNEFLOW将逐段source-AAD较最强非生成基线提升9%-16%，跨被试方差缩小约3倍；试次级融合在两/三个数据集上超过93%。平行复现显示，在严格试次不相交协议下，经典的95-97%方向AAD准确率下降17%-45%，厘清了真实上限。
AI.conclusion: 以条件似然为核心、配合流匹配与推理集成，可显著提升AAD的准确性与跨被试稳健性；同时揭示传统方向AAD指标因协议宽松而被高估，说明似然化建模的必要性。

title: WIPSNet: Deep Learning for Paediatric Wheeze Detection from Overnight Impedance Pneumography
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Structured Data for Health, ICML 2026. Code: https://github.com/felix-oury/WIPSNet
summary: Overnight impedance pneumography (IP) is used to monitor paediatric respiratory health. Its current clinical readout, the Expiratory Variability Index (EVI), compresses each IP recording into a single scalar and achieves an AUC of 0.633 for night-level wheeze classification. We introduce Wheeze Impedance Pneumography Scalogram Network (WIPSNet), a 3D ResNet operating on stacked continuous wavelet transform scalograms of overnight IP signals. On a 15-patient cohort (60 nights, 281 hours), WIPSNet achieves an AUC of $0.783 \pm 0.026$, outperforming EVI, a state-space model (Mamba), and two modern sleep-staging architectures. Performance peaks at a volumetric depth corresponding to 32 minutes of temporal context, suggesting that multi-scale temporal aggregation is important for modelling nocturnal respiratory dynamics. Overall, these results indicate that structured time-frequency representations combined with 3D convolutional architectures provide an effective approach for learning from long, irregular physiological time series.

AI.tldr: 提出WIPSNet，用3D ResNet处理IP信号的堆叠CWT尺度图，夜间喘息分类AUC达0.783，优于EVI等基线，最佳时间上下文为32分钟。
AI.motivation: 现有临床指标EVI将整夜IP记录压缩为单一标量，信息损失大，夜间喘息分类AUC仅0.633，难以刻画呼吸动态的多尺度时频特征。
AI.method: 构建WIPSNet：对整夜阻抗肺容积（IP）信号做连续小波变换（CWT），堆叠为尺度图，输入3D ResNet进行时空特征学习。在15名患者（60夜、281小时）队列上，与EVI、状态空间模型Mamba及两种现代睡眠分期架构对比。
AI.result: WIPSNet取得AUC 0.783±0.026，优于EVI、Mamba及两种睡眠分期架构。性能在对应32分钟时间上下文的体深度处达到峰值。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的时频表示结合3D卷积架构，能有效学习长时程、不规则生理时间序列；多尺度时间聚合对建模夜间呼吸动态至关重要。

title: Metacognitive Reasoning in Energy Based Models using Instance Based Learning Theory
summary: Metacognition involves reasoning about cognitive processes themselves. An example is in resource allocation where we choose how much time and effort to put into a reasoning task before we begin based on our confidence. Current Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems that rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) cannot estimate their uncertainty about an output without first responding, and cannot dynamically allocate resources to producing an output, making this type of metacognitive process difficult. A recently proposed alternative to classic transformer architectures that addresses these two concerns is the Energy Based Model (EBM) which allows for interpretable uncertainty modeling and dynamic allocation of compute resources. While EBMs can allow for control of these two processes, the actual metacognitive task of determining compute allocation based on uncertainty is not directly addressed. Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) provides an approach to modeling human-like decisions from experience that has previously been applied to predicting human metacognitive reasoning. In this paper we introduce a framework for MEtacognitive Reasoning with Instance-based Learning Theory and Energy Dynamics (MERITED). Grounded in IBLT, this framework allows for control of the computational effort allocated in an EBM to allow for metacognitive control over reasoning effort based on uncertainty while remaining computationally efficient. This work has two main contributions, the training and open weight sharing of a 191M parameter reasoning EBM, and an implementation of the MERITED framework for dynamic compute allocation using an IBL model.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MERITED框架，将实例学习理论（IBLT）与能量模型（EBM）结合，实现基于不确定性的元认知计算资源动态分配，并公开了一个191M参数的推理EBM。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的AI系统需先输出才能估计自身不确定性，且无法动态分配计算资源，难以实现"先评估信心、再决定投入多少时间与精力"这类元认知过程；尽管EBM能建模不确定性并动态分配算力，但"依据不确定性确定计算分配"这一元认知任务本身尚未被直接解决。
AI.method: 提出MERITED框架（MEtacognitive Reasoning with Instance-based Learning Theory and Energy Dynamics），以IBLT为理论基础，利用IBL模型控制EBM中投入的计算量，从而在保持计算效率的同时，依据不确定性实现对推理努力的元认知控制。
AI.result: 完成并开放共享了一个191M参数的推理EBM的权重；实现了MERITED框架，用IBL模型进行动态算力分配。
AI.conclusion: MERITED为在EBM中实现基于不确定性的元认知推理资源控制提供了可行路径，兼具类人决策建模与计算效率，两项主要贡献为推理EBM的训练与权重开放以及基于IBL的动态算力分配实现。

title: Representation Transitions Reveal Emerging Safety Risks in Multi-Turn LLM Agents
summary:
Multi-turn attacks on agentic systems can compose individually permissible actions into harmful outcomes, challenging defenses that assess actions or states in isolation. We show that such attacks leave a detectable signature in the agent's internal representations: harmful behavior emerges as an accumulated representation transition across context updates, whose triggering context can be identified from the same signal. We further find that naive aggregation is confounded by benign representation drift, as a contrastive safety direction need not assign zero to benign transitions. We address this by denoising the direction, anchoring benign traffic at zero and removing its leading variation directions, with no runtime cost.
  These findings motivate DART, a runtime framework that detects and attributes representation shifts and intervenes with targeted reminders. Across six models and two multi-turn benchmarks, DART reduces attack success from 84% to 25% on MT-AgentRisk, catching every attack at a mean false-alarm rate of 12%, and from 97% to 52% on ASEval, at costs in benign non-refusal of 8% and 0%, respectively. On MT-AgentRisk, it outperforms ToolShield, the state-of-the-art multi-turn defense, on all six models: under the same protocol, ToolShield reaches only 55%. Denoising is critical: on ASEval, the undenoised monitor catches only 7%-40% of attacks, while the denoised monitor catches 60%-85%. The same monitor covers single-turn indirect injection without modification and adds only 0.14-0.56 s overhead per monitored step without requiring an auxiliary model, making it a lightweight complement to computation-heavy speculative defenses.

AI.tldr: DART：在不增加运行时成本的前提下对表征方向去噪，通过检测和归因多轮攻击中的表征漂移，并以定向提醒进行干预，将MT-AgentRisk攻击成功率从84%降至25%，ASEval从97%降至52%。
AI.motivation: 多轮攻击可将多个单独合规的动作组合为有害结果，而仅在孤立层面评估动作或状态的防御难以应对；作者希望找到此类攻击在智能体内部表征中留下的可检测特征。
AI.method: 发现有害行为表现为跨上下文更新的累积表征迁移，且触发上下文可由同一信号识别；针对良性表征漂移导致对比安全方向对良性迁移非零的问题，对方向进行去噪——将良性流量锚定为零并移除其主导变化方向，无运行时成本；据此提出DART运行时框架，检测并归因表征漂移，并以定向提醒进行干预。
AI.result: 在6个模型和2个多轮基准上，MT-AgentRisk攻击成功率由84%降至25%，以平均12%误报率捕获全部攻击；ASEval由97%降至52%，良性非拒绝代价分别为8%和0%。在MT-AgentRisk上全部6个模型均优于ToolShield（同协议下仅55%）。去噪关键：ASEval上未去噪仅捕获7%-40%攻击，去噪后为60%-85%。同一监控器无需修改即可覆盖单轮间接注入，每步仅增0.14-0.56秒开销，且无需辅助模型。
AI.conclusion: DART通过检测并归因内部表征漂移实现轻量级多轮攻击防御，性能超越现有SOTA，可作为计算密集型推测式防御的补充，并泛化至单轮间接注入场景。

title: The Conflict Between Logic and Memory: Learning Higher-Order Interactions in Shallow MLPs
summary: A network can fit its training examples while failing to recover the rule that generated their labels. We examine this separation in single-hidden-layer multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), using synthetic tasks that control interaction order and the presence of nuisance inputs. We establish elementary benchmark properties: pure parity contains no predictive lower-order marginals, admits an exact Bayes posterior, and can be represented on clean latent inputs by a width-$k$ ReLU network. Experiments then identify distinct optimization outcomes. In a matched order-2--4 sweep, SGD, Adam, and Muon all reach 100\% peak test accuracy at order two; at order three they reach 96.25\%, 50.87\%, and 76.82\%, respectively, while Muon reaches 99.21\% at order four. In a separate mixed-order task, freezing only the first-layer weights connected to independent nuisance inputs raises AdamW's epoch-10 accuracy from 44.73\% to 95.07\%. Removing the same inputs only at test time raises it to 48.38\%. Thus, nuisance-weight learning changes the training outcome beyond its immediate effect on prediction. Bias interventions expose a connection between target symmetry and shallow ReLU representations. In a compact signal-only regime, both SGD and Muon learn orders five through eight, with higher SGD peak accuracy at orders nine through eleven. Together, the results show how optimization and nuisance learning constrain the higher-order rules realized by a shallow network.

AI.tldr: 研究单隐层MLP在合成任务中"拟合训练样本"与"恢复生成规则"的分离，揭示优化器与冗余输入学习如何制约浅层网络实现的高阶规则。
AI.motivation: 网络可以完美拟合训练样本，却无法恢复生成标签的真实规则，这一泛化差距的成因尚不清晰。作者希望借助可控的合成任务，揭示优化过程与冗余输入学习对浅层网络所学规则的约束机制。
AI.method: 使用控制交互阶数与冗余输入的合成任务，在单隐层MLP上建立基准性质（纯奇偶任务不含低阶预测边际、有精确贝叶斯后验、可由宽度-k的ReLU网络在干净隐变量上表示）；比较SGD、Adam、Muon在阶数2-4扫描中的表现；设计混合阶任务，分别冻结连接冗余输入的第一层权重、以及仅在测试时移除这些输入；进行偏置干预以考察目标对称性与浅层ReLU表示的关系。
AI.result: 在2-4阶匹配扫描中，SGD、Adam、Muon在二阶均达100%峰值测试准确率；三阶分别为96.25%、50.87%、76.82%，Muon在四阶达99.21%。混合阶任务中，仅冻结连接冗余输入的第一层权重使AdamW第10轮准确率从44.73%升至95.07%；仅在测试时移除相同输入仅升至48.38%。在纯信号紧凑设定下，SGD与Muon都能学到5-8阶，SGD在9-11阶峰值准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: 训练样本拟合与规则恢复之间存在实质性分离。冗余权重的学习会超出其对预测的即时影响而改变训练结果；优化器选择与冗余输入处理共同制约浅层网络所能实现的高阶规则。偏置干预进一步揭示了目标对称性与浅层ReLU表示之间的联系。

title: EchoPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Pruning via Virtual Context Reconstruction
summary: KV cache pruning reduces long-context inference memory usage by evicting less important key-value pairs. KVzip estimates importance through context reconstruction: prompting a model to repeat the context chunk by chunk. This achieves strong compression quality at the cost of additional forward passes. Learned approximations reduce this cost but require model-specific training. We analyze how KVzip identifies important cached information and show how to approximate its reconstruction scores using information already computed during prefill. These findings motivate EchoPress, a training-free method that approximates reconstruction attention using queries and keys from standard prefill. For each request, it reconstructs only the first chunk to calibrate importance scores for the remaining context. Experiments on LongBench and RULER with Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that EchoPress matches KVzip in task accuracy across eviction ratios from 50% to 90%, while reducing compression overhead by a factor of 1.7-19.6 and total prefill time by a factor of up to 2.9. Code is available at https://github.com/ljwljwljwljw/kvpress/tree/echo-press.

AI.tldr: EchoPress是一种免训练KV缓存剪枝方法，用标准prefill已有的query和key近似KVzip的重建注意力分数，仅重建首个chunk来校准重要性，从而在保持任务精度的同时大幅降低压缩开销。
AI.motivation: KVzip通过逐块重建上下文来评估KV重要性，压缩质量好但需额外前向传播；学习式近似虽降低成本却依赖模型特定训练。作者旨在兼顾高质量与低成本，在免训练前提下降低KVzip的压缩开销。
AI.method: 分析KVzip识别重要缓存信息的方式，发现可用prefill阶段已计算的query和key近似其重建分数。据此提出免训练的EchoPress：对每个请求仅重建第一个chunk来校准其余上下文的重要性分数，免除额外训练与完整重建。
AI.result: 在LongBench和RULER上，使用Qwen3-8B与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，EchoPress在50%至90%的驱逐率下任务精度与KVzip相当，压缩开销降低1.7-19.6倍，总prefill时间最多降低2.9倍。
AI.conclusion: EchoPress表明，借助prefill已有的注意力信息即可有效近似KVzip的重建重要性，在免训练条件下实现高压缩比下的精度保持与显著效率提升，为长上下文KV缓存剪枝提供了轻量高效的方案。

title: Do Better Scores Mean Better Physics? Physics-Grounded Explanations for Sim2Real Neural Operators
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 XAI4Science Workshop, Tiny Paper Track
summary: Machine-learning surrogates accelerate physical simulation, but lower prediction error need not coincide with lower error in physically relevant flow statistics. We examine this question for flow around a NACA4418 airfoil using paired computational-fluid-dynamics simulations and experimental particle-image-velocimetry measurements. A mean-preserving input intervention removes velocity fluctuations from selected regions of observed flow histories. Across four neural operators, removing fluctuations from the most energetic 10% of valid observed cells changes forecasts more than equal-area random removal. Because the masks are not matched for removed fluctuation energy, this contrast measures sensitivity, not independent evidence of physical importance. Separately, a CNO has lower velocity-field error but substantially higher two-component fluctuation-energy error than the reference on both analysis subsets. An output attenuation stress test also demonstrates disagreement between benchmark errors and domain-summed fluctuation energy. These single-benchmark results motivate reporting complementary physical diagnostics alongside aggregate prediction scores; they do not establish counterfactual physical correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文以NACA4418翼型绕流为对象，考察机器学习代理模型的预测误差是否等同于物理相关流动统计量的误差。
AI.motivation: 机器学习代理模型虽能加速物理仿真，但较低的预测误差未必对应较低的物理相关流动统计误差，需实证检验二者是否一致。
AI.method: 结合CFD仿真与PIV实验配对数据，采用均值保持的输入干预（屏蔽选定区域速度脉动），在四种神经算子上比较能量最高10%有效观测单元与等面积随机屏蔽的预测变化；并进行输出衰减压力测试，对比CNO与参考方法的误差。
AI.result: 去除能量最高10%区域的脉动对预测的改变大于等面积随机去除（因掩膜未匹配去除脉动能量，该对比反映的是敏感性而非物理重要性独立证据）；CNO速度场误差更低，但在两个分析子集上双分量脉动能量误差显著高于参考。输出衰减压力测试亦显示基准误差与域求和脉动能量不一致。
AI.conclusion: 单一基准结果说明应在总体预测评分之外报告互补的物理诊断指标；但尚不能确立反事实意义上的物理正确性。

title: Source Identification Is Not Fitness Testing: Measuring the Limits of Synthetic-Data Attribution
summary: Repeated training on model-generated data can degrade later models. One possible response is to use provenance when deciding which generated examples to reuse. We test both how reliably that provenance can be recovered and whether it helps identify better training data. Using financial-risk text, we first identify the source of generated passages and then repeat the test after rewriting them. Generator attribution is 98.7% accurate on the original passages but falls to 53.1% after paraphrasing and 29.0% after style rewriting. Generated-versus-human detection remains close to perfect against the tested human comparison set. We then compare two ways of selecting generated examples over three rounds of generation and retraining. One uses source information. The other uses a score from a separate reference model. The two rules select different examples, but the planned comparison does not detect a stable difference in the degradation of the resulting models. The results show that identifying where data came from and identifying which data are useful for training are separate problems. The experiment therefore separates source identity, criterion-facing selection, and recursive training outcome: neither the provenance score nor the tested criterion-facing proxy is established as sufficient for future recursive behaviour.

AI.tldr: 使用金融风险文本测试生成文本的溯源可靠性及其对递归训练数据选择的有效性：溯源在原文上准确率98.7%，但改写后大幅下降；基于来源与基于参考模型评分的选择规则未产生稳定的退化差异，说明"识别来源"与"识别有用数据"是两个独立问题。
AI.motivation: 模型在自身生成数据上反复训练会导致后续模型性能退化，一种应对思路是利用数据溯源（provenance）判断哪些生成样本值得复用。本文旨在检验两个前提：溯源信息能否被可靠恢复，以及它是否有助于筛选出更好的训练数据。
AI.method: 以金融风险文本为素材，先对生成段落进行生成器归因，再在改写（paraphrase、style rewriting）后重复测试；同时与生成-人类检测任务的接近满分表现作对比。随后进行三轮"生成—重训练"实验，比较两种样本选择规则：一种基于来源信息，另一种基于独立参考模型的评分。
AI.result: 生成器归因在原始段落上准确率为98.7%，改写后降至53.1%，风格重写后仅29.0%；而生成-人类检测在测试的人类对照集上仍保持接近完美。两种选择规则选出的样本不同，但预设比较未能检测到结果模型退化程度上的稳定差异。
AI.conclusion: 识别数据来源与识别数据对训练是否有用是两个相互独立的问题。实验将来源身份、面向准则的选择与递归训练结果三者分离：溯源分数和所测试的准则代理指标均不足以预测未来的递归行为。

title: CommunityKV: Efficient Long-Context Decoding via Graph Partitioning
summary: Scaling Transformers to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of self-attention and the linear growth of key-value cache memory transfer. Sparse attention mitigates this by retrieving only relevant tokens, but current approaches either require large-scale training or, within the training-free regime, rely on semantically coarse heuristics or expensive clustering that is difficult to update efficiently during decoding. We introduce CommunityKV, a framework that formulates sparse attention as a community detection problem. CommunityKV constructs a token graph from the $QK^T$ scores already computed during standard prefill, and partitions the graph into communities to enable retrieval of semantically coherent token groups. A local update rule assigns newly generated tokens to communities in constant time, enabling sparse retrieval throughout streaming decoding without global re-partitioning. We evaluate CommunityKV on Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 models across three long-context benchmarks. With one graph per query head, CommunityKV delivers up to $1.25\times$ the end-to-end generation throughput of dense attention, while query-group graph aggregation yields up to $1.71\times$ with comparable accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出CommunityKV，将稀疏注意力建模为社区检测问题，在预填充阶段利用已有的QK^T分数构建token图并划分社区，通过常数时间局部更新规则实现流式解码中的稀疏检索，最高达1.71倍端到端生成吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: 长上下文Transformer受限于自注意力的二次代价与KV缓存内存传输的线性增长。现有稀疏注意力方法要么需要大规模训练，要么在免训练场景下依赖语义粗糙的启发式或难以在解码时高效更新的昂贵聚类。
AI.method: CommunityKV框架：1) 从标准预填充阶段已计算的QK^T分数构建token图；2) 将图划分为社区以检索语义连贯的token组；3) 引入局部更新规则，以常数时间将新生成token分配到社区，从而在流式解码中持续进行稀疏检索，无需全局重新划分。图可基于单查询头或查询组聚合构建。
AI.result: 在Qwen3与Llama-3.1模型及三个长上下文基准上评测：单查询头建图时端到端生成吞吐最高为稠密注意力的1.25倍；查询组图聚合时最高达1.71倍，且精度相当。
AI.conclusion: 将稀疏注意力重新表述为社区检测问题，可在免训练条件下实现语义连贯的稀疏检索与高效流式解码更新，在保持精度的同时显著提升长上下文生成吞吐。

title: The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation
summary: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood. Combining training-trajectory analyses and controlled interventions, we trace their emergence, growth, and consolidation. Sink-carrying channels vary across random seeds but stabilize early within each run. Over longer training, surrounding channels erode and the sink concentrates onto a few redundant carriers. Across ablations, gradient attenuation follows the sink token's collective root-mean-square magnitude rather than any single channel, making collective scale central to understanding their effects. Our central result is that weight decay causally controls the turnover of global activation scale. In controlled continuations, removing decay near the peak allows this scale to keep rising, whereas retaining it produces decline even at constant learning rate. We develop a balance model for the rise and peak of massive-activation magnitude, in which AdamW-preconditioned growth opposes weight decay. Sweeping the decay coefficient $λ$ shifts peak timing approximately log-linearly and yields peak magnitudes scaling approximately as $λ^{-1/2}$, consistent with this balance. Optimizer measurements further show that preconditioning sustains the large-channel cohort against decay even when raw maintaining forces are too small to do so. Together, these findings connect the observed life cycle to scale-regulating training dynamics and establish weight decay as a training-time lever on activation magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文结合训练轨迹分析与受控干预，追踪了Transformer中大规模激活（massive activations）的涌现、增长与固化过程，并证明权重衰减因果性地调控其全局尺度的周转，提出由AdamW预条件增长与权重衰减相抗衡的平衡模型。
AI.motivation: 大规模激活（幅度远超典型激活的残差流坐标）与注意力汇（attention sinks）相关，但其尺度在训练过程中如何被调控尚不完全清楚。作者希望揭示其生命周期背后的尺度调节训练动力学。
AI.method: 结合训练轨迹分析与受控干预（ablation、受控续训、扫描衰减系数λ），测量梯度衰减与注意力汇token的集体均方根幅度关系，并建立描述大规模激活幅度上升与峰值的平衡模型（AdamW预条件增长对抗权重衰减）。
AI.result: 承载汇的通道随随机种子变化但在每次运行早期即稳定；长期训练中周边通道被侵蚀、汇集中于少数冗余载体。梯度衰减随汇token的集体RMS幅度变化而非单一通道。峰值时移除权重衰减使尺度继续上升，保留则即使学习率恒定也下降。扫描λ使峰值时刻近似对数线性偏移，峰值幅度近似按λ^{-1/2}缩放。优化器测量显示预条件可维持大通道群对抗衰减。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现将观察到的激活生命周期与尺度调节的训练动力学联系起来，确立了权重衰减作为调控激活幅度的训练期杠杆，并验证了AdamW预条件增长与权重衰减相平衡的模型。

title: XOR-Trellis: Ultra-Low-Complexity Dequantization and Curvature-Aware Hadamard-Free LLM Quantization
summary: Trellis-coded quantization enables high-dimensional compression of large language model (LLM) weights at ultra-low bit widths without the exponentially large codebooks required by conventional vector quantization. Practical deployment, however, presents two challenges: reconstructing compressed weights at sufficient parallel throughput to avoid making dequantization an inference bottleneck, and maintaining quantization accuracy without costly incoherence transformations. We address these challenges with two complementary techniques. First, we introduce an ultra-low-complexity trellis dequantizer that uses a structured, hardware-efficient state-to-value mapping while preserving diverse reconstruction choices for trellis search. Second, we reformulate discrete trellis path optimization with a curvature-aware objective that reflects model sensitivity directly in the original coordinate space. Together, these techniques enable high-quality ultra-low-bit trellis quantization with inexpensive, highly parallel runtime reconstruction and without relying on Hadamard-based incoherence processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种互补技术，实现大语言模型权重的超低位宽格码量化：一是超低复杂度、硬件高效的格码反量化器，二是曲率感知的离散路径优化目标，从而在无需Hadamard非相干变换的条件下实现高质量量化与高并行运行时重建。
AI.motivation: 格码量化可在超低位宽下压缩LLM权重且无需指数级大码本，但实际部署面临两大挑战：一是反量化需足够并行吞吐以避免成为推理瓶颈；二是需在不依赖昂贵非相干变换的情况下保持量化精度。
AI.method: 提出两项互补技术：(1) 超低复杂度格码反量化器，采用结构化、硬件高效的状态到数值映射，同时保留格码搜索所需的多样重建选项；(2) 以曲率感知目标重新形式化离散格码路径优化，在原始坐标空间中直接反映模型敏感度。
AI.result: 两项技术结合，实现了高质量超低位宽格码量化，具备低成本、高并行的运行时重建能力，且无需依赖基于Hadamard的非相干处理。
AI.conclusion: 该方法解决了LLM超低位宽格码量化的部署瓶颈，兼顾反量化吞吐与量化精度，并去除了对Hadamard非相干变换的依赖。

title: Every Batch Is Its Own Validation Set: Leave-One-Out Gradient Matching for Online Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Online batch selection fine-tunes a language model on the most useful part of each candidate batch. Selectors that match the gradient of the candidate batch are attractive because they need no held-out data, yet they rarely beat training on the whole batch. We show why. In-sample gradient matching uses every example as part of its own target, so its objective credits each example with its own gradient noise. This is the covariance penalty that makes training error optimistic, now sitting on the diagonal of the gradient Gram matrix: it steers selection toward the noisiest examples and makes the full batch the best solution the objective can reach. The fix costs nothing. For each example, the other candidates form an independent sample of the data distribution, so removing the diagonal turns the matching objective into an unbiased estimate of the update's error with respect to the population gradient. The minimizer of this leave-one-out objective weights examples by their gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and whenever per-example SNR is heterogeneous enough, half of a batch yields a lower-error update than the whole batch; we give the exact condition. We build \method{} on this principle. It computes the Gram matrix in the metric of the Adam preconditioner during the ordinary backward pass, selects a weighted subset greedily with a $(1-e^{-γ})$ guarantee, and uses no held-out data. Across four fine-tuning tasks and seven backbones from 1.5B to 8B parameters, LOOM improves on full-batch training by 2.3 and 2.4 points on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, exceeds every in-sample gradient matcher by 2.4 points and the validation-guided GREATS and OPUS by 1.6--2.0, and selects injected label noise at under a fifth of its base rate.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示在线批选择中样本内梯度匹配存在协方差惩罚问题，提出无偏的留一法目标（LOOM），按梯度信噪比对样本加权选择，无需留出数据即可超越全批训练。
AI.motivation: 在线批选择旨在从每个候选批次中挑选最有用的样本进行微调。基于梯度匹配的选择器无需留出数据，颇具吸引力，但很少能真正优于全批训练。作者希望解释这一现象并加以修正。
AI.method: 分析表明，样本内梯度匹配将每个样本自身纳入其匹配目标，使目标把每个样本自身的梯度噪声计入其贡献，形成协方差惩罚，位于梯度Gram矩阵对角线上，导致选择偏向噪声最大的样本并使全批成为目标最优解。修正方法：对每个样本，其余候选构成数据分布的独立样本，去除对角线后将匹配目标变为对总体梯度更新误差的无偏估计。由此得到留一法目标的极小值解，用梯度信噪比（SNR）对样本加权。基于此构建LOOM，在普通反向传播中以Adam预条件子度量计算Gram矩阵，用贪心算法以(1-e^{-γ})保证选择加权子集，且不使用留出数据。
AI.result: 在四项微调任务、七个1.5B至8B参数的骨干模型上，LOOM在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上分别比全批训练提升2.3和2.4个点，比所有样本内梯度匹配器高2.4个点，比验证引导的GREATS和OPUS高1.6–2.0个点，并以低于其基础率五分之一的水平选出注入的标签噪声。当每样本SNR异质性足够大时，半批样本即可获得比全批更低误差的更新，作者给出了确切条件。
AI.conclusion: 样本内梯度匹配因协方差惩罚而失效；去除对角线得到的留一法无偏目标及按梯度信噪比加权的LOOM方法，无需留出数据即可稳定超越全批训练和现有梯度匹配、验证引导方法，且具备有效的抗噪选择能力。

title: One pool, many targets: a conservation layer and what archival data can identify
summary: Pairwise guide--transcript scores do not enforce conservation of a finite guide-loaded RISC pool when they are interpreted independently as occupancies. We formulate a differentiable scalar equilibrium layer: one conservation equation with a unique positive root and exact implicit gradients. It yields a redistribution theorem, a qualified high-resource limit, an analysis of the retrieval approximation, and a conditional rank-invariance result: within one construct at one dose, rankings by fractional occupancy cannot distinguish equilibrium from independent scoring. We therefore audit the two experiments that proposition leaves open, dose and cross-context, on archival off-target data. Corrected thermodynamic affinities associate weakly with measured repression in the direction a working predictor requires, but a paired permutation test and a construct-cluster bootstrap do not establish added predictive value from the coupling: what survives their differing permutation-null baselines is \GapNet{}, a descriptive \GapNetOverSE{} of the equilibrium association's cluster standard error. The dose fits are heterogeneous and frequently violate the model-implied exponent constraint, which is superlinear rather than sublinear, so these data do not identify the competition parameter. A saturable compression of the competitor set holds both accuracy targets on held-out guide families but is not faster at the size measured. The contribution is a reusable conservation operator and the experimental information needed to test it. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/shadi97kh/One-Pool-Many-Targets.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个可微的标量平衡层，用以在有限RISC池守恒约束下重新解释guide–transcript配对打分；理论上给出重分布定理、高资源极限、检索近似分析及条件性秩不变性，并通过档案脱靶数据审计剂量与跨情境实验，未发现耦合带来额外预测价值的证据。
AI.motivation: 成对guide–transcript打分被独立当作占据率时，无法保证有限向导负载RISC池的守恒，这一建模缺陷可能影响脱靶预测的可解释性与外推性。
AI.method: 构建可微标量平衡层：单一守恒方程（具唯一正根）与精确隐式梯度；据此推导重分布定理、高资源极限、检索近似分析与条件性秩不变结果；在档案脱靶数据上审计剂量与跨情境实验，采用配对置换检验、构造簇自助法、剂量拟合及可饱和竞争者集合压缩，并比较GapNet与GapNetOverSE。
AI.result: 校正后的热力学亲和力与实测抑制呈弱关联且方向符合有效预测器要求；配对置换检验与构造簇自助法未能证明耦合带来附加预测价值，稳健幸存者为描述平衡关联簇标准误的GapNetOverSE；剂量拟合异质且常违反模型隐含指数约束（为超线性而非亚线性），数据无法识别竞争参数；可饱和压缩在留出guide家族上保持两项精度目标，但在所测规模下并不更快。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是可复用的守恒算子及检验其所需要的实验信息；现有数据尚不足以支持有限池耦合的额外预测价值与竞争参数识别。

title: Score the Update, Not the Token: Descent-Aligned Routing for Combinatorial LoRA Experts
summary: Mixture-of-LoRA-experts methods raise the capacity of low-rank adaptation by routing each token to a few low-rank experts. Nearly all of them tie one input-side factor to one output-side factor per expert, and nearly all of them route by scoring the token: the router picks experts without seeing what any of them would write. We argue that the router should score the update. To first order, adding an expert's update to a layer output lowers the loss by the inner product between that update and the negative loss gradient at the output. This usefulness is quadratic in the token, so a router that is linear in the token sees only the part of it that runs through the token mean, and routers that rank experts by the norm of their own activations never see the output factor. If each expert is split into a reader (down-projection) and a writer (up-projection), the usefulness of every reader--writer pair becomes an inner product in the shared rank-$r$ space, and all $N_AN_B$ pairs can be scored from $N_A+N_B$ vectors. We build VANE on this identity. A low-rank compass predicts the descent direction of each token. VANE scores every pair by the alignment between its update and the compass without forming any update, activates the top-$k$ pairs with additive gates, and gives every pair its exact first-order router gradient. On single-domain commonsense reasoning and a four-domain multi-task mixture with Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, VANE attains the best average among twelve PEFT and MoE-LoRA baselines, by 0.9--1.1 and 1.3--1.5 points respectively, with less than half the trainable parameters of an 8-expert MoE-LoRA. Its router scores also track the measured usefulness of experts far more closely than token routers do.

AI.tldr: 提出 VANE，一种"给更新打分而非给 token 打分"的 LoRA 专家混合路由方法：将每个专家拆为 reader（下投影）与 writer（上投影），在共享 rank-r 空间内用低秩 compass 预测各 token 的下降方向，从而对全部 N_A×N_B 个 reader–writer 对进行一阶有用性打分并激活 top-k 对。
AI.motivation: 现有 Mixture-of-LoRA-experts 普遍存在两个缺陷：(1) 每个专家将输入侧因子与输出侧因子绑定，限制了专家组合的灵活性；(2) 路由依据 token 本身打分，路由器在未看到任何专家"会写出什么"的情况下就选择专家。作者主张路由器应当对"更新"打分：一阶近似下，把某专家的更新加到层输出上所带来的损失下降等于该更新与输出处负损失梯度的内积。这种有用性对 token 是二次的，因此线性于 token 的路由器只能看到经由 token 均值的那部分，而按自身激活范数排序专家的路由器则完全看不到输出侧因子。
AI.method: 将每个专家分解为 reader（down-projection）与 writer（up-projection）；在此分解下，任一 reader–writer 对的有用性成为共享 rank-r 空间中的内积，故全部 N_AN_B 个对可由 N_A+N_B 个向量完成打分。基于该恒等式构建 VANE：用低秩 compass 预测每个 token 的下降方向；在不成形任何实际更新的前提下，按"更新与 compass 的对齐度"为每一对打分；以加性门控激活 top-k 对；并为每一对给出精确的一阶路由梯度。
AI.result: 在单域常识推理任务以及四域多任务混合设定上，使用 Llama-3.2-3B 与 Llama-3.1-8B，VANE 在十二个 PEFT 与 MoE-LoRA 基线中取得最佳平均表现，分别高出 0.9–1.1 分和 1.3–1.5 分，且可训练参数量不到 8 专家 MoE-LoRA 的一半。其路由分数对专家实测有用性的跟踪程度也远优于 token 路由器。
AI.conclusion: 以"对更新打分"替代"对 token 打分"是提升 LoRA 专家混合容量与路由质量的有效原则；reader–writer 解耦使全对打分在计算上可行，低秩 compass 与一阶路由梯度进一步保证了打分准确性与可训练性，在参数效率与多任务性能上同时占优。

title: Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps
summary: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Gumbel Straight Flow（GSF），一种利用预训练自回归模型噪声-数据耦合的连续流映射语言模型，实现高质量少步语言生成。
AI.motivation: 现有少步语言生成基线在高质量采样方面存在不足，需要更高效的少步生成方法。
AI.method: 利用预训练AR模型诱导的Gumbel噪声与one-hot token序列耦合，理论证明其形成连接噪声与序列表示的非相交线性路径；采用流映射半群目标，使切线（速度）条件直接由AR教师引导。
AI.result: 在包括预训练与下游任务的多种基准上，GSF优于当前少步语言生成基线。
AI.conclusion: GSF通过结合AR模型的噪声-数据耦合与流映射半群目标，有效提升了少步语言生成的质量与性能。

title: Denoising Surface: Modeling and Predicting Inference Cost for Diffusion LLM Serving
summary: As diffusion large language models (dLLMs) become more capable, they are moving from research settings to real-world \textit{serving}, where request management (such as scheduling and resource allocation) relies on accurate estimation of per-request inference cost. However, common cost proxies fall short for dLLMs: output length ignores that one forward pass can unmask multiple tokens, and denoising-step count ignores the \textit{heterogeneous} per-step costs. We observe that the block-autoregressive generation mechanism induces a two-dimensional execution structure over output blocks and within-block denoising steps, whereas these proxies collapse it into a scalar, discarding information essential for characterizing the cost. Motivated by this insight, we propose the Denoising Workload Surface (DWS), which preserves this two-dimensional block-step structure as a probability surface to weight the heterogeneous per-step costs. We then design a coarse-to-fine training scheme that enables a lightweight prompt-only predictor to accurately predict the complex DWS. This predictor runs efficiently even on a single CPU core, avoiding GPU contention with the serving model. Since DWS decouples request-dependent execution behavior from deployment-specific cost factors, the predictor transfers across hardware configurations without retraining. In \textit{real-world} serving experiments, DWS reduces cost-prediction error by up to $2.50\times$ over scalar-based predictors, while the DWS-guided shortest-job-first scheduler reduces end-to-end latency by up to $1.92\times$ for online chatbots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出去噪工作量曲面（DWS），用二维"块-步"概率曲面刻画扩散大语言模型的推理开销，并设计由粗到细训练方案，使轻量提示级预测器可在 CPU 上准确预测 DWS，从而提升成本预测与服务调度性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）正进入真实服务场景，而调度与资源分配依赖对每请求推理成本的准确估计。常用的标量成本代理对该模型失效：输出长度忽略了单次前向可解掩多个 token，去噪步数则忽略了每步成本的异构性。作者观察到块自回归生成机制天然具有"输出块×块内去噪步"的二维执行结构，而标量代理将其压缩为单一数值，丢失了刻画成本的关键信息。
AI.method: 提出去噪工作量曲面（DWS），以概率曲面的形式保留块-步二维结构，对异构的每步成本进行加权；并设计由粗到细（coarse-to-fine）的训练方案，训练一个仅依赖提示（prompt-only）的轻量预测器来准确预测复杂的 DWS。该预测器可在单 CPU 核心上高效运行，避免与服务模型争抢 GPU。由于 DWS 将请求相关的执行行为与部署相关的成本因素解耦，预测器无需重训即可跨硬件配置迁移。
AI.result: 在真实服务实验中，DWS 相比基于标量的预测器将成本预测误差最多降低 2.50 倍；由 DWS 引导的最短作业优先（SJF）调度器将在线聊天场景的端到端延迟最多降低 1.92 倍。
AI.conclusion: DWS 通过保留二维块-步执行结构，显著提升了扩散大语言模型的推理成本预测精度与调度效率，且预测器轻量、可跨硬件迁移，具备较强的实际部署价值。

title: One-Step Generative Modeling via Training Dynamics Action
summary: One-step generative models construct a static generator through iterative training-time transport. Existing transport objectives primarily assess distributional motion, although a neural generator needs to realize the requested sample displacements jointly through shared parameter updates. The training-time construction raises the question: \emph{once training becomes the iterative process that constructs the final one-step map, what to optimize: the next distributional move, or the route by which the finite generator learns the final map?} To address the question, we introduce \textbf{T}raining \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{A}ction (\textbf{TDAction}), which selects transport targets according to local shared-parameter realization cost while retaining a prescribed level of distributional progress. We formulate the cost as a soft-terminal control problem and derive a closed-form Batch Tangent Action-to-Go value that accounts for parameter effort and terminal mismatch. The criterion captures cross-sample interactions omitted by independent pairwise costs; under isotropic mobility, the criterion agrees with quadratic Euclidean assignment for deterministic balanced couplings. Randomized tangent probes provide a low-rank implementation that constructs shared detached targets without adding an inference-time trajectory. Controlled studies examine the relationship between generator geometry, transport selection, and realized local action. On ImageNet $256\times256$, TDAction attains an FID below $1.1$ without distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TDAction，一种面向一步生成模型的训练动态动作准则，依据共享参数的局部实现代价选择传输目标，同时保留指定的分布进展。方法将代价形式化为软终端控制问题，并推导出闭式Batch Tangent Action-to-Go值。
AI.motivation: 一步生成模型通过迭代的训练期传输构造静态生成器。现有传输目标主要评估分布层面的运动，但神经生成器需通过共享参数更新联合实现所需的样本位移。因此产生核心问题：当训练本身即为构造最终一步映射的迭代过程时，应优化下一步的分布移动，还是优化有限生成器学习最终映射的路径？
AI.method: 提出训练动态动作（TDAction），根据局部共享参数实现代价选择传输目标，并保留预设水平的分布进展；将代价建模为软终端控制问题，推导闭式Batch Tangent Action-to-Go值，兼顾参数努力与终端失配；该准则捕获独立成对代价所忽略的跨样本交互，在各向同性移动下与确定性平衡耦合的二次欧氏分配一致；采用随机切向探针实现低秩近似，构造共享的detached目标且不增加推理时轨迹。
AI.result: 通过受控实验考察生成器几何、传输选择与实际局部动作之间的关系；在ImageNet 256×256上，TDAction在无需蒸馏的情况下取得低于1.1的FID。
AI.conclusion: TDAction将一步生成的训练重点从单纯的分布移动转向生成器学习最终映射的路径，通过参数实现代价驱动的传输目标选择有效提升一步生成质量，并避免蒸馏与额外推理轨迹。

title: SimplexUQ: An Evaluation Framework and Benchmark for Conformal Uncertainty on Simplex-Valued Predictions
comment: Preprint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/liangyou03/SimplexUQ and https://huggingface.co/datasets/liangyou03/SimplexTasks-12-data
summary: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a single calibration threshold can still spread that coverage unevenly, over-covering easy regions and under-covering hard ones. SimplexUQ is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark and reproducible protocol for measuring this allocation problem on simplex-valued predictions; it compares existing conformal wrappers rather than proposing a new one. Its task suite, SimplexTasks-12, combines six controlled synthetic regimes with six frozen-predictor real tasks spanning class probabilities, topic mixtures, spectral abundances, cell-type fractions, age distributions, and emotion mixtures. Each comparison fixes the predictor, score, and response-free stratification map, varies only the wrapper, and reports marginal coverage, worst-stratum coverage, max disparity, and within-task radius and compute. Global calibration can look valid while failing badly: on CIFAR-10 it attains 0.900 marginal coverage but only 0.542 in the worst entropy stratum, and Mondrian calibration raises that stratum to 0.886 while reducing max disparity from 0.358 to 0.022. No wrapper dominates, however. Under smooth synthetic heterogeneity, several repairs are competitive; fixed-map analyses show that rankings depend on the evaluation groups and protocol; and in a 12-task comparison, Mondrian has lower disparity on its single target partition for all 12 tasks, whereas BatchMVP has lower disparity over overlapping groups on five. These are empirical comparisons, not new coverage guarantees. A controlled predictor-bias sweep shows that removing predictor bias only partly reduces global-threshold disparity. We release task cards, result provenance, permitted derived arrays, and rebuild instructions, and treat wrapper selection as a diagnostic comparison rather than a universal ranking.

AI.tldr: SimplexUQ 是首个针对 simplex 值预测中 conformal 覆盖分配不均问题的基准与可复现协议，通过 12 个任务系统比较现有 conformal wrapper，发现全局校准可能掩盖层内严重欠覆盖，且无单一 wrapper 全面占优。
AI.motivation: Conformal prediction 虽保证边际覆盖，但单一校准阈值会导致覆盖在易/难区域分配不均（易区过覆盖、难区欠覆盖）。现有工作缺乏针对 simplex 值预测上这一分配问题的基准与可复现衡量协议。
AI.method: 提出 SimplexUQ 基准与协议，比较现有 conformal wrapper 而非提出新方法。任务套件 SimplexTasks-12 含 6 个受控合成场景与 6 个冻结预测器的真实任务（类概率、主题混合、光谱丰度、细胞类型比例、年龄分布、情绪混合）。每次比较固定预测器、score 与无响应分层图，仅变化 wrapper，报告边际覆盖、最差层覆盖、最大差异及任务内半径与计算量。并进行固定的分层图分析、12 任务对比及受控预测器偏差扫描。
AI.result: 全局校准表面有效但可能严重失效：CIFAR-10 上边际覆盖 0.900，而最差熵层仅 0.542；Mondrian 校准将该层提升至 0.886，并将最大差异从 0.358 降至 0.022。无 wrapper 全面占优：平滑合成异质下多种修复方法相当；固定图分析显示排名依赖评估组与协议；12 任务对比中 Mondrian 在其单一目标分区上 12 个任务差异均更低，而 BatchMVP 在重叠组上 5 个任务更低。预测器偏差扫描显示去除偏差仅部分降低全局阈值差异。
AI.conclusion: 这些为经验比较而非新的覆盖保证。释放任务卡、结果溯源、允许的派生数组与重建说明，将 wrapper 选择视为诊断性比较而非通用排名。

title: Random Recursive Models
summary: Recursive models create computational depth through parameter reuse, offering a parameter-efficient alternative to increasing model size. However, most recursive models repeatedly apply one learned transformation or a prescribed sequence of transformations, restricting computation to a fixed layer order. We introduce the Random Recursive Model (RRM), which maintains a pool of $L$ learned layers and performs $T$ recursive steps by sampling one layer independently with replacement for each example and step. This enables flexible layer reuse while retaining the parameter efficiency of recurrence. We evaluate RRM on challenging reasoning tasks, where it matches or exceeds the baselines, often with 50-75 % fewer parameters. RRM can vary its depth at inference, including beyond that seen during training, without retraining or adding parameters, improving tasks that benefit from deeper iterative computation. RRM also supports Monte Carlo inference and probabilistic test-time scaling, both of which improve performance without retraining. These insights may open new directions in neural network architecture design.

AI.tldr: 提出随机递归模型（RRM），通过可复用层池与逐步随机采样层实现灵活递归，在推理任务上以更少参数匹配或超越基线。
AI.motivation: 递归模型通过参数复用获得计算深度，是提升模型规模的参数高效替代方案。但现有递归模型通常重复应用单一学习到的变换或预定义的变换序列，把计算限制在固定的层顺序上，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: RRM 维护一个包含 L 个可学习层的层池，对每个样本与每个步骤独立地、有放回地采样一层，执行 T 次递归步骤，从而实现灵活的层复用并保持递归的参数效率。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的推理任务上，RRM 匹配或超越基线，且常常减少 50–75% 的参数；RRM 可在推理时改变深度（包括超过训练时见过的深度），无需重训或增加参数，从而改进受益于更深迭代计算的任务；RRM 还支持蒙特卡洛推理与概率式测试时扩展，均能在不重训的情况下提升性能。
AI.conclusion: RRM 通过随机层采样突破了固定层顺序的限制，兼顾灵活性与参数效率，并带来免训练的深度可变与测试时扩展能力，可能为神经网络架构设计开辟新方向。

title: Geometry-Dependent Bounds for Online Non-Monotone DR-Submodular Maximization
summary: We study adversarial online maximization of nonnegative, non-monotone DR-submodular functions over compact convex down-closed sets. A learner commits each action before observing its objective and competes with the best fixed action in hindsight. We prove a comparator-uniform first-order inequality that gives coefficient $4/9$, improving the online $0.401$ benchmark, with one gradient query and one projection per round and $O(\sqrt T)$ expected approximate regret. If $ζ{\bf 1} \in K\subseteq[0,1]^d$, the coefficient improves to $\underlineα(ζ)=\tfrac12-(1-2ζ)_+^2/[2(3-2ζ)^2]$. The proof is a direct ordered-coordinate argument with an objective-independent rational action. Conversely, a three-group symmetry-gap construction yields an offline oracle upper bound $β_*=0.470438681380894\ldots$ at $ζ=0$, even with exact value and full-gradient responses. A parameterized extension and exact finite-instance bounds define an upper function for every $ζ$. The lower and upper bounds match at $1/2$ for $ζ\ge1/2$, and show that the optimal deficit from $1/2$ is $Θ((1/2-ζ)^2)$ as $ζ\uparrow1/2$. For coefficient-revealed polynomials we obtain $1/2$ for quadratics and a geometry-dependent cubic coefficient starting at $8/17$, including $0.49$ at $ζ=1/5$. A constant objective sequence yields an offline $(4/9-\varepsilon)$ approximation with polynomially many first-order queries on the cube and projections, without requiring a supplied positive lower bound on the optimum. We also give nonanticipating adaptive-adversary and value-feedback guarantees, including $O(T^{3/4})$ regret with one noisy value per round.

AI.tldr: 本文研究紧凸下闭集上非负、非单调 DR-子模函数的对抗在线最大化问题，通过有序坐标论证证明系数为 4/9 的比较器一致一阶不等式，改进在线 0.401 基准，并给出离线预言机上界 β*=0.470438681380894...，同时刻画最优亏缺的 Θ((1/2-ζ)²) 渐近行为。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗在线 DR-子模最大化在非负、非单调函数上的最优逼近系数仅为 0.401，且在线保证能否突破该基准并不清楚；此外，在线与离线（预言机）保证之间的最优系数差距以及随可行域参数 ζ 的变化规律缺乏精确刻画。
AI.method: 证明比较器一致的一阶不等式（比较器均匀不等式），采用直接的有序坐标论证，并构造与目标无关的理性动作；通过三组对称间隙构造给出离线预言机上界；进一步以参数化扩展与精确有限实例界定义每个 ζ 的上界函数。
AI.result: 在线系数由 0.401 提升至 4/9（每轮一次梯度查询与一次投影，O(√T) 期望近似遗憾）；当 ζ1∈K⊆[0,1]^d 时系数提升为 ᾱ(ζ)=1/2-(1-2ζ)₊²/[2(3-2ζ)²]；离线预言机上界 β*=0.470438681380894...（ζ=0，即使精确值与全梯度反馈）；上下界在 ζ≥1/2 时于 1/2 吻合，且最优亏缺为 Θ((1/2-ζ)²)；系数揭示多项式情形：二次型得 1/2，三次型几何相关系数从 8/17 起，ζ=1/5 时为 0.49；常数目标序列在立方体与投影上以多项式次一阶查询实现离线 (4/9-ε) 逼近，无需已知最优值的正下界；另给出非预见性自适应对手与值反馈保证，含每轮一次噪声值下的 O(T^{3/4}) 遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 所提一阶不等式在非负、非单调 DR-子模在线最大化中达到 4/9 的比较器一致系数，超越 0.401 基准；离线上界 β* 与在线下界在 ζ≥1/2 时精确吻合，揭示了最优亏缺随 ζ 的二次衰减规律，并刻画了系数揭示多项式与常数目标序列情形下的逼近能力。

title: Evaluating Hybrid Quantum-Classical Models for Reduced-Order Brain Deformation Dynamics
summary: We evaluate hybrid quantum-classical machine learning for the reduced-order prediction of spatiotemporal brain deformation fields. To mitigate the computational intractability of high-dimensional displacement fields, we employ Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) to project the data into a compact latent space. Within this framework, we formulate two distinct learning objectives: static temporal-to-latent regression and autoregressive latent state forecasting. We systematically benchmark compact classical baselines against both minimal and enhanced hybrid quantum architectures. Our results demonstrate that classical networks provide the strongest baselines in the present setting. For static regression, a classical POD-MLP outperforms all evaluated quantum variants, although an enhanced Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) substantially improves upon a minimal VQC baseline. For temporal forecasting, a classical POD-LSTM delivers superior predictive accuracy and statistical robustness compared to an enhanced Quantum LSTM (QLSTM) across varying history windows and random initializations. Overall, this study establishes reduced-order physical field learning as a rigorous testbed for near-term QML, highlighting that while hybrid enhancements successfully recover expressivity in weak quantum circuits, classical architectures retain a definitive advantage in both fidelity and stability.

AI.tldr: 本文将POD降维与量子-经典混合机器学习结合，用于时空脑变形场的降阶预测，并系统对比经典基线与量子模型（VQC/QLSTM）。结果显示经典网络（POD-MLP、POD-LSTM）在精度与稳定性上仍占优，但增强型量子电路可显著提升弱量子基线。
AI.motivation: 高维时空位移场的直接预测计算不可行，需降阶；同时近量子机器学习（QML）需要一个严谨的测试场景来评估其相对于经典方法的真实价值。
AI.method: 用本征正交分解（POD）将高维位移场投影到紧凑潜空间；定义两类学习目标：静态的时序-潜变量回归与自回归潜状态预测；对比紧凑经典基线与最小/增强型量子-经典混合架构，包括POD-MLP、POD-LSTM、最小VQC、增强VQC及增强QLSTM。
AI.result: 静态回归中POD-MLP优于所有量子变体，但增强VQC相比最小VQC有实质性提升；时序预测中POD-LSTM在不同历史窗口与随机初始化下均比增强QLSTM具有更高精度和统计稳健性；经典架构在保真度与稳定性两方面保持明确优势。
AI.conclusion: 降阶物理场学习可作为近期QML的严格测试平台；量子-经典混合增强能恢复弱量子电路的表达能力，但经典架构在精度与稳定性上仍具决定性优势。

title: Redundancy Meets Synergy: Dependency-aware Expert Selection for MoE via Submodular Optimization
summary: While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models effectively scale model capacity through sparse activation, their deployment is often bottlenecked by prohibitive memory requirements. Extracting a compact subset of experts presents a promising solution. However, existing expert selection heuristics predominantly rely on Top-k ranking, which isolates the evaluation of individual experts and ignores the intricate inter-expert dependencies introduced by the MoE gating network. In this paper, we propose DS-MoE, a theoretically grounded framework that redefines expert selection via difference-of-submodular (DS) optimization. By analyzing the second-order Taylor expansion of the loss degradation, we reveal functional duality within expert combinations: redundancy (where experts encode overlapping representations) and synergy (where experts provide complementary error cancellation). To navigate this duality, we mathematically decouple redundancy reduction from synergy maximization by formulating the selection objective as a DS function. Furthermore, we devise a tailored majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm with provable monotonicity guarantees to efficiently identify the optimal expert subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DS-MoE effectively preserves indispensable expert combinations, achieving superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DS-MoE框架，利用子模函数之差（DS）优化重新定义MoE专家选择，通过解耦冗余削减与协同增益，并设计具单调性保证的MM算法求解，实验优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: MoE模型虽通过稀疏激活扩展容量，但部署时受限于巨大内存开销。提取紧凑专家子集是有效方案，但现有启发式方法多依赖Top-k排序，孤立评估单个专家，忽略了门控网络引入的专家间复杂依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出DS-MoE框架，从损失退化的二阶泰勒展开出发，揭示专家组合中的功能二重性：冗余（表示重叠）与协同（互补误差抵消）。将选择目标形式化为子模函数之差（DS函数），数学上解耦冗余削减与协同最大化，并设计定制的majorization-minimization（MM）算法，具备可证明的单调性保证以高效求解最优专家子集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DS-MoE能有效保留不可或缺的专家组合，性能优于当前最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: DS-MoE通过子模优化解耦专家依赖建模，为MoE专家选择提供了有理论保证的高效方案，验证了考虑专家间冗余与协同关系的重要性。

title: Beyond Affine Transformations: A Soft Dominance Layer for Coordinate-Wise Neural Computation
summary: This paper presents a preliminary study of an alternative to the affine transformation underlying conventional neural-network layers. In the proposed Soft Dominance Layer, each output unit compares input coordinates with a learnable reference vector and aggregates smooth inequality responses. A sigmoid relaxation makes the comparisons differentiable, while a sharpness parameter $α$ controls their transition toward hard threshold decisions. The aim is to examine the trainability and direct threshold interpretation of this primitive, not to claim a replacement for affine layers. In single-run MNIST experiments, the highest observed Soft Dominance accuracy is $0.9061$ without annealing and $0.9173$ with annealing, compared with $0.9827$ for the MLP baseline. These descriptive results do not establish reliable configuration rankings or a statistically supported annealing benefit. Learned reference vectors exhibit spatial structure, providing qualitative evidence of structured learning. Repeated-seed experiments and broader datasets are required to assess robustness and practical relevance beyond this proof of concept.

AI.tldr: 本文初步探索了一种替代仿射变换的 Soft Dominance Layer，通过sigmoid松弛与锐度参数α实现可微的软阈值比较，在MNIST上取得0.9061（无退火）与0.9173（含退火）的精度，低于MLP基线的0.9827，仅为概念验证。
AI.motivation: 常规神经网络层以仿射变换为基础，作者希望考察一种具有直接阈值解释性的替代原语，以检查其可训练性与阈值语义，而非宣称可取代仿射层。
AI.method: 提出Soft Dominance Layer：每个输出单元将输入坐标与可学习参考向量比较，聚合成平滑的不等式响应；用sigmoid松弛使比较可微，并以锐度参数α控制其向硬阈值决策的过渡。
AI.result: 单次运行的MNIST实验中，最高Soft Dominance精度为0.9061（无退火）和0.9173（含退火），MLP基线为0.9827；学习到的参考向量呈现空间结构，提供结构化学习的定性证据。
AI.conclusion: 这些描述性结果不足以确立可靠的配置排序，也无法统计支持退火的收益；需要重复随机种子实验与更广数据集来评估稳健性与实际价值。

title: Attention Kernels for Learning Maps Between Heavy-Tailed Measures
comment: 32 pages, 17 figures, accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Operator learning on probability measures can be accomplished with transformers. For measures with polynomial tails, the exponential weighting in softmax can make the corresponding measure-level attention integrals diverge. This motivates replacing the exponential with slower-growing functions. We construct two benchmarks for operator learning on measures with closed-form targets. We use these benchmarks to study attention kernel growth and data transformation in post-norm transformers. Without data transformation, the softmax models exhibit ensemble collapse on both heavy-tailed benchmarks, while the three slower-growing kernels avoid collapse. Symlog preprocessing allows softmax to avoid collapse on the matrix inverse task but not on the sheared swap task. On the Gaussian control, all four kernels perform similarly. We also examine how sample size affects the sensitivity of empirical energy and Wasserstein distances to tail differences. These results support slower-growing attention kernels as an effective design choice for post-norm transformers learning from heavy-tailed ensembles.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对重尾概率测度上的算子学习问题，指出softmax的指数加权会导致测度级注意力积分发散，提出用增长更慢的核替代，并通过基准实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 在概率测度上进行算子学习时，若测度具有多项式尾，softmax中的指数加权会使测度级注意力积分发散，因此需要寻找替代方案。
AI.method: 构造两个具有闭式目标的测度算子学习基准；研究后归一化（post-norm）transformer中注意力核增长与数据变换的作用；比较softmax与三种增长更慢的核，并引入Symlog预处理；同时分析样本量对经验能量与Wasserstein距离的尾部敏感性影响。
AI.result: 无数据变换时，softmax模型在两个重尾基准上均出现集成塌缩，而三种慢增长核避免塌缩；Symlog预处理使softmax在矩阵求逆任务上避免塌缩，但在剪切交换任务上无效；在高斯控制任务上四种核表现相近。
AI.conclusion: 慢增长注意力核是后归一化transformer在重尾集成上学习的有效设计选择。

title: Make Sparse Rewards Count: Density-Aware Reward Aggregation for Multi-Reward RL
summary: Multi-reward reinforcement learning trains large language models to satisfy multiple behavioral objectives simultaneously. Reward-wise normalization, as used in GDPO, preserves reward-specific relative information within rollout groups, but different objectives can still exhibit uneven learning progress. We study this behavior through advantage energy, the sum of a reward's squared advantages over a batch. Under idealized GDPO normalization, we show that this energy is proportional to active-group density: the fraction of rollout groups in which the reward provides nonzero relative advantages. This reveals a residual batch-level signal imbalance and provides a basis for calibrating reward contributions. Based on this relation, we propose Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA). We derive an inverse-square-root density correction that gives greater weight to signals from less frequently active rewards. DARA computes its weights from each rollout batch, adapting to changes in reward activity throughout training without modifying the underlying policy optimization objective. Experiments on tool calling and mathematical reasoning show that DARA learns the targeted behaviors faster than GDPO, reaching high format compliance in up to 26% fewer training steps on tool calling and near-saturated length compliance in up to 65% fewer steps on mathematical reasoning, while remaining competitive in final performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhaihaotian/DARA.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多奖励RL中不同目标学习进度不均的问题，提出用优势能量与活跃组密度刻画信号失衡，并据此设计DARA权重校正方法，加快目标行为学习且不改变原有优化目标。
AI.motivation: 多奖励强化学习虽能同时满足多个行为目标，但即使使用GDPO等奖励维度归一化保留组内相对信息，不同目标的学习进度仍不均衡，存在批量层面的残余信号失衡，需要一种能校准各奖励贡献的方法。
AI.method: 作者以“优势能量”（一个奖励在批次内平方优势之和）为分析工具，在理想化GDPO归一化下证明能量正比于“活跃组密度”（该奖励产生非零相对优势的rollout组比例）。基于该关系提出Density-Aware Reward Aggregation（DARA），推导反平方根密度校正，给活跃频率低的奖励更大权重；权重由每个rollout批次计算，训练中自适应变化，且不修改底层策略优化目标。
AI.result: 在工具调用与数学推理任务上，DARA比GDPO更快学到目标行为：工具调用中达到高格式合规所用训练步数最多减少26%，数学推理中接近饱和的长度合规最多减少65%步数，同时最终性能保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 优势能量与活跃组密度的正比关系揭示了批量级信号失衡，DARA通过批次自适应的反平方根密度加权校准奖励贡献，在不改动策略优化目标的前提下加速多目标行为学习，代码已开源。

title: From Task Mixtures to Specialized Experts
summary: In collaborative foundation model fine-tuning, client data is rarely homogeneous. Instead, clients typically possess unknown mixtures of distinct data distributions, or tasks. Conventional federated learning primarily addresses heterogeneity across clients without explicitly resolving latent task mixtures within each client. We study this setting as compound heterogeneity, where data is heterogeneous both across and within clients. We study adaptation over a common frozen representation and show that, when tasks share the same feature geometry, the optimal model for a client's task mixture under squared loss is a convex combination of the optimal models for its underlying tasks. Thus, a single locally trained model represents the client's overall task mixture, while individual inputs may be drawn from different underlying task distributions. This motivates routing inputs to specialized experts, and we show that, when the task optima form a simplex, task-aligned routing achieves lower risk than any single adapted model for genuinely mixed clients. With access to a small set of task-labeled public samples, we derive a convex program to recover task experts and match them to their corresponding tasks. Our routing analysis shows that effective specialization requires input-dependent expert selection aligned with each client's task mixture. Motivated by this analysis, we propose FedSEE. Across our experiments, FedSEE avoids the negative transfer observed in the evaluated baselines and improves performance by 2.9 points overall and 3.7 points for the worst-served quartile.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究联邦微调中的"复合异质性"问题，即客户端间与客户端内均存在数据分布/任务混杂。作者证明在共享冻结表征下，客户端任务混合的最优模型是各底层任务最优模型的凸组合，并提出基于路由的专家选择方法 FedSEE，在实验中避免负迁移并提升整体及最差服务分位性能。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦学习主要处理客户端之间的异质性，而忽视了单个客户端内部可能混合了多种未知数据分布或任务这一情形。论文将这种客户端间与客户端内同时存在异质性的设定称为复合异质性，并研究如何在冻结共享表征下进行适配。
AI.method: 作者首先从理论上分析：当任务共享相同特征几何时，在平方损失下客户端任务混合的最优模型是其底层任务最优模型的凸组合。当任务最优点构成单纯形时，任务对齐路由的风险低于任何单一适配模型。基于此，作者提出利用少量带任务标签的公共样本，通过凸规划恢复任务专家并将其与对应任务匹配。进一步提出 FedSEE 方法，实现输入依赖的专家选择，使专家选择与各客户端的任务混合对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明，FedSEE 避免了所评估基线方法中出现的负迁移现象，整体性能提升 2.9 个百分点，在服务最差四分位客户端上提升 3.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 有效的任务专门化需要输入依赖的专家选择，并与每个客户端的任务混合保持一致。FedSEE 通过路由到专门专家实现了对复合异质性的有效适配，在提升整体性能的同时显著改善最差服务群体表现。

title: ALER: Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting for Reinforcement Learning
summary: In partially observable reinforcement learning (RL), a later observation can make stored information obsolete or change what it implies for the next decision. Memory architectures and benchmarks for RL mostly test retention, the ability to keep information unchanged until it is needed. We formalize two further requirements. Rewriting sets the decision-relevant content to a value independent of the old one, and experience fusion transforms the old content by a rule that a later observation specifies. For tasks built from such updates, we count the memory states that a solution needs, and several baselines reach their lowest success rates on compositions that need more states. We introduce ALER (Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting), an agent that pairs an LSTM with a slot memory. An independently addressed Gumbel-Softmax write that concentrates its weight on one slot overwrites that slot, and a learned gate fuses the retrieved content with the recurrent state before the policy and value heads. We also introduce Rune-Mazes, three environments in which rune observations invert, cancel, reset, or repeat updates of a hidden cue under vector and pixel observations. Against seven baselines, ALER reaches a success rate of at least $0.82$ in all sixteen Endless T-Maze configurations and at least $0.99$ on all five Rune T-Maze compositions, and it has the highest mean success rate on four-branch Rune Multi-Corridor with an Invert rune. On pixel-based Rune MiniGrid Memory, it has a higher mean success rate than PPO-LSTM in eight of ten configurations. Project page: https://quartz-admirer.github.io/ALER-Adaptive-Learnable-Experience-Rewriting/.

AI.tldr: 该论文在部分可观测强化学习中提出"重写"与"经验融合"两种记忆需求，并设计ALER智能体（LSTM+槽记忆）及Rune-Mazes基准来验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有RL记忆架构与基准多只测试"保持"（retention）能力，即信息在需要前保持不变；但后续观测可能使已存信息过时或改变其含义，因此需要形式化并测试"重写"（rewriting）和"经验融合"（experience fusion）这两类被忽视的记忆需求。
AI.method: 1) 形式化两类需求：重写将决策相关内容设为与旧值无关的值；经验融合按后续观测指定的规则转换旧内容。2) 统计解决此类更新任务所需记忆状态数，分析基线模型在需更多状态组合上的成功率下降。3) 提出ALER（Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting），将LSTM与槽记忆结合：使用独立寻址的Gumbel-Softmax写入，将权重集中于单个槽以覆盖该槽；并学习一个门控，在策略与价值头之前融合检索内容与循环状态。4) 构建Rune-Mazes：三个环境，在向量与像素观测下，用rune观测对隐藏线索执行反转、取消、重置或重复更新。5) 与七个基线对比。
AI.result: ALER在全部16个Endless T-Maze配置上成功率达至少0.82；在全部5个Rune T-Maze组合上至少0.99；在带Invert rune的四分支Rune Multi-Corridor上取得最高平均成功率；在像素Rune MiniGrid Memory上，10个配置中有8个平均成功率高于PPO-LSTM。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，显式建模重写与经验融合的记忆机制（如ALER的独立寻址写入与门控融合）优于仅关注保持能力的现有方法，新基准Rune-Mazes能有效区分不同记忆架构的能力。

title: Learning the identity: a case study of how SGD selects among functional decompositions
summary:
One might think that learning the identity function with a deep linear residual network is trivial - the path along residual connections already implements the identity, and so the network need only drive its weights to zero. However, this zero-weight solution is just one point on an entire manifold of population-loss minimizers, each corresponding to a different decomposition of the identity across the network's layers. Although the population loss does not distinguish among these solutions, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) reproducibly favors particular ones. For instance, under anisotropic label noise, the learned layers exhibit a noise-dependent spectrum; even with weight decay, SGD does not generally recover the zero-weight solution. Changing only the parametrization, while leaving the set of realizable functions unchanged, yields different behavior: factoring each weight matrix as a product of two matrices causes the weights to collapse to zero, even without explicit weight decay.
  While perhaps mysterious and unintuitive at first, these phenomena can be understood through the lens of entropic loss, which augments the population loss with a term proportional to the expected squared norm of the minibatch gradient (Ziyin et al., 2025). On the identity manifold, the population loss is constant, while the entropic term distinguishes among these decompositions. We characterize its minimizers analytically and use them to derive predictions for the structure of solutions favored by SGD. Networks trained with SGD closely match these predictions.
  Overall, the identity learning task studied here serves as a clean and simple case study of how the lens of entropic loss can clarify why SGD favors particular decompositions of the same input-output function.

AI.tldr: 本文研究深度线性残差网络学习恒等映射时的解选择问题：总体损失无法区分恒等函数在不同层间的分解方式，但SGD会可复现地偏好特定解；作者用"熵损失"（在总体损失上附加与minibatch梯度平方范数期望成比例的项）来解释这一现象，并通过解析刻画其极小值点，预测SGD偏好解的结构，实验与预测高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 直觉上，深度线性残差网络学习恒等映射是平凡的：残差连接本身已实现恒等，网络只需将权重驱零。但零权重解只是整个极小值流形上的一个点，该流形对应恒等在不同层间的不同分解。总体损失无法区分这些解，而SGD却会稳定地偏好其中某些解（如各向异性标签噪声下学习到的层呈现噪声依赖的谱，即便有权重衰减也未必收敛到零权重解），且仅改变参数化方式（如将权重矩阵分解为两个矩阵之积）就会改变行为。作者希望找到一个统一视角来解释SGD为何偏好特定分解。
AI.method: 以深度线性残差网络的恒等学习为案例；引入熵损失框架（Ziyin et al., 2025），即在总体损失上增加与minibatch梯度期望平方范数成比例的项。在恒等流形上总体损失为常数，熵项负责区分不同分解；作者解析刻画熵损失的极小值点，并据此推导SGD偏好解的结构预测（含权重衰减与不同参数化情形）。
AI.result: 熵损失的极小值点解析刻画给出了SGD偏好解结构的可检验预测；在多种设置下（如各向异性标签噪声、含权重衰减、将权重矩阵分解为两矩阵之积的参数化）SGD训练结果与预测高度一致，例如矩阵分解参数化下即使无显式权重衰减权重也会塌缩到零。
AI.conclusion: 恒等学习任务是一个干净简洁的案例，表明熵损失视角能阐明SGD为何在同一输入-输出函数的多种分解中偏好特定解。熵项在总体损失平坦的流形上充当选择的机制，将隐式正则化现象归结为可解析分析的目标。

title: Misalignment of Low-Loss Regions Causes Grokking
summary: Grokking refers to the delayed emergence of validation-set generalization after a model has already overfit the training set. Although first observed in small algorithmic tasks trained with transformers, its underlying mechanism remains unsettled. In this work, we develop an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions. The framework predicts that the standard modular-arithmetic setting does not always produce grokking: under a symmetry-preserving train/validation split, we observe a stable anti-grokking case in which validation performance does not recover. This counterexample challenges several existing correlational explanations of grokking. More broadly, our analysis framework and results further suggest that grokking arises when the low-loss regions induced by the training and validation partitions are misaligned. Once these regions become well aligned, training hyperparameters alone cannot produce grokking and the observed dynamics collapse to either trainable or non-trainable behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于模式连通性与低损失区域几何的分析框架，指出标准模运算设定并非总能产生grokking，并发现一个稳定的反例（anti-grokking），认为grokking源于训练与验证划分诱导的低损失区域错位。
AI.motivation: grokking指模型在训练集上已过拟合后，验证集泛化能力延迟出现的现象。尽管最早在小规模算法任务与transformer上观察到，但其内在机制仍无定论。现有解释多为相关性解释，缺乏统一且可预测的机制框架。
AI.method: 构建基于模式连通性（mode connectivity）与低损失区域几何的分析框架，用以刻画训练集与验证集所诱导的低损失区域的相对位置关系（是否对齐/错位）。并在标准模运算任务上采用保持对称性的训练/验证划分进行验证，检验框架的预测。
AI.result: 在保持对称性的训练/验证划分下，观察到稳定的反grokking案例：验证性能不发生恢复，即标准模运算设定并不总产生grokking。该反例对若干既有grokking相关性解释构成挑战。框架进一步表明，当训练与验证划分诱导的低损失区域对齐后，仅靠训练超参数无法产生grokking，所观察到的动力学退化为可训练或不可训练行为。
AI.conclusion: grokking的产生条件是训练集与验证集诱导的低损失区域错位；一旦这些区域良好对齐，训练超参数单独不足以引发grokking，动力学收敛为可训练或不可训练两种行为。该几何视角为grokking提供了可预测的机制性解释，并给出反例修正既有相关性认识。

title: Learning Linear Systems under Heavy-Tailed Noise: A Non-Asymptotic Analysis from A Single Trajectory
summary: We establish non-asymptotic sample complexity bounds for the least-squares estimation of vector autoregressive models for exponentially stable systems with heavy-tailed noise based on a single observed trajectory. By assuming i.i.d. noise, bounded noise covariance, and persistent excitation, we show that the estimation error is $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$ under bounded $p$th moment for $p > 2$, where $T$ is the number of samples, $r$ is the noise dimension, and $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot)$ hides logarithmic terms. We also introduce a unifying approach to sample complexity analysis applicable to broad classes of noise distributions and showcase this by deriving error bounds for sub-exponential and sub-Gaussian noise distributions. Finally, we specialize our analysis to autoregressive models with exogenous inputs and show that the dimension factor of the error bound is independent of the model order.

AI.tldr: 本文针对指数稳定向量自回归模型在重尾噪声下的最小二乘估计，建立了基于单条轨迹的非渐近样本复杂度界，并提出了适用于广泛噪声分布的统一样本复杂度分析方法。
AI.motivation: 重尾噪声下自回归模型的最小二乘估计缺乏非渐近的样本复杂度刻画，且已有分析往往依赖特定噪声分布，难以推广到更广泛的噪声类型，因此需要建立更通用且精确的误差界。
AI.method: 假设噪声独立同分布、噪声协方差有界并满足持续激励条件，在仅观测单条轨迹的设定下，对指数稳定VAR模型的最小二乘估计进行非渐近分析；针对有界p阶矩（p>2）推导误差界，并引入统一方法推广至次指数和次高斯噪声，最后将分析特化到带外生输入的自回归模型。
AI.result: 当噪声具有有界p阶矩（p>2）时，估计误差为 \widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})，其中T为样本数，r为噪声维度，\widetilde{\mathcal{O}} 隐藏对数项；该统一方法成功导出次指数与次高斯噪声下的误差界；对带外生输入的自回归模型，误差界的维度因子与模型阶数无关。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了重尾噪声下指数稳定VAR模型最小二乘估计的非渐近样本复杂度界，并提供了可推广至多种噪声分布的统一样本复杂度分析框架，同时表明在含外生输入的AR模型中误差界维度因子不随模型阶数增长。

title: Group-Invariant Statistics Determine Embedding Geometry: Harmonic Analysis of Representations from Bach to the Night Sky
summary: The representations that language models learn for concepts such as months, weekdays, and places display consistent geometric structure: circles and saddle-shaped "Pringle" manifolds. Recent work traced these structures to $\textit{translation symmetry}$ in word co-occurrence statistics, deriving the observed Fourier geometry when co-occurrence depends only on distance on an abelian lattice of concepts. We demonstrate that more general notions of symmetry lead to equally structured predictions. Considering symmetries defined by arbitrary finite groups, compact groups, and homogeneous spaces, we prove that whenever the co-occurrence statistics of a word family are invariant under a group $G$, the learned word embeddings consist of matrix elements of the irreducible representations (irreps) of $G$. Circles and Pringles arise when $G$ is cyclic, in which case the irreps are Fourier modes. We verify the irrep structure in three experimental settings. (i) The cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$: for the months of the year we recover the known circular geometry. (ii) A dihedral group acting on the major and minor triads: we unify two classical observations -- that transposition and chord inversion form a group ($T/I$) acting on chords (music theory), which $\textit{implies}$ that the well-known "circle of fifths" emerges in learned chord embeddings (machine learning). (iii) We explain and reproduce a recently discovered spherical representation of celestial objects in large language models (LLMs) as a spherical-harmonic embedding derived from our theory. Our results demonstrate that the geometry of learned representations is often a consequence of the statistical symmetry of underlying data.

AI.tldr: 词嵌入中的几何结构（圆环、马鞍形"Pringle"流形）源于共现统计的对称性。将平移对称推广到任意有限群、紧群与齐性空间后，可证明：当词族共现统计在群G下不变时，习得嵌入由G的不可约表示的矩阵元构成。循环群给出圆环与Pringle，二面体群统一音乐理论T/I群与"五度圈"，并解释LLM中天体的球谐表示。
