AI.motivation: 已有工作把月份、星期、地点等概念的嵌入几何（圆环、鞍形Pringle流形）归因于词共现统计中的平移对称性，仅在阿贝尔格点上、共现只依赖距离时导出Fourier几何。作者希望说明这种结构化预测并非平移对称所独有，更一般的对称性（任意有限群、紧群、齐性空间）同样能导出结构化的嵌入几何，从而把"几何源于数据统计对称性"这一命题推广到更广范围，并统一若干分散的观察。
AI.method: 理论层面：在群G作用下共现统计不变的假设下，证明学习到的词嵌入等价于G的不可约表示（irreps）的矩阵元；循环群情形下irreps即Fourier模，故重现圆环与Pringle几何。实验层面设三个验证场景：(i) 循环群Z12，对月份词汇恢复已知的圆形几何；(ii) 二面体群作用于大三度与三度三和弦，将音乐理论中移调与和弦转位构成T/I群的经典观察，与机器学习中习得的"五度圈"和弦嵌入统一起来，说明前者蕴含后者；(iii) 对LLM中近期发现的天体球形表示，用该理论将其解释并复现为球谐嵌入。
AI.result: （i）Z12情形下成功恢复月份的圆形几何；（ii）在二面体群作用下，从T/I群的对称性推出并观察到和弦嵌入中的五度圈结构，统一了音乐理论与机器学习两个经典结论；（iii）成功解释并复现LLM中天体的球形（球谐）表示。
AI.conclusion: 只要词族共现统计在群G下不变，习得表示的几何就由G的不可约表示矩阵元决定：循环群产生圆环与Pringle（Fourier模），其他群给出相应的irrep结构（如二面体群给出五度圈、球谐嵌入给出球面几何）。这表明学习到的表示几何往往是底层数据统计对称性的必然结果，而不仅是平移对称的特例。

title: Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
comment: 40 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.

AI.tldr: 提出StepRS-GRPO：在扩散大语言模型(dLLM)去噪过程中按状态变化风险系数，对组优势做重标定，提升推理的准确率、覆盖率与多样性。
AI.motivation: dLLM通过并行去噪序列或连续块生成文本，多个token被同时揭示；RLVR在所有去噪决策间复用终端奖励反馈，但各决策的条件上下文不同，导致同一条轨迹内优势信号与状态不匹配，存在信用分配与风险敏感性问题。现有GRPO类方法未针对去噪状态差异调整优势变换。
AI.method: 提出Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO)：保持原有训练器不变，仅让组优势变换中的风险系数随去噪状态变化。对二值奖励，证明该变换等价于对中心化结果优势做提示–状态相关的重标定。用基于能力的校准给出系数尺度，并通过端点与插值消融确定调度表的选择。
AI.result: 在多个dLLM骨干与数学推理基准上，StepRS-GRPO相对centered GRPO同时提升pass@1准确率与pass@k覆盖率，并增加答案多样性。消融中，质量匹配对照支持状态分配与调度方向的贡献；将优势RMS匹配至centered GRPO后收益依然存在。推理轨迹诊断显示多样性增益不限于最终答案字符串。
AI.conclusion: 按去噪状态调整风险敏感度可有效利用RLVR的终端反馈，在保持训练框架不变的前提下改善dLLM的推理性能与生成多样性，且效果并非源于优势尺度差异。

title: Analysis of Quantized and Efficiently Adapted Protein Language Models
summary: Background: Protein language models (PLMs) are increasingly used for sequence generation and property prediction, but their size makes fine-tuning and deployment expensive. The effects of quantization and parameter efficient fine-tuning on performance, representations and generation remain insufficiently characterized. Results: We evaluated 4-bit quantization and low-rank adapter fine-tuning (QLoRA) across ESM-2, ESMC, ProtBERT, ProtT5, Ankh, Ankh3 and Profluent-E1. Across protein prediction tasks, many model-task pairs retained more than 90% of full fine-tuning performance. Peak GPU memory savings approached 90% for the largest models, although performance and efficiency varied by model, dataset and training configuration. QLoRA often preserved early-layer representations while inducing task-specific adaptations in middle and late layers, resembling full fine-tuning with smaller representational changes. Training speed and power effects were more varied. For unconditional generation with ProLLaMA, ProtGPT2, ProGen2, ProteinGLM and ESM3, 4-bit quantization largely preserved predicted structural and sequence-level properties, but token-level analysis revealed model-dependent shifts in autoregressive output distributions. Conclusion: QLoRA and 4-bit quantization reduce PLM computational requirements, particularly GPU memory usage. Our results support QLoRA as a first-pass strategy for memory limited adaptation, reserving full fine-tuning for challenging tasks, unstable architectures or low validation recovery. For generative PLMs, sequence-level and structural metrics should be complemented with distributional analysis, since downstream predictions alone may miss quantization-induced shifts. These approaches can broaden access to large-scale protein modelling while requiring model- and task-specific validation.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了4-bit量化与QLoRA在7个蛋白质语言模型（ESM-2、ESMC、ProtBERT、ProtT5、Ankh、Ankh3、Profluent-E1）及5个生成模型（ProLLaMA、ProtGPT2、ProGen2、ProteinGLM、ESM3）上的效果，发现多数任务可保留90%以上全量微调性能，峰值GPU显存节省近90%，并建议在生成任务中补充分布层面的分析。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质语言模型（PLM）规模庞大，导致微调与部署成本高昂。尽管4-bit量化和参数高效微调（如QLoRA）被广泛用作降本手段，但其对模型性能、内部表征以及生成行为的影响仍缺乏系统刻画，尤其在不同模型、任务与训练配置下的适用性尚不明确。
AI.method: 在ESM-2、ESMC、ProtBERT、ProtT5、Ankh、Ankh3、Profluent-E1等模型上评估4-bit量化与低秩适配器微调（QLoRA），覆盖多种蛋白质预测任务；比较性能保留率、显存与训练效率、功耗，并分析各层的表征变化；在ProLLaMA、ProtGPT2、ProGen2、ProteinGLM、ESM3上开展无条件生成实验，结合序列级、结构级指标与token级自回归输出分布分析。
AI.result: 在多数模型-任务组合中，QLoRA保留了超过90%的全量微调性能；最大模型的峰值GPU显存节省接近90%，但性能与效率因模型、数据集和训练配置而异。QLoRA通常保留浅层表征，并在中、后层引入任务特异性适配，其表征变化小于全量微调。训练速度与功耗影响差异较大。生成任务中，4-bit量化基本保持预测的结构与序列级性质，但token级分析揭示出自回归输出分布存在模型依赖性的偏移。
AI.conclusion: QLoRA与4-bit量化可显著降低PLM计算开销，尤其是GPU显存占用。建议将QLoRA作为显存受限场景下的首选适配策略，仅对困难任务、不稳定架构或验证集恢复不佳的情形使用全量微调。对生成式PLM，应在序列级与结构级指标之外补充分布层分析，因为仅依赖下游预测可能遗漏量化引起的偏移。上述方法有助于普及大规模蛋白质建模，但需针对模型与任务进行验证。

title: ORBIT-FMIB: Tracking Order-Resolved Epistatic Information Through ESM-2
summary:
Protein foundation models support mutation-effect and structural prediction, but predictive performance alone does not reveal which forms of biological interaction information remain accessible through model depth. We ask whether ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information as strongly as first- and second-order information across its representation hierarchy, introducing ORBIT-FMIB, a diagnostic framework combining Walsh-based interaction decomposition with subset-conditioned neural dependence estimation. The method is validated on synthetic landscapes with known interaction structure before being applied to the dense four-site GB1 fitness landscape using frozen ESM-2 representations.
  An initial production run suggested ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information less well than lower-order information ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.107$). An independent replication of the complete measurement grid, under matched GPU hardware and identical critic seeds, substantially reduced this contrast ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.017$), and its sign was unstable across otherwise-defensible evaluation-pairing choices applied to the same trained critics ($-0.011$ to $+0.015$). We therefore do not currently have robust evidence that ESM-2 selectively loses higher-order epistatic information, nor that retention is equal across orders; the directional question remains open. The measurement protocol itself, including its documented removal of a positional-subset shortcut in pooled critics, remains validated and is unaffected by this finding. ORBIT-FMIB is offered as a diagnostic framework for probing interaction structure in protein foundation models; this study's own replication result illustrates why such probing requires adequately-powered reproducibility checks before its output is treated as a biological finding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，用于检测蛋白质基础模型ESM-2是否在其表征层级中保留高阶上位性信息；复现实验表明原初观察到的"高阶信息保留较弱"效应并不稳健，方向性结论仍悬而未决。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质基础模型的预测性能无法揭示模型深度中保留何种生物相互作用信息。作者希望探究ESM-2在其表征层级中是否像保留一阶、二阶信息那样强地保留高阶上位性信息，从而更深入理解模型的表征能力。
AI.method: 提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，结合基于Walsh的交互分解与子集条件化神经依赖性估计。先在交互结构已知的合成适应度地形上验证方法，再应用于稠密四站点GB1适应度地形，使用冻结的ESM-2表征。通过两次独立测量（初版生产运行与独立复现，在匹配GPU硬件和相同critic种子下进行），并考察不同评估配对选择对结果的影响。
AI.result: 初版运行显示ESM-2对高阶上位性信息的保留弱于低阶信息（Δ_HO-LO=-0.107）。在匹配硬件与相同种子下的独立复现显著缩小了该差异（Δ_HO-LO=-0.017），且其符号在多种可辩护的评估配对选择下并不稳定（-0.011至+0.015）。因此目前没有稳健证据表明ESM-2选择性地丢失高阶上位性信息，也无法断定各阶信息保留相等。
AI.conclusion: 测量协议本身（包括已记录的去除池化critic中位置子集捷径）仍经验证有效，不受该发现影响。ORBIT-FMIB作为探测蛋白质基础模型交互结构的诊断框架被提出；本研究的复现结果说明，在将此类探测输出视为生物学发现之前，需要进行充分功效的可复现性检验。

title: LabBook: Harnessing Experimental History for Efficient LLM-Driven Discovery
summary: Evolutionary approaches to LLM-driven discovery often generate new programs from a small set of selected ancestors. This keeps contexts manageable but can omit useful evidence from other experiments, whereas including the full experimental history produces long, redundant contexts. We introduce a simple, single-agent discovery harness built around LabBook, an agent-maintained memory that serves two complementary roles: guiding retrieval of relevant evidence from a complete experimental log and informing the generation of new solutions. At each iteration, the same agent combines its memory with retrieved evidence and jointly produces the next program and an updated LabBook. This separates complete history retention from selective context construction, without requiring an explicit population or branching search structure. On 49 Frontier-CS problems, LabBook improves the observed quality-cost trade-off over the evaluated evolutionary baselines with two backbones, while remaining competitive across nine additional mathematical, systems, and heuristic-design tasks. Code will be released at https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/LabBook.

AI.tldr: 提出单智能体发现框架LabBook，用智能体维护的记忆同时承担"从完整实验日志检索证据"和"引导新解生成"两个角色，将完整历史保留与选择性上下文构建解耦，无需显式种群或分支搜索。
AI.motivation: 进化式LLM发现方法通常从少量被选祖先生成新程序，上下文可控但会遗漏其他实验中的有用证据；而纳入全部实验历史又会造成上下文冗长冗余。
AI.method: 构建以LabBook为核心的单智能体发现harness：LabBook是智能体维护的记忆，既用于从完整实验日志中做相关性检索，又用于指导新解生成；每次迭代同一智能体将记忆与检索证据结合，联合产出下一个程序与更新后的LabBook，从而把完整历史保留与选择性上下文构造分离。
AI.result: 在49个Frontier-CS问题上，使用两个backbone时LabBook相较所评估的进化基线改善了观测到的质量-成本权衡；在另外九项数学、系统和启发式设计任务上亦保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆维护与证据检索、方案生成统一在单智能体中，可在不依赖显式种群或分支搜索的前提下兼顾历史完整性与上下文精简，成为进化式LLM发现的有效替代方案；代码将于https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/LabBook发布。

title: SkillSpec: Consensus-Gated Agent Skill Evolution via Representation Specialization
summary: Natural-language skills are textual procedural memories through which large language model (LLM) agents retain reusable task knowledge without updating model weights. Existing methods typically treat skills as either static artifacts or monolithic documents optimized using aggregate validation scores as feedback. However, representing a skill as a monolithic document restricts optimization to its textual content, without explicitly modeling the structure through which procedural knowledge is retrieved and executed. We identify a key distinction between learning what knowledge to retain and determining how to organize it: textual updates should first be validated through execution evidence, after which the retained knowledge should be structured according to its procedural dependencies and retrieval requirements. To this end, we introduce SkillSpec, a two-phase framework comprising consensus-gated evolution and representation specialization. In the consensus-gated phase, complementary editing intents generate complete candidate skills. An update is committed only when paired evaluations reach consensus, requiring sufficient overall improvement and non-negative aggregate paired gain in every repeated evaluation. In the specialization phase, signals of process and redundancy sensitivity derived from the full optimization trajectory, including accepted and rejected candidates, guide the selection of a flat, graph, or hybrid representation.Across six benchmarks and three target language models, SkillSpec improves average success rate over SkillOpt by 6.89%, averaged across the three models. These results demonstrate that reliable skill evolution and representation specialization address complementary objectives: deciding what knowledge to retain and how to structure it for inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillSpec，一个两阶段框架：先通过"共识门控进化"确保技能更新的可靠提交，再通过"表示专门化"依据过程与冗余敏感信号选择扁平、图或混合结构，在六个基准和三个语言模型上相比SkillOpt平均提升6.89%成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体将自然语言技能视为静态产物或单一整体文档，仅用聚合验证分数作为反馈来优化文本内容，未显式建模程序性知识的检索与执行结构。作者指出"学什么知识"与"如何组织知识"是两件不同的事，需要先以执行证据验证文本更新，再按程序性依赖与检索需求对知识进行结构化。
AI.method: SkillSpec包含两个阶段：（1）共识门控进化：由互补的编辑意图生成完整候选技能，只有当配对评估达成共识——即整体提升充分且每次重复评估的聚合配对增益均为非负——才提交更新；（2）表示专门化：从完整优化轨迹（含被接受与被拒绝的候选）中提取过程敏感性与冗余敏感性信号，据此选择扁平、图或混合表示。
AI.result: 在六个基准和三个目标语言模型上，SkillSpec相对SkillOpt平均成功率提升6.89%（三个模型平均）。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的技能进化与表示专门化解决了互补的目标：决定保留哪些知识，以及如何为推理组织这些知识。

title: Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM驱动发现中迭代历史种群与最终发现成功率的关系，提出12种"Modular"harness并在5个任务上评测，发现成功脆弱且受harness设计影响；识别出"模式坍缩"这一常见失败模式，发现多样性干预收益不稳定，转而发现早期发现性能可预测最终成功，据此提出"并行探索初始化"干预，在多harness与多任务上获得一致提升。
AI.motivation: LLM已通过harness（提示LLM迭代优化目标）用于算法、定理、药物等发现任务，但既往harness设计研究较少系统考察"历史迭代种群"与最终发现成功之间的关系；同时发现成功率脆弱、对设计高度敏感，亟需厘清失败机制并找到通用改进手段。
AI.method: 将以往harness设计工作一般化，构建12种harness的"Modular"套件，在5个多样化发现任务上刻画性能；分析迭代解的多样性以识别模式坍缩，评估主流SOTA harness及多样性诱导干预的效果；基于"早期发现性能可预测最终成功"的观察，提出通用干预：先用并行探索阶段初始化，再进行迭代优化。
AI.result: 发现成功率脆弱且对harness设计敏感；模式坍缩（迭代解多样性骤降）是常见失败模式；流行的SOTA harness与多样性诱导干预对延缓解坍缩的收益不一致；早期发现性能对最终成功具有预测性；提出的并行探索初始化方法在多种harness和目标应用上带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 初始化在LLM驱动发现中至关重要；与其在迭代过程中被动维持多样性，不如通过初始并行探索为后续迭代优化提供更优起点，该结论在多个harness与应用上得到一致验证。

title: Beyond Unimodal Bases: Pullback Geometry for Multimodal Data
summary:
Data-driven Riemannian geometry provides nonlinear interpolation and geometric representations of high-dimensional data. For these operations to be statistically meaningful, paths between observations should preferentially traverse high-likelihood regions. Existing scalable pullback constructions typically use a unimodal Gaussian latent distribution, assuming that the data reside close to a single manifold. For multimodal data, mapping separated modes or local structures into one Gaussian region can require substantial transport deformation and compromise the resulting geometry.
  We introduce a pullback geometry for data supported on mixtures of manifolds. Using a latent Gaussian mixture, we define its Riemannian metric as the matrix square of the responsibility-weighted expected component precision. The metric is smooth and positive definite and recovers the existing Gaussian construction in the single-component limit. For structured overlapping mixtures, we establish conditions under which the log-density is concave along geodesics, providing a formal connection between the proposed geometry and paths through high-likelihood regions, and derive the corresponding local curvature relations.
  We instantiate this geometry in a normalizing flow with adaptive mixture learning, allowing the number of active components to emerge from the data and supporting component-wise reconstruction and local effective-dimension estimation. Experiments on synthetic geometric data, a controlled multi-view image setting with a known reference trajectory, and MNIST show reduced transport distortion, competitive path support, close reference-trajectory recovery, and improved interpolation realism. These results extend scalable pullback geometry beyond datasets that reside close to a single manifold while retaining tractable and interpretable local structure.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向多流形混合数据（多模态数据）的可扩展拉回黎曼几何：以潜空间高斯混合代替单模态高斯，将度量定义为“责任加权期望分量精度矩阵的平方”，并实例化于自适应混合学习的归一化流中，从而降低传输形变、提升插值真实感。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的黎曼几何用于高维数据的非线性插值与几何表示，但要让这些操作具有统计意义，观测之间的路径应优先穿过高似然区域。现有可扩展拉回构造通常采用单模态高斯潜分布，隐含假设数据靠近单一流形；对多模态数据，把彼此分离的模态或局部结构映射进同一高斯区域需要较大的传输形变，损害所得几何的合理性与插值质量。
AI.method: 1) 用潜空间高斯混合构造拉回几何，将黎曼度量定义为责任加权期望分量精度矩阵的矩阵平方；该度量光滑、正定，并在单分量极限下退化为既有高斯构造。2) 针对结构化重叠混合，给出对数密度沿测地线为凹的条件，从而在形式上建立该几何与“高似然路径”之间的联系，并推导相应的局部曲率关系。3) 在归一化流中实例化该几何，采用自适应混合学习，使活跃分量数由数据自动涌现，并支持逐分量重构与局部有效维度估计。
AI.result: 在合成几何数据、带已知参考轨迹的受控多视角图像设定以及 MNIST 上，方法表现出：更低的传输形变、具竞争力的路径支撑（高似然支撑）、较接近参考轨迹的恢复效果，以及更优的插值真实感。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将可扩展拉回几何从“靠近单一流形”的数据推广到多流形混合数据，同时保持局部结构可处理、可解释，为多模态数据提供了统计意义更强的插值与非欧几何表示框架。

title: WOMBAT: Whitebox Oracle for Molecular Benchmarking and Attribution Testing
summary: When a graph neural network (GNN) explainer produces an unexpected attribution on a molecule, the attribution alone cannot reveal whether the explainer has failed or the model has learned a shortcut. We introduce WOMBAT, a benchmark of 14 whitebox GNNs, each with message-passing weights set by hand to detect a specific SMARTS motif. Each model's decision rule is known by construction, providing attribution ground truth against which explainer errors can be identified and studied. We validate the models on millions of PubChem molecules and evaluate post-hoc explainers including GNNExplainer, PGExplainer, and Integrated Gradients. Guided by our qualitative analysis, we construct a model that causes Integrated Gradients to spread attribution across the graph, even though the model reliably detects the intended motif. We release the dataset, models, and evaluation code to help researchers in the development of newer XAI tools for GNNs.

AI.tldr: WOMBAT是一个包含14个白盒GNN的基准，每个模型的权重被手工设定以检测特定SMARTS子结构，从而为GNN解释器提供已知的归因真值，并用于评估GNNExplainer、PGExplainer和Integrated Gradients等事后解释器。
AI.motivation: 当GNN解释器在分子上产生意外归因时，仅凭归因结果无法判断是解释器失败还是模型学到了捷径（shortcut）。现有评估缺乏已知决策规则的模型，难以区分这两类错误，因此需要一个具有归因真值的基准来系统性地识别和归因解释器的失效根源。
AI.method: 构建WOMBAT基准：包含14个白盒GNN，每个模型的消息传递权重被人工设定以检测一个特定SMARTS模体（motif）。由于决策规则由构造已知，因此可提供归因真值。在数百万PubChem分子上验证这些模型，并评估GNNExplainer、PGExplainer和Integrated Gradients等事后解释器。基于定性分析，进一步构造一个专门导致Integrated Gradients将归因散布到整个图上的模型，尽管该模型仍能可靠地检测目标模体。
AI.result: 模型在数百万PubChem分子上完成验证；对GNNExplainer、PGExplainer和Integrated Gradients的评估表明，在已知真值下可识别解释器错误；并成功构造出使Integrated Gradients产生全局归因扩散、但模型仍可靠检测目标模体的模型。
AI.conclusion: WOMBAT通过提供归因真值，揭示了单凭归因无法区分的“解释器失败”与“模型学捷径”问题，并公开数据集、模型和评估代码，旨在推动面向GNN的新XAI工具的开发。

title: JEPA-TTT: Persistent Test-Time Training of Latent World Models for Planning under Dynamics Shifts
comment: Accepted to World Models in Physical AI Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026 | Project page: https://jepa-ttt.github.io/
summary: World models enable agents to plan by predicting future states of the environment, but their predictions can become unreliable when test-time dynamics differ from those seen during training. We present JEPA-TTT, which adapts the latent dynamics predictor of a pretrained action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture world model throughout test time. Self-supervised updates accumulate across episodes, while the visual encoder and reward head remain fixed, preserving the pretrained representation and task objective. Planning requires neither a goal image nor online environment reward. JEPA-TTT uses dense replay, which forms prediction windows at every temporal offset, retains them in a growing buffer, and samples minibatches from that buffer for predictor updates. Across eight dynamics shifts in four continuous-control environments, JEPA-TTT improves planning on every shift. After 500 test-time episodes, it reduces autoregressive latent prediction error by 83% on average and improves planning performance by 153% over the frozen JEPA world model. These results show that persistent self-supervised test-time training can adapt a pretrained latent world model under changed dynamics.

AI.tldr: JEPA-TTT 在测试阶段对预训练动作条件 JEPA 世界模型的潜在动力学预测器进行自监督自适应更新,在动力学变化下显著提升规划性能。
AI.motivation: 世界模型通过预测环境未来状态来支持智能体规划,但当测试时动力学与训练时不同,其预测会变得不可靠,因此需要一种能在变化动力学下保持预测与规划有效性的方法。
AI.method: 提出 JEPA-TTT:在测试全程自适应预训练动作条件联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)世界模型的潜在动力学预测器;自监督更新跨回合累积,而视觉编码器与奖励头保持固定,以保留预训练表征与任务目标;规划无需目标图像或在线环境奖励;采用密集回放,在每个时间偏移处构建预测窗口,存入不断增长的缓冲区并从中采样小批量更新预测器。
AI.result: 在 4 个连续控制环境的 8 种动力学变化中,JEPA-TTT 在每一种变化上都提升了规划;经过 500 个测试回合后,自回归潜在预测误差平均降低 83%,规划性能相比冻结的 JEPA 世界模型提升 153%。
AI.conclusion: 持续的、自监督的测试时训练能够使预训练潜在世界模型在动力学改变的情况下实现自适应。

title: Benchmarking Generative Models for Weather Data Assimilation on Real Station Observations
summary: Weather reanalysis products rely on computationally intensive numerical weather predictions followed by data assimilation that corrects the forecast toward observations. Deep generative models offer a cheaper alternative that shifts much of this cost from inference to offline training. However, existing generative approaches have been evaluated on synthetic observations or under different datasets and evaluation schemes, making it unclear which design choices actually improve real-world data assimilation. We present the first controlled benchmark of generative weather data assimilation on real weather station observations. Using 11,849 NOAA MADIS stations across the contiguous United States and four weather variables, we evaluate methods while holding the dataset, observation operator, and deep learning architecture fixed. The benchmark compares the major design choices, including diffusion versus flow matching, pixel versus latent-space formulations, and multiple inference-time conditioning strategies, against a classical 3D-Var baseline. The benchmark reveals three clear conclusions. First, learned generative priors outperform the Gaussian prior of 3D-Var (35.7% vs. 33.3% RMSE reduction over ERA5) despite using no ERA5 background field at inference. Second, full-gradient guidance consistently outperforms stop-gradient and initial-noise optimization. Third, other choices provide little measurable benefit: diffusion and flow matching perform nearly identically under matched conditions, and latent-space variable mixing does not help. We further evaluate both dense and sparse station settings and find advantages from generative AI and full-gradient guidance more pronounced under sparsity. Together, these results identify which components of generative weather data assimilation improve performance on real station observations and establish a standardized benchmark for future work.

AI.tldr: 首个基于真实气象站观测的生成式天气数据同化受控基准，固定数据集、观测算子与网络架构，对比扩散/流匹配、像素/潜空间、推理时条件策略，并与3D-Var基线比较。
AI.motivation: 天气再分析依赖昂贵的数值天气预报与数据同化。深度生成模型可将成本从推理转移到离线训练，但已有生成式方法多在合成观测或不同数据集与评价体系下评估，导致哪些设计选择真正提升真实数据同化性能尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用美国本土11,849个NOAA MADIS站点、四种气象变量，构建受控基准：固定数据集、观测算子与深度学习架构，系统比较扩散与流匹配、像素空间与潜空间建模、多种推理时条件策略（完全梯度引导、停止梯度、初始噪声优化），并与经典3D-Var基线对比；同时评估稠密与稀疏站点两种设置。
AI.result: 学习到的生成先验优于3D-Var的高斯先验（相对ERA5的RMSE降低35.7% vs. 33.3%），且推理时不使用ERA5背景场；完全梯度引导稳定优于停止梯度与初始噪声优化；扩散与流匹配在匹配条件下表现几乎一致，潜空间变量混合无增益；稀疏站点下生成式AI与完全梯度引导的优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 该工作明确了生成式天气数据同化中真正提升真实站点观测性能的关键组件，并建立标准化基准供后续研究使用。

title: Reformulation-Contrastive Learning for Mixed Integer Programs
summary: Mixed-integer linear programs (MILP) model many real-world decision problems, motivating machine-learning methods that exploit recurring structure to accelerate MILP solving. MILPs can admit many equivalent formulations: integrality-preserving changes of variables and the addition of redundant constraints can alter their formulations while preserving the optimization problem. We leverage these reformulations as a source of self-supervision for learning general-purpose representations of MILP variables and constraints. We characterize the affine reformulations that are valid for every input instance, and distinguish re-descriptions, which leave variables unchanged, from substitutions, which transform them predictably. Building on equivariant self-supervised learning, we introduce ReMILP (reformulation-contrastive MILP representation learning), which jointly trains a graph neural network and a hypernetwork to predict how variable embeddings transform under changes of variables. Without solver-derived labels, ReMILP learns representations that exhibit the intended invariance and equivariance on unseen problem classes. Across binary solution, constraint activity and integrality gap prediction, these representations carry task-relevant information when frozen and provide a useful initialization for fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReMILP，利用MILP的重构（冗余约束与变量替换）作为自监督信号，通过等变自监督学习联合训练GNN与超网络，预测变量嵌入在变量变换下的变化，从而无需求解器标签即可学习通用MILP表示。
AI.motivation: 加速求解真实决策问题中的混合整数线性规划（MILP）具有重要价值，而利用重复结构进行机器学习的思路备受关注。同一MILP可存在多种等价形式（保整数性的变量替换、冗余约束添加），以往方法多依赖求解器标签，本文希望挖掘这些重构本身作为自监督来源，以学习通用的变量与约束表示。
AI.method: 刻画对所有输入实例均成立的仿射重构，区分保持变量不变的重描述（re-description）与可预测变换变量的替换（substitution）；基于等变自监督学习提出ReMILP，联合训练图神经网络与超网络，预测变量嵌入在变量变换下如何变换。
AI.result: 在未见问题类别上，ReMILP无需求解器标签即展现出预期的不变性与等变性；在二值解预测、约束活跃度预测与整数间隙预测任务中，冻结表示即携带任务相关信息，并可作为微调的有效初始化。
AI.conclusion: MILP的仿射重构可作为通用、无需标签的自监督信号，学习到具有不变性/等变性且迁移性强的变量与约束表示，为下游MILP预测任务提供有效表示与初始化。

title: Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints
summary: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“grafting”方法：在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，再将其权重增量加到已后训练的模型上，从而近似忠实的预/中训练干预，同时复用已有后训练流程。
AI.motivation: 预训练阶段形成的信念会影响模型从后续训练中的泛化，因此预训练干预对对�齐研究至关重要。合成文档微调（SDF）旨在改变模型信念，但理想做法需将合成文档混入预/中训练，而每次修改预训练语料都必须完整重跑后训练才能评估效果，迭代慢且昂贵。常见做法是直接把SDF应用于已后训练模型，但这会留下伪影、损害能力，并导致“现实漂移”（reality drift）：模型将文档无关的虚构实体当作真实存在。
AI.method: 提出grafting：在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，然后把学习到的权重更新加到后训练模型上。该方法在复用现有后训练的同时，近似忠实的预训练干预路径。作者通过安装虚假事实、训练失准的模型生物体（model organisms）以及应用宪法式中训练干预进行验证，覆盖参数规模达284B的多个模型家族。
AI.result: grafting在目标信念的植入强度上与直接对后训练模型做SDF相当，但平均将现实漂移和偏好一致性损失降低超过一半，并且更接近忠实的�中训练运行结果。由于grafting无需后训练，同一适配器可应用于任意后续检查点。
AI.conclusion: grafting使研究者能以单次微调的开销快速迭代预训练干预，为预/中训练阶段的对齐干预提供了一种高效且更忠实的替代方案。

title: Localizing Transfer Between Memorization Tasks
comment: 17 pages, 10 figures. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
summary: A central puzzle in transfer learning is why pre-training on one task can accelerate training or improve performance on another task, and what mechanisms underlie this transfer. In this work, we examine the transfer between memorization tasks of random input-output mappings. We find two surprising transfer patterns: equivalent transfer, where each additional pre-training epoch saves approximately one downstream fine-tuning epoch; and non-equivalent transfer, where pre-training on a mismatched task can be even more efficient than directly training on the downstream task itself. Through ablation experiments, we decompose and localize the transfer into two separate effects: a "trivial" magnitude-driven transfer in the last layer, and a "non-trivial" structure-driven transfer, partially attributable to the covariance of the other layers. These results advance our understanding of the underlying mechanisms of transfer learning and have the potential to lead to principled pre-training strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机输入-输出映射的记忆任务间的迁移学习，发现"等价迁移"（每个额外预训练epoch约等于一个下游微调epoch）和"非等价迁移"（不匹配任务预训练甚至比直接训练下游任务更高效）两种模式，并通过消融实验将迁移分解为末层的"平凡"幅度驱动效应和部分归因于其他层协方差的"非平凡"结构驱动效应。
AI.motivation: 迁移学习中的一个核心谜题是：为何在一个任务上预训练能够加速另一个任务的训练或提升其性能，以及这种迁移背后的机制是什么。本文旨在揭示迁移学习的底层机制，以期为有原则的预训练策略提供依据。
AI.method: 以随机输入-输出映射的记忆任务作为研究对象考察任务间迁移，识别出两种迁移模式；并通过消融实验对迁移效应进行分解与定位，将其拆分为两个独立的效应。
AI.result: 发现两种出人意料的迁移模式：一是等价迁移，每个额外的预训练epoch大约可节省一个下游微调epoch；二是非等价迁移，在不匹配任务上预训练的效率甚至高于直接在下游任务上训练。消融实验将迁移分解为末层的"平凡"幅度驱动迁移和"非平凡"结构驱动迁移，后者部分可归因于其他层的协方差。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果深化了对迁移学习内在机制的理解，并有望导向有原则的预训练策略。

title: Learning Goal-Reaching Quasimetric Geometry From Finite-Time Reachability
summary: In goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), quasimetric learning models goal-reaching costs as quasimetric distances, connecting local constraints to global value geometry. Its local constraints, however, should reflect the direction- dependent effects of control composition over a finite horizon together with environmental feasibility. We propose ReQRL, which constrains the critic's value gradients through finite-horizon reachability. Drawing on state-constrained optimal control, we decouple dynamical reachability from boundary geometry, estimating both from data. On OGBench, our method outperforms or rivals existing quasimetric approaches and other offline GCRL methods.

AI.tldr: 提出ReQRL，通过有限时域可达性约束critic的价值梯度，将动态可达性与边界几何解耦并从数据中估计，在OGBench上优于或媲美现有拟度量及离线GCRL方法。
AI.motivation: 现有拟度量学习在GCRL中将目标到达代价建模为拟度量距离，但其局部约束未能同时反映有限时域上控制的复合所导致的依赖方向效应以及环境可行性。
AI.method: ReQRL借助状态约束最优控制的思想，用有限时域可达性来约束critic的价值梯度，并将动态可达性与边界几何解耦，二者均从数据中估计得到。
AI.result: 在OGBench基准上，该方法优于或媲美现有拟度量方法及其他离线GCRL方法。
AI.conclusion: 将有限时域可达性约束引入价值梯度学习，为GCRL提供了更符合方向依赖性与环境可行性的局部约束，验证了状态约束最优控制视角的有效性。

title: Training-Aware Target Coverage for Synthetic Data Selection
summary: Synthetic data are increasingly used to scale LLM training, yet more synthetic data do not necessarily produce better models. Useful synthetic data must add information relevant to the target task without introducing errors that offset their benefit, and the value of an example can change as the training set grows. We develop a linear theory that characterizes this tradeoff and determines where synthetic data are useful, how much should be added, and the marginal value of adding one example to an existing set. The analysis shows the conditions when input coverage alone is sufficient and when synthetic errors must also be considered. Guided by these results, we introduce \emph{Training-Aware Target Coverage} (TATC), a synthetic data selection method for LLM fine-tuning. TATC identifies candidates whose training effects are beneficial to the target task and selects among them to expand coverage of target-relevant directions not already represented by the available data. Experiments on text and image data verify the linear theory. With mathematical reasoning tasks, TATC selects synthetic solutions for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and outperforms alternative synthetic-data selection methods on GSM8K across selection budgets. In summary, we provide a principled approach to synthetic data selection by quantifying and maximizing its value to the target task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出刻画合成数据价值的线性理论，并据此设计训练感知目标覆盖（TATC）选择方法，用于LLM微调中的合成数据筛选。
AI.motivation: 合成数据被广泛用于扩大LLM训练规模，但更多合成数据不必然带来更好模型。有效合成数据须为目标任务补充相关信息且不引入抵消收益的错误，且单条样本价值会随训练集增大而改变，因此需要量化合成数据价值并指导选择。
AI.method: 建立线性理论刻画合成数据收益与误差之间的权衡，确定合成数据何时有用、应添加多少以及向现有集合添加一条样本的边际价值；给出仅输入覆盖足够与必须考虑合成误差的条件。基于此提出TATC方法：识别对目标任务训练效应有益的候选样本，并在其中选择扩展目标相关方向（尚未被现有数据覆盖）的样本。
AI.result: 文本与图像数据实验验证了线性理论；在数学推理任务中，TATC为Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct选择合成解答进行微调，在GSM8K上于各选择预算下优于其他合成数据选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过量化并最大化合成数据对目标任务的价值，为合成数据选择提供了有原则的方法论。

title: Quantifying the Impact of Ambulance Ramping: A Multi-Year Analysis of Victorian Emergency Medical Services Cases
summary: Ambulance ramping, the delay between hospital arrival and patient handover, is a critical operational bottleneck in Emergency Medical Services (EMS), yet its systemic magnitude and dynamics remain inadequately characterised at scale. This paper quantifies the scale, trajectory, and operational correlates of ramping across an entire statewide EMS system, analysing 2,850,575 ambulance attendances in Victoria, Australia from January 2020 to March 2024 using an Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). After systematic preprocessing, an analytical cohort of 2,026,569 Emergency Department (ED) transports across 59 hospitals with ED and 79 Local Government Areas (LGA) was examined through interval decomposition, Pareto concentration, hourly cross-correlation, hospital arrival concurrency and priority-stratified operational comparisons. Cumulative Ambulance Hours Lost (AHL) totalled 1,491,127 hours, equivalent to approximately 96 ten-hour ambulance shift lost every day of the study window. Ten of 59 hospitals account for 57.8% of lost hours from 50.9% of cases. Annual losses rose 57% to a 2022 peak while transported demand fell 3.7%, indicating deterioration in per-case handover rather than growth in demand. Handover duration varies little with patient acuity, but rises monotonically with the number of ambulances arriving at the same hospital in the preceding hour, an effect persisting within every hour of the day. Hourly demand is moderately associated with ramping two to four hours later (r = 0.365). These findings establish the empirical preconditions for hospital-state aware ambulance routing.

AI.tldr: 基于澳大利亚维多利亚州2020–2024年202万余次急诊转运的探索性数据分析，量化了全州救护车压床的规模、趋势与运行相关性，发现累计损失149万救护车小时，且压床随到达同院救护车数量单调上升。
AI.motivation: 救护车压床（到达医院至患者交接间的延迟）是EMS的关键运行瓶颈，但其系统性规模与动态特征在大范围尺度上仍缺乏充分刻画，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用探索性数据分析（EDA）。对2020年1月至2024年3月维多利亚州2,850,575次救护车出勤进行系统预处理，得到涵盖59家有急诊科医院、79个地方政府区域的2,026,569次ED转运分析队列，并通过区间分解、帕累托集中度、逐时互相关、医院到达并发性及按优先级分层的运行比较进行分析。
AI.result: 累计救护车损失工时（AHL）达1,491,127小时，约相当于研究期内每天损失96个十小时班次；59家医院中10家贡献了57.8%的损失工时（对应50.9%的病例）。年度损失升至2022年峰值、增幅57%，而转运需求下降3.7%，说明是每例交接恶化而非需求增长所致。交接时长随患者危重程度变化很小，但随前一小时内到达同一医院的救护车数量单调上升，且该效应在一天各时段均存在。逐时需求与2至4小时后的压床呈中度相关（r=0.365）。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了面向医院状态感知的救护车调度的经验前提，表明压床是系统性、集中性且可预测的运行问题。

title: On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D
comment: Published (Spotlight) at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
summary: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and that the resulting weight space can support reuse and generalisation beyond known functions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用超网络直接从少量演示中"即时编译"出紧凑的专家模型参数，在ARC-1D测试床上验证了生成参数构成结构化权重空间，并展现出部分组合泛化与对未见变换的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 通用模型虽能通过上下文适应多种任务，但容量利用率低；专用模型虽高效执行单一功能，却需要针对任务的训练或适配。作者质疑：能否不经过任务特定训练，而直接从少量演示中生成这些专家模型？
AI.method: 以ARC-1D作为受控测试床。首先证明单个变换可由极小的专家模型表示；随后训练一个超网络，从上下文（少量演示）直接生成这些专家模型的参数。实验对比了显式任务标识符存在与去除两种设置，并评估组合泛化及对训练中未见变换的泛化。
AI.result: 生成的参数形成结构化的权重空间；所得专家模型展现出部分组合泛化能力，并能泛化到训练时未见过的变换。在两种设置下去除显式任务标识符，均能提升超出训练变换范围的泛化表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了概念验证：少量样本的任务上下文可以即时编译为紧凑的可执行模型参数，且由此形成的权重空间能够支持复用与超出已知功能的泛化。

title: AnyJev Technical Report
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Early report on work in development. Code: https://github.com/nokia-applied-research/AnyJev
summary: A typed decision is a choice among a fixed set of options, returned as a probability rather than as text. Systems that need typed decisions today use models trained for that purpose. This report describes AnyJev, which reads a typed decision from one prefill of a pretrained instruction-tuned language model. The readout restricts the next-token distribution at the answer position to the option tokens. It has two defects: the model assigns higher probability to some labels whatever the input, and to some positions in the option list. AnyJev corrects both with no gradient steps and no parameter changes: it divides out a label prior estimated from unlabelled inputs, and it averages log-probabilities over the K cyclic rotations of the option list. On two 20-option tasks the rotations lower the order-flip rate from 0.33 to 0.14 and from 0.33 to 0.18, and raise accuracy on 11 of 11 models on both. Reading every rotation requires K prefills. A stopping rule selected against the full-rotation decision on unlabelled states cuts that. Selecting the threshold on one unlabelled split and bounding its disagreement on a second, it reads 10.6 rotations of 18 at a verified 0.008 bound on two of four cells; selected and bounded on one split, as our serving run did, it reads 7.3 and serves 2.2 times as many decisions per second on vLLM. The code is open source.

AI.tldr: AnyJev 通过一次 prefill 从指令微调语言模型的下一词分布中读取“类型化决策”，用标签先验校正与选项列表循环旋转平均消除位置偏置，并配合停止规则降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有需要类型化决策（在固定选项集中做概率化选择）的系统依赖专门训练的模型。本文希望无需训练专用模型，直接从预训练指令微调语言模型的一次 prefill 中读出决策，但原始读出存在两类偏置：模型对某些标签无论输入如何都赋予更高概率，以及对选项列表中某些位置赋值更高。
AI.method: AnyJev 将答案位置的下一词分布限制在选项 token 上。为消除偏置，它在不进行梯度更新、不改变参数的前提下：(1) 除以由无标注输入估计得到的标签先验；(2) 对选项列表的 K 个循环旋转分别计算 log 概率并取平均。为降低需 K 次 prefill 的成本，设计停止规则：在无标注状态上依据全旋转决策选择阈值，并在另一无标注划分上约束其不一致率。
AI.result: 在两个 20 选项任务上，旋转平均将 order-flip 率从 0.33 降至 0.14 和从 0.33 降至 0.18，并在 11/11 个模型上提升准确率。停止规则在一个无标注划分上选阈值、在另一个上验证一致性时，四个单元中有两个在 0.008 界内仅读取 18 个旋转中的 10.6 个；在同一划分上选择与约束（如服务运行）时读取 7.3 个旋转，并在 vLLM 上实现每秒 2.2 倍的决策服务吞吐。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练、无需参数更新的 AnyJev 可有效校正标签先验与位置偏置，提高类型化决策的准确率与顺序稳定性，并通过停止规则显著减少旋转 prefill 次数，提升服务效率；代码已开源。

title: TrueMuse: A Benchmark for Data Attribution in Text-to-Music Models
summary: Text-to-music generation models are trained on massive music collections, creating a growing need for data attribution methods that can quantify the contribution of individual training samples. However, existing attribution methods are difficult to rigorously evaluate due to the lack of reliable ground truth, making it challenging to reliably assess their actual effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce TrueMuse, a controlled dataset and benchmark for text-to-music data attribution. TrueMuse is constructed by fine-tuning three diffusion-based text-to-music models on carefully curated attribution samples, whose known inclusion in fine-tuning provides controlled attribution targets for evaluation. The benchmark covers four attribution settings, spanning melodic structure, timbral characteristics, artist-level stylistic signatures, and genre-level shared patterns, and includes 133 attributes, 648 fine-tuned models, and 95,456 generated samples across two prompt types. Using TrueMuse, we systematically evaluate existing black-box attribution methods along four dimensions: fine-tuning improvement, prompt-type difficulty, multi-task training, and fine-tuning data size. Our results show that attribution remains challenging, with existing methods exhibiting substantial variation across evaluation settings, highlighting the need for more reliable and generalizable attribution methods for text-to-music generation. Code and Dataset will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TrueMuse——一个用于文本到音乐生成数据归因的受控数据集与基准，通过微调扩散模型构建已知归属目标，系统评估现有黑盒归因方法。
AI.motivation: 文本到音乐生成模型基于大规模音乐数据训练，亟需量化单个训练样本贡献的数据归因方法；但现有归因方法因缺乏可靠真值（ground truth）而难以严谨评估，其实际有效性无法得到可靠判断。
AI.method: 构建 TrueMuse：在精心策划的归因样本上微调三个基于扩散的文本到音乐模型，利用其已知的微调纳入情况提供受控归因目标。基准覆盖四种归因场景（旋律结构、音色特征、艺术家级风格签名、流派级共享模式），包含 133 个属性、648 个微调模型、95,456 个生成样本及两种提示类型。据此从四个维度（微调提升、提示类型难度、多任务训练、微调数据规模）系统评估现有黑盒归因方法。
AI.result: 结果显示数据归因仍然困难，现有方法在不同评估设置下表现出显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 文本到音乐生成领域仍需更可靠、更具泛化能力的归因方法。代码与数据集将在论文录用后发布。

title: SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD.

AI.tldr: 提出SHARPO，一种段级事后优势重加权机制，在GRPO基础上按环境交互段分配信用，提升LLM智能体长程多步任务表现。
AI.motivation: 智能体强化学习训练LLM进行长程多步交互时，单个局部错误即可导致任务失败，而轨迹级奖励难以为单个决策提供有效的信用分配信号。
AI.method: 受在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）启发，SHARPO在环境面向的"段"级别细化GRPO：在每个段内计算教师-学生对数概率差，据此生成有界乘子作用于GRPO优势，该乘子由段内所有token共享，使信用可在不同段间变化。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，SHARPO在ALFWorld与WebShop基准上优于GRPO、SDAR、RLSD及StepOPSD等现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 段级信用分配可有效弥补轨迹级奖励的不足，SHARPO为智能体RL中的细粒度信用分配提供了可行方案并取得实证优势。

title: Fixing a Model That Learned Worse Cancer Means Lower Risk: Monotonic Constraints in Bladder Cancer Recurrence Prediction
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Supplementary material (15 pages) provided as ancillary files
summary: Background and Objective: Clinicians expect recurrence risk to climb with cancer severity. In a UK multicentre trial, an unconstrained XGBoost model learnt that higher tumour stage and carcinoma in situ predicted lower recurrence risk, and discrimination, calibration, and SHAP were all blind to it. We developed a counterfactual testing framework to detect this inversion and a monotonic-constraint framework to remove it without hurting performance. Methods: BOXIT enrolled 472 patients with protocol-mandated cystoscopy across 51 UK sites (2007-2012); 435 had at least two years' follow-up (153 recurrences, 35.2%). We developed a counterfactual direction test and a monotonic-constraint correction, with constraint directions drawn from the EORTC and EAU risk systems, and evaluated both against unconstrained XGBoost and logistic regression on 18 predictors (seven directed) over 50 cross-validation folds. The test worsened each patient on one directed feature at a time to check whether risk fell; SHAP direction and calibration were also assessed. Key Findings and Limitations: Tumour stage and carcinoma in situ were associated with lower recurrence, opposite to medical intuition; the unconstrained model reversed carcinoma in situ counterfactuals in 90.2% of cases and stage in 74.3%. Discrimination ($Δ$AUC 0.005, p=0.47), calibration, and SHAP magnitude were all blind to the inversion. Monotonic constraints eliminated every violation at no cost to discrimination (0.723 vs 0.718) and outperformed EORTC (p=8.9e-16). Limitations: single trial, internal-external validation only. Conclusions and Clinical Implications: A model that had learned this inversion passed every conventional check. A counterfactual direction test, run as a single refit with pre-specified monotonic constraints, catches this failure at no cost to performance and should be routine before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示无约束XGBoost模型在膀胱癌复发预测中学到了与医学常识相反的结论（分期和原位癌越高，复发风险反而越低），而传统判别力、校准和SHAP检查均无法发现该问题；作者提出反事实方向检验与单调约束修正框架，可在不损失性能的前提下消除此类方向反转。
AI.motivation: 临床医生预期复发风险随肿瘤严重程度上升，但在英国多中心试验中，无约束XGBoost模型却学到了"更高的肿瘤分期和原位癌预测更低的复发风险"这一反向关系。更令人担忧的是，判别力（AUC）、校准和SHAP等常规模型验证手段对此类方向反转均不敏感，导致一个已学到错误临床逻辑的模型能够通过所有传统检查，存在临床部署隐患。
AI.method: 研究基于BOXIT试验，纳入51个英国中心472例患者（2007-2012），其中435例随访满两年（153例复发，35.2%）。作者开发了反事实方向检验：逐个将患者在某一个有向特征上"恶化"，检测模型风险是否随之下降（即方向是否反转）；同时开发单调约束修正框架，约束方向取自EORTC和EAU风险系统。在18个预测变量（其中7个为有向变量）上，用50折交叉验证对比无约束XGBoost与逻辑回归，并辅以SHAP方向与校准评估。
AI.result: 肿瘤分期与原位癌与更低复发风险相关，与医学直觉相反。无约束模型在90.2%的病例中反转了原位癌反事实，在74.3%的病例中反转了分期反事实。而判别力（ΔAUC 0.005，p=0.47）、校准和SHAP幅度均对该反转"视而不见"。应用单调约束后，所有方向违反被完全消除，且判别力无损失（0.723 vs 0.718），并显著优于EORTC（p=8.9e-16）。局限性：仅基于单一试验，且仅做内部-外部验证。
AI.conclusion: 一个学到此临床方向反转的模型能够通过所有常规检查。以单次重拟合方式运行反事实方向检验，并辅以预先设定的单调约束，可在不牺牲性能的情况下捕获此类失效，应作为临床部署前的常规步骤。

title: Rethinking Data Augmentation under Covariate Shift: Invariant-Guided Diffusion and Prototype Reweighting
summary: In many industrial applications, 1) tabular data is scarce and imbalanced and thus requires synthetic expansion; 2) input distributions drift between training and deployment (covariate shift); 3) validation sets often diverge from unseen test environments; or 4) standard generative models simply mimic outdated source distributions. This learning setting limits the stability of standard augmentation and adaptation pipelines. We generalize the task under such setting as the Augmented and Weighted Learning under Covariate Shift problem (AWL-CS). AWL-CS imposes two critical challenges on existing methods: 1) misleading generative guidance where models optimize for source similarity rather than downstream task relevance, and 2) structural instability of distributional density where reweighting mechanisms overfit to noisy validation signals. To tackle these challenges, we propose IGDPR (Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting), a unified framework that synergizes stable synthesis and structural adaptation: i) To achieve task-relevant generation, we steer the diffusion sampling process using invariant potentials to ensure synthetic samples align with stable decision boundaries rather than outdated correlations. ii) To ensure stable adaptation, we develop a prototype-based reweighting strategy that assesses sample reliability through structural clusters instead of isolated points, effectively filtering validation noise. Extensive experiments on real data demonstrate our method improves data quality by augmenting the most beneficial data for robust learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AWL-CS问题设定（面向协变量偏移的增强与加权学习），并给出统一框架IGDPR，通过不变势引导扩散采样与基于原型的重加权，实现任务相关合成与稳定自适应。
AI.motivation: 工业场景中表格数据稀缺且不平衡需合成扩充；训练与部署间存在协变量偏移；验证集常与未见测试环境不一致；标准生成模型仅模仿过时的源分布。这些因素使常规增强与自适应流程不稳定，因此需要一个统一的问题设定与解决方案。
AI.method: 提出IGDPR（Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting）统一框架：i）用不变势引导扩散采样过程，使合成样本对齐稳定决策边界而非过时相关性，实现任务相关生成；ii）采用基于原型（结构簇）的重加权策略，以结构簇而非孤立点评估样本可靠性，过滤验证噪声，实现稳定自适应。
AI.result: 在真实数据上的大量实验表明，该方法通过增强对鲁棒学习最有益的数据提升了数据质量。
AI.conclusion: IGDPR将稳定合成与结构自适应协同起来，针对AWL-CS的两大挑战（误导性生成引导与分布密度的结构不稳定性）给出有效应对，为稀缺、不平衡且分布漂移的表格数据学习提供统一方案。

title: Match the Distribution, Not the Compute: Post-Training Multi-Token Prediction Heads
summary: Multi-token prediction (MTP) improves the throughput of autoregressive generation by enabling the language model to draft multiple next tokens per forward pass, while a verification step over draft tokens ensures that token distribution of the backbone is preserved. Every open MTP-family release (MiMo-7B, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3) trains its heads jointly with the backbone over the full pretraining run of tens of trillions of tokens, thus setting the drafter quality at pretraining time. We ask whether a lightweight post-training pass on target-generated chain-of-thought is enough to reach the same expected throughput speedup on a frozen reasoning model, and study how a serving-time system built on such a checkpoint can be optimized. We present three findings. 1) On a frozen Qwen3-8B with $K{=}3$ chained MTP heads, we show that a post-training recipe with plain cross-entropy on $\approx\!2.5$B tokens reaches or exceeds the expected speedup of jointly trained MiMo-7B on math, coding and knowledge benchmarks. Our post-training recipe utilizes $10^3$-$10^4\times$ less MTP-training tokens as compared with joint pre-training of MiMO-7B MTP baseline. 2) We propose a chain-aware relaxation of draft token verification rule that allows a bounded drift from backbone language model token distribution. We show that this relaxation lifts expected speedups by $+12$ to $+16\%$ per benchmark while preserving task accuracy. 3) We propose an adaptive controller that dynamically chooses the number of MTP heads to be engaged at inference time and demonstrate recovery of upto $11$--$14\%$ loss in speedup using fixed maximum MTP draft length.

AI.tldr: 在冻结的推理模型上，仅需对目标生成的思维链做轻量后训练即可获得与联合预训练相当的MTP加速；提出的链感知验证松弛与自适应头控制器进一步显著提升期望加速比。
AI.motivation: 现有开源MTP模型（MiMo-7B、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3）均需在数万亿token的完整预训练中联合训练草稿头，草稿器质量在预训练阶段即被固定，代价高昂。作者希望探究：对已冻结的推理模型，是否只需一次轻量后训练即可达到同等吞吐加速，并优化基于该checkpoint的服务系统。
AI.method: 1) 在冻结Qwen3-8B上配置K=3链式MTP头，用约25亿token的目标生成思维链做普通交叉熵后训练；2) 提出链感知的草稿token验证松弛规则，允许相对骨干语言模型token分布的有界漂移；3) 提出自适应控制器，在推理时动态选择启用的MTP头数量。
AI.result: 1) 后训练配方在数学、代码与知识基准上达到或超过联合训练的MiMo-7B期望加速，且MTP训练token量比MiMo-7B联合预训练少10^3–10^4倍；2) 验证松弛使各基准期望加速提升+12%至+16%，同时保持任务准确率；3) 自适应控制器在固定最大MTP草稿长度下，最多挽回11%–14%的加速损失。
AI.conclusion: 对冻结推理模型而言，轻量后训练MTP头是以极低token成本获得高吞吐草稿的有效途径；链感知验证松弛与推理时自适应头选择可进一步放大服务端加速收益且不损失精度，为MTP在部署阶段的应用提供了实用方案。

title: Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks
summary: Coding agents often fail in the last mile: they build most of a feature but drop a requirement, test only the cases their implementation already handles, break behavior that was supposed to stay intact, or validate against an unchecked assumption. We ask whether reinforcement learning (RL) on expert-built agentic coding tasks closes this gap, and whether what the agent learns transfers beyond the training distribution. We post-train Kimi K2.7 Code, a 1T-parameter (32B active) open-weight mixture-of-experts model, with RL alone on 1,700 tasks: 1,000 repository tasks graded by hidden fail-to-pass tests and by pass-to-pass tests of existing behavior, and 700 terminal tasks graded by expert-written hidden verifiers. The reward is the fraction of target checks passed and drops to zero if any pass-to-pass test fails. One epoch of GSPO on a rank-32 LoRA adapter improves pass@1 on each of the six external benchmarks we evaluated, across three agent harnesses: SWE-Bench Pro (60.1 to 64.8), DeepSWE (31.0 to 43.4), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (67.4 to 82.0), Terminal-Bench 3 (1.4 to 12.1), Terminal-Bench 4 (0.0 to 7.6), and SWE-Marathon (5.0 to 25.0). Pooled over the five independent task sets (Terminal-Bench 4 revises Terminal-Bench 3), the improvement is significant (p < 0.001), and it remains significant on the three sets released after the training data was collected (p = 0.004); the model also improves under both harnesses never used in training. Median trajectories on DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench 3 are 24-35% shorter in agent steps. The base model's failed DeepSWE runs are mostly near-misses, and on the tasks the trained model newly solves, paired trajectories show it avoiding each of the four failure modes above.

AI.tldr: 仅用强化学习在1,700个专家构建的代码智能体任务上对Kimi K2.7 Code（1T参数MoE，32B激活）进行后训练，一个epoch的GSPO（rank-32 LoRA）在六个外部基准、三种harness上均提升pass@1，且在训练数据之后发布的基准、以及训练未用过的harness上依然显著提升，轨迹步数更短，新解出任务的配对轨迹显示模型规避了四类失败模式。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体常止步于"最后一公里"：功能大体建成却遗漏需求、只测试自身实现已覆盖的情形、破坏本应保持不变的行为、依据未经检验的假设做验证。论文追问：在专家构建的智能体编码任务上做强化学习能否弥合这一差距，且所学能否迁移到训练分布之外。
AI.method: 以RL单独对Kimi K2.7 Code（1T参数、32B激活的开源权重MoE）进行后训练，训练集为1,700个任务：1,000个代码库任务，由隐藏的fail-to-pass测试与检验既有行为的pass-to-pass测试评分；700个终端任务，由专家编写的隐藏验证器评分。奖励为目标检查通过比例，若任一pass-to-pass测试失败则归零。采用rank-32 LoRA适配器上的GSPO训练一个epoch。
AI.result: 六个外部基准、三种智能体harness上pass@1均提升：SWE-Bench Pro 60.1→64.8，DeepSWE 31.0→43.4，Terminal-Bench 2.1 67.4→82.0，Terminal-Bench 3 1.4→12.1，Terminal-Bench 4 0.0→7.6，SWE-Marathon 5.0→25.0。五个独立任务集（Terminal-Bench 4替代Terminal-Bench 3）汇总提升显著（p < 0.001），在训练数据收集后发布的三个集合上仍显著（p = 0.004），在训练中未使用的两种harness下同样提升。DeepSWE与Terminal-Bench 3的中位轨迹智能体步数缩短24–35%。
AI.conclusion: 纯RL后训练可有效弥合编码智能体的"最后一公里"差距，其收益不仅在分布内显著，还能迁移到训练后发布的新基准与未见过的harness，并伴随更高效的轨迹；配对轨迹分析显示模型在新解出任务上规避了原先的四类失败模式。

title: Clock Diffusion: Efficient Semi-Autoregressive Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Recent works on continuous diffusion for discrete data have demonstrated performance on par with comparable discrete diffusion models. However, these continuous counterparts lack key features that are essential to practical use as language models, namely variable-length generation and support for a key-value cache, and they still lag behind the frontier of autoregressive and discrete diffusion quality. In this work, we address these limitations. We do so by introducing a model parameterization that uses position-dependent noise schedules to define semi-autoregressive (SAR) continuous diffusion language models (DLMs). Together with efficient training and sampling algorithms, we call this framework Clock Diffusion, and we present two special cases of our method: block and sliding window generation. We then define ClockDLMs, a family of Gaussian DLMs based on sliding window Clock Diffusion that attain state-of-the-art diffusion likelihood bounds on OpenWebText, even beating the performant block SAR discrete diffusion models. ClockDLMs trained on TinyGSM also substantially outperform continuous baselines on the GSM8K benchmark and match and exceed comparable SAR discrete diffusion models. Finally, building on our parameterization, we propose more efficient samplers that we dub Cache Grab, which adapt techniques from accelerated inference in discrete diffusion, such as committing tokens whose probabilities exceed a confidence threshold and self-speculative decoding, further improving our models' quality and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 Clock Diffusion 框架，通过位置相关噪声调度实现半自回归连续扩散语言模型，支持变长生成与 KV 缓存，在 OpenWebText 与 GSM8K 上达到最优扩散似然界。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散模型在离散数据上性能可与离散扩散模型相媲美，但缺失作为实用语言模型的关键特性：变长生成与键值（KV）缓存支持，且整体质量仍落后于自回归模型和前沿离散扩散模型。本文旨在弥补这些缺陷。
AI.method: 引入一种使用位置相关噪声调度（position-dependent noise schedules）的模型参数化方法，定义半自回归（SAR）连续扩散语言模型；配合高效训练与采样算法，形成 Clock Diffusion 框架，并给出块（block）与滑动窗口（sliding window）两种特例。基于滑动窗口特例构建 ClockDLMs 高斯扩散语言模型。此外提出 Cache Grab 采样器，借鉴离散扩散加速推理技术，如对概率超过置信阈值的 token 进行确定提交（committing tokens）以及自推测解码（self-speculative decoding）。
AI.result: ClockDLMs 在 OpenWebText 上取得最优扩散似然界，甚至优于高性能的块半自回归离散扩散模型；在 TinyGSM 上训练后在 GSM8K 基准上大幅超越连续基线，并匹配甚至超过可比的 SAR 离散扩散模型。Cache Grab 采样器进一步提升了生成质量与效率。
AI.conclusion: 位置相关噪声调度的半自回归参数化使连续扩散语言模型具备变长生成与 KV 缓存能力，同时达到或超过离散扩散基线的质量；结合高效采样策略可进一步改善质量与推理效率。

title: When Do Biological Reasoning Models Use Their Biological Inputs?
summary: Biological reasoning models use post-training to connect LLMs to biological foundation model representations and biological text. Their benchmark accuracy is taken as evidence that LLMs reason over these inputs. We test this assumption in six biological reasoning models across DNA, protein, and single-cell tasks. We perturb one biological input while holding the query and other inputs fixed, construct evidence conflicts that pair the foundation model representation of one genome, protein, or cell with the text of another, fit linear probes to the representations the language model receives, and analyze reasoning traces against the biological inputs. Evo2 and ESM3 contribute little to BioReason and BioReason-Pro performance on the evaluated tasks. Shuffling the DNA sequence barely changes BioReason disease prediction accuracy, and in evidence conflicts the two models follow the text in 97.9% and 99.7% of cases. Linear probes trained on the Evo2 and ESM3 representations predict the task targets, so these foundation models encode information relevant to the task, but provide limited overall performance improvement to BioReason and BioReason-Pro. In contrast, foundation model inputs contribute to ChatNT, Prot2Text-V2, and CellWhisperer performance, and differentially expressed genes in the gene sentence contribute to Cell2Sentence-Scale performance. Across SFT and RL checkpoints of BioReason-Pro and 42 BioReason checkpoints, increases in accuracy do not imply greater performance contributions from biological inputs. BioReason traces misstate nucleotide changes, while BioReason-Pro traces describe functions omitted from final predictions under evidence conflicts. We find that current post-training strategies do not ensure that foundation model representations contribute to task performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验"生物推理模型的高基准准确率意味着其真正利用了生物基础模型表征"这一假设，发现多数模型的性能提升并不依赖于生物输入，后训练策略无法保证基础模型表征对任务性能有实质贡献。
AI.motivation: 生物推理模型通过后训练将LLM与生物基础模型表征及生物文本相连接，研究者常以其基准测试准确率作为LLM能够对这些输入进行推理的证据。然而这一假设从未被严格验证：高准确率可能来自文本线索或任务捷径，而非对生物表征的真正利用。因此需要系统地检验生物输入到底对模型性能贡献了多少。
AI.method: 作者在DNA、蛋白质和单细胞三类任务上测试了六个生物推理模型。采用多种扰动与归因手段：（1）固定查询和其他输入，仅扰动某一生物输入；（2）构造证据冲突，将某基因组/蛋白质/细胞的基座模型表征与另一实体的文本配对；（3）对语言模型接收到的表征拟合线性探针；（4）结合推理轨迹与生物输入进行对照分析。此外还对比了BioReason-Pro的SFT与RL检查点以及42个BioReason检查点。
AI.result: Evo2和ESM3对BioReason与BioReason-Pro在所评任务上的性能贡献很小：打乱DNA序列几乎不改变BioReason的疾病预测准确率，在证据冲突中两模型分别有97.9%和99.7%的情况跟随文本而非生物表征。尽管线性探针表明Evo2/ESM3表征确实编码了任务相关信息，但对BioReason和BioReason-Pro的整体性能提升有限。相反，基础模型输入对ChatNT、Prot2Text-V2和CellWhisperer的性能有贡献，基因句子中的差异表达基因对Cell2Sentence-Scale有贡献。跨检查点分析显示准确率提升并不意味着生物输入贡献增大。推理轨迹上，BioReason误述核苷酸变化，BioReason-Pro在证据冲突下描述的功能被最终预测所遗漏。
AI.conclusion: 当前的后训练策略并不能保证生物基础模型表征对任务性能产生实质贡献；基准准确率不足以证明模型真正在生物输入上进行推理。评估生物推理模型时应采用扰动、证据冲突和探针等归因方法，而非仅依赖准确率。

title: Sharpen Before You Adapt: Data-Free Entry-State Sharpening for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts language models on unlabeled test problems using supervision derived from their own samples. This makes the checkpoint's \emph{entry state} consequential: a diffuse policy provides noisier self-supervision and may spend much of a limited adaptation budget merely concentrating probability mass before reliably expressing capability it already possesses. We propose \textbf{entry-state sharpening}: use data-free training \emph{before} TTRL to prepare a general-purpose checkpoint in a state that subsequent label-free adaptation can exploit more efficiently. The idea is not tied to one training recipe; different data-free objectives can move the same base model to different entry states. Across five data-free checkpoints derived from Qwen3-4B and evaluated under an identical 15-step TTRL protocol, entry policy entropy strongly rank-orders endpoint conversion efficiency, a reliability-to-reachability measure (Spearman $ρ=-0.90$; $ρ=-0.99$ after controlling for entry reachability). The contrast across objectives is striking: R-Zero remains diffuse at $3.39$ nats and finishes below the untuned base in 6/6 matched comparisons across MATH, GPQA, and AMC, whereas SPIRAL reaches $0.07$ nats and achieves the highest post-TTRL accuracy on MATH and GPQA despite its self-play stage using no math training data. An in-domain label-free self-distillation intervention further shows that the entry state can be deliberately sharpened. These results motivate treating checkpoint preparation as a \emph{state-control problem}: use data-free training to improve TTRL readiness, with entry entropy as a label-free control signal and reachable capability as the constraint.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"入口状态锐化"（entry-state sharpening）这一理念：在测试时强化学习（TTRL）之前，先用无数据训练把通用检查点调整到更易被后续无标签自适应利用的状态，并把检查点准备视为"状态控制问题"，以入口策略熵作为无标签控制信号、以可达能力为约束。
AI.motivation: TTRL 依赖模型自采样产生监督信号来适配无标签测试题，因此检查点的"入口状态"至关重要：策略分布越弥散，自监督越嘈杂，有限的适配预算会大量消耗在把概率质量集中起来，而非表达模型本身已具备的能力。因此需要一种在 TTRL 之前就准备好有利入口状态的方法。
AI.method: 提出 entry-state sharpening：在 TTRL 之前使用无数据（data-free）训练，把通用检查点预备成后续无标签适配更高效的状态；该思路不绑定单一训练配方，不同无数据目标可将同一基座模型推到不同入口状态。实验基于 Qwen3-4B 衍生出五个无数据检查点，在完全相同的 15 步 TTRL 协议下评测，以入口策略熵刻画入口状态，并比较不同目标（如 R-Zero 与 SPIRAL）的差异；另加入域内无标签自蒸馏干预以验证入口状态可被刻意锐化。
AI.result: 入口策略熵与终点转换效率（reliability-to-reachability 指标）高度负相关：Spearman ρ=-0.90；控制入口可达性后 ρ=-0.99。目标间对比显著：R-Zero 仍保持弥散（3.39 nats），在 MATH、GPQA、AMC 上的 6/6 配对比较中均低于未调优基座；SPIRAL 则达到 0.07 nats，尽管其自博弈阶段未使用任何数学训练数据，仍在 MATH 与 GPQA 上取得 TTRL 后最高准确率。域内无标签自蒸馏干预进一步表明入口状态可被刻意锐化。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将检查点准备视为一个"状态控制问题"：用无数据训练提升 TTRL 的就绪度，以入口熵作为无标签控制信号，并以可达能力作为约束条件。

title: Rate-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Linear CMDPs
summary: We study episodic adversarial linear constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs) with unknown transitions, where both the loss and constraint functions may vary adversarially across episodes. The best previous algorithm achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K^{3/4})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation, leaving a gap to the optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ dependence on the number of episodes $K$. We close this gap by proposing a new primal dual algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation without assuming Slater's condition. The main challenge is that learning linear CMDPs requires uniform concentration over a value function class with a controlled covering number, whereas standard techniques in constrained online learning, such as policy mixing, can make this class more complex. Our algorithm combines adaptive Follow the Regularized Leader (FTRL), contracted value estimation, and an exponential Lyapunov function. An adaptive dual regularizer offsets the dependence on the dual weights in the primal regret bound, removing the need for policy mixing. We further show that the normalization in the FTRL update bounds the policy parameters independently of the magnitudes of the dual weights, which explains why the resulting policy class remains compatible with uniform concentration. Under feature access, the computational complexity is independent of the size of the state space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究未知转移的情节式对抗线性约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），提出新的原始-对偶算法，首次在不假设Slater条件的情况下将累积遗憾和累积约束违反同时降至$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$，闭合了与最优界之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有最优算法仅达到$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K^{3/4})$的遗憾与累积约束违反，与理论最优的$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$存在差距。主要技术障碍在于：学习线性CMDP需要对取值函数类做一致集中，而约束在线学习中的策略混合等标准技巧会使该函数类复杂化，从而破坏集中的可控覆盖数。
AI.method: 提出一种新的原始-对偶算法，结合自适应Follow the Regularized Leader（FTRL）、收缩价值估计（contracted value estimation）与指数Lyapunov函数。核心是用自适应对偶正则项抵消原始遗憾界中对对偶权重的依赖，从而避免策略混合；同时证明FTRL更新中的归一化可使策略参数独立于对偶权重幅度，使所得策略类与一致集中保持兼容。
AI.result: 在不假设Slater条件的情况下，同时实现$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$的遗憾与累积约束违反，达到最优的$K$依赖阶；并证明归一化保证了策略参数独立于对偶权重幅度，使策略类保持可控覆盖数。在特征访问模型下，计算复杂度与状态空间大小无关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作闭合了对抗线性CMDP中$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K^{3/4})$与最优$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$之间的差距，无需Slater条件，且通过自适应对偶正则化规避策略混合带来的函数类复杂化问题；在特征访问下计算复杂度不依赖状态空间规模。

title: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
summary: The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. We introduce GUI-HARVEST, an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models. First, to ground diagnosis in observed action effects, it aligns model outputs and executed actions with before-and-after screenshots, tying findings to specific interface transitions. Second, to account for execution variability, it treats repeated runs of the same task as a joint evidence unit, using within-task comparisons to locate outcome-relevant behavioral differences. Third, it consolidates verified findings across tasks into recurring failure patterns, maps them to bounded source-code edits with predictions recorded before evaluation, and checks the predicted behavioral effects alongside task performance through repeated execution. Experiments on OSWorld-Verified show consistent held-out gains across six general-purpose open, GUI-specialized open, and proprietary backbone models; Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct gains 12.33 points on the full suite. Frozen-harness transfer improves GPT-5 by 13.87 percentage points on WindowsAgentArena at 50 steps without further optimization. With the same backbone and initial harness, GUI-HARVEST outperforms Self-Harness and Meta-Harness, suggesting that GUI-specific diagnosis and validation help harness improvements generalize to unseen tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/GaryYang12345/GUI-HARVEST.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GUI-HARVEST，一种面向 GUI 智能体的自动 harness 优化器，可在冻结骨干模型的前提下实现自我改进，并在 OSWorld-Verified 等基准上取得一致的留出集性能提升。
AI.motivation: GUI 模型的可执行 harness 决定了观测组装、动作执行以及验证、恢复与终止的控制方式。与非 GUI 智能体的 harness 优化相比，自动优化 GUI harness 面临三个耦合挑战：协调模型意图与观测到的视觉效果、在可变执行结果下诊断失败、以及跨任务识别可复现的失败模式并转化为可复用的运行时改动。
AI.method: GUI-HARVEST 包含三项关键设计：第一，将模型输出与执行动作对齐到动作前后截图，使诊断锚定于具体的界面状态转移；第二，将同一任务的多次重复运行视为联合证据单元，通过任务内比较定位与结果相关的行为差异；第三，将跨任务验证过的发现整合为可复现失败模式，映射为有界的源码编辑，并在评估前记录预测，通过重复执行同时检验预测的行为效果与任务性能。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld-Verified 上，六种通用开源、GUI 专用开源及专有骨干模型均取得一致的留出集提升；Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 在全套件上提升 12.33 分。冻结 harness 的迁移使 GPT-5 在 WindowsAgentArena 上 50 步设置下提升 13.87 个百分点，且无需进一步优化。在相同骨干与初始 harness 下，GUI-HARVEST 优于 Self-Harness 与 Meta-Harness。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，GUI 专用的诊断与验证机制有助于 harness 改进泛化到未见任务，验证了在不更新骨干模型权重的前提下通过自动优化外围 harness 提升 GUI 智能体性能的可行性。

title: Structure-agnostic Causal Representation Learning
summary: Causal representation learning aims to discover robust features by exploiting the causal structure underlying data generation. Existing methods require specifying the causal structure a priori, yet different structures demand fundamentally incompatible invariance constraints, and misspecification leads to representations that discard predictive information. We introduce SaCRL, a framework that jointly identifies the causal structure and learns the corresponding invariant representation without prior structural knowledge. Our approach formulates structure selection as a soft optimization over candidate invariances using HSIC-based violation metrics, with adaptive weights that automatically concentrate on the achievable structure. We provide theoretical guarantees for structure identification, including under random-feature approximation, invariance satisfaction, and out-of-distribution generalization. Empirically, SaCRL recovers the true structure on synthetic and semi-synthetic Bayesian-network benchmarks, outperforms fixed-invariance baselines on Colored MNIST, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on three DomainBed benchmarks (PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome), and degrades gracefully under structural misspecification and limited environment diversity. Code is available at: https://github.com/ArmanBehnam/sacrl.

AI.tldr: SaCRL 将因果结构选择建模为基于 HSIC 违规度量的软优化问题，在无先验结构知识条件下联合识别因果结构并学习不变表示，兼具理论保证与多基准实验优势。
AI.motivation: 现有因果表示学习方法需预先指定因果结构，而不同结构要求本质上互不兼容的不变性约束；结构设定错误会导致表示丢弃预测性信息。因此需要一种无需先验结构知识、能同时确定结构并学习对应不变表示的方法。
AI.method: 提出 SaCRL 框架：把结构选择表述为对候选不变性集合的软优化，使用基于 HSIC 的违规度量来评估各候选不变性，并采用自适应权重使优化过程自动聚焦于可实现的结构；由此联合完成结构识别与不变表示学习。
AI.result: 理论上给出结构可识别性保证，包括随机特征近似下的保证、不变性满足性以及分布外泛化保证。实验上，在合成与半合成贝叶斯网络基准上恢复真实结构；在 Colored MNIST 上优于固定不变性基线；在 PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome 三个 DomainBed 基准上取得最优精度；在结构误设与环境多样性受限时性能平滑退化。
AI.conclusion: SaCRL 表明无需先验因果结构即可联合实现结构识别与不变表示学习，在理论保证与跨域泛化实验上均具优势，并对结构误设与环境多样性不足具有鲁棒性。

title: Variational Streaming Flow: Probabilistic Forecasting in Physical Time
summary: Probabilistic forecasting is important for predicting complex dynamical systems because intrinsic randomness and incomplete observations can cause the same observed state to evolve into multiple plausible futures. While flow matching is a flexible approach for probabilistic forecasting, it is computationally expensive. Streaming flow (SF) reformulates this approach to model temporal evolution efficiently by learning a continuous velocity field directly in physical time. However, SF learns a deterministic velocity field. Thus, it provides only a single future trajectory for a given fixed initial state and observation history. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Variational Streaming Flow (VSF). Our approach learns a latent distribution that is conditioned on the dynamics of interest. In turn, this enables probabilistic forecasting. Importantly, we retain the computational efficiency of SF by generating in physical time. Across deterministic and stochastic dynamical systems, VSF demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and distributional fidelity. We demonstrate the advantage for both long-horizon rollouts exceeding 1,000 steps, and settings with bifurcating dynamics. Moreover, VSF can be integrated into existing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-based world models as a plug-and-play predictor to improve temporal dynamics and goal-directed success rate in navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出变分流匹配方法VSF，通过在物理时间上学习条件潜在分布，实现高效概率性预测，保留SF计算效率的同时提升预测精度与分布保真度。
AI.motivation: 概率性预测对复杂动力系统很重要，因为内在随机性和观测不完整会导致同一观测状态演化出多种可能未来。流匹配虽灵活但计算昂贵；Streaming Flow（SF）虽在物理时间上高效建模，但学习的是确定性速度场，对固定初始状态和历史仅给出单一未来轨迹，无法进行概率性预测。
AI.method: 提出Variational Streaming Flow（VSF），学习一个以所关注动力学为条件的潜在分布，从而在物理时间上生成实现概率性预测，同时保留SF的计算效率。
AI.result: 在确定性和随机动力系统上，VSF在预测精度和分布保真度上均优于基线；在超过1000步的长时程推演和分叉动力学场景中展现优势，并可作为即插即用预测器集成到基于JEPA的世界模型中，提升导航、运动规划与操作中的时间动力学和目标导向成功率。
AI.conclusion: VSF通过引入条件潜在分布，将高效的物理时间流式建模扩展为概率性预测，兼顾计算效率与预测质量，并具备良好的通用集成性。

title: Generalist Representation, Specialist Detection: TS-Router for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is difficult to generalize across datasets because heterogeneous temporal dynamics imply different notions of normality and favor different detection criteria. While time-series foundation models provide transferable representations, coupling them with a fixed anomaly-scoring mechanism can overlook this variation. This motivates a different perspective on foundation-model-based TSAD: using foundation models to coordinate specialized anomaly criteria rather than directly imposing a universal one. Based on this view, we propose \textbf{TS-Router}, a generalist-representation, specialist-detection framework that estimates the relative competence of heterogeneous anomaly detectors from pretrained temporal representations and selects suitable specialists for each target series. To avoid relying on specialist-performance labels from real tasks, we derive soft competence supervision from specialists' relative performance on labeled simulated tasks. At deployment, routing requires no target anomaly labels, and only the selected specialists are fitted unsupervisedly on the target series. We bound Top-\(k\) set-competence regret under representation coverage and conditional competence stability. Across 16 real-world benchmarks and four complementary evaluation metrics, TS-Router achieves the best overall average rank. Controlled ablations with multiple frozen TSFM encoders further support the use of pretrained representations for competence estimation and adaptive specialist selection. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TS-Router-D8FF.

AI.tldr: 提出TS-Router框架，用预训练时序基础模型表征估计异构异常检测器的相对能力并路由选择专家，实现跨数据集泛化。
AI.motivation: TSAD跨数据集泛化困难：异构时序动态导致"正常"定义与检测准则不同；现有基础模型方法搭配固定异常打分机制，忽略了这种差异性。
AI.method: 将基础模型用于协调多种专用异常检测准则而非强加统一准则；从预训练时序表征估计异构检测器的相对胜任度，为每条目标序列选择合适专家；利用专家在带标签模拟任务上的相对表现构造软胜任度监督，避免依赖真实任务标签；部署时无需目标异常标签，仅对选中专家在目标序列上无监督拟合；在表征覆盖与条件胜任度稳定性假设下给出了Top-k集合胜任度悔界的界。
AI.result: 在16个真实基准和四个互补评价指标上取得最佳总体平均排名；使用多个冻结TSFM编码器的受控消融进一步支持预训练表征用于胜任度估计与自适应专家选择的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型在TSAD中的角色应从"统一打分器"转为"专家路由协调器"，从而以通用表征+专用检测实现跨数据集泛化。

title: HADRec: A Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation Framework by Fusing Molecular Knowledge and Electronic Health Record
summary: Accurate medication recommendation is central to clinical decision-making, directly determining therapeutic efficacy and patient safety. However, existing methods suffer from two key limitations: drugs are often abstracted as discrete tokens, ignoring their molecular structures and pharmacological mechanisms, and the commonly used "flat" recommendation paradigm fails to leverage the hierarchical logic of the internationally standardized Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification system. To address these issues, we propose HADRec, a Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation framework that integrates molecular knowledge with electronic health records (EHRs). HADRec employs LLaMA-7B to encode clinical notes for rich patient representations and ChemBERTa to encode drug Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System strings, building a global molecular knowledge base. A cross-attention mechanism then performs deep multimodal fusion between patient states and drug features. The framework further incorporates a hierarchical predictor and a novel consistency constraint loss to enforce strict adherence to ATC logical dependencies. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III demonstrate that HADRec achieves state-of-the-art performance across Jaccard, F1, and PR-AUC. External validation on MIMIC-IV confirms strong generalization under distribution shifts, and calibration analysis shows well-calibrated predictive confidence on MIMIC-IV with ECE = 0.04, and Brier = 0.06. Counterfactual evaluation reveals clinically aligned reasoning, disentangling disease-specific treatments from general care. Together, these results establish HADRec as a high-performance, interpretable, and clinically grounded pathway toward safe and reliable AI-driven medication recommendation.

AI.tldr: HADRec：融合分子知识与ATC层级结构的药物推荐框架，在MIMIC-III/IV上达到SOTA，并具备良好校准与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有药物推荐方法存在两点不足：一是将药物抽象为离散token，忽略分子结构与药理机制；二是采用"扁平"推荐范式，未利用国际标准ATC分类体系的层级逻辑。因此需要同时引入分子知识与层级约束以提升推荐的准确性、可解释性与安全性。
AI.method: 提出HADRec层级感知药物推荐框架：用LLaMA-7B编码临床笔记以获得患者表示，用ChemBERTa编码药物SMILES字符串构建全局分子知识库；通过交叉注意力机制实现患者状态与药物特征的深度多模态融合；引入层级预测器与新颖的一致性约束损失，强制遵循ATC逻辑依赖关系。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III上，Jaccard、F1与PR-AUC均达到SOTA；在MIMIC-IV上外部验证显示在分布偏移下泛化良好；校准分析表明预测置信度校准良好（ECE=0.04，Brier=0.06）；反事实评估显示推理与临床一致，可将疾病特异性治疗与常规护理解耦。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明HADRec是一种高性能、可解释且具临床依据的药物推荐路径，有助于实现安全可靠的AI驱动用药推荐。

title: Neural scaling laws and evolution of learnable activation functions of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures. Supplementary Notes will be provided in the published version
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a compelling alternative to traditional Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)-based neural networks. By employing activation functions as learnable elements, KANs offer superior interpretability, making them suited for scientific domains. In this work, we investigate the neural scaling laws of KANs and the structural evolution of their learnable activation functions under dataset expansion. Specifically, we evaluate the scaling behavior of three KAN variants---BSRBF-KAN, Gottlieb-KAN, and Faster-KAN---across standard image classification benchmarks (MNIST and Fashion-MNIST) and a specialized scientific regression task (magnetic parameter estimation from domain images of moiré magnetic textures). Our results demonstrate that the test loss ${\cal L}$ exhibits a broken neural scaling law (BNSL) behavior as a function of the dataset size $N_D$. After passing through a random-guess regime, the loss follows architecture- and task-dependent scaling behavior. The loss crosses from a faster- to a slower-scaling branch, ${\cal L}\propto N_D^{-α}$ and ${\cal L}\propto N_D^{-β}$ with $α>β$ for image classification tasks. The exponents $α$ and $β$ depend strongly on both the specific network architecture and the dataset-size regime, ranging from 0.4 to 1.5 and from 0.06 to 0.6, respectively. For the magnetic parameter-regression task, the loss follows a single scaling law with its exponent ranging from 1.28 to 2.59. Additionally, we provide a structural analysis of how activation functions refine their complexity as data volume increases, finding that dataset expansion drives a transition from simple linear-like approximations toward stable, interpretable symbolic forms. These findings provide a quantitative roadmap for the efficient application of KANs while managing the trade-off between model expressivity and computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文研究KAN（Kolmogorov-Arnold网络）的神经缩放律及可学习激活函数在数据集扩张下的结构演化，发现测试损失随数据量呈"破缺神经缩放律"行为，且数据量增大促使激活函数从线性近似过渡到稳定可解释的符号形式。
AI.motivation: KAN以可学习激活函数替代传统MLP，具有更强的可解释性，适合科学领域。但其神经缩放律及激活函数随数据规模扩张的结构演化尚不明确，限制了其高效应用。
AI.method: 评估三种KAN变体（BSRBF-KAN、Gottlieb-KAN、Faster-KAN），在标准图像分类基准（MNIST、Fashion-MNIST）与专门科学回归任务（穆尔磁纹理图像的磁参数估计）上考察其缩放行为；并对激活函数随数据量增加的结构复杂度进行结构分析。
AI.result: 测试损失L随数据量N_D呈破缺神经缩放律（BNSL）：经过随机猜测区后，损失遵循依赖架构与任务的缩放行为。图像分类任务中损失从快缩放支路过渡到慢缩放支路，L∝N_D^{-α}与L∝N_D^{-β}且α>β，指数α在0.4–1.5、β在0.06–0.6之间，强烈依赖网络架构与数据规模区间。磁参数回归任务则遵循单一缩放律，指数介于1.28–2.59。激活函数随数据量增大从简单线性近似过渡为稳定、可解释的符号形式。
AI.conclusion: KAN的缩放行为呈架构与任务依赖的破缺缩放律，且数据扩张驱动激活函数向稳定符号形式演化，为KAN的高效应用及表达能力与计算开销的权衡提供了量化路线图。

title: Auditable Algebraic Counting Field for Cryptic-Pocket Detection from Apo Structures
comment: Accepted for publication in Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB) 2027
summary: Cryptic ligand-binding pockets are not apparent in experimentally determined apo structures, making them difficult to identify from unbound receptor geometry. A complementary challenge is to make the structural measurements and learned evidence behind each prediction directly inspectable. We introduce a supervised algebraic counting field (ACF) for predicting cryptic-pocket residues from apo structures. ACF compiles explicit geometric, physicochemical, and topological features into compact, integer-weighted lookup tables. Each prediction score can be reconstructed from feature values, training counts, table weights, and spatial aggregation, without sequence search, structural-template transfer, or a protein language model at inference. We evaluate ACF on CryptoBench and two locked external collections, separating ranking performance from the effects of residue-calling budgets. On an external set of 57 post-CryptoBench apo-holo units, ACF exceeded P2Rank by +0.044 in mean paired ROC-AUC (multiplicity-adjusted 95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]). The advantage was dataset-dependent: official-fold ROC-AUC and matched-budget F1 differences against P2Rank remained unresolved, and a second external evaluation did not confirm gains from added structural features. ACF thus provides a compact predictor with externally validated signal and an inspectable path from structural measurements and training counts to residue scores.

AI.tldr: 提出监督式代数计数场（ACF）从apo结构预测隐式口袋残基，通过整数权重查找表实现可解释预测，在外部集上ROC-AUC优于P2Rank但增益随数据集变化。
AI.motivation: 隐式配体结合口袋在实验测定的apo结构中不可见，仅凭未结合受体几何难以识别；同时现有预测方法缺乏可检验性，难以直接审查每个预测所依据的结构测量与学习证据。
AI.method: ACF将显式的几何、理化与拓扑特征编译为紧凑的整数加权查找表，预测分数可由特征值、训练计数、表权重与空间聚合重构，推理阶段无需序列搜索、结构模板迁移或蛋白质语言模型；在CryptoBench及两个锁定外部集上评估，并将排序性能与残基判定预算的影响分离。
