AI.result: 在57个post-CryptoBench apo-holo单元的外部集上，ACF的平均配对ROC-AUC较P2Rank高+0.044（多重性校正95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]）；但优势依赖数据集：官方折ROC-AUC与匹配预算F1的差异未达显著，第二次外部评估未证实新增结构特征带来增益。
AI.conclusion: ACF提供了一个紧凑、具有外部验证信号的预测器，并给出从结构测量与训练计数到残基分数的可审查路径，但其相对优势受数据集影响，附加结构特征的增益尚需进一步验证。

title: Adapter Thickets: Splitting an RLVR Budget Beats Concentrating It
summary: Majority voting over sampled completions is the workhorse of test-time scaling, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is the workhorse for making each completion better. The standard pipeline composes the two: train one policy with RLVR, then sample it many times and vote. We show that this composition is lossy. A vote can only overturn mistakes that its voters do not share, and RLVR sharpens a policy so that its samples increasingly make the same mistakes. With every method drawing exactly $160$ completions per problem, training a single LoRA adapter on the full RLVR budget raises single-sample accuracy on every model we test ($1.5$B-$8$B). Yet on three of four models it leaves the majority vote below that of the untrained base model, by up to $4.8$ points. The damage builds during training: voter errors grow steadily more correlated, and the majority vote accuracy peaks early before falling by up to $7.0$ points. The cause is concentration, not RLVR itself. We split the same data and training budget across $K$ LoRA adapters, each trained on its own random disjoint shard, and call the result an adapter thicket. Thickets out-vote the fully trained adapter in all $16$ (model, $K$) settings, and for $K{\geq}4$ they stay within $0.8$ points of the base model or above it. A single adapter stopped early, at a thicket member's step count, is a strong control that matches thickets for small $K$. For $K{\geq}8$, thickets keep more of RLVR's single-sample gain and out-vote this control in six of eight settings. The cost of concentration also grows with the number of votes: from $16$ to $160$ votes, the thicket's lead over the fully trained adapter widens from $1.3$ to $3.3$ points. When the plan is to sample and vote, an RLVR budget is better spent broad than deep.

AI.tldr: 将RLVR训练预算分散训练K个LoRA适配器（adapter thicket）比集中训练单个适配器更有利于多数投票式测试时扩展。
AI.motivation: 标准流程先用RLVR训练单一策略再多次采样投票，但投票只能纠正投票者不共享的错误，而RLVR会使策略样本的错误愈发相关，导致组合有损。作者旨在揭示这种集中化训练的代价并寻找替代方案。
AI.method: 对1.5B-8B的多个模型，每种方法每问题采样160个补全；对比单适配器全量RLVR训练与将相同数据和预算拆分到K个随机不相交数据分片训练的LoRA适配器（adapter thicket），并设置早期停止的单适配器作为对照。
AI.result: 单适配器训练提升单样本准确率，但在四个模型中三个上多数投票低于未训练基座模型，最多低4.8分；投票错误相关性随训练上升，多数投票准确率早期达峰后最多下降7.0分。Thicket在全部16个(model,K)设置中胜过全训练适配器，K≥4时保持在基座0.8分以内或更高；K≥8时在八个设置中六个胜过早期停止对照。从16到160票，thicket领先幅度由1.3扩大到3.3分。
AI.conclusion: 当计划是采样并投票时，RLVR预算应广而非深地使用；伤害源于集中化而非RLVR本身。

title: Reliability-aware short-term roll prediction for unmanned surface vehicles via multi-task learning and adaptive centralization
summary: Reliable roll prediction of unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) is essential for ensuring navi?gational safety and enhancing autonomous decision-making. While existing studies primarily focus on improving prediction accuracy, the quantification of prediction reliability remains insufficiently addressed. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a reliability-aware prediction paradigm that integrates confidence assessment into the predictive pipeline. The architecture utilizes a multi-task learning structure where a shared feature extraction backbone feeds into dual heads: a regression head for precise roll prediction and a quantification head for confidence scoring. This configuration provides accurate prediction and corresponding confidence for risk?sensitive downstream tasks. In addition, an adaptive centralization strategy tailored for short?term real-time roll prediction is introduced to improve model generalization under varying operational conditions. Experiments conducted on a real-sea dataset demonstrate that the proposed method effectively quantifies the reliability of prediction results and maintains superior generalization under varying conditions, offering significant potential for practical engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可靠性感知的横摇预测范式，将置信度评估融入预测流程，在真实海况数据集上实现了准确预测与可靠度量化的兼顾。
AI.motivation: 无人水面艇（USV）横摇预测对航行安全与自主决策至关重要，但现有研究主要关注提升预测精度，对预测可靠性的量化关注不足，难以为风险敏感的下游任务提供可靠性依据。
AI.method: 采用多任务学习架构：共享特征提取主干同时连接回归头（精确横摇预测）与量化头（置信度打分），从而在输出预测值的同时给出对应置信度；并针对短期实时横摇预测设计自适应中心化策略，以提升模型在不同运行工况下的泛化能力。
AI.result: 在真实海况数据集上的实验表明，所提方法能够有效量化预测结果的可靠性，并在不同工况下保持更优的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 该可靠性感知预测范式弥补了预测可靠性量化不足的空白，为风险敏感的下游任务提供预测与置信度双重信息，具有显著的工程应用潜力。

title: Optimal Transport Reweighting for Robust Learning under Spurious Correlations and Label Noise
summary: Machine learning models often suffer performance degradation under subpopulation shift, particularly when spurious correlations cause models to rely on shortcut features that fail to generalize across subgroups. A recent line of work mitigates this issue by using loss-based signals to identify informative samples, but these signals can become severely distorted under label noise: mislabeled samples may also incur large losses and contaminate subsequent reweighting or retraining. Despite its practical importance, this intersection remains largely underexplored. We propose POTER, a reweighting framework based on optimal transport that derives sample importance from the transport geometry between the training distribution and a reference distribution constructed from limited validation group annotations. By measuring alignment at the individual-sample level rather than relying on loss, POTER downweights mislabeled or strongly bias-aligned samples while assigning higher importance to samples better aligned with the reference distribution. In addition, POTER requires only a single ERM training stage, moving beyond the retraining paradigm common in recent work. Across standard benchmarks and noisy-label settings, POTER achieves state-of-the-art worst-group accuracy, including cases where label corruption is concentrated within minority subgroups.

AI.tldr: 提出POTER框架，利用最优传输几何度量样本重要性，在子群体偏移与标签噪声共存场景下实现最差组准确率最优。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型在子群体偏移下性能下降，尤其当虚假相关使模型依赖跨子群体无法泛化的捷径特征时。近期工作用基于损失的信号识别有效样本，但在标签噪声下这些信号严重失真：错标样本同样产生大损失，污染后续重加权或重训练。该交叉问题尚未充分探索。
AI.method: POTER是一个基于最优传输的重加权框架。它通过计算训练分布与由有限验证集组标注构建的参考分布之间的传输几何，在单样本级别衡量对齐程度（而非依赖损失），据此降低错标样本或强烈偏向偏置样本的权重，提升与参考分布对齐更好的样本权重。此外POTER只需一次ERM训练阶段，摆脱了近期工作常见的重训练范式。
AI.result: 在标准基准与噪声标签设置下，POTER取得最差组准确率的最优表现，包括标签污染集中在少数子群体的情形。
AI.conclusion: 基于最优传输几何的样本级重加权可有效应对子群体偏移与标签噪声的叠加问题，且单阶段训练更具实用性。

title: SLIM: Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging
summary: Optimizing merging coefficients for large language models can require many costly benchmark evaluations. We propose \textbf{Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging (SLIM)}, which constructs a quadratic surrogate of aggregate performance on the coefficient simplex using a classical mixture design. Evaluations of individual experts and equal-weight pairs determine the surrogate with the minimum number of measurements needed to identify a general quadratic on this domain. SLIM then optimizes the surrogate without further target-metric evaluations. Experiments on two model architectures demonstrate accurate prediction of unseen multi-expert mixtures and competitive merge performance under limited evaluation budgets. Matched-budget comparisons show that structured evaluation points improve prediction fidelity over random designs, including those using regularized fitting.

AI.tldr: 提出SLIM方法，利用经典混料设计在系数单纯形上构建聚合性能的二次替代模型，仅需评估单个专家等权对即可确定替代模型，无需额外目标指标评估即可优化权重，实现低预算下的模型合并。
AI.motivation: 优化大语言模型的合并系数往往需要大量昂贵的基准评估，成本高昂。
AI.method: SLIM（Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging）：采用经典混料设计，在系数单纯形上构建聚合性能的二次替代模型；通过评估单个专家和等权对，以识别该域上一般二次模型所需的最少测量次数确定替代模型；随后在不进行额外目标指标评估的情况下优化该替代模型。
AI.result: 在两种模型架构上的实验表明，SLIM能准确预测未见的专家混合配置，并在有限评估预算下取得有竞争力的合并性能；同等预算对比显示，结构化评估点相比随机设计（包括使用正则化拟合的设计）提升了预测保真度。
AI.conclusion: 结构化单纯形格点采样可高效替代大量基准评估，在受限预算下实现有效的LLM合并系数优化。

title: Kernelized Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering provides a simple, training-free mechanism for controlling attributes of generative models such as sentiment, style, and helpfulness. However, standard approaches such as Difference-in-Means apply a single input-independent steering vector across all activations, limiting expressivity and ignoring the local geometry of the activation space. We propose Kernelized Activation Steering (KAS), a unifying framework that lifts activation steering into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. KAS formulates steering as an optimization problem expressed purely via kernel evaluations, yielding an implicit, activation-dependent steering score without constructing explicit feature maps. Unlike DiM, KAS induces locally adaptive steering: each activation is modified according to its relative position with respect to source and target reference sets, producing a nonlinear steering field over the representation space. Importantly, DiM is recovered as a special case under a linear kernel, while richer kernels enable geometry-aware interventions. Across standard activation steering tasks, including jailbreaking LLMs and image style control, KAS outperforms or is on par with the existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出KAS（核化激活引导）框架，将激活引导提升到再生核希尔伯特空间，实现输入相关、局部自适应的非线性引导，DiM为其线性核特例，在越狱与图像风格控制任务上表现相当或更优。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法（如Difference-in-Means, DiM）使用单一的、与输入无关的引导向量，对所有激活施加统一干预，表达力有限，且忽略了激活空间的局部几何结构。
AI.method: 将激活引导形式化为再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中的优化问题，仅通过核函数求值表达，无需构造显式特征映射，从而得到隐式的、依赖激活的引导得分；每个激活依据其相对源参考集与目标参考集的位置被修改，在表示空间上形成非线性引导场；线性核下退化为DiM。
AI.result: 在标准激活引导任务（包括大语言模型越狱与图像风格控制）上，KAS的性能优于或与现有方法持平。
AI.conclusion: KAS是一个统一框架，通过核化将激活引导推广为几何感知的局部自适应干预，DiM是其特例，更丰富的核可带来更强的引导能力。

title: GLoC-EHR: Evidence-Cited Clinical Reasoning over Global Context and Local EHR Events
summary: Structured electronic health records (EHRs) contain a patient's clinical trajectory as a sequence of clinical codes. Answering clinical questions from such records requires both the context of the whole trajectory and the specific events that support the answer. We introduce GLoC-EHR, a multimodal language model that reads a contextual encoding of the record through a fixed-size global memory of the trajectory and a local memory of selected events. The model learns to generate hospital-course summaries from the global memory and descriptions of masked concepts from the local memory, aligning both with clinical text. It is then trained to cite evidence before answering, through rationale fine-tuning followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO) with rewards for correct answers and record-supported evidence. On three MIMIC-IV outcome tasks, GLoC-EHR attains the highest macro AUROC among the compared models when it answers directly, whereas zero-shot LLMs reading the serialized record fall far behind. With evidence-cited reasoning, it stays close to its direct multi-task counterpart in macro AUROC, and the evidence terms of the objective reduce unsupported evidence at a similar macro AUROC. The local memory adds distinct supported findings, particularly under strict matching, without a detectable change in macro AUROC. Without retraining, GLoC-EHR transfers to EHRSHOT on par with EHR-BERT and answers two unseen laboratory questions better than zero-shot prompting of its own backbone.

AI.tldr: GLoC-EHR：一种读取结构化电子健康记录（EHR）的多模态语言模型，通过全局与局部记忆对齐临床文本，并以引用证据的方式作答，在MIMIC-IV结局预测任务上取得最高宏AUROC，并具备跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 结构化EHR以临床代码序列刻画患者临床轨迹。回答临床问题既需要整条轨迹的上下文，又需要支撑答案的具体事件，而现有方法（如直接序列化记录并零样本提示LLM）难以兼顾二者，性能落后。
AI.method: 提出GLoC-EHR：以固定大小的全局记忆编码整条轨迹上下文，并以局部记忆表示被选中的事件；模型学习从全局记忆生成住院过程摘要、从局部记忆生成被掩码概念描述，并将二者与临床文本对齐。随后采用理由（rationale）微调与群组相对策略优化（GRPO），奖励正确答案与记录可支持的证据，使模型先引用证据再作答。全局记忆与局部记忆共同对齐临床文本的同时，训练模型先引用证据再回答。
AI.result: 在三个MIMIC-IV结局任务上，GLoC-EHR直接作答时宏AUROC在所比较模型中最高，而读取序列化记录的零样本LLM远落后；在引用证据推理模式下，其宏AUROC接近直接多任务版本，并且目标中的证据项在相似宏AUROC下减少了无依据证据。局部记忆在严格匹配条件下带来独特的可支持发现，但宏AUROC无显著变化。无需重新训练即可迁移至EHRSHOT，性能与EHR-BERT相当，并在两个未见的实验室问题上优于其自身骨干的零样本提示。
AI.conclusion: GLoC-EHR通过全局/局部记忆与证据引用的推理训练，在结构化EHR临床问答中兼顾轨迹上下文与事件证据，取得领先的任务性能并降低无依据证据，同时具备跨数据集与跨任务迁移能力。

title: How Much Can Language Models Gain from Test-Time Computation?
summary: How much can test-time computation improve a language model, and at what cost? Test-time scaling is widely proposed as a substitute for larger models, but existing comparisons mostly evaluate one domain at a time and rarely charge selection to the budget. We introduce SELF-POT, a benchmark and evaluation framework that measures the test-time potential of a model across competition mathematics, competitive programming, and agentic workflows. SELF-POT separates candidate coverage from final accuracy on static tasks, tracks correctness transitions under revision, and measures protocol completion alongside task success in agentic environments. Under a unified budget rule, it compares Direct inference with parallel sampling and self-revision under fixed multiples of the Direct budget, and charges every model call, including selection and critique, in dollars. This design supports two kinds of comparison: the gain a model obtains from additional inference, and a lower-cost model with additional inference against a stronger model. Across five low-cost reasoning models on 350 sealed tasks, with Claude Opus 5.5 Direct as the reference, the returns depend on the domain, the selection rule, and failure handling. When we replay the retained programming candidate pools, public-example selection raises correct submissions from 376 to 453 of 500 scheduled cells while saving 12-49% of logical API cost across models, and simply retaining an available candidate when judging fails recovers 61 submissions at unchanged cost. On identical mathematics pools, judging with fallback yields 186 correct submissions versus 182 for voting, while voting saves 12-21% of logical API cost. These controlled replays show how selection and failure handling change the gains realized from the same generated candidates, and they quantify the marginal value of a model judge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SELF-POT 基准与评估框架，在统一预算规则下跨竞赛数学、竞赛编程和智能体工作流衡量模型的测试时潜力，将候选覆盖与最终准确率分离，并把选择与评判开销按美元计入预算。
AI.motivation: 测试时缩放被广泛视为大模型的替代方案，但现有比较通常按单一领域评估，且很少把选择（selection）成本计入预算，导致对"额外推理换来的增益"缺乏跨领域、成本可比的度量。
AI.method: SELF-POT 在静态任务上将候选覆盖与最终准确率分离，并跟踪修订下的正确性转移；在智能体环境中同时测量协议完成度与任务成功。在固定为 Direct 预算倍数的统一预算规则下，比较 Direct 推理、并行采样与自修订，所有模型调用（含选择与评判）按美元计费。该设计支持两类比较：模型自身从额外推理获得的增益，以及低成本模型加额外推理对比强模型。
AI.result: 在 350 个封存任务上，以 Claude Opus 5.5 Direct 为参考，对五个低成本推理模型进行评估。回放保留的编程候选池时，公共样例选择将正确提交从 500 个调度单元中的 376 提升到 453，同时各模型节省 12–49% 的逻辑 API 成本；评判失败时直接保留可用候选，可在成本不变下恢复 61 个提交。在相同数学候选池上，带回退的评判得到 186 个正确提交，投票为 182，而投票节省 12–21% 逻辑 API 成本。结果表明收益取决于领域、选择规则与失败处理方式，并量化了模型评判的边际价值。
AI.conclusion: 选择规则与失败处理显著改变同一批生成候选所实现的增益，跨领域评估与将选择成本计入预算对衡量测试时缩放的真实收益至关重要。

title: Latent Information Sharing for Accelerating Federated Learning
summary: Federated learning (FL) is a communication-efficient distributed learning paradigm. However, client drift remains one of the most critical challenges, hindering the efficient training of a global model. In this study, we propose a novel latent information sharing scheme that directly mitigates data heterogeneity across clients. Our theoretical and empirical results show that sharing a small amount of hidden-layer activations significantly improves training efficiency while preserving convergence guarantees and data privacy. Furthermore, we compare our method with existing FL approaches designed to address client drift, including FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedPVR, FedProto, and SplitFed, and demonstrate superior model accuracy under a fixed round budget without incurring excessive communication overhead. Overall, this work presents a promising new knowledge aggregation scheme and provides a comprehensive analysis of the impact of activation sharing on federated optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种共享少量隐藏层激活的潜在信息共享方案，直接缓解联邦学习中的客户端漂移，在固定轮次预算下提升精度且通信开销可控。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习虽通信高效，但客户端漂移是阻碍全局模型高效训练的关键挑战，其根源在于客户端数据异构。现有方法（如FedProx、SCAFFOLD等）在缓解漂移上仍有不足，因此需要一种能直接缓解数据异构、同时兼顾收敛性与隐私的新机制。
AI.method: 提出潜在信息共享方案：在客户端间共享少量隐藏层激活（hidden-layer activations），以此作为额外的知识聚合信号直接缓解数据异构。方法附带理论分析与实证验证，考察激活共享对联邦优化的影响，并与FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedPVR、FedProto、SplitFed等进行对比。
AI.result: 理论与实验结果表明，共享少量隐藏层激活可显著提升训练效率，同时保持收敛保证与数据隐私；在固定轮次预算下，模型精度优于上述对比方法，且未引入过度的通信开销。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种有前景的新型知识聚合方案，并系统分析了激活共享对联邦优化的影响，为缓解客户端漂移提供了新思路。

title: Does Scaling Reinforcement Learning Really Require More Training?
summary: Scaling reasoning typically spends more compute on reinforcement learning (RL) or on inference. We show that a completed RL training history can yield policies stronger than the checkpoints visited by its optimizer. We call this policy-space scaling: expanding the deployable policy set accessible from a fixed RL history, without extending training or increasing per-query inference computation. We instantiate it with SURGE (Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion). SURGE combines two checkpoints from the same RL run: a high-accuracy anchor and a competitive donor that generates shorter responses. It expresses both checkpoints as changes from their shared initialization, then spectrally decomposes the anchor's update to retain its dominant component and incorporate the donor's complementary component. With a fixed target for how much of the anchor update to retain, SURGE determines the block size from the weights without testing candidate policies. We evaluate two 1.5B mathematical-reasoning histories, DeepSeek and Nemotron, and one 7B coding history, OLMo. SURGE improves benchmark-average accuracy over both input checkpoints while using fewer reasoning tokens than the anchor. It reaches 54.17% on DeepSeek AIME24 against a measured native maximum of 50.83%, and 83.7% on OLMo HumanEval+ against 82.8%. These gains exceed the observed training curves. Geometric controls support the importance of RL-update structure beyond weight displacement or token reduction alone. Each constructed model runs as a single policy. Our findings identify stored RL history as a reusable scaling resource: the capability available from a training run need not end at its best checkpoint.

AI.tldr: 提出"策略空间缩放"(policy-space scaling)概念：在不延长训练、不增加单次推理计算的前提下，通过融合同一RL训练历史中的两个检查点（高精度锚点+短回复捐赠者）生成比优化器访问过的任何检查点更强的策略。方法SURGE通过谱分解融合二者更新，在DeepSeek/Nemotron/OLMo上均超越输入检查点。
AI.motivation: 现有推理能力缩放通常依靠增加RL训练或推理计算量。作者希望证明：一个已完成的RL训练历史本身可被复用为缩放资源，其能力不必止步于最优检查点，从而在固定训练成本与固定单查询推理开销下扩展可部署策略集合。
AI.method: SURGE（Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion）：取同一RL run的两个检查点——高精度锚点与生成更短回复的捐赠者；将二者表示为相对共享初始化的更新量；对锚点更新做谱分解，保留其主导成分并融入捐赠者的互补成分；在给定锚点更新保留比例的目标下，直接由权重确定块大小，无需评估候选策略。每个构造模型作为单一策略运行。
AI.result: 在两个1.5B数学推理历史（DeepSeek、Nemotron）和一个7B代码历史（OLMo）上评估。SURGE在基准平均准确率上同时超越两个输入检查点，且比锚点使用更少推理token。DeepSeek AIME24达54.17%（实测原生最高50.83%），OLMo HumanEval+达83.7%（对照82.8%）。增益超过训练曲线所观察到的水平。几何控制实验表明RL更新结构的重要性超出单纯的权重位移或token缩减。
AI.conclusion: RL训练历史是一种可复用的缩放资源：一次训练run所能提供的能力不必止于其最佳检查点。策略空间缩放可在不扩展训练、不增加单查询推理计算的情况下，从固定RL历史中扩展可部署策略集合。

title: Parameter-Efficient Distributionally Robust Adaptation of Tabular Foundation Models under Subpopulation Shift
summary: Despite strong mean accuracy, tabular foundation models (TFMs) can perform poorly on underrepresented groups under subpopulation shift, where group proportions change between training and deployment. We propose DR-TFM, a parameter-efficient distributionally robust adaptation framework that requires no true group annotations. DR-TFM adjusts attention to labeled context examples by fine-tuning an existing query scaling network or adding and training one, while keeping all other parameters fixed. We instantiate the framework with two robust objectives using estimated groups or source conditional distributions derived from training data. For TabPFN-3, adaptation updates only 0.016% of the pretrained model's parameters. Across five tabular benchmarks, DR-TFM achieves substantially higher average worst-group accuracy than pretrained TFMs and the compared robust baselines without true group annotations, while maintaining competitive mean group accuracy. DR-TFM also improves average worst-group accuracy on ACS Income and across four additional TFMs.

AI.tldr: 提出DR-TFM，一种无需真实群体标注的参数高效分布鲁棒自适应框架，通过调整注意力中的查询缩放网络，在五个表格基准上显著提升最差群体准确率。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）平均准确率高，但在子群体偏移（训练与部署间群体比例变化）下对代表性不足的群体表现较差，且现有鲁棒方法通常依赖真实群体标注。
AI.method: DR-TFM无需真实群体标注：仅微调现有查询缩放网络或新增并训练一个查询缩放网络以调整对带标签上下文示例的注意力，其余参数全部冻结。用估计群体或训练数据推导的源条件分布实现两种鲁棒目标。在TabPFN-3上仅更新预训练模型0.016%的参数。
AI.result: 在五个表格基准上，DR-TFM的平均最差群体准确率大幅高于预训练TFM及对比鲁棒基线，且无需真实群体标注，同时保持有竞争力的平均群体准确率；在ACS Income及另外四种TFM上平均最差群体准确率亦有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过极少量参数调整注意力机制即可实现分布鲁棒自适应，在无群体标注条件下有效缓解子群体偏移问题，并具备跨数据集与跨TFM的泛化性。

title: Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Looped Transformers introduce recurrent depth as a new scaling axis for LLMs: by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks, they increase effective depth without increasing parameter count. However, the benefits of looping remain unclear for large MoE LLMs under FLOPs-matched comparisons. The main reason is that the gains from additional iterations diminish quickly and can even turn into degradation, so the extra FLOPs spent on looping yield little substantial improvement. Consequently, prior work typically settles on two loops. We identify two main obstacles to scaling looped MoE. First, looping inherits and amplifies the curse of depth: hidden-state variance grows with each iteration as residual updates accumulate, which destabilizes deep recurrence and causes representations to drift. Second, looped MoE suffers from expert selection collapse: routers repeatedly select the same experts across loops, so extra iterations add computation without adding computational diversity. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose LOOM, built on a single principle: each loop should contribute new computation while keeping the recurrent state stable. LOOM stabilizes recurrence by scaling residual updates to bound variance growth and re-injecting the input embedding at every loop, and diversifies it through per-loop routers that engage different experts and a Looping Residual that carries earlier outputs forward. Experiments across 100M-1.7B models show stable scaling to 9-12 loops. Under near-iso-FLOP, the 700M model performs best at 5 loops, reducing perplexity from 18.36 to 16.54 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 38.84% to 39.53% over the non-looped baseline. Without FLOP matching, the 1.7B model trained on 60B tokens peaks at 9 loops, reducing perplexity from 9.62 to 7.77 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 42.4% to 47.7%. Code is available https://github.com/hed-ucas/LOOM.

AI.tldr: 该论文诊断了循环式MoE大模型难以扩展的两大障碍（深度诅咒导致的隐状态方差累积、专家选择坍缩），并提出LOOM方法使循环可稳定扩展至9-12次，在等FLOP与不等FLOP设定下均显著优于非循环基线。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享块以增加有效深度而不增加参数量，但面向大型MoE LLM、在FLOPs匹配比较下，循环收益迅速衰减甚至转为退化，故先前工作通常只采用两次循环。作者希望厘清循环MoE难以扩展的瓶颈并予以解决。
AI.method: LOOM的核心原则是"每次循环应贡献新计算，同时保持循环状态稳定"。稳定性方面：对残差更新进行缩放以约束方差增长，并在每次循环重新注入输入嵌入；多样性方面：采用逐循环路由器（per-loop routers）以激活不同专家，并引入Looping Residual将早期输出向前传递。
AI.result: 在100M-1.7B模型上可稳定扩展至9-12次循环。近等FLOP下，700M模型在5次循环最佳，困惑度由18.36降至16.54，平均零样本准确率由38.84%升至39.53%；非FLOP匹配下，1.7B模型训练60B token时在9次循环达到峰值，困惑度由9.62降至7.77，平均零样本准确率由42.4%升至47.7%。
AI.conclusion: LOOM通过同时实现循环状态的稳定化与计算多样性，突破了循环MoE以往只能停留在两次循环的限制，验证了循环深度作为大模型扩展轴的有效性。

title: Persistent Depth Ordering amid Shifting Block-Bypass Responses in Language Model Pretraining
summary: Layer interventions are widely used to probe the internal organization of language models, yet most analyses examine a single training checkpoint even though model representations and computations evolve throughout pretraining. This leaves open which depth-dependent intervention responses reflect persistent organization and which are transient consequences of training. We study this question using single-block identity bypass on fixed teacher-forced contexts across five released trajectories and 11 model-domain combinations. We find that block-bypass responses retain recognizable depth ordering while their magnitudes redistribute: nearby checkpoints preserve stronger rank correspondence than distant ones, and large changes concentrate at positions that recur across text samples and transfer across evaluation domains. Controlled experiments further show that changes in the natural bypass effect cannot be reduced to a single downstream sensitivity: in replicated Pythia runs, local missing-update magnitude grows while the pooled matched downstream response decreases, whereas OLMo-2 7B exhibits a different balance. These matched responses also depend on perturbation strength and direction, without identifying targeted compensation. Together, our results show that longitudinal layer sensitivity is structured but not static, and that single-checkpoint intervention responses should be interpreted in the context of how the underlying perturbation pathway evolves during training.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在五个已发布训练轨迹、11个模型-领域组合上进行单块恒等旁路（identity bypass）干预，考察语言模型层级干预响应的纵向演化。结果显示：块旁路响应保持可识别的深度排序，但幅度会重新分布；邻近检查点的排序对应关系强于远距离检查点，且大幅变化集中在跨文本样本重复出现、跨评估领域可迁移的位置。受控实验表明自然旁路效应的变化不能归结为单一的下游敏感性：在复制的Pythia运行中，局部缺失更新幅度增大而汇总的匹配下游响应减小，OLMo-2 7B则呈现不同平衡。结论是纵向层级敏感性是有结构但非静态的，单检查点干预响应须结合扰动路径随训练演化来解读。
AI.motivation: 层级干预被广泛用于探查语言模型的内部组织，但多数分析只考察单个训练检查点，而模型的表示与计算在预训练过程中持续演化。这留下一个未解问题：哪些深度相关的干预响应反映持久的组织结构，哪些只是训练的暂时性产物。论文旨在揭示纵向层级敏感性的结构性与动态性。
AI.method: 采用单块恒等旁路（single-block identity bypass）在固定的teacher-forced上下文上施加干预，覆盖五个已发布训练轨迹和11个模型-领域组合；比较不同检查点间的响应排序对应关系与幅度变化；进行受控实验以检验自然旁路效应的变化是否可归结为单一的下游敏感性，并考察匹配下游响应随扰动强度与方向的变化。
AI.result: 块旁路响应保留可识别的深度排序，但幅度发生重新分布；邻近检查点的排序对应关系强于远距离检查点；大幅变化集中在跨文本样本重复出现且跨评估领域可迁移的位置。受控实验显示变化不能归结为单一下游敏感性：复制Pythia运行中局部缺失更新幅度增长而汇总匹配下游响应下降，OLMo-2 7B呈不同平衡；匹配响应依赖扰动强度与方向，未识别出定向补偿。
AI.conclusion: 纵向层级敏感性是有结构但非静态的；单检查点干预响应应在扰动路径随训练演化的背景下加以解读，否则可能把暂时性训练效应误认为持久的内部组织特征。

title: Detect, Explain, Interpret: An End-to-End Benchmark for Time Series Anomaly Detection, Explainability and Interpretability
summary: Time Series Anomaly Detection has received increasing attention, driven by the growing availability of complex time series data. This surge has led to the development of numerous detection methods, as well as a variety of benchmarks aimed at thoroughly evaluating their performance. However, most existing detectors remain largely agnostic to domain context, overlooking explainability and interpretability. One of the main reasons for this gap is that current benchmarks primarily focus on detection accuracy, and only few of them evaluate spatial explainability. Moreover, no benchmark currently provides sufficiently rich semantic annotations to support the generation of human-understandable interpretations of anomalies. To address these limitations, we introduce SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection benchmark), a fully annotated benchmark composed of 215 multivariate, high-dimensional time series collected from real-world distributed cloud storage systems operated by Scality. The proposed dataset includes rich contextual information, covering three families of anomalies with varying degrees of severity. As further contribution, we provide a foundation for future work by evaluating baseline methods for Detection, Explainability, and Interpretability, covering all stages of a TSAD pipeline. For Detection, we benchmark a wide range of existing anomaly detectors, testing their effectiveness on the proposed real-world dataset. Then, we consider explainability by evaluating whether measuring the contribution of each dimension in the generated anomaly score can provide accurate anomaly attributions. Finally, for interpretability, we investigate the effectiveness of frozen LLM baselines in localizing and interpreting anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SHAD——一个全标注的高维多变量时间序列异常检测基准，含215条来自Scality真实云存储系统的序列，并针对检测、可解释性与可解读性提供基线评测。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测方法大多与领域上下文无关，忽视可解释性与可解读性；其原因是当前基准主要关注检测精度，少数仅评估空间可解释性，且没有基准提供足够丰富的语义标注来支撑人类可理解的异常解释。
AI.method: 构建SHAD基准：包含215条来自Scality真实分布式云存储系统的高维多变量时间序列，具有丰富上下文信息，涵盖三类不同严重程度的异常，并进行完整标注；同时建立覆盖TSAD全流程的基线评测框架，包括检测（多种现有异常检测器）、可解释性（检验异常分数中各维度贡献能否提供准确异常归因）与可解读性（考察冻结LLM基线在异常定位与解释上的效果）。
AI.result: 在提出的真实数据集上测试了广泛的现有异常检测器；评估了基于维度贡献的异常归因有效性；并验证了冻结LLM基线在异常定位与解释任务中的表现。
AI.conclusion: SHAD通过提供带丰富语义标注的真实高维时间序列基准及覆盖检测、可解释性、可解读性的基线评测，为弥合时间序列异常检测中上下文缺失与解释性不足的差距奠定基础，并支持未来研究。

title: Learning Rate Transfer for Hybrid Transformer-SSM Architectures
summary: We study learning rate (LR) scaling for hybrid architectures combining Transformer and State-Space Model (SSM) blocks, a class adopted by several recent production language models. In particular, we focus on the gap between the theoretical scaling rules derived for SSMs under zero-order-hold (ZOH) discretization at infinite width with growing state size, and the field-standard practical implementations using simplified-ZOH Mamba at fixed state size. Surprisingly, in this practical regime hybrid architectures achieve a near-zero LR transfer gap across widths 256-2048 and depths 4-32 up to billion-parameter scale using only the original $μ$P prescription, even though SSM operations fall outside its Tensor Programs representability conditions and every parameterization we test fails the standard coordinate-check diagnostic of $μ$P correctness. We attribute this to a two-condition decomposition of LR transfer in hybrid architectures: a global update-to-weight invariance, enforced by $μ$P's initialization and LR scaling; and a local per-component balance, provided by AdamW's per-parameter normalization. Our observations show that the optimal LR is invariant to width up to 8$\times$, that this width invariance holds across depth, sequence length, batch size, and Transformer-to-SSM ratio, and that it transfers to Nemotron-H, a production hybrid outside our custom architecture set. We hope these findings fill the gap between theoretical scaling rules and practical hybrid implementations, and stimulate further research toward bridging it.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了Transformer与SSM混合架构的学习率缩放问题，发现仅用原始μP处方即可在256–2048宽度、4–32深度及十亿参数规模下实现近乎零的LR迁移差距，并将其归因于全局更新-权重不变性与AdamW逐参数归一化提供的局部组件平衡。
AI.motivation: 混合架构（Transformer+SSM）已被多个近期生产级语言模型采用，但理论层面为零阶保持（ZOH）离散化、无限宽度、状态规模增长条件下推导的SSM缩放规则，与实际中使用固定状态规模、简化ZOH Mamba的工程实现之间存在明显差距，且SSM操作不满足μP的Tensor Programs可表示性条件。论文旨在弥合理论缩放规则与实际混合实现之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 在宽度256–2048、深度4–32、直至十亿参数规模下，对Transformer与SSM混合架构进行学习率迁移实验；采用简化ZOH Mamba、固定状态规模、原始μP初始化与LR缩放，并结合AdamW优化器；进行标准的μP coordinate-check诊断，并测试多种参数化方案；进一步验证宽度不变性在不同深度、序列长度、批大小及Transformer-to-SSM比例下的稳健性，并迁移至生产模型Nemotron-H。
AI.result: 在该实际训练区间内，混合架构仅使用原始μP处方即取得近乎为零的LR迁移差距；尽管所有测试的参数化均未通过μP正确性的coordinate-check诊断，且SSM操作不在Tensor Programs可表示性范围内。最优学习率对宽度在8倍范围内保持不变，且该宽度不变性在深度、序列长度、批大小和Transformer-to-SSM比例变化下均成立，并可迁移至自定义架构之外的生产混合模型Nemotron-H。
AI.conclusion: 混合架构中的LR迁移可由两条件分解解释：由μP初始化与LR缩放保证的全局更新-权重不变性，以及由AdamW逐参数归一化提供的局部逐组件平衡。研究结果弥合了理论缩放规则与实际混合实现之间的差距，并为后续进一步桥接二者提供了方向。

title: CAGE-NAS: Certified Functional Descent for Efficient Model Growth
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at AXIOM 2026: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning (NeurIPS 2026 Workshop)
summary: The progressive growth of neural networks requires deciding when the current representation remains sufficient for optimization and when it should be expanded. CAGE-NAS formulates this decision in function space through an admissibility criterion on approximations of the functional gradient. As long as a representation enables a certified Functional Gradient Descent step, the architecture remains fixed; when the criterion fails, a function-preserving expansion is applied and the resulting representation is evaluated again. As the main instance, we study the family induced by the tangent space, using a regularized projection of the functional gradient. In a controlled setting with exact certification, CAGE-NAS produces architectures positioned above the 99.8th performance percentile by held-out RMSE among all admissible alternatives within the same parameter budget, without enumerating them during the growth trajectory.

AI.tldr: 提出CAGE-NAS框架，在函数空间中以泛函梯度的可容许性准则决定神经网络表示何时需要扩展，实现函数保持式增长。
AI.motivation: 渐进式增长的神经网络需要判断当前表示是否仍足以支撑优化，以及在何时应当扩展，现有方法缺乏在函数空间层面刻画这一决策的原则性准则。
AI.method: 将增长决策形式化为函数空间中泛函梯度近似的可容许性准则：只要当前表示能实现被认证的泛函梯度下降步骤，架构保持固定；当准则失效时，执行函数保持式扩展，并重新评估所得表示。主要实例研究切空间诱导的架构族，并使用泛函梯度的正则化投影。
AI.result: 在可精确认证的受控设定下，CAGE-NAS生成的架构在相同参数预算的所有可容许备选中，按留出集RMSE位于第99.8性能百分位以上，且增长轨迹中并未对这些备选进行枚举。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明基于泛函梯度可容许性的函数空间准则可有效指导网络增长决策，在无需枚举候选架构的前提下获得接近最优的表示，为NAS提供了一种认证驱动的增长范式。

title: Rethinking the Information Bottleneck: Structured Decomposition under Label-Induced Partitions
summary: Standard information bottleneck (IB) regularization constrains representations via a single scalar I(Z;X), implicitlytreating all information as homogeneous. However, a single global compression control couples label-relevant structurewith residual within-condition variation, rather than regulating their allocation independently, allowing nuisanceinformation to persist in learned representations. For example, in medical imaging applications, residual variation oftenstems from acquisition conditions, background factors, or subject-specific appearance. This issue becomes particularlypronounced in data-limited settings, where models tend to overfit such variation, hindering generalization. While existingregularization methods can stabilize training, control capacity, or shape representation geometry, they do not explicitlyseparate nuisance-like variation from task-supporting structure. To address this limitation, we revisit IB from a structuredperspective based on a label-induced partition, where condition-level structure and within-condition information playdistinct roles. This leads to a dual-bottleneck formulation: a standard KL term controls global information capacity, while aconditional KL term targets within-condition information. We show that the conditional KL admits an exact decompositioninto a within-condition information term and a prior-mismatch term, explaining its alignment with the design objective.With a simplex-structured conditional prior, the method provides controllable latent geometry and integrates seamlesslyinto existing pipelines. Experiments on classification and segmentation show the clearest gains in low-data classificationand consistent improvements across dense prediction benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文针对标准信息瓶颈（IB）用单一标量 I(Z;X) 约束表示、无法区分标签相关结构与条件内冗余变异的问题，提出基于标签诱导划分的结构化 IB，即双瓶颈（dual-bottleneck）形式：全局 KL 控制总信息容量，条件 KL 专门约束条件内信息，并给出条件 KL 的精确分解与单纯形结构化条件先验，实现可控隐空间几何。实验表明低数据分类收益最明显，密集预测任务上也有稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 标准 IB 仅用单一全局压缩控制，将标签相关结构与条件内残差变异耦合在一起，无法独立调节二者分配，导致 nuisance 信息（如医学影像中的采集条件、背景、个体外观差异）残留在表示中；在数据受限场景下模型易过拟合这些变异、损害泛化。已有正则化方法虽能稳定训练、控制容量或塑造表示几何，但均未显式分离 nuisance 式变异与任务支撑结构。
AI.method: 从基于标签诱导划分的结构化视角重新审视 IB，将条件级结构（condition-level structure）与条件内信息（within-condition information）赋予不同角色，提出双瓶颈公式：1）标准 KL 项约束全局信息容量；2）条件 KL 项针对条件内信息进行约束。理论上证明条件 KL 可精确分解为条件内信息项与先验失配项（prior-mismatch），说明其与设计目标的一致性。采用单纯形结构化条件先验（simplex-structured conditional prior），提供可控的隐空间几何，并可无缝集成到现有流程中。
AI.result: 在分类与分割任务上进行实验：低数据分类场景下增益最为明显，密集预测（dense prediction）基准上取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 IB 结构化、引入条件 KL 瓶颈与单纯形条件先验，可显式分离条件内 nuisance 变异与任务支撑结构，实现可控表示几何并易于集成；该方法在数据受限分类与密集预测任务上验证了有效性。

title: Fully Online Decentralized Learning in Stochastic Games with Unknown Independent Chains
summary: We consider stochastic games with independent controlled chains and unknown transition kernels, where players observe only their local states and realized payoffs. We develop a fully online, decentralized, and uncoordinated mirror-descent algorithm that operates in the dual space of occupancy measures for approximating stationary Nash equilibrium (NE) policies. The algorithm uses a single transition/reward sample at every primitive time step, relies only on local information, and requires neither coverage of the joint state space nor synchronized episodes. Under uniform-ergodicity and finite-coverage assumptions, we show that, with high probability, the time-averaged fixed-comparator regret decays at the canonical $O(T^{-1/2})$ rate, up to logarithmic factors and polynomial dependence on the game parameters. In particular, the complexity depends on the cover times of the individual local state spaces rather than the product state space, avoiding exponential dependence on the number of players and the sizes of the joint state and action spaces. The resulting finite-time regret bound further yields an approximate coarse-correlated-equilibrium guarantee, which is natural for arbitrary reward functions since computing a stationary $ε$-NE is PPAD-hard in this setting. Under an additional global variational-stability condition, we show that the same fully online algorithm converges asymptotically in the last iterate to a stationary $ε$-NE. Our results provide a fully online and scalable learning framework for stochastic games with unknown independent chains. The algorithm can also be viewed as a primal-dual framework for Markov games that exploits the independence and local structure of the players' controlled transition chains.

AI.tldr: 提出一种完全在线、去中心化、无协调的镜像下降算法，在占用测度对偶空间中学习具有独立受控链与未知转移核的随机博弈的平稳纳什均衡策略。
AI.motivation: 针对独立受控链随机博弈中转移核未知、玩家仅能观测本地状态与实现收益的场景，需要避免对联合状态空间覆盖的依赖，并克服计算平稳ε-纳什均衡的PPAD困难性。
AI.method: 在以占用测度为变量的对偶空间中设计完全在线、去中心化且无协调的镜像下降算法；每个基本时间步仅使用单个转移/奖励样本，仅依赖本地信息，无需联合状态空间覆盖，也无需同步回合。
AI.result: 在一致遍历性与有限覆盖假设下，以高概率获得时间平均固定比较器遗憾的O(T^{-1/2})速率（对数因子与多项式参数依赖）；复杂度取决于各局部状态空间的覆盖时间而非乘积状态空间，避免对玩家数量及联合状态、动作空间规模的指数依赖；该有限时间遗憾界进一步给出近似粗相关均衡保证，并在额外全局变分稳定性条件下使同一算法在最后迭代渐近收敛到平稳ε-纳什均衡。
AI.conclusion: 为具有未知独立链的随机博弈提供了完全在线且可扩展的学习框架，并可视为利用玩家受控转移链独立性与局部结构的马尔可夫博弈原始-对偶框架。

title: Low-Budget Active Learning through Entropic Optimal Transport
summary: We consider low-budget active learning, which consists of selecting a limited number of points, the coreset, such that a model can be trained to high accuracy on the selection only. This problem is particularly relevant in contexts where labeling requires costly expert intervention, as in medical applications. We leverage features extracted from a pretrained self-supervised model to represent the data, and perform coreset selection directly in this feature space. In this paper, we use entropic optimal transport, specifically the Sinkhorn divergence, as the coreset selection criterion, which first allows us to get dimension-free sample complexity results, and second admits computationally efficient gradient evaluations. This opens the way to using gradient-based algorithms to rapidly compute solution candidates, further improved by a swap-based local search, with guarantees on the solution quality. Experiments on image benchmarks and medical datasets show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art heuristics in low-budget settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Sinkhorn散度的低预算主动学习coreset选择方法：在预训练自监督特征空间中直接选点，利用熵正则最优传输获得与维度无关的样本复杂度、可高效求梯度，并通过梯度算法加交换式局部搜索求高质量解，在图像与医学数据集上优于现有启发式方法。
AI.motivation: 低预算主动学习只需选择极少量样本（coreset）即可训练出高精度模型，在标注需昂贵专家介入的场景（如医学）尤为重要。然而现有启发式选点方法在预算极低时效果有限，缺乏理论保证与高效优化手段，因此需要一种兼具理论保证和计算可行性的coreset选择准则。
AI.method: 以预训练自监督模型提取的特征表示数据，并在该特征空间内直接进行coreset选择。采用熵正则最优传输中的Sinkhorn散度作为选择准则：一方面可导出与维度无关的样本复杂度结果，另一方面其梯度可高效计算。由此可用基于梯度的算法快速求解候选解，再通过基于交换（swap）的局部搜索进一步改进，并对解的质量提供保证。
AI.result: 在图像基准数据集和医学数据集上的实验表明，该方法在低预算设置下优于当前最先进的启发式方法。
AI.conclusion: Sinkhorn散度作为coreset选择准则是可行且有效的：它同时带来理论上的样本复杂度保证与实际可高效优化的梯度结构，配合梯度算法与交换式局部搜索可获得高质量解，在低预算主动学习、尤其是昂贵标注的医学场景中具有优势。

title: Autoregressive Drillhole Modelling Under Distribution Shift
summary: Autoregressive modelling has achieved remarkable success in language and sequence tasks by learning to predict future states from previous observation. Mineral-exploration drillholes provide a natural but largely unexplored setting for this paradigm: as drilling proceeds, lithology is revealed sequentially from shallow to deep, making prediction of deeper strata inherently autoregressive. Existing drillhole modelling, however, is dominated by spatial interpolation and reconstruction, or largely rely on masked modelling, leaving strictly autoregressive prediction largely underexplored. We introduce DrillBench, a benchmark of 49,671 Western Australian drillholes for next-layer prediction and autoregressive stratigraphic generation across a graded transfer spectrum, from local prediction through spatial shift to cross geological province transfer. Benchmarking classical, geostatistical, and neural models reveals a clear \emph{transfer boundary}: spatial and geochemical conditioning provides large local gains but deteriorates sharply under stronger shift, whereas lithology-sequence autoregressive models transfer more robustly. Guided by this finding, we develop a backbone-agnostic recipe combining large-scale pretraining on historical drillholes with spatial retrieval of neighbouring lithology. Retrieval is most effective in weathered cover, when local spatial continuity remains informative, whereas pretraining contributes more strongly in bedrock and under broader geological shift. Together, they retain strong local performance while improving generalisation under spatial and cross-province shift, most markedly on the most distant splits. The benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/yihaoding/drillbench.

AI.tldr: 提出 DrillBench——包含49,671个西澳钻孔的下一层位预测与自回归地层生成基准，覆盖从局部预测、空间迁移到跨地质省迁移的渐变迁移谱；发现空间/地球化学条件建模在强迁移下失效，而岩性序列自回归模型迁移更稳健，并提出"大规模预训练+邻域岩性空间检索"的骨干无关方法。
AI.motivation: 自回归建模在语言与序列任务中表现优异，而钻孔随钻探由浅至深逐层揭示岩性，天然契合一严格自回归预测范式。但现有钻孔建模多聚焦空间插值与重建或掩码建模，严格自回归预测尚未被充分探索，且缺乏系统性评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 DrillBench 基准，含49,671个西澳钻孔，任务为下一层位预测与自回归地层生成，设置在由局部预测→空间偏移→跨地质省迁移的渐变迁移谱上。对经典、地质统计与神经网络模型进行基准评测，据此提出与骨干无关的训练配方：历史钻孔大规模预训练 + 邻域岩性空间检索。
AI.result: 基准评测揭示出清晰的"迁移边界"：空间与地球化学条件在局部带来显著增益，但在更强分布偏移下急剧退化；岩性序列自回归模型迁移更稳健。预训练+检索的组合在保持强局部性能的同时提升空间与跨省泛化能力，在最远距离划分上提升最明显。检索在风化覆盖层（局部空间连续性仍有效）最有效，预训练在基岩区与更大地质偏移下贡献更大。
AI.conclusion: 钻孔岩性预测是检验自回归迁移的天然试验场；DrillBench 与"预训练+空间检索"配方能在局部精度与跨域泛化间取得平衡，并揭示预训练与检索在不同地质条件下的互补性。基准与代码已开源。

title: Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series
summary: Time-series anomaly detection trades off predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability. We use a large language model not as the detector but as the author of one: an autonomous research loop in which the model repeatedly edits a single short NumPy program under a leakage-free objective, keeping the best-scoring detector it finds. The loop discovers two compact detectors, one for univariate and one for multivariate series, that describe short windows by their local spectral features and compare them with the training-region distribution through a covariance-aware distance. On the TSB-AD benchmark these detectors lead the field across metrics, ahead of the strongest classical, deep, and foundation-model baselines including Time-RCD, yet they train no network and use no GPU, and the multivariate detector is faster than every similarly performing baseline. LLM-driven program search is thus a practical route to accurate, efficient, and transparent detectors.

AI.tldr: 该研究将大语言模型用作"检测器作者"而非检测器本身，通过自主研究循环反复编辑一段简短NumPy程序，在无泄漏目标下搜索最优时间序列异常检测器，最终发现两个紧凑检测器（单变量与多变量各一），在TSB-AD基准上各项指标领先，无需训练网络、不使用GPU，且多变量检测器速度优于同类基线。
AI.motivation: 时间序列异常检测存在预测精度、计算效率与可解释性之间的权衡，现有方法（经典方法、深度模型、基础模型）难以同时兼顾。作者希望探索是否能通过大语言模型驱动的程序搜索自动发现兼具精度、效率与透明性的检测器，从而突破这一权衡。
AI.method: 提出一个基于大语言模型的自主研究循环：模型不直接充当检测器，而是反复编辑一段单一、简短的NumPy程序，在无泄漏（leakage-free）的目标函数下进行搜索，并保留得分最高的检测器。搜索发现两个紧凑检测器，分别面向单变量与多变量序列：它们用局部频谱特征描述短窗口，并通过协方差感知距离（covariance-aware distance）与训练区分布进行比较。
AI.result: 在TSB-AD基准上，发现的检测器在各项指标上均领先领域内方法，超越最强的经典、深度与基础模型基线（包括Time-RCD）；且不训练任何网络、不使用GPU，多变量检测器的速度还优于所有性能相近的基线。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型驱动的程序搜索是获得准确、高效且透明检测器的实用途径，证明了将LLM作为"检测器作者"来替代直接充当检测器的可行性。

title: Mixture-Trained Merging for Unified Multi-Objective Models
summary: Unified language models are increasingly expected to combine heterogeneous capabilities, such as mathematics, code, instruction following, and controllable thinking behavior, within a single set of parameters. A common solution is sequential post-training on multiple objectives, but this entangles all objectives along one optimization trajectory and makes the final model highly sensitive to training order, data ratios, schedules, and stopping criteria. Weight-space merging offers a modular alternative, but naive merging of single-objective experts often fails: domain capabilities degrade sharply, or think/non-think modes collapse into one dominant behavior. We attribute both failures to incompatible weight-space geometry: experts trained on single objectives drift to distant regions of parameter space, placing their interpolations outside any shared low-loss basin. We propose Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM), which trains each branch on an objective-biased data mixture rather than a single objective, exposing it to cross-objective interactions and making branches compatible at merge time. MTM uses merged-model evaluations as a low-cost signal for selecting branch mixtures, avoiding expensive data-mixture ablations. The procedure is iterative: each round promotes the base model using globally selected merge coefficients and refines each branch mixture using domain-preferred coefficients under constraints that preserve other objectives. To scale beyond simplex grid search, MTM uses qNEHVI-based multi-objective Bayesian optimization. Across code, mathematics, instruction following, and think/non-think control, MTM outperforms naive merging and preserves behavioral separation where single-objective merging collapses, suggesting that effective unified models require branches trained to be mergeable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM)，通过让各分支在面向目标的数据混合上训练而非单一目标训练，使分支权重几何兼容，从而在合并时避免能力退化与 think/non-think 模式坍缩，并在代码、数学、指令跟随与思考模式控制上优于朴素合并。
AI.motivation: 统一语言模型需在单一参数集内整合数学、代码、指令跟随与可控思考行为等异构能力。顺序后训练将所有目标纠缠于同一优化轨迹，导致对训练顺序、数据比例、调度与停止准则高度敏感；而权重空间合并虽模块化，但朴素合并单目标专家常失效——领域能力急剧退化，或 think/non-think 模式坍缩为单一主导行为。作者将此归因于权重空间几何不兼容：单目标专家漂移到参数空间的远离区域，其插值落在任何共享低损失盆地之外。
AI.method: 提出 MTM：每个分支在目标偏向的数据混合（objective-biased data mixture）上训练，而非单一目标，使其暴露于跨目标交互，从而在合并时兼容。以合并模型评估作为低成本信号来选择分支混合，避免昂贵的数据混合消融。过程迭代进行：每轮用全局选定的合并系数提升基础模型，并在保持其他目标的约束下，用领域偏好的系数精化各分支混合。为扩展到单纯形网格搜索之外，采用基于 qNEHVI 的多目标贝叶斯优化。
AI.result: 在代码、数学、指令跟随以及 think/non-think 控制上，MTM 优于朴素合并，并在单目标合并发生坍缩之处保持行为分离，表明有效的统一模型需要可合并的分支训练。
AI.conclusion: 有效的统一语言模型要求分支在训练时即具备可合并性；以目标偏向数据混合训练分支并结合多目标贝叶斯优化选择混合与合并系数，是避免能力退化与行为坍缩的可行路径。

title: Context-Aware Error Mitigation Orchestration for Hybrid Quantum Reinforcement Learning on NISQ Systems
summary: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) integrates reinforcement learning with parameterized quantum circuits and is a promising approach to combinatorial optimization. On Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices, however, decoherence, gate imperfections, and measurement errors reduce policy quality and make learning less reliable. Existing error mitigation techniques are generally applied as fixed corrections that do not adapt to changing noise conditions or to the evolving state of training. This work presents Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM) as a context-aware orchestration layer of the hybrid quantum-classical training loop that dynamically selects the most suitable mitigation strategy during QRL training. APGEM evaluates Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Clifford Data Regression (CDR), and Readout Error Mitigation (REM) using policy-level indicators, including quantum-state fidelity, policy entropy, cumulative reward, and approximation ratio, and integrates the selected strategy directly into the reinforcement learning loop. The framework is evaluated on the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), a representative NP-hard problem in urban logistics, under a range of NISQ noise models and noise levels. APGEM consistently outperforms conventional static mitigation methods, reaches approximately 94% of the utility of an oracle strategy, maintains higher quantum-state fidelity as noise increases, and produces more stable learning behaviour throughout training. Ablation studies show that the framework learns context-aware mitigation policies that adapt to different noise environments and circuit execution conditions. These findings demonstrate that integrating adaptive error mitigation into the learning process substantially improves the robustness and reliability of QRL on NISQ hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应策略引导误差缓解（APGEM），在量子强化学习训练循环中动态选择ZNE、PEC、CDR、REM等误差缓解策略，在CVRP任务上显著优于静态方法，达到约94%的oracle效用。
AI.motivation: 量子强化学习（QRL）在NISQ设备上受退相干、门不完美和测量误差影响，导致策略质量下降、学习可靠性降低。现有误差缓解技术通常作为固定校正应用，无法适应噪声条件变化和训练状态的演化，因此需要一种自适应的误差缓解机制。
AI.method: 提出APGEM，作为混合量子-经典训练循环中的上下文感知编排层。它利用策略级指标（量子态保真度、策略熵、累积奖励、近似比）评估ZNE、PEC、CDR和REM四种缓解策略，动态选择最合适的策略并直接集成到强化学习循环中。在CVRP这一NP-hard问题上，于多种NISQ噪声模型和噪声水平下进行评估。
AI.result: APGEM持续优于传统静态缓解方法，达到约94%的oracle策略效用；随着噪声增加仍保持更高的量子态保真度，并在训练全程产生更稳定的学习行为。消融实验表明，该框架能够学习到适应不同噪声环境和电路执行条件的上下文感知缓解策略。
AI.conclusion: 将自适应误差缓解集成到学习过程中，能显著提升QRL在NISQ硬件上的鲁棒性和可靠性。APGEM为噪声条件下量子强化学习的稳定训练提供了有效方案。

title: Model validation in machine learning: A scenario-based guide from hold-out splits to nested group cross-validation in biomedical and applied research
comment: Tutorial with eight controlled scenarios; includes MATLAB and Python/scikit-learn code listings
summary: Model validation estimates the performance of a complete learning procedure on new data. However, an invalid split can produce an optimistic and stable result. This tutorial reviews hold-out validation, train/validation/test designs, repeated random subsampling, k-fold and repeated stratified cross-validation, leave-one-out and leave-p-out schemes, group-aware validation, and nested group cross-validation. General machine-learning principles are linked to EEG epochs, paired-eye OCT images, repeated clinical measurements, and multicenter data. Eight controlled scenarios compare flawed and leakage-safe designs: seven use locked confusion matrices with auditable metrics, and one uses a reproducible repeated-study simulation. The scenarios cover global feature selection, normalization leakage, dependent records, center mixing, repeated test-set use, and estimator instability. Bias, variance, metric aggregation, uncertainty, and computational cost are also examined. A data-size matrix, a decision tree, and reporting checklists are provided. Reproducible MATLAB templates and scikit-learn counterparts are included. The results show that no validation method is universally best. The independent unit must match the intended deployment target. Every data-dependent operation must also exclude the observations used for performance estimation.

AI.tldr: 该教程系统梳理了模型验证方法（留出法、交叉验证、分组与嵌套设计等），并通过八个对照情景展示泄漏与错误划分如何导致乐观且有偏的评估结果，强调验证方法无普适最优，独立单元须匹配部署目标，所有依赖数据的操作须排除估计性能所用的观测。
AI.motivation: 无效的数据划分会产生乐观且稳定的虚高性能评估，而现有实践（尤其在EEG、OCT、重复临床测量、多中心数据等场景）常忽视泄漏与依赖结构，缺少系统的可比对指导与可复现模板。
AI.method: 综述留出验证、训练/验证/测试设计、重复随机子抽样、k折与重复分层交叉验证、留一与留p法、分组感知验证及嵌套分组交叉验证；将通用机器学习原则映射到EEG epochs、配对眼OCT图像、重复临床测量与多中心数据；设计八个对照情景（七个使用锁定混淆矩阵与可审计指标，一个使用可复现的重复研究模拟），覆盖全局特征选择、归一化泄漏、依赖记录、中心混合、重复测试集使用与估计器不稳定；并考察偏差、方差、指标聚合、不确定性与计算成本，辅以数据规模矩阵、决策树与报告清单及MATLAB/scikit-learn模板。
AI.result: 八组对照显示，缺陷设计普遍产生乐观且稳定的性能估计，而泄漏安全设计给出更保守且更可信的结果；没有一种验证方法在所有情形下最优，其表现取决于数据结构与部署目标。
AI.conclusion: 独立单元必须与预期部署目标一致；所有依赖数据的操作（如特征选择、归一化）必须排除用于性能估计的观测；应结合数据规模矩阵、决策树与报告清单选择并透明报告验证设计。

title: EP-Flow: Disordered Crystal Structure Prediction without Site-Level Annotations
summary: Generative models have made rapid progress in ordered crystal structure prediction, yet many functional materials are intrinsically disordered, with substitutional mixing, vacancies, or interstitial species controlling their properties. Existing crystal generators either assume deterministic site occupations or require site-level disorder annotations, which are often unavailable when the chemical formula is the primary input. We formulate disordered crystal structure prediction through an Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), a continuous site-by-species representation that unifies ordered crystals, solid solutions, vacancy disorder, and interstitial occupancy. A valid ODM must satisfy coupled site-wise occupancy, mass-conservation, and non-negativity constraints, placing each sample on a formula-dependent transportation polytope. We propose Entropic Polytope Flow (EP-Flow), a marginal-constrained flow matching framework that canonicalizes heterogeneous polytopes into a shared double-centered space, learns a marginal-preserving flow, and recovers feasible occupancies through a Sinkhorn inverse map. By jointly generating occupancies, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters, EP-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance on formula-conditioned disordered CSP benchmarks derived from COD and MPDS, substantially outperforming adapted ordered-crystal generators. Analyses further show that EP-Flow recovers sparse and chemically meaningful local disorder patterns rather than merely matching global composition statistics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出占位分布矩阵（ODM）统一表示有序/无序晶体结构，并设计边缘约束流匹配框架 EP-Flow，将公式相关的运输多胞体规范化到双中心空间，经 Sinkhorn 逆映射恢复可行占位，实现公式条件下无序晶体结构预测的 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 功能材料常本质无序（取代混合、空位、间隙原子主导性质），而现有晶体生成器要么假设确定性占位，要么依赖位点级无序标注；当仅有化学式作为输入时，标注通常不可得，导致无序晶体结构预测缺乏统一且无需标注的生成框架。
AI.method: 1) 以占位分布矩阵（ODM）作为连续"位点×物种"表示，统一有序晶体、固溶体、空位无序与间隙占位；2) 有效 ODM 需满足逐位点占位、质量守恒与非负三重耦合约束，构成公式相关的运输多胞体；3) 提出熵多胞体流（EP-Flow）：将异质多胞体规范化为共享双中心空间，学习保边缘的流匹配，并用 Sinkhorn 逆映射恢复可行占位；4) 联合生成占位、分数坐标与晶格参数。
AI.result: 在基于 COD 与 MPDS 构建的公式条件无序 CSP 基准上达到 SOTA，显著优于适配后的有序晶体生成器；分析表明 EP-Flow 能恢复稀疏且化学上有意义的局部无序模式，而非仅拟合全局组分统计。
AI.conclusion: 通过 ODM 表示与 EP-Flow 的约束流建模范式，可在仅给定化学式的条件下生成满足占位、质量守恒与非负约束的无序晶体结构，为无序功能材料的逆向设计与结构预测提供了可行且无需位点级标注的通用方案。

title: Prediction-powered Neural Architecture Search
summary: Evaluating candidate architectures in neural architecture search (NAS) faces an inherent trade-off: on the one hand, reliable performance labels are limited because training and evaluating architectures is costly; on the other hand, zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) are cheap to compute at large scale but can be noisy. Yet, how to effectively combine these two sources of supervision remains unclear. In this paper, we propose PPNAS, a novel prediction-powered inference (PPI) approach for NAS. PPNAS fuses (1) a small set of architectures with observed performance labels and (2) a large set of architectures with ZCP information. To combine these two sources of supervision, PPNAS exploits the ordinal information provided by ZCPs to construct additional pairwise ranking supervision, while PPI debiases systematic discrepancies between ZCP-based and true performance rankings. We evaluate PPNAS in end-to-end predictor-based NAS, where it achieves state-of-the-art under limited evaluation budgets. To the best of our knowledge, PPNAS is the first prediction-powered approach for label-efficient NAS.

AI.tldr: PPNAS 提出一种预测驱动推断（PPI）方法用于神经架构搜索，融合少量真实性能标签与大量零成本代理（ZCP）信息，通过构建成对排序监督并去偏，实现标签高效且达到SOTA的预测式NAS。
AI.motivation: NAS中评估候选架构存在固有权衡：真实性能标签因训练评估代价高昂而稀缺，而ZCP虽可大规模廉价计算但噪声较大。如何有效结合这两类监督信号尚不明确，因此需要一种能同时利用二者的标签高效方法。
AI.method: PPNAS基于预测驱动推断（PPI）框架，融合两类监督：（1）带观测性能标签的小规模架构集合；（2）带ZCP信息的大规模架构集合。利用ZCP提供的序信息构建额外的成对排序监督，并借助PPI对ZCP排序与真实性能排序之间的系统性偏差进行去偏。
AI.result: 在端到端基于预测器的NAS中评估PPNAS，在有限评估预算下取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: PPNAS是首个面向标签高效NAS的预测驱动方法，验证了结合稀缺真实标签与大规模ZCP监督的有效性，为标签高效的架构搜索提供了新思路。

title: Feature Selective Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: Total Replacement versus Fixed-Budget Training
summary: Model collapse arises when generative models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models. The phenomenon has attracted considerable attention because of its societal and technical implications. However, previous studies have reached seemingly contradictory conclusions: replacing real data with synthetic data causes collapse (Shumailov et al.), yet accumulating real data alongside synthetic data can prevent it. For diffusion models, we study an intermediate regime typical of finite-budget pipelines: all past datasets and the real data are kept, but each new model is trained on a fixed-size sample from this growing pool, so the real fraction vanishes without any data being removed. Experiments on a 2D spiral dataset as well as the image benchmarks (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10) show that replacement protocol degrades dataset rapidly as in the literature, whereas the fixed budget degrades only partially, sparing some features. A linear-response model of the multi-generational parameter dynamics, analyzed by stochastic recursion, confirms that the two protocols differ: some features will be fragile and lost within a few generations for both protocols, while some will be robust and preserved over practically unbounded horizons under the fixed budget protocol.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究扩散模型在有限预算流水线中的数据复用场景：保留全部历史与真实数据但每代仅采样固定规模训练集，导致真实数据占比消失。实验与线性响应模型表明，替换协议会快速退化，而固定预算仅部分退化并保留部分特征。
AI.motivation: 既往关于模型崩溃的研究结论看似矛盾：一是用合成数据替换真实数据会导致崩溃，二是在合成数据中持续累积真实数据可以避免崩溃。作者希望在扩散模型上考察一种介于两者之间的"有限预算"机制，以厘清何种条件决定崩溃是否发生。
AI.method: 在2D螺旋数据集及MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10图像基准上，对扩散模型设计"替换协议"与"固定预算协议"对比实验：固定预算下保留所有历史数据集与真实数据，但每个新模型仅从不断增大的数据池中采样固定大小的训练子集，因此真实数据比例自然趋零而数据从未被删除。同时构建多代参数动态的线性响应模型，并用随机递归进行分析。
AI.result: 替换协议如文献所述使数据集迅速退化；固定预算协议仅发生部分退化，部分特征得以保留。线性响应模型通过随机递归分析证实两种协议存在本质差异：某些特征在两种协议下都脆弱，会在数代内丢失；而某些特征在固定预算协议下具有稳健性，可在几乎无界的代际范围内被保留。
AI.conclusion: 模型崩溃并非不可避免：即使真实数据未被删除、仅因固定采样预算而比例趋零，扩散模型的退化也是部分的、特征选择性的。特征可划分为脆弱与稳健两类，其存续取决于协议类型，这解释了此前看似矛盾的实验结果。

title: Robust Non-Clairvoyant Scheduling with Classification Models
summary: We study the classical single-machine scheduling problem of minimizing the sum of completion times of jobs in a non-clairvoyant setting, where the processing time of each job remains unknown until its completion. This is a hard problem for which no constant competitive algorithm is possible. Inspired by robust optimization and learning-augmented algorithms, we introduce a novel robustness framework that leverages structural information provided by a classification model to overcome this limitation. Specifically, we assume that jobs are partitioned into classes and we have access to the confusion matrix of the classifier, whose entry $(k,\ell)$ indicates the number of jobs predicted to belong to class~$k$ but that actually belong to class~$\ell$. In this manner, we are able to characterize uncertainty as a set of permutations within each predicted class, rather than as a collection of discrete numerical scenarios, avoiding the computational difficulty of classical robust metrics, such as Min-Max and Min-Max Regret. In addition to these worst-case metrics, we also consider the expected objective over all scenarios. We first propose an optimal non-adaptive strategy that is oblivious with respect to all three robust criteria. We then investigate adaptive and randomized algorithms, showing that they can outperform the optimal non-adaptive strategy when the matrix exhibits particular structural properties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非预知（non-clairvoyant）单机最小化总完工时间调度问题，利用分类模型提供的混淆矩阵构建鲁棒性框架，将不确定性刻画为各预测类内的排列集合，并设计在三类鲁棒准则下均最优的非自适应策略，同时探讨自适应与随机算法在特定矩阵结构下可超越该策略。
AI.motivation: 非预知设定下作业处理时间未知，该问题不存在常数竞争比的算法。受鲁棒优化与学习增强算法启发，作者希望借助机器学习分类器提供的结构信息，突破该问题的固有下界限制。
AI.method: 假设作业被划分到若干类，并已知分类器的混淆矩阵（第(k,ℓ)项表示被预测为类k而实际属于类ℓ的作业数）。据此将不确定性表示为各预测类内部的排列集合，而非离散数值情景集合，从而避免Min-Max与Min-Max Regret等经典鲁棒度量的计算困难。除最坏情况度量外，还考虑所有情景上的期望目标。方法上先给出对所有三种鲁棒准则均无感知（oblivious）的最优非自适应策略，再研究自适应与随机算法。
AI.result: 提出了一个最优的非自适应策略，该策略对三类鲁棒准则（Min-Max、Min-Max Regret及期望目标）均无感知且最优；进一步分析表明，当混淆矩阵具有特定结构性质时，自适应算法与随机算法能够优于该最优非自适应策略。
AI.conclusion: 通过分类模型混淆矩阵引入的结构信息，可在非预知调度中构造新的鲁棒框架，规避经典鲁棒度量的计算困难，并在保证最坏情况鲁棒性的同时，借助自适应性或随机化在特定结构下进一步提升性能。

title: Discrete Wasserstein Flows for One-Step Generative Modeling
summary: We introduce a new framework for one-step generative modelling on finite state spaces. To extend drifting beyond continuous domains, we use discrete Wasserstein geometry to define a target-relative KL gradient flow over the transitions of a reversible Markov kernel. We realize this probability flow at the particle level through Markov jumps and amortize the resulting transport updates into a latent-conditioned generator, so that the iterative dynamics are required only during training while inference remains one-step. In a controlled setting where the underlying distributions and transport dynamics can be computed exactly, we verify KL dissipation, consistency between the particle dynamics and the probability flow, and the predicted numerical scaling. We further show that a finite-capacity neural generator can track these exact transport targets while retaining one-step generation. These results validate the basic construction and provide a foundation for scaling Discrete Drifting to structured discrete data.

AI.tldr: 提出Discrete Drifting框架，借助离散Wasserstein几何定义目标相对的KL梯度流，实现有限状态空间上的一步生成建模。
AI.motivation: 将drifting方法从连续域推广到离散域，以支持结构化离散数据的一步生成。
AI.method: 利用离散Wasserstein几何，在可逆马尔可夫核的转移上定义目标相对的KL梯度流；通过马尔可夫跳跃在粒子层面实现该概率流，并将输运更新摊销到以隐变量为条件的生成器中，使迭代动力学仅用于训练、推理保持一步。
AI.result: 在分布与输运动力学可精确计算的受控设置中，验证了KL耗散、粒子动力学与概率流的一致性以及预测的数值缩放；有限容量的神经生成器能够跟踪精确的输运目标并保持一步生成。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了该基本构造，为将Discrete Drifting扩展到结构化离散数据提供了基础。

title: Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks for Systems with Multiple Asymptotically Stable Equilibria
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: AXIOM - Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning
summary: Stable port-Hamiltonian neural networks certify asymptotic stability by construction. Yet, their Hamiltonian is a global Lyapunov function with a single global minimum, so they can represent only dynamic systems with {one} attractor. We demonstrate that this excludes even simple systems with energy landscapes forming a double well, and we overcome the restriction by parametrising the Hamiltonian as a {product} of Bregman divergences generated by one input-convex network. We prove that the resulting model is locally Lyapunov stable, that the coexistence of stable equilibria forces additional non-asymptotically-stable equilibria to exist, that all equilibria lie in a bounded region, and under a hyperbolicity assumption that almost-everywhere stability holds. On three systems our approach is able to recover the energy surface characteristics and improve the convergence speed by 1.8$\times$-8.5$\times$.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用单个输入凸网络生成的Bregman散度乘积参数化Hamiltonian，突破稳定port-Hamiltonian神经网络仅能表示单吸引子系统的限制，可建模双井等复杂能量景观，并在三个系统上实现1.8×–8.5×的收敛加速。
AI.motivation: 稳定port-Hamiltonian神经网络通过构造保证渐近稳定，但其Hamiltonian是仅具单一全局极小值的全局Lyapunov函数，因此只能表示具有一个吸引子的动态系统。这一限制甚至无法涵盖能量景观呈双井结构的简单系统，亟需放宽该约束。
AI.method: 将Hamiltonian参数化为由一个输入凸网络生成的Bregman散度的乘积形式，从而构造具有多重极小值的Lyapunov函数。
AI.result: 证明了所得模型局部Lyapunov稳定；稳定平衡点的共存必然迫使额外的非渐近稳定平衡点存在；所有平衡点位于有界区域；在双曲性假设下几乎处处稳定成立。在三个系统上，该方法能够恢复能量面特征，并将收敛速度提升1.8×–8.5×。
AI.conclusion: 通过Bregman散度乘积参数化Hamiltonian，可在保持稳定性保证的同时突破单吸引子限制，刻画多平衡点能量景观，并获得收敛速度的显著提升。

title: From Redundancy to Minimality: Fixed-Point-Guided Hierarchical Reduction of Learned Piecewise-Linear Dynamics
summary: Understanding a nonlinear dynamical system from time series requires not only reproducing its trajectories, but also identifying a simple representation that preserves its essential dynamical structure. Almost-linear recurrent neural networks (AL-RNNs) are piecewise-linear RNNs in which only a subset of units use ReLU nonlinearities, so that nonlinear capacity is explicitly controlled by the number of ReLU units. Their activation patterns define linear regions, represented as symbols, whose observed transitions form a symbolic transition graph. However, directly training AL-RNNs with few ReLU units to realize minimal dynamical representations can be unreliable. We ask whether an AL-RNN with more ReLU units can instead be trained first and systematically reduced to a minimal dynamical representation. We introduce a fixed-point-guided hierarchical reduction procedure that progressively linearizes selected ReLU units, merging neighboring linear regions and graph nodes while preserving distinct symbols containing fixed points (FPs). The resulting reduction tree defines a hierarchy of progressively simpler candidates. Each reduced candidate is initialized from the parent parameters and retrained under guidance from the parent dynamics. We also prove that reproducing $Q$ distinct fixed points requires at least $Q$ FP-containing symbols, providing a certificate of symbol-level minimality when this bound is attained. On the 3-scroll Chua system, direct training with the theoretical minimum of three ReLU units achieves high-fidelity minimal realizations in only 20% of seeds, whereas our learn-reduce-retrain strategy increases the seed-macro success rate to approximately 71% at the same final nonlinear capacity. These results show that redundant nonlinear capacity can serve as a scaffold for discovering and realizing minimal dynamical representations.

AI.tldr: 提出定点引导的层次化缩减流程，把先用较多ReLU单元训练好的AL-RNN逐步线性化，在保持含定点符号的前提下合并线性区域与图节点，形成可从父代初始化并重训的候选层级，并用符号级最小性界作为最优性凭证；在3卷Chua系统上把达到最小实现成功率从20%提升到约71%。
AI.motivation: 直接从时间序列训练仅含极少数ReLU单元的AL-RNN以获得最小动力学表示不稳定；作者转而探索"先用冗余非线性容量训练、再系统缩减到最小表示"的可行性。
AI.method: 定义AL-RNN（部分单元使用ReLU的分段线性RNN），其激活模式对应线性区域与符号，符号转移构成转移图。提出定点引导的层次化缩减：逐步线性化选定ReLU单元，合并相邻线性区域与图节点，但保留包含定点的不同符号，得到缩减树与逐步简化的候选；每个候选从父代参数初始化并在父代动力学指导下重训。理论证明重现Q个不同定点至少需要Q个含定点符号，达到该界即为符号级最小性证书。
AI.result: 在3卷Chua系统上，直接以理论最少的3个ReLU单元训练仅在20%的随机种子中取得高保真最小实现；而先学习-缩减-重训策略在相同最终非线性容量下将种子宏观成功率提升至约71%。
AI.conclusion: 冗余非线性容量可作为发现并实现最小动力学表示的"脚手架"；定点引导的层次化缩减与重训能可靠地获得符号级最小的动力学表示。

title: Learning Commute-Time-Preserving World Models for Planning
summary: World models allow agents to plan in latent space by choosing a sequence of actions that most reduces the distance to a given goal state. Thus, planning can benefit from latent representations whose distances mirror commute-times in the environment. The spectral embedding space of the graph Laplacian provides such a representation, if it obeys a specific eigenvalue-dependent scaling. Unfortunately, instantiating the graph Laplacian is intractable in large, continuous environments. Self-supervised learning offers a natural route to such commute-time-preserving embeddings at scale. However, here we show that existing methods, which commonly encourage isotropic representations to prevent representational collapse, tend to degrade the "correct" eigenvalue-dependent scaling, leading to an inaccurate representation of commute times. To address this problem, we introduce Commute-Time-Preserving World Models (CTWMs), combining a latent displacement predictor and a log-determinant regularizer that prevents collapse, which provably recover the correctly scaled Laplacian representation under reversible deterministic dynamics and at the predictor's fixed point. In numerical simulations, CTWM matches or outperforms LeWM, a task-agnostic baseline, on several complex, continuous goal-reaching benchmarks, while using half the parameters.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为CTWM的world model，通过latent displacement predictor与log-determinant regularizer的组合，在可逆确定性dynamics及predictor不动点条件下可证明地恢复出正确缩放的Laplacian表示，从而在连续环境中保持commute-time结构；在多个复杂连续goal-reaching基准上以半数参数匹配或超越无任务先验的LeWM基线。
AI.motivation: World model通过在latent space中选择能最大程度缩小与目标状态距离的动作序列来做规划，因此规划质量依赖于latent representation的距离是否与environment中的commute-time（通勤时间）一致。graph Laplacian的spectral embedding天然提供这种表示，但需要满足特定的特征值相关缩放。然而在大型连续环境中显式构造graph Laplacian不可行，故需借助self-supervised learning。现有方法常用isotropic表示防止representational collapse，但这种做法会破坏正确的特征值缩放，导致commute-time表示不准。
AI.method: 提出Commute-Time-Preserving World Models（CTWMs），包含两部分：一个latent displacement predictor，以及一个用于防止collapse的log-determinant regularizer。二者结合，在可逆确定性dynamics下，并在predictor的fixed point处，可证明地恢复出正确缩放的Laplacian representation。
AI.result: 在数值仿真中，CTWM在多个复杂连续goal-reaching基准上匹配或超越任务无关基线LeWM，且仅使用后者一半的参数。
AI.conclusion: 以log-determinant正则替代isotropic约束，可在避免representational collapse的同时保留commute-time所需的特征值相关缩放，从而获得更准确的latent规划空间，并在参数效率上具优势。

title: Action-On-Item Preference Flow: A Shared Event Schema for Predictive and Generative Personalization
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Author-prepared archival version with expanded discussion and interpretation
summary: A user's movie, news, and dialogue histories differ in their native actions and outputs, yet each interaction supplies evidence that can update user memory. We study whether these histories can train one reusable update mechanism. An action-on-item schema pairs a mapped interaction role with a content embedding, allowing shared update parameters to operate on separate user states. We establish invariance to native relabeling, bounded state changes under item-embedding perturbations, and a pooled-training bound under explicit compatibility conditions. The Multi-Timescale State Hypothesis (MTSH) specifies how this evidence enters, persists, and is consumed; PerTIDE implements it with action gating, three state-space traces, fusion, and command-conditioned readout. On PENS, the same history encoder supports both next-news prediction and personalized headline generation. In a controlled PENS-to-MovieLens experiment, a frozen source-trained core exceeds an identically structured random core by 15.23 MRR points after fitting the same target consumer. On MIND, PerTIDE retains a 4.12-point MRR advantage over a same-input three-branch state-space control. Action, readout, and trace interventions identify complementary contributions to these gains. Together, the theory and experiments support learning history updates across compatible sources and reusing them through predictive and generative consumers.

AI.tldr: 用户在不同场景（电影、新闻、对话）的交互历史形态各异，但都能更新用户记忆。本文提出可复用的统一更新机制，以"动作-物品"模式配对交互角色与内容嵌入，并给出理论保证与实现PerTIDE。
AI.motivation: 电影、新闻、对话等用户历史在原生动作与输出上各不相同，难以直接迁移；但每种交互都提供了可更新用户记忆的证据。作者希望探究这些异构历史能否共同训练一个可复用的更新机制，从而实现跨源迁移与统一更新。
AI.method: 提出"动作-物品"（action-on-item）模式：将映射后的交互角色与内容嵌入配对，使共享更新参数作用于分离的用户状态。理论上证明对原生重标记的不变性、物品嵌入扰动下有界状态变化，以及在显式兼容条件下的池化训练界。提出多时间尺度状态假设（MTSH），并用PerTIDE实现：动作门控、三条状态空间迹、融合与命令条件读出。
AI.result: 在PENS上，同一历史编码器同时支持下一新闻预测与个性化标题生成。受控的PENS到MovieLens实验中，冻结的源训练核心在适配同一目标用户后，比结构相同的随机核心高出15.23 MRR点。在MIND上，PerTIDE相比同输入的三分支状态空间对照模型保持4.12 MRR点优势。动作、读出与迹的干预实验表明三者贡献互补。
AI.conclusion: 理论与实验共同支持：在兼容来源间学习历史更新，并通过预测型与生成型消费者复用该更新机制是可行的。

title: Minimax Optimal Regret for Causal Logistic Bandits with Counterfactual Fairness
summary: We study causal logistic bandits with counterfactual fairness constraints. The causal structure is given through known factual and counterfactual feature maps that share an unknown logistic reward parameter, but the learner observes only factual rewards. Consequently, the directions determining counterfactual feasibility need not be identifiable from the available feedback. The closest prior analyses either omit a coverage condition or impose a comparatively strong one, and do not establish matching lower bounds. We first show that some coverage condition is necessary: without a coverage-type restriction, factually indistinguishable environments with different optimal fair actions force $Ω(T)$ expected joint loss. Under a weaker full-rank condition on the factual covariance pooled across actions, we identify a target-specific information scale $V_\star$ that measures the difficulty of estimating rewards and counterfactual effects from factual feedback. We construct worst-case families satisfying this condition on which every policy incurs expected joint loss $Ω\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}\right)$. We also give an explore--then--exploit procedure tuned using $V_\star$ and an adaptive algorithm that does not require its value. Both algorithms achieve $\max\{R_T,V_T\}=\widetilde{O}\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}+κd/σ_0^2\right)$, where $R_T$ is regret relative to the best fair action and $V_T$ denotes the cumulative stage-wise positive violations. Thus the upper and lower bounds match in their leading dependence on $T$, $V_\star$, and $\min\{\log K,d\}$, up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带反事实公平约束的因果逻辑斯蒂强盗。证明覆盖条件是必要的，在较弱满秩条件下识别出信息尺度 $V_\star$，给出 $\Omega([V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}]^{1/3}T^{2/3})$ 下界，并设计两种达到匹配上界的算法。
AI.motivation: 因果逻辑斯蒂强盗中学习者仅能观测事实奖励，决定反事实可行性的方向未必可从反馈中辨识。既有分析要么缺少覆盖条件，要么施加过强条件，且未建立匹配下界。作者旨在厘清覆盖条件的必要性，并在更弱假设下给出紧致的最优速率刻画。
AI.method: 问题设定中因果结构由共享未知逻辑斯蒂奖励参数的事实与反事实特征映射给出，仅观测事实奖励。首先证明若无覆盖类限制，存在事实不可区分但最优公平动作不同的环境导致 $\Omega(T)$ 损失。随后在跨动作合并的事实协方差满秩（较弱的）条件下，定义目标特定的信息尺度 $V_\star$ 以度量从事实反馈估计奖励与反事实效应的难度。基于 $V_\star$ 构造最坏情形族以证明下界；并设计两种算法：一种用 $V_\star$ 调参的探索-再利用算法，一种无需其值的自适应算法。
AI.result: 下界：在满足满秩条件的最坏情形族上，任意策略的期望联合损失为 $\Omega([V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}]^{1/3}T^{2/3})$。上界：两种算法均达到 $\max\{R_T,V_T\}=\widetilde{O}([V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}]^{1/3}T^{2/3}+\kappa d/\sigma_0^2)$，其中 $R_T$ 为相对最优公平动作的遗憾，$V_T$ 为累积分阶段正违规量。上下界在 $T$、$V_\star$ 与 $\min\{\log K,d\}$ 的主阶依赖上匹配（至对数因子）。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖条件是反事实公平因果逻辑斯蒂强盗可学习性的必要条件；在较弱满秩条件下，$V_\star$ 准确刻画了从事实反馈估计奖励与反事实效应的信息难度。所提探索-再利用与自适应算法达到与下界匹配的最优速率 $\widetilde{O}([V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}]^{1/3}T^{2/3})$，实现了速率最优性。

title: Robust Evidential Learning Through Latent Consistency
summary: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for deploying deep learning models in high-stakes settings, where out-of-distribution and adversarial inputs can induce confident but unreliable predictions. Evidential Deep Learning provides efficient uncertainty estimates in a single forward pass, but can still assign high evidential strength to inputs that are poorly supported by the learned representation, such as adversarial inputs. We introduce CLEAR, a lightweight, task-agnostic post-hoc method that improves evidential robustness without retraining or altering the base prediction. Using held-out calibration data, CLEAR characterises the group-conditioned geometry of the model's latent space. At inference, it efficiently generates perturbation views directly in the latent space and measures their conflict relative to the calibrated geometry of the predicted group. High latent conflict indicates unsupported evidence, which CLEAR uses to selectively reduce evidential strength while retaining evidence for latent-consistent inputs. On ImageNet$\rightarrow$CUB, CLEAR improves OOD and adversarial AUROC by $+8.29$ and $+5.01$ while running 17.4$\times$ faster than competing post-hoc methods while preserving predictive performance across classification, regression, and object detection benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CLEAR是一种轻量、任务无关的事后方法，通过在校准数据上刻画潜空间的分组几何结构，在推理时于潜空间生成扰动视图并度量冲突，从而选择性降低不受支持的证据强度，提升证据深度学习的不确定性鲁棒性，无需重训练或改变预测。
AI.motivation: 证据深度学习（EDL）虽能在单次前向传播中高效估计不确定性，但对分布外和对抗性输入仍可能赋予过高的证据强度（即"自信但不可靠"的预测），这对高风险场景下的部署构成威胁。因此需要一种不重训练即可提升证据鲁棒性的方法。
AI.method: CLEAR为事后、任务无关的轻量方法：1）利用留出的校准数据刻画模型潜空间的分组条件几何结构；2）推理时直接在潜空间中高效生成扰动视图；3）度量这些视图相对于预测所属组校准几何的冲突；4）高潜空间冲突指示证据不受支持，据此选择性降低证据强度，而对潜空间一致的输入保留证据。全程不重训练、不改变基础预测。
AI.result: 在ImageNet→CUB上，CLEAR将OOD和对抗AUROC分别提升+8.29和+5.01，速度比竞争的事后方法快17.4倍；在分类、回归和目标检测基准上均保持预测性能。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR通过潜空间几何冲突检测，有效提升了EDL对OOD和对抗输入的鲁棒性，兼具高效性与任务通用性，且不损害原有预测性能，适用于高风险场景下的不确定性量化。

title: AF-Muon: An AdamW-Free Muon Optimizer for Tied-Embedding Models
comment: 63 pages, 19 figures. An earlier, shorter version of this work was accepted as a poster at the OPT 2026 workshop (Optimization for Machine Learning) at NeurIPS 2026; this is the complete version
summary: Muon improves large-scale training by applying a spectral-norm steepest-descent update to matrix parameters, but practical models also contain parameter blocks that do not fit dense-matrix geometry. One important case is the tied vocabulary table, which appears in language models and other token generators and can receive multiple structurally different gradient sources, from sparse input lookups to dense output-classifier updates. In the reference recipe these blocks are handed to an auxiliary AdamW optimizer, which restores second-moment state and updates the aliased table as a generic tensor. We propose AF-Muon, an AdamW-free extension of Muon that keeps the Muon matrix update for hidden weight matrices while using a support-aware finite-cap linear minimization oracle for tied vocabulary tables and an RMS-normalized update for one-dimensional auxiliary parameters. AF-Muon therefore trains every parameter class with a single first-moment buffer and no second-moment state, saving around 20% optimizer-state memory relative to Hybrid Muon in our benchmark. Across nine tied-token settings - decoder-only language models from 124M to 1B parameters, a fully shared T5-style encoder-decoder, and ImageGPT-style image-token, protein, and sparse-MoE variants, spanning text, image, and protein-sequence data - AF-Muon improves mean validation loss and perplexity over both Hybrid Muon and a SCION-style Sign endpoint. Long-horizon runs and hyperparameter sensitivity studies confirm the gain is robust, and identical-momentum diagnostics attribute it to the finite cap, which preserves more within-row magnitude than Sign while bounding the coordinate concentration of row-RMS. These results identify tied vocabulary tables as a distinct optimizer geometry and yield a robust AdamW-free Muon variant across models, modalities, and architectures, with about 1% step-time overhead in matched training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AF-Muon，一种无需 AdamW 的 Muon 扩展，通过对绑定词表采用支持感知有限上限线性最小化预言机、隐藏权重沿用 Muon 矩阵更新、一维参数用 RMS 归一化更新，实现单一一阶动量缓冲、无二阶状态的统一优化。
AI.motivation: Muon 通过谱范数最速下降更新改善大规模训练，但实际模型含不适用稠密矩阵几何的参数块，典型如绑定词表，其梯度来源结构异构（稀疏输入查表与稠密输出分类器更新），参考方案将其交给辅助 AdamW，重新引入二阶矩状态并以通用张量方式更新别名表。
AI.method: AF-Muon：隐藏权重矩阵保留 Muon 矩阵更新；绑定词表使用支持感知的有限上限线性最小化预言机；一维辅助参数采用 RMS 归一化更新；整体仅用单一 first-moment buffer，不维护 second-moment 状态。
AI.result: 相较 Hybrid Muon 节省约 20% 优化器状态内存；在九个绑定 token 设置（124M–1B 解码器语言模型、全共享 T5 式编解码器、ImageGPT 式图像 token、蛋白质及稀疏 MoE 变体，涵盖文本、图像、蛋白质序列）上，平均验证损失与困惑度均优于 Hybrid Muon 和 SCION 式 Sign 端点；长程运行与超参敏感性研究确认增益稳健；相同动量诊断归因于有限上限，比 Sign 保留更多行内幅度，同时约束行 RMS 的坐标集中度。
AI.conclusion: 绑定词表构成一种独立优化器几何；AF-Muon 是跨模型、模态与架构稳健的 AdamW-free Muon 变体，匹配训练下步时开销约 1%。

title: Reusing Past Samples in Proximal Policy Optimization: When and How Does It Help?
summary: Among on-policy deep reinforcement learning methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has become the de facto standard, due to its consistently strong empirical performance across diverse application domains. However, on-policy methods are inherently sample inefficient: fresh data collected under the current policy is used for just a few updates before being discarded. Off-policy methods avoid this inefficiency via experience replay, achieving notable sample efficiency gains, but at the cost of training instabilities or extensive tuning. This motivated the rise of hybrid strategies that augment PPO with off-policy data reuse. Existing sample-reuse variants of PPO demonstrated improved sample efficiency over vanilla PPO, yet a systematic study of when reuse helps, in which scenarios, and to what extent remains missing. In this work, we study the effectiveness of sample reuse in PPO by instantiating two variants within a multiple importance weighting framework. Both retain the core PPO mechanics, reusing only samples from a window of recent iterations, thereby isolating the effect of data reuse from other factors. The variants, termed wPPO-U and wPPO-BH, employ vanilla importance weights or balance-heuristic-corrected ones, respectively. For both, we derive policy improvement lower bounds providing theoretical grounding for their respective losses. We use them to empirically study when and how data reuse improves sample efficiency or final performance of PPO across continuous control tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文在多重重要性加权框架下实例化两种PPO样本重用变体（wPPO-U与wPPO-BH），仅重用近若干迭代的样本以隔离数据重用的影响，并推导策略改进下界，进而在连续控制任务上系统研究数据重用对PPO样本效率与最终性能的作用条件与程度。
AI.motivation: PPO作为on-policy深度强化学习的事实标准，样本效率低（每次采集的新数据仅更新几次即被丢弃）；off-policy方法虽通过经验回放提升样本效率，却带来训练不稳定与调参负担。已有的混合策略（PPO+off-policy数据重用）虽显示样本效率提升，但缺乏对"数据重用何时有用、在何种场景有用、有用到什么程度"的系统性研究。
AI.method: 在多重重要性加权（multiple importance weighting）框架下实例化两种保留PPO核心机制的变体，仅重用最近若干迭代窗口内的样本，以将数据重用的影响与其他因素隔离：wPPO-U使用原始重要性权重，wPPO-BH使用平衡启发式（balance-heuristic）校正后的权重。针对两者分别推导策略改进下界，为各自的损失函数提供理论依据。
AI.result: 在连续控制任务上开展了实证研究，系统刻画了数据重用改善PPO样本效率或最终性能的条件与方式；两种变体均获得策略改进下界的理论支撑。
AI.conclusion: 通过在统一的多重重要性加权框架下隔离并对比两种重用变体，本文为PPO中样本重用的有效性提供了理论下界与实践层面的系统性评估，明确了重用带来收益的场景与边界。

title: Why Does Train-Validation Separation Emerge? Update-Pressure Density Dynamics in Pretrained Backbones
summary: Train-validation separation is the evolving difference between performance on observed training examples and a finite held-out validation set.
