AI.result: 发现四点：(1)损失平均隐含对响应加权，token平均偏向长响应，领域等权仍保留域内加权；(2)Adam一阶矩缩小参数更新差异，教师间余弦相似度0.83，平均规则间达0.96；(3)BF16舍入掩盖微小变化，约97% FP32主权重偏离初始化，而仅7-11% BF16权重如此；(4)top-64交集KL梯度与Qwen全词表梯度高度接近，但任务效果依赖平均方式——数学准确率在响应平均下比采样token策略梯度高2.6分，在全局token平均下低2.1分。
AI.conclusion: 教师信号的影响受平均规则、优化器动量、数值精度及梯度近似共同调制，MOPD设计需审慎考虑这些因素以实现有效的多教师知识融合。

title: SoftServe: A Scalable Quasi-Newton Method for Deep Learning
summary: Quasi-Newton (QN) methods have long been among the most effective methods for large-scale unconstrained convex optimization. Two obstacles have limited their use in deep learning: non-convexity and enormous parameter sizes. We introduce SoftServe, a family of QN methods designed to overcome these obstacles without line searches or ad hoc curvature corrections. SoftServe derives positivedefinite curvature estimates from the variational objective of Berglund et al. (2025), even in the presence of negative curvature. We develop diagonal and Kroneckerfactored variants that preserve positive definiteness by construction and scale to massive neural networks. Finally, SoftServe relies on the stable coupled Newton-Schulz iteration for the required matrix operations, replacing costly matrix decompositions with GPU-friendly matrix multiplications. SoftServe excels on problems that are severely ill-conditioned, including tasks such as recurrent networks, deep autoencoders, physics-informed neural networks, and a 136M-parameter physics-informed diffusion model, often achieving lower losses than established baselines including Adam, Muon, and SOAP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SoftServe，一族面向深度学习的拟牛顿方法，无需线搜索或启发式曲率修正，通过变分目标构建正定曲率估计，并设计对角与 Kronecker 分解变体，结合 Newton-Schulz 迭代实现高效矩阵运算，在多种病态问题上优于 Adam、Muon 和 SOAP。
AI.motivation: 拟牛顿方法在大规模无约束凸优化中十分有效，但在深度学习中受两大障碍限制：目标函数的非凸性以及参数量极其庞大。现有方法通常依赖线搜索或启发式的曲率修正，难以适用于深度网络。
AI.method: SoftServe 从 Berglund 等人（2025）的变分目标中推导正定曲率估计，即使在存在负曲率的情况下也能保持正定。作者开发了对角与 Kronecker 分解两种变体，通过构造保证正定性并可扩展至超大规模神经网络。此外，该方法采用稳定的耦合 Newton-Schulz 迭代完成所需矩阵运算，以 GPU 友好的矩阵乘法替代代价高昂的矩阵分解。
AI.result: SoftServe 在严重病态问题上表现优异，包括循环网络、深度自编码器、物理信息神经网络以及一个 1.36 亿参数的物理信息扩散模型，其损失通常低于 Adam、Muon 和 SOAP 等已有基线。
AI.conclusion: SoftServe 无需线搜索或启发式曲率修正，即可将拟牛顿方法有效扩展至深度学习，通过正定曲率估计与高效矩阵运算，在病态优化任务上取得优于主流基线的效果。

title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free
summary: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops. Each loop yields an intermediate representation decodable for the same next token, yet standard decoding discards earlier states. Because earlier loops embody less computation, recurrence inherently supplies aligned weak-and-strong prediction pairs without auxiliary models or external training. We introduce LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that guides token selection by contrasting the final prediction with an earlier recurrent pass, operating either in logit space with one extra output pass (LoopCD-Logits) or in hidden-state space with zero output overhead (LoopCD-Hidden). Across four looped Transformer families, LoopCD delivers substantial, consistent gains at full recurrent depth: LoopCD-Logits raises Ouro-2.6B-Thinking's AIME 2024 pass@1 from 61.88% to 73.33%, while LoopCD-Hidden lifts Huginn's HumanEval pass@1 from 22.56% to 31.71%. Crucially, these performance gains enable halving the number of recurrent loops while still matching or exceeding full-depth unguided baselines, reducing forward FLOPs by 22.5% to 48.2%. By transforming intermediate recurrent states into effective guidance signals, LoopCD achieves superior decoding quality while substantially reducing inference compute.

AI.tldr: LoopCD 是一种免训练的对比解码框架，利用循环 Transformer 的中间循环状态作为弱预测，与最终强预测对比以引导解码，在提升解码质量的同时可将循环深度减半并降低 22.5%–48.2% 的前向 FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复执行共享块实现参数高效，每个循环都会产生可用于预测同一 next token 的中间表示，但标准解码丢弃了早期状态。由于早期循环蕴含的计算更少，循环结构天然提供了对齐的"弱-强"预测对，无需辅助模型或额外训练即可用于对比解码。
AI.method: 提出 LoopCD，一种免训练的对比解码框架：将最终预测与较早的循环前向结果进行对比来引导 token 选择。包含两种变体——LoopCD-Logits 在 logit 空间操作（需一次额外输出前向），LoopCD-Hidden 在隐状态空间操作（无额外输出开销）。方法在四个循环 Transformer 家族上进行验证。
AI.result: 在全循环深度下取得一致且显著的增益：LoopCD-Logits 将 Ouro-2.6B-Thinking 的 AIME 2024 pass@1 从 61.88% 提升至 73.33%；LoopCD-Hidden 将 Huginn 的 HumanEval pass@1 从 22.56% 提升至 31.71%。此外，这些增益使循环次数减半后仍能匹配或超越全深度无引导基线，前向 FLOPs 减少 22.5%–48.2%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将中间循环状态转化为有效的引导信号，LoopCD 在实现更优解码质量的同时大幅降低推理计算量，证明了循环结构中"被浪费"的中间状态可作为免训练对比解码的天然监督来源。

title: Higher-Order Molecular Grammars for Generative and Foundation Models in Chemistry
summary: Molecular learning models are strongly shaped by their underlying representations. Yet standard sequential and graph formalisms struggle to explicitly encode higher-order topology, such as ring systems and recurring motifs. Existing higher-order representations can capture these structures directly, but they are often computationally demanding and difficult to decode into valid molecules. Here, we introduce Higher-order Grammar Representation (HGR), a principled, topology-aware framework that lifts molecules to combinatorial complexes and parses each complex into a compact sequence of production rules under a context-free higher-order grammar. By serialising higher-order topology into rule sequences, HGR makes these structures directly compatible with standard sequence models, avoiding the computational overhead of explicit higher-order encodings while preserving topological expressiveness. To reduce benchmark bias towards simple ring systems, we construct RingDiv, a ring-enriched benchmark containing 1.18 million molecules, including the curated RingDiv300k subset, and introduce the ring diversity index (RDI) to quantify ring-system coverage. In molecular generation, HGR-based models uniquely combine 100% validity by construction with leading distributional alignment, ranking first in FCD on all five generation benchmarks. In representation learning, HGR-FM achieves the highest mean AUC across seven MoleculeNet benchmarks under both transfer protocols, improving on the strongest baseline by 8.3 and 3.3 AUC points under probing and full fine-tuning, respectively. Collectively, these results establish HGR as an efficient higher-order representation for molecular generation and transferable representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高阶语法表示（HGR），将分子提升为组合复形并用上下文无关高阶语法解析为产生式规则序列，使高阶拓扑结构可与标准序列模型兼容；同时构建RingDiv环富集基准并提出环多样性指数（RDI）。实验表明HGR在生成任务上兼具100%有效性与最优分布对齐，在表示学习任务上取得最高平均AUC。
AI.motivation: 标准序列与图表示难以显式编码环系统、重复基序等高阶拓扑；已有高阶表示虽可直接捕捉这些结构，但计算开销大且难以解码为有效分子。此外，现有基准偏向简单环系统，存在评估偏差。
AI.method: HGR：将分子提升为组合复形，并在上下文无关高阶语法下把复形解析为紧凑的产生式规则序列，从而将高阶拓扑序列化，兼容标准序列模型，兼顾拓扑表达能力与计算效率。同时构建RingDiv基准（含118万分子及RingDiv300k子集），并提出环多样性指数（RDI）量化环系统覆盖度。
AI.result: 分子生成：基于HGR的模型在构造上保证100%有效性，同时分布对齐领先，在全部五个生成基准上FCD排名第一。表示学习：HGR-FM在七项MoleculeNet基准上、两种迁移协议下均取得最高平均AUC，在探测与全量微调下分别较最强基线提升8.3和3.3个AUC点。
AI.conclusion: HGR是一种高效的高阶分子表示，适用于分子生成与可迁移表示学习，并通过RingDiv与RDI缓解了基准对简单环系统的偏置。

title: Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features
summary: Intrinsically disordered protein regions (IDRs) play central roles in cellular processes such as transcriptional regulation, signal transduction, and subcellular localization, yet their functional design remains challenging. Structure-based design methods do not readily apply to IDRs, and existing protein language models are trained on full-length protein sequences, thus learning a prior that is biased towards folded domains. Here, we present IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on IDiom-DB, a dataset of 54 million predicted IDRs curated from the AlphaFold Database. IDiom generates diverse sequences that recapitulate the composition, patterning, motifs, and predicted disorder of natural IDRs. To control function-associated sequence patterns, we also introduce reinforcement learning with sparse autoencoder features (RL-SAE), a post-training method that rewards the generation of sequences that activate specified feature sets. Across eight IDR design tasks, RL-SAE sequences activate, on average, 90% of 30 targeted features, compared to 24% for activation steering. We demonstrate that RL-SAE improves the predicted subcellular localization and transcriptional activity of generated IDRs compared to steering and supervised fine-tuning, and enables features associated with distinct biological functions to be combined within individual sequences. Thus, IDiom and RL-SAE enable interpretable and composable IDR design through explicit control of function-associated sequence features. More broadly, RL-SAE could extend to other protein design settings where interpretable features provide useful design targets. Code is available at https://github.com/rotskoff-group/idiom.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出IDiom（基于AlphaFold预测IDR数据集训练的IDR专用自回归蛋白语言模型）及RL-SAE后训练方法，实现对内在无序区功能相关序列特征的可解释、可组合设计。
AI.motivation: 内在无序区（IDRs）在转录调控、信号转导和亚细胞定位等细胞过程中作用关键，但功能设计困难：基于结构的设计方法难以适用于IDRs，而现有蛋白语言模型在全长序列上训练，其先验偏向折叠结构域。因此亟需面向IDR的专用建模与可控生成方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建IDiom-DB数据集，包含从AlphaFold Database中筛选的5400万条预测IDR；2) 训练自回归蛋白语言模型IDiom；3) 提出RL-SAE（基于稀疏自编码器特征的强化学习）后训练方法，以激活指定特征集为奖励信号，实现功能相关序列模式的显式控制。
AI.result: IDiom可生成在组成、模式、基序及预测无序度上与天然IDR相似的多样序列。在8项IDR设计任务中，RL-SAE生成序列平均激活30个目标特征中的90%，而activation steering仅为24%；在预测亚细胞定位与转录活性方面优于steering和监督微调，并能将不同生物功能相关特征组合于单条序列中。
AI.conclusion: IDiom与RL-SAE通过显式控制功能相关序列特征，实现了可解释、可组合的IDR设计；RL-SAE有望推广至其他以可解释特征为设计目标的蛋白设计场景。代码已开源。

title: Trust the Direction, Search the Step: Zero-and-First-Order Methods for LLM Fine-Tuning
comment: Accepted to 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Code: https://github.com/nizswan/Zeroth-First-Order-Framework
summary: Step-size selection remains a central challenge in large-scale neural network optimization; conservative steps slow convergence, while aggressive steps can destabilize it. We combine \textbf{Z}ero-and-\textbf{F}irst-\textbf{O}rder optimization~(ZFO) and propose a lightweight framework that decouples direction selection from step-size. ZFO uses a trusted first-order optimizer to determine the direction and performs zeroth-order evaluations only along this one-dimensional subspace to choose how far to move. Using the current {gradient information} and two additional objective function evaluations, ZFO instances construct a local model of the objective function along the proposed direction and select a curvature-aware step within a bounded search interval. This yields an adaptive step-selection mechanism that costs less than a full line search. We provide theoretical guarantees to show that shared-sample evaluations produce reliable finite-difference curvature estimates, that the induced local model selects a near-optimal step along the search interval, and that ZFO converges to a neighborhood of a stationary point. Across the evaluated settings, language models and datasets, ZFO frequently improves optimization and final performance relative to fixed-step first-order baselines, with the magnitude and preferred local model depending on the objective. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/nizswan/Zeroth-First-Order-Framework.

AI.tldr: ZFO将方向选择与步长解耦：由一阶优化器定方向，沿该一维子空间做零阶评估，用梯度信息与两次函数评估构造局部模型，在有限区间内选曲率感知步长，代价低于完整线搜索。
AI.motivation: 大规模神经网络优化中步长选择是核心难题：步长保守导致收敛慢，步长激进则引起训练不稳定。传统线搜索代价较高，需要更轻量且自适应的步长选择机制。
AI.method: 提出ZFO（Zero-and-First-Order）轻量框架，解耦方向选择与步长：用可信的一阶优化器确定更新方向，仅沿该一维子空间做零阶函数评估；结合当前梯度信息与两次额外目标函数评估，沿该方向构造目标的局部模型，并在有界搜索区间内选择曲率感知的自适应步长。配套给出理论保证：共享样本评估可产生可靠的有限差分曲率估计，局部模型在搜索区间内选出近最优步长，且ZFO收敛至驻点邻域。
AI.result: 在多种实验设置、语言模型与数据集上，ZFO相比固定步长的一阶基线常能改善优化过程与最终性能；改善幅度与偏好的局部模型类型依赖具体目标函数。
AI.conclusion: ZFO以低于完整线搜索的开销实现自适应、曲率感知的步长选择，并在理论与实践上验证了其可靠性与收敛性，为大规模神经网络优化提供了一种有效且轻量的步长选择方案。代码已开源。

title: The Missing Primitive: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated striking capabilities on frontier mathematical problems, it remains unclear whether they possess the structural mathematical understanding underlying their solutions. In this paper, we take a first step toward systematically studying mathematical understanding in LLMs, from diagnosing its distinct capabilities to leveraging these findings to improve post-training. First, we introduce the notion of Mathematical Primitive to probe structural mathematical understanding and propose \hlei{}, a novel benchmark that evaluates mathematical reasoning along four distinct dimensions: Discovery, Generation, Digestion, and Execution. Second, our systematic diagnosis shows that solution accuracy masks distinct capability profiles, primitives unlock substantial latent execution capacity, and Discovery is the dominant bottleneck in mathematical reasoning. Our post-training analysis further shows that discovery-limited failures are particularly amenable to repair. Finally, building on these findings, we introduce \abs{}, a primitive-privileged self-distillation framework that selectively transfers primitive-guided reasoning into the student model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \abs{} consistently improves mathematical reasoning over baselines across model scales and challenging benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"数学基元"概念与四维评测基准,系统诊断LLM的数学理解能力,并基于发现提出基元优先的自蒸馏框架以提升推理表现。
AI.motivation: LLM在前沿数学问题上表现突出,但是否具备支撑其解答的结构性数学理解尚不明确。作者希望系统研究这一理解能力,并将诊断结论用于改进后训练。
AI.method: 1) 提出"数学基元(Mathematical Primitive)"概念以探测结构性数学理解,并构建涵盖发现、生成、消化、执行四个维度的基准;2) 开展系统性诊断,分析能力画像、潜在执行能力与瓶颈;3) 进行后训练分析,考察失败的可修复性;4) 提出基元优先的自蒸馏框架,选择性地将基元引导的推理迁移至学生模型。
AI.result: 诊断显示:解答准确率掩盖了不同的能力画像;基元能够释放大量潜在执行能力;发现是数学推理的主要瓶颈;受发现限制的失败尤易修复。实验表明该框架在不同模型规模和挑战性基准上稳定优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从概念、基准到诊断与训练方法形成了完整闭环,表明显式建模结构性数学理解不仅有助于刻画LLM能力,也能切实提升数学推理性能。

title: Cost-augmented Schrödinger bridges on graphs are exactly solvable: a Feynman-Kac tilt replaces learned control
summary: The generalized Schrödinger bridge on a graph moves mass between two distributions while charging a cost for the states visited. It has been approached by learning the rates of a controlled continuous-time Markov chain, with a temporal-difference penalty that restores the cost. A state cost folds into the reference process as a Feynman-Kac tilt. The cost-augmented bridge is then a plain bridge against the tilted reference, and the penalty is unnecessary. The bridge is computed exactly by alternating two endpoint rescalings, each one sparse matrix-exponential application; nothing is discretized in time or learned. The alternation converges at a rate set by the endpoint coupling alone. For a quadratic congestion cost on time-averaged occupancies, damped best response around the exact bridge is gradient descent on a strongly convex function, and its residual bounds its error. On a protein-folding model, a free-energy cost lowers the expected barrier of the folding paths. On the learned approach's road network, roll-outs of the exact bridge match the target within sampling error, and on networks with millions of intersections its memory grows linearly.

AI.tldr: 用倾斜参考过程（Feynman-Kac）重构图上的广义Schrödinger桥，使成本约束内化，从而无需时间离散化或学习，通过两次端点重标定的交替（各一次稀疏矩阵指数应用）精确求解，并给出收敛率与凸性分析，在蛋白质折叠与道路网络上验证。
AI.motivation: 图上的广义Schrödinger桥需在移动概率质量的同时对访问状态计费。既有方法通过学习受控连续时间马尔可夫链的速率并加时间差分惩罚来恢复成本，存在学习与离散化带来的近似与开销。作者希望给出无需学习、无需时间离散化的精确求解途径。
AI.method: 将状态成本作为Feynman-Kac倾斜折入参考过程，成本增广桥即相对于倾斜参考的普通桥，惩罚项因此不再必要；桥通过两个端点重标定的交替精确计算，每步仅一次稀疏矩阵指数运算，不在时间上离散化也不学习；并分析交替收敛率仅由端点耦合决定。对时间平均占据量的二次拥堵成本，围绕精确桥的阻尼最佳响应等价于强凸函数上的梯度下降，其残差给出误差上界。
AI.result: 在蛋白质折叠模型中，自由能成本降低了折叠路径的期望势垒；在学习方法所用的道路网络上，精确桥的roll-out在采样误差范围内匹配目标；在拥有数百万交叉口的网络上，内存随规模线性增长。
AI.conclusion: Feynman-Kac倾斜把成本约束解析地并入参考过程，使广义Schrödinger桥可精确、无学习、无时间离散地求解，代价为交替的两次稀疏矩阵指数；收敛率由端点耦合单独决定。二次拥堵成本下的阻尼最佳响应具强凸梯度下降结构并给出误差界，方法在分子与大规模网络上均有效且可扩展。

title: TACO: Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse Optimizer for LLM Fine-Tuning
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Jichao2357/TACO_optimizer
summary: Full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial optimizer state memory overhead, limiting the model sizes that fit on modern GPUs. Existing approaches either compress optimizer state, abandon first-order gradients, or change the update geometry while retaining dense state. The recently introduced Muon optimizer reduces optimizer memory through matrix-valued updates. Still, its geometry differs from AdamW and can lead to performance degradation when fine-tuning AdamW-pretrained models. To reduce optimizer memory without sacrificing accuracy or computational efficiency in LLM fine-tuning, we propose Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse optimizer, or TACO, which follows Muon's operator-norm steepest-descent view but takes the geometric route further. TACO computes the exact steepest-descent direction under a dimension-normalized $1\to1$ operator norm by selecting the sign of the largest magnitude entry in each column of two-dimensional weight matrices. This retains first-order gradients while making optimizer state memory nearly negligible. Our practical TACO optimizer maintains only a small set of low precision gradient components per column, reducing persistent optimizer state by $174\times$ relative to AdamW8bit (from 27.7 GB to 0.16 GB) and peak training memory by $2.9\times$ (from 80.6 GB to 27.5 GB) on OPT-13B, while achieving comparable accuracy and runtime. TACO further enables full-parameter fine-tuning of 30-32B-parameter models on a single 80 GB H100 GPU across multiple model families and tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TACO 优化器，通过维度归一化 1→1 算子范数下的精确最速下降方向（每列仅保留最大幅值项符号），将优化器状态内存压缩约 174 倍，在保持精度和效率的同时支持 30–32B 模型单卡全参数微调。
AI.motivation: LLM 全参数微调中优化器状态内存开销巨大，限制了可在现代 GPU 上容纳的模型规模。现有方法或压缩优化器状态、或放弃一阶梯度、或在保留稠密状态的前提下改变更新几何；Muon 虽通过矩阵值更新降低内存，但其几何与 AdamW 不同，微调 AdamW 预训练模型时可能导致性能下降。因此需要在微调中不牺牲精度和计算效率的前提下降低优化器内存。
AI.method: 提出 TACO（Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse）优化器。它沿用 Muon 的算子范数最速下降视角但几何上更进一步：在维度归一化的 1→1 算子范数下，通过选取二维权重矩阵每一列中最大幅值项的符号，计算精确的最速下降方向。该方法保留一阶梯度，同时使优化器状态内存几近可忽略——实际实现中每列仅维护少量低精度梯度分量。
AI.result: 在 OPT-13B 上，持久化优化器状态相比 AdamW8bit 减少 174 倍（从 27.7 GB 降至 0.16 GB），峰值训练内存降低 2.9 倍（从 80.6 GB 降至 27.5 GB），同时达到相当的精度和运行时间；并可在单张 80 GB H100 GPU 上对 30–32B 参数模型跨多种模型族与任务进行全参数微调。
AI.conclusion: TACO 在保持一阶梯度、精度与计算效率的同时大幅降低优化器状态内存，使更大规模模型的全参数微调在有限显存下变得可行。

title: Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?
comment: Preprint. under review at a NeurIPS 2026 workshop. 15 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables
summary: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

AI.tldr: 该研究构建4个微任务基准，检验现成SLM能否通过实践者设定的阈值，发现16个配置全部不合格，且量化无法使其合格，差距主要随模型规模而非精度变化。
AI.motivation: Agent框架希望在前沿LLM规划器周边的微任务（如自动批准shell命令、写记忆、选工具、排序历史轮次）上部署小型语言模型（SLM）。然而，现成SLM是否达到实践者定义的性能阈值、失败原因以及量化是否改变结论尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建含4个微任务的基准，使用固定提示和自动指标，每个任务设定预设阈值τ（锚定于廉价非LLM基线）及CI感知合格规则（置信界需超过τ才算合格）。在Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B上以最佳配置（FP16、贪心、单一冻结提示、无调优）扫描，并用logprob决策阈值诊断区分失败类型；进一步测试4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）的影响，并在Llama-3.x上复现。
AI.result: 出现“合格性缺口”：4任务×4模型的16个配置全部不合格（经原始输出与解析器行为核查）。logprob阈值诊断将失败分为能力缺陷与可通过调整解码阈值解决的失败（4种情形）。4-bit量化造成的损害取决于模型规模，但未使任何配置合格；缺口更多随模型规模而非精度变化。结论在Llama-3.x上复现（12/12不合格），对锚点选择（τ-sweep）和提示措辞（原句加3种中性改写共0/112合格）均稳健。示例：4B重排器在BM25短列表上优于BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]），但自身仍未通过合格性认证。
AI.conclusion: 应将SLM置于满足CI支持阈值的基线之后，仅在基线未达阈值处使用SLM；即SLM作为补充而非替代。合格性缺口主要由模型规模驱动，量化并非决定因素。

title: Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor
summary: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对话幽默训练中的自动化奖励设计，揭示两类奖励的“奖励利用”问题并提出对策。嵌入式惊喜奖励会误接受词序打乱回复；受众模型奖励易受笑声线索影响。对策可阻断已知攻击但存在副面代价，最终训练虽提升整体指标，幽默专项改进仍未达预定目标。
AI.motivation: 语言模型对话幽默训练缺乏可靠的人工反馈，需依赖自动化奖励。但自动化奖励常被模型利用（reward hacking），即接受表面满足奖励信号却无真实幽默的回复。作者希望在“可理解的惊喜”和“预测观众愉悦”两类奖励上系统识别此类利用行为，并探索兼顾堵漏与保留目标行为的对策。
AI.method: 研究两条奖励路线：一是捕捉“可理解的惊喜”的嵌入式奖励，二是预测观众发笑的受众模型奖励。通过受控测试检验奖励对词序打乱回复、演讲者消息中的笑声线索等的敏感性。随后设计对策：对惊喜奖励加入流畅性过滤器；对受众奖励进行跨演讲者的线索归一化。最后进行三次强化学习训练，逐次修订奖励，评估组合评分、零分会话比例及幽默专项指标。
AI.result: 嵌入式惊喜奖励对词序打乱回复与机智回复同样接受；流畅性过滤器能检测打乱，但组合奖励同时拒绝部分机智回复且后续验证失败。受众模型奖励易被任一演讲者消息中的笑声线索利用；跨演讲者归一化可阻断已覆盖攻击，但未匹配的表达仍可被利用。三次RL训练中，最终运行将组合评估分数提高0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项改进低于预定目标。
AI.conclusion: 自动化奖励设计存在普遍挑战：对策必须阻断可利用的捷径，同时保留奖励原本要鼓励的行为。单纯加过滤器或归一化虽能封堵特定攻击，却可能损害有效信号，导致幽默能力提升有限。未来需在攻击鲁棒性与目标行为保真度之间寻找更优平衡。

title: When a Data Artifact Isn't a Shortcut: Causal Auditing of Synthetic RLVR Corpora
summary: Several recent pipelines build RLVR training data by masking a span of real corpus text and asking a language model to invent plausible wrong answers around it. The correct option is therefore genuine human prose; every distractor is synthetic. Correctness and provenance become entangled, and a policy could in principle learn the second instead of the first. We audit that possibility in GooseReason-0.7M. First we ask whether the asymmetry is visible at all: a classifier reading only five surface statistics (never the meaning) reaches AUROC 0.562 over 315,499 options, barely above chance. The aggregate hides something, though. Code sits at 0.416, below chance, and manual inspection explains why: code distractors turn out to be single-operator mutations of the gold answer rather than freely written alternatives, so the two classes are nearly identical by construction. Detecting a signal is not the same as showing a model uses it, so we then run an intervention. We build a paraphrase-matched control corpus, hold training-set size identical across arms, and train two policies under one fixed budget. The exploitation gap does not favour the unmodified-data arm: 0.021 against 0.027 for the control. Under our budget, in other words, a detectable artifact went unexploited. We think that dissociation, along with the domain-specific construction finding, is worth knowing for anyone curating corpora of this kind, and we release the audit as a mostly CPU-only protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了RLVR训练数据中"正确答案为真实人类文本、干扰项为合成文本"这一来源性不对称是否会被策略利用，发现表层统计信号虽可检测但未被利用。
AI.motivation: 近期多条流水线通过掩码真实语料片段、让语言模型围绕其编造看似合理的错误答案来构建RLVR训练数据。这导致正确选项来自真实人类文本，而每个干扰项都是合成的，正确性与来源性纠缠在一起，策略原则上可能学到来源性而非正确性。作者希望审计这一可能性。
AI.method: 以GooseReason-0.7M为对象：(1) 训练仅读取五项表层统计特征（不看语义）的分类器，在315,499个选项上检测来源性信号；(2) 构建转述匹配的对照语料，在固定预算、相同训练集规模下训练两个策略，比较利用差距。
AI.result: 分类器整体AUROC仅0.562，略高于随机；但存在领域差异，代码领域为0.416（低于随机），人工检查发现代码干扰项是金标准的单算子变异，两类构造上几乎相同。干预实验中，未修改数据臂的利用差距为0.021，对照臂为0.027，并未更有利于未修改数据臂。
AI.conclusion: 在给定预算下，一个可检测的来源性伪迹未被策略利用，检测到信号不等于模型会使用该信号；这一"解离"现象及领域特定的构造发现对类似语料的策展者有参考价值，作者将审计作为基本仅需CPU的协议发布。

title: Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole
summary: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

AI.tldr: 在受约束信号信道中，当知情对手与受众共享信道时，最优抗对手信号恰好与既有研究中的显著性极点重合（仅在显著性—贝叶斯坐标无定义的2748项上不同），这一重合使对手感知能力的实证评估存在结构性限制。
AI.motivation: 既有研究可能假设贝叶斯后验最大化是最优信号策略，但当知情对手能利用同一信道并施展说服预算β反对正确答案时，真实最优信号可能改变；作者希望探究在对手存在时，如何选择能最好保护真相的信号，并厘清其与先前显著性极点的关系。
AI.method: 将对手引入强制选择任务（抽象自《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》）：对手知晓目标、观察信号，并以说服预算β为最强错误答案辩护。分析最优信号随β从0到有限值的变化，并在108个确认性项目及20万项池上比较抗对手最优与显著性极点。
AI.result: 在108个确认性项目上，抗对手最优与先前工作的显著性极点完全一致；在20万项池中，两者仅在2748项上不同，且这些差异恰好出现在显著性—贝叶斯坐标无定义处。当β=0时，博弈还原为原始oracle模型（听众温度τ=1）。18.2%的池中项目在有限预算下最优会移动，且每个项目的临界预算是精确的。两种对手框架使7个语言模型在108项中的30–77项上改变所选选项，但无法判断移动方向是趋向对手感知最优还是显著性，因为二者相同。
AI.conclusion: 抗对手鲁棒最优在可定义处完全等同于显著性策略，这构成实证评估的结构性限制而非零结果。建议在评估对手感知能力前，先检验鲁棒目标是否与启发式目标在评估项目上重合，这是一项低成本的诊断检查。

title: Refusal Localizes, the Damage Relocates: Safety Layers Under Few-Sample Fine-Tuning
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 21 tables. Jungseob Lee and Dongyub Jude Lee contributed equally
summary: Fine-tuning adapts aligned large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but a few dozen harmful examples can remove their refusal of harmful requests. Prior work localizes safety-related behavior to specific layers, directions, and tokens, suggesting targets for protection. We test whether successful localization and recovery support defenses that survive changes in the attack. Across six checkpoints from four model families, harmful and benign prompts remain linearly separable after attack, and patching full clean hidden states into the compromised model restores refusal at a reproducible transition depth. Building on a prior layer-freezing defense, we freeze every layer up to this depth and repeat the attack. At a hundred harmful examples, refusal remains near zero on all six checkpoints, with recovery transitions above the frozen boundary. In a second study, removing the update's top two singular directions restores refusal after short attention-only fine-tunes on four checkpoints. On Llama-3.1-8B, ordinary training changes weaken this repair and an attacker who spreads the update defeats it. A spectral detector calibrated on benign Llama fine-tunes misses most repair failures on that checkpoint. Localized freezing can nevertheless help preserve refusal when a few harmful examples enter training data unintentionally. These results show that an attacker can bypass a region identified by recovery and defeat a repair that works across multiple checkpoints, motivating five checks for defenses against adaptive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/refusal-relocates.

AI.tldr: 本文检验基于安全行为定位的防御能否在攻击变化下仍然有效，发现攻击者可绕过恢复所定位的区域并使跨检查点的修复失效，据此提出五项防御评估检查。
AI.motivation: 已有工作将LLM的安全拒答行为定位到特定层、方向和token，但尚不清楚这种定位与恢复能否支撑在攻击变化后仍然稳健的防御。
AI.method: 在来自4个模型系列的6个检查点上，比较受攻击前后的有害/良性提示可分性并做干净隐状态补丁；基于层冻结防御，冻结至可复现的恢复转变深度后重复攻击；另移除更新矩阵前两个奇异方向以修复纯注意力微调；在Llama-3.1-8B上测试常规训练扰动、攻击者分散更新及基于良性微调校准的谱检测器。
AI.result: 攻击后有害与良性提示仍线性可分，补入干净隐状态可在可复现转变深度恢复拒答；但在一百个有害样本下，六个检查点冻结至该深度后拒答率仍近零，恢复转变发生在冻结边界之上；移除前两个奇异方向可修复四个检查点的短程纯注意力微调，但在Llama-3.1-8B上被常规训练削弱且可被分散更新的攻击者击败；谱检测器漏检该检查点多数修复失败。
AI.conclusion: 攻击者可绕过由恢复定位的区域并击败跨检查点有效的修复，说明定位与恢复不足以构成稳健防御；局部冻结仍可在少量有害样本意外进入训练数据时帮助保留拒答；据此提出针对自适应微调防御的五项检查。

title: CAST: Cost-Aware Speculative Trees from One-Pass Block Drafters
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting future tokens cheaply and verifying them with the target model in parallel. Block drafters score a whole block of future tokens in one forward pass, yet standard decoding verifies only the top-scoring chain and discards the other candidates. Because these candidates are already scored, verifying more of them adds target computation but no extra drafting. We introduce CAST (Cost-Aware Speculative Trees), which packs these candidates into a tree and verifies it in a single target pass, leaving the target model, drafter weights, and decoding rule untouched. To decide how wide the tree should be, CAST adds candidates while the expected gain from the next one outweighs the verification time it adds. The width therefore adapts to each deployment from a latency measurement, without sweeping over widths. We evaluate CAST across five domains on three GPU generations and two model families. At its predicted width, CAST is faster than the standard chain in all eight settings, by up to 43%. We also find that the best width depends strongly on the deployment. Where verification cost jumps at a kernel boundary, a 128-token tree is only 2% faster than the standard chain, whereas the tree at the predicted width is 20% faster. Furthermore, we prove that CAST leaves the target output distribution unchanged under both greedy and sampled decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/CAST.

AI.tldr: CAST 将块草稿器产生的候选打包为树，在一次目标模型前向中验证，并按延迟测量自适应选择宽度，从而在保持输出分布不变的前提下加速推理。
AI.motivation: 块草稿器能一次前向给出一整块未来 token 的分数，但标准推测解码只验证得分最高的链，丢弃了其余已评分的候选。验证更多候选只增加目标计算、不增加草稿开销，因此存在被浪费的加速潜力；同时验证成本随部署和内核边界变化，固定宽度并非最优。
AI.method: CAST（Cost-Aware Speculative Trees）把块草稿器的候选组织成树，在一次目标前向中并行验证；不修改目标模型、草稿器权重与解码规则。宽度由成本感知准则决定：持续加入候选，直到下一个候选带来的期望收益不再超过其增加的验证时间，宽度因此可由一次延迟测量为每个部署自适应确定，无需扫描宽度。
AI.result: 在三个 GPU 代际、两个模型家族、五个领域的八个设置中，CAST 在其预测宽度下均快于标准链，最高提速 43%。最优宽度强烈依赖部署：在验证成本因内核边界跃升的场景，128-token 树仅比标准链快 2%，而预测宽度下的树快 20%。
AI.conclusion: CAST 证明在贪心与采样解码下均不改变目标输出分布。作者指出应基于成本而非固定宽度选择推测树宽度。代码已开源于 https://github.com/js-lee-AI/CAST。

title: ContractRL: Shielded Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Auditable Tool-Call Repair
summary: Structured tool calls often fail after only a small number of fields violate a schema or an execution contract. Regenerating the complete object enlarges the action surface and makes repeated repair difficult to audit. We introduce ContractRL, a contract-constrained sequential repair protocol that models verifier-guided JSON repair as a bounded decision process. At each step the policy observes the candidate, typed verifier feedback, JSON Pointer, immutable repair history, and remaining budget; a contract-derived action mask filters malformed or prohibited RFC-6902 operations before a deterministic validator performs the transition. We specify a contract-constrained group-relative objective for patch, retry, and abstention decisions while keeping canonical targets and semantic labels outside the online state until trace freeze. Under identical verifier information, ContractRL attains 0.9362 semantic success with 34.4 generated tokens, compared with 0.9076 and 44.9 tokens for Patch-SFT and 0.9148 and 137.2 tokens for full regeneration over 192 cases per seed and five seeds. Policy optimization improves semantic success from 0.9186 for supervised ContractRL to 0.9375. A separate three-seed paired evaluation against Patch-SFT yields a semantic difference of +0.0396 (95% CI $[+0.0137,+0.0662], p=0.0039$). Feedback, action-mask, budget, and schema-shift analyses connect these gains to localized correction, while adversarial and multi-turn evaluations characterize the remaining failure modes.

AI.tldr: ContractRL 将受验证器引导的 JSON 修复建模为有界决策过程，通过合约约束的序列化修复协议，在更少 token 下取得更高语义成功率。
AI.motivation: 结构化工具调用常因少量字段违反 schema 或执行合约而失败；整体重新生成会扩大动作空间，且重复修复难以审计。
AI.method: 提出合约约束的序列化修复协议：每步策略观察候选对象、类型化验证器反馈、JSON Pointer、不可变修复历史与剩余预算；合约导出的动作掩码在确定性验证器执行转移前过滤非法或禁止的 RFC-6902 操作；定义面向 patch、重试与弃权决策的合约约束组相对目标，并在轨迹冻结前将规范目标与语义标签排除于在线状态。
AI.result: 相同验证器信息下，ContractRL 语义成功率达 0.9362、生成 34.4 token；Patch-SFT 为 0.9076/44.9 token，全量重生成为 0.9148/137.2 token（每种子 192 例、五种种子）。策略优化将语义成功从监督式 ContractRL 的 0.9186 提升至 0.9375。三种子配对评估相对 Patch-SFT 语义差异为 +0.0396（95% CI [+0.0137,+0.0662]，p=0.0039）。
AI.conclusion: 反馈、动作掩码、预算与 schema 漂移分析将增益归因于局部化修正；对抗与多轮评估刻画了剩余失败模式。

title: Benchmarking Prompt Optimization of Large Language Models With Chess
summary: Evaluating large language models becomes increasingly challenging as their capabilities advance: benchmarks can saturate, public test sets risk contamination, and assessing harder tasks can require expensive grading or execution infrastructure. These challenges are amplified in automatic prompt optimization (APO), where evaluation is repeated throughout the search for better prompts. Studying APO therefore requires a benchmark that is cheap and deterministic to score, hard enough to leave room for improvement, and renewable as models evolve. We introduce a chess benchmark built from 1,118 Lichess puzzles to study APO for frozen LLMs: we optimize their prompts without updating their model weights. Chess combines inexpensive exact-match scoring, engine-based evaluation of alternative moves, and a renewable supply of problems with adjustable difficulty. Unlike evaluations that report only success on isolated test items, the benchmark also connects puzzle-solving gains to short game-play rollouts within the same domain. We use it to evaluate six APO algorithms on eight target models, measuring not only baseline strength but also how much each model responds to optimization and whether optimized prompts transfer across models and to game play. Chess is thus a well-suited benchmark for APO: it is (i) challenging, as even the strongest evaluated model, Gemini 3.5 Flash (used as the meta-model), solves only about 55\% of puzzles; (ii) discriminative, revealing gains, unchanged performance, and regressions across methods and models; (iii) renewable, with fresh puzzles to reduce contamination risk and adjustable difficulty to maintain headroom as models improve; and (iv) affordable, as the complete study runs for around \$800. We release the puzzles, optimization and evaluation code, and dataset-renewal scripts (https://github.com/imec-ailabs/Automatic-Prompt-Optimization-with-Chess).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于1118道Lichess国际象棋谜题的基准，用于研究冻结大语言模型的自动提示优化（APO），兼具有挑战性、判别性、可更新性与低成本的特点。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型能力提升，评测愈发困难：基准饱和、公开测试集存在污染风险、更难任务需要昂贵的评分或执行基础设施。这些问题在自动提示优化（APO）中被放大，因为优化搜索过程需要反复评测。因此需要一个评分廉价且确定性、难度足够留有提升空间、并随模型演进而可更新的基准。
AI.method: 构建基于1,118道Lichess谜题的国际象棋基准，在不更新模型权重的前提下优化冻结LLM的提示。国际象棋具备精确匹配评分廉价、可借助引擎评估替代走法、以及可按难度调节并补充新题的优势。基准还将解题增益与同领域的短时对弈rollout关联。基于该基准，在8个目标模型上评测6种APO算法，测量基线强度、各模型对优化的响应程度，以及优化提示在模型间与对弈任务上的迁移性。
AI.result: 即使最强评测模型Gemini 3.5 Flash（用作meta-model）也仅解决约55%的谜题；不同方法与模型上呈现出性能提升、不变与退化等多种结果，具有判别力；完整研究成本约800美元。
AI.conclusion: 国际象棋是适合APO的基准：具有挑战性、判别性、可更新性（新题降低污染、可调难度保持提升空间）与可负担性。作者开源了谜题、优化与评测代码及数据集更新脚本。

title: Can LLMs Reason Over Long Horizons? An Empirical Evaluation of Context Strategies for Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning
summary: Longitudinal clinical reasoning requires large language models (LLMs) to identify and integrate relevant evidence distributed across extended patient histories. Although long-context models can process increasingly large amounts of information, providing more history does not necessarily make relevant evidence more accessible or improve reasoning. We compare five context strategies (Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, and Hybrid) on MedLoCoMo across four open-weight LLMs, examining answer correctness, robustness to query-evidence distance, and abstention on questions with unsupported premises. Episodic and Hybrid generally achieve the strongest overall accuracy, while Recent Context degrades most as supporting evidence becomes more distant; Episodic and Hybrid maintain the highest accuracy at long distances. Analysis of adversarial questions further shows that strong performance on answerable questions does not necessarily translate to successful abstention when the available history does not support the requested conclusion. These findings show that reliable longitudinal reasoning depends not only on how much history an LLM can access, but critically on how relevant evidence is selected and presented for reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文在 MedLoCoMo 基准上比较五种上下文策略（Full、Recent、Episodic、Semantic、Hybrid）对四个开源大模型纵向临床推理的影响，发现 Episodic 与 Hybrid 整体准确率最高且远距离证据下最稳健，而 Recent 随查询-证据距离增大退化最严重，同时可答问题上的优异表现未必带来对无依据前提问题的正确拒答。
AI.motivation: 纵向临床推理要求模型识别并整合分散在冗长病史中的相关证据。尽管长上下文模型能处理越来越大的信息量，但提供更多病史并不必然使相关证据更易获取或提升推理质量，因此需要考察“证据如何被选择与呈现”这一关键因素。
AI.method: 在 MedLoCoMo 上对四种开放权重 LLM 比较五种上下文策略：Full（全部病史）、Recent（近期上下文）、Episodic（按就诊片段组织）、Semantic（语义检索）、Hybrid（混合）。评估三个维度：答案正确性、对查询—证据距离的鲁棒性、以及在含无支撑前提问题上的拒答能力（对抗性问题分析）。
AI.result: Episodic 与 Hybrid 整体准确率最强；Recent Context 随支撑证据距离增大退化最明显，而 Episodic 与 Hybrid 在长距离下保持最高准确率。对抗性问题分析显示，在可答问题上的强表现并不能转化为对无支撑前提问题的成功拒答。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的纵向推理不仅取决于模型能访问多少病史，更关键地取决于相关证据如何被选择并呈现给推理过程。

title: Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media with Multi-Task QLoRA
summary: Explainable suicide-risk assessment requires models not only to estimate risk severity, but also to identify supporting language and the risk and protective factors expressed in a post. We present our system for the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup on Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media, which addresses three tasks: risk-level classification, evidence phrase extraction, and multi-label factor identification. Our approach adapts Qwen2.5-Instruct models using quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) and an answer-masked causal language-model objective. We jointly train across all three tasks for risk classification, jointly train on Tasks~1a and 1b for evidence extraction, and adapt Task~2 separately for factor identification. We also tailor aggregation to each output: we average risk-level probabilities from the 32B and 72B models, combine evidence phrases through cross-fold consensus, and calibrate factor-specific decisions through rate matching based on out-of-fold operating points. On the official leaderboard, the final system achieved a composite score of 0.7738, with 0.8089 on Task~1 and 0.6919 on Task~2. Across the evaluated configurations, three-task training performed best for Task~1a, joint training on Tasks~1a and 1b performed best for Task~1b, and task-specific training performed best for Task~2. Probability averaging further improved Task~1a when component models had complementary errors. These findings highlight the value of tailoring both training objectives and aggregation strategies to the output structure of each task within a unified language-model framework.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 IEEE BigData 2026 Cup 可解释自杀风险评估系统的方案：基于 Qwen2.5-Instruct 与 QLoRA 微调，覆盖风险分级、证据短语抽取和多标签因素识别三任务，通过任务定制的训练与聚合策略，在官方榜单取得综合分 0.7738。
AI.motivation: 可解释的自杀风险评估不仅需要预测风险严重程度，还需识别帖文中支撑判断的语言证据及表达的风险与保护因素。现有方法通常只关注风险分级，缺乏对证据抽取与多因素识别的统一建模和输出结构适配。
AI.method: 采用 Qwen2.5-Instruct 模型，使用量化低秩适配（QLoRA）与答案掩码的因果语言建模目标进行适配。训练策略为：风险分类（Task 1）三任务联合训练；证据抽取联合训练 Task 1a 与 1b；因素识别（Task 2）单独任务特定训练。聚合策略因输出而异：Task 1a 对 32B 与 72B 模型的风险概率取平均，证据短语采用跨折共识合并，因素识别基于折外操作点的比率匹配进行校准。
AI.result: 官方榜单最终系统综合分为 0.7738，Task 1 为 0.8089，Task 2 为 0.6919。在评估配置中，三任务训练对 Task 1a 最优，Task 1a+1b 联合训练对 Task 1b 最优，任务特定训练对 Task 2 最优；当组件模型误差互补时，概率平均进一步提升了 Task 1a。
AI.conclusion: 在统一语言模型框架下，针对每个任务的输出结构定制训练目标与聚合策略具有重要价值，可同时提升风险分级、证据抽取与因素识别的整体性能。

title: CompMat-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Computational Materials Science
summary: Evaluating AI agents on scientific research tasks is constrained by the time and resources required for the underlying experiments or calculations. In computational materials research, repeating the same expensive simulations across agents and trials can make evaluation impractical. We introduce CompMat-Bench, a benchmark of 94 tasks derived from recently published computational materials studies, each asking agents to complete a step toward achieving the study's scientific goal. We reproduce the research steps in advance and assess agents on preparing inputs and analyzing outputs for expensive simulations, so expensive simulations can be avoided during evaluation. The reproduced inputs and results serve as ground truth for grading agents with fixed rules, without an LLM judge. The benchmark supports four evaluation conditions: single tasks and workflows composed of related tasks, each with full or reduced methodological guidance. With full guidance on single tasks, agents based on three LLMs demonstrate the ability to complete individual materials research steps, with pass rates of 66.0-90.4% across 94 tasks. Both longer workflows and reduced guidance can limit agent performance, but in different ways for different agents: they lower the pass rates of the weaker agents, whereas the strongest agent falls only when a long workflow is combined with reduced guidance. Failure analysis attributes most failures to scientific errors rather than to errors in software usage. CompMat-Bench provides a basis for comparing agents on the steps of real materials research and for analyzing agent failure modes.

AI.tldr: 提出 CompMat-Bench：94 个源自近期计算材料研究的任务基准，通过预先复现实验步骤、仅评估输入准备与结果分析，规避昂贵模拟开销，并用固定规则评分。
AI.motivation: 在科学研究任务上评估 AI 智能体受限于底层实验或计算所需的时间与资源。计算材料研究中，跨智能体与多次试验重复昂贵模拟会导致评估不可行，因此需要一种无需实际执行高价计算的评估方案。
AI.method: 从近期发表的计算材料研究衍生 94 个任务，每个任务要求智能体完成通向该研究科学目标的一步；提前复现研究步骤，将评估聚焦于昂贵模拟的输入准备与输出分析，以避免评估期间执行昂贵模拟。复现的输入与结果作为真值，采用固定规则评分（不使用 LLM 评委）。基准支持四种评估条件：单任务与由相关任务组成的工作流，各含完整或精简方法学指导。
AI.result: 在单任务+完整指导条件下，基于三种 LLM 的智能体能够完成单个材料研究步骤，94 个任务的通过率为 66.0%–90.4%。更长工作流与精简指导均会限制智能体表现，但对不同智能体影响方式不同：二者降低较弱智能体的通过率，而最强智能体仅在“长工作流+精简指导”组合下才下降。失败分析显示，多数失败归因于科学错误而非软件使用错误。
AI.conclusion: CompMat-Bench 为在真实材料研究步骤上比较智能体、并分析其失败模式提供了基础。

title: Agent Evaluation Reliability: More Tasks Won't (Always) Fix An Agent Leaderboard
summary: Agent evaluations are increasingly used to compare LLMs and inform deployment decisions, yet ranks can reflect not only the model but also the effects of the evaluation conditions such as the scaffolds or tasks. This makes reliability claim-dependent: an evaluation that reliably ranks deployed systems may not reliably rank underlying models. We ask which conclusions current agent evaluations reliably support and what additional evaluation would improve them. We develop a Bayesian variance-decomposition framework for sparse, imbalanced agent leaderboards and apply it to 22 benchmarks from the Holistic Agent Leaderboard and Harbor Index. The framework separates signal, performance differences relevant to the intended claim, from noise, irrelevant variation that can still change rankings. We find: (1) Reliability depends on the measurement goal. Fixed model-scaffold systems are ranked reliably (0.935-0.994), while underlying-model reliability is substantially lower (0.148-0.841). (2) Scaffold choice can change conclusions. Inter-scaffold reliability measures whether scaffolds preserve model rankings, showing that scaffold effects vary substantially across evaluations. (3) More tasks cannot resolve all uncertainty. Even infinitely many similarly constructed tasks improve model-ranking reliability of a benchmark by at most 0.097 when uncertainty is dominated by limited scaffold coverage. (4) Pooling diverse benchmarks can improve cross-task rankings at lower cost. For rankings across diverse agentic tasks, pooling benchmarks raises projected reliability from 0.44 to 0.75 at the same task budget and can reduce projected cost by up to 83\%. Evaluation design should follow the intended claim: identify what a score or ranking should mean, diagnose what limits its reliability, and spend evaluation budget on the sources of uncertainty that matter.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出贝叶斯方差分解框架，用于量化稀疏、不平衡的智能体排行榜中的可靠性，并区分"部署系统排名"与"底层模型排名"两类结论的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 智能体评测常被用来比较LLM并指导部署决策，但排名不仅反映模型本身，还受评测条件（如脚手架scaffold、任务）影响，因此可靠性是"依赖于结论"的：一个能可靠排名已部署系统的评测未必能可靠排名底层模型。作者希望明确当前评测能可靠支持哪些结论，以及需要哪些额外评测来改进。
AI.method: 开发贝叶斯方差分解框架，将信号（与目标结论相关的性能差异）与噪声（无关但仍会改变排名的变异）分离，适用于稀疏、不平衡的智能体排行榜；将其应用于Holistic Agent Leaderboard和Harbor Index的22个基准。
AI.result: (1) 可靠性取决于测量目标：固定模型-脚手架系统排名可靠（0.935–0.994），而底层模型可靠性显著较低（0.148–0.841）。(2) 脚手架选择会改变结论：跨脚手架可靠性（衡量脚手架是否保持模型排名）在不同评测间差异很大。(3) 增加任务无法解决所有不确定性：当不确定性主要来自脚手架覆盖有限时，即使无限增加同类构造任务，模型排名可靠性最多仅提升0.097。(4) 合并多样基准可提升跨任务排名且成本更低：相同任务预算下，合并基准将可靠性从0.44提升到0.75，成本最多可降低83%。
AI.conclusion: 评测设计应遵循预期结论：明确分数或排名应代表什么，诊断限制其可靠性的因素，并将评测预算花在真正重要的不确定性来源上。

title: When More Data Is Not Enough: The Context-Sufficiency Frontier in Generative AI Personalization
comment: PREPRINT - SUBMITTED TO JOURNAL OF SERVICE RESEARCH (JSR)
summary: Personalization has long relied on customer data to infer what an individual is likely to value. We call this customer evidence: the customer's historical behavior and preferences. Generative AI extends personalization by allowing providers to supply changing situational information at the moment a response is produced, without encoding every condition in advance. We define this provider-side context as information about what is possible, permitted, or advisable now. This flexibility creates a new problem: once context becomes easy to supply, more is not necessarily better. We develop a theory of context sufficiency in which the relevance of context to the customer's current intent matters more than its volume. The theory identifies four states, insufficiency, sufficiency, saturation, and interference, and introduces the Context-Sufficiency Frontier to locate the minimal relevant set. In a full-factorial experiment with a generative recommender at a large home-furnishing retailer, relevant context improved appropriateness, while irrelevant context reduced it and destabilized retrieval. The framework shifts personalization from supplying more context toward identifying what the current interaction actually requires and enforcing constraints throughout the service process.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"上下文充分性"理论，指出生成式AI个性化中，上下文与客户意图的相关性比数量更重要，并划分不足、充分、饱和、干扰四态及"上下文充分性前沿"。
AI.motivation: 个性化长期依赖"客户证据"（历史行为与偏好）。生成式AI使提供方可在生成响应时动态注入情境信息，无需预先编码所有条件，但由此产生新问题：上下文一旦易得，是否越多越好？
AI.method: 将提供方情境定义为"当前何为可能、被允许或被建议"的信息；构建上下文充分性理论，区分相关性优先于数量，提出四态框架与上下文充分性前沿以定位最小相关集；在一家大型家居用品零售商的生成式推荐系统上开展全因子实验。
AI.result: 相关上下文提升推荐适当性，无关上下文降低适当性并破坏检索稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 个性化应从"提供更多上下文"转向识别当前交互真正所需，并在服务流程中持续施加约束。

title: Backdoor Containment via Expert Quarantine and Shutdown in LLMs
summary: Backdoored large language models (LLMs) can behave normally on benign inputs while producing attacker-specified outputs under hidden triggers. Existing defenses span four stages--prior-training, in-training, post-training, and inference-time--and share one of two underlying strategies: either suppress backdoor learning (by filtering poisoned data or interrupting its acquisition during optimization) or learn, then purify (by repairing model weights or gating inputs after a fully backdoored model has formed). We propose a third strategy, learn, but channel: allow backdoor formation during training but route it into a designated, quarantined component that can be disabled at deployment. To this end, we propose Quarantined Expert Shutdown QES, a computationally efficient containment strategy built in a regularization-steered MoE-like setting. Specifically, given a poisoned dataset, QES augments a Transformer-based language model with routed expert-specific LoRA branches and lightweight routers, and uses auxiliary routing objectives to attract trigger-conditioned behavior into a designated expert while preserving benign capability elsewhere. At deployment, mitigation reduces to a single constant-time operation: zeroing the quarantined expert's routing weight, without trigger screening or further updating model weights. Empirically, our methods reduce the attack success rate ASR from 100% to 0-10% on most settings across two tasks, three attacks, and four model families, while downstream utility is often preserved or only modestly affected. These results establish learn, but channel as a previously unexplored regime for backdoor containment in generative LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出"学习但引导"(learn, but channel)这一后门防御新范式，将后门行为诱导至可隔离的专家模块，部署时通过置零路由权重实现常量时间的后门消融。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM后门防御分为两阶段：或抑制后门学习（过滤数据、打断优化），或先学习后净化（修复权重、门控输入）。作者希望探索第三条路径：允许训练期间后门形成，但将其引导至可隔离、可在部署时关闭的独立组件。
AI.method: 提出Quarantined Expert Shutdown (QES)，在正则化引导的类MoE结构中实现：为Transformer语言模型增设路由化的专家专属LoRA分支与轻量路由器，通过辅助路由目标将触发条件行为汇聚到指定专家，同时保持其他专家上的良性能力。部署时仅需将隔离专家的路由权重置零。
AI.result: 在两项任务、三种攻击、四类模型族上，ASR从100%降至多数设定下的0–10%，下游效用常得到保持或仅轻微下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了"学习但引导"作为生成式LLM后门隔离的一个此前未探索的新机制。

title: Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the AI Data Readiness for Scientific Discovery (AIDaR) Workshop at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Paris
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly underpin scientific AI applications that reason over structured knowledge, from biomedical question answering to materials informatics. However, their logical reasoning often falls short, producing factual inaccuracies unacceptable in these settings. Reliable evaluation remains challenging: manual dataset construction scales poorly, and LLM-based generation risks embedding the very flaws it aims to measure. High-quality benchmarks must ground both correct and incorrect labelled examples in explicit background knowledge, formally verifiable by a standard reasoner. We propose a pipeline that automatically generates ontology-grounded multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks from any sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontology, with correct answers grounded in the ontology by design. Distractors are generated by perturbing the right-hand-side class expressions of class definition axioms, and their incorrectness is formally verified by an OWL reasoner via entailment checks. We evaluate the pipeline on three ontologies: Pizza (small, academic), PMDco (complex, materials science), and DOID (large, biomedical), generating 112, 2,491, and 15,216 MCQs respectively. Distractors span four semantic categories from class unsatisfiability to weakened subsumptions, enabling diagnostic evaluation of specific reasoning failures. Items meet natural language quality standards: mean LLM judge scores of 4.02, 4.36, and 3.36 out of 5 confirm fluency, and correct-answer-to-distractor similarity above 0.8 shows that wrong options cannot be dismissed on surface form alone. Six LLMs evaluated zero-shot achieve 41.1-76.8% accuracy, well above the 25% random-guessing baseline, indicating the benchmarks are challenging and discriminative. This work is a step towards more reliable benchmarks for assessing logical reasoning in scientific AI.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从OWL 2本体自动生成多选题基准的流程，正确答案由本体保证，干扰项经本体推理机形式化验证，并在三个本体上生成规模不等的数据集用于评测LLM逻辑推理。
AI.motivation: LLM在科学AI中常需对结构化知识进行逻辑推理，但推理能力不足且易产生事实错误。现有评测手段存在缺陷：人工构建数据集难以规模化，LLM生成数据可能把要测量的错误本身引入基准。因此需要高质量基准，使正确与错误样例都基于显式背景知识并可被标准推理机形式化验证。
AI.method: 构建一条自动生成本体驱动多选题基准的流水线，可从任何公理化充分的OWL 2本体生成MCQ，正确答案在设计上由本体支撑。干扰项通过对类定义公理的右侧类表达式进行扰动生成，并利用OWL推理机通过蕴含检查形式化验证其错误性。干扰项覆盖从类不可满足到弱化包含等四类语义范畴。
AI.result: 在Pizza、PMDco、DOID三个本体上分别生成112、2491、15216道MCQ。语言质量方面，LLM评判平均分分别为4.02、4.36、3.36（满分5），正确答案与干扰项相似度高于0.8，说明错误选项无法仅凭表面形式排除。六个LLM零样本评测准确率为41.1%–76.8%，显著高于25%随机猜测基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为科学AI中的逻辑推理评测提供了更可靠的基准构建途径，所生成基准具有挑战性和区分度，并支持对特定推理失败的诊断性评估。

title: Backdoor Purification for LoRA-Tuned LLMs via Null-Space Projection
summary: With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, the risk of backdoor attacks has become more severe. Existing backdoor purification methods typically rely on at least one of the strong assumptions, such as prior knowledge of triggers, access to clean references, or aggressive retraining, and they often lack comprehensive evaluations. These constraints substantially limit their practical applicability. To overcome these challenges, our work proposes purifying LoRA-tuned LLMs without these assumptions and even without post-hoc retraining of the suspect parameters. Our objective is to significantly reduce the attack success rates (ASR) while preserving both (i) the base model's general capabilities and (ii) the new downstream skills learned through the adapter. Through a series of ablation studies, we progressively scale our approach from a single layer in a text classification setting to a full-parameter LLM in the generative task. Through careful data curation and feature approximation, we extract high-fidelity backdoor directions and, for each layer or head, construct orthogonal null spaces in both the input and output channels, onto which the LoRA updates are projected. Empirically, our null-space projection method reduces the ASR from nearly 100% to less than 10%, while preserving the base model's benign performance and the adapter's learned abilities during downstream task adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需触发器先验、干净参考或事后重训练的后门净化方法，通过在输入/输出通道构造正交零空间并投影LoRA更新，将ASR从近100%降至10%以下，同时保留基座模型能力与适配器下游技能。
AI.motivation: LLM与PEFT（如LoRA）广泛使用使后门攻击风险加剧；现有后门净化方法依赖强假设（触发器先验、干净参考数据、激进重训练），且评估不全面，严重限制实用性。
AI.method: 在无上述假设、且不进行可疑参数事后重训练的前提下净化LoRA微调LLM。通过数据整理与特征近似提取高保真后门方向，对每层/每个注意力头在输入与输出通道构造正交零空间，将LoRA更新投影到该零空间上；并通过消融研究从文本分类的单层逐步扩展到生成任务的全参数LLM。
AI.result: 空空间投影方法将攻击成功率（ASR）从接近100%降至低于10%，同时保持基座模型的良性性能以及适配器在下游任务适配中获得的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在不依赖强假设、不重训练可疑参数的条件下有效净化LoRA后门，兼顾安全性与效用，具备更强的实际适用性。

title: R-GroundBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for R-Group Groundingin Markush Molecular Editing
summary: Recent advances in AI for scientific discovery enable molecular understandingand design, yet reasoning over incomplete chemical representations remainsunclear.Markush structures, which encode molecular families through variable R-groupplaceholders (\textit{R\textsubscript{1}}, \textit{R\textsubscript{2}}, \textit{X}, etc.), are ubiquitous in pharmaceutical patents and requiregrounding across molecular, textual, and chemical information.However, existing molecule-language benchmarks focus on fully specifiedmolecules, leaving R-group grounding largely unevaluated.We introduce R-GroundBench:, a diagnostic benchmark built from real patent Markushstructures, featuring a Multiple-Choice (VQA) track with controlled difficultyand modality splits, and an open-ended Generation track.Our results reveal a substantial gap between recognition andmolecular grounding.While models achieve over 90\% accuracy on Easy VQA, performance drops to56--66\% on Hard VQA when shortcuts are controlled.Chemical-domain VLMs also remain unreliable, achieving only 25.7--46.2\% on HardVQA despite domain-specific pretraining.Moreover, Generation Exact Match remains below 20\% for most models and below8\% when visual input is required.These findings reveal that current AI systems lack reliable grounding andexecution for Markush editing, highlighting challenges for AI-drivenscientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 R-GroundBench，一个基于真实专利 Markush 结构的诊断性基准，包含受控难度与模态划分的 VQA 轨道及开放式生成轨道，揭示当前模型在 R 基团接地与分子编辑上的显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: Markush 结构通过可变 R 基团占位符编码分子家族，广泛存在于药物专利中，需要跨分子、文本与化学信息进行接地。然而现有分子-语言基准仅关注完全指定的分子，R 基团接地问题基本未被评估。
AI.method: 构建 R-GroundBench，从真实专利 Markush 结构中派生，设置两个轨道：多选题（VQA）轨道，含受控难度与模态划分；以及开放式生成轨道。
AI.result: 模型在 Easy VQA 上准确率超 90%，但在控制捷径后 Hard VQA 降至 56–66%；化学领域 VLM 即使经领域预训练，Hard VQA 也仅 25.7–46.2%。生成任务中多数模型 Exact Match 低于 20%，需要视觉输入时低于 8%。
AI.conclusion: 现有 AI 系统缺乏可靠的 Markush 编辑接地与执行能力，构成 AI 驱动科学发现的重要挑战。

title: Reason in Style: Discovering and Controlling Style in Language Models
summary: Language models learn content and style jointly, making stylistic variation in their outputs difficult to identify and control. We study whether recurring styles in model responses can be discovered without supervision and explicitly controlled. We design an algorithm that learns to separate representations of content and style from language models' outputs and validate its effectiveness on math questions in a controlled setting. By applying this method to over 100K verified traces from nine distinct teacher models, we discover six recurring yet imbalanced styles. We then fine-tune smaller student models to follow these styles when explicitly conditioned on them, using importance weighting to balance the contribution of the styles represented in the corpus. This approach improves Pass@$k$ over standard fine-tuning on the same data across six math reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating that we can diversify the style of answers effectively. We confirm that this also results in strong correspondence between requested and realized styles. We find that style affects correctness: the probability of solving a problem depends on the style we condition on, and different problems benefit from different styles. In summary, our results show that stylistic variation in model-generated data can be discovered in an unsupervised way, and made explicit, providing a source of both control and improved reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出无监督方法从语言模型输出中分离内容与风格表示，发现九种教师模型的十万余条数学推理轨迹中存在六种重复但不均衡的风格，并通过显式风格条件微调学生模型，在六个数学推理基准上提升Pass@k并实现可控风格生成。
AI.motivation: 语言模型将内容与风格联合学习，导致输出中的风格变化难以识别与控制；作者希望探究模型响应中的重复风格能否被无监督发现并被显式控制，从而同时获得可控性与推理性能提升。
AI.method: 设计一种算法，从语言模型输出中学习分离内容与风格的表示，并在受控的数学问题场景下验证有效性；将该方法应用于九种不同教师模型的超过10万条经校验的推理轨迹，发现六种重复但分布不均衡的风格；随后用重要性加权微调较小的学生模型，使其在显式风格条件下遵循这些风格，以平衡语料中各风格的贡献。
AI.result: 在六个数学推理基准上，相比在同一数据上的标准微调，该方法提升了Pass@k；请求风格与实际生成风格之间具有强对应关系；风格影响正确性，解题概率取决于所条件的风格，且不同问题受益于不同风格。
AI.conclusion: 模型生成数据中的风格变化可被无监督发现并显式化，这既提供了控制手段，也带来推理性能的提升。

title: VERITYGATE: A Four-Gate Schema-Level Faithfulness Framework and Paired Benchmark for Grounded LLM Narrations over Structured Evidence
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/sachinkg12/yukti/releases/tag/veritygate-groundlm-2026-v1.0.0 Supplementary artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22668710
summary: Fluent LLM explanations may not follow the evidence from a structured system. We present VERITYGATE, a four-gate checker for declared evidence IDs, entities, numbers, and claim types. It checks a fixed schema; it does not verify every fact in the prose. At r=0 and r=1, we test 900 instances per setting (450 grounded-ungrounded pairs) with GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.3-70B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Under this schema-level contract and before repair, 80.3% of mini claims and 47.9% of Sonnet claims fail. These are verifier rejection rates, not prose-hallucination rates. One repair pass raises claim survival from 19.7% to 28.0% for mini and from 52.1% to 54.3% for Sonnet. Verified claims per example change by +0.14 for mini, -0.71 for Llama, and -0.47 for Sonnet, so survival and output volume must be reported together. A second Sonnet pass gives no clear gain. At r=1, Gate 4 covers 97.0%, 98.7%, and 100% of failing claims for mini, Llama, and Sonnet. Small human studies support the rules but show gaps between schema checks and correct prose. A domain-specific GPT-4o judge test shows an order effect, so it is only a usefulness check. We release the code and data.

AI.tldr: 提出四门控检查器VERITYGATE，验证LLM解释中的证据ID、实体、数字与主张类型是否符合结构化模式；结果显示不同模型在修复前后主张存活率与输出量的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 流畅的LLM解释可能并不遵循结构化系统提供的证据，因此需要一种在模式层面而非全事实层面的检查机制，以衡量解释与证据的对齐程度。
AI.method: VERITYGATE包含四个门控，分别检查声明的证据ID、实体、数字和主张类型，遵循固定模式且不核验散文中的每个事实。在r=0和r=1下，每设置测试900个实例（450个有据-无据配对），使用GPT-4o-mini、Llama-3.3-70B和Claude Sonnet 4.6，并进行一轮修复实验与小型人类研究。
AI.result: 修复前，mini有80.3%的主张、Sonnet有47.9%的主张未通过（为验证器拒绝率而非散文幻觉率）。一轮修复使主张存活率从19.7%升至28.0%（mini），从52.1%升至54.3%（Sonnet）。每例已验证主张数变化为mini +0.14、Llama -0.71、Sonnet -0.47。r=1时Gate 4对失败主张的覆盖率为mini 97.0%、Llama 98.7%、Sonnet 100%。第二次Sonnet修复无明确增益；GPT-4o评判测试显示顺序效应。
AI.conclusion: 模式级检查可有效识别解释与证据的结构性偏离，但存活率与输出量须同时报告；人类研究揭示模式检查与正确散文之间仍存在差距，领域特定评判仅作为有用性检验，代码与数据已公开。

title: ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization
comment: 37 pages, 16 figures. Project website and code: https://autosaddler-projectpage.github.io/activesaddler/
summary: Automated harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents by iteratively updating their prompts, tool interfaces, and control logic from execution feedback. However, existing methods primarily optimize how the harness is updated while largely fixing which training scenarios generate the feedback that drives those updates. As the harness evolves, the scenarios most useful for further optimization can change, suggesting that the training curriculum itself should adapt alongside the harness. We formulate this missing dimension of harness optimization as an automated curriculum learning problem and introduce ActiveSaddler. ActiveSaddler models the evolving curriculum as a non-stationary bandit with dynamically instantiated optimization targets. It abstracts recurring failures into reusable failure-pattern arms, estimates the potential learning progress from further targeting each pattern, and adaptively balances revisiting known weaknesses with exploring unseen scenarios for new ones. Optimization outcomes continually update both the set of discovered failure patterns and their priorities, allowing the curriculum to co-evolve with the harness. Experiments on GAIA2 and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that ActiveSaddler consistently discovers stronger harnesses, improving test Pass@1 by 4.4 and 7.5 percentage points over the same harness optimizer using a scenario order fixed before optimization, respectively. Ablations further show that these gains depend on dynamically constructing optimization targets, estimating their evolving utility, and balancing continued optimization with new failure discovery. Together, these results establish automated curriculum learning as a new crucial optimization dimension for harness optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ActiveSaddler，将 harness 优化中"训练场景该如何选择"这一被忽视的维度形式化为自动化课程学习问题，用非平稳 bandit 建模动态课程，使课程与 harness 协同演化，在 GAIA2 与 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上显著提升 Pass@1。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化 harness 优化方法（迭代更新 prompt、工具接口与控制逻辑）主要聚焦"如何更新 harness"，却基本固定了"由哪些训练场景产生反馈"这一前提。随着 harness 演化，对进一步优化最有用的场景会发生变化，因此训练课程本身也应随 harness 自适应调整。作者认为这是被现有工作忽略的关键优化维度。
AI.method: 将缺失的维度形式化为自动化课程学习问题，提出 ActiveSaddler。方法把演化中的课程建模为非平稳 bandit，并动态实例化优化目标：将反复出现的失败抽象为可复用的"失败模式臂"（failure-pattern arms），估计继续针对每种模式的潜在学习进展，在"重访已知弱点"与"探索新场景以发现新失败"之间自适应权衡。优化结果持续更新已发现失败模式的集合及其优先级，使课程与 harness 共同演化。
AI.result: 在 GAIA2 与 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，相比使用"优化前即固定场景顺序"的同一 harness 优化器，ActiveSaddler 持续发现更强的 harness，测试 Pass@1 分别提升 4.4 与 7.5 个百分点。消融实验表明，这些增益依赖于动态构建优化目标、估计其不断变化的效用，以及在持续优化与新失败发现之间进行平衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立自动化课程学习是 harness 优化的一个新的重要维度：不仅优化 harness 的更新方式，还应同步自适应地优化训练课程，二者协同演化可带来稳定且可观的性能提升。

title: ReHoPER: Receding-Horizon Planning for Enhanced Reasoning
summary: We propose ReHoPER, an inference-only, zero-shot method that improves large language models' reasoning by generating and answering intermediate questions along multiple paths before the final answer. It iteratively plans a horizon of candidate intermediate questions, selects one to answer, and replans from the updated history. ReHoPER is task-agnostic, using the same generic instructions across datasets and models without labeled data or task-specific prompt design. Across multiple datasets, including iLLC, a new controlled benchmark for compositional reasoning, ReHoPER outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains in the most compositional settings. Our implementation and the iLLC generator are publicly available to support future work.

AI.tldr: 提出ReHoPER：一种仅推理、零样本方法，通过在最终答案前沿多条路径生成并回答中间问题，提升大语言模型推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型推理提升方法常依赖标注数据或任务特定提示设计，泛化性受限。本文旨在实现任务无关的零样本推理增强。
AI.method: ReHoPER迭代地规划一个候选中间问题的horizon，选择一个进行回答，并基于更新后的历史重新规划；在所有数据集和模型上使用相同的通用指令，无需标注数据或任务特定提示。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，包括新的组合推理受控基准iLLC，ReHoPER优于强基线，且在最具组合性的设置中增益最大。实现与iLLC生成器已公开。
AI.conclusion: ReHoPER为任务无关、零样本的推理增强提供了有效方案，并公开资源以支持后续研究。

title: Distilling Directional Verification
summary: Knowledge distillation aims to transfer the factual knowledge of large language models to smaller models for efficient deployment. Yet a teacher may recall a relation in one direction while failing to generate the answer in the reverse direction. Distillation from its generated answers can therefore propagate this directional limitation to the student. The same teacher can nevertheless recognize such an answer by scoring the relation in the direction it knows. We introduce directional label distillation, in which frozen teachers score candidate answers in that known direction and the best-scoring candidate becomes the student's training target. On facts about parents and their children, known-direction scoring yields more accurate labels than scoring the requested direction, even after tuned corrections for name priors. With prior-corrected scores, the better direction depends on the facts rather than the template, and reverses on mined facts whose notable entity is the parent rather than the child. With the evaluated children's forward facts withheld, students trained on known-direction labels improve open-ended accuracy on their trained queries by 13 to 15 points over students trained on prior-corrected reverse labels. After generated answers are matched to a fixed name list by lexical similarity, students reproduce nearly all selected labels. Their accuracy largely follows label quality. The label advantage holds on unscreened queries and when candidates are retrieved without inserting correct answers. Our findings show that directional verification mitigates the transfer of errors from teacher-generated answers to students by providing more accurate training targets. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/directional-verification.

AI.tldr: 提出"方向性标签蒸馏"(directional label distillation)：让冻结教师模型在其"已知方向"上对候选答案打分，选取得分最高者作为学生模型训练标签，以缓解教师生成答案中方向性局限的传递。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏旨在将大模型的事实知识迁移到小模型以利于高效部署。但教师模型可能能回忆某一方向的关系（如"某人的孩子"），却无法在反方向（如"某人的父母"）生成答案。直接蒸馏其生成答案会把这种方向性缺陷传递给学生，导致错误标签。
AI.method: 引入方向性标签蒸馏：教师模型冻结，在其已知（可正确作答）方向上对候选答案打分，得分最高的候选成为学生的训练目标。对姓名先验进行调优校正后，在挖掘出的"显著实体为父母"的事实上，较优方向随事实本身而非模板变化并发生反转。学生生成答案通过词法相似度匹配到固定姓名列表。
AI.result: 在父母—子女事实上，已知方向打分比请求方向打分产生更准确的标签，即使经过针对姓名先验的调优校正依然如此。在隐藏所评估儿童的"正向"事实后，用已知方向标签训练的学生在其训练查询上的开放式准确率比用先验校正反向标签训练的学生高出13至15个百分点。匹配姓名列表后学生几乎复现所有选定标签，其准确率大体随标签质量变化。在未筛选查询、以及不插入正确答案进行候选检索时，标签优势依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 方向性验证通过提供更准确的训练目标，缓解了错误从教师生成答案向学生的传递。代码已开源。

title: Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model
summary: Decision models return probabilities intended for routing, abstention and automated action. Calibration makes those probabilities useful on average, but does not establish whether low confidence reflects chance or missing knowledge, nor whether confidence falls when a model moves beyond what it knows. We audit this distinction in Jev, a decision model, with over 15 public datasets and 6 generated task families, with paired interventions that vary the information supplied for a fixed item. Jev's confidence is calibrated on familiar closed-choice tasks but fails as an indicator of missing knowledge: with no answer-relevant information it assigns up to 0.80 to a salient option, and on news beyond an observed knowledge boundary it exceeds accuracy by 0.21--0.33, a gap that recalibration on earlier months does not close. Targeted yes/no questions give sharper readouts of the case: whether an outcome is settled (AUROC 1.00) and whether the evidence suffices (0.95, against 0.85 for confidence on the same items). Asking whether Jev knows the answer appears to flag fabricated entities and post-boundary news (0.91), but with realistic names or with dates removed it shows no advantage over answer uncertainty. Black-box knowledge audits therefore need explicit controls for surface cues. Code: https://github.com/Syntheme/beyond-answer-confidence.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了决策模型 Jev 的置信度是否能够区分"随机不确定性"与"知识缺失"，发现其置信度在熟悉封闭任务上校准良好，但在缺乏相关信息或超出知识边界时严重失效，且"是否知道答案"的追问易受表面线索干扰。
AI.motivation: 决策模型的概率输出常用于路由、弃权与自动执行，校准只保证平均意义上的可用性，却无法确定低置信度究竟源于随机性还是知识缺失，也无法判断模型是否在超出自身知识时降低置信度。论文旨在审计这一关键区分。
AI.method: 使用决策模型 Jev，在超过 15 个公开数据集与 6 类生成任务族上评测；采用配对干预，对同一问题改变所提供的信息；并设计针对性的是/否问题来探测"结果是否已定""证据是否充分""模型是否知道答案"。
AI.result: Jev 的置信度在熟悉的封闭选择任务上校准良好，但作为知识缺失指标失效：无答案相关信息时对显著选项给出高达 0.80 的置信度；对超出知识边界的新闻，置信度超过准确率 0.21–0.33，且用早期月份重校准无法弥合。是/否问题提供更清晰读数：判断结果是否已定 AUROC 1.00，判断证据是否充分 0.95（同一批题目上置信度仅 0.85）。追问"Jev 是否知道答案"可识别虚构实体与边界后新闻（0.91），但使用真实姓名或去除日期后，相对答案不确定性无任何优势。
AI.conclusion: 黑箱知识审计需要显式控制表面线索，否则探测结果可能被名称、日期等表层特征误导；仅靠校准的答案置信度不足以充当知识边界的可靠指标。

title: Sentence Specificity Scores for Collaborative Technical Documentation: A Domain-Transfer Study
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE 12th International Conference on Collaboration and Internet Computing (CIC)
summary: Collaboration depends on shared context, and technical documentation is one way that context persists across people and AI teammates. Specificity, the amount and exactness of detail expressed in language, shapes what information documentation captures and how precisely that information is communicated. This work audits sentence-specificity scoring artifacts on technical documentation and tests whether scores applied only after generation help choose among fixed LLM-generated revisions. Across Wikipedia and three technical-documentation corpora, the fixed general-domain predictor SpeciTeller and the pinned post-publication author-repository implementation of Ko et al.'s target-adapted predictor produce different corpus orders and same-sentence rank agreement from -0.066 to 0.510. Strict filtering and token-length adjustment change these patterns without reconciling them. In the Gemma set, SpeciTeller ranking raises direction-valid selection from 71.7% to 83.3% (+11.7 points; 95% source-case bootstrap interval +1.7 to +21.7); in the GPT-OSS-120B set, SpeciTeller ranking raises direction-valid selection from 51.7% to 56.7% (+5.0 points; 95% source-case bootstrap interval -6.7 to +16.7), and every primary single-score GPT-OSS-120B interval includes zero. These findings tie score interpretation and decision value to the predictor and candidate set.

AI.tldr: 本文审计技术文档上的句子具体性评分工具，并检验"仅在生成后"使用评分在固定LLM修订候选中进行选择的效果。SpeciTeller与Ko等人的目标适配预测器在不同语料上给出不同排序（同句秩一致度-0.066至0.510），严格过滤与长度调整无法使二者一致；SpeciTeller排序在Gemma集显著提升方向有效选择（+11.7点），而在GPT-OSS-120B集提升不显著（+5.0点，区间含零）。
AI.motivation: 协作依赖共享上下文，技术文档是上下文在人（及AI队友）之间持久化的载体；而具体性（细节的数量与精确度）决定了文档捕捉并传达信息的方式。已有句子具体性预测器众多，但缺乏对其作为"生成后选择判据"的可靠性审计，尤其是预测器与候选集之间的依赖关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在Wikipedia与三个技术文档语料上，对比固定通用域预测器SpeciTeller与Ko等人目标适配预测器（固定的发表后作者仓库实现）；考察语料级排序、同句秩一致度、严格过滤与token长度调整的影响；再在固定的LLM生成修订集合（Gemma与GPT-OSS-120B）上，仅用单一具体性分数排序，评估"方向有效选择"比例，并采用源案例bootstrap区间。
AI.result: 两个预测器产生不同的语料级排序，同句秩一致度介于-0.066至0.510；严格过滤与token长度调整改变排序模式但无法使二者调和。Gemma集上SpeciTeller排序将方向有效选择从71.7%提升至83.3%（+11.7点；95%区间+1.7至+21.7）；GPT-OSS-120B集从51.7%提升至56.7%（+5.0点；95%区间-6.7至+16.7），且所有GPT-OSS-120B单分数主区间均包含零。
AI.conclusion: 具体性分数的解释与其决策价值并非预测器无关的常量，而是同时取决于预测器本身与候选集构成。因此，将具体性评分作为生成后选择判据时，必须先明确预测器与候选集合，其增益不能跨预测器或跨模型无条件外推。

title: Capturing In-Context Learning Dynamics with Task Operators
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to perform new tasks from demonstrations without weight updates. However, every ICL inference requires processing the full set of examples, resulting in inefficient deployments, and how ICL works mechanistically is not fully understood. Prior work compresses ICL into fixed activation vectors extracted from specific layers or positions, but these input-independent interventions fail on complex tasks where the output depends on fine-grained interactions with the input. By analyzing the ICL forward pass, we show that each attention head's output is an affine transformation of its context-masked counterpart, and that the parameters of this transformation are empirically stable across samples for a given task. Building on this, we introduce Task Operator (TO), which replays this transformation as an analytically derived update to the attention output projection. Across lexical, algorithmic, and reasoning tasks, TO achieves the best overall performance among prior methods and substantially narrows the gap between zero-shot inference and ICL. We further show that the extracted knowledge concentrates in a task-specific sparse circuit across layers and positions, and that averaging operators from disjoint demonstration batches enables effective many-shot scaling without expanding the context window. Our code is available at https://github.com/gzxiong/task_operator.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Task Operator (TO)，通过分析 ICL 前向过程中注意力头输出与上下文掩码对应项之间的仿射变换关系，将 ICL 的知识提取为一个可复用的、任务特定的稀疏电路，从而在不扩展上下文窗口的情况下显著缩小零样本推理与 ICL 的性能差距。
AI.motivation: ICL 虽能让语言模型无需权重更新即可完成新任务，但每次推理都需处理全部示例，部署效率低；且其内部机制尚不完全清楚。已有方法把 ICL 压缩为固定激活向量，但这些与输入无关的干预在复杂任务上失效，因为复杂任务的输出依赖与输入的细粒度交互。
AI.method: 作者分析 ICL 的前向传播，发现每个注意力头的输出是其上下文掩码对应输出的仿射变换，且该变换参数在同一任务的不同样本间经验稳定。基于此提出 Task Operator (TO)，将该变换重放为对注意力输出投影的解析更新，实现无需完整示例的 ICL 复现。
AI.result: 在词汇、算法与推理任务上，TO 取得优于既有方法的整体最佳性能，并显著缩小零样本推理与 ICL 的差距。提取的知识集中于跨层与位置的、任务特定的稀疏电路；对来自不相交演示批次的算子取平均可实现有效的多次示例扩展，而无需扩大上下文窗口。
AI.conclusion: ICL 可被机制性地表示为注意力输出投影上的任务特定仿射更新，TO 提供了一个高效、可扩展且输入相关的 ICL 替代方案，为理解 ICL 机制与高效部署提供了新视角。

title: Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting
summary:
Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation.
  This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.

AI.tldr: 将指令微调语言模型嵌入六个DSGE模拟器，检验其政策行动是否符合经济动态；采用PPO为主要方法、GRPO为无评论家基线，考察长时程信用分配等问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能生成听起来合理的经济政策回应，但这不能说明其行动与经济动态一致，需要以模拟经济后果而非语言合理性来评判政策行动。
AI.method: 将指令微调语言模型置于六个Snowdrop支持的DSGE模拟器中，模型每轮观察经济状态与经济话语变化并选择有界政策行动，接收下一状态与经济奖励；实现统一Python接口支持重复实验、持续冲击、状态克隆与滚动时程模拟；以PPO为主方法，GRPO为匹配的无评论家基线，并测试方向性语义信号、奖励时程、轨迹热启动、跨模拟器迁移及历史锚定的冲击。
AI.result: 该设置形成长时程信用分配问题：政策效果可能在行动后数个季度才显现；PPO的习得价值函数可通过广义优势估计将延迟奖励传播到早期token，而GRPO无习得价值函数、仅基于完整回合回报分配组相对优势，无法区分哪一早期轮次导致结果，若所有回合回报相同则归一化优势为零。
AI.conclusion: 应以模拟经济后果而非表面合理的语言来评判语言模型的政策行动，PPO在长时程信用分配上优于GRPO。

title: Temporally-Resolved Token Attribution Reveals the Generation Dynamics of Diffusion Language Models
summary: This work presents Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients (DLIG), a token attribution method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that extends Integrated Gradients (IG~\cite{sundararajan2017axiomatic}) to arbitrary layers and denoising steps. DLIG attributes a DLM's progressive commitment to a self-generated or fixed completion for an input prompt. We establish direct correspondences between DLIG and the IG axioms of completeness, implementation invariance, linearity, and symmetry preservation. As a lightweight complement to interventional analysis, DLIG provides an inexpensive first check of mechanistic hypotheses across the denoising trajectory. We demonstrate this on word-sense disambiguation, multi-hop graph reasoning, and sentence infilling, revealing how DLMs draw on inputs across positions, layers, and denoising steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DLIG（Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients），一种面向扩散语言模型（DLM）的token归因方法，将Integrated Gradients扩展到任意层与任意去噪步，用于刻画DLM对自生成或固定completion的渐进承诺过程。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型的去噪轨迹中，模型对输出的"渐进承诺"机制尚缺乏细粒度、低成本的归因工具；现有interventional分析代价较高，需要一种轻量补充手段来检验机制假设。
AI.method: DLIG将Integrated Gradients从传统单一层/步的设定推广到DLM的任意层与任意去噪步，对输入prompt到自生成或固定completion的归因进行分解，并论证其与IG公理（完整性、实现不变性、线性、对称保持）的对应关系。
AI.result: DLIG与IG的核心公理建立直接对应；作为interventional分析的轻量补充，可在去噪轨迹上低成本地初步检验机制假设；在词义消歧、多跳图推理和句子填空任务上，揭示了DLM如何跨位置、跨层、跨去噪步利用输入信息。
AI.conclusion: DLIG为DLM提供了一种具备公理保障、跨层跨步的token归因方法，可作为机制可解释性研究的廉价前置检查工具，并在多类任务上展示了对DLM输入利用模式的可解释性洞察。

title: Verify Claims, Not Scores: Evidence-Based Verification of Modular Agents
summary: When developers change one component of an agent, such as its controller, a learned model or its verifier, they usually judge the change by an aggregate task score. That score cannot tell whether improvement was attainable, which component lost value, or what the agent's own checks certify. We introduce a claim-specific verification audit for modular agents that plan, act, check and refine. Instead of scoring the agent, the audit scores the evidence: each conclusion is recorded with the evidence behind it, one of four verdicts (supported, unsupported, unresolved or not evaluated) and the boundary within which it holds. Three tools supply that evidence. Oracle policies measure attainable improvement under an explicitly stated action set, so that a low value can be traced to the evaluation rather than to the environment. Replacing one component at a time with a perfect counterpart locates lost value, with null results read as unresolved whenever a downstream component could mask them. A separate test asks whether the verifier's score identifies the quantity it is read as bounding.
