Applied to a constrained portfolio-allocation agent in a synthetic market with known hidden regimes, the audit shows that the value of perfect regime information depends on the action set used to measure it, that the scenario generator discards most of the regime signal while better local fidelity does not improve decisions, and that the runtime verifier can be bypassed with no visible change in outcomes. The contribution is the protocol and the evidential distinctions it enforces; the empirical findings are specific to the agent and environment studied.

AI.tldr: 提出面向模块化智能体的"论断级验证审计"协议：不以聚合任务分数评价智能体，而是评价"证据"本身——每条结论需记录其支撑证据、四类判定（supported/unsupported/unresolved/not evaluated）及成立边界；并通过三种工具提供证据。
AI.motivation: 开发者更换智能体的某个组件（控制器、学习模型或验证器）时，通常只用聚合任务分数判断改动好坏。该分数无法说明：改进是否本来就可实现、哪个组件损失了价值、智能体自身的检查能证明什么。因此需要一种能区分这些问题的证据性审计方法。
AI.method: 1）Oracle策略：在明确声明的动作集下度量可达改进，使低分值可归因于评估而非环境；2）逐组件替换为完美对应物以定位价值损失，当下游组件可能掩盖结果时将零结果判读为unresolved；3）独立检验验证器的分数是否识别出其被当作界所解读的量。每条结论以证据、四类判定和成立边界记录。
AI.result: 应用于合成市场（含已知隐藏机制）中的受限组合配置智能体：完美机制信息的价值取决于度量所用的动作集；场景生成器丢弃了大部分机制信号，且提高局部保真度并未改善决策；运行时验证器可被绕过而对结果无可观测影响。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于协议本身及其强制执行的证据性区分（证据、判定类别、边界）；实证发现仅针对所研究的智能体与环境，不外推。

title: Generation Provenance Before Behavior Attribution: Auditing Synthetic Speech Research Objects
comment: Accepted to the Third NeurIPS Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale: Data Attribution and Provenance. 4 pages, 0 figures, 1 table. An aggregate reproducibility package is available from the authors on request!
summary: Attributing model behavior to synthetic training data requires knowing what produced each training item before estimating what that item caused. A waveform-label pair does not preserve this knowledge. We propose a generation-provenance substrate in which a synthetic research object binds source specification, generated content, waveform, target, fact requirements, quality signals, review lineage, and immutable manifest identity. Producer and selection mechanism determine evidentiary meaning; storage location and variable name do not. We audit this substrate in a private Japanese care-handoff pipeline. A 113-asset review population contains 1.552 hours of synthetic speech across six scenario families; all items have linked audio, transcripts, candidate notes, and fact checklists, but human evidence is selective and source-specific. Two faithful-only manifests are scenario-seed-disjoint and immutably versioned, while exact upstream attribution remains blocked by floating generator aliases, missing per-clip TTS and code stamps, and an unversioned checking prompt. We argue that generation provenance is necessary but not sufficient for behavior attribution: it defines the candidate causal graph and audit units, whereas contributive attribution still requires frozen training runs and intervention or influence evidence. The paper contributes a compact provenance contract, an audit protocol, and a bounded case study for synthetic-data attribution; controlled research access may be offered, but we do not claim causal training-data attribution, clinical validity, or unrestricted public release.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"生成溯源基座"（generation-provenance substrate），将合成研究对象绑定源规格、生成内容、波形、目标、事实需求、质量信号、审核谱系与不可变清单身份，以支撑对合成训练数据的行为归因。
AI.motivation: 要将模型行为归因于合成训练数据，必须先知道每个训练项由何生成，再估计该项造成了什么。但波形—标签对无法保存这一生成知识，导致上游归因受阻。
AI.method: 提出生成溯源基座：每个合成研究对象绑定源规格、生成内容、波形、目标、事实需求、质量信号、审核谱系及不可变清单身份；强调生产者与选取机制决定证据意义，而非存储位置或变量名。并在某日文护理交接私有流水线上进行审计：113 个资产审核样本、1.552 小时合成语音、六个场景族，均含音频、转写、候选记录与事实清单；两份仅保真清单为场景种子不相交且不可变版本化。
AI.result: 全部条目具备链接的音频、转写、候选记录与事实清单，但人工证据具有选择性与来源特异性；精确上游归因仍受阻于浮动的生成器别名、缺失的逐片段 TTS 与代码戳，以及未版本化的核查提示词。
AI.conclusion: 生成溯源是行为归因的必要非充分条件：它界定候选因果图与审计单元，而贡献性归因仍需冻结的训练运行与干预/影响证据。论贡献为紧凑溯源契约、审计协议与有界案例研究；不主张因果训练数据归因、临床有效性或无条件公开发布。

title: Generalization Is Stability, Not Accuracy: Multi-Axis Evaluation of LLMs
comment: Accepted at the TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop: Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Generalization in large language models (LLMs) is the ability to produce consistent and semantically stable outputs when the same input is expressed in different ways. Existing work typically evaluates generalization through aggregate accuracy on a single prompt format, task, or set of variations, which conflates robustness with overall benchmark performance. In this work, we show generalization evaluation at the level of individual examples, across multiple input variants, and across different aspects of model behavior, focusing on variability rather than reducing performance to a score that can be improved through narrow training or other ways that obfuscate generalization evaluation. Following this view, we introduce the Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO), a framework that measures how much model behavior changes for the same input under different variations and benchmarks, capturing variability across several dimensions including generation consistency, internal activations, confidence, and response mirroring. We show that many commonly used models exhibit statistically significant and consistent generalization instability: no model generalizes uniformly, behavioral axes capture independent failure modes, and cross-dataset variation can reverse model rankings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以“实例级、多变体、多行为维度”的方差视角评估大模型泛化，并给出SAGO框架，发现现有模型普遍存在显著且一致的泛化不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作通常用单一提示格式、单一任务或单组变体上的聚合准确率来评估泛化，将鲁棒性与整体基准性能混为一谈，掩盖了泛化的真实状况。
AI.method: 提出Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO) 框架，在单个样本层面、跨多种输入变体与基准，测量同一输入下模型行为的变化程度，涵盖生成一致性、内部激活、置信度与回应镜像等多个维度。
AI.result: 多个常用模型表现出统计显著且一致的泛化不稳定性：没有模型能均匀泛化，各行为轴反映相互独立的失败模式，跨数据集的变化甚至会逆转模型排名。
AI.conclusion: 泛化评估应关注实例级行为变异性而非聚合分数，SAGO提供了可揭示独立失败模式与排名翻转的多维评估路径。

title: LESS: Lightweight Evolutionary Supernet Search in Minutes
summary: Low-cost NAS must both explore high-performing architectures and identify them reliably, yet reducing evaluation cost often weakens the fidelity of candidate comparisons. Training-free methods reduce evaluation cost by replacing learned task feedback with proxy signals measured at initialization. We introduce LESS (Lightweight Evolutionary Supernet Search), a data-driven method that combines a brief fair hard-path warm-up with discrete search under a single CMA-ES distribution. Each proposal is evaluated as its decoded hard genotype after six candidate-conditioned supernet updates. On NAS-Bench-201, LESS achieves \(93.189\pm0.467\%\) CIFAR-10 test accuracy in 409.1 seconds, coming within 0.04 percentage points of FairNAS using approximately \(1/24\) of its source-reported search time. Matched controls show that calibration improves selected validation accuracy by \(0.577\) percentage points while changing best-visited accuracy by only \(0.054\) points, indicating that its primary effect is to reduce selection regret. The frozen configuration transfers without tuning to CIFAR-100 and ImageNet16-120 with \(69.615\pm1.139\%\) and \(43.720\pm1.697\%\) accuracy. Applied without tuning to the larger DARTS space, LESS achieves \(96.95\pm0.14\%\) on CIFAR-10 and \(82.43\pm0.80\%\) on CIFAR-100, with each search completing in approximately 43.5 minutes on a single GPU. Together, these results show that short, balanced, data-dependent updates enable competitive neural architecture search across datasets and search spaces within minutes.

AI.tldr: LESS 是一种数据驱动的轻量级进化超网搜索方法，通过在单一 CMA-ES 分布下结合短暂公平硬路径预热与离散搜索，在数分钟内实现具有竞争力的神经架构搜索。
AI.motivation: 低成本 NAS 需要同时高效探索高性能架构并可靠地识别它们，但降低评估成本往往会削弱候选架构比较的保真度；免训练方法虽以初始化时的代理信号替代学习任务反馈来降低成本，却可能损失评估可靠性。
AI.method: LESS 将短暂的公平硬路径预热与离散搜索统一在单一 CMA-ES 分布下；每个候选方案在六次候选条件化的超网更新后，以其解码后的硬基因型进行评估，属于数据驱动方法。
AI.result: 在 NAS-Bench-201 上，LESS 于 409.1 秒内达到 93.189±0.467% 的 CIFAR-10 测试精度，与 FairNAS 相差仅 0.04 个百分点，而搜索时间约为其来源报告时间的 1/24；匹配对照显示校准使所选验证精度提升 0.577 个百分点，而最佳访问精度仅变化 0.054 个百分点，表明其主要作用是降低选择遗憾。冻结配置无需调参即迁移至 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet16-120，分别达到 69.615±1.139% 和 43.720±1.697%；在更大的 DARTS 空间上无需调参，CIFAR-10 达 96.95±0.14%，CIFAR-100 达 82.43±0.80%，每次搜索在单 GPU 上约 43.5 分钟完成。
AI.conclusion: 短暂、平衡且依赖数据的更新使神经架构搜索能够在数分钟内跨数据集和搜索空间实现具有竞争力的性能。

title: OpenMTB-Audit: Exposing Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation
comment: Accepted for oral presentation and publication at the Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB) 2027
summary: Molecular tumor boards integrate genomic findings, clinical context, and therapeutic evidence to support precision oncology. As AI enters this workflow, a key safety challenge is distinguishing truly unsupported recommendations from evidence-supported options that still require oncologist review because of incomplete information, poor ECOG performance status, or other clinical caveats. We introduce OpenMTB-Audit, an open-source benchmark of 500 synthetic non-small cell lung cancer cases spanning five adversarial error categories and four safety labels: Supported, Partially Supported, Unsupported, and Insufficient Information. Across eight large language model configurations, we identify pervasive over-refusal: all LLM configurations failed to retain the Partially Supported label in 83.3-100% of true Partially Supported cases, achieving high aggregate safety scores through label collapse rather than clinically calibrated reasoning. To address this limitation, we developed MTB-AuditAgent, a deterministic seven-module framework separating evidence verification, missing-information detection, safety classification, and abstention. It reduces over-refusal to 6.7% and achieves 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%). A two-oncologist annotation study found disagreement concentrated at the boundary between information sufficiency and treatment optimization, underscoring the need to preserve clinically meaningful distinctions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenMTB-Audit基准与MTB-AuditAgent框架，用于审计分子肿瘤委员会中AI推荐的循证支持程度，解决过度拒答与标签塌缩问题。
AI.motivation: 随着AI进入分子肿瘤委员会工作流，一个关键安全挑战是区分"真正无证据支持的推荐"与"证据支持但因信息不全、ECOG体能状态差等临床限制仍需肿瘤医生复核的选项"。现有LLM配置存在严重误判，需要可量化审计的基准与可校准的推理框架。
AI.method: 构建OpenMTB-Audit开源基准，含500例合成非小细胞肺癌病例，覆盖五类对抗性错误与四个安全标签（Supported、Partially Supported、Unsupported、Insufficient Information）。评估八种LLM配置。提出MTB-AuditAgent确定性七模块框架，将证据核验、缺失信息检测、安全分类与弃权（abstention）分离处理。并开展双肿瘤医生标注研究。
AI.result: 八种LLM配置普遍存在过度拒答：在真实Partially Supported病例中，83.3%-100%未能保留该标签，通过标签塌缩获得高总体安全分而非临床校准推理。MTB-AuditAgent将过度拒答降至6.7%，准确率达91.2%（95% CI: 88.6-93.6%）。双肿瘤医生标注的分歧集中于信息充分性与治疗优化之间的边界。
AI.conclusion: AI肿瘤推荐审计需保留临床有意义的标签区分，避免以标签塌缩换取表面安全；模块化、确定性的证据核验与弃权设计可显著降低过度拒答并提升准确性。

title: Sharpening Tax in Post-Training
summary: An emerging hypothesis about reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs) is that it merely sharpens existing behaviors of a base model, improving single-shot accuracy at the cost of solution coverage. Although this trade-off has been observed in math and coding tasks, it need not extend to agentic tasks, where multi-turn tool use and interaction may require capabilities newly acquired during post-training. Our surprising finding is that pre-trained LLMs, equipped with a light inference harness, can serve as capable agents. Despite far lower accuracy (pass@1), they often surpass their post-trained counterparts in solution coverage (pass@K) given a sufficient test-time budget. We further analyze the underlying mechanism and show that post-training pushes tasks toward two extremes, always solved or never solved, and thereby improves sampling efficiency and consistency at the cost of solution coverage. To measure this cost, we propose Sharpening Tax, a diagnostic metric that quantifies the loss in test-time scalability after post-training. Across 14 base/post-trained model pairs from four families and three agentic benchmarks (42 cases in total), the tax is prevalent in most settings, can be estimated from a few rollouts, and correlates well with other metrics. Finally, we present posterior-tempered group sampling (PTGS), a simple plug-and-play Bayesian sampler that adapts the sampling temperature per prompt to its estimated difficulty. Applied during RL training in two agentic environments, PTGS pays a smaller tax than the fixed-temperature baseline, solving more tasks under repeated sampling while also improving single-shot accuracy.

AI.tldr: 预训练LLM配合轻量推理框架即可作为有能力的智能体，其在解覆盖度（pass@K）上常超越后训练模型；后训练将任务推向"总能解/从不解"两极，提升采样效率但牺牲覆盖度，作者提出锐化税（Sharpening Tax）度量该损失，并给出PTGS采样方法以减小该代价。
AI.motivation: 已有假设认为RL后训练只是"锐化"基座模型已有行为，以牺牲解覆盖度为代价换取单次准确率提升；但该权衡此前仅在数学与代码任务中被观察到，在需要多轮工具使用与交互的智能体任务中未必成立，因此需要重新检验并量化后训练对测试时扩展性的影响。
AI.method: 作者对比预训练模型（配轻量推理框架）与后训练模型在智能体基准上的pass@1与pass@K表现；通过分析任务求解概率分布变化解释机理；提出诊断指标Sharpening Tax量化后训练带来的测试时扩展性损失，在4个模型家族、14组基座/后训练配对、3个智能体基准共42个案例上评估其普遍性、可估计性及与其他指标的相关性；并提出即插即用的后验温度组采样（PTGS），依据估计难度自适应调整每个提示的采样温度，在两个智能体环境的RL训练中验证。
AI.result: 预训练模型虽pass@1显著更低，但在充足测试时预算下pass@K常超过其后训练对应模型；锐化税在大多数设置中普遍存在，可由少量rollout估计，并与其他指标相关性良好；PTGS相较固定温度基线缴纳更小的锐化税，在重复采样下解出更多任务，同时提升单次准确率。
AI.conclusion: RL后训练对LLM智能体的作用并非单纯增强，而是通过将任务推向"总能解或从不解"的两极来提升采样效率与一致性，代价是解覆盖度下降；该代价可由Sharpening Tax量化，并可通过PTGS这类按难度自适应温度的贝叶斯采样策略在训练中缓解，从而兼顾pass@1与pass@K。

title: Decision Titan: Test-Time Training for Long-Term Memory in Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-term dependencies remain a major challenge for sequential decision-making in the field of AI: RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and the limited expressivity of vector-based hidden states, whilst Transformer-based models are limited by the quadratic scaling of attention. Recent work has proposed tackling this problem with the Test-Time Training (TTT) framework, which stores episodic memories in the parameters of a neural network through gradient descent at both train and test-time. This approach has seen success in the domain of Natural Language Processing, however, to the best of our knowledge it has not yet been applied to the domain of Reinforcement Learning (RL), nor has there been a study analysing how this memory practically functions. In this paper, we study the potential of the TTT framework for offline RL by augmenting a Decision Transformer with TTT layers, dubbed the Decision Titan. We analyse performance and properties of the model in the X-Maze environment, an extension of T-Maze designed to test sequential memory, and investigate how the memory mechanism learns by visualising gate values over time. Our key findings are that Decision Titan can learn long-term dependencies with ranges 20x longer than the context window, generalises to lengths 1.7x the training data, but crucially temporal generalisation depends on the time embeddings used, and the ability to learn long-term dependencies depends on how the relevant information is encoded.

AI.tldr: 本文将测试时训练(TTT)框架引入离线强化学习,提出 Decision Titan(在 Decision Transformer 上增加 TTT 层),在 X-Maze 环境中验证其长程依赖建模能力,并可视化门控值以分析记忆机制。
AI.motivation: 序列决策中的长程依赖问题突出:RNN 存在梯度消失和向量隐状态表达能力受限,Transformer 受注意力二次复杂度限制。TTT 框架通过训练与测试时的梯度下降将情景记忆存入网络参数,已在 NLP 中成功,但尚未应用于 RL,也缺乏对其记忆机制如何实际运作的分析。
AI.method: 用 TTT 层增强 Decision Transformer,构建 Decision Titan;在 X-Maze(由 T-Maze 扩展而来、用于检验序列记忆)环境中评估性能与特性;通过可视化随时间的门控值来研究记忆机制的学习方式。
AI.result: Decision Titan 能学习比上下文窗口长 20 倍范围的长程依赖,并可泛化到 1.7 倍于训练数据的长度;但时序泛化依赖于所采用的时间嵌入,且长程依赖的学习能力取决于相关信息如何被编码。
AI.conclusion: TTT 在离线 RL 中具有潜力,Decision Titan 展现了显著的超上下文窗口记忆能力;但时序泛化与长程依赖学习并非无条件成立,分别受时间嵌入设计和信息编码方式制约。

title: Continual Reinforcement Learning with Neuroevolution
summary: Despite many studies about causes and remedies of plasticity loss in Reinforcement Learning (RL) under continual task changes, no RL method has yet consistently achieved a good balance between adaptation and forgetting. Here we turn to an alternative optimization paradigm, neuroevolution (NE): algorithms that search directly in weight space through mutation and selection over a population of neural networks. Across a wide array of environments and environmental changes, with policies ranging from a few hundred parameters to million-parameter networks, we compare evolution strategies (ES) and genetic algorithms (GAs) against state-of-the-art continual RL variants and population-based RL. ES most consistently achieves a good stability-plasticity trade-off, while the GA is the most plastic method but forgets more than ES. To explain this, we study the return landscape around each method's solutions. ES finds the widest neighborhoods, i.e.\ regions of weight space in which perturbed policies still solve the task, and the size of the overlap between the neighborhoods of consecutive tasks correlates with a method's stability-plasticity trade-off. Rewarding behavioral diversity in a GA through novelty search makes the population even more plastic, at the cost of forgetting. Finally, symptoms of plasticity loss commonly reported in RL do not transfer to NE. Overall, these results establish NE as a competitive alternative to RL under continual task changes, and suggest that training under perturbations in weight space may be a useful mechanism for continual learning more broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文比较神经进化（NE，含进化策略ES与遗传算法GA）与主流持续强化学习方法，发现ES在稳定性-可塑性权衡上表现最一致，并提出用权重空间中解的邻域宽度及其跨任务重叠度来解释其机制。
AI.motivation: 持续强化学习中的可塑性丧失问题长期存在，现有RL方法在任务持续变化时难以稳定地在"适应新任务"与"不遗忘旧任务"之间取得平衡，因此作者转向直接在权重空间搜索的神经进化范式寻找替代方案。
AI.method: 在多种环境和环境变化设定下，将进化策略（ES）与遗传算法（GA/新颖性搜索）同当前最先进的持续RL变体及基于种群的RL进行对比；策略规模覆盖数百参数到百万参数网络；并通过分析各方法解附近的回报景观（return landscape），测量权重空间中被扰动后仍能完成任务的最宽邻域，以及相邻任务邻域之间的重叠大小。
AI.result: ES最稳定地实现良好的稳定性-可塑性权衡；GA可塑性最强但遗忘更多；ES找到最宽的邻域，且相邻任务邻域重叠大小与方法的稳定性-可塑性权衡相关；在GA中通过新颖性搜索奖励行为多样性会进一步提升可塑性，但代价是更强的遗忘；RL中常见的可塑性丧失症状并未在NE中重现。
AI.conclusion: 神经进化是持续任务变化下相较RL具有竞争力的替代方案；在权重空间扰动下训练可能是更广泛持续学习的一种有效机制。

title: Which LLM to pick? Online Active Model Selection for Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to process streaming data, with practitioners relying on benchmarks to select the best model even though these signals only approximate real performance. While oracle annotations can provide reliable feedback, they are often costly and difficult to obtain at scale. To address this challenge, we propose ONLINE LLM PICKER, the first framework for active model selection for LLMs in online settings. Given an arbitrary stream of queries and a limited annotation budget, ONLINE LLM PICKER selects the most informative prompts for annotation to identify the best LLM among candidate models. Across multiple tasks including 10 datasets, for over 130 language models, we show that ONLINE LLM PICKER saves annotation cost by up to 71.67% while reliably identifying the best or near-best model for the stream. We also show that using the returned model for sequential generation on unannotated prompts across the stream reduces regret by up to a factor of 2.51x, indicating that ONLINE LLM PICKER can identify the best or near-best model well before processing all streaming prompts.

AI.tldr: 提出 ONLINE LLM PICKER，首个面向在线场景的 LLM 主动模型选择框架，在有限标注预算下挑选最具信息量的提示进行标注，从而识别最优候选模型。
AI.motivation: LLM 越来越多用于处理流式数据，从业者依赖基准来选择最佳模型，但基准信号只能近似真实性能；而可靠的 oracle 标注成本高、难以大规模获取。因此需要在在线流式场景下，用有限标注预算高效地识别最优模型。
AI.method: 将在线 LLM 选择形式化为主动模型选择问题：给定任意查询流与有限标注预算，ONLINE LLM PICKER 主动选择信息量最大的提示进行标注，以在候选模型中识别最优 LLM。实验覆盖 10 个数据集、多种任务及 130 多个语言模型。
AI.result: 最多节省 71.67% 的标注成本，同时可靠地识别出该查询流上的最优或近最优模型；在未标注提示上进行顺序生成时，遗憾（regret）最高降低 2.51 倍，说明无需处理完所有流式提示即可找到最优或近最优模型。
AI.conclusion: ONLINE LLM PICKER 是首个在线 LLM 主动模型选择框架，能在有限标注预算下显著降低标注成本并提前识别最优或近最优模型，适用于流式数据场景下的模型选择。

title: Q-Learning for Reachability in MEC-Free MDPs
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for reachability specifications is fundamental to sequential decision-making. Prior work establishes asymptotic convergence to optimal policies, but only through model-based methods that must explicitly estimate the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov Decision Process (MDP). We present Quasar, the first model-free algorithm with asymptotic guarantees for reachability on the fragment of MDPs free of non-terminal maximal end components (MECs), a building block to which every MDP reduces by the standard MEC quotient. Our algorithm follows the classical Q-learning approach, using temporal-difference updates to converge to an optimal policy without ever learning the transition probabilities. The resulting learner reduces the memory footprint from the O(|S|^2|A|) that model-based methods require to O(|S||A|). On the standardized Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set, our algorithm converges to the optimal policy with orders of magnitude fewer samples than the previous model-based state-of-the-art. Together these results are a concrete step toward the practical deployment of reachability learning and, with it, of specification-guided RL.

AI.tldr: Quasar是首个在无非终端MEC的MDP片段上对可达性目标具有渐近最优保证的无模型算法，用TD更新避免学习转移概率，将内存从O(|S|^2|A|)降至O(|S||A|)，并在QVBS上以少数量级的样本收敛到最优策略。
AI.motivation: 可达性规范的强化学习是序贯决策的基础，但已有渐近收敛到最优策略的方法都是基于模型的，必须显式估计底层MDP的转移概率，导致内存开销大、样本效率低，限制了实际部署。
AI.method: 提出Quasar：在无非终端极大端分量（MEC）的MDP片段上（任意MDP经标准MEC商约简后均可归约到该片段），采用经典Q-learning的时序差分（TD）更新，无需学习转移概率即可收敛到最优策略；用单一无模型学习器替代基于模型的方法。
AI.result: 内存占用由基于模型方法的O(|S|^2|A|)降至O(|S||A|)；在标准化定量验证基准集（Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set, QVBS）上，收敛到最优策略所需样本数比此前基于模型的最优方法少若干个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Quasar首次为可达性学习提供了无模型的渐近保证，显著降低内存与样本需求，是推动可达性学习及规范引导强化学习走向实际部署的具体一步。

title: Code Owns the Simulation, Jev Owns the Evaluation
comment: 10 pages main text, 20 pages total with appendix; 6 figures, 7 tables. Preprint
summary: Judgment models such as \jev{} return, in a single call and without reasoning text, a probability for each described option. This makes them attractive as an agent's action-selection layer, but it is unclear which decisions they can be trusted with. We test \jev{} on reflection tests, one-shot matrix games, the text game ALFWorld and robot control, and find a sharp boundary. \jev{} succeeds when the right option can be judged from what the input describes, which we call \emph{evaluation}. Specifically, it solves 99\% of the counterintuitive Cognitive Reflection Test questions. However, it fails when the right option depends on \emph{simulation} (i.e., predicting something not in the input), such as the opponent's action or the subgoal that must come first. In games, \jev{} plays suboptimally as if its rational opponent acted at random, because the opponent's action is not given. In ALFWorld, \jev{} favors commands that mention an object or place named in the task description. For example, given the task ``put a clean knife in the drawer'', \jev{} carries an unwashed knife straight to the drawer instead of first washing it at the sink. Surprisingly, many of these failures are not due to a lack of knowledge. Asked separately what the opponent will do, \jev{} usually answers correctly, and it responds well given the opponent's action. It fails when one call must both perform the simulation and evaluate based on it. This suggests letting code make the prediction or simulation. When code supplies it, such as a lookahead in ALFWorld and physics simulation in robot control, \jev{} becomes an expert controller through its general evaluation ability.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了JEV等判断模型在反思测试、矩阵博弈、ALFWorld文本游戏和机器人控制中的表现，发现其能力存在清晰边界：擅长"评估"（依据输入描述判断选项），但缺乏"模拟"（预测输入中未给出的信息）；引入代码进行模拟后，其评估能力可使其成为专家级控制器。
AI.motivation: 判断类模型（如JEV）单次调用即可为每个选项输出概率、无需推理文本，因而适合作为智能体的动作选择层，但其可信赖的决策范围尚不明确，需要界定其能力边界。
AI.method: 在认知反思测试（CRT）、单次矩阵博弈、ALFWorld文本游戏和机器人控制四类任务上测试JEV，并设计对照实验，检验"单独询问对手动作"与"单次调用同时模拟并评估"的差异，以及由代码提供模拟（如ALFWorld的lookahead、机器人控制的物理仿真）后的效果。
AI.result: JEV在可依据输入描述判断正确选项的"评估"任务上表现优异，解决99%的反直觉CRT问题；但在依赖"模拟"的任务上失败：博弈中如同面对随机对手般次优行动，ALFWorld中偏好任务描述里提到的物体或地点（如把未洗的刀直接放入抽屉而非先去水槽清洗）。这些失败并非知识缺失——单独询问时它能正确预测对手动作，给定对手动作后表现良好；仅在单次调用需同时完成模拟与评估时才失败。
AI.conclusion: 让代码负责预测或模拟：当代码提供模拟信息时（如ALFWorld的lookahead和机器人控制的物理仿真），JEV凭借通用评估能力可成为专家级控制器。这为判断模型作为动作选择层时的设计提供了指导。

title: TRACE: Tackling Real-World Resource Assignment Problems via Agentic Heuristic Design
summary: Dynamic resource assignment, the real-time allocation of task streams to heterogeneous processing nodes, is the backbone of modern computing infrastructure. While learning-based schedulers excel in research, industrial deployments still rely on hand-written rules that operators can read, audit, and execute within tight latency budgets. LLM-based Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) promises to automate writing such rules. However, existing AHD frameworks were developed for combinatorial problems fully specified to the LLM, and they learn only from a scalar fitness score. In real systems, the behaviour that determines a good heuristic, such as processor speeds or power consumption, is unknown a priori: the score reveals which heuristic performs better, but not why. This missing information is recorded in the system logs that every evaluation produces. Exploiting it is non-trivial: logs are massive and noisy, the relevant signals depend on the objective, and their content and format vary across hardware and software stacks, so they can neither be fed to an LLM as is nor processed by a fixed parser. We propose TRACE, which couples an evolutionary AHD loop with an agentic knowledge-extraction workflow. A Reasoner agent analyzes the log schema in light of the objective and formulates hypotheses about the system dynamics; a Coder agent writes and executes schema-specific code to test them, producing insights or executable tools for the evolved heuristics. We evaluate TRACE on a synthetic cloud benchmark and a 5G vRAN scenario built from industrial testbed measurements and operational traffic traces. TRACE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art AHD methods in resource assignment problems and yields more auditable heuristics at under 2% overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE框架，将进化式自动启发式设计（AHD）与智能体式知识抽取工作流耦合，从系统日志中挖掘与目标相关的动态信号来指导启发式生成。在合成云基准与基于工业测量的5G vRAN场景中，TRACE在资源分配问题上一致优于SOTA AHD方法，并生成更可审计的启发式，额外开销低于2%。
AI.motivation: 现代计算基础设施的核心是动态资源分配，即将任务流实时分配到异构处理节点。工业部署仍依赖人工编写的规则，以便运维人员阅读、审计并在严格的延迟预算内执行。基于LLM的自动启发式设计（AHD）有望自动生成这类规则，但现有AHD框架面向完全指定给LLM的组合优化问题，且仅从标量适应度分数学习。真实系统中决定启发式优劣的行为（如处理器速度、功耗）先验未知：分数只揭示哪个启发式更好，而不揭示原因。这些缺失信息记录在每次评估产生的系统日志中，但日志体量大、噪声高，相关信号依赖目标，格式随软硬件栈变化，既不能原样喂给LLM，也无法用固定解析器处理。
AI.method: TRACE耦合进化式AHD循环与智能体式知识抽取工作流。其中Reasoner智能体结合优化目标分析日志模式（schema），提出关于系统动态的假设；Coder智能体编写并执行特定schema的代码来检验这些假设，从而产出洞见或可执行工具，用于指导被进化的启发式。
AI.result: 在合成云基准和一个由工业测试床测量与运营流量轨迹构建的5G vRAN场景上进行评估。TRACE在资源分配问题上持续优于最先进的AHD方法，产生更可审计的启发式，且额外开销低于2%。
AI.conclusion: TRACE表明，将系统日志中的因果性知识通过智能体式抽取引入AHD循环，可突破仅依赖标量适应度反馈的局限，在真实异构资源分配场景中生成更优且可审计的调度启发式，且开销可忽略。

title: Counterfactual Auditing of Bias in Open-Source Large Language Models for Clinical Triage
summary: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. Models include Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a QLoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage, overtriage, shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, versus 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base model. Several larger or medical-domain models showed more significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses further revealed clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns hidden by aggregate rates. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight, clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks in open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 对十种开源大语言模型在小儿ESI分诊预测中进行反事实偏差审计，发现模型规模与医学预训练并不必然降低反事实敏感性，微调模型表现最优。
AI.motivation: 急诊分诊是高风险优先级判定任务，人口学、社会经济与系统背景信息可能不当影响分级。开源大模型被日益用于本地化、隐私保护的临床决策支持，但其反事实偏差在不同模型家族、规模、医学领域与领域适配模型间如何变化尚不清楚。
AI.method: 基于真实及手册式临床情景构建配对反事实变体，每次仅改变一项注入的人口学、社会经济、医疗可及性、行为、社会或系统背景变量，保持临床表现固定。审计对象包括Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct、QLoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B、MedGemma系列、MedLLaMA2-7B、GPT-OSS-20B与GPT-OSS-120B。指标包括任何反事实偏移、漏诊（undertriage）、过度分诊（overtriage）、偏移超过一个ESI等级、平均偏移及平均绝对偏移。
AI.result: 反事实敏感性差异显著，且不随模型规模增大或医学领域预训练而稳定下降。微调Qwen2.5-7B总体敏感性最低，任何偏移率5.27%、平均绝对偏移0.0534，而基座模型分别为16.02%和0.1706；若干更大或医学领域模型表现出更显著偏移。分层与相关分析揭示出聚合比率所掩盖的临床重要方向性与共有失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 反事实审计可作为轻量、临床可解释的框架，用于开源大模型临床部署前的公平性风险评估。

title: Universal Byte-Level Encoding: UTF-8/UTF-16 Routing to Reduce Cross-Script Token-Budget Disparities
summary: Byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizers are attractive for multilingual large language models (LLMs) because they cover all Unicode text. In UTF-8-based BBPE, however, many scripts start from a higher fallback cost than English: when no learned merges can be applied, a multibyte character requires multiple byte-derived symbols. We call this worst-case pre-merge cost the encoding floor. A higher floor can increase token counts and per-request cost and shrink usable context. Changing the text encoding can reduce this gap, but a single global encoding can make already-efficient English spans more expensive in mixed-script text. We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps 1-2-byte UTF-8 characters on the UTF-8 path while routing 3-4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE); the merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE's LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and slightly lowers English token counts, yielding more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 UBE 双字母表分词器：1-2 字节 UTF-8 字符走 UTF-8 路径，3-4 字节字符走 UTF-16，降低编码下限，缩小跨语言 token 差异且不损失性能。
AI.motivation: BBPE 分词器虽覆盖全 Unicode，但在基于 UTF-8 的方案中，非英语文字的"编码下限"（无合并规则可用时多字节字符需拆成多个字节派生符号的最坏代价）更高，导致 token 数与请求成本上升、可用上下文被压缩。更换文本编码可缩小差距，但单一全局编码会让混合文本中原本高效的英文片段变贵。
AI.method: UBE（Universal Byte-Level Encoding）双字母表分词器：保留 1-2 字节 UTF-8 字符于 UTF-8 路径，将 3-4 字节 UTF-8 字符经 UTF-16 路由，从而降低高 token 溢价文字中 3 字节 BMP 字符的编码下限，同时不抬升混合文本中已高效片段的成本。仅改变呈现给 BPE 的字节表示，合并规则仍为标准 BPE，精确解码得以保留，并可与其他边界策略和形态学表示组合。
AI.result: Unicode 17 审计中，UBE 对所有 Unicode 标量值及官方 normalization、grapheme-break、emoji 测试集均可精确往返；内在评测中降低英语归一化 token 计数比的离散度，减少跨语言 token 预算差异；多语言 LM 实验中质量与 BBPE 相当；主要多语言设置下对高溢价文字减少 token 数最多，并略微降低英文 token 数，在固定 token 预算下提供更多可用上下文，内容匹配基准上提示处理更快。
AI.conclusion: UBE 通过双字母表路由在保持标准 BPE 与精确解码的前提下降低编码下限，缩小跨语言 token 预算差距、提升固定预算下的可用上下文并加速提示处理，且不牺牲语言模型质量。

title: Scalable, Transferable Meta-network for Data Selection Requires a Different Loss (and Why the Obvious Choice is Problematic)
summary: Data selection is critical for training large language models on massive and heterogeneous corpora. Meta-learning for Training-data Selection offers a principled alternative to heuristic scoring by learning data weights from a target validation objective, but existing methods face a trade-off between fine-grained valuation and transferability to unseen data. A natural solution is to replace per-sample weights with a selection network. However, we find that directly incorporating such a network into existing MTS objectives leads to unstable optimization and poor generalization, caused by weight suppression and persistent reliance on easy-to-learn features. To address these issues, we propose Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS), a scalable data-selection framework built on a Pointwise Value Matching objective (PVM). Experiments on LLM safety and targeted instruction tuning demonstrate strong transfer across datasets, from subsets to full corpora, and from smaller to larger models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TESS，一种基于逐点价值匹配目标的可迁移数据选择框架，用于大语言模型训练语料筛选，在安全与定向指令微调任务上展现出跨数据集、跨规模和跨模型的有效迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 大规模异质语料训练大语言模型时，数据选择至关重要。元学习式训练数据选择（MTS）虽比启发式打分更有原则，但现有方法面临细粒度估值与对未见数据可迁移性之间的权衡。用选择网络替代逐样本权重是自然的思路，但直接嵌入现有MTS目标会导致权重抑制和持续依赖易学特征，从而造成优化不稳定与泛化差。
AI.method: 提出TESS（Transferable Example Scoring and Selection）可扩展数据选择框架，核心是构建于逐点价值匹配目标（Pointwise Value Matching, PVM）之上，以选择网络替代逐样本权重，缓解权重抑制及对易学特征的依赖。
AI.result: 在大语言模型安全与定向指令微调实验中，TESS展现出强迁移性：从子集到全语料、从较小模型到较大模型、以及跨数据集均能有效迁移。
AI.conclusion: TESS通过PVM目标缓解了选择网络在MTS中的优化不稳定与泛化问题，为大规模LLM数据选择提供了可扩展且具迁移性的方案。

title: From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.

AI.tldr: 研究"源学习"问题，提出SourceLearn构建并持续精化持久化源模型，在5个基准、3个LLM后端上表现最佳。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需反复访问持久外部源以完成知识密集型任务序列。现有方法聚焦于源内容的访问与组织方式，智能体记忆系统保存可复用知识，但同一源的重复使用仍被视为重复访问，而非逐步深化对该源理解的机会。作者由此提出"源学习"：在持久权威源上构建可复用的源特定能力。
AI.method: 用持久化的"源模型"表示该能力，刻画对源知识结构、解释与应用的复用性理解。提出SourceLearn，融合两种互补机制：自导向源学习（Self-Directed Source Learning）识别尚未完全理解的部分，自适应重访源；任务导向源学习（Task-Guided Source Learning）利用下游经验揭示局部表征缺口与源知识组织的反复需求。两者中学习信号决定"重新考虑什么"，持久化更新则从权威源重建。
AI.result: 在5个基准、3个LLM后端共15个设置中，SourceLearn有13个取得最佳性能，相比Hybrid RAG最大提升22.6个点，并相对静态源表征与基于经验的记忆基线有显著整体改进。
AI.conclusion: 将同一源的重用从"重复访问"重构为"渐进式源学习"，并通过自导向与任务导向双机制持续精化源模型，可有效提升源特定能力，优于RAG与记忆类基线。

title: Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM），将离散token生成与连续隐轨迹耦合在统一的去噪过程中，以潜变量作为唯一持久生成状态，在数独、倒计时和LM1B任务上超越离散与连续扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型并行解码时各token独立从边缘分布采样，破坏了同批解码token间的统计依赖；连续扩散模型通过去噪共享连续状态来规避该问题，但其去噪器只看到该状态，在最终解码前无法保证其对应有效token配置。因此需要一种能同时保持token间依赖与有效token配置约束的方法。
AI.method: 提出HC-DLM，在单一有原则的去噪过程中耦合离散token生成与连续隐轨迹，训练目标由token似然的变分下界推导得到。与将连续上下文附着于自包含离散链的近期方法不同，HC-DLM将潜变量作为唯一持久生成状态：每一步从中读出token，并将token反馈作为下一潜变量更新的支架（scaffold）。
AI.result: 在结构化推理（Sudoku）、数学规划（Countdown）和语言建模（LM1B）任务上，在匹配模型规模下，HC-DLM在Sudoku与Countdown的谜题准确率以及LM1B的生成困惑度上均优于离散与连续扩散基线。
AI.conclusion: 以连续潜变量为唯一持久生成状态、并将读出的token反馈为潜更新的支架，可在单一去噪过程中同时保留token间统计依赖与有效token配置约束，从而在结构化推理、数学规划和语言建模上取得一致改进。项目页面：https://hc-dlm.github.io/。

title: Multi-Behavioral Evolved Substrates Through Neuromodulation and Activation Selection
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Published version of the paper presented at ALIFE 2026: Proceedings of the 2026 Artificial Life Conference (MIT Press). Code and data: https://github.com/RomainClaret/emr-hyperneat
summary:
Open-ended artificial life systems must acquire diverse competencies from a single evolving genotype. Biological brains combine neuromodulation, which reconfigures circuits without changing connections, with diverse neuron types matched to specific computational roles. Can artificial evolution achieve something analogous in indirectly encoded substrates?
  Using indirectly encoded substrates evolved via CPPNs, we show through more than 10,000 experiments that neuromodulation alone is insufficient: under evolutionary search, monotonic activation functions impose a 75% ceiling on parity tasks that persists regardless of capacity, topology, or population size. This is an evolutionary search barrier, not a representational limit, since Adam gradient descent achieves 100% on the identical architecture.
  We combine neuromodulation with per-task activation function selection, matching oscillatory primitives to parity tasks and monotonic to threshold tasks, producing multi-behavioral evolved substrates. The result: 100% simultaneous 5-task success across all 30 seeds (median 14 generations). This generalizes across the oscillatory activation class: all four functions reach 100% (30 seeds each). Neither mechanism suffices alone.
  The barrier extends to higher-arity and asymmetric tasks, while multi-layer depth provides an alternative path. For open-ended evolution, the computational primitive should itself be an evolvable trait. At inference, one evolved genotype expresses many behaviors.

AI.tldr: 在间接编码（CPPN）人工生命系统中，单独使用神经调制无法突破进化搜索瓶颈；必须让激活函数本身成为可进化性状，才能由单一基因型表达多种行为。
AI.motivation: 开放式人工生命系统需要从单一进化基因型获得多样能力。生物大脑将神经调制（不改变连接即重构电路）与承担特定计算角色的多种神经元类型相结合。作者希望探究：人工进化能否在间接编码基质中实现类似机制。
AI.method: 基于CPPN间接编码基质进行超过10,000次进化实验；对比神经调制单独作用与"神经调制+逐任务激活函数选择"的组合；将振荡型激活原语匹配奇偶（parity）任务、单调型匹配阈值任务；并分析高元、非对称任务及多层深度的作用。
AI.result: 神经调制单独作用时，单调激活函数在奇偶任务上形成75%的成功率上限，且不随容量、拓扑或种群规模改变；而Adam梯度下降在同一结构上可达100%，表明这是进化搜索障碍而非表征极限。将神经调制与逐任务激活函数选择结合后，全部30个种子同时完成5任务达100%（中位14代），并在全部四种振荡激活函数上均达100%（每种30个种子）。瓶颈同样存在于高元与非对称任务，多层深度可作为替代路径。
AI.conclusion: 单一机制均不足以支撑多行为进化。对开放式进化而言，计算原语本身应当是可变性状。推理阶段，单个进化出的基因型即可表达多种行为。

title: Per-Node Activation Function Evolution in Indirectly Encoded Substrates: Solvability, Limits, and Emergent Diversity
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Published in ALIFE 2026 (MIT Press). This is the version of record, posted under CC BY 4.0
summary:
Biological neurons achieve computational diversity through specialized types: tonic, bursting, adapting, and fast-spiking cells coexist within the same circuit. Artificial neural networks, by contrast, apply a single activation function uniformly to all nodes, which limits what they can represent. We show that this uniformity creates hard limits for evolutionary search: across sparse evolved substrates, monotonic functions fail to solve parity beyond its smallest instance, XOR, while a single oscillatory unit suffices at all tested scales. The gap is one of search and sparsity, not representation: monotonic networks can represent parity with a modest number of hidden units, and gradient descent recovers that solution. We evolve, to our knowledge for the first time in indirect encoding, per-node activation function assignments from an 18-function palette across more than 4,500 experimental runs spanning Boolean logic, regression, and spatial classification.
  Testing each of the 18 functions individually on Parity-4 reveals a three-tier solvability structure: oscillatory functions achieve 100%, intermediate functions 6.7-80%, and all 9 monotonic functions 0%. This divide is not universal. Recurrence collapses it, and gradient descent inverts it entirely, showing that the barrier is specific to evolutionary search in sparse substrates. What activation functions a network can use, beyond its topology and weights, determines what evolutionary search can solve. Indirect encoding discovers heterogeneous per-node activation assignments unlikely to be chosen by hand.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明，稀疏进化基质中所有节点统一使用单一激活函数会造成进化搜索的硬性限制：单调函数无法求解比 XOR 更大的奇偶校验任务，而单个振荡单元即可在所有测试规模上成功；这一障碍属于搜索与稀疏性问题而非表示能力问题，并首次在间接编码中进化出逐节点激活函数分配。
AI.motivation: 生物神经元通过 tonic、bursting、adapting、fast-spiking 等专门类型在同一回路内实现计算多样性，而人工神经网络对所有节点统一施加同一激活函数，限制了其可表示与可搜索的解空间。作者希望探究这种统一性对进化搜索能力的具体制约，以及激活函数多样性在稀疏间接编码基质中的作用。
AI.method: 在间接编码框架下，进化逐节点的激活函数分配，使用一个包含 18 种激活函数的函数库，覆盖布尔逻辑、回归和空间分类任务，共进行超过 4,500 次实验运行；并单独测试 18 种函数在 Parity-4 上的表现，同时对比循环连接和梯度下降的情形。
AI.result: 在 Parity-4 上呈现三层可解性结构：振荡函数达 100%，中间函数为 6.7%–80%，全部 9 个单调函数均为 0%。单调网络在稀疏进化基质中无法求解超过最小实例 XOR 的奇偶校验，但以少量隐藏单元即可表示该解，且梯度下降能够恢复该解。该分化并非普遍规律：循环连接会使其消失，梯度下降则完全逆转该结果。
AI.conclusion: 网络可使用的激活函数（而非仅拓扑与权重）决定了进化搜索能求解什么；该障碍特异地存在于稀疏基质中的进化搜索。间接编码能够发现手工难以选择的异质逐节点激活函数分配。

title: Neuromorphic Pseudo-Random Number Generators with a Low Power Hardware Implementation
summary: Pseudo-random number generation often requires trade-offs among quality, power consumption, and bandwidth to produce unpredictable sequences of numbers. The brain, on the other hand, efficiently generates unpredictable output complex network dynamics occurring in a high-dimensional state. This state, which is hypothesized to be chaotic, relies on the balance between excitation and inhibition. Here, we investigated if computational models of these chaotic balanced states can be harnessed for Neuromorphic Pseudo-Random Number Generators (NPRNGs) in low power hardware. We successfully constructed a balanced spiking neural network model consisting of leaky-integrate-and-fire neurons that could be readily implemented in low power FPGAs and used as a NPRNG. The prototyped NPRNG consumed 3.24 mW during operation and produced pseudo-random numbers at 120kbps. In both hardware and software instantiations, NPRNGs produce high-quality random numbers as validated by standard metrics for testing RNG quality.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了基于兴奋-抑制平衡的脉冲神经网络模型，将其用作低功耗神经形态伪随机数生成器（NPRNG），并在FPGA上实现，功耗3.24 mW、速率120 kbps，随机数质量通过标准测试。
AI.motivation: 传统伪随机数生成需在质量、功耗与带宽之间权衡。大脑通过高维状态中的混沌网络动力学高效产生不可预测输出，该状态依赖兴奋与抑制的平衡。作者希望验证此类混沌平衡态计算模型能否用于低功耗硬件的神经形态伪随机数生成器。
AI.method: 构建由漏电积分放电（LIF）神经元组成的平衡脉冲神经网络模型，该模型便于在低功耗FPGA上实现，并作为NPRNG使用。
AI.result: 原型NPRNG运行时功耗为3.24 mW，产生伪随机数的速率为120 kbps；在硬件与软件实现中，均通过标准RNG质量测试指标验证，产生高质量随机数。
AI.conclusion: 基于混沌平衡态脉冲神经网络的模型可作为低功耗神经形态伪随机数生成器，在低功耗、低带宽条件下生成高质量随机数，为神经形态硬件中的随机数生成提供了可行方案。

title: Inherited Learning in an Artificial Ecology: How Controls and Update Allocation Shape Benefits
summary: Learning can improve an individual's behavior, yet a population risks losing that experience whenever individuals die and are replaced. Inheriting learned preferences offers a way to preserve useful behavior across generations, raising a question for artificial populations: when does inheritance improve collective performance, and how can its benefits be measured fairly? The challenge is that inheritance changes not only offspring behavior but also survival, reproduction, and opportunities for further hereditary updates. Random controls with equal update magnitudes may therefore yield misleading comparisons if they alter different states or obey different stability constraints. We investigate this problem in a resource-limited artificial ecology, combining structured random controls with interventions on newborn preferences and the allocation of hereditary updates. Preserving the state structure of random updates substantially narrows the apparent inheritance advantage, while a conditional establishment-speed benefit remains. Preference erasure and faster-learning compensation support a contribution from reduced offspring relearning. Update allocation also changes the comparison: event quotas and common time cutoffs can reverse rankings, although they also change realized update amounts. With update count and cumulative magnitudes matched, staged release improves occupancy but does not achieve the prespecified establishment criterion. These findings provide a framework for distinguishing the value of inherited preferences from the effects of control design and update allocation, clarifying how inherited learning should be evaluated in artificial populations.

AI.tldr: 该论文在资源受限的人工生态中研究“继承学习偏好”何时提升群体表现以及如何公平度量其收益。结论是：保留随机更新的状态结构后，继承优势显著缩小，仅余条件性的建立速度收益；更新分配方式也会改变比较结果。
AI.motivation: 个体死亡与被替换会使种群丧失学习所得经验，而继承习得偏好可在代际间保留有用行为。核心问题是：继承何时改善集体表现，以及如何在不被混杂因素误导的前提下公平测量其收益。难点在于继承不仅改变后代行为，还改变存活、繁殖与后续遗传更新的机会，等更新幅度的随机对照若改变不同状态或遵循不同稳定性约束，会产生误导性比较。
AI.method: 在资源受限的人工生态中开展实验，采用结构化随机对照，并结合对新生个体偏好的干预与遗传更新分配的干预。通过匹配更新次数与累积幅度、设置事件配额与共同时间截点、偏好擦除、以及加速学习补偿等条件，区分继承偏好的真实贡献与对照设计及更新分配带来的效应。
AI.result: 保留随机更新的状态结构后，表观继承优势大幅收窄，但仍存在条件性的建立速度收益。偏好擦除与更快学习补偿表明，收益部分来自减少后代的重新学习。更新分配会改变比较：事件配额与共同时间截点可能反转排名，但它们同时改变实际实现的更新量。在更新次数与累积幅度匹配时，分阶段释放提升了占用率，但未达到预设的建立标准。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了一个框架，用于区分继承偏好的价值与对照设计、更新分配所造成的影响，明确了在人工种群中应如何评估继承学习。

title: Controllable Stochastic Quantization Encoding for Adversarially Robust Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have attracted increasing attention due to their impressive temporal dynamics, energy efficiency, and brain-inspired mechanisms. Although SNNs have demonstrated promising performance in image classification tasks, recent studies have shown that they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks, where imperceptible perturbations are added to input images to mislead model predictions. Existing defense methods mainly focus on training strategies, while the role of input encoding remains less explored. An observation is that the robustness advantage of Poisson encoding over direct encoding may benefit from its inherent randomness. Motivated by this, we propose a stochastic quantization encoding method that encodes the input image with controllable randomness adjusted by the quantization scale, thereby improving the adversarial robustness of SNNs. We further show that this method constitutes a general framework that reduces to both Poisson encoding and direct encoding under different choices of the quantization scale. Since it enhances robustness at the input encoding stage, it can be combined with existing training-based defenses for further gains. Experimental results on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed stochastic quantization encoding method. To sum up, this work highlights the importance of input encoding for the adversarial robustness of SNNs, providing a new perspective for understanding and improving it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种随机量化编码方法，通过量化尺度调控输入编码的随机性，提升脉冲神经网络(SNN)的对抗鲁棒性，并证明其为统一泊松编码与直接编码的通用框架。
AI.motivation: SNN虽在图像分类上表现良好，但仍易受对抗攻击。现有防御方法多聚焦训练策略，而输入编码的作用研究不足。作者观察到泊松编码相较直接编码的鲁棒性优势可能源于其固有随机性。
AI.method: 提出随机量化编码(stochastic quantization encoding)：在输入编码阶段引入可由量化尺度调节的可控随机性。理论上证明该方法构成通用框架，在不同量化尺度选择下退化为泊松编码或直接编码。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的实验验证了所提随机量化编码方法的有效性；由于作用于输入编码阶段，可与现有基于训练的防御方法结合获得进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 本工作凸显了输入编码对SNN对抗鲁棒性的重要性，为理解和提升SNN鲁棒性提供了新视角。

title: On-Device Named-Entity Recognition: A Deployability Study of Accuracy, Cost, Reliability, and Confidence
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. Code and per-span records reproduce all reported numbers offline
summary: Named-entity recognition (NER) is increasingly wanted on-device (no API, low latency, data kept local). The practitioner's question is not the leaderboard but which model is deployable, how to evaluate it without human annotation, and whether its confidence can be trusted. We answer these jointly. We place nine systems across three paradigms and 13 M to 8 B parameters: a classical tagger (spaCy), bidirectional-encoder specialists (GLiNER, 166 to 460 M), and generative LLMs run locally (Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B), on three datasets of differing character, and report accuracy plus two axes the literature omits: latency and output validity. Because our corpus (RSS-News) had no gold, we built silver gold from a cross-family LLM judge panel, then measured its fidelity against benchmark gold and a full human re-validation of the corpus (strict F1 0.95, an upper bound since the human gold was silver-seeded); gold provenance flips the paradigm ranking, moving from LLM-authored silver to human gold raises every encoder and lowers every generative model. On accuracy alone a 4 B instruct LLM is competitive (it leads on clean newswire), so the encoder's case is deployability: it matches or slightly trails at one-ninth to one-twenty-fourth the size, at millisecond-to-second latency, with zero malformed output, while the smallest generative models emit up to 27% invalid output on long inputs, a failure fixed by scale, not output budget. We then characterize GLiNER's per-span confidence: it ranks correctness well (AUROC 0.76 to 0.86) but is overconfident (ECE 0.24 to 0.47, halved by temperature scaling); thresholding gives a small honest out-of-sample F1 gain; an all-local small-to-large cascade gives a modest, corpus-dependent gain over cost-matched random routing; and confidence tracks correctness but not novelty. Every number recomputes offline from per-span records.

AI.tldr: 本文面向端侧NER的落地需求，联合回答“哪种模型可部署、无人工标注如何评估、置信度是否可信”三个问题。作者在3个数据集上评测了3类共9个系统（spaCy、GLiNER 166-460M、本地生成式LLM 0.6B-8B），报告准确率、延迟与输出有效性，并用跨家族LLM评审团构建silver gold。结果显示准确率上4B指令模型已具竞争力，编码器优势在可部署性；GLiNER置信度排序能力好但过度自信，可用温度缩放与阈值化部分缓解。
AI.motivation: 端侧NER需求上升（无API、低延迟、数据本地），而实践者真正关心的不是排行榜，而是：哪个模型可部署、在无人工标注时如何评估、模型置信度是否可信。现有文献普遍忽视延迟与输出有效性这两个维度，且缺少对无gold场景下评估方法的可靠性验证。
AI.method: 选取3类范式共9个系统、参数规模13M至8B：经典tagger spaCy；双向编码器专才GLiNER（166M-460M）；本地运行的生成式LLM（Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct，DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B）。在3个性质不同的数据集上报告准确率、延迟与输出有效性。针对无gold的RSS-News语料，用跨家族LLM评审团构建silver gold，并在基准gold及全人工复审上测量其保真度。进一步刻画GLiNER的per-span置信度（AUROC、ECE、温度缩放、阈值化、级联路由）。
AI.result: silver gold保真度：与基准gold及全人工复审对比，strict F1 0.95（因人工gold以silver为种，属上界）。gold来源翻转范式排名：从LLM生成的silver换为人工gold，所有编码器提升、所有生成模型下降。仅看准确率，4B指令LLM具竞争力（在干净新闻稿上领先）。编码器优势在可部署性：以1/9至1/24的参数量持平或略逊，延迟为毫秒至秒级，零畸形输出；最小生成模型在长输入上畸形输出高达27%，且该问题靠规模而非输出预算解决。GLiNER置信度：排序正确性良好（AUROC 0.76-0.86），但过度自信（ECE 0.24-0.47，温度缩放可减半）；阈值化带来小幅且诚实的样本外F1增益；全本地小到大级联相对成本匹配的随机路由仅带来有限、依赖语料的增益；置信度追踪正确性但不追踪新颖性。所有数字可由per-span记录离线复算。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择不应只看准确率：编码器在可部署性（参数效率、毫秒级延迟、零畸形输出）上占优，而4B级指令LLM在干净文本上准确率可竞争但小模型存在高达27%的无效输出风险。无gold评估中，LLM评审团silver gold可达到接近人工的保真度，但gold来源会显著影响范式排名，需谨慎解读。GLiNER置信度可用于排序与阈值过滤，但需温度缩放校准；级联路由收益有限。建议以per-span记录支持可复算的透明评估。

title: SCM-based Fairness and Faithful Explainability for Legal Document Classification
summary: Transformer models such as LegalBERT are increasingly used in legal decision support, raising concerns about both fairness and the transparency of model explanations. These properties are usually evaluated separately, leaving open whether a debiasing intervention that changes fairness also changes how faithfully explanations reflect model reasoning. This study investigates that relationship on the ECtHR alleged-violations corpus from LexGLUE. It compares a LegalBERT baseline with a fairness-regularized variant that penalizes stereotypical warmth and competence representations during fine-tuning. The evaluation covers predictive performance, demographic fairness, and SHAP explanation faithfulness across five random seeds. At the performance-optimal regularization strength, the intervention does not reduce demographic disparity. This null result holds across two fairness definitions and a conventional word-pair control on the gender axis. Classification performance is largely unchanged. However, the intervention consistently degrades explanation sufficiency across all five seeds and three thresholds. A shuffled-pair control reproduces this degradation while leaving performance and fairness unchanged, indicating that the effect arises from contrastive representational regularization rather than specifically from the warmth and competence structure. The results demonstrate a dissociation between fairness and explanation faithfulness: changes in explanation behavior do not necessarily indicate changes in fairness, and fairness must therefore be evaluated directly.

AI.tldr: 研究在ECtHR数据集上考察公平性去偏与解释忠实度的关系：在性能最优正则强度下，公平性去偏无效，但解释充分性一致下降，两者出现解离。
AI.motivation: 法律决策支持中Transformer模型（如LegalBERT）的公平性与解释透明度通常被分开评估，尚不清楚改变公平性的去偏干预是否会同时改变解释对模型推理的忠实反映程度。
AI.method: 基于LexGLUE的ECtHR alleged-violations语料，对比LegalBERT基线与其公平性正则化变体（微调时惩罚刻板化的warmth与competence表征）；评估预测性能、人口统计公平性及SHAP解释忠实度，跨5个随机种子；设置两种公平性定义、常规词对控制与打乱词对控制。
AI.result: 在性能最优正则强度下，干预未降低人口统计差异（该零结果在两种公平性定义与性别轴词对控制下稳健），分类性能基本不变；但解释充分性在全部5个种子和3个阈值上一致下降，打乱词对控制复现该下降且性能与公平性不变。
AI.conclusion: 公平性与解释忠实度之间存在解离：解释行为的变化不一定指示公平性变化；该效应源于对比式表征正则化而非warmth/competence结构本身，因此公平性必须被直接评估。

title: The First Token Is Not the Verdict: Hidden Costs of Reading LLM Judges Without Generating
summary: Reading an LLM judge's verdict from the logits of its first generated token is cheap, requires no generation, and is exactly what constrained decoding and likelihood-scoring evaluation harnesses produce. We show that this readout distorts position bias in one direction: it overstates it in every condition we test, so figures obtained this way behave as upper bounds. The mechanism is that judges do not always lead with a verdict token, on 12% to 49% of pairs for three Qwen3 judges and under 3% for Llama-3.1-8B and Phi-3.5-mini, and forcing a read on those pairs returns whichever response was shown first rather than a judgment. Pooled over the 924 pairs where a judge did not commit, the forced read flips on 89.7% of them when the responses are swapped, against 47.5% read after generation (paired difference +0.422, 95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]). The distortion is specific to what is measured: it moves position bias by 42 points while moving judge accuracy by under one point in seven of ten conditions, so it misleads whoever audits a judge rather than whoever uses one. A second, smaller failure occurs even when the judge does lead with a verdict token, since it sometimes opens with one letter and reasons its way to the other, on 0 to 5.5% of pairs at a rate uncorrelated with compliance. We recommend reporting the rate at which a judge leads with a verdict token, which costs one forward pass and no labels, alongside any position-bias figure.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示：从LLM评审器首个生成token的logits直接读取判定（无需生成），会系统性高估位置偏差，该读数应被视为上界；建议同时报告"评审器以判定token开头的比率"。
AI.motivation: 在受限解码（constrained decoding）与基于似然的评测框架中，普遍采用"读取首个token的logits"这一廉价方式来获取LLM评审器的判定，因为它无需生成成本。然而作者怀疑这种捷径可能系统性扭曲对位置偏差（position bias）的测量，从而误导那些审计评审器可靠性的人，因此需要验证该读数与真实（生成后读取）结果之间的差异及其机制。
AI.method: 作者对比了两种读数方式：(1)直接在首个生成token的logits上读取判定（forced read）；(2)生成后再读取判定。测试对象包括三个Qwen3评审器及Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-3.5-mini。通过统计评审器"是否以判定token开头（lead with a verdict token）"的比例，分析强制读数在未主动给出判定的样本对上的行为，并采用配对交换（swap）实验测量翻转率。共统计924个评审器未主动表态的样本对。
AI.result: 评审器并非总以判定token开头：三个Qwen3评审器在12%–49%的样本对上如此，Llama-3.1-8B与Phi-3.5-mini则低于3%。在这些对中，强制读数实际返回的是先展示的那个回复而非真正判定。在924个未主动表态的样本对上，交换回复顺序后强制读数翻转率达89.7%，而生成后读取仅为47.5%（配对差值+0.422，95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]）。该扭曲具有测量特异性：位置偏差被移动42个百分点，而评审准确率在十个条件中有七个变动不足1个百分点。此外还存在次级失效：即便评审器以判定token开头，它有时会先给出一个字母却在推理后得出相反结论，发生率为0–5.5%，且与合规率不相关。
AI.conclusion: 基于首个token logits的判定读数会单方向高估位置偏差，可作为上界使用；该扭曲主要影响审计评审器者而非使用者。作者建议在报告任何位置偏差指标时，同时报告"评审器以判定token开头的比率"——该指标只需一次前向传播且无需标注。

title: Measuring Human-Like Bias in LLMs? A Critique of Human-Derived Bias Constructs in LLM Evaluation
summary: Researchers increasingly use human-derived bias constructs to study Large Language Models (LLMs), including social-cognitive constructs such as implicit bias and stereotype activation, and cognitive biases such as anchoring, framing effects, and confirmation bias. Such approaches offer alternatives to overt bias probes, particularly when direct questioning may obscure bias or when model behaviour appears normatively acceptable. However, adapting human bias constructs to LLMs introduces an inferential gap. Psychological instruments were developed to study human cognition and social behaviour, whereas LLM evaluations rely on probabilities, text completions, rankings, or simulated decisions. This paper critiques human-centered bias evaluation in LLMs. We show how this gap arises from mismatches pertaining to human-derived constructs, human-model differences, and evaluation contexts, which can blur distinct interpretations of model bias. We then introduce a framework providing an analytical lens for relating these elements to warranted interpretations, with attention to target constructs, operationalizations, scope of inference, and limits of human analogy.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地审视了将人类偏见构念迁移至大语言模型评估的做法，指出其中存在"推断鸿沟"，并提出一个用于规范偏见解释的分析框架。
AI.motivation: 研究者日益借助源自人类的偏见构念（如内隐偏见、刻板印象激活、锚定效应、框架效应、确认偏误）来研究大语言模型，以此作为外显偏见探测的替代方案。然而，将人类心理测量工具套用于基于概率、文本补全、排序或模拟决策的模型评估，会产生推断鸿沟，可能混淆对模型偏见的不同解读。
AI.method: 采用批判性分析的方法，系统剖析该推断鸿沟的成因，即人类衍生构念、人—模型差异以及评估情境三者之间的错配；在此基础上构建一个分析框架。
AI.result: 揭示推断鸿沟源于三类错配：人类衍生构念与模型机制的错配、人与模型的差异、以及评估情境的错配，这些错配会模糊模型偏见的多种解释。
AI.conclusion: 提出一个分析框架，围绕目标构念、操作化方式、推断范围以及人类类比的限度等要素，将上述元素与有依据的偏见解释相关联。

title: Legal text classification in Korean sexual offense cases: from traditional machine learning to large language models with XAI insights
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Published in Artificial Intelligence and Law
summary: The advancement of natural language processing (NLP) has expanded AI-based text classification in the legal domain. However, accurately classifying legal documents remains challenging due to the complexity of legal texts and subtle differences between legal categories. This study evaluates legal text classification models ranging from traditional machine learning techniques to large language models (LLMs) using ten categories of Korean sexual offense precedents. The results show that fine-tuning small-scale models such as KLUE-BERT on legal data outperforms general-purpose models such as GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.0, as well as traditional machine learning models. KLUE-BERT achieved the highest accuracy of 99.3%, indicating that domain adaptation and fine-tuning can be more important than model size for legal document classification. We further employ explainable AI (XAI) techniques to analyze model predictions and misclassification cases. XAI analysis identifies linguistic features influencing model decisions and limitations in capturing subtle textual cues. Using KICS data, which closely resembles real-world legal case records, we further evaluate the model's generalization capabilities and find that it struggles to interpret implicit contextual cues. These findings highlight the importance of both performance and interpretability in legal AI and demonstrate how XAI can improve transparency in legal text classification. AI-assisted tools can support legal professionals in tasks including document classification, legal information retrieval, and case assessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用十类韩国性犯罪判例，评估从传统机器学习到LLM的法律文本分类模型，发现经法律数据微调的小模型（KLUE-BERT）以99.3%准确率优于GPT-3.5/4.0及传统方法，并借助XAI分析预测依据与误分类案例，揭示模型在理解隐含语境线索上的局限。
AI.motivation: 法律文本复杂、法律类别间差异细微，使法律文书自动分类极具挑战；同时需兼顾模型性能与可解释性，以支撑法律AI的透明应用。
AI.method: 以十类韩国性犯罪判例为数据集，对比传统机器学习、通用LLM（GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0）与小规模模型（KLUE-BERT）的分类表现；对KLUE-BERT进行领域微调，并采用XAI技术分析模型预测与误分类案例；进一步使用贴近真实案件记录的KICS数据评估泛化能力。
AI.result: 经法律数据微调的KLUE-BERT取得最高99.3%准确率，优于GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0及传统机器学习模型；XAI分析识别出影响模型决策的语言特征，并揭示其难以捕捉细微文本线索；在KICS数据上模型难以解读隐含语境线索，泛化能力受限。
AI.conclusion: 在法律文书分类中，领域适应与微调可能比模型规模更重要；性能与可解释性对法律AI同等关键，XAI有助于提升法律文本分类透明度，AI辅助工具可支持文书分类、法律信息检索与案件评估等任务。

title: BudgetSchemaBench: A Budget-Swept Diagnostic for Schema Context in Text-to-SQL
summary: Data agents over structured sources must fit database schema into the model's context window. Large catalogs can span many databases and thousands of columns, so cost constraints may require choosing between table coverage and serialization detail well before the context window is full. We introduce BudgetSchemaBench, an execution-grounded diagnostic for this setting. Its construction derives relevance labels mechanically from gold SQL, without human- or LLM-authored ground truth. Using a pooled 80-database catalog, we sweep four schema-context budgets and compare three representations while keeping each retriever's table ranking fixed. A source-namespace check rejects queries that obtain the correct result from the wrong database. The evaluation covers three conditions: end-to-end retrieval; frozen-gold, in which the required tables are guaranteed; and a probe that removes those tables. For the primary solver with raw serialization, raising the budget from 2.5% to 50% of the catalog improves execution accuracy on 1,279 held-out questions by 18 percentage points under lexical retrieval but only 3 under dense retrieval; the dense retriever already finds most required tables at the smallest budget. When the required tables are removed, 94.6% of correct predictions name one of them exactly, consistent with reconstruction of absent schema from parametric knowledge. For the two main solvers in the frozen-gold condition, the three representations differ by at most 2 percentage points, and the widest paired 95% confidence interval bounds the difference within +/-4 points. We observe the same qualitative patterns with one reasoning model from a different family. When retrieval is coverage-limited, execution accuracy is more sensitive to the schema budget than to the tested serializations. The diagnostic and the code used to construct and evaluate it are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BudgetSchemaBench，一个面向结构化数据源的数据智能体的执行级诊断基准。其相关性标签由gold SQL机械推导，无需人工或LLM标注；在80个数据库的合并catalog上以四种schema预算和三种序列化表示进行评测，发现当检索受覆盖度限制时，执行准确率对schema预算的敏感度高于对序列化方式的敏感度。
AI.motivation: 数据智能体需要将数据库schema塞入模型上下文窗口。大型catalog可跨多个数据库、包含数千列，在上下文窗口远未填满前，成本约束就迫使系统在表覆盖度与序列化细节之间取舍。然而此前缺乏针对该权衡的执行级诊断工具，且标注依赖人工或LLM易引入偏差。
AI.method: 构建BudgetSchemaBench：相关性标签从gold SQL机械推导，避免人工/LLM标注。使用80个数据库的合并catalog，扫描四种schema上下文预算，比较三种表示，同时固定各检索器的表排序。加入source-namespace检查，拒绝从错误数据库得到正确结果的查询。评测覆盖三种条件：端到端检索；frozen-gold（保证必需表存在）；以及移除必需表的探针。
AI.result: 对主求解器加原始序列化：预算从catalog的2.5%提升到50%，词法检索下1,279道留出问题的执行准确率提升18个百分点，而稠密检索仅提升3个百分点；稠密检索器在最小预算下已找出大多数必需表。移除必需表后，94.6%的正确预测恰好点名其中一张表，与从参数化知识重建缺失schema一致。frozen-gold下两个主求解器的三种表示差异最多2个百分点，最宽的配对95%置信区间将差异界定在±4点内。用另一家族的推理模型得到相同定性模式。
AI.conclusion: 当检索受覆盖度限制时，执行准确率对schema预算的敏感度高于对所测序列化表示的敏感度。该诊断基准及构建和评测代码已公开。

title: FACET at WMT 2026 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task
comment: Accepted at WMT 2026 (shared task system paper)
summary: Different error types in machine translation require different evidence. Whether meaning is preserved can be judged only against the source, while whether the target is well-formed, or whether it names one entity consistently, can be judged from the target alone. We present FACET, our reference-free submission to the WMT26 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task, which decomposes evaluation into Fluency, Accuracy, and Consistency passes and gives each pass only the context its error type requires. A single fixed model is prompted three times, and the merged error spans yield the three task outputs, error spans, quality scores, and error-free labels, with no trained components. We also submit FACET-C, which omits the Consistency pass. Without gold labels, we characterize the predictions of FACET. Its system rankings place post-edited human translation first, and the Consistency pass changes about a tenth of segment scores while leaving the ranking nearly unchanged.

AI.tldr: FACET 是一个无参考的机器翻译质量评估提交系统，将评价分解为流畅度、准确度和一致性三个通道，每个通道仅获得其错误类型所需的上下文，用同一固定模型提示三次，无训练组件。
AI.motivation: 不同错误类型需要不同证据：意义是否保留只能对照源文判断，而目标语是否通顺、实体命名是否一致可仅凭译文判断。因此统一评价方式会引入无关上下文，需要按错误类型分别提供所需证据。
AI.method: 提出 FACET，向 WMT26 自动翻译质量评估任务的提交，将评估分解为 Fluency、Accuracy、Consistency 三个通道，每个通道只给该错误类型所需的上下文；对同一固定模型提示三次，合并错误片段得到三项输出（错误片段、质量分数、无错误标签），无训练组件。另提交省略 Consistency 通道的 FACET-C。
AI.result: 在没有金标签的情况下刻画 FACET 的预测：其系统排序将人工译后编辑译文排在第一；Consistency 通道改变了约十分之一的片段分数，但几乎不改变排序。
AI.conclusion: FACET 表明按错误类型分配上下文的无参考评估方法可行，无需训练组件即可产出多种评估输出；一致性通道主要影响片段级分数而非系统级排序，为无金标签条件下的评估可信度提供了实证支持。

title: Metric-Construction Coupling Inflates Measured Synthetic Dialect Recovery
summary: Korean dialect corpora are available but not redistributable: weights may be released, while reproducing training and evaluation from the underlying data cannot be. We ask how much of that supervision synthetic data recovers, and whether that recovery can be measured independently of the synthesis pipeline. We contribute KoDialectBench, 1,000 items across five regions on three axes, released as identifier hashes and scoring code so users reconstruct the items from their own licensed copy. Recovery is strongly axis-dependent: our best synthetic arm reaches 91.2% of the real-data gain on region identification but 63.7% on comprehension. On generation the answer depends on the metric: the deployed marker lexicon reports 92.3% on dialectness and 119.3% on region match, the latter exceeding the real-data reference, whereas reference-based generation reaches 72.4%. We find the marker metrics' scoring inventory is entirely contained in the inventory our transformation rules can emit. We test the effect of construction access directly with an exact-form construction-disjoint arm that withholds 20% of marker types from the rules. At exactly matched training size (8,600 examples) it reduces dialectness recovery from 91.8% to 8.1% and region-match recovery from 101.9% to 25.6% on the held-out marker inventory, while the three pipeline-independent measurements do not fall at all. A complementary evaluator sweep defines metric-construction coverage (MCC) and finds measured dialectness recovery increasing monotonically as overlap rises from MCC=0 to MCC=1. Shared construction and evaluation inventories can therefore substantially inflate estimates of synthetic-data recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 KoDialectBench（五个地区、三个维度共 1,000 项，以标识符哈希与评分代码发布），用以量化合成数据在韩国方言任务上对真实数据监督的恢复程度，并将其与合成流程解耦度量。结果显示恢复率高度依赖任务轴，且当评价指标与构造规则共享数据清单时会显著虚高。
AI.motivation: 韩国方言语料虽存在但不可再分发：可发布模型权重，却无法复现基于原始数据的训练与评测。因此需要回答两个问题：合成数据能恢复多少真实监督，以及这种恢复能否脱离合成流程被独立测量。
AI.method: 构建 KoDialectBench，覆盖五个地区、三个评价轴共 1,000 项，以标识符哈希与评分代码发布，用户可凭自有授权语料重建条目。设计精确形式、构造不相交（construction-disjoint）的实验臂：从变换规则中扣留 20% 的标记类型，并在严格匹配训练规模（8,600 条）下对比；同时进行评测器扫描，定义指标-构造覆盖率（MCC），考察恢复率随重叠度的变化。
AI.result: 恢复率随轴差异显著：最佳合成方案在地区识别上达到真实数据增益的 91.2%，在理解任务上仅 63.7%。生成任务取决于指标：已部署标记词表报告方言度 92.3%、地区匹配 119.3%（超过真实数据参考），而基于参考的生成仅 72.4%。标记指标的打分清单完全被变换规则可产出的清单包含。构造不相交实验在匹配训练规模下将方言度恢复从 91.8% 降至 8.1%、留出标记清单上的地区匹配从 101.9% 降至 25.6%，而三项流程无关测量完全不下降。MCC 从 0 升至 1 时，测得方言度恢复单调上升。
AI.conclusion: 共享构造与评测清单会实质性地夸大对合成数据恢复能力的估计；流程无关的测量则不受构造访问影响。KoDialectBench 提供了一种可复现、可解耦的评测范式，用于在数据不可再分发条件下审慎评估合成监督的真实价值。

title: A Holistic Assessment of the Carbon Footprint of Noor, a Very Large Arabic Language Model
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Published in Proceedings of BigScience Episode #5 -- Workshop on Challenges & Perspectives in Creating Large Language Models (ACL 2022)
summary: As ever larger language models grow more ubiquitous, it is crucial to consider their environmental impact. Characterised by extreme size and resource use, recent generations of models have been criticised for their voracious appetite for compute, and thus significant carbon footprint. Although reporting of carbon impact has grown more common in machine learning papers, this reporting is usually limited to compute resources used strictly for training. In this work, we propose a holistic assessment of the footprint of an extreme-scale language model, Noor. Noor is an ongoing project aiming to develop the largest multi-task Arabic language models -- with up to 13B parameters -- leveraging zero-shot generalisation to enable a wide range of downstream tasks via natural language instructions. We assess the total carbon bill of the entire project: starting with data collection and storage costs, including research and development budgets, pretraining costs, future serving estimates, and other exogenous costs necessary for this international cooperation. Notably, we find that inference costs and exogenous factors can have a significant impact on total budget. Finally, we discuss pathways to reduce the carbon footprint of extreme-scale models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对超大规模语言模型Noor进行全生命周期碳足迹评估，涵盖数据采集存储、研发、预训练、未来推理及外部性成本，发现推理成本与外部因素对总碳预算影响显著，并讨论减排路径。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型规模不断扩大，其环境代价（尤其是算力消耗带来的碳足迹）日益受到批评；然而现有机器学习的碳报告通常仅局限于训练阶段所用算力，缺乏对项目整体碳成本的系统评估，因此需要一个覆盖全流程的整体性评估框架。
AI.method: 以正在进行的超大规模阿拉伯语多任务语言模型项目Noor（参数量最高达13B，依赖零样本泛化与自然语言指令完成下游任务）为案例，开展整体性碳足迹评估：核算范围从数据采集与存储成本出发，纳入研发预算、预训练成本、未来服务（推理）估算，以及支撑该国际合作所必需的其他外生成本。
AI.result: 研究发现推理成本和外生因素会对总碳预算产生显著影响，表明仅统计训练阶段算力会明显低估模型的真实碳足迹。
AI.conclusion: 对极端规模语言模型的碳评估应采用覆盖全项目生命周期的整体视角，并据此提出降低其碳足迹的可行路径。

title: CAVE-Mem: Boundary-Aware Experience Validation for Memory Search
summary: Long-term memory agents increasingly rely on it- erative search and reusable experience to answer questions over large personal, factual, or narrative histories. However, current experience-memory systems largely optimize relevance: they re- trieve past search lessons that appear similar to the current state and inject them into the prompt. A relevant experience can still be harmful when the memory substrate, question intent, answer granularity, or evidence boundary changes. We propose CAVE- Mem, a training-free framework that represents experience as a typed intervention operator with applicability, boundary, and utility conditions. CAVE-Mem first obtains a base memory-search answer, then allows an operator to change it only if the oper- ator matches the current substrate, answer contract, evidence boundary, and cross-fitted utility; otherwise the system abstains. Experiments across long-term conversational memory, multi-hop question answering, and long-document narrative reasoning show consistent gains over relevance-only experience reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的CAVE-Mem框架，将经验建模为带适用、边界与效用条件的类型化干预算子，在算子不匹配当前情境时选择弃权，避免相关性经验复用带来的负面迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前经验记忆系统主要优化"相关性"，检索与当前状态相似的过往搜索经验并注入提示词。但相关性不等于有益：当记忆基底、问题意图、答案粒度或证据边界发生变化时，相关经验反而可能有害。
AI.method: CAVE-Mem为免训练框架，将经验表示为带适用性、边界条件与效用条件的类型化干预算子。流程为：先获取基础记忆搜索答案，仅当算子同时匹配当前记忆基底、答案契约、证据边界，并通过交叉拟合效用检验时，才允许该算子修改答案；否则系统弃权。
AI.result: 在长期对话记忆、多跳问答以及长文档叙事推理等任务上，相较仅基于相关性的经验复用方法取得了一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 经验复用应以条件化、可弃权的干预方式引入，而非单纯依据相似度，从而降低变更情境下相关经验带来的负迁移风险。

title: Signed Lexical Confidence for Risk-Calibrated Intent Routing
summary: Selective intent routing allows an assistant to act on reliable predictions while deferring uncertain requests. Standard confidence scores primarily reflect the base model's representation, leaving an opportunity to incorporate complementary evidence without changing its decisions. We introduce a signed lexical gate that combines a sentence classifier's logit margin with a sparse lexical model's support for the classifier's predicted intent. By assigning positive evidence to lexical agreement and negative evidence to a lexically favored competing intent, the gate retains more information than either unsigned lexical confidence or a hard agreement rule. An independent binomial calibration stage selects an operating threshold for a specified risk target. Across ten runs on BANKING77, CLINC150, and HWU64, the proposed score reduces area under the risk-coverage curve by 15.8%, 15.1%, and 11.8% relative to a learned semantic-only gate. At a nominal 5% error target, it increases accepted coverage by 1.83 and 5.14 percentage points on BANKING77 and HWU64, while CLINC150 is already near full coverage. At a stricter 2% target, the simultaneous binomial procedure yields a nonempty policy in all 30 dataset-run combinations at the available calibration budgets. Matched controls show that the proposed feature improves average error ranking over the tested unsigned lexical-confidence feature, with dataset-dependent gains over binary agreement. The resulting two-feature gate provides a compact, interpretable confidence enhancement for risk-calibrated intent routing while preserving the base classifier's predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种带符号词法门控（signed lexical gate），将句分类器的logit margin与稀疏词法模型对预测意图的支持/竞争证据结合，配合独立二项校准选择阈值，在不改变基分类器预测的前提下改进风险-覆盖权衡，用于可靠的意图路由。
AI.motivation: 选择性意图路由需要助手在可靠预测上执行、对不确定请求延后处理。而标准置信度主要只反映基模型的表示，未利用互补证据；直接的词法置信度或硬一致规则又会丢失信息。
AI.method: 构造带符号词法门控：句分类器logit margin为基准，稀疏词法模型对预测意图的支持记为正证据、对词法上更受青睐的竞争意图记为负证据，从而保留比无符号词法置信度或二值一致规则更多的信息。随后用独立二项校准阶段为指定风险目标选取操作阈值。在BANKING77、CLINC150、HWU64上各进行十次运行。
AI.result: 相对仅语义的学习门控，风险-覆盖曲线下面积分别降低15.8%（BANKING77）、15.1%（CLINC150）、11.8%（HWU64）。名义5%误差目标下，BANKING77与HWU64的接受覆盖率分别提升1.83与5.14个百分点，CLINC150已接近全覆盖；更严格的2%目标下，同步二项程序在全部30个数据集-运行组合中于可用校准预算内均得到非空策略。匹配对照显示该特征相较无符号词法置信度改善了平均错误排序，并相对二值一致规则有依赖数据集的增益。
AI.conclusion: 该双特征门控为风险校准的意图路由提供紧凑、可解释的置信度增强，且保持基分类器预测不变。

title: Certainty Is Not Just Correctness: Rethinking Token-Level Certainty in LLM Reasoning
summary: Token-level certainty is widely used as a proxy for correctness in LLM training and inference. However, the performance of certainty-based methods depends both on the information in certainty scores and on how those scores are used. We therefore directly assess certainty's predictive ability through controlled empirical evaluations across models and tasks. We distinguish two prediction targets: identifying questions a model is more likely to answer correctly and distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. In our experiments, certainty is generally better at identifying questions a model is likely to answer correctly than at distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. Certainty also varies systematically across token types and positions within words, reflecting local properties of words and text form. Information about question difficulty appears early in generation, while the weaker information about answer correctness is more concentrated near the end. These findings show that the information certainty provides for decisions depends on the prediction target, the model, the certainty metric, and which token positions in the response are included in aggregation. We further demonstrate the practical value of these findings for test-time compute. We allocate the number of responses using certainty early in generation and weight answer votes using certainty near the end of each response. Compared with a fixed-sampling majority-voting baseline, this approach increases overall accuracy from 78.71\% to 79.54\% while reducing generated-token cost by 82.4\%.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过受控实验评估了LLM中token级确定性(certainty)的预测能力,发现其更擅长判断"模型能否答对某题"而非"同一题下区分对错",且信息在生成过程中呈位置分布特征;基于此设计了分阶段的测试时计算分配策略,在提升准确率的同时大幅降低token开销。
AI.motivation: token级确定性常被用作LLM训练与推理中正确性的代理指标,但其实际效能不仅取决于确定性分数所携带的信息,还取决于这些分数的使用方式。作者希望直接评估确定性本身的预测能力,厘清其在不同预测目标、模型与任务下的表现差异。
AI.method: 作者设计跨模型、跨任务的受控实证评估,并区分两类预测目标:(1)识别模型更可能答对的问题;(2)区分同一问题下正确与错误的回答。同时分析确定性在不同token类型、词内位置上的系统性变化,以及生成过程中信息的时序分布。
AI.result: 实验表明,确定性在识别"模型可能答对的问题"上普遍优于区分"同一问题的对错回答"。确定性随token类型与词内位置系统性变化,反映词的局部属性与文本形式;问题难度信息在生成早期即出现,而较弱的答案正确性信息更集中于末尾。实际应用中,利用早期确定性分配响应数量、末期确定性加权投票,相比固定采样多数投票基线,准确率从78.71%提升至79.54%,生成token成本降低82.4%。
AI.conclusion: 确定性所提供的信息对决策的价值取决于预测目标、模型、确定性度量方式以及聚合时所纳入的响应token位置。研究进一步验证了这些发现在测试时计算中的实用价值,可实现准确率与计算成本的更优权衡。

title: DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding: Benchmarking Document Grounding and Hallucinations in Voice Agents
summary: Voice agents enable low-latency, natural interaction, yet their ability to faithfully ground responses in external documents remains underexplored. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding (DSB-DG), a benchmark for evaluating document grounding in voice agents across five professional domains. DSB-DG targets three failure modes: Context Saturation, which measures grounding under increasing document length; Grounding Decay, which measures retention of document facts across multi-turn dialogue; and Proactive Grounding, which evaluates whether context re-injection mitigates conversational drift. The benchmark contains 1,636 adversarially verified QA pairs from 50 documents covering five professional domains, and supports fully automatic evaluation of grounding accuracy, hallucination, and response latency. Across systems spanning cascaded, proprietary full-duplex and real-time, and open-weight speech2speech architectures, we find substantial differences in effective grounding capacity. While cascaded pipeline (ASR-LLM-TTS) achieves the highest grounding accuracy, Gemini-Live and GPT-Realtime closely trail behind. Open-weight systems exhibit distinct failure modes, most notably an abrupt context-capacity collapse and multi-turn grounding decay. More broadly, grounding fidelity degrades with context and conversational load, and failures frequently manifest as unsupported generations rather than abstention. We show that contextual grounding as a key unresolved challenge for reliable full-duplex voice agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DSB-DG基准，用于评测语音代理在外部文档中的忠实grounding能力，涵盖上下文饱和、grounding衰减与主动grounding三类失效模式，并系统评测了级联、全双工及开源speech2speech系统。
AI.motivation: 语音代理已实现低延迟自然交互，但其能否将回答忠实锚定于外部文档尚缺乏系统评测，这制约了可靠全双工语音代理的发展。
AI.method: 构建DSB-DG基准，含来自5个专业领域50份文档的1,636条对抗性验证QA对，针对Context Saturation、Grounding Decay、Proactive Grounding三种失效模式，支持对grounding准确率、幻觉与响应延迟的自动化评测，并横评级联、专有全双工/实时及开源speech2speech架构。
AI.result: 有效grounding容量差异显著：级联流水线（ASR-LLM-TTS）grounding准确率最高，Gemini-Live与GPT-Realtime紧随其后；开源系统出现明显的上下文容量骤降与多轮grounding衰减。grounding保真度随上下文与对话负载上升而下降，失效多表现为无依据生成而非拒答。
AI.conclusion: 上下文grounding仍是可靠全双工语音代理的关键未解挑战。

title: Dissonant ballerinas and crafty carrots: a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian brain rot
summary: This paper presents a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian and Romanian brain rot memes, investigating the factors that contribute to its appeal and the linguistic and cultural distinctions between the two versions. To conduct this analysis, we introduce a multi-modal brain rot dataset named CRIB (Collection of Romanian and Italian Brain rot), a manually curated collection of 240 TikTok videos stratified by language (Italian, Romanian) and popularity, on which we examine textual, acoustic, and visual features.
