AI.method: 引入消息干预诊断（message-intervention diagnostic）：固定证据与候选答案，仅改变跨越推理器-验证器边界所传递的理由。在 MuSiQue、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 的 400 个样本上，以 DeepSeek 同时作为生成器与验证器。设计盲验证器提示与显式理由检查提示两种条件，并辅以人工审计、跨模型与任务边界检查。
AI.result: 忠实理由相对无理由几乎不增加答案准确率，而被污染的理由强烈改变支持判断。盲验证器提示下，无害改述仅使支持性判断移动 0–2.5%，被污染理由则移动 10–22%；显式理由检查提示将同一模式放大到 34–55%。最终答案移动较小（2–30%），且仅 2.9–35.3% 的支持性翻转与答案变化同时发生。人工审计中，42 个有效污染有 16 个属"污染过度信任"案例，盲审人类拒绝或标记为不清楚了 9/10 个模型接受的被污染理由。
AI.conclusion: 理由共享应被视为一种验证消息机制来评估，而非仅仅作为通向更高答案准确率的途径。跨模型与任务边界检查表明该通道可能处于激活、放大、惰性或被并入任务标签等不同状态。

title: Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs
summary: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

AI.tldr: 本文隔离并提出 PPFG 机制，在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + Math-Shepherd + MATH500 上以等价性检验证明其与独立并行 CoT 基线统计不可区分，并诊断其失效原因。
AI.motivation: 并行链式思维出现多样性坍塌，促使研究者设计推理时干预：将被 PRM 剪枝链条中的高 PRM 前缀抽取并原样嫁接到仍在解码的兄弟链作为上下文示例。作者希望在最省成本的操作点上严格检验这种跨轨迹步级迁移是否真正有效——即在前人报告收益需要额外补偿要素的条件下，单独隔离该机制本身的效果。
AI.method: 将机制隔离为 PPFG（PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting）。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上结合 Math-Shepherd，于完整 MATH500（n=500，三个随机种子）测试停滞目标与随机目标两种 PPFG 变体，与独立并行 CoT 基线对比。对 322 次停滞规则注入事件做四桶分类；尝试多种复合门控（compound-gate）细化并做随机对照；在三个基础 LM、六个 benchmark、第二个 PRM 及兼容性门控扫描上做复制实验；使用双单侧检验（TOST）将持平提升为正向等价；进行逐事件抽查与幸存兄弟反事实分析，并用事后 oracle 给出上界。
AI.result: 所有测量轴上 PPFG 两种变体均与独立并行 CoT 基线统计不可区分。322 次注入事件中仅 14% 命中真正挣扎的链，其余落在已成功、接近完成或 PRM 平台期的链上，救援嫁接无法改变。无复合门控能同时实现良好靶向与足够触发密度；随机对照以 2.4 倍触发率同样持平，说明惰性非启发式特定。结果在三个基础 LM、六个 benchmark、第二个 PRM 及兼容性门控扫描中复制；TOST 在全部 12 个 Qwen/LLaMA 单元上确认正向等价。逐事件抽查中注入链的剪枝率为匹配步的 2.75 倍，但幸存兄弟反事实未发现群体级补偿。事后 oracle 将选择 PPFG 而非独立的单题收益上界限定为 +0.13 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: PPFG 在所测操作点上对推理性能无实质影响，其失效源于触发定位不准而非启发式设计问题。作者提供了用于建立推理时机制零结果的等价性检验模板，并强调所有结论均限定于其测试的操作点。

title: Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks
comment: 46 pages (11 pages main text, references, 33-page appendix); 10 figures, 29 tables. Evaluated corpus: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agents (commit 48dedd2); evaluation code and item-level records are not released
summary: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

AI.tldr: 对503个职业专用AGENTS.md提示词进行对照评测发现：加载完整职业提示词并不提升科学任务准确率，却显著增加token消耗与成本。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍使用详细的职业专用系统提示词（system prompts），但缺乏对其成本-收益的实证检验。作者希望验证：这类长提示词是否真能带来准确率提升，以及其token与费用代价是否可以接受。
AI.method: 构建开源语料Scientific Agents，含503个职业专用AGENTS.md配置文件；使用Gemini 3.8 Flash（经OpenRouter、Pi agent harness）在9个文本科学基准（4,531题采样、100个匹配配置）上比较5种条件：最小基线、配置开篇角色句、通用科学严谨性指南、无关领域配置、匹配的职业配置；任务用自动化规则化评分。另在60道需工具调用的BioMysteryBench生物信息题上，对基线与配置各跑3次。
AI.result: 配置与基线平均准确率差为-0.6个百分点（95% bootstrap区间[-1.5,+0.2]），无任何基准出现统计显著的提升；匹配配置输出token为基线的1.5-2.3倍、每次成功调用成本高2.2-4.5倍。BioMysteryBench上配置平均解题率46.7%，基线56.7%，差-10.0个百分点（95%区间[-16.7,-3.3]），主要因配置条件下更频繁触及token与时间上限。唯一意外优势在SuperGPQA：供应商API频繁中断时，短基线仅54.0%题目首次作答正确，而长配置达71.6%，但通用与不匹配提示词表现相近，说明该收益来自提示词长度或格式而非领域专业性。
AI.conclusion: 在受测模型与任务上，默认加载完整职业配置文件不提升准确率且成本大幅上升；通用和不匹配提示词可靠性相当，领域专业知识并非收益来源。选择性检索配置片段或改用开放式科学任务能否改变结论，仍有待检验。

title: Legal Research Bench: Measuring End-to-End Reliability in Long-Horizon Legal Research Agents
summary: Legal research is a core and time-consuming legal workflow. Lawyers must identify controlling authority, verify that it remains valid, reconcile statutes and cases, and synthesize a grounded answer. Language model agents are a natural fit for this retrieval-intensive workflow, and automating even part of it would be valuable. But that value depends on reliability: a single missing authority, stale citation, or wrong legal conclusion can make an otherwise plausible answer unusable. We introduce \textbf{Legal Research Bench} (LRB), a benchmark of 413 open-ended U.S. legal research questions written by experts, each paired with a gold answer, supporting authorities, and a binary grading rubric. We evaluate thirteen frontier models in a harness with web search, case-law search, page parsing, and retrieval tools. We score agent responses through all-pass grading with source verification, where a response is correct only if every required criterion is satisfied and its cited authorities verify. We also validate the LLM judge against expert attorneys ensuring that benchmark scores track attorney judgment. Agents remain far from reliable: among the models we tested, the strongest, Claude Opus 4.8, is fully correct on 42.9\% of questions. Performance also varies substantially by task setting: all-pass rates differ across areas of law and are lower on questions requiring reconciliation of conflicting authorities. Across models, more turns, tool calls, and inference cost do not predict higher accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 Legal Research Bench (LRB)，一个包含 413 道美国法律研究开放题的专家编写基准，每题配有标准答案、支撑权威来源与二元评分细则；在带检索工具的环境中评测 13 个前沿模型，采用全通过式评分与来源验证，发现最强模型 Claude Opus 4.8 仅 42.9% 完全正确。
AI.motivation: 法律研究是核心且高耗时的流程，需要识别控制性权威、验证其有效性、协调成文法与判例并综合出有依据的答案，非常适合检索密集型的语言模型智能体，但自动化价值高度依赖可靠性——遗漏权威、引用过期或结论错误都会使答案不可用，因此需要可靠、可验证的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 LRB 基准，含 413 道由专家撰写的美国法律研究开放题，每题配标准答案、支撑权威与二元评分细则；在具备网络搜索、判例检索、页面解析与检索工具的 harness 中评测 13 个前沿模型；采用全通过式评分结合来源验证（所有必需标准满足且所引权威可验证才算正确），并以执业律师对 LLM 评判器进行验证。
AI.result: 智能体远未达到可靠水平：测试中最强的 Claude Opus 4.8 仅 42.9% 题目完全正确；不同法律领域的全通过率差异显著，需要协调冲突权威的题目表现更差；跨模型来看，更多轮次、工具调用与推理成本并不能预测更高准确率。
AI.conclusion: 现有前沿智能体在法律研究任务上仍不可靠，且性能受任务设置（法律领域、是否需协调冲突权威）影响显著，增加交互轮次或算力投入不等于提升准确率，说明该领域需要针对可靠性与权威验证的专门优化。

title: Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent's tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. A Sapien policy specifies permitted tool-call sequences using a regular expression extended with stateful predicates, deferred policy generation, and scoped semantic checks. We show that Sapien stays within a few percent of an unconstrained agent's utility. Even if the agent is fully hijacked, Sapien's policies rule out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists on long-horizon tasks).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sapien，一种支持有状态上下文策略的策略引擎，用于约束多步任务中 AI 智能体的工具调用，兼顾效用与安全。
AI.motivation: 现有时上下文安全防御通过合成任务特定的策略并强制施加于智能体的工具调用来防止越权行为，但在多步任务中，哪些动作有效往往取决于智能体此前已完成和已获知的内容，静态策略难以刻画这种状态依赖关系。
AI.method: Sapien 使用扩展了有状态谓词、延迟策略生成与作用域语义检查的正则表达式来规定允许的工具调用序列，从而对多步任务实施有状态上下文策略。
AI.result: Sapien 的效用接近无约束智能体（差距仅几个百分点）；即便智能体被完全劫持，其策略在 AgentDojo 上可排除 93–95% 的攻击，在 Toolathlon 上可排除 62–85%，在长时程任务中拦截的攻击数量是工具白名单的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入有状态谓词、延迟策略生成和语义检查，Sapien 能在保持高实用性的同时显著提升多步任务智能体的安全性。

title: Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

AI.tldr: 提出 InFlowOp，用统一的“无标签代价”定价多智能体工作流中的每个决策，在构建与运行阶段双向决定任务分解粒度与智能体分配，并以最低代价纠正故障；同时发布 Braid 基准。实验表明其优于单智能体基线最多 +11.97%。
AI.motivation: 多智能体工作流构建困难：任务划分粒度、子任务与智能体的匹配、何时新建专用智能体都需事前决策，成功与否事先未知；而改进工作流代价高昂，故障定位通常需要参考答案、评分结果或训练好的评估器，修复需整体重执行、重搜索或重训练。
AI.method: InFlowOp 以单一的“无标签代价”衡量智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配度及智能体运行开销。执行前，依据该代价双向确定任务分解粒度与智能体分配，而非固定模板；执行中，沿用同一代价以最低成本动作纠正故障，使该代价同时服务于工作流的构建与运行。此外提出 Braid 基准，其任务需要多智能体协同而超出单智能体能力。
AI.result: 在多个领域与多种骨干模型上，InFlowOp 相比单智能体基线提升最多 +11.97%，其中流内优化带来 +9.64% 的提升。
AI.conclusion: InFlowOp 通过统一的无标签代价机制，将工作流的构建与运行优化统一起来，无需参考答案或训练评估器即可实现低成本故障修复，并借助 Braid 基准验证了多智能体工作流的有效性。

title: Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent communication aims to help agents benefit from one another's information. Yet improvements in system performance leave a fundamental ambiguity: do they reflect effective communication, a favorable agent architecture, or simply additional reasoning? Because communication methods are commonly evaluated within the systems they were designed for, these factors are difficult to disentangle. Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions. We introduce Independent--Communicate--Revise (ICR), a controlled framework that evaluates communication as answer revision following independent reasoning. ICR fixes initial reasoning trajectories, measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness, and uses a no-message revision control to quantify gains beyond additional reasoning. Across four reasoning benchmarks, our audit of textual and latent communication reveals that similar aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behaviors. Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike. Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks. These findings challenge treating communication quality as an intrinsic property of a channel. ICR therefore recenters evaluation on selective revision, providing a unified framework for examining how message content and receiver policies jointly produce benefits and harms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出受控框架 ICR（Independent–Communicate–Revise），将通信评估重新定义为"独立推理后的答案修正"，以解耦通信、智能体架构与额外推理的贡献，并区分修正错误与破坏正确两类决策变化。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体通信方法通常在其所属系统内部评估，导致系统性能提升的来源难以归因：究竟是有效通信、有利的智能体架构，还是单纯增加了推理量？此外，最终准确率将"修正错误"与"破坏正确答案"合并为单一指标，掩盖了通信对决策的真实影响。
AI.method: ICR 固定初始推理轨迹，在两个智能体初始正确性条件下分别度量 correction（修正）与 preservation（保持），并设置 no-message 的修正对照组，用于剥离额外推理带来的增益。基于该框架，在四个推理基准上审计文本通信与潜空间通信，并在 MedQA 与 GPQA-D 上比较不同接收方策略。
AI.result: 相似的总体准确率可能掩盖显著不同的修正行为。相比仅传递答案，传递完整推理在四个基准上均提升修正但降低保持，说明更丰富的信息同时放大了有益与有害影响。MedQA 与 GPQA-D 上的接收方策略对比表明，结构化验证策略使各通道一致趋向更高保持与更低修正，而其对选择性的影响随通道与任务而变。
AI.conclusion: 通信质量不应被视为通道的固有属性；ICR 将评估重心转向选择性修正，为考察消息内容与接收方策略如何共同产生收益与损害提供统一框架。

title: Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver
summary: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“空承诺”（empty commitment）概念：智能体承诺在当前轮之后执行某动作，但其工具或运行时配置根本无力执行，仅凭配置即可判定其空洞性，无需后续轨迹。作者基于承诺语义给出定义、三类失败类型、可被工具实现的承诺的锚定条件及回复层结果分类，并设计五级递进持能设置下的测量协议。
AI.motivation: 聊天机器人常说“我明天提醒你”之类承诺，但用户若不再次发言，会话便不再运行，承诺永远无法兑现。与“食言”不同，这类空洞性源于智能体自身配置，不依赖后续行为轨迹，现有承诺语义研究缺乏对此类结构性失效的刻画与度量。
AI.method: 在承诺语义（commitment semantics）之上形式化定义空承诺，划分三类失败类型；提出锚定条件（anchoring condition），用以判定某项承诺是否能被某工具在现实中兑现；构建回复层结果分类法；并设计测量协议：以五组设置逐项添加持续性能力（persistence affordance），同时控制环境是隐式还是显式表述，通过后续请求进行检验。
AI.result: 摘要为概念与协议提出型，未报告实验数据。所提框架给出了空承诺的定义、失败类型学、锚定判据与回复分类，以及五级设置×环境表述方式的测量协议，可用于系统化识别与量化此类承诺。
AI.conclusion: 空承诺是区别于食言的独立失效模式，可由智能体配置单独判定。通过分层递进的持续性能力设置与后续请求探测，可对空承诺进行测量，为对话智能体的承诺能力评估提供可操作框架。

title: Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graphs for Dynamic Reasoning
summary: Conventional reasoning protocols present a fixed, preselected task, so they cannot test whether an agent propagates relevant updates, preserves unaffected work, or reconstructs a historical task binding. We therefore study \emph{dynamic task routing}, in which an event stream revises task bindings and a system must select the document version valid at each query time before solving it. To study this problem, we repurpose six widely used benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedMCQA, MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval into 31{,}119 dynamic episodes comprising 373{,}428 temporally categorized queries. This setting exposes a central trade-off: recomputing after every event wastes work, whereas unguarded reuse returns stale conclusions. We introduce the Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG), a bounded multi-agent policy that separates deterministic temporal resolution from task reasoning. RIAG caches solutions by immutable document identity, starts each fresh task with two unexposed attempts, and conditionally invokes audit and repair, using at most four calls per document version. On this collection, homogeneous RIAG achieves 54.24\% joint routing-and-answer accuracy at 0.62 calls/query, compared with 32.22\% at 18.00 calls/query for the strongest comparison method; heterogeneous RIAG reaches 49.78\% at 0.63 calls/query.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"动态任务路由"设定，将6个基准重构为含31,119个动态事件与373,428个时序查询的数据集，并提出Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG) 有界多智能体策略。
AI.motivation: 传统推理协议给定固定、预先选定的任务，无法检验智能体是否能传播相关更新、保留未受影响的既有成果，或重建历史任务绑定，因此需要引入随事件流动态修正任务绑定的评测设定。
AI.method: 将MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MedMCQA、MATH、GPQA、HumanEval六个基准重构为动态episode；提出RIAG，将确定性时间解析与任务推理分离，按不可变文档标识缓存解，新任务给予两次未公开尝试，并按条件触发审计与修复，每个文档版本最多四次调用。
AI.result: 同构RIAG达到54.24%的联合路由与作答准确率，每次查询0.62次调用；最强对比方法为32.22%准确率但需18.00次调用/查询；异构RIAG为49.78%，0.63次调用/查询。
AI.conclusion: 该设定揭示了"重算浪费"与"无保护复用导致过时结论"之间的核心权衡，而RIAG以有界调用预算在准确率与调用效率上显著优于对比方法。

title: SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI--AD continuum. Retrospective training records provide sampled Bellman targets for an energy-based teacher, whose action distributions are distilled into a Qwen policy. At deployment, the agent selects acquisition or diagnosis actions under availability and budget constraints without access to unacquired values. After each acquisition, the evidence and ordinal belief are updated before the next decision. On ADNI, SCOPE-AD achieves 77.70\% Macro-F1 at an average acquisition cost of \$50.46, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.34 percentage points. Full-modality evaluation raises Macro-F1 by only 1.89 points while increasing acquisition cost by 116.7 times. These results support selective acquisition for cost-effective diagnosis.

AI.tldr: SCOPE-AD：基于能量模型与序数信念规划的成本感知序贯采集与诊断智能体
AI.motivation: AD诊断需在异质检测成本与患者负担下序贯获取证据；固定模态预测器无法联合决定"下一步测什么"与"何时证据足够"。
AI.method: 掩码感知序数模型建模CN–MCI–AD连续不确定度；回顾数据采样Bellman目标训练能量模型教师，将其动作分布蒸馏至Qwen策略；部署时在可用性与预算约束下选择采集或诊断动作，每次采集后更新证据与序数信念。
AI.result: ADNI上77.70% Macro-F1，平均采集成本$50.46，超最强基线9.34个百分点；全模态仅提升1.89点Macro-F1，成本增至116.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 支持选择性采集以实现成本有效的AD诊断。

title: DAYJOB: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Professional Work
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. An earlier version was accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET) at NeurIPS 2026. Evaluation harness: https://github.com/surge-ai/dayjob
summary: Professional work often starts with a brief request that leaves the professional to work out what is needed, which documents matter, and whether the request's premise holds. We introduce DAYJOB, a benchmark of 130 tasks built by professionals in healthcare (50) and finance (80). The tasks are estimated to take a professional 13.6 hours on average in healthcare and 16.6 in finance. Each task is a containerized Harbor environment with an expert rubric of binary criteria (median 47.5 and 57.5 per task) that an agentic judge applies to the delivered files, and an attempt passes only if it meets every criterion. Across 30 model configurations from 13 developers, the strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, passes 24.7% of healthcare and 23.9% of finance attempts, and the median configuration passes 0.6% and 2.5%. In case studies, agents accept premises that the record contradicts and carry wrong inputs through otherwise consistent analyses. We release all healthcare tasks, 50 of the 80 finance tasks, the evaluation harness, and the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAYJOB基准，包含由医疗（50个）和金融（80个）领域专业人士构建的130个任务，评估智能体在专业工作场景中的端到端交付能力。
AI.motivation: 专业工作往往始于一个简短请求，需要从业者自行判断需要什么、哪些文档重要以及请求前提是否成立。现有基准缺乏对此类真实专业工作全流程、含隐藏前提任务的评估。
AI.method: 构建130个容器化Harbor环境任务，每个任务配备专家制定的二元标准评分表（中位数分别为47.5与57.5条），由智能体评判器对交付文件逐条核验，必须满足全部标准才算通过。测试来自13个开发者的30种模型配置。
AI.result: 最强模型Claude Opus 5.5在医疗任务通过率24.7%、金融23.9%；中位数配置仅0.6%和2.5%。案例研究中，智能体接受与记录相矛盾的前提，并将错误输入贯穿于其余一致的分析中。
AI.conclusion: DAYJOB揭示了当前智能体在真实专业任务上的显著能力缺口，尤其难以识别和质疑请求前提。作者公开全部医疗任务、80个金融任务中的50个、评估框架及排行榜。

title: Gacha Decoding: Eliciting Diverse Generations Through Instruction Following
summary: We introduce Gacha Decoding, an inference-time method for eliciting diverse language model generations that scales with model capability. Across open-ended domains (in-the-wild chat, creative writing, planning for image generation, and protein design), Gacha Decoding significantly outperforms existing generation diversity approaches at equal quality (up to 2.4x Vendi over the next-best prior approach), reaching the same number of high-quality modes with over an order of magnitude fewer samples (11.0x) and discovering novel modes that no other approach surfaces. Our key insight is to treat diversity as an instruction-following problem: rather than relying on the LM's token entropy, we combine its instruction-following capability with randomness from an external RNG tool to scalably identify and realize distinct modes of the response space. This approach of "planning with dice" enables Gacha to invert the long-observed tension between diversity and model capability. As the underlying LM becomes a better instruction follower, diversity under Gacha Decoding consistently improves--even as its token entropy and diversity under prior approaches decline. Together, our results highlight that instruction following, rather than token entropy alone, can drive generation diversity.

AI.tldr: 提出 Gacha Decoding，一种推理时方法，将多样化生成转化为指令遵循问题，借助外部随机数工具，在同等质量下显著提升语言模型生成的多样性，且随模型能力增强而提升。
AI.motivation: 现有提升生成多样性的方法依赖语言模型的 token 熵，而模型能力越强、token 熵下降，导致多样性与模型能力之间存在长期张力，难以兼顾高质量与多模态覆盖。作者希望打破这一矛盾。
AI.method: Gacha Decoding 将多样性视为指令遵循任务：不依赖 LM 的 token 熵，而是结合 LM 的指令遵循能力与外部 RNG 工具的随机性，通过"用骰子做规划"来可扩展地识别并实现响应空间中不同的模式。
AI.result: 在开放域任务（真实场景对话、创意写作、图像生成规划、蛋白质设计）中，Gacha Decoding 在同等质量下显著优于现有方法，Vendi 指标最多提升 2.4 倍；以超过一个数量级更少的样本（11.0 倍）达到相同数量的高质量模式，并发现其他方法无法呈现的新模式。随着 LM 指令遵循能力增强，其多样性持续提升，而 token 熵及先前方法的多样性反而下降。
AI.conclusion: 指令遵循而非 token 熵，才是驱动生成多样性的关键；Gacha Decoding 反转了多样性与模型能力之间的传统张力，使二者随模型能力共同提升。

title: Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks
comment: 44 pages, 9 figures. Code, benchmark protocol, scoring code, and all 288 per-cell results: https://github.com/Mingbird/Mingbird-agent
summary: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate point-by-point for small-model failure forms, three of them representative: a byte-level net-zero prefill budget, a finish gate that re-reads the task before accepting completion, and signature-level loop detection. On LRAB, a controlled comparison holding machine, models, budgets, and scoring fixed (4 harnesses $\times$ 4 open models (2B-35B) $\times$ 18 real tasks, deterministic artifact scoring), Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), and 0.405 (agent-mini), with all 288 cells published; on $τ^2$-bench (278 tasks, three arms, one protocol) it totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737; and a frontier-model probe on the same 18 tasks spans 0.997 to 0.478 across harnesses, with well-formed scaffolds staying within 0.072 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation is reported as directional only: same-night replications of the same arm move its mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal single-trial delta, and the one batch-matched comparison (full mechanism stack versus text re-read alone) gives the executable completion guards a paired +0.10 across three replications. The evidence carries stated limits: a self-built benchmark, a single machine, and single-trial scoring.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并验证了 Mingbird——一个面向 Windows 与 Ollama 的本地优先 agent harness，通过十项机制逐点补偿小模型（2-9B）的失败形式。在自建基准 LRAB 上以 0.886 显著超越 goose（0.631）、opencode（0.479）和 agent-mini（0.405），在 τ²-bench 上达 0.856；并论证相当比例的失败源于 harness 而非模型本身。
AI.motivation: 小规模开源权重模型（2-9B）虽可在普通笔记本上运行，但在云规模的 agent harness 下几乎无法完成真实任务，典型失败包括：工具预填充溢出上下文、自纠正发散、工具演示循环、任务被静默放弃。作者希望证明这些失败中有相当大比例可归因于 harness（执行框架）而非模型能力本身，从而为本地优先的 agent 设计提供依据。
AI.method: 方法上，作者先通过受控的单机对比与一个第三方基准进行评估。提出 Mingbird，一个面向 Windows/Ollama 的本地优先 harness，包含十项机制，逐点针对小模型失败形式，其中三项具有代表性：(1) 字节级净零预填充预算（byte-level net-zero prefill budget）；(2) 完成闸门（finish gate），在接受完成前重读任务；(3) 签名级循环检测（signature-level loop detection）。主实验为 LRAB：固定机器、模型、预算与评分方式，设置 4 个 harness × 4 个开源模型（2B–35B）× 18 个真实任务，采用确定性产物评分，共 288 个单元全部公开。另在 τ²-bench（278 任务、三组臂、单一协议）上验证，并做前沿模型探针实验；机制消融采用留一法（leave-one-mechanism-out）。
AI.result: LRAB 结果：Mingbird 总体得分 0.886，对比 goose 0.631、opencode 0.479、agent-mini 0.405，288 个单元全部公布。τ²-bench（278 任务）上总计 0.856，对比 0.791 与 0.737。同一 18 任务的前沿模型探针在不同 harness 间得分为 0.997 至 0.478，结构良好的脚手架（well-formed scaffolds）彼此差距在 0.072 以内。留一机制消融仅作方向性报告：同夜重复同一臂可使均值变动达 0.069，与每个名义单次试验增量相当；唯一批次匹配对比（完整机制栈 vs 仅文本重读）显示可执行完成守卫在三重复下配对提升 +0.10。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：小模型在真实 agent 任务中的失败有相当部分应归因于 harness 而非模型，harness 设计可显著改变完成率；Mingbird 以其十项补偿机制在多个基准上取得领先。但证据存在明确局限：自建基准、单机环境、单次试验评分，因此消融结论仅具方向性，需谨慎推广。

title: A Comparative Explainability Framework for DeBERTa-v3 in Zero-Shot Medical Abstract Classification
summary: A comparative explainability framework is presented to audit DeBERTa-v3 under zero-shot classification of medical abstracts. The work addresses the disagreement problem in Explainable Artificial Intelligence, where different attribution methods produce divergent explanations for the same input and prediction. A natural language inference engine is implemented over the Medical Abstracts corpus with five enriched hypotheses per diagnostic category and a balanced sample of one thousand texts per class. Five explanation methods are compared: SHAP and LIME as model-agnostic approaches, occlusion and Input x Gradient as deep-learning-specific approaches, and Attention x Gradient as a transformer-specific approach. Explanations are standardized through top-token attribution, and pairwise agreement is quantified using the Jaccard index. High predictive accuracy is achieved across well-defined clinical domains, whereas performance degrades under high semantic ambiguity. Explanatory stability directly mirrors predictive certainty, exhibiting strong convergence in univalent categories and a marked drop under diagnostic uncertainty. Furthermore, qualitative error auditing uncovers three systemic failure mechanisms: lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence. The results support the combined use of several explanation methods and quantitative agreement metrics when auditing transformer-based models in medical text classification, and suggest prioritizing specific clinical ontologies over broad diagnostic labels.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个比较性可解释性框架，用于审计DeBERTa-v3在医学摘要零样本分类中的表现，通过五种归因方法（SHAP、LIME、occlusion、Input x Gradient、Attention x Gradient）与Jaccard指数量化解释一致性。
AI.motivation: 解决可解释人工智能中的"分歧问题"——针对同一输入与预测，不同归因方法会产生相互矛盾的解释，这在医学文本分类等高风险场景中尤为关键。
AI.method: 基于Medical Abstracts语料库构建自然语言推理引擎，每个诊断类别设置五个丰富化假设，每类平衡采样1000篇文本；比较五类解释方法：SHAP与LIME（模型无关）、occlusion与Input x Gradient（深度学习专用）、Attention x Gradient（Transformer专用）；通过top-token归因标准化解释，并用Jaccard指数量化成对一致性。
AI.result: 在界定清晰的临床领域中预测准确率高，语义高度模糊时性能下降；解释稳定性与预测确定性直接对应，单一明确类别中收敛性强，诊断不确定时显著下降；定性错误审计揭示三类系统性失效机制：词汇过度敏感、语义重叠、归因连贯性丧失。
AI.conclusion: 支持在医学文本分类的Transformer模型审计中联合使用多种解释方法与量化一致性指标，并建议优先采用具体临床本体而非宽泛诊断标签。

title: Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents
summary: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

AI.tldr: 本文将长时程智能体的外部记忆视为"冻结世界模型",提出以"记忆使用形状"（核心—长尾分布）为分析对象，通过保守的长尾审计发现该集中现象可复现但依赖策略，并据此提出排序式记忆控制器CTWM，在合成图世界、ALFWorld与LongMemEval上实现token节省与尾部预测误差下降。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统仅以任务成功率或token开销作为评价指标，忽略了有限上下文与重复检索条件下记忆使用形态这一关键对象：智能体记忆可能集中于一个很小的核心，而稀有状态滞留在长尾中，导致预测误差在长尾不断累积。作者希望把这种重尾记忆痕迹从"有限检索的诊断信号"转化为"token高效世界模型的控制信号"。
AI.method: 1）提出保守的长尾审计（tail audit）方法，刻画记忆检索痕迹的集中程度与核心—尾结构；2）发现随机游走策略产生的检索痕迹符合对数正态分布，而语义LLM策略产生最强的截断幂律型核心—尾痕迹；3）基于该审计提出Core–Tail World Model（CTWM），一种基于秩（rank-based）的记忆控制器，用单一指数τ分配提示预算并保留经摘要的尾部。
AI.result: 在Synthetic Graph World上，CTWM保持完整的状态与转移覆盖，相比图记忆基线减少5.9%的提示token，并将下半尾部预测误差降低13.6%；在ALFWorld上配对比较得到一致的token节省；在LongMemEval上实现24.48%的token削减，且总体准确率持平。
AI.conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索条件下的一种诊断指标，也可作为实用的控制信号，用于构建token高效的智能体世界模型；核心—尾结构为记忆预算分配提供了可解释且可操作的依据。

title: When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedCausalCompose框架，用于模块化LLM agent的因果世界模型，论证并验证因果接口在跨模块规划中有效的条件：接口需统计可辨识且以agent可用的形式呈现。
AI.motivation: 标准世界模型通常拟合观测轨迹，但干预时刻的规划需要的是干预响应量而非观测相关性。仅凭观测轨迹无法区分"支付先于发货"究竟意味着支付授权了发货、库存中介了效应，还是存在隐藏共同触发因素。这一差距在模块化工具系统（订单、支付、库存、发货等）中尤为突出，因为一个模块的动作会改变另一模块的有效转移。
AI.method: 提出FedCausalCompose——面向模块化LLM agent的因果世界模型框架，利用局部动作提供跨模块接口的干预响应证据。理论上刻画观测世界模型在未阻断后门路径下的不可约干预误差，分析接口恢复与干预响应覆盖率的关系，并给出oracle因果组合优于非因果下界的条件。随后在诊断性agent设置中检验该预测，对比结构化工具环境与对话、叙事环境的表现，并考察注意力锚点对因果信息可用性的影响。
AI.result: 观测世界模型在存在未阻断后门路径时会产生不可约的干预误差；接口恢复随干预响应覆盖率提升而改善；在覆盖率与局部机制误差受控时，oracle因果组合可突破非因果下界。实验上，因果接口在结构化工具环境（API签名暴露前置条件与下游效应）中收益最大；在对话与叙事环境中，agent常忽略原始边列表，除非用简短注意力锚点使因果信息与决策相关。
AI.conclusion: 因果世界模型对LLM agent有效需满足具体条件：跨模块接口既要统计可辨识，又要以agent在行动时刻可使用（decision-relevant）的形式呈现。仅提供因果结构并不充分，呈现形式与可辨识性共同决定因果建模的实际收益。

title: From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures. Engineering validation and descriptive pilot. Public artifacts: https://github.com/praxa-labs/praxa-benchmarks/releases/tag/preprint-v1.4.0
summary: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Praxa——一个将"提议、授权、派发、外部验证效果、服务上线"等状态显式分离的 agent 编排框架，并通过四条证据链（本地审计、Terminal-Bench 试点、协调代理开发对比、部署配置证据）报告其架构有效性与局限。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型 agent 能提出并执行动作，但"提议""授权""派发""经外部验证的效果""服务上线推广"是彼此不同的主张，现有系统常将其混为一谈，缺乏对权威到效果转换过程的显式、可测试表示。
AI.method: Praxa 通过确定性准入（deterministic admission）、代理化执行（brokered execution）、外部读回（external read-back）、对账（reconciliation）与经审查的推广（reviewed promotion）显式表示上述状态；评估采用四条证据链：固定修订版的仓库本地审计、provider 支持的 Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 试点（12 任务，基线与可靠性层各 36 次严格试验）、调试后双序协调代理开发对比（基线与来源自撰候选各 180 次试验），以及部署源码/配置证据分析。
AI.result: ① 本地审计通过 1,027/1,027 单元测试与 89/89 Workerd 测试，插桩全部 363 个预期源文件并满足四项覆盖率下限，但原始逐测试记录与独立复现不可得；② Terminal-Bench 试点中基线与可靠性层各通过 17/36，可靠性层多耗 37.49% 输入、50.73% 输出 token，不支持优越性；③ 协调代理对比中两者均 180/180 完成、准确率相等、具备完全密封崩溃恢复且零受保护违规，候选省 37.11% token、33.84% 估计端点成本、11.63% 步骤，但未证实质量、延迟或生产行为提升；④ 部署证据显示反射有界、回忆核算、记忆编译与工具健康路径，但无生产结果提升。
AI.conclusion: Praxa 的受支持贡献是一个"证据受约束"的架构，使权威到效果的转换显式且可测试；当前证据尚不能确立对抗性安全、生产安全、通用专家优越性、自主递归优化或用户收益。

title: Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization
summary: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

AI.tldr: 本文将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题，揭示DPO更新方向与用户效用梯度的对齐关系，提出GAP-DPO实现效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择，在个性化文本生成任务上优于标准DPO变体。
AI.motivation: 个性化大模型需使生成行为对齐用户特定偏好而非平均质量。DPO虽提供稳定的偏好学习框架，但在个性化场景中的效果关键取决于偏好对的选择方式。现有方法多依赖启发式准则（如基于似然的极端样本），使优化与显式用户效用脱钩，导致个性化效果退化。
AI.method: 作者通过分析期望用户效用梯度与DPO更新方向之间的一阶交互，将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题。分析表明，在off-policy采样下，当偏好边际与效用梯度方向对齐时，DPO更新会从纯粹的误差纠正信号转变为类强化学习更新，从而将偏好对选择揭示为决定个性化成败的几何决策。基于此提出GAP-DPO：一种迭代算法，执行效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择，并通过逐轮（epoch-wise）重新生成来控制分布偏移。
AI.result: 在个性化文本生成基准上的实验表明，GAP-DPO在风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量方面均持续优于标准DPO变体。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立梯度对齐作为个性化偏好优化的统一原则，并证明偏好对选择是优化几何的内在组成部分，而非启发式预处理步骤。

title: K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook
comment: 38 pages, 8 figures plus a graphical abstract; includes benchmark prompts, scoring rubric, and per-prompt scores. Code: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok
summary: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

AI.tldr: K-Dense BYOK 是一个免费、开源的本地化 AI 科研助手，通过科学脚手架、Living Lab Notebook 与不可被智能体写入的观测日志来缓解模型过度声称问题。在二十个跨学科研究提示上，其在科学质量与研究执行两项指标上均优于两个托管平台。
AI.motivation: 通用聊天助手与编码智能体缺乏科研专用的过程支撑与可信记录机制，最常见失败模式是模型过度声称（overclaiming）：模型自述完成的工作与实际执行不符。作者希望以"使声称可核查"而非"阻止声称"的思路来解决该问题，并让数据、代码、结果与记录留在研究者自管机器上。
AI.method: K-Dense BYOK 运行于研究者自有计算机，由研究者自带模型（托管或本地）。除模型外提供三项能力：内置科学流程库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据目录，以及评审与写作角色交接；Living Lab Notebook 以条目链接成论证链，只增不删；记录机制为主动观测智能体行为而非采信其自述，日志写入是智能体无可用工具可调用的。评估方式为二十个跨学科研究提示，采用预先固定的评分量表，与两个托管平台对比。
AI.result: 在科学质量与研究执行两项指标上均领先两个托管平台。其交付物是唯一记录了所运行软件的，也通常是唯一附带可重生成结果命令的。其中一个托管平台使用相同前沿模型，却未提供上述记录。环境记录属于智能体自行写入的文件，而非观测日志的一部分，因此该日志尚未覆盖软件环境本身。
AI.conclusion: 以日志观测替代自述可有效提升科研智能体的可核查性，并将模型过度声称从"不可见"变为"可检验"。当前观测日志仍未捕获软件环境，环境记录依赖智能体自写文件，是后续需补齐的缺口。项目以 MIT 许可证开源。

title: EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs
summary: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

AI.tldr: EviGraph 通过区分"关键决策需求"与"可悬置信息"，用语言智能体在时序知识图谱中链接证据并由确定性检查器判定推荐是否被支持，在 bilingual 香港公共服务基准上减少了不必要弃答；但额外验证会撤回已支持的推荐而不提升决策质量。
AI.motivation: 公共服务推荐需要与服务、范围、日期相匹配的证据；但若把每个缺失细节都视为决定性因素，就会导致系统过度弃答，从而扣留有用推荐。
AI.method: 提出 EviGraph：由语言智能体将关键决策需求链接到时序知识图谱中的证据，再由确定性检查器判定推荐是否被支持；区分必须确立的决策需求与可保持未决的信息。
AI.result: 在双语香港公共服务基准（含可执行政策引用）上评估：该区分降低了不必要的弃答；然而额外验证会撤回本已受支持的推荐，且未改善决策质量。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的证据驱动导航取决于明确界定"决策必须确立什么"，而非单纯增加验证。

title: Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying
comment: 26 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables. Data paper. Dataset openly available at https://zenodo.org/records/20451474. Under review at the ASCE Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering
summary: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

AI.tldr: 提出 Build2SPARQL，一个面向建筑知识图谱的大规模 text-to-SPARQL 基准，通过 KG 接地流水线生成 6,136 条可执行 SPARQL 查询与 30,680 条自然语言问题，并给出检索增强的评估基线。
AI.motivation: 建筑自动化系统正以 Brick、ASHRAE 223P 等本体表示为语义知识图谱，为 AI 应用提供机器可读底座。其中 text-to-SPARQL 可让运维人员用自然语言查询图谱，但缺乏大规模自然语言/SPARQL 基准，制约了进展。
AI.method: 构建 KG 接地流水线：SPARQL 查询完全由图遍历代码生成并验证，LLM 仅生成自然语言问题，使查询正确性独立于模型行为。流水线挖掘六类查询模式（线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL、属性过滤），并以五种词汇语域对每类查询进行表述。应用于 201 个建筑 KG（180 个 Brick、21 个 ASHRAE 223P）。
AI.result: 生成 6,136 条可执行 SPARQL 查询和 30,680 条问题。对 300 条问题开展双标注者人工验证，语义保真度 98.8%、自然度 98.8%、操作合理性 84.0%。在三个开放权重模型上的检索增强评估将精确匹配准确率从零样本的 0.2–20% 提升至三样本检索的 56–65%。
AI.conclusion: Build2SPARQL 为建筑知识图谱上的 text-to-SPARQL 提供了规模化、可执行且经人类验证的基准，检索增强能显著提升开放权重模型的查询生成准确率，为建筑运维语言智能体奠定数据基础。

title: Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score
summary: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."

AI.tldr: 学习率调度决定了数据排列（顺序）效应的大小：衰减调度抑制顺序效应，常数调度放大之；两半效应可分离为一个乘性界，且顺序效应在约定无关指标下完全不可见。
AI.motivation: 作者质疑"顺序是否重要"这一非此即彼的提法，认为学习率调度并非背景条件，而是决定顺序效应的平均算子本身；同时指出现有精确匹配类基准无法观测到模型对某一种书写约定的承诺。
AI.method: 理论侧给出一个界，将排列与调度作为两个独立相乘因子：排列只以块周期进入，调度只以其在任一时刻可施加的权重上限进入。实验侧固定单一语料、单一预算与路径之外的一切条件，构造同一问题的两种互不兼容但均正确的书写约定，取十种排序，在仅 lr_scheduler_type 不同的调度族（常数率与单个余弦）下各跑两遍，测量分配份额与对比度下限。
AI.result: 常数率下内部跨度达 0.2221（分配）与 11.63（对比度下限），且随排列分块程度单调；同一余弦下十条臂仅占据两个可区分状态（自身分辨率约可容纳十个）。十二臂中 acc_A+acc_B 在 9.7% 内恒定，而分配份额从 0.04 变到 0.87，故 12.29-sigma 的排列切换在约定无关指标下恰为零；该守恒在衰减族中更稳定。
AI.conclusion: "顺序重要"与"顺序不重要"是同一旋钮的两端，由调度决定；路径写入的是模型承诺于哪种约定，任何精确匹配基准都看不到这一点。在提示中标注约定可使该切换坍缩，并达到并集上界的 87.5%。

title: Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents
summary: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. In text-only ALFWorld, 162 checkpoints produce 972 paired true and false interventions. Complete local inspections give GAVA and always verify 100 percent correction accuracy, establishing the evidence contract rather than a comparative advantage. In same-episode execution, GAVA reduces interaction cost against always verify but ties a cost threshold under a perfect speaker. An exploratory training-only object-location prior lowers interaction and declared joint cost on 340 unseen scenarios by 0.490 and 0.420 relative to uniform GAVA. After freezing the policy, costs, baselines, and multiplicity plan, the gains replicate on 77 non-overlapping seen checkpoints, covering 308 scenarios: 0.595 and 0.517, with both 95 percent checkpoint-bootstrap confidence intervals excluding zero. Joint cost also improves over an identical-prior fixed policy, while the matched calibrated no-VOI comparison remains inconclusive. Semantic GAVA makes four factual errors in each cohort, corresponding to 98.8 percent and 98.7 percent accuracy, and all methods complete every task. Results support selective information gathering with semantic priors under declared costs, but do not establish a general advantage of environmental value of information over clarification. The study uses normalized claims, complete symbolic observations, and controlled speakers; it evaluates neither human participants, visual input, nor physical robots.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"grounded correction arbitration"问题：当人的纠正可能有误时，具身智能体应在接受、拒绝、查验世界、询问说话者之间做选择。GAVA以观测受限证据、合法探查和一步期望损失规则实现该接口，在ALFWorld文本环境中验证了选择性信息收集结合语义先验的有效性，但未证明环境信息价值相对澄清提问的普遍优势。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体面对人类纠正时，不能默认纠正一定正确，也不能盲目全盘验证。核心动机是把"是否采信纠正"形式化为四选一的仲裁决策（接受/拒绝/查验世界/询问说话者），并在可声明成本下研究何时值得花费交互代价去获取证据。
AI.method: 提出GAVA，在观测受限证据（observation-bounded evidence）、合法探查（legal probes）与一步期望损失规则下做仲裁。实验在纯文本ALFWorld中进行：162个checkpoint生成972对真实与虚假干预；采用同episode执行、仅训练用物体位置先验、冻结策略后的复现设计、多重性计划、checkpoint bootstrap置信区间，并与always verify、相同先验固定策略及匹配校准的无VOI对照比较。
AI.result: 完整局部查验使GAVA与always verify均达100%纠正准确率，确立了证据契约而非比较优势。同episode执行中GAVA相对always verify降低交互成本，但在完美说话者下与成本阈值持平。仅训练用物体位置先验在340个未见场景上相对统一先验GAVA将交互与声明联合成本分别降低0.490和0.420；冻结策略后在308个场景、77个非重叠已见checkpoint上复现为0.595和0.517，两个95%置信区间均不含零。联合成本也优于相同先验固定策略，但匹配校准的无VOI比较仍不确定。语义GAVA各队列仅4个事实错误（98.8%、98.7%准确率），所有方法均完成任务。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在声明成本下结合语义先验进行选择性信息收集，但未确立环境信息价值（VOI）相对澄清提问的普遍优势。研究限于归一化声明、完整符号观测与受控说话者，未评估人类被试、视觉输入或物理机器人。

title: Rules to Tools: Executable Checks for LLM Agents in Scientific Computing
summary: Scientific coding agents receive equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements in writing, then must assess the programs they revise. Rules to Tools (R2T) supplies prepared executable checks of public scientific requirements. Matched SciCode repair groups share written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the tool group receives a callable implementation. Across two task-ID cohorts, complete repair is 26/30 with text and 29/30 with the prepared checks. Three task IDs favor tools, one favors text, and eleven tie. The eight-ID cohort scores 13/16 versus 15/16, with a task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of [-12.5, 43.75] percentage points for the difference. The larger shared-definition SciCode cohort ties at 13/24 per group. Five development-exposed tasks with alternate starting programs score 3/10 versus 7/10. The tool group favors tasks 17, 77, and 11; initial checks flag task 17 and report no violation for tasks 77 and 11. Task 37 favors text and has no initial reported violation. A fresh source-through-Python arm also reaches 15/16, matching the dedicated command's aggregate. In a matched PDE comparison, detailed text scores 23/24 and checks score 24/24, with 31.2% lower reported model output for checks. Agent-side output savings vary by cohort, while public CPU use rises in both task-ID cohorts. These results measure task-dependent repair outcomes and agent-side costs with prepared checks.

AI.tldr: 论文比较"规则即工具"(Rules to Tools, R2T)——将公开科学需求转化为可执行检查——与纯文本需求说明在科学编程智能体程序修复任务中的效果与成本。
AI.motivation: 科学编程智能体必须根据书面需求(方程、边界条件、输出要求)自行评估并修改程序,但书面规则需要智能体自行转化为可执行的验证逻辑,过程易出错。作者希望探究:若直接提供已制备好的可执行检查(而非文字描述),能否提升修复成功率,并考察其对智能体侧输出量和公共CPU开销的影响。
AI.method: 在SciCode修复任务上构建配对实验:同一任务ID下,文本组与工具组共享书面检查、起始程序、模型与预算,工具组额外获得可调用的函数实现。设置两个任务ID队列(8个ID、11个ID差异分析),另用共享定义的更大SciCode队列、五个已暴露开发任务(带替代起始程序)、全新"源码转Python"臂,以及一个匹配的PDE对比实验(文本组23/24 vs 检查组24/24)进行交叉验证,并以任务簇自助法(bootstrap)估计差异区间。
AI.result: 两个任务ID队列中,完全修复率文本组26/30、工具组29/30;3个ID偏向工具、1个偏向文本、11个持平。8-ID队列为13/16对15/16,任务簇bootstrap 95%区间为[-12.5, 43.75]个百分点。更大的共享定义SciCode队列两组均持平于13/24。五个开发暴露任务为3/10对7/10。工具组在任务17、77、11上占优,首次检查仅在任务17报出违规,任务77、11未报违规;任务37偏向文本且首次未报违规。全新源码转Python臂达到15/16,与专用命令聚合结果一致。匹配PDE对比中,检查组报告模型输出量低31.2%。智能体侧输出节省因队列而异,而公共CPU使用在两个任务ID队列中均上升。
AI.conclusion: 将公开科学需求制备为可执行检查可带来任务依赖性的修复成功率增益(整体略优、部分任务显著占优、也存在持平或反向案例),同时削减智能体侧输出量但增加公共CPU开销;效果随队列与任务难度而异,提示应根据任务特征选择文本或工具化需求交付方式。

title: Predictive Credit: Measuring What Scientific Explanations Add to Experimental Forecasts
summary: Research agents explain planned experiments. We measure predictive credit with paired forecasts sharing an intervention, forecaster, and outcome while varying description, matched explanation, and donor context. Five checks track commitment, delivery, predictive gain, alignment, and known-signal uptake. Across 336 prospective states in controlled learning, 12 Tox21 endpoints, and 24 OpenML tasks, v5's frozen credit decision was inconclusive. Tox21's preregistered ROC AUC interval-score harm test was unmet ($D-M=-.0026$, 95 percent interval [$-.0174$, .0104]); OpenML's joint formation, point-equivalence, and repeatability rule was unmet. Matched point-accuracy gains over description remained unconfirmed, and Tox21/OpenML seed-donor intervals spanned zero. Under requested DeepSeek V4 Pro, matched and donor cards reduced secondary Tox21 drift by 64.5 and 59.1 percent. A DeepSeek V4 Flash replay raised matched point MAE from .01823 to .02020 and missed matched-donor interval-score equivalence. OpenML full-card assignment widened nominal 80 percent intervals by 21 percent, with 49.3 percent coverage versus 51.4 percent for description and content in 66/144 cards. Direct-text Flash delivered all 144 notes without detectable matched point-accuracy gain. A researcher-authored mechanism positive control lowered point MAE by 2.60 percentage points versus description. The protocol measures predictive credit for research-agent benchmarks and scientific forecasting; natural-explanation credit remained unconfirmed at the tested donor resolutions.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种通过配对预测来度量研究智能体的"预测性信用"（predictive credit）的协议，在受控学习、Tox21与OpenML任务上进行系统检验，结果整体不确证。
AI.motivation: 研究智能体常对其计划实验给出解释，但尚缺乏严格的度量方法来判定这些解释是否真正贡献了预测性信用，而非仅是描述性文字。作者因此设计可检验的协议来区分描述、匹配解释与捐赠者上下文等因素的作用。
AI.method: 采用配对预测设计：共享干预、预测者与结果，仅变化描述、匹配解释与捐赠者上下文。设置五项检查，分别追踪承诺、交付、预测增益、对齐与已知信号采纳。评估覆盖受控学习中的336个前瞻状态、12个Tox21终点和24个OpenML任务，并使用冻结的信用决策（v5）以及DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash、直接文本Flash等复现与消融设置。
AI.result: v5冻结信用决策结论不确证。Tox21预注册的ROC AUC区间分数伤害检验未满足（D−M=−.0026，95%区间[−.0174, .0104]）；OpenML的联合形成、点等价与可重复性规则未满足。匹配相对描述的点准确率增益未获确认，Tox21/OpenML的种子-捐赠者区间跨越零。DeepSeek V4 Pro下匹配与捐赠者卡片使次要Tox21漂移分别降低64.5%和59.1%；DeepSeek V4 Flash复现使匹配点MAE由.01823升至.02020，且未通过匹配-捐赠者区间分数等价。OpenML全卡片分配使名义80%区间加宽21%，覆盖率49.3%，低于描述的51.4%（66/144卡片）。直接文本Flash交付全部144条笔记但无可检测的匹配点准确率增益。研究者编写的机制阳性对照使点MAE相对描述降低2.60个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该协议可用于度量研究智能体的预测性信用并为科学预测提供基准；但在所测试的捐赠者分辨率下，自然解释带来的信用仍未被确证，仅阳性对照显示了可检测的机制效应。

title: Mathematical Transfer in LLMs Follows Reasoning Approach More Than Topic
summary: When selecting mathematical training data for LLMs, a natural organizing principle is topic: probability examples for probability targets. An alternative is reasoning approach: worked solutions that share a solution method with the target, even when the mathematical domain differs. We ask which relation produces greater transfer after fine-tuning. We evaluate two counterbalanced $2\times2$ designs: probability and combinatorics crossed with invariant reasoning and double counting (2,000 problems), and number theory and geometry crossed with complement and pigeonhole reasoning (800 problems). In each design, every cell serves as the held-out target in turn: same-approach (SA) sources share the target's method but change the topic, while same-topic (ST) sources share the topic but change the method. Every source appears once in each role, so additive source-quality effects cancel from the equally weighted aggregate contrast. Across five base models and three training seeds per design, SA outperforms ST in all 40 seed-pooled model--target comparisons. Model-level advantages range from 8.2 to 16.2 percentage points in the primary design (mean: 10.8) and from 12.0 to 16.0 in the second design (mean: 14.3); all ten model-level 95% confidence intervals exclude zero. In both designs, ST sources are more similar to targets under embedding and lexical measures, so the SA advantage runs opposite to the measured ordering of statement-level resemblance. These findings identify reasoning approach as a more effective matching criterion than topic for mathematical transfer across the evaluated topic--approach combinations.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较数学训练数据选择中"同主题"(ST)与"同推理方法"(SA)两种匹配准则的迁移效果，发现按推理方法匹配显著优于按主题匹配。
AI.motivation: 为LLM挑选数学训练数据时，直觉上常按主题组织（如用概率题训练概率目标）。作者质疑这一"同主题"原则，提出替代假设：共享解题方法的题目（即使数学领域不同）可能带来更强迁移，并系统检验哪种关系在微调后产生更大迁移。
AI.method: 采用两个平衡的2×2设计：设计一为概率与组合数学×不变式推理与重复计数（2000题），设计二为数论与几何×补集与鸽巢原理推理（800题）。每个单元轮流作为留出目标；同方法(SA)源与目标共享方法但换主题，同主题(ST)源共享主题但换方法。每个源在各角色中仅出现一次，使加性源质量效应在等权聚合对比中相消。共5个基座模型×3个训练种子。
AI.result: 在全部40个按种子汇总的"模型—目标"比较中，SA均优于ST。设计一中模型级优势为8.2至16.2个百分点（均值10.8），设计二为12.0至16.0（均值14.3）；十个模型级95%置信区间均不含零。同时，ST源在嵌入与词汇相似度指标上更接近目标，说明SA的优势与语句层面相似度的测量排序相反。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的主题—方法组合范围内，推理方法比主题是更有效的数学迁移匹配准则，挑战了以主题组织数学训练数据的默认做法。

title: Fault-Tolerant Budget Conservation in Distributed Multi-Agent Delegation
comment: 67 pages, 3 figures, 17 tables, 4 algorithms, and 3 listings. Includes formal proofs, bounded model checking, mutation analysis, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments
summary: Resource limits are becoming an authorization boundary for AI agents that delegate work across concurrent and failure-prone workers. Parent-child allocation constraints, affine objects, and distributed escrow do not by themselves prevent overspend when replies are lost, effects complete after timeout, messages repeat, branches partition, or DAG joins alias one lineage. We formalize fault-tolerant budget conservation for distributed multi-agent delegation. Budgets are quantized resource vectors represented by exclusive escrow credits that move through a delegation DAG. Before dispatch, a branch converts credit into an operation reservation bound to lineage, epoch, normalized effect, maximum charge, receiver, and idempotency key. It persists a signed dispatch permit with quarantine; the gateway verifies that permit before first acceptance. Uncertain effects remain charged until authenticated settlement, a fenced authoritative no-effect proof, or permanent retirement. We prove ownership partition, ledger and effect conservation, descendant non-amplification, at-most-once settlement, late-completion safety, and partition confinement under explicit mediation, durability, authentication, normalization, and gateway assumptions. An indistinguishability result shows that partition-local availability requires exclusive preallocation. Bounded TLA+ checking, an independent JavaScript explorer, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments exercise the declared scope and detect timeout-refund and historical-certificate-validation mutants. The mechanism preserves the issued budget bound across the evaluated crash, retry, duplicate, partition, join, and late-completion schedules.

AI.tldr: 论文形式化了分布式多智能体委托中的容错预算守恒问题，提出以独占托管信用（escrow credit）在委托DAG中流转的机制，并给出正确性证明与多工具实证。
AI.motivation: 资源限制正成为AI智能体跨并发、易故障工作节点委托时的授权边界。现有的父子分配约束、仿射对象与分布式托管无法在回复丢失、超时后效应完成、消息重复、分支分区、DAG汇合别名等故障场景下防止超额支出，因此需要为分布式多智能体委托建立容错预算守恒的形式化机制。
AI.method: 将预算量化为资源向量，由独占托管信用表示，在委托DAG中流动。分派前，分支把信用转换为操作预留，绑定于血缘、纪元、归一化效应、最大计费、接收方与幂等键；持久化带隔离的签名分派许可，网关在首次接受前验证该许可。不确定效应保持计费，直至认证结算、带栅栏的权威无效应证明或永久退役。通过TLA+有界检验、独立JavaScript探索器与注入崩溃的双进程SQLite实验进行验证。
AI.result: 证明了所有权划分、账本与效应守恒、后代非放大、至多一次结算、迟完成安全性与分区封闭性（在明确的调解、持久性、认证、归一化与网关假设下）；不可区分性结果表明分区本地可用性需要独占预分配。实验覆盖了声明的范围，并检出超时退款与历史证书验证两类变异体；在评估的崩溃、重试、重复、分区、汇合与迟完成调度下均保持已发行预算界。
AI.conclusion: 该机制在给定假设下为分布式多智能体委托提供了容错的预算守恒保障，且分区本地可用性与独占预分配存在本质权衡。

title: JusticeAxis: Benchmarking Legal Judgment between Rigid Rule Application and Ungrounded Discretion
summary: A sound judgment applies the law to established facts and weighs the circumstances in which they arose. However, existing methods swing between rigid statute matching and ungrounded discretion, benchmarks score a label or a rubric, and the experience that would supply the balance stays unverified. We formalize legal judgment as a reference-anchored task, whose object is a single decision that stays tied to the statute and to the circumstances at once. We introduce JusticeAxis, 256 real-world criminal cases from 18 countries with audio, image, and text evidence, and three lawyer-written judgments for every case: the recorded one and one for each failure. We further propose JusticeAgent, a harness whose element agents establish the facts and whose judge agent applies the law under skills carrying experience of the circumstances. Skills are distilled from execution trajectories and admitted only under Bayesian credible bounds. Experiments show that failure turns direction with scale: open-weight backbones drift to unsupported grounds, frontier models to the statutory default. We further verify that JusticeAgent, as a simple yet effective plugin, carries a frozen open-weight backbone to commercial level. Project resources are available at https://github.com/beita6969/JusticeAxis.

AI.tldr: 该论文将法律裁判形式化为"参照锚定"任务，提出JusticeAxis数据集（18国256个真实刑事案件，含音图文本证据及三份律师判决）与JusticeAgent框架（要素智能体确立事实、法官智能体在经验技能下适用法律），实验揭示失败模式随模型规模反转，并证明该插件可将冻结的开源骨干提升至商业级水平。
AI.motivation: 现有法律裁判方法在僵化的法条匹配与无根据的自由裁量之间摇摆；基准仅评标签或评分表，而能提供平衡的"情境经验"始终未被验证。
AI.method: 形式化法律裁判为参照锚定任务（判决同时锚定法条与情境）；构建JusticeAxis数据集（18国256个真实刑事案件，含音频、图像、文本证据，每案3份律师撰写的判决：实录1份加2份失败判决）；提出JusticeAgent，由要素智能体确立事实、法官智能体在携带情境经验的技能下适用法律；技能从执行轨迹蒸馏，并仅在贝叶斯可信界下准入。
AI.result: 失败的方向随模型规模反转：开源权重骨干偏向无依据理由，前沿模型偏向法条默认结果；JusticeAgent作为简洁有效的插件，可将冻结的开源权重骨干提升至商业级水平。
AI.conclusion: 以参照锚定的方式将法条与情境统一，配合经验蒸馏与统计准入的技能机制，为法律裁判的可靠评测与增强提供新范式，且无需重新训练骨干即可显著提升性能。

title: What Should an Agent Remember? Disentangling Retention from Retrieval in Bounded-Memory Evaluation
comment: Code available in the accompanying repository
summary: A persistent agent must decide both what to retain as information arrives and what to surface once a query appears, yet memory evaluations can confound these decisions by comparing methods that differ in both retention and selection. We build a streaming-recall benchmark crossing retention and selection rules and evaluate every condition on the same 300 seeded episodes. Holding access fixed, query-aware selection improves required-fact recall by 15.5 percentage points (95% CI: 12.8 to 18.2), whereas a mixed comparison that also changes history access reports a 68.7-point advantage, of which 53.2 points are attributable to access. Under bounded retention, query-aware, dense, and oracle selection reach the retention ceiling, and all 319 observed failures in the bounded recency condition are caused by eviction rather than ranking errors. Recall falls to 0% as targets recede sufficiently far into the past. Repeating the evaluation on SQuAD preserves the retention ceiling while showing that dense retrieval can outperform lexical retrieval on natural text. These results show that bounded-memory evaluations should hold access fixed and report retention and selection separately.

AI.tldr: 提出流式召回基准，交叉保留与选择规则，在相同300个种子情景上评估，揭示记忆评估中访问、保留与选择决策被混淆的问题。
AI.motivation: 持久智能体需同时决定随信息到达保留什么、查询出现后呈现什么，但现有记忆评估常比较同时改变保留与选择的方法，无法区分二者贡献。
AI.method: 构建流式召回基准，交叉组合保留规则与选择规则，并对所有条件在相同300个种子情景上评估；在SQuAD上重复评估。
AI.result: 固定访问时，查询感知选择将必需事实召回提高15.5个百分点（95% CI：12.8至18.2）；混合比较因同时改变历史访问而报告68.7个百分点优势，其中53.2个百分点归因于访问。有界保留下，查询感知、稠密与oracle选择达到保留上限；有界近期条件下全部319次失败均由驱逐而非排序错误导致；目标退到足够久远时召回降至0%。SQuAD上保留上限保持，稠密检索在自然文本上可优于词法检索。
AI.conclusion: 有界记忆评估应固定访问条件，并分别报告保留与选择的性能。

title: When Harnesses Lose the Signal: Causal Evaluation of Recovery in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents rely on external harnesses to pass information between the model and its environment and to recover from execution errors. Yet recovery is usually judged only by average task success. This hides an important tension. The same operation can rescue a failing trajectory or disrupt one that would otherwise succeed. We frame recovery as a causal decision problem. Starting from the same execution state, we compare what happens with and without recovery, separate rescue from harm, and study how the value of recovery changes over time. We then introduce the Causal Intervention Router (CIR), a lightweight policy that uses information available before recovery to decide when intervention is worthwhile. On long-horizon ALFWorld tasks with Qwen3-14B, CIR raises success from 70.33% to 73.33%, a gain of 3.00 percentage points. It leaves all evaluated trajectories with correct observations untouched. Additional controls show that the benefit of recovery cannot be explained solely by the new observation returned by the environment. These results provide a practical way to evaluate recovery and apply it selectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文将LLM智能体的“恢复”行为建模为因果决策问题，区分救援与伤害，并提出轻量策略CIR仅在有价值时才干预，在ALFWorld长程任务上将成功率从70.33%提升至73.33%。
AI.motivation: 现有评估通常只用平均任务成功率衡量恢复效果，掩盖了一个核心矛盾：同一恢复操作既可能挽救即将失败的轨迹，也可能破坏本可成功的轨迹。因此需要从因果视角重新刻画恢复的价值。
AI.method: 作者把恢复形式化为因果决策问题：从相同执行状态出发，对比“有恢复”与“无恢复”两种情形，将救援与伤害分离，并考察恢复价值随时间的变化；进而提出Causal Intervention Router（CIR），一种利用恢复前可用信息来判断是否值得干预的轻量策略。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-14B上的ALFWorld长程任务中，CIR将成功率从70.33%提升到73.33%，增益3.00个百分点；对所有观测正确的评估轨迹不做改动。额外对照实验表明，恢复收益不能仅由环境返回的新观测解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种实用的方法来评估恢复行为并有选择地施加恢复，使智能体在需要时被救援、在不必干预时保持原状。

title: JevSpawn: Adaptive Agentic Inference through Compositional Action Spaces
summary: LLM agents generate intermediate reasoning and actions token by token, making extended interactions slow and computationally expensive. Jev-style models offer fast probabilistic predictions over finite fields, but require those fields to be specified in advance. This requirement limits autonomous task solving, where the available actions must be derived from natural language instructions and adapted through interaction. We introduce JevSpawn, a compositional policy that connects natural language task specifications to finite probabilistic exploration. Parallel action spawning is coupled with feedback driven branch selection, representation revision, and recovery from retained alternatives. Shared action structure and model prefixes reduce repeated generation and context computation without additional training. Evaluations on eight benchmark tasks against seven agent baselines and a TypeSafe Jev variant establish JevSpawn as a promising approach to structured agentic inference, with improved task performance and faster navigation.

AI.tldr: JevSpawn 提出一种组合式策略，将自然语言任务规范与有限域概率探索连接，通过并行动作生成与反馈驱动的分支选择，在无需额外训练的情况下提升任务表现并加快导航。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体逐词元生成中间推理与动作，导致长交互缓慢且计算昂贵；Jev 类模型虽能对有限域做快速概率预测，但要求预先指定域，限制了需从自然语言指令中推导动作并随交互调整的自主任务求解。
AI.method: JevSpawn 组合策略：将自然语言任务规范映射到有限概率探索；并行动作生成与反馈驱动的分支选择相结合，并支持表示修订及对保留备选分支的恢复；利用共享动作结构与模型前缀减少重复生成与上下文计算，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在八个基准任务上，与七个智能体基线及一个 TypeSafe Jev 变体对比，JevSpawn 在任务性能与导航速度上均取得更优结果。
AI.conclusion: JevSpawn 是通向结构化智能体推理的有前景方法，兼顾性能提升与更快的导航，且无需额外训练。

title: Before Agents Decide: Epistemic Action in LLM-Based Systems
comment: Accepted at the Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Before a difficult decision, people often act simply to understand the situation better. We turn an object to see another side, place alternatives next to each other, or change one condition and observe what happens. These actions may not complete the task, but they improve the evidence needed for the next choice. LLM-based agents can search and explore, yet agent design gives less attention to an earlier question: is the available evidence ready for the decision? Sometimes necessary evidence is missing. In other cases, the evidence is present but its form hides what matters, or the comparison needed to judge it does not yet exist. Cognitive science calls actions that improve the basis for a later choice epistemic actions. We bring this idea to LLM-based agents and distinguish three modes: acquiring missing evidence, transforming available evidence, and probing a system to create a revealing response. We use the term epistemic scaffolding for the interfaces, tools, and environments that make these actions possible and auditable. This paper argues that agent design must address how decision-ready evidence is produced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出应将认知行动（epistemic actions）引入LLM智能体设计，区分三种模式——获取缺失证据、转化现有证据、探测系统以生成揭示性反馈，并引入"认知脚手架"概念指代支撑这些行动的界面、工具与环境，主张智能体设计必须关注决策就绪证据如何被生成。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体研究侧重搜索与探索，较少关注一个更前置的问题：现有证据是否已为决策做好准备。证据可能缺失、形式掩盖关键信息，或缺乏必要的比较条件。认知科学早已研究此类为后续选择改善证据基础的行动，但这一视角尚未被纳入智能体设计。
AI.method: 论文为立场/概念性工作。借鉴认知科学中"认知行动"概念，将其迁移至LLM智能体，归纳出三种模式：①获取缺失证据（acquiring missing evidence）；②转化可用证据（transforming available evidence）；③探测系统以产生揭示性响应（probing a system）。并定义"认知脚手架"（epistemic scaffolding）为支持这些行动且可审计的界面、工具与环境。
AI.result: 论文未报告实验或量化结果，属于理论论证型研究。其"成果"为提出一套概念框架：以证据就绪度为核心的分析视角，以及三种认知行动模式与认知脚手架的概念工具。
AI.conclusion: 智能体设计不应仅关注搜索与探索能力，还须系统性地解决决策就绪证据如何被产生、转化与验证的问题；认知行动与认知脚手架为这一设计目标提供了理论基点和可审计的实践路径。

title: Ontology-Based Contextual AI Evaluations (OB-CAIE) Methodology
summary: The ontology-based contextual AI evaluation (OB-CAIE) methodology was developed to address a lack of scientific rigor that arises from unclear testing coverage, to balance human expertise and automations, and to address a lack of reproducibility of AI evaluation testing environments. OB-CAIE strengthens the current state of AI evaluations by addressing the first step in the scientific method by clearly defining what will be tested. Two ontologies represent the tractable problem space in the OB-CAIE methodology: the Domain-Specific Ontology (DSO) and the Evaluation Process Ontology (EPO). The DSO is the what; the EPO is the how. An OB-CAIE problem space can be used for one or multiple AI evaluations. The OB-CAIE methodology allows for human judgment at specific points, in scientifically grounded ways, and in complex subject areas where human feedback is genuinely irreducible or machine irreplaceable. A key advantage of the OB-CAIE methodology is that failure points can be traced, visualized and analyzed within the canonical OB-CAIE methodology problem space.

AI.tldr: 提出OB-CAIE（基于本体的情境化AI评估）方法，通过领域本体（DSO，测什么）与评估过程本体（EPO，怎么测）界定可处理的评估问题空间，以提升AI评估的科学严谨性、可复现性，并在必要环节保留人类判断。
AI.motivation: 现有AI评估存在测试覆盖不清晰导致的科学严谨性不足、人机专长与自动化配置失衡，以及评估测试环境缺乏可复现性等问题。
AI.method: 构建OB-CAIE方法论，以两个本体刻画问题空间：领域特定本体（DSO）定义评估对象（what），评估过程本体（EPO）定义评估流程（how）；同一问题空间可支持单项或多项AI评估，并在特定节点以科学化方式引入人工判断。
AI.result: 通过明确界定"测什么"来强化科学方法的第一步；使人类反馈在复杂、不可约或机器不可替代的领域中得到科学化利用；失败点可在规范化的OB-CAIE问题空间内被追溯、可视化与分析。
AI.conclusion: OB-CAIE通过本体驱动的规范化问题空间，平衡人机分工并提升AI评估的严谨性、可复现性与失败可追溯性。

title: Science or Slop?: Benchmarking and Mitigating Scientific Slop in AI-Generated Papers
summary: AI-generated content, often called AI slop, is increasingly common everywhere, particularly in academia. Slop in AI-generated scientific papers, however, has more complex patterns that cannot be easily detected by existing token-based AI detectors. Each part of such a paper looks plausible while the scientific reasoning that connects the parts breaks down, which can mislead how readers assess the work. We benchmark these failures as scientific slop through six measures across Structure, Argument, and Artifacts. We construct SciSlopBench with 390 AI-generated papers, mostly in computer science but spanning the life, social, and natural sciences, each paired with a human-written paper matched by research problem and contribution type. Our measures identify the AI paper in each pair with 85.9% accuracy, compared with 68.7% for Binoculars. Higher scientific slop accompanies lower ICLR ratings and distinguishes rejected from accepted papers above chance in every year from 2017 to 2025. Reducing these patterns, however, is not as simple as directly optimizing the measures. We therefore propose SciSlopHarness, a harness-level framework that guides a fixed LLM to revise slop only where the experiment records support the change. While standard revisions leave residual slop and direct slop-aware prompting triggers reward hacking, SciSlopHarness reduces the remaining AI-human gap by 63% over the strongest revision baseline without requiring human reference targets. Overall, we demonstrate that AI-generated scientific papers leave fundamental traces in their global reasoning, and that responsible mitigation demands strict evidentiary grounding rather than mere prose refinement.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"科学slop"概念及六项度量（覆盖结构、论证、制品），构建SciSlopBench基准与SciSlopHarness修正框架，证明AI生成论文在全局推理上留下可检测痕迹。
AI.motivation: AI生成内容（AI slop）在学术界日益普遍，但科学论文中的slop模式更复杂，现有基于token的AI检测器难以识别：每个部分看似合理，但连接各部分的科学推理断裂，会误导读者对工作的评估。
AI.method: 构建SciSlopBench，含390篇AI生成论文（以计算机科学为主，涵盖生命、社会与自然科学），每篇配一篇研究问题和贡献类型匹配的人类撰写论文。提出六项度量，跨越结构（Structure）、论证（Argument）和制品（Artifacts）三个维度。进而提出SciSlopHarness——一种harness级框架，引导固定LLM仅在实验记录支持变更处进行修订。
AI.result: 度量在每对论文中以85.9%准确率识别AI论文，优于Binoculars的68.7%。科学slop越高，ICLR评分越低，且在2017至2025每年都能高于随机水平地区分被拒与接收论文。标准修订会残留slop，直接的slop感知提示会触发reward hacking；SciSlopHarness在不需人类参考目标的情况下，将剩余AI-人类差距相对最强修订基线缩减63%。
AI.conclusion: AI生成科学论文在全局推理中留下根本性痕迹；负责任的缓解需要严格的证据支撑，而非单纯的文字润色。

title: Worse Together: How Performance Breaks Down in Multi-User Multi-Agent Teams
comment: 63 pages, 22 Figures, 10 Tables, Code: https://github.com/safety-research/MAMUBench (will be released after review)
summary: People are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, and those agents are increasingly encountering other people's agents over shared resources such as a codebase, a calendar, or a budget. When each agent acts for a different user with different goals, coordination often fails, and the group ends up worse off than if a single agent had acted for everyone. We study this multi-user, multi-agent setting across five frontier models and 77 scenarios in four environments: an API key environment in which agents share a compute budget, a clinic in which they share a calendar, a personal assistant environment in which they share a group order or booking, and a merge queue in which they share a release cutoff. In each scenario, we compare a single agent that serves every user (a coordinator) to a team in which each agent serves one user, with and without a communication channel between the agents. Teams deliver worse group outcomes than the coordinator in every environment: without a channel, they completely collapse in two environments, and even with one, coordination overhead creates substantial gaps. For example, in the personal assistant environment, the coordinator fulfills a targeted user request about twice as often as teams. We identify distinct behaviors associated with this poor group-level performance, including stalling as teams grow, overriding each other's actions, and fabricating claims. We find effective but environment-specific mitigations, such as a team lead, explicit procedural instructions, and a platform check that makes an agent read its peers' messages before committing. We will release the API key, clinic, and personal assistant environments as MAMUBench, comprising 74 scenarios for evaluating multi-user, multi-agent coordination.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了多用户多智能体协调基准，覆盖5个前沿模型、4类环境、77个场景，发现团队形态在多用户场景下普遍劣于单一协调者智能体，并识别出导致群体表现差的典型行为及环境特定缓解手段。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体被广泛用于代理用户任务，不同用户的智能体常需在共享资源（代码库、日历、预算等）上交互。当各智能体代表目标不同的用户时，协调往往失败，群体结果甚至比由单一智能体服务所有用户更差，这一多用户多智能体协调问题缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 在5个前沿模型、4类环境（API密钥/compute预算、诊所/共享日历、个人助理/共享团购或预订、合并队列/发布截止时间）共77个场景中，对比"单一协调者智能体服务全部用户"与"每个智能体服务一个用户的团队"两种设置，并区分有无智能体间通信通道。同时分析失败行为并测试多种缓解措施。
AI.result: 在所有环境中，团队形态的群体结果均劣于协调者。无通信通道时，团队在两个环境中完全崩溃；即便有通信通道，协调开销仍造成显著差距。例如个人助理环境中，协调者满足目标用户请求的频率约为团队的两倍。识别出与群体表现差相关的行为：随团队规模扩大而停滞、相互覆盖对方操作、编造声明。有效的缓解手段具有环境特异性，包括设置团队负责人、给出显式流程指令、以及平台层面强制智能体提交前阅读同伴消息。
AI.conclusion: 多用户多智能体协调是当前前沿模型的显著短板，且缓解手段难以跨环境泛化。作者将发布MAMUBench（含API密钥、诊所、个人助理三类环境共74个场景）以支持后续多用户多智能体协调研究。

title: Incident-Arena: Getting agents to the last nine of reliability
summary: AI coding agents are ubiquitous in engineering workflows amongst industry and academia. Yet, despite their use in app coding, relatively less attention has been paid to their ability to execute on production incident response. This emerging field, termed agentic site-reliability-engineering (SRE) contains benchmarks limited by (1) unrealistic environments, typically toy repositories (2) non-standard framework implementations and (3) simple static verifiers. We introduce Incident-Arena, a human-built benchmark of 20 carefully selected tasks grounded in real-world deployed open source software. Each task deploys a production application to an ephemeral Kubernetes cluster, injecting a fault from the config layer through underlying images, and a sustained load profile given the task requirements. We also present a novel verification method, going beyond static checks to functional verifiers, holding systems level metrics stable, while ensuring repairs are done safely. Agent trials run an average of 2.81M tokens and 41 turns, going beyond existing benchmarks, demonstrating agentic long horizon reasoning. Across 20 tasks and 3 application substrates, frontier models score below 64.3%, with failures extending from diagnosis/localization errors, through incomplete repairs and unsafe regressions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Incident-Arena，一个基于真实生产开源软件、在临时 Kubernetes 集群中注入故障的 20 任务基准，用于评测 AI 编码智能体在站点可靠性工程（SRE）事故响应中的长时程推理能力，并引入功能性验证器替代静态检查；前沿模型得分低于 64.3%。
AI.motivation: AI 编码智能体已广泛用于工程流程，但其在生产事故响应（agentic SRE）中的能力研究不足；现有基准存在三大局限：环境不真实（多为玩具仓库）、框架实现非标准、验证器为简单静态检查。
